name: Edward H Adelson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: John and Dorothy Wilson Professor
summary: Studies visual perception, including mid-level visual processing and the perception of materials, using image statistics and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知，包括中级视觉处理和材料感知，使用图像统计和计算方法。

name: Polina Anikeeva
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Department Head DMSE/Professor
summary: Develops optoelectronic and magnetic devices to study and treat brain disorders such as depression and Parkinson’s disease.
summary_zh: 设计和制造光电子和磁性设备，以研究和治疗抑郁症、帕金森病等神经系统疾病。

name: Mark Bear
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Picower Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the brain is modified by experience, deprivation, and disease, focusing on synaptic plasticity in the visual cortex and hippocampus.
summary_zh: 研究经验、剥夺和疾病如何改变大脑，重点关注视觉皮层和海马体的突触可塑性。

name: Edward Stuart Boyden
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Develops tools for analyzing and repairing the brain, including optogenetics and expansion microscopy.
summary_zh: 开发分析和修复大脑的工具，包括光遗传学和扩展显微镜。

name: Emery N Brown
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods and signal-processing algorithms to analyze neural data, focusing on understanding general anesthesia and circadian rhythms.
summary_zh: 开发统计方法和信号处理算法来分析神经数据，重点理解全身麻醉和昼夜节律。

name: Gloria Choi
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sensory stimuli drive behavioral responses and internal states, focusing on olfactory circuits and learning mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究感觉刺激如何驱动行为反应和内部状态，重点关注嗅觉回路和学习机制。

name: Kwanghun Chung
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops and applies novel technologies for 3D imaging and phenotyping of biological systems to study brain function and dysfunction.
summary_zh: 开发和应用新型技术进行生物系统的三维成像和表型分析，以研究大脑的功能和功能障碍。

name: Robert Desimone
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Director, McGovern Institute & Berkey Professor
summary: Studies how the brain selectively amplifies relevant information and suppresses distractions through synchronized neuronal activity, particularly in the prefrontal cortex.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过同步神经活动选择性地放大相关信息并抑制干扰，特别是在前额叶皮层。

name: James DiCarlo
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Director, Quest/Professor
summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms of visual object recognition using neurophysiology, fMRI, and computational modeling in awake, behaving non-human primates.
summary_zh: 研究视觉物体识别的神经机制，使用清醒行为非人灵长类动物的神经生理学、功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算建模方法。

name: Sven Dorkenwald
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Silverman (1968) Family Career Development Assistant Professor
summary: Develops computational tools to map and analyze synapse-resolution connectomes, investigating how neuronal circuits are organized in the brain.
summary_zh: 开发计算工具来绘制和分析神经元连接组，研究神经回路的组织方式及其如何支持复杂的计算。

name: Linlin Fan
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: joined the Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences as an Assistant Professor in 2024 and was named Samuel A
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的认知和神经机制，使用计算模型和行为实验方法。

name: Evelina Fedorenko
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people understand and produce language using behavioral and brain imaging methods in healthy adults and patients, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何理解和产生语言，使用行为和脑成像方法在健康成人和患者中以及计算建模。

name: Michale S Fee
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Dept Head, BCS & Dorflinger Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of complex sequence generation and learning in songbirds, focusing on circuitry in RA and HVC.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类歌声序列生成和学习的神经机制，重点关注RA和HVC回路。

name: Guoping Feng
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies molecular mechanisms regulating neuron-neuron communications and synaptic function, using genetic models to understand autism, OCD, depression and schizophrenia.
summary_zh: 研究神经元间通讯和突触功能的分子机制，使用遗传模型来理解自闭症、强迫症、抑郁症和精神分裂症。

name: Ila Fiete
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of memory, integration, and learning in the brain and deep networks using computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究大脑和深度网络中的记忆、整合和学习机制，使用计算建模技术。

name: Steven Flavell
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how neuromodulators like serotonin control long-lasting behavioral states in nematodes, using genetics, optogenetics, and calcium imaging.
summary_zh: 研究神经递质如血清素如何控制动物长时间的行为状态，使用遗传学、光遗传学和钙成像技术。

name: John D. E. Gabrieli
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Grover M. Hermann Professor
summary: Studies neurodevelopmental and mental health differences using MRI and EEG, focusing on brain-behavior relations across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育和心理健康差异，使用MRI和EEG，关注生命各阶段的大脑-行为关系。

name: Edward A Gibson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the syntax of human languages and how people process and learn language using behavioral experiments and statistical modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言的句法以及人们如何学习和处理语言，使用行为实验和统计建模方法。

name: Ann M. Graybiel
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Institute Professor and Professor in BCS
summary: Studies the mechanisms of the basal ganglia in learning and memory, focusing on habits and their relation to cognition, emotion, and disease.
summary_zh: 研究基底节在学习和记忆中的机制，重点关注习惯与认知、情绪和疾病的关系。

name: Mark Harnett
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how biophysical features of neurons enable complex computations in neural circuits, using electrophysiology and imaging in behaving animals.
summary_zh: 研究神经元的生物物理特征如何使神经回路能够执行复杂的计算，使用电生理学和成像技术在行为动物中进行研究。

name: Susan Hockfield
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Whitehead Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies molecular substrates of mammalian brain development, focusing on aggrecan and BEHAB/brevican proteins.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑发育的分子机制，重点在于aggrecan和BEHAB/brevican蛋白。

name: Alan Pradip Jasanoff
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Develops next-generation brain imaging techniques to study neural mechanisms of behavior and cognition in live animals.
summary_zh: 开发下一代脑成像技术，研究行为和认知的神经机制在活体动物中的表现。

name: Mehrdad Jazayeri
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Teaches quantitative methods and computational models in neuroscience, helping students analyze and model neurobiological data.
summary_zh: 教授神经科学中的定量方法和计算模型，帮助学生分析和建模神经生物学数据。

name: Nancy Kanwisher
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Walter A Rosenblith Professor
summary: Studies the functional organization of the brain, focusing on specific regions involved in visual perception, social cognition, and intuitive physics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑的功能组织，重点关注涉及视觉感知、社会认知和直观物理的具体脑区。

name: Roger Levy
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how linguistic communication resolves uncertainty, using computational modeling and psycholinguistic experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言交流如何解决不确定性，使用计算建模和心理语言学实验。

name: Troy Littleton
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Menicon Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms of synaptic formation and function using Drosophila genetics and electrophysiology, with implications for neurological diseases.
summary_zh: 研究突触形成和功能的机制，使用果蝇遗传学和电生理学方法，对神经退行性疾病具有重要意义。

name: Josh McDermott
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Uncas (1923) and Helen Whitaker Professor
summary: Studies how people hear, focusing on sound recognition, cocktail party problem, and music perception using behavioral experiments and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类听觉，包括声音识别、鸡尾酒会问题和音乐感知，使用行为实验和计算建模方法。

name: Earl K Miller
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Picower Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory, attention, and executive control using multiple-electrode neurophysiology and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆、注意力和执行控制的神经机制，采用多电极神经生理学和计算方法。

name: Elly Nedivi
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: William R. (1964) and Linda R. Young Professor
summary: Studies the molecular genetic analysis of synaptic plasticity, focusing on activity-regulated genes and their roles in neuronal and synaptic function.
summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性的分子遗传分析，重点关注活动调节基因及其在神经元和突触功能中的作用。

name: Tomaso A Poggio
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Eugene McDermott Professor in the Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the computational basis of intelligence, including learning, memory, and visual understanding, using mathematical theories and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究智能的计算基础，包括学习、记忆和视觉理解，使用数学理论和计算模型。

name: Drazen Prelec
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Digital Equipment Corp LGO Professor of Management
summary: Studies decision-making processes, including self-control and consumer behavior, using behavioral and fMRI methods.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程，包括自我控制和消费者行为，使用行为和fMRI方法。

name: Sara Prescott
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies memory and learning processes, using techniques from cognitive neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习过程，使用认知神经科学的技术。

name: Alexander Rakhlin
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Richard Larson Professor
summary: Studies machine learning and statistics, focusing on online prediction, deep learning, and high-dimensional statistics.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习和统计学，专注于在线预测、深度学习和高维统计。

name: Robert Mark Richardson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain electrophysiology and behavior in patients undergoing functional neurosurgery, focusing on basal ganglia-cortical dynamics and closed-loop brain stimulation for epilepsy.
summary_zh: 研究功能性神经外科手术中的人类大脑电生理和行为，重点是基底节-皮层动态和癫痫的闭环脑刺激。

name: Rebecca R Saxe
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Dean & Jarve Professor
summary: Studies the development and neural basis of social cognition, focusing on how people think about others and make moral judgments.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知的发展和神经基础，关注人们如何思考他人以及进行道德判断。

name: Laura E Schulz
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: John & Dorothy Wilson Professor
summary: Studies how children learn concepts and causal relations, using computational models and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习概念和因果关系，使用计算模型和婴儿注视时间实验。

name: Nidhi Seethapathi
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the computational objectives governing movement decisions, the strategies used to execute movement, and how new movements are learned.
summary_zh: 研究运动决策背后的计算目标、执行运动所使用的策略以及如何学习新运动。

name: Morgan Hwa-Tze Sheng
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor Sheng received a B.A. (1st class honors) from Oxford University and obtained his medical degree and training at Lon
summary: Studies the molecular and cell biology of synapses and synaptic plasticity, and the pathogenic mechanisms of neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究突触和突触可塑性的分子和细胞生物学，以及神经退行性疾病和精神障碍的致病机制。

name: Pawan Sinha
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain recognizes objects through visual experience, using experimental and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉经验如何使大脑识别物体，采用实验和计算方法。

name: Mriganka Sur
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development, plasticity, and dynamics of cerebral cortex circuits using experimental and theoretical approaches, identifying mechanisms of brain disorders and proposing novel therapeutics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层回路的发育、可塑性和动态变化，通过实验和理论方法识别大脑疾病的机制并提出新型治疗方法。

name: Joshua B Tenenbaum
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Whitehead Professor
summary: Studies the computational basis of human learning and inference, using behavioral testing, mathematical modeling, and formal tools like Bayesian statistics.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习和推理的计算基础，使用行为测试、数学建模和贝叶斯统计等正式工具。

name: Fan Wang
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of general anesthesia, pain perception, and movement control, discovering new pathways and circuits.
summary_zh: 研究全身麻醉、疼痛感知和运动控制的神经机制，发现新的通路和电路。

name: Brandon Weissbourd
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the transcriptional shifts across cell types in jellyfish, using single-cell RNA-seq and genetic models.
summary_zh: 研究水母细胞类型中的转录变化，使用单细胞RNA测序和遗传模型。

name: Matthew A Wilson
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Sherman Fairchild Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how memories form and persist, focusing on neural activity in the hippocampus and neocortex during waking and sleep.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的形成和持久性，重点关注海马和新皮层在清醒和睡眠期间的神经活动。

name: Feng Zhang
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: James & Patricia Poitras Professor in Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和神经影像技术研究学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Timothy Buschman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the roles of prefrontal cortex, parietal cortex, and basal ganglia in executive control, using behavioral tasks, electrophysiology, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层、顶叶皮层和基底节在执行控制中的作用，使用行为任务、电生理学和光遗传学方法。

name: Rebecca Carey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social class influences close relationships and their impact on health and well-being, focusing on lower-class contexts.
summary_zh: 研究社会阶层如何影响亲密关系及其对健康和福祉的影响，重点关注低阶层群体。

name: Jonathan Cohen
title: Robert Bendheim and Lynn Bendheim Thoman Professor in Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of cognitive control and its disturbances in psychiatric disorders like schizophrenia and depression.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制的神经生物学机制及其在精神疾病如精神分裂症和抑郁症中的紊乱。

name: Alin Coman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social cognition shapes collective behaviors, using cognitive methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知如何塑造集体行为，采用认知方法。

name: Joel Cooper
title: Professor
summary: Studies attitudes and attitude change, particularly cognitive dissonance and its vicarious experience.
summary_zh: 研究态度及其变化，特别是认知失调及其他人的间接体验。

name: Molly Crockett
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social and technological factors influence knowledge and moral beliefs, using experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究社会和技术因素如何影响知识和道德信念，使用实验和计算模型方法。

name: Nathaniel Daw
title: Huo Professor in Computational and Theoretical Neuroscience
summary: Studies how people and animals learn from trial and error to make decisions, combining computational, neural, and behavioral perspectives.
summary_zh: 研究人和动物如何通过试错学习进行决策，结合计算、神经和行为视角。

name: Asif Ghazanfar
title: Professor
summary: Studies the developmental and evolutionary bases of social communication, focusing on the interaction between neural systems, the body, and socioecological context.
summary_zh: 研究社会交流的发育和进化基础，重点关注神经系统、身体和社会生态背景之间的相互作用。

name: Adele Goldberg
title: Moses Taylor Pyne Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how humans learn language using general cognitive processes and brain mechanisms, focusing on constructions and metaphors.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何使用一般认知过程和大脑机制学习语言，重点关注构式和隐喻。

name: Michael Graziano
title: Professor
summary: Studies the brain basis of consciousness, focusing on how the brain arrives at the conclusion of having subjective experience.
summary_zh: 研究意识的脑基础，关注大脑如何得出具有主观体验的结论。

name: Tom Griffiths
title: Henry R. Luce Professor of Information Technology, Consciousness and Culture
summary: Studies how people solve complex computational problems, using methods from statistics, machine learning, and AI to explain human behavior.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何解决复杂的计算问题，使用统计学、机器学习和人工智能的方法来解释人类行为。

name: Uri Hasson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of brain-to-brain communication and natural language processing using ECoG data and deep learning models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑之间的交流和自然语言处理的神经基础，使用ECoG数据和深度学习模型。

name: Sabine Kastner
title: Professor
summary: Studies large-scale brain networks during cognition using electrophysiology and imaging in humans and macaques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程中大规模脑网络的运作机制，使用电生理学和成像技术在人类和猕猴中进行研究。

name: Brenden Lake
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies human cognitive abilities like few-shot learning and goal generation, using neural network modeling and child behavior data.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知能力如少量学习和目标生成，使用神经网络建模和儿童行为数据。

name: Casey Lew-Williams
title: Professor
summary: Studies how young children learn from their communicative environments using eye movements, infant-directed speech, and neural synchrony.
summary_zh: 研究婴幼儿如何从交流环境中学习，使用眼动、婴儿定向言语和神经同步的方法。

name: Tania Lombrozo
title: Arthur W. Marks ’19 Professor
summary: Studies how people explain their environment, learning, judgments, and decisions, blending psychology and philosophy.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何解释环境、学习、判断和决策，结合心理学和哲学的方法。

name: Yael Niv
title: Professor
summary: Studies reinforcement learning and decision-making processes, using computational models to understand optimal brain mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究强化学习和决策过程，使用计算模型来理解最优的大脑机制。

name: Kenneth Norman
title: Huo Professor in Computational and Theoretical Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the brain forms and modifies memories, using computational models and neuroimaging to explore learning rules and the role of sleep.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成和修改记忆，使用计算模型和神经成像探索学习规则和睡眠的作用。

name: Kristina Olson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults understand and navigate gender diversity, focusing on identity development and social transitions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何理解和应对性别多样性，重点关注身份发展和社会过渡。

name: Elizabeth Levy Paluck
title: Eugene Higgins Professor of Psychology and Public Affairs
summary: Studies how social norms and behaviors shift in real-world settings using field experiments and large-scale interventions to reduce prejudice and intergroup conflict.
summary_zh: 研究社会规范和行为在现实世界中的变化，通过大规模实地实验和干预措施减少偏见和群体冲突。

name: Emily Pronin
title: Professor
summary: Studies self-perception versus other-perception asymmetries and the effects of thought speed on mood and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究自我感知与他人感知的不对称以及思维速度对情绪和行为的影响。

name: Eldar Shafir
title: Class of 1987 Professor in Behavioral Science and Public Policy
summary: Studies reasoning, judgment, and decision-making, particularly in contexts of poverty and policy applications.
summary_zh: 研究推理、判断和决策，特别是在贫困情境下的决策以及政策应用。

name: Anuj Shah
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of attention and automaticity in decision-making and social conflict, using lab and field experiments to inform public policy.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和自动化在决策和社会冲突中的作用，使用实验室和实地实验来指导公共政策。

name: Nicole Shelton
title: Stuart Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how prejudice and situational factors affect intergroup interactions and the development of cross-racial friendships.
summary_zh: 研究偏见和情境因素如何影响跨种族互动以及跨种族友谊的发展。

name: Stacey Sinclair
title: Professor
summary: Studies how interpersonal interactions shape individual thoughts and actions through social tuning and implicit homophily, without conscious awareness.
summary_zh: 研究人际互动如何通过社会调谐和隐含的同质性影响个体的思想和行为，而无需意识参与。

name: Susan Sugarman
title: Professor
summary: Studies everyday human experiences and the mind through comparisons of childhood and adulthood, and examines historical psychological thinking from Aristotle to Freud.
summary_zh: 研究日常人类经验和心智，通过将儿童期与成年期进行比较，并探讨从亚里士多德到弗洛伊德的心理学思想史。

name: Diana Tamir
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human mind thinks about and predicts others' minds, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类思维如何思考和预测他人的心智，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

name: Jordan Taylor
title: Professor
summary: Studies how explicit cognitive strategies interact with implicit motor adaptation during skill acquisition, using computational processes and neural systems.
summary_zh: 研究显性认知策略与隐性运动适应在技能习得中的相互作用，通过计算过程和神经系统的分析。

name: Taylor Webb
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how higher-order cognitive processes like reasoning and metacognition are implemented in distributed neural networks, both biological and artificial.
summary_zh: 研究推理和元认知等高级认知过程在生物和人工分布式神经网络中的实现机制。

name: Elke Weber
title: Gerhard R. Andlinger Professor in Energy and the Environment
summary: Studies decision-making processes and their application to environmental and financial decisions, using a variety of methods including lab and field experiments.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程及其在环境和金融决策中的应用，使用实验室和实地实验等多种方法。

name: Carlos Brody
title: Wilbur H. Gantz III '59 Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies cognitive processes like memory and decision-making in rats using computational and behavioral techniques.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的认知过程，如记忆和决策，使用计算和行为技术。

name: Tatiana Engel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how coordinated neural activity drives behavior and cognition using computational and theoretical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究分布式神经环路如何驱动行为和认知功能，采用计算和理论方法。

name: Annegret Falkner
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social experience and internal state influence sensory perception and social motivation, shaping behavioral choices in mice.
summary_zh: 研究社会经验和内部状态如何影响感觉感知和社会动机，从而塑造小鼠的行为选择。

name: Jesse Gomez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of the human brain and its cognitive functions from gestation to adolescence, using fMRI, qMRI, dMRI, and behavioral observations.
summary_zh: 研究从妊娠到青春期的人类大脑及其认知功能的发展，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、定量磁共振成像（qMRI）、扩散加权磁共振成像（dMRI）和行为观察。

name: Elizabeth Gould
title: Dorman T. Warren Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how brain plasticity contributes to behavior during development and adulthood, using neurogenesis, synaptogenesis, and hormone manipulations.
summary_zh: 研究大脑可塑性在发育和成年期对行为的影响，使用神经发生、突触发生和激素操纵的方法。

name: Christina K. Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and molecular mechanisms underlying cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和分子机制，了解认知功能。

name: Andrew Leifer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how collective neural activity drives animal behavior and higher cognitive functions in C. elegans using optical recording techniques.
summary_zh: 研究集体神经活动如何驱动动物行为和高级认知功能，使用光学记录技术在秀丽隐杆线虫中进行研究。

name: Carolyn McBride
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and neuronal basis of behavior in mosquitoes, focusing on how changes in olfactory circuits drive preference for human odor.
summary_zh: 研究蚊子（如埃及伊蚊）的行为遗传和神经基础，特别是如何改变嗅觉回路驱动蚊子偏好人类气味。

name: Mala Murthy
title: Karol and Marnie Marcin ’96 Professor of Neuroscience
areas: Neural Mechanisms Underlying Social Communication in Flies
summary: Studies how male flies use visual and self-motion cues to pattern their courtship songs, and how female flies process these songs to choose mates.
summary_zh: 研究雄性果蝇如何使用视觉和自我运动线索来调节其求偶歌声，并研究雌性果蝇如何处理这些歌声以选择配偶。

name: Catherine Jensen Peña
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how early life stress affects brain development, using rodent behavior and RNA sequencing to understand mechanisms of depression risk.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响大脑发育，使用啮齿动物行为和RNA测序来理解抑郁症风险的机制。

name: Jonathan Pillow
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods for analyzing neural data and studies sensory-motor decision making and working memory.
summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析神经数据，研究感觉-运动决策和工作记忆。

name: H. Sebastian Seung
title: Anthony B. Evnin Professor in Neuroscience
summary: Studies brain wiring diagrams using connectomics to understand brain function and development, particularly in fly and mouse visual systems.
summary_zh: 研究大脑连接图谱以理解脑功能和发育，特别是在果蝇和小鼠视觉系统中的应用。

name: David Tank
title: Henry L. Hillman Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies persistent neural activity in neural circuits, linking it to short-term memory across various brain areas and species.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路中的持久神经活动，将其与不同脑区和物种中的短期记忆联系起来。

name: Samuel S. Wang
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of the cerebellum in sensorimotor learning, working memory, and social interaction in mice.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠中延髓在传感器运动学习、工作记忆和社会互动中的作用。

name: Ilana Witten
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits for reward learning and decision making using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究奖励学习和决策的神经电路机制，使用光遗传学、电生理学和计算建模方法。

name: Leah H. Somerville
title: Grafstein Family Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how brain development through adolescence shapes cognitive, motivational, and social changes using psychological and neuroscientific approaches.
summary_zh: 研究青春期大脑发展如何塑造认知、动机和社会方面的变化，采用心理和神经科学方法。

name: George A. Alvarez
title: Fred Kavli Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the human visual system selects and tracks objects, enabling navigation and object recognition.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉系统如何选择和跟踪物体，从而实现导航和物体识别。

name: Ashwini Ashokkumar
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how identities influence political discourse and how discourse affects social cohesion.
summary_zh: 研究身份如何影响政治话语以及话语如何影响社会凝聚力。

name: Mahzarin R. Banaji
title: Richard Clarke Cabot Professor of Social Ethics
summary: Studies social attitudes and beliefs in adults and children, focusing on implicit mental systems.
summary_zh: 研究成年人和儿童的社会态度和信念，特别是关注隐性心理系统。

name: Elika Bergelson
title: John L. Loeb Associate Professor of the Social Sciences
summary: Studies how infants and toddlers learn words from their environment, using observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和学龄前儿童如何从环境学习词汇，采用观察方法。

name: Randy L. Buckner
title: Sosland Family Professor of Psychology and of Neuroscience
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using neuroimaging techniques in humans.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究人类行为的脑系统。

name: Mark Chen
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how emotion and emotion regulation processes are shaped by adverse life experiences and contribute to psychopathology across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和情绪调节过程如何受到不良生活经历的影响，并在生命不同阶段的精神障碍中发挥什么作用。

name: Mina Cikara
title: Fredric Wertham Professor of Law and Psychiatry in Society
summary: Studies how social context influences mind, brain, and behavior, particularly how group membership and prejudice affect cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境如何影响认知、大脑和行为，特别是群体归属感和偏见如何影响认知过程。

name: Fiery Cushman
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the functional principles underlying moral judgment, focusing on how punishments and rewards influence behavior.
summary_zh: 研究道德判断的基本功能原则，关注惩罚和奖励如何影响行为。

name: Samuel J. Gershman
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how richly structured knowledge about the environment is acquired and aids adaptive behavior, using behavioral, neuroimaging, and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究环境知识的获取及其对适应性行为的作用，采用行为学、神经成像和计算方法。

name: Daniel Gilbert
title: Edgar Pierce Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people predict and experience happiness, using experiments and popular books.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何预测和体验幸福，使用实验和通俗书籍。

name: Joshua D. Greene
title: Alfred and Rebecca Lin Professor of Civil Discourse
summary: Studies the mechanics of moral thinking and high-level cognition using behavioral experiments and functional neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究道德思维和高级认知的机制，使用行为实验和功能性神经成像。

name: Mark L. Hatzenbuehler
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the biopsychosocial mechanisms contributing to mental health outcomes among minority group members, focusing on stigma.
summary_zh: 研究生物心理社会机制如何影响少数群体成员的心理健康结果，重点关注污名的作用。

name: Jill M. Hooley
title: John Lindsley Professor of Psychology in Memory of William James
summary: Studies psychosocial predictors of psychiatric relapse in patients with severe psychopathology such as schizophrenia, depression, and borderline personality disorder.
summary_zh: 研究严重精神病学障碍（如精神分裂症、抑郁症和边缘型人格障碍）患者的精神社会预测因素，以预防精神病复发。

name: Joshua Conrad Jackson
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people’s psychologies change in larger, diverse, economically developed, and interconnected societies.
summary_zh: 研究社会规模更大、多样性更高、经济更发达和相互联系更紧密时人们心理的变化。

name: Talia Konkle
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how we see and understand the visual world using behavioral techniques and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究我们如何通过行为技术和神经成像理解视觉世界。

name: Ellen Langer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people can be made more mindful in their daily lives, using experiments and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过实验和干预使人们在日常生活中更加有意识。

name: Richard J. McNally
title: Professor
summary: Studies anxiety and related disorders, including panic disorder, specific phobia, OCD, social anxiety disorder, and PTSD.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑及相关障碍，包括恐慌障碍、特定恐惧症、强迫症、社交焦虑障碍和 PTSD。

name: Jason P. Mitchell
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes supporting inferences about others' psychological states and introspective awareness using neuroimaging and behavioral measures.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像和行为测量方法研究支持推断他人心理状态和内省意识的认知过程。

name: Matthew K. Nock
title: Edgar Pierce Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the reasons behind self-harm behaviors, focusing on suicide, using interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究自我伤害行为的原因，重点关注自杀，采用跨学科方法。

name: Elizabeth A. Phelps
title: Pershing Square Professor of Human Neuroscience
summary: Studies how emotions influence thoughts and actions, using human neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响思维和行为，采用人类神经科学方法。

name: Steven Pinker
title: Johnstone Family Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies language, mind, and human nature using experimental cognitive psychology methods.
summary_zh: 使用实验认知心理学方法研究语言、心智和人性。

name: Daniel L. Schacter
title: William R. Kenan, Jr. Professor
summary: Studies the constructive nature of human memory using cognitive, neuropsychological, and neuroimaging approaches.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的构建性质，使用认知、神经心理学和神经影像学方法。

name: Jesse Snedeker
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies language development, comprehension, production and representation in typically developing children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究语言发展、理解、产生和表示，涉及正常发育的儿童和成人。

name: Elizabeth S. Spelke
title: Marshall L. Berkman Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the origins and growth of human infants' cognitive capacities, especially their fast and flexible learning.
summary_zh: 研究人类婴儿认知能力的起源和发展，特别是他们快速灵活的学习能力。

name: Ashley Thomas
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how infants, toddlers, and children learn about social hierarchy and navigate social networks.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿、幼儿和儿童如何学习社会等级并导航社交网络。

name: Tomer D. Ullman
title: Morris Kahn Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies common-sense reasoning and computational models for cognitive processes in children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究常识推理和认知过程的计算模型，特别是在儿童和成人中的应用。

name: Woo-kyoung Ahn
title: John Hay Whitney Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people learn and represent concepts and causal relations, and how these processes affect thinking and clinical diagnoses.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何学习和表征概念及因果关系，以及这些过程如何影响思维和临床诊断。

name: Arielle Baskin-Sommers
title: Professor of Psychology and of Psychiatry, Head of Silliman College
summary: Studies cognitive-affective deficits associated with disinhibition in psychopathology, using interdisciplinary methods to develop syndrome-specific interventions.
summary_zh: 研究与心理障碍相关的抑制不足的认知情感缺陷，使用跨学科方法开发特定综合征的干预措施。

name: Dani S. Bassett
title: Professor
summary: Studies dynamic changes in network architecture and their influence on system function in physical and biological systems, including brain connectivity and cognitive development.
summary_zh: 研究网络结构动态变化及其对系统功能的影响，包括物理和生物系统中的网络结构以及大脑连接性和认知发展。

name: Tyrone Cannon
title: Clark L. Hull Professor of Psychology and Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the interplay between psychological phenomena and neurobiological mechanisms in people with schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, focusing on the emergence of psychosis and developing.
summary_zh: 研究心理现象与神经生物学机制在精神分裂症和双相情感障碍患者中的相互作用，特别是精神病症状的出现及其预防策略。

name: Nicolò Cesana-Arlotti
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies logical cognition and its development in infants and children, combining developmental psychology, vision science, and psycholinguistics.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的认知逻辑及其发展，结合发展心理学、视觉科学和语义语言学的方法。

name: Steve Chang
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain computes social preferences and mediates prosocial and antisocial decisions using neurophysiological, neuropharmacological, and neuroimaging techniques during social.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何计算社会偏好并调节亲社会和反社会决策，使用神经生理学、神经药理学和功能性神经成像技术在社会互动中进行研究。

name: Marvin Chun
title: Richard M. Colgate Professor and Chair of Psychology and Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies visual attention, memory, and decision-making using fMRI to decode brain activity and predict individual differences in behavior.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究视觉注意力、记忆和决策制定，解码大脑活动并预测个体行为差异。

name: Margaret Clark
title: John M. Musser Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people form and maintain close relationships, focusing on emotional processes and interpersonal dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何建立和维持亲密关系，重点关注情绪过程和人际动态。

name: Lila Davachi
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory encoding, consolidation, and retrieval work, using cognitive neuroscientific methods.
summary_zh: 研究记忆编码、巩固和检索的认知神经科学方法。

name: Yarrow Dunham
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social groups are formed and their effects on cognition, using experiments and cross-cultural methods with adults and children.
summary_zh: 研究社会群体的形成及其对认知的影响，使用实验和跨文化方法研究成人和儿童。

name: Melissa Ferguson
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies implicit cognitive processes that influence evaluation, self-control, and social behavior, focusing on updating impressions of others, controlling behavior, and expressing prejudice.
summary_zh: 研究隐含的认知过程如何影响评价、自我控制和社会行为，重点关注更新对他人的印象、控制行为和表达偏见。

name: Dylan Gee
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how early environments affect emotional learning and regulation in the brain, with implications for mental health disorders.
summary_zh: 研究早期环境如何影响情绪学习和调节的大脑机制，对心理健康障碍具有重要意义。

name: Randolph Helfrich
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the circuit and network mechanisms of higher cognitive functions like goal-directed attention and cognitive control using multimodal cognitive neurophysiology, combining electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知功能（如目标导向注意力和认知控制）的电路和网络机制，采用多模态认知神经生理学方法，结合电生理学、成像和刺激技术。

name: Julian Jara-Ettinger
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Computer Science
summary: Studies social intelligence, including fairness, communication, and moral reasoning, using computational modeling and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究社会智能，包括公平性、沟通和道德推理，使用计算建模和眼动追踪技术。

name: Jutta Joormann
title: Richard Ely Foundation Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and emotion regulation in depression and anxiety, using cognitive tasks, psychophysiological measures, and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁和焦虑中的认知过程和情绪调节，使用认知任务、生理心理测量和脑成像方法。

name: Frank Keil
title: Charles C. and Dorathea S. Dilley Professor of Psychology and Linguistics
summary: Studies how children and adults construct and evaluate causal interpretations of the world, focusing on gaps in knowledge and the role of experts.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何构建和评估对世界的因果解释，重点关注知识缺口以及专家的作用。

name: Julia Leonard
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children decide when to exert effort, using behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging methods with diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在不同环境输入下如何适当地分配努力，使用行为、计算和神经影像学方法，涵盖不同年龄段的群体。

name: Gregory McCarthy
title: Henry Ford II Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the functional organization of the human brain, focusing on social perception and cognition, and the neuroscience of executive processing and working memory.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑的功能组织，重点关注社会知觉和认知以及执行处理和工作记忆的神经科学。

name: Samuel McDougle
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the cognitive processes involved in motor skill acquisition and performance, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, neuroimaging, and neuropsychology.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程在运动技能获取和表现中的作用，使用行为实验、计算建模、神经影像学和神经心理学方法。

name: Wendy Berry Mendes
title: Chris Argyris Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how emotion and stress affect decision-making and physiology, using autonomic nervous system physiology, neuroendocrinology, and facial EMG in various contexts.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和压力如何影响决策和生理功能，使用自主神经系统生理学、神经内分泌学和面部肌电图在不同情境中进行研究。

name: Kia Nobre
title: Wu Tsai Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain anticipates, prioritizes, and selects information to form experience and guide behavior, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何预测、优先处理和选择信息以形成经验和指导行为，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Jennifer Richeson
title: Philip R. Allen Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people experience and respond to racial and societal diversity, including managing discrimination threats and political consequences.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何体验和应对种族和社会多样性，包括应对歧视威胁和政治后果。

name: Micaela Rodriguez
title: (Starting July 2027) Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological functions and consequences of solitude, the role of digital technologies in social connection, and relationships with nonhuman entities, using diverse methodologies.
summary_zh: 研究独处的心理功能及其后果、数字技术在社会连接中的作用以及与非人类实体的关系，采用多种方法。

name: Robb Rutledge
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the relationship between decision making and emotion using computational models, neuroimaging, and smartphone data.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型、神经成像和智能手机数据研究决策制定与情绪之间的关系。

name: Peter Salovey
title: Sterling Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological significance and function of human moods and emotions, and the effectiveness of programs teaching emotional intelligence.
summary_zh: 研究人类情绪的心理意义和功能，以及教授情绪智力的项目效果。

name: Laurie Santos
title: Chandrika and Ranjan Tandon Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the evolutionary origins of human cognition and the science of happiness, teaching students how to make better life choices.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知的进化起源和幸福科学，教授学生如何做出更好的生活选择。

name: Brian Scholl
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies visual cognition, including visual awareness, object persistence, and causality perception, using experiments with humans and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉认知，包括视觉意识、物体持久性和因果性知觉，使用人类和计算模型实验。

name: David Silverman
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological and social factors contributing to achievement and well-being disparities among young people, using both laboratory experiments and longitudinal studies.
summary_zh: 研究心理和社会因素对年轻人群体成就和福祉差异的影响，采用实验室实验和纵向研究相结合的方法。

name: Brenden Tervo-Clemmens
title: (Starting July 2027) Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies individual variability in adolescent mental health risk and resilience through precision brain health approaches, integrating brain imaging, behavioral studies, and smartphone assessments.
summary_zh: 研究青少年心理健康风险和复原力的个体差异，通过精准脑健康方法，结合脑成像、行为研究和智能手机评估。

name: Nick Turk-Browne
title: Susan Nolen-Hoeksema Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how perception, attention, learning, and memory interact using psychophysical experiments, fMRI, case studies, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、注意力、学习和记忆之间的相互作用，使用心理物理学实验、功能性磁共振成像、病例研究和计算模型。

name: Shirley Wang
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops and uses novel methods like machine learning and ambulatory assessment to model the complexity of mental health disorders, focusing on suicide, self-injury, and eating disorders.
summary_zh: 开发和运用机器学习和移动监测等方法，建模精神障碍的复杂性，重点关注自杀、自伤和进食障碍。

name: Lauren Whitehurst
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Black Studies
summary: Studies how social inequities affect sleep quality and cognitive outcomes, using neuroscience to advance health equity.
summary_zh: 研究社会不平等如何影响睡眠质量和认知结果，利用神经科学促进健康公平。

name: Ilker Yildirim
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the mind implements algorithms in neural activity and online psychological processes, focusing on visual cognition and object perception.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过神经活动实现心理过程中的算法，重点关注视觉认知和物体知觉。

name: Nii Addy
title: Albert E. Kent Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Associate Professor of Cellular and Molecular Physiology
summary: Studies mechanisms of substance use and mood disorders, focusing on cholinergic, dopaminergic, and L-type calcium channel pathways.
summary_zh: 研究物质使用和情绪障碍的机制，重点关注胆碱能、多巴胺能和L型钙通道途径。

name: AZA Allsop
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how listening to music during social interactions affects brain activity and social connectedness, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究音乐在面对面社交互动中对大脑活动和社会连接性的影响，使用神经成像技术。

name: Amy Arnsten
title: Albert E. Kent Professor of Neuroscience and Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies molecular influences on prefrontal cortex functions, focusing on working memory and cognitive disorders, using multi-disciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层功能的分子影响，重点关注工作记忆和认知障碍，采用多学科方法。

name: Hilary Blumberg
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the biological and environmental factors affecting mood disorders like bipolar disorder and depression, using MRI and other techniques to identify markers and develop treatments.
summary_zh: 研究情绪障碍（如双相情感障碍和抑郁症）的生物学和环境因素，使用MRI等技术识别生物标志物并开发治疗方法。

name: Hal Blumenfeld
title: Mark Loughridge and Michele Williams Professor of Neurology and Professor of Neuroscience and of NeurosurgeryCards
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of consciousness and impaired consciousness in epilepsy, using neuroimaging, electrophysiology, and animal models.
summary_zh: 研究意识的神经机制及其在癫痫中的受损情况，使用神经成像、电生理学和动物模型。

name: Jessica Cardin
title: Gordon M. Shepherd Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the dynamic relationship between neurons and networks in the cortex, focusing on synaptic interactions and gain control mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层中神经元与网络之间的动态关系，重点在于突触交互作用和增益控制机制。

name: Alicia Che
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies how oxytocin influences the development of social touch and fear extinction in the brain, using mouse genetics and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究催产素在社会触觉和恐惧消退中的作用，使用小鼠遗传学和成像技术。

name: Ralph Adolphs
title: Bren Professor of Psychology, Neuroscience, and Biology
summary: Studies the neural and psychological basis for human social behavior, using fMRI, eye tracking, and brain recordings to understand social and moral judgments, emotional processing, and autism-related.
summary_zh: 研究人类社会行为的神经和心理基础，使用功能性磁共振成像、眼动追踪和脑电图来理解社会和道德判断、情绪处理以及自闭症相关社会障碍。

name: Richard A. Andersen
title: James G. Boswell Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural basis of intentions and motor planning, developing cognitive-based neural prostheses for paralyzed patients.
summary_zh: 研究意图和运动规划的神经基础，开发认知神经假肢以帮助瘫痪患者。

name: David J. Anderson
title: Seymour Benzer Professor of Biology
summary: Studies emotional behavior in mice and vinegar flies, focusing on fear, anxiety, and aggression using molecular genetics and functional imaging.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠和醋酸杆菌的情绪行为，重点在于恐惧、焦虑和攻击行为，使用分子遗传学和功能成像技术。

name: Colin Camerer
title: Robert Kirby Professor of Behavioral Economics
summary: Studies decision-making processes and social behaviors using economic experiments and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和社会行为，使用经济实验和神经成像技术。

name: Georgia Gkioxari
title: Assistant Professor of Computing and Mathematical Sciences and Electrical Engineering
summary: Develops advanced visual perception models for 2D and 3D perception, spatial reasoning, and tools.
summary_zh: 开发先进的视觉感知模型，涵盖2D和3D感知、空间推理和工具。

name: Elizabeth J. Hong
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how molecular diversity at synapses affects synaptic physiology and circuit function in odor-driven behaviors of vinegar flies.
summary_zh: 研究突触分子多样性如何影响嗅觉驱动行为的突触生理和电路功能。

name: Sarkis Mazmanian
title: Luis B. and Nelly Soux Professor of Microbiology
summary: Studies how gut bacteria influence immune and nervous system development, with a focus on Bacteroides fragilis and its polysaccharide A (PSA) in preventing intestinal inflammation and autism.
summary_zh: 研究肠道细菌如何影响免疫系统和神经系统的发展，重点关注脆弱拟杆菌及其多糖A（PSA）在预防肠道炎症和自闭症行为中的作用。

name: Markus Meister
title: Anne P. and Benjamin F. Biaggini Professor of Biological Sciences
summary: Studies how large circuits of nerve cells in the visual system process visual information, using recordings and mathematical modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉系统中大规模神经网络如何处理视觉信息，使用记录和数学建模方法。

name: John O'Doherty
title: Fletcher Jones Professor of Decision Neuroscience
summary: Studies decision-making processes and neural mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和神经机制，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Yuki Oka
title: Professor of Biology
summary: Studies how the brain monitors internal body state and generates motivated behaviors to maintain homeostasis, using genetics, pharmacology, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何监测体内状态并产生动机行为以维持稳态，使用遗传学、药理学和光遗传学方法。

name: David Prober
title: Professor of Biology
summary: Studies genetic and neuronal mechanisms underlying sleep using zebrafish, optogenetics, and whole-brain imaging.
summary_zh: 使用斑马鱼、光遗传学和全脑成像研究睡眠的遗传和神经机制。

name: Antonio Rangel
title: Bing Professor of Neuroscience, Behavioral Biology, and Economics
summary: Studies decision-making processes and neural mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和神经机制，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Ueli Rutishauser
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning, memory, and decision-making using single-unit electrophysiology, eye-tracking, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究学习、记忆和决策的神经机制，使用单个神经元放电记录、眼动追踪和计算方法。

name: Shinsuke Shimojo
title: Gertrude Baltimore Professor of Experimental Psychology
summary: Studies implicit cognitive processes, emotional decision making, and social communication using psychophysical and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究隐性认知过程、情绪决策和社会沟通，使用心理物理学和神经成像方法。

name: Thanos Siapas
title: Professor of Computation and Neural Systems
summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms of learning and memory formation, focusing on interactions between the hippocampus and neocortex in freely behaving animals.
summary_zh: 研究海马与新皮层之间的神经机制，关注自由行为动物中学习和记忆形成的脑区交互作用。

name: R. Michael Alvarez
title: Flintridge Foundation Professor of Political and Computational Social Science
summary: Studies public opinion and voting behavior using statistical and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究公众意见和投票行为，使用统计和计算建模方法。

name: Frederick Eberhardt
title: Professor of Philosophy
summary: Develops methods to learn causal relations from data, bridging philosophy, machine learning, statistics, and cognitive science.
summary_zh: 开发从数据中学习因果关系的方法，跨哲学、机器学习、统计学和认知科学领域。

name: Steven R. Quartz
title: Professor of Philosophy
summary: Studies how brain value systems interact with culture to shape moral, political, and economic lives, using fMRI and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究大脑价值系统如何与文化互动以塑造道德、政治和经济生活，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算建模方法。

name: Laura L. Carstensen
title: Fairleigh S. Dickinson, Jr. Professor of Public Policy and Professor, by courtesy, of Health Policy
summary: Studies aging and its psychological aspects, focusing on motivation, cognition, and emotion in older adults.
summary_zh: 研究老化及其心理方面，重点在于老年人的动机、认知和情绪。

name: Geoffrey Cohen
title: Professor, Graduate School of Education
summary: Studies processes that shape people's sense of belonging and self, using interventions and experiments in school, work, and health care settings.
summary_zh: 研究塑造人们归属感和自我感的过程，使用干预和实验方法在教育、工作和医疗保健环境中进行。

name: Alia Crum
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and, by courtesy, of Medicine (Primary Care & Population Health)
summary: Studies how subjective mindsets can alter objective reality through behavioral, psychological, and physiological mechanisms, focusing on the placebo effect and its applications in health.
summary_zh: 研究主观心态如何通过行为、心理和生理机制改变客观现实，特别是在健康、表现和福祉方面的应用，重点是安慰剂效应。

name: Carol Dweck
title: Lewis and Virginia Eaton Professor and Professor, by courtesy, of Education
summary: Studies how self-conceptions influence motivation, self-regulation, and achievement in development and social processes.
summary_zh: 研究自我概念如何影响动机、自我调节和成就以及发展和社会过程。

name: Jennifer Eberhardt
title: Professor, Organizational Behavior
summary: Studies the impact of racial associations on criminal justice outcomes, using interdisciplinary methods.
summary_zh: 研究种族联想对刑事司法结果的影响，采用跨学科方法。

name: Cameron Ellis
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the cognitive mechanisms of infant perception, attention, learning, and memory using fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿知觉、注意、学习和记忆的认知机制，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)。

name: Judith Ellen Fan
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology, by courtesy, of Education and of Computer Science
summary: Studies how people use physical representations to learn, communicate, and solve problems, combining cognitive science, computational neuroscience, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用物理表示进行学习、交流和解决问题，结合认知科学、计算神经科学和人工智能的方法。

name: Michael Frank
title: Benjamin Scott Crocker Professor of Human Biology and Professor, by courtesy, of Linguistics
summary: Studies how children learn language and its interaction with social understanding, using behavioral experiments, computational tools, and novel measurement methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言学习及其与社会理解的相互作用，使用行为实验、计算工具和新型测量方法。

name: Justin Gardner
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how neural activity in the human cortex creates visual perception using fMRI, computational modeling, and psychophysical measurements.
summary_zh: 研究人类皮层神经活动如何产生视觉感知，使用功能性磁共振成像、计算建模和心理物理学测量方法。

name: Tobias Gerstenberg
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and, by courtesy, of Computer Science
summary: Studies how people decide whether one event caused another, using psychophysical experiments and a Bayesian multimodal inference model.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何判断一个事件是否导致了另一个事件，使用心理物理学实验和贝叶斯多模态推理模型。

name: Noah Goodman
title: Professor of Psychology and of Computer Science
summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and artificial intelligence, focusing on language and perception.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和人工智能研究认知过程，重点在于语言和知觉。

name: Ian Gotlib
title: Marjorie Mhoon Fair Professor
summary: Studies risk factors for depression in children and adults, including neural, cognitive, and social factors, and their cross-generational transmission.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人抑郁症的风险因素，包括神经、认知和社会因素，并探讨这些因素的跨代传递。

name: Kalanit Grill-Spector
title: Susan S. and William H. Hindle Professor in the School of Humanities and Sciences and Professor, by courtesy, of Computer Science
summary: Studies the functional organization of the human visual system, including face, object, place, and word recognition, using deep neural networks and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉系统的功能组织，包括面孔、物体、地点和单词识别，使用深度神经网络和神经成像技术。

name: James Gross
title: Ernest R. Hilgard Professor, Professor of Psychology and, by courtesy, of Philosophy
summary: Studies emotion regulation using psychological and neuroscientific methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节，使用心理学和神经科学方法。

name: Hyowon Gweon
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how humans learn from and help others learn, using developmental, computational, and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何从他人学习以及帮助他人学习，采用发展、计算和神经成像方法。

name: Brian Knutson
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies the neural basis of emotion, using biogenic amines, functional brain imaging, and psychopharmacology to explore decision-making and psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究情绪的神经基础，使用生物胺、功能性脑成像和精神药理学探索决策和精神疾病。

name: Ellen Markman
title: IBM Provostial Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between language and thought, early word learning, and theory of mind in children.
summary_zh: 研究语言与思维的关系、儿童早期词汇学习和理论思维。

name: Hazel Markus
title: Davis-Brack Professor of the Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how cultures shape thought, feeling, and action, focusing on the role of self in regulating behavior.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何塑造思维、情感和行为，重点关注自我在调节行为中的作用。

name: Jay McClelland
title: Lucie Stern Professor in the Social Sciences, Professor of Psychology and, by courtesy, of Linguistics and of Computer Science
summary: Studies perception, decision making, learning, memory, language, and cognitive development through neural population processing and adaptation of connections among neurons.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、决策、学习、记忆、语言和认知发展，通过神经群体处理和神经元连接的适应来实现。

name: Benoît Monin
title: Bowen H. and Janice Arthur McCoy Professor of Leadership Values and Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how organizational behavior and leadership values influence decision-making and social interactions, using experimental and empirical methods.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为和领导价值观如何影响决策和社会互动，使用实验和实证方法。

name: Russell Poldrack
title: Albert Ray Lang Professor of Psychology and, by courtesy, of Psychiatry and Behavioral Science
summary: Studies decision making, executive control, and learning and memory using cognitive neuroscience tools and develops neuroinformatics resources.
summary_zh: 使用认知神经科学工具研究决策制定、执行控制和学习记忆，并开发神经信息学资源。

name: Nilam Ram
title: Professor of Communication and of Psychology
summary: Studies short-term changes in psychological processes such as learning and emotion regulation across the life span using longitudinal designs and data science methods.
summary_zh: 研究生命历程中学习和情绪调节等心理过程的短期变化，采用纵向研究设计和数据科学方法。

name: Steven Othello Roberts
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological bases of racism and how to dismantle them, focusing on conversations about race in Black and White families.
summary_zh: 研究种族主义的心理基础及其拆解方法，重点关注黑人和白人家庭关于种族的对话。

name: Jordan Gerard Starck
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological mechanisms driving racial inequality, using social psychology to understand and improve racial attitudes and organizational diversity practices.
summary_zh: 研究种族不平等的心理机制，使用社会心理学理解并改善种族态度和组织多样性实践。

name: Jeanne L. Tsai
title: Dunlevie Family Professor
summary: Studies the cultural shaping of emotion and its implications for health, decision-making, and person perception.
summary_zh: 研究文化对情绪的影响及其对健康、决策和人际感知的含义。

name: Anthony Wagner
title: Lucie Stern Professor in the Social Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience of memory and cognitive/executive control in young and older adults, using fMRI, EEG, and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和认知/执行控制的认知神经科学，使用功能性磁共振成像、脑电图和经颅磁刺激在年轻和老年成人中。

name: Brian A. Wandell
title: Isaac and Madeline Stein Family Professor and Professor, by courtesy, of Electrical Engineering, of Ophthalmology and of Education
summary: Studies visual perception and brain organization for reading, using MRI and behavior testing.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和大脑组织阅读功能，使用功能性磁共振成像和行为测试。

name: Daniel Yamins
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and of Computer Science
summary: Studies how the brain solves computational challenges, using computational modeling, artificial intelligence, and large-scale data analysis to build better AI algorithms and understand brain function.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何解决计算挑战，通过计算建模、人工智能和大规模数据分析来构建更好的AI算法并理解大脑功能。

name: Jason Yeatman
title: Associate Professor of Pediatrics (Developmental-Behavioral Pediatrics), of Education and of Psychology
summary: Studies the neurobiology of literacy and how brain plasticity affects learning, particularly in children with dyslexia.
summary_zh: 研究阅读能力的神经生物学及其如何影响学习，特别是在患有阅读障碍的儿童中的脑可塑性。

name: Stephen A. Baccus
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how the retina processes visual information into electrical impulses, using multielectrode arrays, two-photon imaging, and mathematical models.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜如何将视觉信息转化为电信号，使用多电极阵列、双光子成像和数学模型。

name: Anne Brunet
title: Professor of Genetics
summary: Studies aging and longevity in various organisms, focusing on chromatin modifiers and stem cell regeneration in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究衰老和长寿的机制，特别是在不同生物体中，关注染色质修饰和大脑干细胞再生。

name: Thomas Clandinin
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how neuronal circuits assemble and function during development and adulthood, using the fruit fly visual system.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路在发育和成年期的组装和功能，以果蝇视觉系统为模型。

name: Jun Ding
title: Professor of Neurosurgery and of Neurology
summary: Studies the functional organization of motor circuits, particularly cortico-thalamo-basal ganglia networks, using electrophysiology, 2-photon microscopy, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究运动回路的功能组织，特别是皮层-丘脑-基底节网络，使用电生理学、双光子显微镜和光遗传学方法。

name: Shaul Druckmann
title: Associate Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how dynamics in neuronal circuits relate to information representation and computation, using neural recordings, theoretical analysis, and circuit structure studies.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路动态如何影响信息表征和计算，采用神经记录、理论分析和回路结构研究的方法。

name: Neir Eshel
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies the neural circuits of reward processing, decision making, and social behavior using optogenetic, electrophysiological, neuroimaging, and behavioral approaches.
summary_zh: 研究奖励处理、决策和社交行为的神经回路，使用光遗传学、电生理学、神经成像和行为方法。

name: William Giardino
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of stress, addiction, and sleep disorders in mice using genetic, pharmacological, and optical methods.
summary_zh: 研究压力、成瘾和睡眠障碍的小鼠神经机制，使用遗传学、药理学和光学方法。

name: Lisa Giocomo
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of spatial navigation and memory in the medial entorhinal cortex using electrophysiology and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究内侧内嗅皮层在空间导航和记忆中的细胞和分子机制，使用电生理学和基因方法。

name: Andrea Goldstein-Piekarski
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sleep disruption in affective disorders, using neuroimaging and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠中断对情绪障碍的神经机制，使用神经成像和计算建模方法。

name: Deborah M Gordon
title: Professor of Environmental Biology
summary: Studies how ant colonies function without central control, using simple interactions and evolving networks.
summary_zh: 研究蚂蚁群体在没有中央控制的情况下如何运作，通过简单的交互和进化的网络。

name: Julie Kauer
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies mechanisms of epilepsy, particularly temporal lobe epilepsy, using cellular and molecular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫机制，尤其是颞叶癫痫，使用细胞和分子技术。

name: Corey Keller
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of brain stimulation technologies to develop personalized treatments for neurological and psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究脑刺激技术的神经机制，以开发针对神经和精神疾病个性化治疗方法。

name: Scott W. Linderman
title: Assistant Professor of Statistics
summary: Studies neural networks and machine learning, focusing on computational models of brain function.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络和机器学习，专注于大脑功能的计算模型。

name: Irene L. Llorente
title: Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

name: Anish Mitra
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how neural activity in large-scale networks causes mental illness, using targeted neurostimulation and functional MRI.
summary_zh: 研究大规模神经网络中的神经活动如何导致精神疾病，使用定向神经刺激和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Tirin Moore
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of visual-motor integration and the impact of planned movements on sensory perception, using single neuron recordings and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉-运动整合的神经机制以及计划动作对感觉知觉的影响，使用单个神经元记录和行为实验的方法。

name: Elizabeth Mormino
title: Associate Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies cognitive trajectories and neurodegenerative diseases using imaging and genetics.
summary_zh: 使用成像和遗传学研究认知轨迹和神经退行性疾病。

name: William Newsome
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of visual perception and decision-making using systems and cognitive neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和简单形式决策的神经机制，采用系统和认知神经科学方法。

name: Scott Owen
title: Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of motor control and learning, using electrophysiology and optogenetics in mice.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和学习的神经机制，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法在小鼠中进行。

name: Jennifer Raymond
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning by recording from the cerebellum in awake behaving animals and transgenic mice.
summary_zh: 研究学习的神经机制，通过在清醒行为动物和转基因小鼠的齿状核中记录来识别神经误差信号。

name: Anthony J. Ricci
title: Professor of Otolaryngology
summary: Studies the role of hearing loss on cognitive function and develops new technologies for auditory sensory hair cells.
summary_zh: 研究听力损失对认知功能的影响，并开发新的技术以研究听觉感觉毛细胞。

name: Manish Saggar
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Develops computational methods to link psychiatric diagnoses with neural circuits and spatiotemporal neurodynamics, using neuroimaging data.
summary_zh: 开发计算方法将精神疾病诊断与神经环路和时空神经动力学联系起来，使用神经影像学数据。

name: Mark Schnitzer
title: Professor of Biology
summary: Studies neural circuits and brain function using advanced imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和脑功能，使用先进的成像技术。

name: Ivan Soltesz
title: Professor of Neurosurgery and Neurosciences
summary: Studies neuronal microcircuits and network oscillations in epilepsy using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫中的神经微回路和网络振荡，使用光遗传学、电生理学和计算建模方法。

name: Longzhi Tan
title: Assistant Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Vivianne Tawfik
title: Associate Professor of Anesthesiology
summary: Studies the immune contribution to persistent pain, using research to understand and treat chronic pain disorders.
summary_zh: 研究免疫系统在慢性疼痛中的作用，通过研究来理解并治疗慢性疼痛障碍。

name: Suzanne Tharin
title: Associate Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies the role of microRNAs in the development and injury response of corticospinal motor neurons.
summary_zh: 研究微小RNA在运动皮层神经元发育和脊髓损伤反应中的作用。

name: Raag Airan
title: Faculty
summary: Develops and implements noninvasive technologies like focused ultrasound and nanotechnology for precise brain intervention.
summary_zh: 开发和实施聚焦超声和纳米技术等非侵入性技术，实现精准脑部干预。

name: Laren Becker
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how aging affects the interaction between immune cells and the enteric nervous system, impacting gastrointestinal function.
summary_zh: 研究衰老如何影响免疫细胞与肠神经系统之间的相互作用，进而影响胃肠功能。

name: Kwabena Boahen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain function and designs computational models inspired by neural systems.
summary_zh: 研究大脑功能并设计受神经系统启发的计算模型。

name: Paul Buckmaster
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the pathophysiological mechanisms of temporal lobe epilepsy using electrophysiological, molecular, and anatomical techniques.
summary_zh: 使用电生理学、分子生物学和解剖学技术研究颞叶癫痫的病理生理机制。

name: Xiaoke Chen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和神经影像技术研究学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Luis de Lecea
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain arousal circuits using molecular, optogenetic, and behavioral methods, focusing on sleep, wakefulness, stress, and drug addiction.
summary_zh: 使用分子、光遗传学和行为方法研究脑觉醒电路，重点关注睡眠、清醒、应激和药物成瘾。

name: Karl Deisseroth
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how optogenetics can be used to manipulate neural activity to understand and treat psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究如何使用光遗传学操纵神经活动以理解并治疗精神疾病。

name: Laramie Duncan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies genetic effects on psychiatric disorders using genome-wide association studies and single nucleus RNA sequencing.
summary_zh: 研究精神疾病中的遗传效应，使用全基因组关联研究和单细胞RNA测序方法。

name: Lawrence Fung
title: is an associate professor of Psychiatry at Stanford University
summary: Studies the neurobiology of autism and develops interventions to improve the lives of neurodiverse individuals.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症的神经生物学并开发干预措施以改善神经多样性个体的生活。

name: Xiaojing Gao
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis of memory and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和学习的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Shaul Hestrin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how neocortical neuron properties and circuit interactions generate behavior using in vivo recordings, calcium imaging, and optogenetics in mice.
summary_zh: 研究神经元属性和回路交互如何生成行为，使用在活体小鼠中的全细胞记录、钙成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Hadi Hosseini
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain network alterations in neurodevelopmental and neurocognitive disorders using neuroimaging and computational methods, developing personalized interventions.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育和神经认知障碍中的脑网络异常，使用神经影像学和计算方法，开发个性化干预措施。

name: Robert Malenka
title: was appointed Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Physiology at UCSF, at which he reached the rank of Full Prof
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of neural communication and the role of circuit dysfunction in brain disorders such as addiction, Alzheimer’s, autism, and depression.
summary_zh: 研究神经通讯的分子机制以及神经回路功能障碍在成瘾、阿尔茨海默病、自闭症和抑郁症等脑部疾病中的作用。

name: Emmanuel Mignot
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiology, genetics, and immunology of narcolepsy, using advanced genetic and proteomic techniques.
summary_zh: 研究发作性睡病的神经生物学、遗传学和免疫学，使用先进的遗传学和蛋白质组学技术。

name: Nirao Shah
title: is a Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences and of Neurobiology at Stanford Universit
summary: Studies genes and neurons that control social interactions, providing insights into autism, dementia, mood disorders, and PTSD.
summary_zh: 研究控制社交互动的基因和神经元，为自闭症、痴呆、情绪障碍和 PTSD 等行为表现提供见解。

name: Christoph Thaiss
title: Assistant Professor of Pathology
summary: Studies how gut microbiome influences brain function and behavior, using multi-omic technologies and animal models.
summary_zh: 研究肠道微生物群如何影响大脑功能和行为，使用多组学技术和动物模型。

name: Andreas Tolias
title: Professor of Ophthalmology
summary: Studies the principles of natural intelligence by combining large-scale neuroscience experiments with machine learning, focusing on perceptual inference and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究自然智能的基本原理，通过结合大规模神经科学实验和机器学习，专注于知觉推理和决策制定。

name: Gordon Wang
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Develops imaging tools to analyze proteins, mRNA and lipids at synapses, studying synaptic heterogeneity in neural circuits during development and aging, and in diseases like autism and fragile X.
summary_zh: 开发成像工具分析突触中的蛋白质、mRNA 和脂质，研究突触异质性对神经回路在发育和衰老过程中的功能影响，以及在自闭症和脆性 X 综合征等疾病中的作用。

name: Frank Willett
title: Assistant Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Develops brain-computer interfaces to restore movement and communication in people with neurological disorders, focusing on handwriting and speech-based BCIs.
summary_zh: 开发脑机接口以恢复神经障碍患者的运动和交流能力，重点关注基于手写和言语的BCI。

name: Michael Zeineh
title: Professor of Radiology
summary: Studies neurodegenerative disorders using advanced imaging techniques like fMRI and DTI, focusing on hippocampal microcircuitry.
summary_zh: 使用高级成像技术如fMRI和DTI研究神经退行性疾病，重点关注海马微电路。

name: Jamie Zeitzer
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how light affects circadian rhythms and sleep patterns, using actigraphy to identify markers of psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究光对昼夜节律和睡眠模式的影响，并使用行为记录法识别精神障碍的标志物。

name: Dolores Albarracín
title: Amy Gutmann University Professor
summary: Studies attitudes, persuasion, and behavioral change, focusing on how beliefs influence actions and how to correct misinformation.
summary_zh: 研究态度、说服和行为改变，关注信念如何影响行为以及如何纠正错误信息。

name: Coren Apicella
title: Professor
summary: Studies decision processes and social behaviors in humans, focusing on cooperation and moral perceptions across cultures.
summary_zh: 研究人类决策过程和社会行为，重点关注跨文化的合作和道德感知。

name: Michael Arcaro
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the environment shapes neural development and supports visual perception across mammalian species using neuroimaging, visual psychophysics, and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究环境如何塑造哺乳动物神经系统的发育并支持视觉感知，使用神经成像、视觉心理物理学和电生理学方法。

name: Sudeep Bhatia
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive basis of human judgment and decision making using mathematical and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究人类判断和决策的认知基础，使用数学和计算模型。

name: Tyler Bonnen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies computational models of perception and memory, integrating methods from neuroscience, psychology, and computer science.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和记忆的计算模型，结合神经科学、心理学和计算机科学的方法。

name: David Brainard
title: RRL Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies human vision, investigating how the visual system estimates object properties from light signals, using psychophysical experiments and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉，探讨视觉系统如何从光线信号中估计物体属性，使用心理物理学实验和计算建模方法。

name: Johannes Burge
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how humans estimate depth from natural images, using computational models and behavioral studies.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何从自然图像中估计深度，使用计算模型和行为研究。

name: Delphine Dahan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how listeners interpret spoken language, focusing on the time course of interpretation and the role of context in speech comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究听者如何解释口头语言，重点关注解释的时间进程以及上下文在言语理解中的作用。

name: Angela Duckworth
title: Rosa Lee and Egbert Chang Professor
summary: Studies how individuals differ in their perseverance and self-control, focusing on the development of grit.
summary_zh: 研究个体在毅力和自我控制方面的差异，重点关注坚毅的发展。

name: Russell Epstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying visual scene perception, object recognition, and spatial navigation in humans using fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉场景感知、物体识别和空间导航的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术。

name: Martha Farah
title: Annenberg Professor of Natural Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience, focusing on brain systems for behavior and perception.
summary_zh: 研究认知神经科学，关注行为和感知的脑系统。

name: Loretta Flanagan-Cato
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops community-engaged neuroscience courses to improve mood and reduce intergroup anxiety.
summary_zh: 开发社区参与神经科学课程以改善情绪并减少群体焦虑。

name: Steven Fluharty
title: SAS Board of Advisors Professor of Psychology, Pharmacology, and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the regulation of neuropeptide receptor gene expression and signal transduction in neurons and animals.
summary_zh: 研究神经肽受体基因表达和信号转导的调节及其在神经元和动物中的作用。

name: Geoffrey Goodwin
title: Professor
summary: Studies social cognition and moral psychology, exploring how people judge and reason about moral actions and beliefs.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知和道德心理学，探讨人们如何判断和推理关于道德行为和信念的问题。

name: Jay Gottfried
title: Arthur H. Rubenstein University Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of human smell, focusing on odor codes, circuits, and percepts using fMRI and intracranial EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类嗅觉的神经生物学，重点在于气味代码、电路和感知，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和颅内脑电图（intracranial EEG）。

name: Sara Jaffee
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of antisocial behavior in children, focusing on gene-environment interactions and longitudinal effects.
summary_zh: 研究儿童反社会行为的发展，重点关注基因-环境交互作用和纵向效应。

name: Adrianna Jenkins
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social cognition and its relationship to decision-making, focusing on the prefrontal cortex and uncertainty in social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知及其与决策的关系，重点关注前额叶皮层和社交不确定性机制。

name: Joseph Kable
title: Jean-Marie Kneeley President's Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people make decisions, using fMRI and methods from social and cognitive neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何做出决策，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和社会认知神经科学的方法。

name: Allyson Mackey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain plasticity and its impact on learning and academic outcomes, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑可塑性及其对学习和学术成果的影响，使用神经成像技术。

name: Barbara Mellers
title: I. George Heyman University Professor
summary: Studies decision-making and forecasting accuracy, using psychological strategies to improve policy-relevant predictions.
summary_zh: 研究决策和预测准确性，通过心理策略提高政策相关预测的质量。

name: Daniel Moriarity
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the dynamic interplay between stress, immunology, and affective psychopathology, refining clinical phenotypes and integrating biological mechanisms into psychosocial frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究压力、免疫学与情感精神病理之间的动态相互作用，细化临床表型并整合生物机制到心理社会框架中。

name: Michael L. Platt
title: James S. Riepe University Professor
summary: Studies decision-making and social interaction, applying insights from brain science to business and sports.
summary_zh: 研究决策和社交互动，将脑科学的见解应用于商业和体育。

name: Nicole Rust
title: Professor, Rose Family Endowed Term Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how memory and mood are processed in the brain, combining human behavior, neural activity measurements, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和情绪在大脑中的处理过程，结合人类行为、神经活动测量和计算建模方法。

name: Nacho Sanguinetti
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of adaptive cognitive processes in wild rodents, focusing on play behavior and scatter-hoarding.
summary_zh: 研究野生啮齿动物的适应性认知过程的神经基础，重点关注玩耍行为和散播储藏行为。

name: Anna Schapiro
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how memories of regularities in the environment are formed and consolidated, using neural network modeling and empirical methods like fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究环境中的规律性记忆是如何形成和巩固的，使用神经网络建模和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）等实证方法。

name: Martin Seligman
title: Zellerbach Family Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies positive psychology, optimism, learned helplessness, and well-being, using big data and coaching.
summary_zh: 研究积极心理学、乐观主义、习得无助感和幸福感，使用大数据和辅导方法。

name: Alan Stocker
title: Professor
summary: Studies how visual perception is shaped by beliefs and expectations, using theory and experiments to understand the underlying computations and neural processes.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知如何受到信念和预期的影响，通过理论和实验来理解背后的计算和神经过程。

name: Daniel Swingley
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children learn and recognize words, using perceptual experiments and statistical analyses.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何学习和识别单词，使用知觉实验和统计分析方法。

name: Philip Tetlock
title: Leonore Annenberg University Professor
summary: Studies how experts think about possible pasts and probable futures, and how accountability pressures affect judgment and choice.
summary_zh: 研究专家如何思考可能的历史和可能的未来，以及问责制压力如何影响判断和选择。

name: Sharon Thompson-Schill
title: Christopher H. Browne Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the biological bases of human cognitive systems, focusing on the frontal lobe's role in memory and language, using fMRI and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知系统的生物基础，特别是前额叶在记忆和语言中的作用，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。

name: John Trueswell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults learn words and grammar, using eye-tracking to observe real-time language comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何学习词汇和语法，使用眼动追踪观察实时语言理解。

name: Rebecca Waller
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies socioemotional development and the environmental factors influencing antisocial behavior in children, using fMRI and genetic models.
summary_zh: 研究儿童社会情感发展及其反社会行为的环境因素，使用功能性磁共振成像和遗传模型。

name: Joshua I. Gold
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how inference and learning shape decision-making processes in the brain, using behavioral, electrophysiological, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究推理和学习如何塑造大脑中的决策过程，使用行为学、电生理学和计算建模方法。

name: Michael J. Kahana
title: Faculty
summary: Studies human episodic memory using behavioral and electrophysiological methods, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究人类事件记忆，使用行为和电生理方法以及计算模型。

name: Erica Korb
title: Associate Professor of Genetics
areas: The Korb lab works at the intersection of neuroscience
summary: Studies how chromatin modifications regulate learning and memory, focusing on histone variants and their role in neurodevelopmental disorders.
summary_zh: 研究染色质修饰如何调节学习和记忆，重点关注组蛋白变体及其在神经发育障碍中的作用。

name: Konrad P Kording
title: Professor of Bioengineering
summary: Studies the relationship between neural structure and function, using causal inference and machine learning to reverse-engineer nervous systems.
summary_zh: 研究神经结构与功能之间的关系，使用因果推断和机器学习方法反向工程神经系统。

name: Lauren Kreeger
title: Assistant Professor of Otorhinolaryngology: Head and Neck Surgery
summary: Studies the auditory system and neural circuits involved in hearing, using electrophysiology and anatomical methods.
summary_zh: 研究听觉系统和参与听觉的神经回路，使用电生理学和解剖学方法。

name: Manzar Ashtari
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像学方法。

name: Nicholas L. Balderston
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the mechanisms of clinical anxiety using psychophysiology, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation.
summary_zh: 研究临床焦虑的机制，使用生理心理学、神经成像和神经调节方法。

name: MD Ran Barzilay
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the development of brain and behavior in stressed children and adolescents, focusing on risk and resilience factors leading to suicidal behavior.
summary_zh: 研究压力下儿童和青少年的大脑和行为发展，重点关注导致自杀行为的风险和韧性因素。

name: MD Mathias Basner
title: Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the impact of sleep and circadian rhythms on cognitive performance and mental health, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和昼夜节律对认知表现和心理健康的影响，使用实验方法。

name: Danielle S. Bassett
title: Professor of Bioengineering
summary: Studies biological, physical, and social systems using network science and complex systems theory, focusing on brain networks and predicting learning and disease.
summary_zh: 研究生物、物理和社会系统，使用网络科学和复杂系统理论，特别是在大脑网络、学习预测和疾病诊断方面。

name: Michael Stephen Beauchamp
title: Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies the neural basis of multisensory integration, particularly the McGurk effect, using electrophysiological recording and deep neural network models.
summary_zh: 研究多感官整合的神经基础，特别是麦格尔效应，使用电生理记录和深度神经网络模型。

name: Timothy A. Machado
title: Presidential Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how motor command pathways interact to generate specific movements using multiregion neural recording techniques.
summary_zh: 研究运动指令路径如何相互作用以生成特定动作，使用多区域神经记录技术。

name: J Nicholas Betley
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Seema Bhatnagar
title: Professor of Anesthesiology and Critical Care
summary: Studies the neural circuits impacted by chronic stress and how they contribute to affective and anxiety disorders, using rats and advanced neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究慢性应激对神经回路的影响及其如何导致情感和焦虑障碍，使用大鼠和先进的神经科学技术。

name: Sandra Maday
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the cellular mechanisms of learning and memory in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中学习和记忆的细胞机制。

name: Julie A. Blendy
title: Professor of Systems Pharmacology and Translational Therapeutics
areas: Molecular Basis of Addiction and Depression
summary: Studies the molecular basis of addiction and depression using mouse models and behavioral genetics, focusing on CREB and CREM transcription factors.
