summary_zh: 研究成瘾和抑郁的分子基础，使用小鼠模型和行为遗传学，重点关注CREB和CREM转录因子。

name: Lauren M Massimo
title: Assistant Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory in humans.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Corey T McMillan
title: Associate Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's and ALS, using brain imaging and genetic analyses to identify biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病和ALS等神经退行性疾病，使用脑成像和基因分析来识别诊断和治疗的生物标志物。

name: Arghya Mukherjee
title: Assistant Professor of Pediatrics (Neurology)
summary: Studies how brain circuits in the prefrontal cortex support cognitive functions like memory and reasoning, using behavioral physiology and optogenetic techniques in rodents and treeshrews.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层如何支持记忆和推理等认知功能，使用行为生理学和光遗传学技术在啮齿动物和松鼠猴中进行研究。

name: Gideon Nave
title: Faculty
summary: Studies decision-making processes and their neural basis.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程及其神经基础。

name: M.D. Anjan Chatterjee
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies how spatial attention and representation work in the brain, using behavioral studies and neuroimaging in patients and normal subjects.
summary_zh: 研究空间注意力和表征的认知神经科学，使用患者和正常受试者的行为研究和神经成像技术。

name: Desmond J. Oathes
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neurobiological signatures of anxiety and depression using fMRI and TMS, focusing on affective disorders and PTSD.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和抑郁的神经生物学特征，使用功能性磁共振成像和经颅磁刺激，重点关注情感障碍和PTSD。

name: Shinjae Chung
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling sleep and their interconnections with emotional states, using techniques like optogenetics and in vivo physiology.
summary_zh: 研究调控睡眠的神经回路及其与情绪状态的相互作用，使用光遗传学和体内生理学等技术。

name: MD Joseph Cichon
title: Assistant Professor of Anesthesiology and Critical Care
summary: Studies the cellular and circuit mechanisms of anesthetics, rapid-acting antidepressants, and psychedelics using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究麻醉剂、快速起效抗抑郁药和致幻剂的细胞和回路机制，使用动物模型进行研究。

name: Rebecca L. Pearl
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis of cognitive control and decision-making processes.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和决策过程的神经基础。

name: Yale E. Cohen
title: Gabriel Tucker Professor II
summary: Studies how the brain combines sensory, motor, and cognitive cues to form internal models of the external world, focusing on auditory information in the cortex.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何结合感觉、运动和认知线索形成对外部世界的内部模型，重点在于听觉信息在皮层中的处理。

name: Jennifer E. Phillips-Cremins
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the structure and function of chromatin in neurons, using genomics and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经元中的染色质结构与功能，使用基因组学和计算方法。

name: Gregory Corder
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neural basis of pain perception and opioid dependence, using in vivo calcium imaging and optogenetics in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究疼痛感知和阿片类依赖的神经基础，使用体内钙成像和光遗传学在啮齿动物模型中进行.

name: Robert Christopher Pierce
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: M.D. Alexander Proekt
title: Robert Dunning Dripps Professor in Anesthesia II
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory and consciousness using computational and systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和意识的神经机制，采用计算和系统神经科学方法。

name: John A. Dani
title: David J. Mahoney Professor of Neurological Sciences II
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying addiction and their similarities to learning processes, using behavioral tasks and pharmacological methods.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾的神经机制及其与学习过程的相似性，使用行为任务和药理学方法。

name: Mariella De Biasi
title: Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies drug addiction and its mechanisms using electrophysiology and behavioral testing in preclinical genetic models.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及其机制，使用电生理学和行为测试在预临床遗传模型中。

name: John A. Detre
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies brain physiology and pathophysiology of functional activation using magnetic resonance techniques.
summary_zh: 研究功能性激活的脑生理和病理生理学，使用磁共振技术。

name: David F. Dinges
title: Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the effects of sleep and circadian rhythms on cognitive performance and neurobehavioral functions in humans.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和昼夜节律对人类认知表现和神经行为功能的影响。

name: Heath Donmar Schmidt
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像技术。

name: Marc F. Schmidt
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of vocal production, perception and learning in songbirds, using chronic recording and behavioral analysis.
summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的发声、感知和学习的神经机制，使用慢性记录和行为分析方法。

name: MD Jacob Dubroff
title: Associate Professor of Radiology at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
summary: Studies neuroreceptor PET imaging and molecular imaging of neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on addiction and brain plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究神经受体PET成像和神经精神疾病分子成像，重点关注成瘾和大脑可塑性。

name: Benjamin Scholl
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention, using psychophysical methods and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用心理物理学方法和计算模型。

name: Amita Sehgal
title: John Herr Musser Professor
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular networks driving rhythmic behaviors, particularly sleep, using fruit flies, mice, and human cells.
summary_zh: 研究驱动节律行为（尤其是睡眠）的分子和细胞网络，使用果蝇、小鼠和人类细胞进行研究。

name: J. Christopher Edgar
title: Professor of Radiology at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia
summary: Studies brain imaging techniques such as magnetoencephalography and electroencephalography to understand disorders like autism spectrum disorder and schizophrenia.
summary_zh: 研究脑成像技术如脑磁图和脑电图，以理解自闭症谱系障碍和精神分裂症等疾病。

name: Amelia J. Eisch
title: Professor of Anesthesiology and Critical Care
summary: Studies how molecular and cellular changes in the hippocampus affect learning, memory, anxiety, and stress response, using genetic, molecular, and behavioral approaches.
summary_zh: 研究海马区的分子和细胞变化如何影响学习、记忆、焦虑和应激反应，采用遗传学、分子生物学和行为学方法。

name: M.D. Sheila Shanmugan
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the development of brain networks and their relation to psychopathology in youth using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究青少年脑网络的发展及其与精神病理学的关系，使用神经影像学技术。

name: Christopher M. Fang-Yen
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
areas: Neurobiology and behavior in C. elegans
summary: Studies aging and behavior in C. elegans using optogenetics and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用光遗传学和成像技术研究衰老和行为的秀丽隐杆线虫。

name: Li Shen
title: Professor of Informatics in Biostatistics and Epidemiology
summary: Develops and applies advanced AI/ML methods to analyze large-scale biobank and health datasets to improve understanding and treatment of complex disorders.
summary_zh: 开发和应用先进的AI/ML方法分析大规模生物银行和健康数据集，以提高对复杂疾病的理解与治疗。

name: Brett L. Foster
title: Associate Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies human brain networks supporting memory and perception using neurosurgical recordings, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation.
summary_zh: 使用神经外科记录、神经成像和神经调节研究支持记忆和知觉的人类脑网络。

name: Maria Neimark Geffen
title: Professor of Otorhinolaryngology: Head and Neck Surgery
summary: Studies how the brain encodes auditory information and how emotional state affects perception, using computational and biological approaches.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码听觉信息以及情绪状态如何影响知觉，采用计算和生物学方法。

name: Christoph A. Thaiss
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Marco Tizzano
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像学技术。

name: Jena Shaw Tronieri
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Harvey J Grill
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural circuits and transmitter systems in the caudal brainstem that control meal size and food intake.
summary_zh: 研究控制餐食大小和食物摄入的尾脑干神经回路和递质系统。

name: M.D. Murray Grossman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases, focusing on frontotemporal degeneration, neurolinguistics, and executive functioning using behavioral, imaging, and biofluid measures.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病中的生物标志物，重点关注前颞叶退化、神经语言学和执行功能，使用行为、成像和生物体液测量方法。

name: Ruben C. Gur
title: Professor of Psychology in Psychiatry
summary: Studies cognitive and neuroimaging aspects of schizophrenia, focusing on neurodevelopment and social cognition.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的认知和神经成像方面，重点关注神经发育和社会认知。

name: Franz Weber
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
areas: We are interested in the neural
summary: Studies the neural and homeostatic mechanisms controlling REM sleep and its functional roles in emotional behaviors using optogenetics and in vivo electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究REM睡眠的神经和稳态机制及其在情绪行为中的功能作用，使用光遗传学和体内电生理学方法。

name: Michael P Hart
title: Assistant Professor of Genetics
summary: Studies how genes regulate behaviors by defining cellular and molecular mechanisms, using C. elegans to test and compare gene impacts on neurons, synapses, circuits, and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究基因如何调节行为，通过定义细胞和分子机制，在秀丽隐杆线虫中测试和比较基因对神经元、突触、回路和行为的影响。

name: Corinde E. Wiers
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the effects of metabolic ketosis on brain energetics and alcohol consumption in substance use disorder using PET and MRI neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究代谢酮症对酒精成瘾患者大脑能量代谢和酒精摄入的影响，使用正电子发射断层扫描和磁共振成像神经影像学方法。

name: Emily Hartwell
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
summary: Studies the genetic and pharmacological factors influencing alcohol use disorder and substance use disorders, using genetic, neuroimaging, and clinical data.
summary_zh: 研究酒精使用障碍和物质使用障碍的遗传和药理因素，使用遗传学、神经影像学和临床数据。

name: Beth A Winkelstein
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Hao Huang
title: Professor of Radiology
summary: Studies brain development and neuropsychiatric disorders using advanced neuroimaging techniques and big-data analytics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和神经精神障碍，使用先进的神经影像技术和大数据分析。

name: Yeong Shin Yim
title: Assistant Professor of Systems Pharmacology and Translational Therapeutics
summary: Studies the effects of inflammation on social behavior in mice, using behavioral tests and genetic models.
summary_zh: 研究炎症对小鼠社会行为的影响，使用行为测试和遗传模型。

name: Li-Feng Jiang-Xie
title: Assistant Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the function and origin of sleep using electrophysiology, two-photon imaging, and computational tools to develop a theory of self-cleansing brain during sleep.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠的功能和起源，使用电生理学、双光子成像和计算工具来发展大脑自我清洁的理论。

name: Michelle Jillian Johnson
title: Professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies the effects of robot-assisted interventions on brain plasticity and motor control in aging, neural disease, and injury.
summary_zh: 研究机器人辅助干预对衰老、神经疾病和损伤引起的脑可塑性和运动控制的影响。

name: Dorsa Amir
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how culture influences and is influenced by cognition, focusing on decision-making in children and adults and how children’s cognitive strengths shape culture.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何影响和被认知所影响，重点关注儿童和成人决策以及儿童的认知优势如何塑造文化。

name: Steven R. Asher
title: Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
summary: Studies social development in childhood, adolescence, and college, focusing on social competence and peer relationships, using observational and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、青少年和大学时期的社会发展，重点在于社交能力与同伴关系，采用观察和实验方法。

name: Gary G. Bennett
title: is a professor of psychology & neuroscience, global health, medicine, and nursing, and is the
summary: Develops and tests digital behavior change interventions, especially for obesity treatment in primary care.
summary_zh: 开发和测试数字行为改变干预措施，特别是在初级保健中的肥胖治疗。

name: Staci D. Bilbo
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the impact of early-life immune activation on brain development and later neuropsychiatric disorders, focusing on microglia.
summary_zh: 研究早期免疫激活对大脑发育的影响及其与神经精神障碍后期结果的关系，重点关注小胶质细胞。

name: Roberto Cabeza
title: Haley Family Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural correlates of memory and cognition in young and older adults using fMRI, focusing on episodic memory processes and cross-functional comparisons.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究年轻和老年成人记忆和认知的神经相关性，重点关注 episodic 记忆过程和跨功能比较。

name: Avshalom Caspi
title: Edward M. Arnett Distinguished Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how childhood experiences shape aging and health inequalities, genetic influences on environmental responses, and the life course of mental health problems.
summary_zh: 研究童年经历如何影响老化和健康不平等，基因差异如何影响环境反应，以及心理健康问题的生活轨迹。

name: Harris M. Cooper
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the relationship between time and learning, focusing on school calendars and homework.
summary_zh: 研究时间与学习的关系，重点关注学校日程和家庭作业。

name: Curriculum Vita
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural basis, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Maureen Alyson Craig
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how diversity, inequality, and discrimination affect attitudes and social relations, using inter-minority relations and lay beliefs of privilege.
summary_zh: 研究多样性和不平等如何影响态度和社会关系，使用跨少数群体关系和特权的直觉信念。

name: Ruth S. Day
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies basic cognitive processes like perception, memory, and problem-solving, and how they apply to everyday situations such as medical and legal cognition, and teaching.
summary_zh: 研究基本认知过程（如知觉、记忆和问题解决），以及这些过程在医疗、法律和教学等日常生活情境中的应用。

name: Tobias Egner
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the computational and neural mechanisms of cognitive control, focusing on how people switch between tasks and maintain focus on current tasks.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制的计算和神经机制，重点在于人们如何在不同任务之间切换以及如何保持对当前任务的关注。

name: Sarah Elizabeth Gaither
title: Nicholas J. and Theresa M. Leonardy Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social identities and intergroup contact influence social perceptions and behaviors, particularly in diverse settings, to foster positive group relations.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份和跨群体接触如何影响社会认知和行为，特别是在多元环境中，以促进积极的群体关系。

name: Jennifer M. Groh
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sensory and motor systems work together, focusing on the interactions between vision and hearing, and how neural representations influence sensorimotor and cognitive processing.
summary_zh: 研究感觉和运动系统如何协同工作，特别是在视觉和听觉之间的相互作用，以及神经表征如何影响感觉运动和认知处理。

name: Ahmad Hariri
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies biological pathways mediating individual differences in behavior and related risk for psychopathology using neuroimaging, pharmacology, and molecular genetics.
summary_zh: 研究行为差异和精神疾病风险的生物途径，使用神经影像学、药理学和分子遗传学方法。

name: Rick Hoyle
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies health-promoting and health-risk behaviors in late adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on social and psychological factors, and develops latent variable models.
summary_zh: 研究晚期青少年和新兴成年人的健康促进和健康风险行为，关注社会和心理因素，并开发潜在变量模型。

name: Scott Huettel
title: Professor in the Department of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of decision-making, using fMRI, ERP, and behavioral economics methods.
summary_zh: 研究决策机制的认知神经科学，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、事件相关电位（ERP）和行为经济学方法。

name: Tamar Kushnir
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how children learn and revise beliefs, focusing on theory of mind and moral cognition.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习和修正信念，重点在于理论思维和道德认知。

name: Kevin S. LaBar
title: Robert L. Wilson Distinguished Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how emotional events affect cognitive processes in the human brain, using fMRI, machine learning, and behavioral studies.
summary_zh: 研究情绪事件如何影响人类大脑的认知过程，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、机器学习和行为研究。

name: Elizabeth J. Marsh
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how memory can be accurate or erroneous, focusing on the processes of learning, memory, and the impact of fiction on memory.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的准确性和错误性，关注学习、记忆过程以及虚构内容对记忆的影响。

name: Jenna Ann McHenry
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural circuits directing social and nonsocial motivated behaviors, using optogenetics and in vivo deep-brain calcium imaging.
summary_zh: 研究指导社会和非社会动机行为的神经回路，使用光遗传学和深脑在体钙成像技术。

name: Terrie E. Moffitt
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the long-term effects of mental and behavioral disorders on aging, using longitudinal data from the Dunedin and E-Risk studies.
summary_zh: 研究精神和行为障碍的长期影响，使用来自邓迪和E-Risk纵向研究的数据。

name: Moffitt Biosketch
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Minna Ng
title: Faculty
summary: Studies teaching practices to enhance student learning and classroom dynamics, using cognitive diversity and collaboration.
summary_zh: 研究教学实践以提高学生学习和课堂动态，利用认知多样性与合作。

name: Bass Connections
title: Faculty
summary: Studies not found in provided profile.
summary_zh: 研究信息未在提供的简介中找到。

name: Tobias Overath
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sound is processed in the human brain, focusing on acoustic parameters and neural mechanisms using fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理声音，重点关注声学参数和神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图。

name: O-Lab Homepage
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how sound is processed in the human auditory cortex, focusing on acoustic parameters and neural mechanisms for detecting meaningful changes.
summary_zh: 研究人类听觉皮层中声音处理的过程，重点是声学参数以及检测有意义变化的神经机制。

name: Eve S. Puffer
title: Pamela and Jack Egan Associate Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates interventions to promote child mental health and prevent HIV risk behavior in rural Kenya and other countries.
summary_zh: 开发和评估促进儿童心理健康和预防HIV风险行为的干预措施，特别是在肯尼亚农村和其他国家。

name: David C. Rubin
title: Juanita M. Kreps Distinguished Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies long-term memory, especially for complex stimuli, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods to explore autobiographical memory and its relation to morality.
summary_zh: 研究长期记忆，特别是复杂刺激的记忆，使用行为和神经成像方法探索自传体记忆及其与道德的关系。

name: Phia S Salter
title: Fred W. Shaffer Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the bi-directional relationships between collective memory, history, and identity, and theorizes racism as a systemic phenomenon embedded in cultural context.
summary_zh: 研究集体记忆、历史与身份之间的双向关系，并将种族主义视为嵌入文化背景中的系统性现象。

name: Cristina E Salvador
title: Susan W. Beltz and A. Morris Williams, Jr. Assistant Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
summary: Examines how culture interfaces with biology to influence thinking, feeling, and behavior through comparisons between groups, neural responses, and the impact of social norms.
summary_zh: 研究文化与生物学如何相互作用以影响思维、情感和行为，通过组间比较、神经反应和社交规范的影响进行分析。

name: Gregory Russell Samanez-Larkin
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how motivation, emotion, and cognition influence decision-making and health behavior across the lifespan, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究动机、情绪和认知如何影响决策和健康行为的生命周期，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: James Shah
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the interplay between motivation and cognition in goal pursuit, examining emotional and behavioral outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究动机与认知在目标追求中的相互作用，探讨情感和行为结果。

name: Timothy J. Strauman
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies self-regulation and its role in mental health, using neuroimaging and clinical research to develop interventions.
summary_zh: 研究自我调节及其在心理健康中的作用，使用神经成像和临床研究开发干预措施。

name: Michael Tomasello
title: James F. Bonk Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies social cognition, cooperation, and shared intentionality in children and great apes.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知、合作和共享意向性在儿童和大猿中的发展。

name: Henry Yin
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of goal-directed actions using behavioral assays, electrophysiological techniques, and genetic tools in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究目标导向行为的神经机制，使用行为分析、电生理技术和遗传工具在啮齿动物中进行研究。

name: Nancy Lee Zucker
title: Professor in Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how disruptions in interoception contribute to psychosomatic disorders like anorexia nervosa and functional abdominal pain, and designs treatments to help individuals use bodily signals.
summary_zh: 研究内感受障碍如何导致功能性腹痛和厌食症等身心疾病，并设计治疗方法帮助个体有效利用身体信号。

name: Leonard Edward White
title: Associate Professor in Neurology
summary: Studies the structure and function of the mammalian brain, using magnetic resonance methods and light sheet microscopy to understand brain connectivity and development.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑的结构和功能，使用磁共振方法和光片显微镜来理解大脑连接性和发育。

name: Marina Bedny
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how developmental experience shapes the human mind and brain, focusing on visual cortex plasticity and conceptual development in blind individuals.
summary_zh: 研究发育经验如何塑造人类心智和大脑，重点关注盲人视觉皮层可塑性和概念发展。

name: Janice Chen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how we construct and retrieve memories of complex real-world episodes using movies and narratives, focusing on mnemonic and sensory systems.
summary_zh: 研究复杂现实事件的记忆构建与检索过程，使用电影和叙述作为刺激，关注记忆和感觉系统的作用。

name: Céline Drieu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how distributed brain networks support learning and memory in rodents, using electrophysiology, imaging, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究分布式脑网络如何支持学习和记忆，使用电生理学、成像和光遗传学方法在啮齿动物中进行研究。

name: Howard Egeth
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies perception and cognition, attention and attentional selectivity, and memory.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和认知、注意力和注意力选择性以及记忆。

name: Lisa Feigenson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Chair and Professor
summary: Studies the development of numerical abilities, working memory, and early learning in infants and adults.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和成人数量能力、工作记忆和早期学习的发展。

name: Chaz Firestone
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies perception and how it interacts with higher-level cognition, exploring physical intuitions and visual attention.
summary_zh: 研究知觉及其与高级认知的相互作用，探索物理直觉和视觉注意力。

name: Jonathan Flombaum
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual perception, attention, and cognition using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、注意力和认知，使用多种方法。

name: Justin Halberda
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how vision, cognition, and language interact, focusing on word-learning and numerical cognition in infants and adults.
summary_zh: 研究视觉、认知和语言之间的相互作用，关注婴儿和成人词汇学习和数理认知。

name: Christopher Honey
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain perceives and learns sequences of information using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过计算方法感知和学习信息序列。

name: Patricia Janak
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the behavioral and neural mechanisms of associative learning and addiction, focusing on the role of the amygdala and dopamine in cue and outcome encoding, and relapse triggered by.
summary_zh: 研究条件反射和成瘾的行为和神经机制，重点在于杏仁核和多巴胺在条件刺激和结果编码中的作用，以及环境线索引起的复吸机制。

name: Christopher Krupenye
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive abilities of humans and other animals, focusing on theory of mind, social and physical knowledge, and mental time travel using eye-tracking and behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究人类和其他动物的认知能力，特别是理论思维、社会和物理知识以及心理时间旅行，使用眼动追踪和行为任务。

name: Kishore Kuchibhotla
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and dynamics that enable learning, with an emphasis on the role of context and brain state.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和动态机制，以了解学习过程，重点关注上下文和脑状态的作用。

name: Shari Liu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children develop cognitive abilities, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的认知能力发展，使用行为和神经影像学方法。

name: Cynthia Moss
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how bats use echolocation to navigate and perceive their environment, focusing on sensorimotor integration and spatial perception.
summary_zh: 研究蝙蝠通过回声定位感知环境和导航的机制，重点在于感觉运动整合和空间知觉。

name: Shreesh Mysore
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
areas: comparative approach to the design of neural circuits
summary: Studies the circuit mechanisms of attention and decision-making using computational neuroscience and a comparative approach.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和决策行为背后的神经环路机制，采用计算神经科学和比较方法。

name: Ian Phillips
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor, Department of Philosophy and Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies perception, memory, imagination, consciousness, and time perception using philosophical and empirical methods.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、记忆、想象、意识和时间知觉，采用哲学和实证方法。

name: Barbara Landau
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Dick and Lydia Todd Professor
areas: Human knowledge of language and space
summary: Studies how children learn words from spatial relationships, using experimental methods with young participants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过空间关系学习词汇，使用针对幼儿的实验方法。

name: Brenda Rapp
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognitive Science
summary: Studies the cognitive processes and neural substrates of written and spoken word production and comprehension, using fMRI to understand recovery from neural injury.
summary_zh: 研究书面和口头单词生成和理解的认知过程和神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）来理解神经损伤后的恢复过程。

name: Marilyn Albert
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor and Director
summary: Studies aging, cognition, and memory in humans.
summary_zh: 研究人类衰老、认知和记忆。

name: Charles Connor
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain transforms visual images into knowledge about the world, focusing on higher-level visual cortex and object and scene vision.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何将视觉图像转化为对世界的知识，重点在于高级视觉皮层和物体与场景视觉。

name: Mounya Elhilali
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Charles Renn Faculty Scholar and Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sounds and how this guides human behavior, using computational models and neural recordings.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理复杂声音以及这种处理如何指导人类行为，使用计算模型和神经记录。

name: Christopher Fetsch
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Mind/Brain Institute
summary: Studies how the brain combines visual and vestibular signals to make decisions about self-motion and the confidence in those decisions.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何结合视觉和前庭信号来做出关于自身运动的决策及其信心。

name: Barry Gordon
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral aspects of neurology, focusing on improving language, memory, and thinking skills in individuals with brain conditions.
summary_zh: 研究神经病学的认知和行为方面，专注于改善患有脑部疾病个体的语言、记忆和思维能力。

name: E.J. Green
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Miller Associate Professor, Department of Philosophy and Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
areas: Philosophy of mind and philosophy of cognitive science
with a primary focus on perception
summary: Explores the philosophical foundations of perception, integrating insights from cognitive science.
summary_zh: 探讨知觉的哲学基础，结合认知科学的见解。

name: Steven Gross
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Philosophy
summary: Explores the philosophy of language, mind, and cognitive science, focusing on topics like perception, attention, and cognitive penetration.
summary_zh: 研究语言、心灵和认知科学的哲学，重点关注知觉、注意力和认知渗透等主题。

name: Leyla Isik
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how humans recognize and understand social information from visual input, using a combination of human behavior, neuroimaging, and advanced computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何从视觉输入中识别和理解社会信息，使用人类行为、神经成像和高级计算建模的结合。

name: Alfredo Kirkwood
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Mind/Brain Institute
summary: Studies mechanisms of cortical modification, exploring how the brain changes in response to experience.
summary_zh: 研究皮层可塑性的机制，探索大脑如何因经验而改变。

name: James Knierim
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Mind/Brain Institute
areas: Behavioral neurophysiology of the hippocampal formation
summary: Studies how the hippocampal formation influences behavior through neural activity.
summary_zh: 研究海马区通过神经活动如何影响行为。

name: Hey-Kyoung Lee
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Mind/Brain Institute
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular changes at synapses to allow memory storage, using electrophysiological recording, biochemical/molecular analysis, and imaging.
summary_zh: 研究突触在记忆形成中的细胞和分子变化，使用电生理记录、生物化学/分子分析和成像技术。

name: Michael McCloskey
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognitive Science
summary: Studies reading, writing, and visual perception, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods to examine cognitive processes and deficits.
summary_zh: 研究阅读、书写和视觉感知，使用行为和神经影像学方法探讨认知过程和缺陷。

name: Ernst Niebur
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms that organize neural circuits during development.
summary_zh: 研究发育过程中神经回路的组织机制。

name: Hanna Pickard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor, Department of Philosophy and Berman Institute of Bioethics
summary: Explores philosophical questions arising from clinical practice, integrating addiction science, philosophy, and psychology.
summary_zh: 探讨临床实践中产生的哲学问题，将成瘾科学、哲学和心理学相结合。

name: Joshua Vogelstein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies patterns in physical and mental worlds, focusing on brain mechanisms and aligning them for better human and animal life.
summary_zh: 研究物理世界和心理世界中的模式，专注于大脑机制及其与人类和动物生活的更好协调。

name: Kristina Nielsen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Mind/Brain Institute
summary: Studies the function and development of higher level visual cortex, using brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究高级视觉皮层的功能及其发展，使用脑成像技术。

name: Veit Stuphorn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies decision-making processes using neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 使用神经生理学方法研究决策过程。

name: Kyle Rawlins
title: Professor & Chair
summary: Studies formal semantics, pragmatics, and syntax, integrating theoretical linguistics, computational modeling, and experimental data.
summary_zh: 研究形式语义学、语用学和句法，结合理论语言学、计算建模和实验数据。

name: Mick Bonner
title: Assistant Professor, Colloquium Chair
summary: Studies the visual system of the human brain using computational methods and neuroimaging to understand how visual cortex representations are computed from sensory inputs.
summary_zh: 使用计算方法和神经成像研究人类大脑的视觉系统，理解视觉皮层如何从感官输入中生成表征。

name: John T. Hale
title: Professor
summary: Studies human language processing using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 使用计算建模和神经成像研究人类语言处理。

name: Jennifer Hu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the computational principles of human language and communication, using computational modeling, behavioral experiments, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言和交流的计算原理，使用计算建模、行为实验和人工智能方法。

name: Annemarie Kocab
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language emerges and is acquired, focusing on homesign systems, Nicaraguan Sign Language, and language comprehension in sign language users.
summary_zh: 研究语言的产生和习得，重点关注家庭手势系统、尼加拉瓜手语以及手语使用者的语言理解。

name: Géraldine Legendre
title: Professor
summary: Studies the syntax and acquisition of syntax in adults and children, focusing on optimization theory and cross-linguistic variation.
summary_zh: 研究成人的句法和句法习得，重点是优化理论和跨语言变体。

name: Colin Wilson
title: Professor
summary: Studies phonology, phonetics, and computational models of speech perception and production across languages.
summary_zh: 研究音系学、语音学以及跨语言语音感知和生产的计算模型。

name: Alan Yuille
title: Bloomberg Distinguished Professor of Cognitive Science & Computer Science
summary: Develops computational models of vision and mathematical models of cognition, integrating artificial intelligence and neural networks.
summary_zh: 开发视觉计算模型和认知数学模型，结合人工智能和神经网络。

name: Brance Amussen
title: Faculty
summary: Supports brain sciences organizational units in the Krieger School of Arts & Sciences.
summary_zh: 支持Krieger文理学院的脑科学组织单位。

name: Brendan Banyai
title: Faculty
summary: Studies language processing and semantics using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 使用认知神经科学方法研究语言处理和语义。

name: Justin Bledin
title: Associate Professor, Philosophy
summary: Develops an informational view of logic and deductive inquiry, focusing on formal semantics, epistemology, and decision theory.
summary_zh: 发展逻辑和演绎推理的信息论观点，专注于形式语义学、认识论和决策理论。

name: Dana Boatman
title: Professor, School of Medicine, Neurology and Neurosurgery
summary: Studies how the human brain perceives sounds in complex listening environments, using electrophysiology and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑在复杂听觉环境中的声音感知机制，使用电生理学和计算建模方法。

name: John E. Desmond
title: Professor, School of Medicine, Neurology and Neurosurgery
summary: Studies the role of the cerebellum in cognition, particularly verbal working memory, using fMRI and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究小脑在认知中的作用，特别是口头工作记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。

name: Jason Eisner
title: Professor, Whiting School of Engineering, Computer Science
summary: Develops probabilistic models for linguistic structure and connects them to common-sense reasoning and AI applications.
summary_zh: 开发概率模型以构建语言结构，并将其与常识推理和AI应用相结合。

name: Argye Hillis
title: Professor, School of Medicine, Neurology and Neurosurgery
summary: Studies cognitive and neuroimaging recovery after right hemisphere stroke, focusing on language and cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 研究右半球中风后语言和认知功能的恢复机制及其神经影像学表现。

name: Brice Ménard
title: Professor, Physics and Astronomy
summary: Studies the physics of learning and properties of neural networks in artificial and biological systems, combining physics and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究学习的物理原理和神经网络（人工和生物）的性质，结合物理学和机器学习。

name: Tianmin Shu
title: Assistant Professor, Whiting School of Engineering, Computer Science
summary: Studies machine social intelligence, developing AI agents that understand, reason about, and interact with humans in complex environments.
summary_zh: 研究机器社会智能，构建能够理解、推理和与人类在复杂环境中互动的AI代理。

name: Kyrana Tsapkini
title: Associate Professor, Neurology, School of Medicine
summary: Studies the interactions between language and cognitive systems in post-stroke and primary progressive aphasia using brain imaging and stimulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言和认知系统在中风后和进行性失语症中的相互作用，使用脑成像和刺激技术。

name: Benjamin Van Durme
title: Associate Professor, Whiting School of Engineering, Computer Science
summary: Develops algorithms for natural language processing and understanding, focusing on helping people work with large amounts of information.
summary_zh: 开发自然语言处理和理解的算法，帮助人们处理大量信息。

name: Alex Lu
title: Fellow by Courtesy in the Language Creation and Learning Lab
summary: Develops machine learning methods to analyze biological images, aiming to uncover subtle patterns in data.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习方法分析生物图像，旨在揭示数据中的细微模式。

name: Jeremy Purcell
title: Fellow by Courtesy in the Cognitive & Brain Sciences Lab (Rapp Lab)
summary: Develops and applies novel methods to analyze local neural representational differentiation, focusing on written language.
summary_zh: 开发和应用新型方法分析局部神经表征差异，重点研究书面语言的神经基础。

name: Sue Potterfield
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes using budget analysis methods.
summary_zh: 使用预算分析方法研究认知过程。

name: Charlie Ainsworth
title: Faculty
summary: Studies sign language creation and learning, focusing on language acquisition and development.
summary_zh: 研究手语的创造与学习，关注语言习得与发展。

name: Donovan Catt
title: Faculty
summary: Studies sign language creation and learning, focusing on linguistic structures and processes.
summary_zh: 研究手语的创造与学习，关注语言结构和过程。

name: Ronak Elias
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience and neuroplasticity in development using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究发展认知神经科学和神经可塑性，使用计算方法。

name: Lissette Gonzalez
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn language and understand space using games and activities.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过游戏和活动学习语言和空间概念。

name: Michael Bailey
title: Professor
summary: Studies sexual orientation and gender nonconformity, examining arousal patterns and genetic influences.
summary_zh: 研究性取向和性别不遵从，探索性唤起模式和遗传影响。

name: Mark Beeman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people solve complex problems and experience sudden insight, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何解决复杂问题和经历突然顿悟，使用认知神经科学方法。

name: Galen Bodenhausen
title: Professor
summary: Studies how stereotypes and prejudice affect attention, inference, and memory, and how affect influences social cognition.
summary_zh: 研究刻板印象和偏见如何影响注意力、推理和记忆，以及情绪如何影响社会认知。

name: Edith Chen
title: John D & Catherine T MacArthur Professor
summary: Studies the psychological and biological mechanisms linking poverty to poor health outcomes in children, and resilience in children facing adversity.
summary_zh: 研究贫困与儿童不良健康结果之间的心理和生物学机制，以及逆境中儿童的复原力。

name: Mesmin Destin
title: Professor
summary: Studies how socioeconomic environments influence cognition and motivation, particularly in young people's perceptions of resources and opportunities.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济环境如何影响认知和动机，特别是在年轻人对资源和机会的感知方面。

name: Eli Finkel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how relationships affect well-being and decision-making, using longitudinal studies and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系如何影响幸福感和决策，使用纵向研究和调查问卷。

name: Steven Franconeri
title: Professor
summary: Studies how visual thinking and communication work, and how to improve them for better thinking, remembering, and communicating.
summary_zh: 研究视觉思维和交流的工作原理，以及如何改进以促进更有效的思考、记忆和交流。

name: Stephanie Fryberg
title: James E. Johnson Professor
summary: Studies how social representations of race, culture, and social class affect self, well-being, health, and education.
summary_zh: 研究种族、文化和社会阶层的社会表征如何影响自我、福祉、健康和教育。

name: Wendi Gardner
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social inclusion affects self-perception and self-regulation through mental processes and behaviors, including attention to others and cognitive strategies for feeling connected.
summary_zh: 研究社会包容如何影响自我感知和自我调节，包括对他人的注意力以及感到联系的认知策略。

name: Dedre Gentner
title: Alice Gabrielle Twight Professor
summary: Studies how analogies and language influence learning and cognitive development in children.
summary_zh: 研究类比和语言如何影响儿童的认知发展和学习。

name: Sid Horton
title: Associate Professor, Director of Cognitive Psychology
summary: Studies the social and contextual factors affecting language use and understanding, including common ground and epistemic judgments.
summary_zh: 研究社会和情境因素如何影响语言使用和理解，包括共通知识和知识判断。

name: Katie Insel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies adolescent brain development to understand cognitive and behavioral changes, using fMRI and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究青少年大脑发展，以理解认知和行为变化，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和计算建模方法。

name: Michael Kraus
title: Professor, Director of Social Psychology
summary: Studies societal inequality, emotion, and self-perception, focusing on race, class, and gender.
summary_zh: 研究社会不平等、情绪和自我感知，重点关注种族、阶级和性别。

name: Dan McAdams
title: Henry Wade Rogers Professor
summary: Studies the development of life stories and identity, focusing on themes of power, intimacy, and redemption in human lives.
summary_zh: 研究生命故事和身份的发展，重点关注权力、亲密关系和救赎等主题在人类生活中的体现。

name: Greg Miller
title: Louis W Menk Professor
summary: Studies how early-life stress affects health across the lifespan, using a combination of behavioral and biomedical sciences.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响一生的健康，结合行为和生物医学科学的方法。

name: Vijay Mittal
title: David S. Holmes Professor of Brain Science, Department Chair
summary: Studies the early identification and intervention of psychotic disorders in adolescents, using cognitive neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究青少年精神病性障碍的早期识别和干预，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Daniel Molden
title: Professor, Honors Program Coordinator
summary: Studies how people's motivations influence their cognitive processes and judgments, examining strategies and theories.
summary_zh: 研究人们动机如何影响认知过程和判断，探讨策略和理论的作用。

name: Dan Mroczek
title: Professor, Director of Personality, Development and Health
summary: Studies personality development across the lifespan and its impact on health outcomes, using longitudinal designs and multilevel modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人格在一生中的发展及其对健康结果的影响，使用纵向设计和多层次建模方法。

name: Ken Paller
title: James Padilla Professor
summary: Studies human memory and other cognitive aspects, including the biological bases of mental phenomena, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和其他认知方面，包括心理现象的生物学基础，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Sylvia Perry
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how racial bias awareness develops and its implications for prejudice reduction and medical trainees' perceptions.
summary_zh: 研究种族偏见意识的发展及其对减少偏见和医疗培训生感知的影响。

name: David Rapp
title: Walter Dill Scott Professor
summary: Studies reading comprehension processes, including activation of prior knowledge and memory updating, and how these processes influence everyday learning experiences.
summary_zh: 研究阅读理解过程，包括先验知识的激活和记忆更新，以及这些过程如何影响日常学习经验。

name: Paul Reber
title: Professor, Director of Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience
areas: Nonconscious perceptual learning of artificial categories
summary: Studies how the brain expresses memory and the neural correlates of rule-based and information-integration visual category learning.
summary_zh: 研究记忆在大脑中的表达以及规则和信息整合视觉类别学习的神经相关性。

name: William Revelle
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality and its interaction with situational factors to understand cognitive performance, using SAPA techniques and R package psych.
summary_zh: 研究人格与情境因素的相互作用，以理解认知表现，使用SAPA技术和psych包。

name: Lance Rips
title: Professor
summary: Studies concepts of objects and events, reasoning about new mathematical systems, and autobiographical memory.
summary_zh: 研究对象和事件的概念、新的数学系统推理以及自传式记忆。

name: Satoru Suzuki
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and selects global forms from ambiguous visual inputs, using psychophysical methods and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何从模糊的视觉输入中编码和选择全局形式，使用心理物理学方法和计算建模。

name: Jennifer Tackett
title: Professor
summary: Studies early personality traits related to leadership and entrepreneurship in youth, using longitudinal and cross-situational methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年领导力和创业精神相关的早期人格特质，采用纵向和跨情境方法。

name: David Uttal
title: Kenneth Burgess Professor
summary: Studies how children develop spatial and mathematical thinking, using cognitive and educational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的空间认知和数学思维的发展，采用认知和教育方法。

name: Sandra Waxman
title: Louis W Menk Professor
summary: Studies how infants link language and cognition, examining the acquisition of concepts and language in young children across different cultures.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的语言和认知联系，考察不同文化下儿童概念和语言的获得。

name: Richard Zinbarg
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality traits linked to anxiety and depression, focusing on cognitive and affective processes, psychotherapy, and prevention.
summary_zh: 研究与焦虑和抑郁相关的个性特质，关注认知和情感过程，心理治疗和预防。

name: Ana Maria Acosta
title: Professor of Physical Therapy and Human Movement Sciences
summary: Studies the mechanisms of movement impairments after neural injury or disease and how the nervous system adapts.
summary_zh: 研究神经损伤或疾病后运动障碍的机制以及神经系统如何适应。

name: Ivan Alekseichuk
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how neural communications encode cognition and emotions in wellness and disorders, using precision neuromodulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑宏观神经通信如何编码认知和情绪在健康和疾病中的表现，采用精确神经调节技术。

name: Luis Amaral
title: Erastus Otis Haven Professor of Chemical and Biological Engineering
summary: Studies neurodegenerative diseases associated with aging, focusing on changes in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究与衰老相关的神经退行性疾病，关注大脑的变化。

name: Vania Apkarian
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies brain mechanisms of acute and chronic pain in humans and rodents using multiple technologies.
summary_zh: 研究人类和啮齿动物急性及慢性疼痛的大脑机制，使用多种技术手段。

name: Shana Augustin
title: Assistant Professor of Pharmacology
summary: Studies neuromodulation and intracellular signaling pathways affecting synaptic efficacy and decision-making circuits.
summary_zh: 研究神经调节和细胞内信号通路对突触效能及决策电路的影响。

name: Raj Awatramani
title: Professor of Neurology (Movement Disorders)
summary: Studies how dysfunctional dopamine signaling may underpin neuropsychiatric disorders, focusing on midbrain dopamine neuron heterogeneity.
summary_zh: 研究中脑多巴胺神经元异质性如何导致神经精神疾病中的多巴胺信号功能障碍。

name: Jim Baker
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies sensory-motor processing in vestibular and oculomotor systems using mice.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠的前庭和眼动运动系统的感觉-运动处理机制。

name: Kynon J Benjamin
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Investigates the influence of genetic factors on therapeutics for underrepresented communities.
summary_zh: 研究遗传因素对少数群体治疗效果的影响。

name: Mark Bevan
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the basal ganglia's role in action sequences and motivation, using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究基底节在动作序列和动机中的作用，采用神经科学方法。

name: Borna Bonakdarpour
title: Associate Professor of Neurology (Behavioral Neurology)
summary: Studies the neurobiology of language impairment in aphasia and investigates the efficacy of music interventions.
summary_zh: 研究语言障碍（失语症）的神经生物学机制，并调查音乐干预的有效性。

name: Thomas Bozza
title: Edgar C. Stuntz Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how the mammalian olfactory system encodes information about the chemical world, focusing on genetics and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物嗅觉系统如何编码化学世界的信号，重点关注遗传学和神经回路。

name: C. Savio Chan
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies cell and circuit elements in basal ganglia function and dysfunction.
summary_zh: 研究基底节功能和失常中的细胞和电路元素。

name: Anis Contractor
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms of synaptic communication and how they are altered in neurodevelopmental and neuropsychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究突触通讯的基本机制及其在神经发育和神经精神疾病中的异常。

name: Daniel Corcos
title: Professor of Physical Therapy and Human Movement Sciences
summary: Studies brain activity in Parkinson's disease patients using TMS, fMRI, EEG, and EMG.
summary_zh: 使用经颅磁刺激（TMS）、功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和肌电图（EMG）研究帕金森病患者的脑活动。

name: R. James Cotton
title: Assistant Professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies gait analysis using computer vision to infer nervous system capacity in neurorehabilitation.
summary_zh: 使用计算机视觉进行步态分析，以推断神经系统的功能能力，应用于神经康复。

name: Carla Cuda
title: Assistant Professor of Medicine (Rheumatology)
summary: Studies neuropsychiatric manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus using basic and translational methods.
summary_zh: 研究系统性红斑狼疮的神经精神表现，采用基础和转化研究方法。

name: Shawn Davidson
title: Assistant Professor of Medicine (Pulmonary and Critical Care)
summary: Studies how metabolic dysfunctions contribute to neurodegenerative diseases using spatial metabolomics.
summary_zh: 研究代谢功能障碍如何导致神经退行性疾病，使用空间代谢组学方法。

name: Julius P Dewald
title: Professor and Chair of Physical Therapy and Human Movement Sciences
summary: Studies motor recovery following stroke, focusing on brain plasticity and developing therapeutic interventions.
summary_zh: 研究中风后的运动恢复，关注大脑可塑性并开发治疗干预措施。

name: Daniel Dombeck
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies the neuronal activity underlying mammalian spatial navigation, focusing on cellular and circuit mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物空间导航的神经元活动，关注细胞和回路机制。

name: Hongxin Dong
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences (General Psychiatry)
summary: Studies the interaction of genetic and environmental influences on aging and their relevance to neuropsychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究遗传和环境因素在老化过程中的相互作用及其与神经精神障碍的相关性。

name: Andrew Fink
title: Assistant Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how organisms learn the structure of their world, focusing on object recognition and learning mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究生物如何学习其环境的结构，重点关注物体识别和学习机制。

name: James Fitzgerald
title: Associate Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies sensory processing, learning and memory, motor control, and whole-brain dynamics using theoretical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究感觉处理、学习与记忆、运动控制和全脑动态的理论方法。

name: Colin Franz
title: Assistant Professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, focusing on physical medicine and rehabilitation.
summary_zh: 研究大脑系统的行为机制，专注于物理医学与康复。

name: Marco Gallio
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how sensory stimuli are used to build internal representations and how these representations influence actions and behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究感觉刺激如何构建内部表征以及这些表征如何影响行为和行为。

name: Joshua Glaser
title: Assistant Professor of Neurology (Comprehensive Neurology)
summary: Develops interpretable machine learning methods to analyze large-scale neural activity data from individual neurons.
summary_zh: 开发可解释的机器学习方法，分析单个神经元的大规模神经活动数据。

name: Matt Goldrick
title: Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies the cognitive neuroscience of language using behavioral experiments, formal models, and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究语言的认知神经科学，使用行为实验、形式模型和电生理学方法。

name: Jordan Grafman
title: Professor of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies the functions and representations of the human prefrontal cortex, focusing on reward and motivation mechanisms in social cognition and learning.
summary_zh: 研究人类前额叶皮层的功能和表征，特别是在社会认知和学习中的奖励和动机机制。

name: Alicia Guemez-Gamboa
title: Assistant Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how neural circuits assemble during development and disease, focusing on genetic causes and cellular mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路在发育和疾病中的组装机制，关注遗传因素和细胞机制。

name: Claudia Haase
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Social Policy and Psychology, Associate Dean for Well-Being, School of Education and Social Policy
summary: Studies age-related changes in emotion and motivation across the life span, using multiple methods.
summary_zh: 研究生命周期中情绪和动机的变化，使用多种方法。

name: Mitra Hartmann
title: Professor of Biomedical Engineering and Mechanical Engineering
summary: Studies how animals use their sense of touch, focusing on rodent whiskers.
summary_zh: 研究动物如何使用触觉，特别是以啮齿动物的触须系统为模型。

name: Robert Vassar
title: Director of Mesulam Center for Cognitive Neurology and Alzheimer's Disease, Professor of Neurology (Behavioral Neurology) and Cell & Developmental Biology
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of Alzheimer's disease to develop effective disease-modifying therapies.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的分子和细胞机制，以开发有效的疾病修饰疗法。

name: Sandra Weintraub
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences (Psychology)
summary: Studies age-related neurodegenerative diseases affecting cognition and behavior, focusing on selective impacts on language networks.
summary_zh: 研究影响认知和行为的老年神经退行性疾病，重点关注语言网络的选择性影响。

name: Catherine Woolley
title: Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies how steroid hormones regulate synaptic structure and function in the hippocampus, affecting behavior.
summary_zh: 研究类固醇激素如何调节海马体的突触结构和功能，影响行为。

name: Beverly Wright
title: Professor of Communication Sciences and Disorders
summary: Studies how practice improves sensory perception, focusing on the factors that enhance perceptual learning.
summary_zh: 研究实践如何改善感觉知觉，关注增强感知学习的因素。

name: Lirong Yan
title: Associate Professor of Radiology (Basic and Translational Radiology Research)
summary: Develops novel MRI techniques to study brain function and hemodynamics, creating early biomarkers for neurodegeneration.
summary_zh: 开发新的MRI技术研究大脑功能和血流动力学，创建神经退行性疾病的早期生物标志物。

name: Yue Yang
title: Assistant Professor of Neurobiology
summary: Studies gene expression patterns in the brain to understand neural circuit development and refinement.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中基因表达模式以理解神经回路的发育和精炼。

name: Jun Yao
title: Professor of Physical Therapy and Human Movement Sciences
summary: Studies neuromechanisms of motor control and movement disorders using multi-modality brain imaging and quantitative methodologies.
summary_zh: 使用多模态脑成像和定量方法研究运动控制和运动障碍的神经机制。

name: Phyllis Zee
title: Benjamin and Virginia T. Boshes Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies the link between sleep, circadian rhythms, and neurological and cardio-metabolic disorders.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠、昼夜节律与神经和心血管代谢疾病之间的联系。

name: Edward S. Awh
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory and attention using psychophysics, EEG, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 使用心理物理学、EEG 和 fMRI 研究记忆和注意力的神经机制。

name: Xuechunzi Bai
title: Neubauer Family Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how individual decision processes interact with societal phenomena, focusing on human stereotyping and its cognitive mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究个体决策过程与社会现象之间的互动，重点关注人类刻板印象的认知机制及其社会后果。

name: Wilma A. Bainbridge
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies what makes certain images more memorable than others, using behavioral experiments, computer vision, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究哪些图像更容易被记住，使用行为实验、计算机视觉和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Akram Bakkour
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how relational memory influences decision-making processes using functional brain imaging, eyetracking, and neuropsychological studies.
summary_zh: 研究关系记忆如何影响决策过程，使用功能性脑成像、眼动追踪和神经心理学研究。

name: Marc G. Berman
title: Professor and Chair, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies the cognitive benefits of interacting with nature and neural mechanisms of self-control and emotion regulation using brain imaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究自然环境对认知的益处以及自我控制和情绪调节的神经机制，使用脑成像和行为实验方法。

name: Lin Bian
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children develop social cognition, including their reasoning about social categories and stereotypes, and sociomoral expectations.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会认知发展，包括他们对社会类别和刻板印象的推理以及社会道德期望。

name: Marisa Casillas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive and social processes influence language learning and production in children and adults, using experimental and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知和社会过程如何影响儿童和成人语言学习和生成，使用实验和观察方法。

name: Jean Decety
title: John D. MacArthur Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of empathy and morality, focusing on their development across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究同理心和道德的神经机制及其在生命周期中的发展。

name: Lydia Emery
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social class and self-concepts influence romantic relationships and identity formation, and promotes inclusive research practices.
summary_zh: 研究社会阶层和自我概念如何影响恋爱关系和身份形成，并促进包容性研究实践。

name: David A. Gallo
title: Professor
summary: Studies how human memory and metacognition change across the adult lifespan, including the impact of aging and disease.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和元认知在成人 lifespan 的变化，包括老化和疾病的影响。

name: Susan Goldin-Meadow
title: Beardsley Ruml Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies how children and deaf individuals use gestures to communicate and think, revealing insights into language development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和聋人如何通过手势进行交流和思考，揭示语言发展中的秘密。

name: Kyshia Henderson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how White Americans justify and promote racism by ignoring and distorting historical truths.
summary_zh: 研究美国白人如何通过忽略和歪曲历史事实来为种族主义辩护。

name: Leslie M. Kay
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of behavioral context on olfactory and limbic system neurophysiology, focusing on oscillatory cooperativity in rats.
summary_zh: 研究行为背景对嗅觉和边缘系统神经生理学的影响，重点关注大鼠的振荡协同作用。

name: Boaz Keysar
title: William Benton Professor
summary: Studies how language use affects decision-making, including the impact of foreign languages on choices and reasoning.
summary_zh: 研究语言使用如何影响决策，包括外语对选择和推理的影响。

name: Katherine D. Kinzler
title: Professor and Vice Provost
summary: Studies the origins of prejudice and ingroup/outgroup thinking, focusing on how language and accent mark social groups.
summary_zh: 研究偏见和群体思维的起源，重点关注语言和口音如何划分社会群体。

name: Yuan Chang Leong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how goals, beliefs, and emotions influence human cognition through perception, attention, memory, decision-making, affective and social reasoning using fMRI, fNIRS, computational models, and.
summary_zh: 研究目标、信念和情绪如何影响人类认知，涉及知觉、注意力、记忆、决策、情感和社会推理，使用功能性脑成像（如fMRI、fNIRS）、计算认知模型、自然语言处理工具和机器学习方法。

name: Susan C. Levine
title: Rebecca Anne Boylan Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies how children’s spatial and numerical thinking develop and interact, and how adult interactions can support this development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的空间和数值思维的发展及其相互关系，并探讨成人互动如何促进这些思维的发展。

name: Daniel Margoliash
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of vocal learning in songbirds using neuroethological approaches.
summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的鸣叫学习的神经基础，采用神经生态学方法。

name: Greg J. Norman
title: Associate Professor, Associate Chair, and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies the physiological processes underlying social interaction and health outcomes using both animal models and human participants, focusing on oxytocin and stress reactivity.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动和健康结果之间的生理过程，使用动物模型和人类参与者，重点在于催产素和应激反应。

name: Howard C. Nusbaum
title: Stella M. Rowley Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how sleep affects language learning and memory consolidation, using birds and humans.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠如何影响语言学习和记忆巩固，使用鸟类和人类作为研究对象。

name: Shigehiro Oishi
title: Marshall Field IV Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies how cultural, socio-ecological factors predict and affect well-being, including predictors and consequences of a good life.
summary_zh: 研究文化和社会生态因素如何预测和影响幸福感，包括幸福生活的预测因素和后果。

name: Brian J. Prendergast
title: Professor
areas: Seasonal behavior and ecology of migratory animals
Molecular mechanisms of migration and behavior
molecular and epigenetic mechanisms of biological timing
Chronic disease and the brain: neuroinflammation
summary: Studies seasonal behavior and migration in animals, focusing on neuroendocrine and molecular mechanisms, and the bidirectional interactions between biological clocks and the microbiome.
summary_zh: 研究迁徙动物的季节性行为和迁徙机制，关注神经内分泌和分子机制，以及生物钟与微生物之间的双向相互作用。

name: Monica Rosenberg
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies attention and cognition using functional neuroimaging and machine learning to predict behavior from brain activity.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和认知，使用功能性神经成像和机器学习技术从大脑活动预测行为。

name: Alex Shaw
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults balance different reputational concerns in social situations, using developmental psychology.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何在社交情境中平衡不同的声誉关切，采用发展心理学的方法。

name: Steven K. Shevell
title: Eliakim Hastings Moore Distinguished Service Professor of Psychology and Ophthalmology & Visual Science
summary: Studies human vision, especially color vision, using mathematical and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉，特别是颜色视觉，使用数学和计算方法。

name: Richard A. Shweder
title: Harold Higgins Swift Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies cultural psychology, focusing on moral reasoning, emotional functioning, and gender roles in different cultures, particularly in India.
summary_zh: 研究文化心理学，重点关注不同文化中的道德推理、情绪功能和性别角色，特别是在印度的研究。

name: Edward K. Vogel
title: Irving B. Harris Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of attention and working memory using EEG, psychophysical, and neuroimaging techniques in humans.
summary_zh: 研究注意和工作记忆的神经机制，使用EEG、心理物理学和神经影像学技术在人类中进行探索。

name: Amanda Woodward
title: William S. Gray Distinguished Service Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how infants understand social interactions and develop social cognition, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解社会互动和社会认知的发展，使用实验方法。

name: Jai Yu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurophysiological mechanisms of knowledge creation from individual experiences, focusing on coordinated brain activity across regions.
summary_zh: 研究个体经验转化为知识的神经生理机制，关注不同脑区在不同时间尺度上的协调活动。

name: Marlene Cohen
title: Professor
summary: Studies how task uncertainty affects decision-making through neuronal mechanisms, using visual cortex and dynamic task-belief.
summary_zh: 研究任务不确定性对决策的影响及其神经机制，通过视觉皮层和动态任务信念进行研究。

name: Julia Cox
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies computational neuroscience, focusing on neural networks and brain function.
summary_zh: 研究计算神经科学，专注于神经网络和大脑功能。

name: Brent Doiron
title: Heinrich Kluver Professor
summary: Studies the development of neuronal orientation tuning in mouse visual cortex and the role of homeostatic plasticity in neuronal assemblies.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠初级视觉皮层中神经元方向调谐的发展以及稳态可塑性在神经元群体中的作用。

name: John Downey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops Brain-Computer Interfaces to restore hand and arm function and sensation in people with paralysis.
summary_zh: 开发脑-机接口以恢复高位瘫痪或截肢者的手和手臂功能及感觉。

name: Melina E Hale
title: William Rainey Harper Professor
summary: Studies how axial movements are generated and coordinated in fishes, using zebrafish and comparative species to examine motor control and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究鱼类的轴向运动生成与协调，使用斑马鱼和比较物种来探讨运动控制和神经回路。

name: Nicholas G. Hatsopoulos
title: A.J. Carlson Professor
summary: Studies the cortical basis of motor control and learning, using neural recordings and mathematical models to understand how motor behavior is encoded in neuronal ensembles.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和学习的大脑皮层基础，使用神经记录和数学模型来理解运动行为是如何在神经元群体中编码的。

name: Joshua Jacobs
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational neuroscience, focusing on neural networks and brain function.
summary_zh: 研究计算神经科学，专注于神经网络和大脑功能。

name: Jorge Jaramillo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: MD Narayanan Kasthuri
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and applies advanced microscopy techniques to visualize brain ultrastructure in mice and primates.
summary_zh: 开发和应用先进显微技术可视化小鼠和灵长类动物的大脑超微结构。

name: Jason Maclean
title: Professor
summary: Studies the dynamics of cortical circuits in behaving mammals, using network science and spiking neural network models.
summary_zh: 研究行为哺乳动物皮层回路的动力学，使用网络科学和脉冲神经网络模型。

name: John H.R. Maunsell
title: Albert D. Lasker Distinguished Service Professor
summary: Studies how neuronal signals in visual cortex generate perceptions and guide behavior, using recordings from monkeys and mice.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层神经信号如何产生知觉并指导行为，通过从猴子和小鼠中记录神经元活动进行研究。

name: Samuel Muscinelli
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how representations change along the cortical hierarchy and the optimal neural coding for learning and memory.
summary_zh: 研究皮层层次上的神经编码变化以及学习和记忆的最佳神经编码机制。

name: Ramon Nogueira Manas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: Marcella Noorman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how a few neurons maintain and update accurate internal representations of continuous variables, using computational models and connectomics in Drosophila.
summary_zh: 研究少量神经元如何维持和更新连续变量的准确内部表示，使用计算模型和果蝇连接组学方法。

name: Anne-Marie Oswald
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational models of neural networks and their applications in neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络的计算模型及其在神经科学中的应用。

name: DPHIL Stephanie Palmer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how populations of neurons encode and perform computations on sensory inputs, focusing on predictive coding in the retina and visual cortex of rodents.
summary_zh: 研究神经元群体如何编码和执行对感官输入的计算，重点是啮齿动物视网膜和视觉皮层中的预测编码。

name: Lucas Pinto
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: MD David Satzer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies local field potentials (LFP) in epilepsy, focusing on single-cell contributions, computational models, and neuromodulation.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫中的局部场电位（LFP），关注单细胞贡献、计算模型和神经调节。

name: Mark Sheffield
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain forms and recalls complex memories using optical techniques in mice and virtual reality tasks.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成和回忆复杂记忆，使用光学技术在小鼠和虚拟现实任务中。

name: Wim Van Drongelen
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of epilepsy using advanced statistical and digital signal processing techniques, mathematical and computational modeling, and analysis of clinical recordings.
summary_zh: 使用先进的统计和数字信号处理技术、数学和计算建模以及临床记录分析来研究癫痫的机制。

name: Joel Voss
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of intracranial electrical stimulation on brain networks and memory, using meta-analyses and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究颅内电刺激对大脑网络和记忆的影响，使用元分析和神经成像技术。

name: Other Academic Appointments
title: Associate Instructional Professor, Comparative Human Development, University of Chicago
summary: Studies how language shapes self-concept through discourse genres, focusing on Turkish heteroglossia.
summary_zh: 研究语言如何通过话语体裁塑造自我概念，以土耳其异质语言为例。

name: Eman Abdelhadi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the reproduction of subcultural communities across generations, focusing on second-generation immigrant Muslim Americans and the gendered attachment to religious communities.
summary_zh: 研究代际传承中的亚文化社区，重点关注第二代移民穆斯林美国人及其对宗教社区的性别化依附。

name: Jennifer Cole
title: Professor
summary: Studies how personal change and individual development shape, and are shaped by, broader political, economic and cultural transformations, focusing on Madagascar’s colonial and post-colonial history.
summary_zh: 研究个人变化和个体发展如何塑造并被更广泛的政经文化变迁所影响，重点关注马达加斯加的殖民和后殖民历史及其对青年和移民的影响。

name: Terra Edwards
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the emergence of protactile languages in DeafBlind communities, exploring how different ways of being in the world give rise to new forms of communication.
summary_zh: 研究聋盲社区中新兴的触觉语言，探索不同的存在方式如何产生新的交流形式。

name: Michele Friedner
title: Professor and Chair, Department of Comparative Human Development
summary: Studies the social, moral, and economic practices of deaf and disabled peoples, focusing on cochlear implants and their impact on disability in India.
summary_zh: 研究聋哑和残疾人群的社会、道德和经济实践，重点关注人工耳蜗植入及其对印度残疾人的影响。

name: Chiara Galli
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the legal and social struggles of international migration, focusing on unaccompanied minors and their legal representation in the U.S.
summary_zh: 研究国际移民中的法律和社会斗争，重点关注无陪伴未成年人及其在美国的法律代理问题。

name: Guanglei Hong
title: Professor
summary: Develops causal inference theories and methods for evaluating educational and social policies, focusing on mediation and moderation mechanisms.
summary_zh: 发展因果推断理论和方法，评估教育和社会政策的影响，重点关注中介和调节机制。

name: Micere Keels
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sociodemographic characteristics affect educational outcomes and supports for children and adolescents, particularly in high-crime communities.
summary_zh: 研究社会人口特征如何影响儿童和青少年的教育结果和支持，特别是在高犯罪率社区。

name: Dario Maestripieri
title: Professor
summary: Studies the evolution of human behavior and mental life, focusing on primate behavior and ecology, and the contributions of literature to knowledge formation.
summary_zh: 研究人类行为和心理生活的进化，重点关注灵长类动物的行为和生态，以及文学对知识形成的影响。

name: Jill Mateo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the development of adaptive behaviors in Belding's ground squirrels, focusing on learning, anti-predator strategies, and kin recognition.
summary_zh: 研究贝灵顿地松鼠适应性行为的发展，重点在于学习、反捕食策略和亲缘识别。

name: Eugene Raikhel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Examines the transformation of knowledge and expertise in biomedicine, particularly in the context of addiction and mental health, using ethnographic and historical methods.
summary_zh: 研究生物医学知识和专业领域在成瘾和心理健康中的演变，采用民族志和历史方法。

name: Onnie Rogers
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how racially and ethnically diverse children and adolescents develop and resist oppressive ideologies, focusing on identity formation and social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究种族和 Ethnic 背景的儿童和青少年如何形成和抵抗压迫性意识形态，重点关注身份形成和社会背景。

name: Dendritic Spines
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development of dendritic spines in the brain, focusing on undergraduate education in neuroscience and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究树突棘的发育及其在神经科学和行为学本科教育中的应用。

name: Transgenerational Epigenetic Inheritance
title: Herbert and Florence Irving Assistant Professor of Cell Research, Department of Psychology, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how epigenetic changes can be inherited across generations, affecting offspring's traits.
summary_zh: 研究表观遗传修饰如何在代际之间传递，影响后代的特征。

name: Intergroup Relations
title: Professor of Psychology & Special Advisor to the Executive Vice President for Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how group identities influence social interactions and emotions, using psychophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究群体身份如何影响社会互动和情绪，使用生理测量方法。

name: Circadian Rhythms
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies circadian rhythms and their impact on behavior and cognition.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律及其对行为和认知的影响。

name: Anamaria Alexandrescu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of active learning in undergraduate classrooms to design effective pedagogical strategies.
summary_zh: 研究大学生课堂中的认知学习机制，以设计有效的教学策略。

name: Dima Amso
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how infants' attention, learning, and memory systems develop, offering plasticity in response to risk and opportunity.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿注意力、学习和记忆系统的发育，如何在风险和机遇面前表现出可塑性。

name: Christopher A. Baldassano
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how prior knowledge influences event construction and memory through experiments with narratives, movies, and virtual reality, using functional MRI.
summary_zh: 研究先验知识如何影响事件构建和记忆，通过使用叙事、电影和虚拟现实实验，并使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）.

name: Niall Bolger
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how close relationships influence coping with stress, using diary and physiological data.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系如何影响应对压力，并使用日记和生理数据进行分析。

name: Natalie Brito
title: Associate Professor of Psychology, Director of Graduate Studies, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how social and cultural contexts shape early childhood brain and behavioral development, using neural, behavioral, and physiological markers.
summary_zh: 研究社会和文化背景如何塑造幼儿的认知和行为发展，采用神经、行为和生理学指标。

name: Sarah DeMoya
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how synapse-related changes in dendritic spines affect working memory in aging, using cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究与树突棘变化相关的突触如何影响衰老中的工作记忆，使用认知任务进行评估。

name: Geraldine Downey
title: Robert Johnston Niven Professor of Humane Letters in Psychology
summary: Studies how people's expectations of rejection affect their perception and behavior, using social cognition paradigms and physiological recordings.
summary_zh: 研究人们对于被拒绝的预期如何影响其感知和行为，使用社会认知范式和生理记录方法。

name: Katherine Fox-Glassman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how living in hazardous environments affects people's daily functioning and risk perception, using probabilistic threats like natural disasters.
summary_zh: 研究居住在自然灾害高风险地区如何影响人们的日常功能和风险感知。

name: Jon Freeman
title: Professor of Psychology, Department Chair
summary: Studies how we perceive and categorize others, using cognitive and neural mechanisms, functional neuroimaging, and behavioral paradigms.
summary_zh: 研究我们如何感知和分类他人，使用认知和神经机制、功能性神经成像和行为范式。

name: Carl Hart
title: Congratulations to Professor Carl Hart: The City of Miami has proclaimed February 1, 2016 Dr. Carl Hart Day! To read more about it, visit his website.
summary: Studies the behavioral and neuropharmacological effects of psychoactive drugs in humans, focusing on drug self-administration and developing treatments.
summary_zh: 研究精神活性药物对人体的行为和神经药理学效应，重点关注药物自我给药行为并开发治疗方法。

name: Larisa Heiphetz Solomon
title: Associate Professor of Psychology, Co-Director of STAR Program
summary: Studies moral cognition in children and adults, exploring moral beliefs, intergroup attitudes, and the connection between religion and morality.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人的道德认知，探索道德信念、群体态度以及宗教与道德之间的联系。

name: E. Tory Higgins
title: Stanley Schachter Professor of Psychology and Professor of Business
summary: Studies motivation, social cognition, and judgment in social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究动机、社会认知和社交判断。

name: Eleanor Holton
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how goal commitment affects cognitive processes, using both human and neural network models.
summary_zh: 研究目标承诺如何影响认知过程，使用人类和神经网络模型进行分析。

name: Katie Insel
title: Faculty
summary: Studies adolescent brain development using fMRI and computational modeling to understand cognitive skills and mental health.
summary_zh: 研究青少年大脑发展，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算建模来理解认知技能和心理健康。

name: Nora Isacoff
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how humans construct meaningful categories, using both quantitative and qualitative methods to explore cognitive science, linguistics, and education.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何构建有意义的类别，使用定量和定性方法探索认知科学、语言学和教育。

name: Nikolaus Kriegeskorte
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies visual perception and cognition using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和认知，使用神经成像技术。

name: Chujun Lin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people form impressions of others using computational approaches and cross-cultural designs, and how these impressions influence real-world behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用计算方法和跨文化设计形成对他人的印象，以及这些印象如何影响实际行为。

name: Patricia Lindemann
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people use different strategies in decision-making, focusing on factors like context and personality.
summary_zh: 研究人们在决策中使用不同策略的方式，重点关注情境和个性等因素的影响。

name: Bianca Jones Marlin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how learned behaviors in parents become innate in offspring through transgenerational epigenetic inheritance, using neural imaging and molecular genetics.
summary_zh: 研究父母习得的行为如何通过跨代表观遗传遗传成为后代的先天行为，使用神经成像和分子遗传学方法。

name: Rebecca Martin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how social influence affects adolescent decision-making and brain development, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会影响如何影响青少年决策和大脑发展，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

name: Janet Metcalfe
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people know what they know, focusing on metacognitive abilities and their application to effective self-control and study skills.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何知道自己的知识，重点在于元认知能力及其在有效自我控制和学习技能中的应用。

name: Meghan Meyer
title: Associate Professor of Psychology, Co-Director of STAR Program
summary: Studies how people navigate social networks and learn about others using brain imaging, behavioral, and mobile sensing methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过脑成像、行为和移动传感方法导航社交网络和了解他人。

name: Kevin Ochsner
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion regulation and self-control using fMRI, focusing on how thinking about experiences changes feelings.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节和自我控制的神经机制，使用fMRI探讨思考经历如何改变感受。

name: Valerie Purdie Greenaway
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people with threatened identities experience intergroup relations, using experimental and psycho-physiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究受威胁身份的人在群体关系中的体验，使用实验和生理心理方法。

name: Daphna Shohamy
title: Kavli Professor of Brain Science, Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how decisions are shaped by past experience and the role of explicit and implicit memories in learning and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究过去经验如何塑造决策以及显性记忆和隐性记忆在学习和决策中的作用。

name: Tiago Siebert Altavini
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how expectations influence visual perception and other sensory modalities, using neural activity patterns in the visual cortex.
summary_zh: 研究期望如何影响视觉感知和其他感觉模态，通过视觉皮层的神经活动模式。

name: Rae Silver
title: Faculty
summary: Studies circadian rhythms and the role of mast cells in the brain, focusing on how internal clocks regulate behavior and health.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律和脑中肥大细胞的作用，关注内部时钟如何调节行为和健康。

name: Herbert Terrace
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the evolution of intelligence in primates and autistic children, focusing on cognitive processes without language.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物和自闭症儿童的认知进化，重点关注无需语言的认知过程。

name: Nim Tottenham
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development of neural circuits underlying affective behaviors in children and adolescents, focusing on the effects of early-life stress on brain development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年情感行为神经回路的发展，重点关注早期生活压力对大脑发育的影响。

name: Sarah M. N. Woolley
title: Professor of Psychology
areas: Neural basis and behavior of social communication
summary: Studies how perception in the context of social communication is accomplished in the brain, focusing on songbirds.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类社会交流中的感知机制，特别是鸣禽。

name: Larry Abbott
title: Professor of Physics, Brandeis University
summary: Studies neural networks and how neurons interact to produce functioning circuits, using computational and mathematical methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络和神经元如何相互作用以产生功能电路，使用计算和数学方法。

name: Ishmail J. Abdus-Saboor
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the nervous system encodes different types of touch, using systems neuroscience, computation, genetics, and mathematics to link behavior with neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何编码不同类型的触觉，使用系统神经科学、计算、遗传学和数学将行为与神经回路联系起来。

name: Genevera I. Allen
title: Faculty
summary: Develops statistical machine learning tools for reliable data-driven discoveries in neuroscience, focusing on connectomics and multi-modal data integration.
summary_zh: 开发统计机器学习工具，用于神经科学中的可靠数据驱动发现，重点关注连接组学和多模态数据集成。

name: Christoph Anacker
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how early life stress affects the development of stress-responsive neurons in the hippocampus, using transgenic mice and molecular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响海马区应激反应神经元的发展，使用转基因小鼠和分子技术。

name: Mark Ansorge
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the developmental origins of neuropsychiatric disorders using mouse models, focusing on serotonin signaling and its effects on brain circuits.
summary_zh: 研究神经精神障碍的发育起源，使用小鼠模型探讨血清素信号传导及其对大脑回路的影响。

name: Dmitriy Aronov
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying memory and thought in rats and birds, using virtual reality and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和思维的神经回路在大鼠和鸟类中的作用，使用虚拟现实和行为实验方法。
