name: Randy P. Auerbach
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying adolescent depression and suicidal behaviors, using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究青少年抑郁和自杀行为的神经机制，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: MD Richard Axel
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the olfactory system discriminates odors using non-human models, focusing on receptor genes and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究嗅觉系统如何通过非人类模型区分气味，重点在于受体基因和神经回路。

name: Kevin G Bath
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how early life stress affects neural and behavioral development in mice, focusing on the amygdala, hippocampus, and orbitofrontal cortex, and the genetic mechanisms involved.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响小鼠的神经和行为发育，重点在于杏仁核、海马体和前额叶皮层，并探讨遗传机制。

name: Rudy Behnia
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how visual neurons process and encode visual features like object, shape and color in fruit flies, using techniques like in vivo patch-clamp recordings and two-photon imaging.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇中视觉神经元如何处理和编码视觉特征如物体、形状和颜色，使用体内单细胞记录和双光子成像等技术。

name: MD Andres Bendesky
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiology of social and complex behaviors in deer mice and Siamese fighting fish, focusing on aggression and parental care.
summary_zh: 研究 Deer 鼠和暹罗斗鱼的社会和复杂行为的神经生物学，重点在于攻击性和抚育行为。

name: MD Maura Boldrini
title: is an Associate Professor of Psychiatry, Director of the Quantitative Brain Biology (BrainQUANT) Institut
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular basis of brain diseases, using single cell and spatial multiomics methods.
summary_zh: 研究脑疾病中的分子和细胞基础，使用单细胞和空间多组学方法。

name: Adam M. Brickman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive aging and dementia using advanced neuroimaging techniques to understand age-related changes in brain structure and their cognitive consequences.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化和痴呆，使用先进的神经影像技术理解年龄相关的大脑结构变化及其认知后果。

name: Gwyneth M. Card
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms and circuit architectures of visually guided escape behaviors in flies, using genetic, electrophysiological, and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇视觉引导的逃避行为的神经机制和电路架构，使用遗传学、电生理学和成像技术。

name: Mark Churchland
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural dynamics in motor cortex and brain-machine interfaces to understand and model movement generation.
summary_zh: 研究运动皮层的神经动力学和脑机接口，以理解和建模运动生成。

name: John Patrick Cunningham
title: Faculty
summary: Develops statistical and machine learning algorithms to understand neural computation in movement control, advancing both scientific understanding and computational methods.
summary_zh: 开发统计和机器学习算法以理解运动控制中的神经计算，推动科学理解与计算方法的进步。

name: Aniruddha Das
title: Faculty
summary: Studies task-related anticipation in visual cortex and the cortical basis of visual form processing using optical imaging and electrophysiology in non-human models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层中的任务相关预测以及视觉形式处理的皮层基础，使用光学成像和电生理学方法在非人类模型中进行。

name: Lila Davachi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how memory works, using cognitive tasks and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的工作原理，使用认知任务和脑成像技术。

name: Kira Delmore
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the genetic, molecular, and neurobiological basis of migratory behavior in birds, using tracking technology, genomics, and neurobiology.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类迁徙行为的遗传、分子和神经生物学基础，使用追踪技术、基因组学和神经生物学方法。

name: Christine Ann Denny
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of learning and memory in mice, using optogenetics and transgenic mice to investigate memory circuits in conditions like stress, depression, aging, and Alzheimer's.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的分子机制，在小鼠中使用光遗传学和转基因小鼠来探究压力、抑郁、衰老和阿尔茨海默病等条件下记忆回路的变化。

name: MD Alex Dranovsky
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how stressful and enriching experiences affect adult hippocampal stem cells, producing lasting changes in behavior and brain circuits.
summary_zh: 研究应激和丰富经历如何影响成年海马干细胞，产生持久的行为和脑回路变化。

name: M.D Dani Dumitriu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of resilience to stress, using animal models and imaging techniques to understand brain circuitry differences.
summary_zh: 研究应激下的神经生物学韧性基础，使用动物模型和成像技术来理解大脑回路差异。

name: Yasmine El-Shamayleh
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of vision, particularly visual form processing in primate cerebral cortex, using optogenetic and viral vector strategies.
summary_zh: 研究视觉形式处理的神经机制，特别是在灵长类大脑皮层中的视觉形式处理，使用光遗传学和病毒载体策略。

name: Vincent P. Ferrera
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how animals learn abstract relationships, using computational models and neurophysiology in parietal and prefrontal cortex, with a focus on working memory and developing therapies for memory.
summary_zh: 研究动物如何学习抽象关系，使用计算模型和皮层和前额叶皮层的神经生理学方法，重点在于工作记忆并开发治疗记忆障碍的新疗法。

name: Stefano Fusi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and learning using computational models and neural dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经动力学方法。

name: MD Jay Gingrich
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of serotonin in brain development and behavior, including anxiety, depression, and psychosis, using genetic and pharmacological manipulations in mice.
summary_zh: 研究血清素在大脑发育和行为中的作用，包括焦虑、抑郁和精神分裂症，使用遗传和药理学操纵的小鼠模型。

name: Jacqueline Gottlieb
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain generates intelligent behavior, focusing on working memory and selective attention in monkeys using neurophysiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何生成智能行为，重点关注猴子的工作记忆和选择性注意，使用神经生理学技术。

name: Wesley Grueber
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the proprioceptive and interoceptive systems, focusing on sensory neuron function and body position sensing in Drosophila larvae.
summary_zh: 研究感觉神经系统，特别是 proprioceptive 和 interoceptive 系统的功能，以及在果蝇幼虫中的身体位置感知。

name: MD Alexander Harris
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural circuitry underlying stress-induced psychiatric symptoms and how stress disrupts reward processing and motivation in mice and humans.
summary_zh: 研究应激引起的神经精神症状的神经环路及其如何扰乱奖赏处理和动机在小鼠和人类中的机制。

name: Rene Hen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of neurogenesis in anxiety and depression, using mouse models.
summary_zh: 研究神经发生在焦虑和抑郁中的作用，使用小鼠模型。

name: Elizabeth Hillman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cellular and systems-level interrelations between neuronal activity and hemodynamic responses in the brain using optical imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经元活动与脑内血流动力学反应之间的细胞和系统级相互关系，使用光学成像技术。

name: MD Guillermo Horga
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiological and computational mechanisms of psychotic symptoms in schizophrenia, using fMRI and PET in healthy humans and patients.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症精神病症状的神经生物学和计算机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和正电子发射断层扫描在健康人和患者中进行研究。

name: Stephen J. Huston
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the fly brain transforms sensory inputs into motor outputs, focusing on visually driven head movements.
summary_zh: 研究飞脑如何将感官输入转化为运动输出，重点在于视觉驱动的头部运动。

name: Kiyohito Iigaya
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational principles of learning and decision-making, using models and empirical studies with fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究学习和决策的计算原理，使用模型和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）的人类实验研究。

name: Elias Issa
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the computational role of recurrent processing in visual recognition using marmosets and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究视觉识别中递归处理的计算作用，使用狨猴和光遗传学技术。

name: Joshua Jacobs
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the human brain represents spatial information during navigation and memory, using single-neuron recordings from neurosurgical patients.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑在导航和记忆过程中如何表示空间信息，使用神经外科患者的大脑单个神经元记录。

name: Manu Ben Johny
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Christoph Kellendonk
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiology of cognitive and negative symptoms of schizophrenia, focusing on working memory and motivation in mice.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的认知和负性症状的神经生物学，重点关注小鼠的工作记忆和动机。

name: Darcy B. Kelley
title: Assistant Professor, The Rockefeller University - 1978 - 1981
summary: Studies the neural and genetic basis of species- and sex-specific vocal communication in Xenopus, focusing on how production and perception of vocal signals are matched across sexes.
summary_zh: 研究两栖动物 Xenopus 的物种和性别特异性鸣叫的神经和遗传基础，关注其产生和感知鸣叫信号的匹配机制。

name: Aurel Lazar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural circuits and brain computation using theoretical methods and reverse engineering of the fruit fly brain.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和大脑计算，使用理论方法和果蝇大脑的逆向工程。

name: Michael L. Lipton
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain mechanisms of neurobehavioral dysfunction due to injury and disease, focusing on concussion and mild COVID-19 effects.
summary_zh: 研究神经行为功能障碍的脑机制，重点关注创伤和轻度 COVID-19 的影响。

name: Ashok Litwin-Kumar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies learning algorithms and their neural implementations, comparing them to those in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 研究学习算法及其神经实现，将其与机器学习和人工智能中的算法进行比较。

name: Tom Maniatis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of protocadherins in neural circuit development and function, using genetic and behavioral assays.
summary_zh: 研究突触连接蛋白在神经网络发育和功能中的作用，使用遗传和行为学方法。

name: Rachel Marsh
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in normal development and psychiatric disorders, using MRI and CBT in children and adults with OCD.
summary_zh: 研究正常发育和儿童及成人强迫症等精神障碍中的脑-行为关系，使用MRI和认知行为疗法（CBT）。

name: George Z. Mentis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Nima Mesgarani
title: Faculty
summary: Studies speech processing and auditory cortex using neural recordings and computational models with non-human models.
summary_zh: 研究听觉皮层中的语音处理和计算模型，使用神经记录和非人类模型。

name: Kenneth Miller
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the circuitry and computations of the cerebral cortex using theoretical and computational methods, focusing on primary visual cortex.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层的电路和计算功能，使用理论和计算方法，重点研究初级视觉皮层。

name: John Ross Morrison
title: Faculty
summary: Develops frameworks for understanding brain representations and inferences, abstracting from individual neurons.
summary_zh: 开发大脑表征和推理的理解框架，从单个神经元的层面进行抽象。

name: Liam Paninski
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural coding and decoding in sensory systems, using mathematical and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究感觉系统中的神经编码和解码，使用数学和计算方法。

name: Yueqing Peng
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the circuit, cellular, and molecular mechanisms of sleep regulation in normal and diseased brains using electrophysiology, calcium imaging, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究正常和患病大脑中睡眠调节的电路、细胞和分子机制，使用电生理学、钙成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Ning Qian
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and motor planning, using computational and psychophysical models to explain depth perception and face processing.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和运动规划，使用计算和知觉生理学方法解释深度感知和面孔处理。

name: MD Stephen Rayport
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of glutamatergic neurotransmission in schizophrenia and addiction, using animal models and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究谷氨酸能神经传递在精神分裂症和成瘾中的作用，使用动物模型和光遗传学方法。

name: Dustin R. Rubenstein
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how environmental factors influence animal behaviors, combining ecology, evolution, and neuroendocrine mechanisms across various species.
summary_zh: 研究环境因素如何影响动物行为，结合生态学、进化论和神经内分泌机制，涵盖多种物种。

name: Nuttida Rungratsameetaweemana
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how expectations influence sensory processing and working memory in the brain using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究期望如何影响感觉处理和工作记忆的认知神经科学问题，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Paul Sajda
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain processes visual information and makes decisions, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理视觉信息并做出决策，使用神经成像技术。

name: MD Daniel Salzman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms that give sensory stimuli emotional value, using primate visual systems and amygdala neurons.
summary_zh: 研究感觉刺激的情感价值神经机制，使用灵长类动物视觉系统和杏仁核神经元进行实验。

name: Tristan T Sands
title: Faculty
summary: Studies genetic causes of neurodevelopmental disability and epilepsy, using mouse and human models, with a focus on developing therapeutic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍和癫痫的遗传机制，并使用小鼠和人类模型开发治疗方法。

name: Nathaniel Sawtell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the functions of cerebellum-like structures in fish and mammals, focusing on how past experience affects sensory processing and the generation of sensory predictions.
summary_zh: 研究鱼类和哺乳动物中类似小脑结构的功能，重点在于过去经验如何影响感觉处理以及感觉预测的生成。

name: MD Michael Shadlen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain makes decisions by integrating evidence from various sources and calculating costs and benefits.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过整合不同来源的信息并计算成本和收益来做出决策。

name: Nikhil Shar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development and regulation of neural circuits using genetic and molecular approaches.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路的发育和调控，使用遗传和分子方法。

name: Mimi Shirasu-Hiza
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how circadian rhythms affect immunity and metabolism in Drosophila, exploring the role of sleep and time-restricted eating in disease prevention.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律如何影响果蝇的免疫和代谢，探索睡眠和限时进食在疾病预防中的作用。

name: Steven A. Siegelbaum
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of electrical signaling and synaptic transmission in the nervous system, focusing on HCN channels and the CA2 region of the hippocampus.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的电传导和突触传递的分子和细胞机制，重点关注HCN通道和海马CA2区。

name: Tarjinder Singh
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the genetic basis of psychiatric disorders, using large-scale genomic data and machine learning to identify risk genes and pathways.
summary_zh: 研究精神障碍的遗传基础，使用大规模基因组数据和机器学习来识别风险基因和途径。

name: Kimberly L. Stachenfeld
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Yaakov Stern
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive reserve and aging, using brain imaging to explore how life experience affects brain function and aging processes.
summary_zh: 研究认知储备和老化，使用脑成像探索生活经历如何影响大脑功能和老化过程。

name: David Sulzer
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the function and alteration of synapses in the cortex and basal ganglia, particularly in Parkinson's and Huntington's diseases, using optical, electrophysiological, and electrochemical.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层和基底节突触的功能和改变，特别是在帕金森病和亨廷顿病中的作用，使用光学、电生理和电化学方法。

name: Maria Antonietta Tosches
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: MD Jeremy Veenstra-Vanderweele
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the genetic and neurobiological basis of autism spectrum disorder and obsessive-compulsive disorder using mouse models and translational research.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍和强迫症的遗传和神经生物学基础，使用小鼠模型和转化研究。

name: Junhao Wen
title: Faculty
summary: Develops and applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyze multi-omics and multi-organ data for precision medicine in aging and disease.
summary_zh: 开发和应用人工智能和机器学习技术分析多组学和多器官数据，以推进精准医学在衰老和疾病中的应用。

name: Daniel M. Wolpert
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the computational principles of human sensorimotor control using theoretical studies, computer simulations, and human experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类运动感知控制的计算原理，使用理论研究、计算机模拟和人类实验。

name: Guang Yang
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how immune responses affect neural plasticity and learning, using in vivo imaging and molecular manipulation in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究免疫反应如何影响神经可塑性和学习，使用活体成像和分子操纵技术在啮齿动物模型中进行研究。

name: MD Rafael Yuste
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural circuits and ensembles to understand the relation between neuronal activity and behavior, using electrophysiology and optical methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和神经元群落，以理解神经元活动与行为之间的关系，使用电生理学和光学方法。

name: Charles Zuker
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Brad Duchaine
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the cognitive, neural, developmental, and genetic basis of face perception, focusing on prosopagnosia and prosopometamorphopsia.
summary_zh: 研究面孔知觉的认知、神经、发展和遗传基础，重点在于面孔失认症和面孔变形症。

name: Sian Leah Beilock
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how anxiety affects performance, particularly in high-stakes situations like public speaking and math tests, using experimental and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑如何影响表现，特别是在公共演讲和数学测试等高风险情境中，使用实验和观察方法。

name: Luke J. Chang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neurobiological and psychological processes underlying social interactions, using computational techniques and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动的神经生物学和心理学过程，使用计算技术和神经成像方法。

name: Ann S. Clark
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Donna Coch
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Education, Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the development of reading and the neural basis of language processing, combining education, psychology, linguistics, and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究阅读能力的发展和语言加工的神经基础，结合教育、心理学、语言学和神经科学的方法。

name: Gus Cooney
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Emily S. Finn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences in cognition affect perception and brain activity during naturalistic experiences like watching movies.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异如何影响认知及在观看电影等自然刺激下的知觉和脑活动模式。

name: Richard H. Granger
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies learning and memory, brain evolution, and computational neuroscience, developing algorithms and analyzing brain circuits.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆、大脑进化和计算神经科学，开发算法并分析大脑回路。

name: James V. Haxby
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of visual and social cognition using fMRI and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉和社会认知的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算方法。

name: David Kraemer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neural and behavioral correlates of learning and complex cognition, focusing on individual differences and using fMRI, psychophysiology, and behavioral testing.
summary_zh: 研究学习和复杂认知的神经和行为机制，重点关注个体差异，并使用功能性磁共振成像、生理学和行为测试方法。

name: Jeremy R. Manning
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies learning and memory using computational methods and neuroimaging, developing personalized learning tools.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆，使用计算方法和神经成像技术，开发个性化学习工具。

name: John D Murray
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Gregg L. Engles Associate Professor
summary: Studies computational models of neural systems, focusing on how the brain processes information.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的计算模型，关注大脑如何处理信息。

name: Katherine M. Nautiyal
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying impulsivity, particularly the role of serotonin in psychiatric-relevant behaviors and psychedelic treatments.
summary_zh: 研究冲动行为的神经环路，特别是血清素在精神疾病相关行为和 psychedelic 治疗中的作用。

name: Pia-Kelsey T. O'Neill
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how emotional experiences are encoded within neural circuits, focusing on the amygdala and escape responses in mice.
summary_zh: 研究情绪体验如何在神经回路中编码，重点关注小鼠的杏仁核和逃避反应。

name: Caroline Robertson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the interaction between perception and memory systems, focusing on autism and GABAergic action.
summary_zh: 研究知觉与记忆系统的相互作用，重点关注自闭症和GABA能作用。

name: Kyle S. Smith
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how the brain generates reward, motivation, actions, and habits using neural recording and modulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何产生奖励、动机、行为和习惯，使用神经记录和调节技术。

name: Alireza Soltani
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies adaptive decision making and learning using computational modeling and behavioral studies in humans.
summary_zh: 研究适应性决策和学习，使用计算建模和人类行为研究。

name: Viola S. Stoermer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor in Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of human perception, attention, and memory, focusing on selective attention and visual working memory using psychophysics, experimental psychology, and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类知觉、注意力和记忆的认知和神经机制，重点是选择性注意力和视觉工作记忆，使用心理物理学、实验心理学和EEG方法。

name: Arjen Stolk
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how context influences the interpretation of communicative signals in social interaction, using neuroimaging and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究语境如何影响交际信号的解释，使用神经成像和脑电图技术。

name: Mark A. Thornton
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain organizes social knowledge and uses it to predict social interactions, using fMRI, computational modeling, and naturalistic behavior.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何组织社会知识并据此预测社会互动，使用功能性磁共振成像、计算建模和自然行为方法。

name: Peter Ulric Tse
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neural basis of consciousness, including preconscious processing, subjective experience, volitional attention, and top-down and bottom-up interactions.
summary_zh: 研究意识的神经基础，包括前意识处理、主观体验、意志性注意以及自上而下和自下而上的相互作用。

name: Matthijs van der Meer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning, memory, and decision-making in rodents, using simultaneous neural recordings and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习、记忆和决策的神经机制，使用同时神经记录和计算建模方法。

name: Tor Wager
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Diana L. Taylor Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the neurophysiology of pain, emotion, and stress, using functional neuroimaging and developing analysis methods.
summary_zh: 研究疼痛、情绪和压力的神经生理学，使用功能性神经影像学和开发分析方法。

name: Shelley M. Warlow
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain generates motivated behavior, focusing on reward vs. fear circuits in mice using neurotransmitter-specific inputs and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何产生动机行为，重点在于小鼠奖赏与恐惧电路中的神经递质特异性输入和光遗传学方法。

name: Thalia Wheatley
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Lincoln Filene Professor in Human Relations
summary: Studies social interaction and social networks using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动和社会网络的认知神经科学方法。

name: John Anderson
title: Richard King Mellon University Professor of Psychology and Computer Science
summary: Studies the structure of higher-level cognition, particularly mathematical problem solving, using cognitive architectures like ACT-R and brain imaging data.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知结构，特别是数学问题解决，使用认知架构ACT-R和脑成像数据。

name: Jessica Cantlon
title: Ronald J. and Mary Ann Zdrojkowski Professor of Developmental Neuroscience/Psychology
summary: Studies the origins of quantitative reasoning in human adults, children, and non-human primates using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类成人、儿童和非人灵长类动物的数量推理起源，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Chante Cox-Boyd
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social cognition, focusing on how individuals make social judgments and the impact of these judgments on intergroup relations and stereotypes.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知，关注个体如何进行社会判断以及这些判断对群体关系和刻板印象的影响。

name: David Creswell
title: William S. Dietrich II Professor in Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how mindfulness meditation and self-affirmation reduce stress and improve health outcomes through neuroimaging and intervention trials.
summary_zh: 研究正念冥想和自我肯定如何通过神经成像和干预试验减轻压力和改善健康结果。

name: Kasey Creswell
title: Director of Graduate Studies, Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the mechanisms of addiction, focusing on cigarette craving and alcohol use, using experimental methodologies and longitudinal designs.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾机制，特别是吸烟渴望和酒精使用，采用实验方法和纵向设计。

name: Janine Dutcher
title: Assistant Dean of Research (Dietrich College), Assistant Professor (Research) and Co-Director of the BRIDGE Neuroimaging Center
summary: Studies how positive interventions like self-affirmation and mindfulness meditation reduce stress and improve physical health using neuroimaging and psychoneuroimmunology.
summary_zh: 研究积极干预措施（如自我肯定和正念冥想）如何减少压力并改善身体健康，使用神经成像和神经免疫学方法。

name: Jenelle Feather
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and the Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies the neural activity patterns underlying perception and cognition using computational modeling, behavioral observations, and brain measurements in auditory and visual perception.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和认知背后的神经活动模式，使用计算建模、行为观察和脑部测量方法，涉及听觉和视觉知觉。

name: Brooke Feeney
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how close relationships and specific social behaviors impact human thriving, using video-recording and coding of interactions and physiological assessments.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和社会行为如何影响人类繁荣，使用录像和编码互动以及生理评估的方法。

name: Susanne Ferber
title: Professor and Department Head
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of perception awareness using fMRI and EEG, and investigates cognitive impairments in neurological patients.
summary_zh: 研究知觉意识的认知和神经机制，使用fMRI和EEG，并研究神经病患者的认知障碍。

name: Anna Fisher
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how young children learn and generalize knowledge, focusing on inductive reasoning and selective sustained attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习和进行归纳推理，重点关注选择性持续注意和归纳学习。

name: Vicki Helgeson
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people adjust to chronic illnesses like diabetes, focusing on psychological and physical well-being, and the role of social support and gender-related traits.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疾病（如糖尿病）对人们心理和生理健康的适应，关注社会支持和性别相关特质的作用。

name: Laurie Heller
title: Professor of Psychology (Teaching)
summary: Studies how humans use sound to understand environmental events, using perceptual experiments and brain imaging to explore sound recognition and localization.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何利用声音理解环境事件，使用知觉实验和脑成像探索声音识别和定位。

name: Marcel Just
title: D.O. Hebb Professor of Psychology, University Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural basis of human thought using fMRI, focusing on language comprehension, working memory, and social cognition.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究人类思维的神经基础，重点关注语言理解、工作记忆和社会认知。

name: Roberta Klatzky
title: Charles J. Queenan, Jr. University Professor of Psychology and Human-Computer Interaction
summary: Studies perception, spatial thinking, and action across multiple modalities in real and virtual environments, with applications in tele-manipulation and navigation aids.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、空间思维和动作在多种模态下的表现及其在真实和虚拟环境中的应用，涉及远程操作和导航辅助。

name: Ken Koedinger
title: Hillman Professor of Computer Science, Professor of Human-Computer Interaction and Psychology
summary: Studies how students learn through computational models and educational technologies, improving student achievement in mathematics, science, and language.
summary_zh: 研究学生通过计算模型和教育技术学习的方式，提高他们在数学、科学和语言方面的学业成就。

name: Phoebe Lam
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how early-life stress shapes development across the lifespan and identifies factors that mitigate its negative health effects.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力如何影响一生的发展，并识别减轻其负面影响的因素。

name: Marsha Lovett
title: Vice Provost for Teaching and Learning Innovation, Professor of Psychology (Teaching)
summary: Studies how learning works in college-level courses and develops educational technologies to improve student learning and metacognition.
summary_zh: 研究大学课程中的学习过程，并开发教育技术以提高学生的学习和元认知能力。

name: Brian MacWhinney
title: Teresa Heinz Professor of Cognitive Psychology
summary: Studies how children learn language through competitive processes and perspective-taking, using neural network models and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究儿童通过竞争过程和视角转换学习语言，使用神经网络模型和脑成像技术。

name: Brad Mahon
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how object concepts are represented and organized in the brain, using patients with brain injuries to understand mechanisms of perception and action.
summary_zh: 研究物体概念在大脑中的表征和组织，通过脑损伤患者了解感知和动作的基本机制。

name: Kody Manke-Miller
title: Associate Professor of Psychology (Teaching), Director of Research on Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (Dietrich College)
summary: Studies the effects of social identity and stereotype threat on academic performance and wellbeing, using lab and field studies and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份和刻板印象威胁对学生表现和幸福感的影响，使用实验室和实地研究以及干预措施。

name: David Plaut
title: Professor of Psychology and the Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies cognitive processing in vision, reading, and language using computational modeling and empirical studies, with a focus on cognitive impairments and development.
summary_zh: 使用计算建模和实证研究探讨视觉、阅读和语言的认知处理，重点关注认知障碍和发育。

name: David Rakison
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how infants develop concepts of objects and actions, using behavioral methods and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何发展对物体和动作的概念，使用行为方法和计算模型。

name: Barbara Shinn-Cunningham
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain processes and attends to sounds, using behavioral, neuroimaging, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和关注声音，使用行为、神经成像和计算方法。

name: Erik Thiessen
title: Director of Undergraduate Studies, Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how infants learn language and other information from statistical patterns in their environment, using experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何从环境中的统计模式中学习语言和其他信息，使用婴儿实验方法。

name: Michael Trujillo
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the social and health consequences of stigma, particularly among LGBTQ and minority populations, using experimental and longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究污名的社会和健康后果，特别是对LGBTQ和少数群体的影响，使用实验和纵向方法。

name: Jonathan Tsay
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how humans learn and master movements using computational modeling, psychophysics, and neuropsychology.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过计算建模、心理物理学和神经心理学掌握动作技巧。

name: Timothy Verstynen
title: Professor of Psychology and the Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies how we plan actions, the neural mechanisms of stopping actions, and the dynamics of skill learning using psychophysics, computational modeling, and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究动作计划、停止动作的神经机制以及技能学习的动力学，使用心理物理学、计算建模和脑成像技术。

name: David Badre
title: George A. and Helen Dunham Cowan Professor of Cognitive Neuroscience and Director of the Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies cognitive control and decision-making processes using neuroimaging and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和决策过程，使用神经成像和计算模型。

name: Alison Barth
title: Maxwell H. and Gloria C. Connan Professor in the Life Sciences
summary: Studies neural circuits and computational methods to understand learning and memory processes.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和计算方法以理解学习与记忆过程。

name: Drew Beauchamp
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience Institute, Biomedical Engineering
summary: Develops and applies neurotechnology to study neural circuits and motor control, estimating upstream signaling in the spinal cord and brain.
summary_zh: 开发和应用神经技术研究神经回路和运动控制，估计脊髓和大脑中的上游信号传导。

name: Maysam Chamanzar
title: Assistant Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

name: Steve Chase
title: Professor, Biomedical Engineering, Neuroscience Institute, Electrical and Computer Engineering and Robotics Institute
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using brain-computer interfaces and neural prosthetics.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用脑-机接口和神经假体技术。

name: Tzahi Cohen-Karni
title: Associate Professor, Biomedical Engineering and Materials Science & Engineering
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and learning using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

name: Gary Fedder
title: Howard M. Wilkoff Professor, Electrical and Computer Engineering and Robotics Institute
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of perception and action, using computational models and robotics.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和动作的神经机制，使用计算模型和机器人技术。

name: Christopher Genovese
title: Department Head and Professor, Statistics
summary: Studies statistical methods for analyzing brain imaging data, focusing on cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究统计方法分析脑成像数据，专注于认知过程。

name: Aryn Gittis
title: Associate Professor, Biological Sciences and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural circuits and learning & memory using computational and molecular methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和学习记忆，使用计算和分子方法。

name: Darcy Griffin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies skilled voluntary movements and signaling through the corticomotoneuronal system.
summary_zh: 研究技能性自愿运动和皮层-运动神经元系统的信号传递。

name: Pulkit Grover
title: Angel Jordan Associate Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

name: Bin He
title: Trustee Professor, Biomedical Engineering, Neuroscience Institute and Electrical and Computer Engineering
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing, using EEG and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究脑机接口和神经信号处理，使用EEG和机器学习方法。

name: Kate Hong
title: Assistant Professor, Biological Sciences and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural circuits and systems neuroscience using computational and physiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和系统神经科学，使用计算和生理学方法。

name: Jana Kainerstorfer
title: Associate Professor, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing, focusing on decoding neural activity to improve human-computer interaction.
summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和神经信号处理，侧重于解码神经活动以改善人机交互。

name: Robert Kass
title: The Maurice Falk Professor of Statistics and Computational Neuroscience, Statistics, Neuroscience Institute and Machine Learning
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of decision-making and perception using statistical models and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究决策和知觉的神经机制，使用统计模型和计算方法。

name: Tai Sing Lee
title: Professor, School of Computer Science and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural circuits and computational methods in learning and memory, developing physiological and anatomical methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和计算方法在学习与记忆中的作用，开发生理和解剖学方法。

name: Tom Mitchell
title: Founders University Professor, Machine Learning, School of Computer Science, Computational Biology, Language Technologies Institute and Robotics Institute
summary: Studies machine learning and computational biology, integrating computer science and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习和计算生物学，结合计算机科学和神经科学。

name: Linda Moya
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social decision-making and neural basis of cognition using interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究社会决策和认知的神经基础，采用跨学科方法。

name: Burak Ozdoganlar
title: Professor, Mechanical Engineering
summary: Studies biomechanics of neural tissue, using mechanical engineering principles to understand brain function and injury.
summary_zh: 研究神经组织的生物力学，运用机械工程原理理解大脑功能和损伤。

name: Rahul Panat
title: Professor, Mechanical Engineering and Civil and Environmental Engineering
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Andreas Pfenning
title: Assistant Professor, Computational Biology and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies computational models of neural systems to understand motor control and language processing.
summary_zh: 研究计算模型以理解运动控制和语言处理的神经系统。

name: Xaq Pitkow
title: Professor, Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies how the brain processes information and makes decisions, using computational models and neural recordings.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理信息和做出决策，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

name: Richard Randall
title: Associate Professor of Music Theory, School of Music
summary: Studies music perception and cognition, exploring how musical structures are processed in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究音乐知觉与认知，探索音乐结构在大脑中的处理机制。

name: Cosma Shalizi
title: Associate Professor, Statistics and Machine Learning
summary: Studies statistical models and machine learning algorithms to understand complex systems in neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究统计模型和机器学习算法以理解神经科学中的复杂系统。

name: Aarti Singh
title: Associate Professor, Machine Learning
summary: Develops machine learning algorithms to analyze neural data, improving our understanding of brain function.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习算法分析神经数据，提高对大脑功能的理解。

name: Matthew Smith
title: Professor, Biomedical Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies the neural basis of cognition using advanced imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用高级成像技术研究认知的神经基础。

name: Mike Tarr
title: Kavcic-Moura Professor of Cognitive and Brain Science & Department Head, Psychology and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies visual perception and object recognition, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和物体识别，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

name: Valerie Ventura
title: Associate Professor, Statistics
summary: Analyzes statistical methods in neuroscience research.
summary_zh: 分析神经科学研究中的统计方法。

name: Saurabh Vyas
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience Institute and Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: Doug Weber
title: Associate Professor, Mechanical Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies motor control and sensation & perception using computational and mathematical methods.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和感觉知觉，使用计算和数学方法。

name: Sossena Wood
title: Assistant Professor, Biomedical Engineering and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies learning and memory using behavioral methods and non-invasive brain monitoring techniques.
summary_zh: 使用行为方法和非侵入性脑部监测技术研究学习与记忆。

name: Eric Yttri
title: Assistant Professor, Biological Sciences and Neuroscience Institute
summary: Studies neural circuits and learning & memory using computational and systems neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和学习记忆，使用计算和系统神经科学方法。

name: Byron Yu
title: Gerard G. Elia Career Development Professor, Electrical & Computer Engineering and Biomedical Engineering, Neuroscience Institute, Carnegie Mellon University
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of decision-making and motor control using computational models and neural recordings.
summary_zh: 研究决策和运动控制的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

name: Yongxin Zhao
title: Assistant Professor, Biological Sciences
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in rodents using behavioral tasks and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为任务和电生理学方法。

name: Alexander G. Ophir
title: Professor
summary: Studies the roles of vasopressin and oxytocin in social recognition, attachment, aggression, and care-giving in prairie voles.
summary_zh: 研究催产素和血管加压素在原鼠社交识别、依恋、攻击性和抚育行为中的作用。

name: Khena M. Swallow
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how attending to behaviorally relevant moments in time impacts attention and memory, using behavioral, eye tracking, and MRI data.
summary_zh: 研究行为相关时刻的注意和记忆影响，使用行为、眼动追踪和MRI数据。

name: Misha Ailsworth
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of families, communities, and schools on Black girls' mental health, using qualitative and participatory methods.
summary_zh: 研究家庭、社区和学校对黑人女孩心理健康的影响，采用质性研究和参与式方法。

name: Adam Anderson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of emotions in perception and moral judgment, integrating psychological and neural analysis.
summary_zh: 研究情绪在知觉和道德判断中的作用，结合心理和神经层面的分析。

name: John H. Blume
title: Professor and Samuel F. Leibowitz Professor of Trial Techniques and Director, Cornell Death Penalty Project
summary: Studies cognitive and social processes in legal contexts, focusing on the psychology of testimony and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究认知和社会过程在法律环境中的作用，重点是证词和决策的心理学。

name: Charles Brainerd
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory influences reasoning and vice versa, developing fuzzy-trace theory to explain counterintuitive aspects of human cognition.
summary_zh: 研究记忆如何影响推理以及反过来推理如何影响记忆，发展模糊痕迹理论来解释人类认知中的一些反直觉方面。

name: Anthony Burrow
title: Ferris Family Professor of Life Course Studies
summary: Studies the role of purpose in life and its impact on psychological adjustment and resilience, particularly among ethnic minorities.
summary_zh: 研究生活目的在心理调适和韧性中的作用，尤其是对少数民族群体的影响。

name: Daniel Casasanto
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how linguistic, cultural, and bodily experiences influence cognition and decision-making, using various methods including fMRI, VR, and fieldwork.
summary_zh: 研究语言、文化和身体经验如何影响认知和决策，并使用多种方法，包括功能性磁共振成像、虚拟现实和实地研究。

name: Marianella Casasola
title: Professor and Senior Associate Dean for Undergraduate Affairs, Cornell Human Ecology
summary: Studies how infants and children develop spatial skills and learn language, using naturalistic and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的空间技能发展和语言学习，使用自然观察和实验方法。

name: Stephen Ceci
title: Helen L. Carr Professor of Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies children's testimonial competence, sex discrimination in science, and intellectual development across cultures.
summary_zh: 研究儿童作证能力、科学领域中的性别歧视以及跨文化智力发展。

name: Morten H. Christiansen
title: William R. Kenan, Jr. Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the evolution, acquisition, and processing of language, focusing on the role of chunking and statistical learning.
summary_zh: 研究语言的进化、获得和处理，重点关注块状结构和统计学习的作用。

name: Thomas A. Cleland
title: Professor
summary: Studies how learning and memory shape sensory processing in the brain, using electrophysiology, pharmacology, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆如何塑造大脑的感觉处理，使用电生理学、药理学和计算建模方法。

name: Audun Dahl
title: Professor
summary: Studies how moral reasoning and behavior develop across the lifespan, using experiments and observations with various age groups.
summary_zh: 研究道德推理和行为在生命周期中的发展，使用不同年龄段的实验和观察方法。

name: Eve De Rosa
title: Mibs Martin Follett Professor in Human Ecology and Rebecca Q. and James C. Morgan Sesquicentennial Fellow
summary: Studies the neurochemistry of attention and learning in rats and humans, using fMRI and pharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和学习的神经化学机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和药理学方法，比较啮齿动物和人类。

name: Rachel Dunifon
title: Professor and Rebecca Q. and James C. Morgan Dean, Cornell Human Ecology
summary: Studies the impact of policy and family settings on the development of less-advantaged children, focusing on maternal employment, family living arrangements, and grandparents' roles.
summary_zh: 研究政策和家庭环境对弱势儿童发展的影响，重点关注母亲就业、家庭居住安排和祖父母的作用。

name: Shimon Edelman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the evolution and consciousness of life forms, from amoeba to humans, with a focus on climate change.
summary_zh: 研究生命形式（从原生动物到人类）的进化和意识，并重点关注气候变化。

name: Gary Evans
title: Elizabeth Lee Vincent Professor of Human Ecology
summary: Studies how the physical environment affects children's health and well-being, focusing on poverty, housing, and schools.
summary_zh: 研究物理环境如何影响儿童的健康和福祉，重点关注贫困、住房和学校。

name: David J. Field
title: Professor
areas: Theories and models of sensory coding and visual processing
summary: Studies sensory coding and visual perception, exploring how the structure of the natural environment is represented by sensory systems.
summary_zh: 研究感觉编码和视觉知觉，探索自然环境结构如何被感觉系统表征。

name: Thomas D. Gilovich
title: Irene Blecker Rosenfeld Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, including decision-making and social behavior.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，包括决策和社交行为。

name: Michael H. Goldstein
title: Professor, Stephen H. Weiss Presidential Fellow, and Director of the Robert S. Harrison College Scholar Program
summary: Studies how infants learn to talk, focusing on vocal learning and development in songbirds and human infants, using social and statistical mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何学习说话，通过鸟类和人类婴儿的鸣叫学习和发展，使用社会和统计机制。

name: Marlen Gonzalez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social and physical environments impact neural sensitivity to rewards, punishment, vigilance, and stress, using psychophysiology, neuroimaging, and spatial analysis.
summary_zh: 研究社会和物理环境如何影响奖赏、惩罚、警觉性和压力的神经敏感性，使用心理生理学、神经成像和空间分析方法。

name: Will Hobbs
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods to analyze public attitudes towards government policies, focusing on the Affordable Care Act.
summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析公众对政府政策的态度，重点是《平价医疗法案》。

name: Adam J. Hoffman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social identities develop and change in adolescence, their relation to mental health, and how to leverage them for positive youth development.
summary_zh: 研究青少年时期的社会身份如何发展和变化，它们与心理健康的关系，以及如何利用这些身份促进青少年的积极发展。

name: Nori Jacoby
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how internal representations of sensory and cognitive abilities are shaped by nature and nurture, using machine learning and large-scale experiments.
summary_zh: 研究感觉和认知能力内部表征如何由先天和后天因素塑造，使用机器学习和大规模实验。

name: Corinna Loeckenhoff
title: Janet and Gordon Lankton Professor of Psychology and Professor of Gerontology in Medicine, Weill Cornell Medicine
summary: Studies age differences in time horizons, personality, and emotional experience, and their impact on health.
summary_zh: 研究不同年龄段的时间视野、人格和情绪体验及其对健康的影响。

name: Jane Mendle
title: Professor
summary: Studies the transition from childhood to adolescence, focusing on how puberty and its perception affect mental health.
summary_zh: 研究从儿童期到青春期的过渡，关注青春期及其感知如何影响心理健康。

name: Anthony Ong
title: Professor
summary: Studies how emotions and social connections affect health and development across the lifespan, using longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和社会联系如何影响从成年到老年的健康和发展，使用纵向研究方法。

name: Gordon Pennycook
title: Associate Professor, Dorothy and Ariz Mehta Faculty Leadership Fellow
summary: Studies reasoning and decision-making, focusing on the causes and consequences of analytic thinking and its importance in decision processes.
summary_zh: 研究推理和决策过程，关注分析性思维的原因及其后果，并探讨其在决策中的重要性。

name: Karl Pillemer
title: Hazel E. Reed Professor of Human Development
summary: Studies aging and family social networks, focusing on the life course and health policy.
summary_zh: 研究老化和家庭社会网络，关注生命周期和健康政策。

name: David A. Pizarro
title: Professor
summary: Studies moral judgment and the influence of emotions on moral intuitions, using psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究道德判断及其情绪影响，采用心理学实验方法。

name: Nora H. Prior
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of cognitive functions in humans.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知功能的发展。

name: David Rand
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how AI chatbots can influence voters' attitudes and behaviors, aiming to restore trust in digital public spheres.
summary_zh: 研究AI聊天机器人如何影响选民的态度和行为，旨在恢复数字公共领域的信任。

name: Valerie Reyna
title: Lois and Melvin Tukman Professor
summary: Studies judgment and decision making, particularly dual processes, false memory, and their implications for risky decisions in various fields.
summary_zh: 研究判断与决策过程，尤其是双过程理论、错误记忆及其对法律、健康、医学和神经科学中风险决策的影响。

name: Jonathan A. Rottenberg
title: Professor
summary: Studies long-term well-being after depression, focusing on factors that predict good outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁症后的长期福祉，重点关注预测良好结果的因素。

name: Jessica M. Salerno
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive, emotional, and social processes affect legal judgments, especially in courtrooms, to improve justice systems.
summary_zh: 研究认知、情感和社会过程如何影响法庭判决，以改进司法制度。

name: David M. Smith
title: Professor
summary: Studies learning and memory processes in rodents using neural recordings and pharmacological manipulations.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和记忆过程，使用神经记录和药理学操纵方法。

name: Robert Sternberg
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional processes, including creativity, intelligence, and expertise, using psychological assessments and theories.
summary_zh: 研究认知和情绪过程，包括创造力、智力和专业知识，使用心理评估和理论。

name: Felix J. Thoemmes
title: Associate Professor
areas: I work on topics of quantitative methods and design
for the social sciences. In particular
both model-based and design-based. I have done work on the
finishing up an IES grant on software development for
summary: Develops software for regression-discontinuity designs and applies causal inference methods in developmental and health psychology.
summary_zh: 开发回归连续性设计软件并应用因果推断方法于发展和健康心理学。

name: Katherine Tschida
title: Mary Armstrong Meduski ‘80 Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying mouse vocalizations, focusing on social context, brainstem neuron coordination, and communication signals.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠鸣叫的神经回路，关注社会背景、脑干神经元协调和沟通信号。

name: Qi Wang
title: Joan K. and Irwin M. Jacobs Professor
summary: Studies the development of cognitive and social-cognitive skills, including autobiographical memory and future thinking, in the context of culture.
summary_zh: 研究文化背景下认知和社会认知技能的发展，包括自传体记忆和未来思考。

name: Jenna Wells
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how emotion in close relationships affects mental and physical health in late life, focusing on caregivers of those with neurodegenerative diseases.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的情绪如何影响晚年的心身健康，特别是照顾神经退行性疾病患者的护理人员。

name: Wendy Williams
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development and assessment of intelligence and cognitive performance in real-world contexts, focusing on promoting women in science and encouraging underrepresented groups to pursue.
summary_zh: 研究智力和认知表现的发展与评估，特别是在现实世界中的应用，重点关注促进女性从事科学研究，并鼓励少数群体从事科学教育和职业。

name: Jordan C. Wylie
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how morality, norms, and rules influence social cognition, using surveys, behavioral experiments, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究道德、规范和规则如何影响社会认知，使用调查、行为实验和神经成像方法。

name: Vivian Zayas
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people form and maintain relationships, using implicit processes, EEG/ERP, fMRI, and self-reports.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何形成和维持关系，使用隐性过程、EEG/ERP、fMRI 和自我报告。

name: Daphna Buchsbaum
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development and social learning in children and dogs using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和狗的认知发展和社会学习，使用计算模型和行为实验的方法。

name: Ruth Colwill
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies animal learning and behavior, early adverse experiences, and canine communication systems.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习与行为、早期不良经历以及犬类交流系统。

name: Fulvio Domini
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human visual system processes 3D visual information for successful interactions with the environment, using computational methods and behavioral studies.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉系统如何处理3D视觉信息以成功与环境互动，采用计算方法和行为研究。

name: Serra Favila
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of episodic memory using functional neuroimaging, intracranial recordings, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究情景记忆的神经基础，使用功能性神经成像、颅内记录和计算建模方法。

name: Roman Feiman
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children develop higher-level cognitive skills, focusing on language acquisition and formal semantics.
summary_zh: 研究儿童高级认知技能的发展，特别是语言习得和形式语义学。

name: Oriel FeldmanHall
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how individuals navigate social interactions and make decisions in complex social networks, using neuroimaging and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究个体如何在复杂的社会网络中进行社会互动和决策，使用神经成像和计算建模方法。

name: Michael Frank
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Edgar L. Marston Professor, Cognitive Science Graduate Advisor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of reinforcement learning, decision making, and cognitive control using computational modeling and experimental techniques.
summary_zh: 研究强化学习、决策和认知控制的神经机制，使用计算建模和实验技术。

name: William Heindel
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies human memory, attention, and perception in neurologically intact individuals and brain-damaged patients.
summary_zh: 研究正常个体和脑损伤患者的记忆、注意力和知觉认知神经科学。

name: Joachim Krueger
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies social judgment and decision-making, including self-perception and intergroup relations, with intersections in behavioral economics and organizational behavior.
summary_zh: 研究社会判断与决策，包括自我知觉和群体关系，涉及行为经济学和组织行为学。

name: David Levari
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Lawrence A. Rand and Tiina Smith Assistant Professor
summary: Studies judgment and decision-making, social and cognitive psychology, using behavioral experiments and computational models to understand why people often take on tasks inappropriately and how.
summary_zh: 研究判断与决策、社会与认知心理学，通过行为实验和计算模型来理解人们为何常常不恰当地承担任务以及绩效评估为何会变得不那么准确。

name: Bertram F. Malle
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies social cognition, moral psychology, and human-robot interaction, focusing on intentionality, blame, and moral competence in robots.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知、道德心理学和人机交互，重点关注意图性、责备和机器人中的道德能力。

name: Julia Marshall
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of moral and social cognition in children and adults, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人道德和社会认知的发展，采用实验方法。

name: Andrea Megela Simmons
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of sound perception and communication in frogs, echolocating bats, dolphins, and humans.
summary_zh: 研究声音感知和交流的认知和神经机制，涉及青蛙、回声定位蝙蝠、海豚和人类。

name: Jason Okonofua
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how racial stereotypes affect teacher-student relationships and develops interventions to mitigate racial disparities in discipline.
summary_zh: 研究种族刻板印象如何影响师生关系，并开发干预措施以减轻纪律处分中的种族差异。

name: Frederike Petzschner
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies higher-level cognition and neural/computational models of mind, brain, and behavior, focusing on perception and action.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知和神经/计算模型的心智、大脑和行为，侧重于知觉和行动。

name: Thomas Serre
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
areas: Neural/Computational Models of Mind Brain and Behavior
summary: Studies neural computations supporting visual perception, combining biological and artificial vision.
summary_zh: 研究支持视觉感知的神经计算，结合生物视觉和人工视觉。

name: Steven Sloman
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people think and make decisions, focusing on collective cognition and the interaction of thought systems.
summary_zh: 研究人们的思维和决策过程，特别是集体认知以及思维系统的交互作用。

name: Dave Sobel
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor, Honors Advisor
summary: Studies how children learn from parent-child interaction and their causal reasoning in early education, linking cognitive and social development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童从亲子互动中学习以及早期教育中的因果推理，将认知发展和社会道德发展相结合。

name: Joo-Hyun Song
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how multiple systems involved in visual attention, target selection, and motor control work together to interact with complex environments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意、目标选择和运动控制等多个系统如何协同工作以应对复杂环境。

name: William Warren
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Chancellor's Professor
summary: Studies how visual information controls human locomotion, navigation, and collective motion using virtual reality techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉信息如何控制人类的运动、导航和集体行为，使用虚拟现实技术。

name: Takeo Watanabe
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Fred M. Seed Professor
summary: Studies how attention and reinforcement signals influence perceptual learning.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和强化信号在知觉学习中的作用。

name: Lio Wong
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how human minds efficiently learn and use language, including subjective aspects like storytelling and emotions, using experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何高效地学习和使用语言，包括叙述故事和情感等主观方面，使用实验和计算模型的方法。

name: Yuka Sasaki
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Professor (Research)
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Christopher Hill
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Faunce Professor of Philosophy and Professor of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies higher-level cognition and perception and action.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知和知觉与动作。

name: Matt Nassar
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural and computational models of higher-level cognition, perception and action using behavioral neuroscience and cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知、知觉和行动的神经和计算模型，采用行为神经科学和认知神经科学方法。

name: Hwamee Oh
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Human Behavior
summary: Studies cognitive processes and psychological mechanisms, focusing on the interplay between cognition and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和心理机制，重点关注认知与行为之间的相互作用。

name: Ellie Pavlick
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Briger Family Distinguished Associate Professor of Computer Science
summary: Studies neural and computational models of mind, brain, and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究心智、大脑和行为的神经和计算模型。

name: Apoorva Bhandari
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor (Research)
summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和行为实验研究认知过程。

name: Drew Linsley
dept: Department of Cognitive and Psychological Sciences
title: Assistant Professor (Research)
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Carlos Aizenman
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sensory experience shapes the connectivity and functional properties of developing neural circuits in the visual system of Xenopus laevis tadpoles, using electrophysiology, imaging, and.
summary_zh: 研究感觉经验如何塑造发育中视觉系统神经回路的连接性和功能特性，使用电生理学、成像和建模方法。

name: Gilad Barnea
title: Sidney A. Fox and Dorothea Doctors Fox Professor of Ophthalmology, Visual Science, and Neuroscience
summary: Develops trans-synaptic labeling systems to trace and functionally study neural circuits in mice, focusing on olfactory and gustatory systems.
summary_zh: 开发跨突触标记系统以追踪和功能研究小鼠的嗅觉和味觉神经回路。

name: David Berson
title: Professor of Neuroscience, Sidney A. Fox and Dorothea Doctors Fox Professor of Ophthalmology and Visual Science, Vice-Chair of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the structure and function of retinal neurons and their signals to the brain, focusing on ganglion cells and their roles in visual behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经元的结构和功能及其对大脑的信号传递，重点关注视网膜节细胞及其在视觉行为中的作用。

name: Anda Chirila
title: Manning Assistant Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the functional organization and plasticity of neural circuits mediating touch and pain, using mouse molecular-genetic tools and in vivo electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究感觉和疼痛的神经环路的功能组织和可塑性，使用小鼠分子遗传工具和在体电生理学方法。

name: Theresa Desrochers
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience, Rosenberg Family Associate Professor of Brain Science, Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Human Behavior
summary: Studies cognitive sequence control from single neurons to brain networks in both humans and animals, using fMRI, TMS, and high-density recordings.
summary_zh: 研究认知序列控制从单个神经元到脑网络的机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和高密度记录，涵盖人类和动物模型。

name: Alexander Fleischmann
title: Professor of Neuroscience, Provost's Professor of Brain Science
summary: Studies how neural circuits in the mouse olfactory cortex process sensory stimuli to generate perception and behavior, using molecular genetic, imaging, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠嗅皮层神经回路如何处理感官刺激以产生感知和行为，使用分子遗传学、成像和计算方法。

name: Diane Hoffman-Kim
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience, Associate Professor of Engineering, Director of the NIH-Brown Graduate Partnership Program
summary: Studies cellular and molecular neurobiology and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究细胞和分子神经生物学及神经回路。

name: Karla Kaun
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies genetic, molecular, and neural mechanisms of reward and addiction using fruit flies, combining genetics, behavior, and in vivo imaging.
summary_zh: 研究奖励和成瘾的遗传、分子和神经机制，使用果蝇结合遗传学、行为和体内成像方法。

name: Leenoy Meshulam
title: Assistant Professor of Neuroscience, Assistant Professor of Physics, Robert J. and Nancy D. Carney Assistant Professor of Brain Science
summary: Studies how large networks of cells generate collective function in nervous systems and brains, using statistical-physics approaches.
summary_zh: 使用统计物理学方法研究神经网络如何生成集体功能。

name: Michael Paradiso
title: Professor of Neuroscience, Sidney A. Fox and Dorothea Doctors Fox Professor of Ophthalmology and Visual Science
summary: Studies how visual perception and information processing in V1 are affected by saccades and natural vision, using neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究视皮层V1在眨眼和自然视觉影响下的知觉和信息处理，使用神经生理学方法。

name: Jerome Sanes
title: Professor of Neuroscience, Director of MRI Facility
summary: Studies brain mechanisms of voluntary movement and motor learning using MRI and surface brain electrical recording.
summary_zh: 研究自愿运动和运动学习的大脑机制，使用MRI和头皮脑电图记录技术。

name: David Sheinberg
title: Professor of Neuroscience, Vice-Chair of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the brain processes dynamic visual information and how perceptual learning changes neural responses.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理动态视觉信息以及知觉学习如何改变神经反应。

name: James A. Simmons
title: Professor of Biology
summary: Studies how bats perceive their environment using ultrasonic echolocation, focusing on neural processing in the bat's brain.
summary_zh: 研究蝙蝠如何使用超声波回声定位感知环境，重点在于蝙蝠大脑中的神经处理机制。

name: Margaret Beier
title: Autrey Professor of Psychological Sciences & Department Chair, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how individual differences and training affect aging and occupational health.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异和培训如何影响衰老和职业健康。

name: Rebecca Brossoit
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the health, safety, and well-being of working populations, focusing on employee sleep, organizational interventions, and the impact of the built and natural environment.
summary_zh: 研究工作人群的健康、安全和福祉，重点关注员工睡眠、组织干预以及建筑和自然环境的影响。

name: Michael Byrne
title: Elma Schneider Professor of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies human factors and cognitive aspects of human-computer interaction.
summary_zh: 研究人类因素和认知方面的计算机交互。

name: Jing Chen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies human performance and decision-making in complex interactions, applying findings to autonomous driving and cybersecurity.
summary_zh: 研究人类在复杂交互中的表现和决策，并将其应用于自动驾驶和网络安全等领域。

name: Marc Coutanche
title: Associate Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how the human brain transforms sensory experiences into lasting knowledge, using fMRI, virtual reality, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何将感官体验转化为持久的知识，使用功能性磁共振成像、虚拟现实和机器学习方法。

name: Patricia DeLucia
title: Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies perception of collision, motion, and depth, and multisensory integration in normal and impaired vision, with applications in transportation, healthcare, and military.
summary_zh: 研究正常和受损视觉中的碰撞、运动和深度感知以及多感官整合，并应用于交通运输、医疗保健和军事领域。

name: Bryan Denny
title: Associate Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of emotion regulation in healthy and clinical populations, using neuroimaging and behavioral analysis to develop interventions.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节的神经生物学机制，在健康和临床人群中的应用，使用神经成像和行为分析开发干预措施。

name: Christopher P. Fagundes
title: Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how psychosocial adversity accelerates diseases of aging through biological mechanisms like immune dysregulation and autonomic dysfunction.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会压力如何通过免疫失调和自主神经系统功能障碍加速衰老相关疾病。

name: Simon Fischer-Baum
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how written and spoken language is processed, focusing on short-term memory and cognitive neuropsychology.
summary_zh: 研究书面和口头语言处理，侧重于短时记忆和认知神经心理学。

name: Luz Maria Garcini
title: Associate Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the health needs of marginalized communities, using biobehavioral and sociocultural approaches to identify risk and resilience.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化社区的健康需求，采用生物行为和社会文化方法来识别风险和韧性。

name: Noni Gaylord-Harden
title: Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the impact of community violence on Black adolescents and families, focusing on protective factors and developing interventions.
summary_zh: 研究社区暴力对黑人青少年和家庭的影响，重点关注保护因素并开发干预措施。

name: Eden King
title: Lynette S. Autrey Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the management of diverse organizations to promote equity and inclusion, using research in diversity, work-family balance, and occupational health.
summary_zh: 研究多元组织的管理以促进公平与包容，涉及多样性、工作与家庭平衡以及职业健康的研究。

name: Danielle King Jordan
title: Associate Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies employee resilience and identity, and organizational resources that support thriving.
summary_zh: 研究员工的韧性和身份，以及组织资源如何促进繁荣。

name: Philip Kortum
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies human factors and human-computer interaction, focusing on user experience and interface design.
summary_zh: 研究人因与人机交互，专注于用户体验和界面设计。

name: James LeBreton
title: Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies personality motives and their impact on behavior in organizations, using conditional reasoning theory and psychometrics.
summary_zh: 研究人格动机及其对组织中行为的影响，采用条件推理理论和心理测量学方法。

name: Seth Osborn
title: Professor in the Practice
summary: Studies team development, personality in the workplace, and identity measurement and development, collaborating with various organizations.
summary_zh: 研究团队发展、工作场所人格以及身份测量与发展，与各类组织合作。

name: Eduardo Salas
title: Professor
summary: Studies factors that enhance team effectiveness in organizations, evaluating training methods and designing optimal training systems.
summary_zh: 研究组织中团队效能的促进因素，评估培训方法并设计优化的培训系统。

name: Alyssa Sinclair
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how people update their knowledge and beliefs, using brain imaging and computational modeling to develop interventions for learning and behavior change.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何更新知识和信念，使用脑成像和计算建模来开发促进学习和行为改变的干预措施。

name: Erin Standen
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the facilitators and barriers of healthy behavior change, particularly in eating, physical activity, and weight, using interventions in mobile health apps, workplaces, and clinical settings.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为改变的促进因素和障碍，特别是在饮食、体育活动和体重方面，使用移动健康应用程序、工作场所和临床互动中的干预措施。

name: Tianjun Sun
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies personnel selection, individual differences, and psychometrics to improve staffing decisions and candidate experiences.
summary_zh: 研究人员选拔、个体差异和心理测量学，以提高人员配置决策和候选人体验。

name: Andre Bastos
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain builds predictions using neuronal recordings, computational modeling, and optogenetics in non-human primates performing cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何构建预测，使用神经元记录、计算建模和光遗传学技术，在进行认知任务的非人灵长类动物中进行。

name: Camilla P. Benbow
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of academically talented adolescents, focusing on their trajectories and the impact of educational interventions.
summary_zh: 研究天才青少年的发展轨迹及其教育干预的影响。

name: Deon T. Benton
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how infants and young children acquire knowledge and concepts through behavioral experiments and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何通过行为实验和计算建模获得知识和概念。

name: Amy E. Booth
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies early cognitive development and learning, focusing on the origins and outcomes of individual variability in pre-academic skills, particularly causal reasoning and scientific literacy.
summary_zh: 研究早期认知发展和学习，重点关注个体差异在前学术技能（尤其是因果推理和科学素养）发展中的起源和结果。

name: James R. Booth
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Patricia and Rodes Hart Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies the brain mechanisms of language, reading, and cognitive development in typical and atypical populations using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言、阅读和认知发展中的大脑机制，使用神经影像技术探讨典型和非典型人群的发育情况。

name: Sarah Brown-Schmidt
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how knowledge about conversational partners guides language use, memory processes in language, and the link between thoughts and speech in unscripted conversation.
summary_zh: 研究对话伙伴知识如何指导语言使用、语言中的记忆过程以及思想与未编剧本对话中的言语之间的联系。

name: Sun-Joo Cho
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Develops statistical models for analyzing complex data in education and psychology, focusing on item response, multilevel, and longitudinal modeling.
summary_zh: 开发用于教育和心理学复杂数据的统计模型，重点是项目反应、多层次和纵向建模。

name: Alexander Christensen
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies dynamic systems in psychology using network and data science to model psychological phenotypes and develop tools for accurate measurements and predictions.
summary_zh: 使用网络和数据科学研究心理学中的动态系统，建模心理表型并开发工具以实现准确的测量和预测。

name: Bruce Compas
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Pediatrics
summary: Studies coping and emotion-regulation in response to stress and adversity in children, adolescents, and adults, developing interventions to enhance stress management.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、青少年和成人应对压力和逆境时的情绪调节和应对策略，并开发增强应对压力的方法。

name: Scott Crossley
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies cognition using data science and artificial intelligence, focusing on natural language processing and developing intelligent textbooks.
summary_zh: 使用数据科学和人工智能研究认知，重点是自然语言处理和开发智能教科书。

name: Elisabeth Dykens
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies psychopathology and strengths in individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, focusing on Prader-Willi, Williams, and Down syndromes.
summary_zh: 研究智力和发育障碍个体的心理病理学和优势，特别是普拉德-威利综合症、威廉斯综合症和唐氏综合症。

name: Lisa Fazio
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how people learn new information and correct errors in knowledge, with applications for journalists and teachers.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何学习新信息并纠正知识中的错误，其应用范围包括记者和教师。

name: Isabel Gauthier
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Radiology and Radiological Sciences
summary: Studies visual object recognition, focusing on the plasticity of recognition mechanisms and their neural substrate, particularly how experience shapes face recognition.
summary_zh: 研究视觉物体识别，特别是识别机制的可塑性及其神经基础，以及经验如何塑造面孔识别。

name: Suzana Herculano-Houzel
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the cellular composition and evolution of brains, focusing on the metabolic cost and number of neurons across species.
summary_zh: 研究大脑的细胞组成和进化，关注不同物种的大脑代谢成本和神经元数量。

name: Justine Hoch
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies exploratory behavior and learning in early childhood, focusing on the development of perception-action systems.
summary_zh: 研究早期儿童的探索行为和学习，关注感知-行动系统的发育。

name: Kari Hoffman
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies memory and visual exploration in the primate hippocampus using sharp-wave ripples and pupillary responses.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物海马体中的记忆和视觉探索，使用尖波涟漪和瞳孔反应。

name: Steven D. Hollon
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Gertrude Conaway Vanderbilt Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the etiology and treatment of depression in adults, focusing on cognitive and biological processes, and the efficacy of psychosocial versus pharmacological interventions.
summary_zh: 研究成人抑郁症的病因和治疗方法，关注认知和生物学过程，并比较心理社会干预与药物治疗的有效性。

name: Kathryn L. Humphreys
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor, Dept. of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies the effects of adversity on child development and caregiving, using neurobiological and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究逆境对儿童发展和照料者行为的影响，采用神经生物学和行为学方法。

name: Jon Kaas
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Distinguished Centennial Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the evolution and functional organization of sensory-perceptual, cognitive, and motor systems in primates, using electrophysiological and neuroanatomical techniques.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物感觉-知觉、认知和运动系统的进化和功能组织，使用电生理学和神经解剖学技术。

name: Antonia Kaczkurkin
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of anxiety and depressive disorders using fMRI, EEG, and other psychophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和抑郁障碍的神经生物学机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和其他生理学测量方法。

name: Autumn Kujawa
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies the role of reward responsiveness in depression and its neural predictors, using cognitive behavioral therapy and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究奖励反应性在抑郁症中的作用及其神经预测因子，使用认知行为疗法和神经成像技术。

name: Jonathan D. Lane
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how children develop understanding of other people's minds and how they learn from others, including attitudes toward new social groups.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展对他人的心理理解以及如何从他人那里学习，包括对新社会群体的态度。

name: Daniel Levin
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how knowledge influences visual perception and event sequence recognition, using movies and scene perception experiments.
summary_zh: 研究知识如何影响视觉感知和事件序列识别，使用电影和场景感知实验。

name: Gordon Logan
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Centennial Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies automaticity and skill acquisition, attention and performance, and executive control processes.
summary_zh: 研究自动性和技能获取、注意力和表现以及执行控制过程。

name: David Lubinski
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Cornelius Vanderbilt Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies intellectually precocious youth and conditions for enhancing their learning, work performance, and creativity.
summary_zh: 研究智力超常青年及其学习、工作表现和创造力提升的条件。

name: Alexander Maier
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the relationship between brain activity and conscious visual perception using local field potentials and attentional selection in sensory cortex.
summary_zh: 研究大脑活动与视觉意识感知之间的关系，使用局部场电位和注意选择在感觉皮层中的作用。

name: René Marois
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of attention and working memory using fMRI and psychophysical tools, and explores attentional capacity limits and the relationship between attention and awareness.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和工作记忆的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像和心理物理学工具，探讨注意力容量限制及其与意识的关系。

name: Timothy P. McNamara
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people use spatial cues during navigation to estimate their position and goals, using Bayesian decision theory.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用空间线索进行导航以估计其位置和目标，使用贝叶斯决策理论。

name: Amy Needham
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how infants and young children learn with their hands, focusing on tool use and fine motor skills development.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何通过手部动作学习，重点关注工具使用和精细运动技能的发展。

name: Bunmi O. Olatunji
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Gertrude Conaway Vanderbilt Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the role of disgust in anxiety disorders, using longitudinal and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究厌恶感在焦虑障碍中的作用，采用纵向和实验方法。

name: Thomas Palmeri
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies visual cognition, including categorization, memory, and decision-making using behavioral experiments, cognitive neuroscience, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉认知，包括分类、记忆和决策，使用行为实验、认知神经科学和计算模型。

name: Sohee Park
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Gertrude Conaway Vanderbilt Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive and social aspects of schizophrenia, using virtual reality and brain imaging techniques.
