summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的认知和社会方面，使用虚拟现实和脑成像技术。

name: Sean Polyn
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies memory and retrieval processes using fMRI and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和检索过程，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算模型。

name: Kristopher J. Preacher
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor
summary: Develops and applies statistical methods for modeling correlational and longitudinal data, focusing on mediation and moderation hypotheses.
summary_zh: 开发和应用统计方法来建模相关性和纵向数据，重点是中介和调节假设。

name: Bethany Rittle-Johnson
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor, Psychology & Human Development
summary: Studies how children learn problem-solving procedures and key concepts in mathematics, focusing on the roles of comparison and explanation.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习数学问题解决程序和关键概念，重点关注比较和解释的作用。

name: Megan Saylor
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习词汇，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Jonathan Schaefer
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the environmental determinants of mental health, using twin and longitudinal methods to identify modifiable mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究环境因素对心理健康的影响，使用双生子和纵向方法来识别可修改的机制。

name: David G. Schlundt
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies behavioral interventions and environmental factors affecting eating, exercise, and health disparities, particularly in African American and Native American communities.
summary_zh: 研究行为干预和环境因素对饮食、锻炼和健康差异的影响，特别是在非裔美国人和美洲原住民社区。

name: Sonya K. Sterba
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Develops latent variable models for longitudinal and cross-sectional data, advancing psychology research methods.
summary_zh: 发展纵向和横截面数据的潜在变量模型，推进心理学研究方法。

name: Frank Tong
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Centennial Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural bases of visual perception, attention, and working memory using fMRI and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、注意力和工作记忆的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算建模方法。

name: Mark Wallace
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain integrates information from multiple sensory systems to enhance perception and motor commands, using techniques like fMRI and neurophysiological recordings.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何整合多种感官信息以增强感知和运动指令，使用功能性磁共振成像和神经生理记录等技术。

name: Duane Watson
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how gesture, pitch, rhythm, and emphasis in speech influence communication, and how individual differences affect language production and comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究手势、音高、节奏和重音在言语交流中的作用，以及个体差异如何影响语言生产和理解。

name: Ashley Watts
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the causes and consequences of mental illness, particularly addiction, using a variety of methods including psychometrics and psychiatric epidemiology.
summary_zh: 研究精神疾病（尤其是成瘾）的原因和后果，使用多种方法，包括心理测量学和精神病流行病学。

name: Eric D. Wilkey
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies the development of mathematical skills and the neurocognitive mechanisms involved, using fMRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究数学技能的发展及其神经认知机制，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和行为实验方法。

name: Thilo Womelsdorf
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how neural circuits learn and control attentional allocation in nonhuman primates and humans using virtual reality, electrophysiology, and neuromodulation.
summary_zh: 研究非人灵长类动物和人类的神经回路如何学习和控制注意力分配，使用虚拟现实、电生理学和神经调节方法。

name: Geoffrey F. Woodman
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how visual attention and memory influence interactions with the world, focusing on figure-ground segregation, attentional deployment, and cognitive control.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和记忆如何影响与世界的互动，重点关注图底分离、注意力分配和认知控制。

name: Hao Wu
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Evaluates statistical models in psychology and education, focusing on identifiability, uncertainty quantification, and model fit.
summary_zh: 评估心理学和教育中的统计模型，重点关注可识别性、不确定性量化和模型拟合。

name: Cristina Zepeda
dept: Department of Psychology (College of Arts and Science)
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies how metacognition, motivation, and instructional strategies affect student learning and problem-solving, with a focus on enhancing STEM skills.
summary_zh: 研究元认知、动机和教学策略对学生学习和问题解决的影响，旨在提高STEM技能。

name: Malcolm J. Avison
title: Professor of Radiology & Radiological Sciences
summary: Develops and applies novel imaging methods to study central nervous system development and function in health and disease.
summary_zh: 开发和应用新型成像方法研究中枢神经系统在健康和疾病中的发育和功能。

name: James W. Bodfish
title: Professor & Vice Chair for Research, Department of Hearing & Speech Sciences
summary: Studies social behaviors and repetitive behaviors in autism spectrum disorder, using behavioral observations and genetic models.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍中的社会行为和重复行为，使用行为观察和遗传模型。

name: Kendal S. Broadie
title: Stevenson Professor of Neurobiology, Professor of Biological Sciences, Pharmacology, and Cell & Developmental Biology
summary: Studies genetic and molecular mechanisms of coordinated movement, behavior, cognition, learning, and memory, focusing on synaptic development and plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究遗传和分子机制，涉及协调运动、行为、认知、学习和记忆，重点在于突触的发育和可塑性。

name: Erin S. Calipari
title: Professor, Department of Pharmacology
summary: Studies how neural circuits integrate experiences with positive and negative stimuli to guide future behavior, using cutting-edge technology to understand circuit and molecular dysregulation in.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路如何整合正负刺激的经验以指导未来行为，并使用前沿技术理解精神疾病中的电路和分子失调。

name: Carissa J. Cascio
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences - Division of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional processes in mental health, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知和情绪过程在心理健康中的作用，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

name: M.D. Daniel Claassen
title: is a Professor of Neurology at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, with subspecialty trainin
summary: Studies the biologic basis of human behavior regulation and cognitive processes in neurodegenerative disorders like Parkinson's and Huntington's, using cognitive neuroscience and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病（如帕金森病和亨廷顿病）中人类行为调节和认知过程的生物基础，使用认知神经科学和神经成像技术。

name: Blythe A. Corbett
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies socioemotional responsivity in children with autism spectrum disorder using neuropsychological testing, behavioral observation, neuroimaging, and cortisol assessment.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症儿童的情绪和社会反应性，使用神经心理测试、行为观察、神经成像和皮质醇评估。

name: Nancy J. Cox
title: Professor of Medicine, Mary Phillips Edmonds Gray Professor of Genetics, Director, Vanderbilt Genetics Institute, Director, Division of Genetic Medicine
summary: Studies the genetic basis of common diseases, integrating genomics with translational phenotypes.
summary_zh: 研究常见疾病的遗传基础，整合基因组学与转化表型。

name: Laurie E. Cutting
title: Professor of Special Education
summary: Studies brain-behavior relations in children and adolescents, focusing on reading disabilities, language, and executive function using neuroimaging and neuropsychological testing.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年的大脑-行为关系，重点是阅读障碍、语言和工作记忆，使用神经影像学和神经心理学测试。

name: M.D. Ryan Darby
title: Assistant Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies how brain atrophy in different locations causes the same clinical syndrome in neurodegenerative disorders, using neuroimaging and behavioral testing.
summary_zh: 研究不同脑区萎缩如何导致神经退行性疾病中相同的临床症状，使用神经影像学和行为测试。

name: Prashant Donthamsetti
title: Assistant Professor of Pharmacology
summary: Studies mechanisms of addiction and drug effects on brain function.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾机制和药物对大脑功能的影响。

name: Melissa C. Duff
title: Professor and Chair, Hearing and Speech Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of speech and hearing, using brain imaging techniques and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究言语和听力的神经机制，使用脑成像技术和行为实验。

name: Sabine Fuhrmann
title: Associate Professor of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences
summary: Studies visual perception and its neural basis using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知及其神经基础，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Rene H. Gifford
title: Professor and Director, Cochlear Implant Research Laboratory, Department of Hearing and Speech Sciences
summary: Studies hearing and speech using cochlear implants, focusing on neural mechanisms and clinical applications.
summary_zh: 研究听觉和言语的神经机制及临床应用，使用人工耳蜗植入技术。

name: Reyna L. Gordon
title: Assistant Professor, Otolaryngology
summary: Studies the relationship between rhythm and language abilities using behavioral, cognitive, neural, and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究节奏与语言能力之间的关系，采用行为、认知、神经和遗传学方法。

name: John C. Gore
title: University Distinguished Professor
summary: Develops and applies multimodal imaging methods to understand tissue physiology and structure, and functional brain imaging.
summary_zh: 开发和应用多模态成像方法以理解组织生理和结构以及功能性脑成像。

name: Todd R. Graham
title: Stevenson Professor of Biological Sciences
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Brad A. Grueter
title: Associate Professor of Anesthesiology
summary: Studies the Nucleus Accumbens circuitry and synaptic modifications in reward-related neurocircuits to understand addiction and disease intervention.
summary_zh: 研究奖赏相关神经回路中的核团腹侧部（NAc）环路和突触修饰，以理解成瘾和疾病干预机制。

name: Fiona E. Harrison
title: Associate Professor of Medicine and Director, Vanderbilt Mouse Neurobehavioral Core
summary: Studies how vitamin C deficiency and high fat diet impact Alzheimer’s disease development in mice, focusing on beta-amyloid accumulation.
summary_zh: 研究维生素C缺乏和高脂饮食如何影响小鼠阿尔茨海默病的发展，重点关注β-淀粉样蛋白积累。

name: Timothy J. Hohman
title: Associate Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies genetic and proteomic markers of Alzheimer's disease resilience using neuroimaging and big-data analytics.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病抗性的遗传和蛋白质组学标志物，利用神经影像学和大数据分析方法。

name: Angela Jefferson
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies the vascular contributions to cognitive impairment and Alzheimer’s disease, using multimodal biomarker assessment.
summary_zh: 研究血管因素对认知损害和阿尔茨海默病的贡献，采用多模态生物标志物评估方法。

name: M.D. Lori Jordan
title: Associate Professor, Pediatrics, Pediatric Neurology
summary: Studies brain injury and cognitive function in children with congenital heart disease and type I diabetes, focusing on pediatric stroke and sickle cell disease.
summary_zh: 研究先天性心脏病和1型糖尿病儿童的脑损伤和认知功能，重点关注儿童卒中和镰状细胞病。

name: Christine L. Konradi
title: Professor of Pharmacology
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of psychiatric disorders, focusing on learning, behavioral adaptation, and brain disorders using pharmacological and molecular biology techniques.
summary_zh: 研究精神障碍的分子机制，关注学习、行为适应和大脑障碍，使用药理学和分子生物学技术。

name: Miriam Lense
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Otolaryngology
summary: Studies the intersection of rhythm and music with social, emotional, and cognitive processes in infants, children, and adults with developmental disabilities, developing music-based interventions.
summary_zh: 研究节奏和音乐与发育障碍个体的社会、情绪和认知过程的交集，开发音乐干预措施。

name: Shan Meltzer
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Pharmacology
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of somatosensory circuit assembly in mice, using genetics, sequencing, and behavior to understand touch, pain, and itch.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠触觉环路组装的分子和细胞机制，使用基因编辑、测序和行为学方法来理解触觉、疼痛和痒感。

name: Ramnarayan Ramachandran
title: Associate Professor of Hearing & Speech Sciences
summary: Studies the neural basis of speech and hearing, focusing on auditory processing and its impact on communication.
summary_zh: 研究听觉处理的神经基础及其对交流的影响。

name: Tonia S. Rex
title: Professor of Ophthalmology & Visual Sciences
summary: Studies visual perception and its disorders, using translational research methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知及其障碍，采用转化研究方法。

name: Douglas Ruderfer
title: Douglas Ruderfer, PhD, is an Associate Professor in the Departments of Medicine, Biomedical Informatics and Psychiatry at Vanderbilt University Medical Center.
summary: Develops and applies analytical approaches to understand the genetic etiology and improve the phenotypic characterization of psychiatric disorders and behavioral health traits.
summary_zh: 开发和应用分析方法来理解精神疾病和行为健康特征的遗传学病因，并改善其表型特征。

name: Monica M. Santisteban
title: Assistant Professor of Medicine, Neurology and Pharmacology
summary: Studies the mechanisms of neurovascular dysfunction and cognitive impairment caused by hypertension, aiming to improve brain health.
summary_zh: 研究高血压引起的神经血管功能障碍和认知损害机制，旨在改善大脑健康。

name: Cody Siciliano
title: Assistant Professor, Pharmacology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of individual differences in decision-making, using rodent models and behavioral procedures.
summary_zh: 研究决策差异的神经机制，使用啮齿动物模型和行为程序。

name: Richard B. Simerly
title: Louise B. McGavock Professor
summary: Studies how environmental factors influence the formation of limbic-hypothalamic circuits through endocrine signals, using molecular genetic tools to manipulate neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究环境因素通过内分泌信号影响边缘-下丘脑回路的形成，使用分子遗传工具操纵神经回路，以获得对电路架构如何定义稳态表型的脑区广泛理解。

name: Michelle Southard-Smith
title: Professor, Departments of Medicine and Cell & Developmental Biology
summary: Studies the development of neural crest lineages in the peripheral nervous system.
summary_zh: 研究外周神经系统中神经嵴谱系的发育。

name: Marie P. Suver
title: Assistant Professor, Biological Sciences
summary: Studies how nervous systems predict and learn about the world using electrophysiology, genetics, and behavior in Drosophila.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何预测和学习世界，使用电生理学、遗传学和行为学方法在果蝇中进行研究。

name: Sophia Vinci-Booher
title: Assistant Professor, Psychology and Human Development
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Neil D. Woodward
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavorial Sciences, Charlotte and Donald Test Jr. Chair in Psychiatry Division of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural basis of psychotic disorders, particularly schizophrenia and bipolar disorder, using neuroimaging and cognitive neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和双相情感障碍的神经基础，采用神经成像和认知神经科学方法。

name: Tiffany G. Woynaroski
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Hearing and Speech Sciences
summary: Studies speech and hearing, focusing on speech-language pathology and auditory processing.
summary_zh: 研究言语和听力，专注于言语病理学和听觉处理。

name: Chengwen Zhou
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 使用神经科学方法研究大脑系统与行为的关系。

name: Kiel M. Telesford
title: Assistant Professor of Ophthalmology & Visual Sciences
summary: Studies visual perception and its neural basis using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知及其神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Wouter Kool
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain implements effort-based decision making and arbitrates between choice strategies using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何实现基于努力的决策制定以及在选择策略之间进行权衡，使用行为实验、计算建模和神经成像方法。

name: Alan Lambert
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of emotion in forming attitudes and judgments, particularly in political contexts.
summary_zh: 研究情绪在形成态度和判断中的作用，特别是在政治领域的应用。

name: Seanna Leath
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cultural, social, and structural contexts shape the health and wellbeing of Black youth, families, and communities, using qualitative, quantitative, and mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究文化、社会和结构背景如何影响黑人青少年、家庭和社区的健康和福祉，使用定性、定量和混合方法。

name: Lori Markson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children learn from and think about other people, focusing on social categories like race and fairness.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从他人学习和思考，重点关注种族和社会公平等社会类别。

name: Josh Oltmanns
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops AI models to assess personality and psychopathology using natural language, speech, and movement processing.
summary_zh: 开发基于人工智能的语言、语音和动作处理方法来评估人格和心理障碍。

name: Juston Osborne
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of psychosis, focusing on motor system abnormalities and cannabis use, using EEG and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的神经生物学机制，重点关注运动系统异常和大麻使用，使用EEG和神经影像学方法。

name: Zachariah Reagh
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human brain encodes and retrieves dynamic experiences, and how these processes change in healthy aging and Alzheimer’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何编码和检索动态经历，以及这些过程在健康老化和阿尔茨海默病中的变化。

name: Mitchell Sommers
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies memory and aging, focusing on false memories in older adults and individuals with dementia.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和老化，重点关注老年人和阿尔茨海默病患者的虚假记忆。

name: Renee Thompson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotional processes and their role in depression, using ecological momentary assessment and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪过程及其在抑郁症中的作用，使用生态瞬时评估和计算方法。

name: Kristin Van Engen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how linguistic experience and environmental factors affect speech perception in noisy conditions.
summary_zh: 研究语言经验与环境因素如何影响嘈杂环境下的语音感知。

name: Emily Willroth
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how different components of well-being vary and change over time, linking well-being to health outcomes in middle and older adulthood.
summary_zh: 研究不同维度的幸福感如何随时间变化，并将其与中老年时期的健康结果联系起来。

name: Jeffrey M. Zacks
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cognition changes with healthy aging and age-related neurological disorders using behavioral tasks, eye-tracking, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究认知随健康老化和神经退行性疾病的变化，使用行为任务、眼动追踪和神经成像方法。

name: Richard Abrams
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mental mechanisms underlying overt and covert movements, focusing on the role of perceptual objects in attention and action.
summary_zh: 研究知觉对象在注意和动作中的作用，以及捕获注意的视觉刺激类型。

name: Deanna Barch
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of depression in early childhood, focusing on emotion regulation and hippocampal development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童早期抑郁的发展，重点关注情绪调节和海马体发育。

name: Ryan Bogdan
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies genomic and environmental factors associated with psychopathology risk and their biological correlates across the lifespan using molecular genetics, fMRI, and behavioral assessment.
summary_zh: 研究与心理障碍风险相关的基因和环境因素及其生物学指标，使用分子遗传学、fMRI 和行为评估方法贯穿整个生命周期。

name: Todd Braver
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control mechanisms, working memory, and how mindfulness training impacts these processes using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制机制、工作记忆以及正念训练如何影响这些过程，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Julie Bugg
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control processes, particularly in the Stroop task and Eriksen flanker task, using experimental psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制过程，特别是stroop任务和eriksen flanker任务，使用实验心理学方法。

name: Andrew C. Butler
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how contextual factors shape memory retrieval and its effects on learning, using various methods in educational settings.
summary_zh: 研究情境因素如何影响记忆检索及其对学习的影响，使用多种方法在教育环境中进行研究。

name: William Chopik
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how close relationships and social factors influence development and health over time.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和社会因素如何影响发展和健康随时间的变化。

name: Rebecca Cox
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of sleep and circadian rhythm disruption on anxiety-related disorders, using multimethod approaches including actigraphy and self-report measures.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和昼夜节律紊乱对焦虑相关障碍的影响，采用多方法手段，包括活动监测和自我报告量表。

name: Alexandra Decker
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Ian Dobbins
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies memory and cognitive control using functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和认知任务研究记忆和认知控制。

name: Tammy English
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the social effects of emotion regulation and its impact on social functioning and relationships.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节的社会效应及其对社交功能和关系的影响。

name: Ellen Fitzsimmons-Craft
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops and tests digital interventions to improve access to evidence-based care for eating disorders and other mental health problems.
summary_zh: 开发和测试数字干预措施，以提高对饮食障碍和其他心理健康问题的基于证据的治疗方法的可及性。

name: Leonard Green
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how individuals discount rewards based on delay and probability, using behavioral experiments with humans and animals.
summary_zh: 研究个体如何根据延迟和概率折现奖励，使用人类和动物的行为实验。

name: Sandra Hale
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies working memory and cognitive abilities across the adult lifespan, using psychological assessments.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和认知能力在成人生命周期中的结构，使用心理评估方法。

name: Denise Head
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies aging and Alzheimer's disease using neuroimaging and cognitive tests.
summary_zh: 研究老化和阿尔茨海默病，使用神经影像学和认知测试。

name: Patrick Hill
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of purpose in life on mental health and aging, using longitudinal studies and personality models.
summary_zh: 研究生活目的在心理健康和衰老中的作用，使用纵向研究和人格模型。

name: Derek Isaacowitz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how attention and emotion change with age, using eye-tracking and psychophysiology in various behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和情绪随年龄变化的关系，使用眼动追踪和生理指标在不同行为任务中进行评估。

name: Joshua Jackson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality traits and their long-term effects on health, relationships, and cognitive development.
summary_zh: 研究人格特质及其对健康、关系和认知发展长期影响的认知心理学。

name: Mariam Aly
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how perception and memory interact, using behavioral studies, fMRI, and patient studies to understand memory systems and their influence on attention and perception.
summary_zh: 研究感知与记忆之间的相互作用，通过行为研究、fMRI 和患者研究来理解记忆系统及其对注意力和感知的影响。

name: Ozlem Ayduk
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies how self-distancing and emotion regulation develop in children and close relationships.
summary_zh: 研究自我疏离和情绪调节在儿童和亲密关系中的发展。

name: Jasmin Brooks Stephens
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of sociocultural factors on mental health, particularly among Black youth and emerging adults, focusing on suicide prevention and racial trauma.
summary_zh: 研究社会文化因素对黑人青少年和新兴成年人心理健康的影响，特别是自杀预防和种族创伤。

name: Silvia Bunge
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development and plasticity of higher cognitive functions in humans, focusing on reasoning, learning, and goal-directed behavior.
summary_zh: 研究人类高级认知功能的发展和可塑性，重点在于推理、学习和目标导向行为。

name: Serena Chen
title: Professor
summary: Studies self and identity, self-compassion, and close relationships, exploring how social power affects interpersonal dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究自我和身份、自我同情以及亲密关系，探讨社会权力如何影响人际动态。

name: Anne Collins
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how learning, decision-making, and executive functions are processed by cognitive and neural systems using computational modeling and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习、决策和执行功能的认知和神经处理过程，使用计算建模和行为实验。

name: Mark D'Esposito
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of working memory and executive control using fMRI, pharmacological studies, and behavioral experiments in patient populations.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和执行控制的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、药理学研究和患者行为实验。

name: Gul Dolen
title: Professor, The Renee & U.S. Marine LCPl Bob Parsons Endowed Chair
summary: Studies social behaviors, psychedelics, and synaptic plasticity in octopuses and humans, exploring critical periods and oxytocin effects.
summary_zh: 研究社会行为、致幻剂和突触可塑性，涉及八爪鱼和人类，探索关键时期和催产素的作用。

name: Marina Dubova
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of discovery, concept learning, and theory building, including social learning and experimentation.
summary_zh: 研究认知发现机制、概念学习和理论构建，包括社会学习和实验研究。

name: Arianne Eason
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social and cultural contexts shape attitudes and behaviors towards diverse groups, focusing on racial segregation, media representation, and resource allocations in infancy.
summary_zh: 研究社会和文化背景如何塑造人们对不同群体的态度和行为，重点关注种族隔离、媒体代表性以及婴儿期资源分配。

name: Jan Engelmann
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children and chimpanzees develop and differ in cooperative skills and motivations, focusing on prosociality and fairness.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和黑猩猩在合作技能和动机方面的差异和发展，重点在于亲社会行为和公平感。

name: Aaron Fisher
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies psychopathology at the individual and momentary level, using configural psychometrics to identify necessary and sufficient clinical configurations.
summary_zh: 研究个体和瞬时的心理障碍，使用构型心理测量学来识别必要的和充分的临床配置。

name: Manuel Galvan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how unequal social contexts shape psychology and behavior, exacerbating economic and racial disparities, using distributional approaches and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究不平等的社会环境如何塑造心理和行为，加剧经济和种族不平等，采用分布性方法和干预措施。

name: Allison Harvey
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Develops treatments for mental illness, focusing on behavior change and transdiagnostic processes, particularly sleep disorders.
summary_zh: 开发治疗精神疾病的方法，重点关注行为改变和跨诊断过程，特别是睡眠障碍。

name: Stephen Hinshaw
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the development and long-term outcomes of ADHD in girls and women, focusing on stigma, self-harm, and neurocognitive vulnerabilities.
summary_zh: 研究女孩和女性注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的发展和长期结果，重点关注污名、自伤和神经认知脆弱性。

name: Richard Ivry
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how people select, plan, and produce movement, using behavioral studies, TMS, fMRI, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何选择、计划和产生运动，使用行为研究、TMS、fMRI 和计算建模方法。

name: Oliver P. John
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies self-concept and self-perception accuracy, examining how individuals understand themselves and others across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究自我概念和自我感知准确性，探讨个体如何在一生中理解自己和他人。

name: Sheri Johnson
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms and outcomes of emotion-related impulsivity in bipolar disorder, using fMRI, behavioral, and self-report measures.
summary_zh: 研究双相障碍中情绪相关冲动的机制和结果，使用功能性磁共振成像、行为和自我报告测量方法。

name: Keanan Joyner
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the etiology of addiction and the representation of Black individuals in psychophysiological research, using EEG/ERPs and EMA.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾的起因以及黑人在生理心理研究中的代表性问题，使用EEG/ERPs和EMA方法。

name: Dacher Keltner
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the social functions of emotion, including the roles of embarrassment, love, and awe in social interactions, and how individual differences in positive emotions affect relationships and.
summary_zh: 研究情绪的社会功能，包括尴尬、爱和敬畏在社会互动中的作用，以及积极情绪差异如何影响人际关系和幸福感。

name: Celeste Kidd
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn and explore using computational models and behavioral experiments, focusing on attention and curiosity in infancy and childhood.
summary_zh: 研究儿童学习和探索的过程，使用计算模型和行为实验，重点关注婴儿期和儿童期的注意力和好奇心。

name: Hedy Kober
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural and psychological mechanisms of craving regulation in substance use and eating disorders, using mindfulness and cognitive strategies.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾和进食障碍中渴望调节的神经和心理机制，使用正念和认知策略。

name: Lance Kriegsfeld
title: Professor
summary: Studies the genetic, cellular, and hormonal mechanisms of circadian rhythms and their impact on motivated behaviors and physiology.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律的遗传、细胞和激素机制及其对动机行为和生理功能的影响。

name: Iris Mauss
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotions and emotion regulation, linking them to health using various measures and approaches.
summary_zh: 研究情绪及其调节与健康的关系，使用多种测量和方法。

name: R. Mendoza-Denton
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social and cultural factors influence intergroup relations, stigma, and prejudice.
summary_zh: 研究社会和文化因素如何影响群体关系、污名和偏见。

name: Daniel DongWon Oh
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social cognition and perception, focusing on individual differences, stereotypes, and cultural influences.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知和知觉，关注个体差异、刻板印象和文化影响。

name: Steven Piantadosi
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development, focusing on how children learn and process information.
summary_zh: 研究认知发展，关注儿童如何学习和处理信息。

name: Giovanni Ramos
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies risk and resilience factors for Latinx mental health, adapting evidence-based treatments, and developing digital interventions.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔人群的心理健康风险和韧性因素，改进基于证据的治疗方法，并开发数字干预措施。

name: Amitai Shenhav
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural and computational mechanisms of motivation, affect, decision-making, and cognitive control using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究动机、情感、决策和认知控制的神经和计算机制，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Mahesh Srinivasan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: William Thompson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the social foundations of human intelligence, including language and creative thinking, using behavioral experiments and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类智能的社会基础，包括语言和创造性思维，使用行为实验和计算建模方法。

name: Kevin Weiner
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the structural-functional relationships in the brain, particularly in the fusiform gyrus, using various imaging techniques in both living and post-mortem individuals.
summary_zh: 研究大脑结构与功能的关系，特别是在 Fusiform 窦，使用多种成像技术在活体和死后个体中进行分析。

name: David Whitney
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual perception and attention, focusing on how these processes guide actions, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，关注这些过程如何指导行动，使用认知神经科学方法。

name: Linda Wilbrecht
title: Professor
summary: Studies how experience shapes brain circuits involved in decision making and addiction, using behavioral and systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究经验如何塑造与决策和成瘾相关的脑回路，采用行为和系统神经科学方法。

name: Fei Xu
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and language development in infants, focusing on word learning and social cognition.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知和语言发展，重点关注词汇学习和社会认知。

name: Qing Zhou
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of behavioral problems and competence in children and adolescents, focusing on temperament, emotion regulation, parenting, and cultural context.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年行为问题和能力的发展，重点关注气质、情绪调节、养育方式和文化背景。

name: Hillel Adesnik
title: Professor, Pivotal Life Sciences Chancellor's Chair in Neuroscience
areas: Pivotal Life Sciences Chancellor's Chair in Neuroscience
summary: Studies the plasticity, connectivity, and dynamics of neural networks.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络的可塑性、连接性和动态变化。

name: Gopala Anumanchipalli
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops speech technologies to assist people with disordered speech, using automated methods for diagnosis and rehabilitation.
summary_zh: 开发语音技术以辅助言语障碍患者，使用自动化方法进行诊断和康复。

name: Helen Bateup
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the molecular basis of synapse and circuit changes in epilepsy and autism.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫和自闭症中突触和神经回路变化的分子基础。

name: Annaliese Beery
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms supporting social bonding between peers and the neuroendocrinology of complex behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究同伴之间社会纽带的机制及其复杂行为的神经内分泌学。

name: Yang Dan
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits controlling sleep and mechanisms of executive control, using circuit-level approaches.
summary_zh: 研究控制睡眠的神经回路和执行控制的机制，采用电路级的方法。

name: Michael DeWeese
title: Professor, Co-director of the Redwood Center for Theoretical Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of auditory processing and selective attention in the cerebral cortex and artificial neural networks.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层中的听觉处理和选择性注意的神经机制以及人工神经网络。

name: David Feinberg
title: Professor
summary: Develops MRI technology to map visual circuitry and neurovascular coupling.
summary_zh: 开发MRI技术以映射视觉电路和神经血管耦合。

name: Daniel Feldman
title: Professor, Coates Family Endowed Chair in Neuroscience
areas: Coates Family Endowed Chair in Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sensory processing and plasticity occur in the somatosensory cortex.
summary_zh: 研究感觉处理和皮层可塑性在体感皮层中的发生机制。

name: Marla Feller
title: Professor, Director of the Neuroscience PhD Program
summary: Studies the functional development and organization of neural circuits in the retina.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经回路的功能发育和组织.

name: Yvette Fisher
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Flexibility of neural circuits for spatial navigation
Flexibility of neural circuits for spatial navigation
summary: Studies how neural circuits adapt during spatial navigation, using flexible cognitive strategies.
summary_zh: 研究空间导航过程中神经电路的适应性，使用灵活的认知策略。

name: David Foster
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neural ensembles in the hippocampus encode spatial memory and navigation toward rewards.
summary_zh: 研究海马神经群体如何编码空间记忆和导航至奖励的过程。

name: Jack Gallant
title: Professor, Co-director of the Brain Imaging Center
summary: Studies how the brain represents information about the world and its own mental states using brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用脑成像技术研究大脑如何表示世界信息及其自身心理状态。

name: Liberty Hamilton
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of speech and language processing in the developing brain using statistical methods.
summary_zh: 使用统计方法研究发育中大脑的语音和语言处理的神经机制。

name: Ming Hsu
title: Professor
summary: Studies consumer behavior and decision-making using brain imaging techniques, integrating economics and marketing.
summary_zh: 使用脑成像技术研究消费者行为和决策，结合经济学和营销学。

name: Alexander Huth
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language and meaning are processed in the brain using computational models.
summary_zh: 研究语言和意义在大脑中的处理过程，使用计算模型方法。

name: Ehud Isacoff
title: Professor, Evan Rauch Chair in Neuroscience, Director of HWNI, Co-director of The Weill Neurohub
summary: Studies the function of ion channels, synapse development, plasticity, and neural circuit function.
summary_zh: 研究离子通道功能、突触发育、可塑性和神经环路功能。

name: William Jagust
title: Professor
areas: and neurochemical bases of brain aging and dementia
summary: Studies the anatomic, biochemical, and neurochemical bases of brain aging and dementia.
summary_zh: 研究大脑衰老和痴呆的解剖学、生物化学和神经化学基础。

name: Na Ji
title: Professor
areas: Novel imaging methods to understand the brain
summary: Develops novel imaging methods to understand brain function.
summary_zh: 开发新型成像方法以理解大脑功能。

name: YoungJu Jo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops and applies neurotechnologies to measure and control neural dynamics in behaving animals, combining systems and computational neuroscience with optical and genetic engineering.
summary_zh: 开发和应用神经技术来测量和控制行为动物的神经动力学，结合系统和计算神经科学与光学和基因工程。

name: Preeya Khanna
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of dexterous motor skills and develops neurotechnology to restore and rehabilitate movement.
summary_zh: 研究灵巧运动技能的神经基础，并开发神经技术以恢复和康复运动功能。

name: Bob Knight
title: Professor of the Graduate School
summary: Studies neural coding for goal-directed behavior and develops brain-machine interfaces for motor and language prostheses.
summary_zh: 研究目标导向行为的神经编码并开发用于运动和语言假体的脑机接口。

name: Stephan Lammel
title: Professor
summary: Studies midbrain dopamine circuits in reward-based behaviors and pathological changes in addiction, depression, and schizophrenia.
summary_zh: 研究中脑多巴胺电路在奖励行为中的作用及其在成瘾、抑郁和精神分裂症中的病理变化。

name: Lexin Li
title: Professor
summary: Analyzes brain connectivity and imaging data using statistical methods and regression techniques.
summary_zh: 使用统计方法和回归技术分析脑连接性和成像数据。

name: Chunlei Liu
title: Professor, Co-director of the Brain Imaging Center
areas: Co-director of the Brain Imaging Center
summary: Develops MRI technology to study neural circuits and modulation.
summary_zh: 开发MRI技术研究神经回路和调控。

name: Bruno Olshausen
title: Professor
summary: Develops computational models to understand sensory coding and visual perception.
summary_zh: 开发计算模型来理解感觉编码和视觉知觉。

name: Michael Silver
title: Professor, Director of the UC Berkeley Center for the Science of Psychedelics
summary: Studies the neurophysiological and neurochemical bases of visual perception, attention, and learning using advanced neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、注意力和学习的神经生理和神经化学基础，采用先进的神经科学技术。

name: Sergey Stavisky
title: Associate Professor, starting Jan 2027
summary: Studies the neurobiology of speech and language.
summary_zh: 研究语言和言语的神经生物学。

name: Mark Tanouye
title: Professor
summary: Studies the genetic causes of epilepsy and other nervous system disorders using novel genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 使用新颖的遗传方法研究癫痫和其他神经系统疾病的遗传原因。

name: Rowland Taylor
title: Professor
summary: Studies the structure and function of neural circuits in the retina.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经回路的结构和功能。

name: Frédéric Theunissen
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sounds, using auditory perception experiments.
summary_zh: 研究复杂声音的听觉处理机制，使用听觉感知实验方法。

name: Doris Tsao
title: Professor, Pivotal Life Sciences Faculty Scholar
summary: Studies how the brain constructs a model of the visual world.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何构建视觉世界的模型。

name: Joni Wallis
title: Professor
summary: Studies neuronal mechanisms underlying high-level cognitive and behavioral processes.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知和行为过程的神经机制。

name: Michael Ward
title: Professor
summary: Studies age-related neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, using molecular and cellular approaches.
summary_zh: 研究与年龄相关的神经退行性疾病，包括阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病，采用分子和细胞方法。

name: Michael Yartsev
title: Professor
areas: Neural basis of complex spatial and acoustic behaviors
summary: Studies the neural basis of complex spatial and acoustic behaviors in animals.
summary_zh: 研究复杂空间和声学行为的神经基础。

name: Jacob Yates
title: Assistant Professor, Co-director of the Redwood Center for Theoretical Neuroscience
summary: Studies how populations of neurons in cortex encode visual information, using statistical models and machine learning to understand neural activity and human perception.
summary_zh: 研究皮层神经元群体如何编码视觉信息，使用统计模型和机器学习来理解神经活动和人类知觉。

name: Paul R. Abramson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention in infants using eye-tracking methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的视觉感知和注意力，使用眼动追踪方法。

name: Howard S. Adelman
title: Professor
summary: Studies policies and practices for addressing barriers to students' learning, focusing on system variables and intrinsic motivation.
summary_zh: 研究解决学生学习障碍的政策和实践，重点关注系统变量和内在动机。

name: Avi Adhikari
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling fear and food-seeking in mice using optogenetics, calcium imaging, and behavioral assays.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠恐惧和觅食行为的神经回路，使用光遗传学、钙成像和行为测试技术。

name: Amber Ankowski
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习词汇，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Carrie Bearden
title: Professor
summary: Studies early risk factors for developmental neuropsychiatric disorders, focusing on intermediate neurobehavioral traits and rare genetic disorders like 22q11.2 Deletion Syndrome.
summary_zh: 研究发育神经精神障碍的早期风险因素，重点关注中间神经行为特征和罕见的遗传疾病，如22q11.2缺失综合征。

name: Jackson Beatty
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the large-scale structure of functional cortical cognitive circuits using neuroinformatic methods and computational models of competitive learning networks.
summary_zh: 使用神经信息学方法和竞争学习网络的计算模型研究功能性皮层认知回路的大规模结构。

name: Peter M. Bentler
title: Faculty
summary: Studies personality, drug abuse, psychometrics, and causal modeling using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究人格、药物滥用、心理测量学以及因果建模的理论、方法和应用。

name: James Bisley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of visual attention and memory, using behavioral tasks and neurophysiological techniques with animals.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和记忆的神经机制，使用动物的行为任务和神经生理技术。

name: H. Tad Blair
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neural oscillators encode information and how learning alters neural activity to form memories in rats.
summary_zh: 研究神经振荡如何编码信息以及学习如何改变神经活动形成记忆的小鼠行为。

name: Aaron P. Blaisdell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how animals build and use representations of their world through conditioning and problem-solving tasks, focusing on causal inferences and rational behavior in rats and pigeons.
summary_zh: 研究动物如何通过条件反射和解决问题任务构建和使用其世界的表征，重点关注老鼠和鸽子的因果推理和理性行为。

name: Idan Blank
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how we understand language, using neuroimaging and computational methods to explore the mental structures and processes involved in comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解的认知神经机制，使用神经成像和计算方法探讨理解语言时的心理结构和过程。

name: Erie Boorman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain forms cognitive maps and uses them to make decisions and inferences, employing computational, behavioral, neuroimaging, and neurophysiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成认知地图并利用它们进行决策和推理，采用计算、行为、神经成像和神经生理学技术。

name: Julienne Bower
title: Professor
summary: Studies how positive psychological factors influence physical health in individuals with life-threatening illnesses, focusing on immune and neuroendocrine pathways.
summary_zh: 研究积极的心理因素如何影响患有致命疾病的个体的生理健康，重点关注免疫和神经内分泌途径。

name: Li Cai
title: Faculty
summary: Develops statistical methods for item factor analysis and structural equation modeling.
summary_zh: 开发项目因数分析和结构方程模型的统计方法。

name: Bridget Callaghan
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how early life experiences influence interactions between physical and mental health across the lifespan, using fMRI, microbiome, and physiology.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活经历如何影响身心健康的相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像、微生物组和生理学方法。

name: Alan Castel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory changes across the adult lifespan, focusing on selective memory and attentional processes.
summary_zh: 研究成年期记忆的变化，重点在于选择性记忆和注意过程。

name: Jaime Castrellon
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how neural and behavioral factors influence motivation and decision-making, particularly in social and non-social contexts, using fMRI, PET, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究神经和行为因素如何影响动机和决策，特别是在社交和非社交情境中，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、正电子发射断层扫描（PET）和计算模型。

name: Patricia Cheng
title: Professor
summary: Studies how humans form causal and empirical categories through cognitive experiments on adults and preschoolers, focusing on rationality and existential threats.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过认知实验形成因果和经验类别，重点关注理性与人类存在的威胁。

name: David Clewett
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how physiological arousal influences memory formation and retrieval, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究生理唤醒如何影响记忆的形成与检索，采用神经成像和行为学方法。

name: Michelle Craske
title: Faculty
summary: Studies anxiety disorders and their treatments, focusing on cognitive and behavioral therapies.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍及其治疗方法，侧重于认知和行为疗法。

name: Han Du
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and applies Bayesian methods and statistical techniques in developmental, clinical, cognitive, educational, and health research.
summary_zh: 开发和应用贝叶斯方法和统计技术于发展、临床、认知、教育和健康研究。

name: Naomi Eisenberger
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of social rejection and connection, using neuroimaging techniques to understand how social relationships impact emotional and physical well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社会排斥和连接的神经基础，使用神经成像技术理解社会关系如何影响情绪和身体健康。

name: Craig Enders
title: Professor
summary: Develops methods for handling missing data in multilevel models, particularly using Bayesian estimation and multiple imputation.
summary_zh: 开发处理多级模型中缺失数据的方法，特别是使用贝叶斯估计和多重插补。

name: Chris Evans
title: Professor-in-Residence
summary: Studies the molecular, cellular, and behavioral effects of opioid drugs, focusing on striatal function and reward circuitry modulation.
summary_zh: 研究阿片类药物的分子、细胞和行为效应，重点关注纹状体功能和奖赏电路的调节。

name: Michael Fanselow
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the nature and function of fear, focusing on forebrain regions and neurotransmitter systems using pharmacological manipulations and genetic modifications in rats and mice.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧的本质和功能，集中在前脑区域和神经递质系统，使用药理学操纵和基因修改在大鼠和小鼠中进行。

name: Yi Feng
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops advanced quantitative methods, particularly structural equation modeling, for psychology and education research.
summary_zh: 开发高级量化方法，特别是结构方程模型，应用于心理学和教育研究。

name: Iris Firstenberg
title: Faculty
summary: Studies creativity and innovation in organizations, problem solving, and decision making.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的创造力和创新、问题解决和决策制定。

name: Craig Fox
title: Professor
summary: Studies judgment and decision making under risk and uncertainty, using surveys, experiments, and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究风险和不确定性下的判断与决策，使用调查、实验和脑成像方法。

name: Andrew Frane
title: Faculty
summary: Studies musical and auditory perception, using statistical methodology.
summary_zh: 研究音乐和听觉感知，采用统计方法。

name: Andrew J. Fuligni
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how sociocultural experiences and biobehavioral factors influence adolescents' prosocial behavior and sleep patterns.
summary_zh: 研究社会文化经验与生物行为因素如何影响青少年的亲社会行为和睡眠模式。

name: Adriana Galván
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using publications classified by the National Library of Medicine.
summary_zh: 使用美国国家医学图书馆分类的出版物研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

name: Bonnie Goff
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiological impacts of early adverse experiences on socio-emotional development, using insights into future mental health outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究早期不良经历对社会情绪发展的影响及其神经生物学机制，以预测未来的精神健康结果。

name: Noah Goldstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social norms influence behavior, using persuasion and conformity experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会规范如何影响行为，使用说服和从众实验。

name: Shulamite Green
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neurobiological and physiological mechanisms of sensory processing difficulties in high-risk developmental populations, including autism and anxiety disorders, using neuroimaging and.
summary_zh: 研究高风险发展群体（包括自闭症和焦虑障碍）的感觉处理困难的神经生物学和生理学机制，使用神经成像和行为方法。

name: Patricia M. Greenfield
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the impact of social change, cultural evolution, and communication technologies on human development, particularly among immigrant and first-generation college students.
summary_zh: 研究社会变迁、文化进化和通讯技术对人类发展的影响，特别是移民和第一代大学生。

name: Carlos V. Grijalva
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychobiology of stress, behavior, and bodily diseases in animal models, focusing on brain and behavioral mechanisms of feeding and gastrointestinal functions.
summary_zh: 研究应激、行为和身体疾病的心理生物学机制，特别是在动物模型中的进食和消化功能的脑和行为机制。

name: William Grisham
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of behavior in modular digital courseware for undergraduate neuroscience education.
summary_zh: 研究行为的神经机制，并开发模块化数字课程ware以用于本科神经科学教育。

name: Constance Hammen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how stress affects mental health, using longitudinal studies and daily diaries.
summary_zh: 研究压力对心理健康的影响，使用纵向研究和日常日记的方法。

name: Jesse Harris
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how different sources of information are integrated during sentence processing, using real-time response methods and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究不同信息来源在句子处理中的整合，使用实时反应方法和眼动追踪技术。

name: Martie Haselton
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive biases in communication, intimate relationships, and the effects of reproductive hormones on human behavior.
summary_zh: 研究沟通中的认知偏差、亲密关系以及生殖激素对人类行为的影响。

name: Hal Hershfield
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people consider their future selves and how this impacts financial and well-being decisions.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何考虑未来自我以及这种考虑如何影响财务和幸福感决策。

name: Tiffany Ho
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how brain circuits underlying thoughts, emotions, and behaviors change during adolescent development, focusing on stress and depression.
summary_zh: 研究青少年时期大脑电路如何随思维、情感和行为的变化而变化，重点关注压力和抑郁症。

name: Eric W. Holman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how statistical properties of classifications reflect psychological processes and the nature of classified items.
summary_zh: 研究分类的统计特性如何反映分类者的心理过程以及分类对象的性质。

name: Keith Holyoak
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how analogy and relational knowledge influence reasoning, learning, and decision-making using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究类比和关系知识如何影响推理、学习和决策，并使用计算建模和神经成像进行研究。

name: Yuen J. Huo
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how social identity needs and experiences with fairness affect social interactions and intergroup cooperation, particularly in diverse communities.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份需求和公平体验如何影响社交互动和跨群体合作，特别是在多元化社区中。

name: Alicia Izquierdo
title: Professor
summary: Studies the brain mechanisms of flexible reinforcement learning and value-based decisions using behavioral, molecular, pharmacological, computational, and in vivo imaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究灵活的强化学习和基于价值的决策的脑机制，使用行为学、分子生物学、药理学、计算建模和体内成像方法。

name: Kerri Johnson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people perceive and categorize others based on physical appearance, using various methods including experiments with children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何根据外貌对他人进行分类和感知，使用包括儿童和成人实验在内的多种方法。

name: Scott Johnson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive and perceptual development, using computational modeling and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知和知觉发展，使用计算建模和神经生理学方法。

name: Katherine H. Karlsgodt
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive changes in neuropsychiatric disorders using fMRI, DTI, and behavioral testing in humans and animal models.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)、扩散张量成像(DTI)和行为测试研究神经精神障碍中的认知变化，涉及人类和动物模型。

name: Benjamin Karney
title: Professor
summary: Studies how external stress affects relationship maintenance in newlywed couples, using longitudinal data and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究外部压力如何影响新婚夫妇关系的维持，使用纵向数据和观察方法。

name: Phil Kellman
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how visual perception of objects, contours, and shapes works, using deep networks and perceptual learning.
summary_zh: 研究视觉对象、轮廓和形状的感知机制，使用深度网络和知觉学习方法。

name: Barbara Knowlton
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of memory using neuroimaging and neuropsychological testing.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的神经基础，使用神经成像和神经心理学测试方法。

name: Ian Krajbich
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people make decisions by evaluating options over time, using choice-process measures like response times and eye tracking.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过时间评估选项来做决策，使用反应时间、眼动追踪等选择过程指标。

name: Franklin B. Krasne
title: Faculty
summary: Studies invertebrate neurophysiology, focusing on physiological psychology.
summary_zh: 研究无脊椎动物神经生理学，侧重于生理心理学。

name: Jaimie Arona Krems
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how humans form and maintain friendships, addressing challenges like finding and keeping friends, and how women navigate social relationships.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何建立和维持友谊，探讨寻找和保持朋友时面临的挑战，以及女性如何在社交关系中导航。

name: Anna S. Lau
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how infants learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Stephanie Leal
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how memory works and how it is affected in disorders like Alzheimer’s disease and depression, using imaging techniques and cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的工作机制及其在阿尔茨海默病和抑郁症等疾病中的异常，使用成像技术和认知任务。

name: Steve S. Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies the origins, development, and outcomes of ADHD and disruptive behavior disorders in children, focusing on risk factors, causal mechanisms, and sex differences.
summary_zh: 研究注意力缺陷多动障碍和破坏性行为障碍的起源、发展和结果，重点关注风险因素、因果机制和性别差异。

name: Matthew Lieberman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of social interactions and consciousness using fNIRS, focusing on friendship, ideological conflict, and team performance.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动和意识的神经基础，使用功能性近红外光谱成像技术（fNIRS），关注友谊、意识形态冲突和团队表现。

name: Falk Lieder
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies moral learning and decision-making using computational modeling and experiments, aiming to improve societal decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究道德学习和决策制定，使用计算建模和实验方法，旨在改善社会决策。

name: Zili Liu
title: Professor
summary: Studies how our perceptual representation of the world differs from reality, focusing on 3D motion and shape perception, perceptual learning, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究我们对世界的知觉表征与现实之间的差异，重点关注三维运动和形状知觉、知觉学习和计算建模。

name: Hongjing Lu
title: Professor
summary: Studies how humans learn and reason, focusing on action recognition, object recognition, causal reasoning, and analogical reasoning.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习和推理的方式，重点关注动作识别、物体识别、因果推理和类比推理。

name: Vickie M. Mays
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies mental and physical health disparities among racial and ethnic minority populations, focusing on discrimination, HIV/AIDS, and mental health services.
summary_zh: 研究种族和 Ethnic 少数群体的心理和身体健康差异，重点关注歧视、艾滋病和心理健康服务。

name: Sean McAuliffe
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention using eye-tracking methods with adults.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用眼动追踪方法与成人。

name: Martin M. Monti
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between language and thought, and consciousness in patients with severe brain injuries, using fMRI and behavioral tools.
summary_zh: 研究语言与思维之间的关系以及严重脑损伤患者的意识状态，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和行为工具。

name: Amanda Kay Montoya
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods and tools to improve research practices in psychology, focusing on mediation, moderation, and structural equation modeling.
summary_zh: 开发统计方法和工具以改善心理学研究实践，重点关注中介、调节和结构方程建模。

name: Virginia Sklar Muscatello
title: Faculty
summary: Studies educational practices and research methods to support equitable and evidence-based teaching and learning in psychology.
summary_zh: 研究教育实践和研究方法，以支持心理学中的公平和基于证据的教学和学习。

name: Carolyn Murray
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes in infants using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知过程，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Lauren C. Ng
title: Faculty
summary: Develops and implements evidence-based interventions for underserved communities affected by trauma, focusing on posttraumatic stress disorder in Rwanda and Ethiopia.
summary_zh: 开发和实施针对受创伤影响的边缘化社区的基于证据的干预措施，重点关注卢旺达和埃塞俄比亚的创伤后应激障碍。

name: Carolyn Parkinson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human brain represents and navigates social networks and the cognitive and behavioral consequences of social network structure.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何表示和导航社交网络及其结构对认知和行为的影响。

name: Letitia Anne Peplau
title: Faculty
summary: Studies close relationships, gender issues, and gay and lesbian relationships and identity.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系、性别问题以及同性恋和双性恋关系和身份。

name: Efrén Pérez
title: Professor
summary: Studies the influence of language on political thinking and attitudes, using implicit cognition measures and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究语言对政治思维和态度的影响，使用隐性认知测量和调查方法。

name: Lara Ray
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of risk and treatment response for substance use disorders, integrating clinical psychology, pharmacology, and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究物质使用障碍的风险机制和治疗反应，结合临床心理学、药理学和神经科学的方法。

name: Dario Ringach
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual psychophysics and electrophysiology to understand how the brain processes visual information.
summary_zh: 研究视觉心理物理学和电生理学，以了解大脑如何处理视觉信息。

name: Jesse Rissman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how goal-directed attentional control processes modulate memory formation, maintenance, and retrieval using fMRI and virtual reality.
summary_zh: 研究目标定向注意力控制过程如何调节记忆的形成、维持和检索，使用功能性磁共振成像和虚拟现实技术。

name: Maureen Ritchey
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the hippocampus interacts with cortical networks to support memory reconstruction, using functional MRI, brain stimulation, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究海马与皮层网络如何协作支持记忆重构，使用功能性磁共振成像、脑刺激和计算建模方法。

name: Theodore Robles
title: Professor
summary: Studies how stress and social relationships affect health through allostatic and restorative processes, using experimental and non-experimental designs.
summary_zh: 研究压力和社会关系如何通过 allostatic 和 restorative 过程影响健康，使用实验和非实验设计。

name: Catherine M. Sandhofer
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words, categories, and concepts, examining the role of the learning environment.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习词汇、类别和概念，探讨学习环境的作用。

name: Ajay Satpute
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychological and neural mechanisms of social and emotional experiences, using brain imaging and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究社会和情感体验的心理和神经机制，使用脑成像和机器学习方法。

name: Tara Scanlan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention in infants using eye-tracking methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的视觉感知和注意力，使用眼动追踪方法。

name: Christine Dunkel Schetter
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how stress affects pregnancy and infant development, using longitudinal studies and animal models.
summary_zh: 研究应激对妊娠和婴儿发展的影响，使用纵向研究和动物模型。

name: Ladan Shams
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention using psychophysical methods and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用心理物理学方法和眼动追踪技术。

name: Margaret Shih
