title: Faculty
summary: Investigates cortical circuit dysfunction in neurological disorders, particularly Parkinson disease.
summary_zh: 研究神经疾病中的皮层电路功能障碍，尤其是帕金森病。

name: Jie J. Zheng
title: Faculty
summary: Studies molecular and genetic mechanisms of cognitive functions, using NIH-funded research.
summary_zh: 研究认知功能的分子和遗传机制，使用NIH资助的研究。

name: Larry S. Zipursky
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, focusing on molecular and cellular processes.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，侧重于分子和细胞过程。

name: Aron Barbey
title: Andrew J. McKenna Family Professor
summary: Studies how intelligence emerges from brain network organization, using cognitive neuroscience, experimental psychology, and computer science methods.
summary_zh: 研究智力如何源自大脑网络组织，采用认知神经科学、实验心理学和计算机科学方法。

name: Ryan Carpenter
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies substance use and co-use in natural environments using ecological momentary assessment (EMA) and mobile health interventions.
summary_zh: 研究自然环境中物质使用和共用现象，使用生态时刻评估（EMA）和移动健康干预措施。

name: Caitlin Clements
title: Mary Hesburgh Flaherty and James F. Flaherty Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of reward processing in neurotypical and neurodivergent infants and children using EEG and eye-tracking, and investigates genetic mechanisms underlying autism.
summary_zh: 研究典型和神经多样性儿童的奖励处理神经机制，使用EEG和眼动追踪技术，并探讨与自闭症相关的遗传机制。

name: E. Mark Cummings
title: William J. Shaw Family Professor
summary: Studies the impact of family conflict on children's development, focusing on emotional security theory and prevention programs.
summary_zh: 研究家庭冲突对儿童发展的影响，侧重于情感安全理论和预防项目。

name: Jingnan Du
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the organization of large-scale human brain networks and their roles in cognitive functions like language processing and social inference, using neuroimaging and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑网络的组织及其在认知功能如语言处理和社会推理中的作用，使用神经成像和计算方法。

name: Kathleen Eberhard
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how bilingual individuals coordinate understanding during spoken language interaction, using eye-tracking technology.
summary_zh: 研究双语者在口语交流中如何协调理解，使用眼动追踪技术。

name: Haya Fatimah
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies complex dynamics in psychopathology, especially borderline personality and comorbid disorders, using dynamical systems and network models.
summary_zh: 研究边缘人格障碍及其共病障碍的复杂动态，使用动力系统和网络模型。

name: Tess Forest
title: Assistant Professor (Incoming, Jan. 2027)
summary: Studies how brain development shapes learning and how attention and memory co-develop in early life, using eye-tracking and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发展如何塑造学习以及注意力和记忆在早期生活中的共同发育，使用眼动追踪和神经成像技术。

name: Alexis Georgeson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates novel scoring methods for measuring psychological constructs, focusing on statistical mediation in intervention research.
summary_zh: 开发和评估用于测量心理构念的新评分方法，特别是在干预研究中的统计中介分析。

name: Bradley Gibson
title: Professor
summary: Studies perception of the body and external world, memory for time and space, and attention in typical and ADHD populations.
summary_zh: 研究身体和外部世界的感知、时间和空间的记忆以及典型和ADHD人群中的注意力。

name: Dawn Gondoli
title: Professor
summary: Studies adolescent development, particularly parenting, mother and adolescent well-being, body image, and disordered eating.
summary_zh: 研究青少年发展，特别是亲子关系、母亲与青少年的福祉、体型形象和饮食障碍。

name: Oscar Gonzalez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how psychological measurement affects causal models and prediction models, using statistical and machine learning methods.
summary_zh: 研究心理测量如何影响因果模型和预测模型，使用统计和机器学习方法。

name: Gerald Haeffel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and products that contribute to risk and resilience to depression, focusing on cognitive vulnerability.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和产物如何影响抑郁的风险和韧性，重点关注认知脆弱性。

name: Kaylin Hill
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychophysiology of affect across the lifespan using EEG to understand the development of depression.
summary_zh: 研究情绪生理学在生命周期中的变化，使用脑电图（EEG）理解抑郁的发展。

name: Cheng Liu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops statistical models and computational tools for educational and psychological research, applying machine learning and cognitive diagnosis modeling.
summary_zh: 开发统计模型和计算工具，应用于教育和心理研究，特别是机器学习和认知诊断建模。

name: Nicole McNeil
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children think, learn, and solve mathematical problems, focusing on numerical representation and symbolic reasoning.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在数学思考、学习和解决问题方面的认知发展，重点关注数值表示和符号推理。

name: Laura Miller-Graff
title: Professor
summary: Studies the developmental and intergenerational effects of violence on children and families, focusing on resilience and psychological interventions.
summary_zh: 研究暴力对儿童和家庭的代际影响，关注韧性及心理干预。

name: Jenny Padilla
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies Latinx family relationships, sibling dynamics, and cultural values affecting adolescent and young adult psychological adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔家庭关系、兄弟姐妹动态和文化价值观对青少年和年轻成人心理适应的影响。

name: Jessica Payne
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sleep and stress affect memory consolidation, emotion, and creativity.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和压力如何影响记忆巩固、情绪和创造力。

name: G. A. Radvansky
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory and comprehension work in understanding and remembering events, with a focus on how memories change over time.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和理解在事件理解和记忆中的作用，特别是记忆随时间的变化。

name: Matthew Robison
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies attention control and memory interactions using behavioral experiments, individual-differences designs, and psychophysiological tools like eye-tracking and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究注意力控制和记忆交互作用，使用行为实验、个体差异设计和眼动追踪、瞳孔直径变化和脑电图等生理心理工具。

name: Elizabeth Shewark
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how contextual influences and genetic factors jointly impact the development of youths' social, emotional, and academic competence.
summary_zh: 研究家庭、学校和社区环境以及遗传因素如何共同影响青少年的社会、情绪和学业能力的发展。

name: Kristin Valentino
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of adversity on child development, focusing on caregiving behaviors and interventions to improve outcomes for maltreated children.
summary_zh: 研究逆境对儿童发展的影响，重点关注养育行为和干预措施，以改善虐待儿童的发展结果。

name: Ivan Vargas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the biological, behavioral, and cognitive pathways linking insomnia to mental health disorders, particularly depression, and evaluates scalable treatment models.
summary_zh: 研究失眠与心理健康障碍（尤其是抑郁症）之间的生物、行为和认知路径，并评估可扩展的治疗方法。

name: Sophia Vinci-Booher
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how action and perception interplay affects learning, particularly in early childhood literacy, using MRI and behavioral assessments.
summary_zh: 研究动作与感知的交互作用如何影响学习，特别是在儿童早期读写能力的发展，使用MRI和行为评估方法。

name: Lijuan Wang
title: Professor
summary: Develops methods for analyzing intensive longitudinal data, mediation, and moderation in clinical, developmental, education, family, and health research.
summary_zh: 开发用于临床、发展、教育、家庭和健康研究的密集纵向数据分析、中介和调节方法。

name: Ke-Hai Yuan
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods for analyzing real-world data, including robust methods and missing data analysis.
summary_zh: 开发用于分析实际数据的统计方法，包括稳健方法和缺失数据分析。

name: Guangjian Zhang
title: Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates new research methods in psychometrics and dynamic analysis, focusing on factor analysis and structural equation modeling.
summary_zh: 开发和评估心理测量和动态分析的新研究方法，重点是因子分析和结构方程建模。

name: Zhiyong Zhang
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods and software for education, health, management, and psychology, focusing on Bayesian methods and big data analysis.
summary_zh: 开发教育、健康、管理和心理学领域的统计方法和软件，重点是贝叶斯方法和大数据分析。

name: Patricia J. Bauer
title: Asa Griggs Candler Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how memory develops from infancy to college, focusing on semantic knowledge and its use.
summary_zh: 研究从婴儿期到大学阶段记忆的发展，重点关注语义知识及其应用。

name: Gregory S. Berns
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies canine cognitive function using awake fMRI and maps white matter pathways in various mammals.
summary_zh: 使用清醒态功能性磁共振成像研究犬的认知功能，并绘制不同哺乳动物的白质通路。

name: Patricia A. Brennan
title: Samuel Candler Dobbs Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies maternal stress and its effects on infant and child neurodevelopment, using epigenetics and brain function.
summary_zh: 研究母体压力对婴儿和儿童神经发展的影响，使用表观遗传学和脑功能等方法。

name: Vanessa M. Brown
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies reinforcement learning and decision-making in anxiety disorders, using computational modeling and neuroimaging to understand treatment mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍中的强化学习和决策机制，使用计算建模和神经成像来理解治疗机制。

name: Yuk Fai Cheong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the validation of measures for violence, patterns of women's exposure to violence, and the impact of executive orders on femicide using multilevel modeling.
summary_zh: 使用多层次建模研究暴力测量的有效性、女性暴力暴露模式以及州级行政命令对女性谋杀率的影响。

name: Daniel D. Dilks
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the functional organization of human visual cortex and how it develops and changes in adults, using fMRI, psychophysics, and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉皮层的功能组织及其在儿童和成人中的发展和变化，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、心理物理学和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。

name: David Edwards
title: Charles Howard Candler Professor of Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies hormonal correlates of competition and performance in athletes, using field and laboratory studies.
summary_zh: 研究运动员在竞争和表现中的激素相关因素，采用实地和实验室研究方法。

name: Michael Hallquist
title: Professor
summary: Studies how learning, decision-making, and emotion shape personality and psychopathology using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究学习、决策和情绪如何塑造人格和精神障碍，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Stephan Hamann
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural correlates of emotional memory and the effects of emotion on memory using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究情绪记忆的神经机制及其对记忆的影响，使用神经成像技术。

name: Robert Hampton
title: Director of Graduate Studies and Samuel Candler Dobbs Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies memory and metacognition in nonhuman primates and birds using computerized tests.
summary_zh: 研究非人灵长类动物和鸟类的记忆和元认知，使用计算机测试。

name: Peter Hitchcock
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decision-making processes in depression and anxiety using computational models and behavioral tasks, developing self-guided treatments.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁症和焦虑症中的决策过程，使用计算模型和行为任务，开发自助治疗方法。

name: Aubrey Kelly
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of social behavior across various species, including finches, voles, and mice, using behavioral ecology and neuroendocrinology.
summary_zh: 研究不同物种（如金丝雀、原田鼠和非洲棘鼠）的社会行为的神经机制，采用行为生态学和神经内分泌学方法。

name: Philip Kragel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural and computational basis of emotions in humans using machine learning and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究人类情绪的神经和计算基础，使用机器学习和fMRI。

name: Stella Felix Lourenco
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies spatial and numerical cognition, using behavioral techniques and fMRI to examine how humans represent number and space, and how these abilities develop.
summary_zh: 研究空间和数值认知，使用行为技术和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）来探讨人类如何表示数字和空间，以及这些能力如何发展。

name: Donna L. Maney
title: Professor
summary: Studies hormonal and genetic influences on social behavior in white-throated sparrows, focusing on a supergene that mimics early sex chromosome evolution.
summary_zh: 研究激素和基因对白喉麻雀社会行为的影响，重点关注模拟早期性染色体进化的超级基因。

name: Joseph Manns
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain enables memory acquisition in humans and rats, focusing on the hippocampal and amygdala systems.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何在人类和大鼠中形成记忆，重点关注海马体和杏仁核系统。

name: Jared Medina
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain represents the body, examining multisensory integration, plasticity, and tactile qualia.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表征身体，探讨多感官整合、可塑性和触觉质料。

name: Lynne Nygaard
title: Department Chair and Professor
summary: Studies the perceptual and cognitive aspects of spoken language, including voice, accent, and prosody, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究口头语言的感知和认知方面，包括声音、口音和语调，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Rohan Palmer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies genetic and environmental factors of substance use disorders using twin, family, and whole-genome data.
summary_zh: 研究物质使用障碍的遗传和环境因素，使用双胞胎、家庭和全基因组数据。

name: James K. Rilling
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of human social cognition and behavior, focusing on caregiving in fathers and the role of oxytocin signaling.
summary_zh: 研究人类社会认知和行为的神经基础，重点关注父亲的照顾行为以及催产素信号的作用。

name: Philippe Rochat
title: Professor
summary: Studies the early sense of self and moral development in infants and children from diverse cultural backgrounds.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童在不同文化背景下的自我意识和道德发展。

name: Hillary R. Rodman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of blindsight, focusing on changes in specific neuronal circuits following early visual cortex damage.
summary_zh: 研究盲视的神经基础，重点关注早期视觉皮层损伤后特定神经回路的变化。

name: Arber Tasimi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the origins, development, and variations of human values and beliefs, including both common and unique constructs.
summary_zh: 研究人类价值观和信念的起源、发展和变化，包括常见和独特的内容。

name: Irwin Waldman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and environmental factors underlying childhood disruptive disorders and externalizing behaviors, using twin studies and molecular genetics.
summary_zh: 研究儿童破坏性障碍和外向行为的遗传和环境因素，使用双生子研究和分子遗传学方法。

name: Elaine F. Walker
title: Charles Howard Candler Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies risk factors for psychosis, focusing on neurodevelopmental and socioemotional aspects, and brain development in predicting mental illness.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症前驱症状的风险因素，重点关注神经发育和社会情感方面，并预测精神疾病的大脑发育。

name: Benjamin Wilson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the evolution of language and cognition in humans and nonhuman primates using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言和认知在人类和非人类灵长类动物中的进化，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Phillip Wolff
title: Professor
summary: Studies language semantics, machine learning, and causal reasoning, using digital phenotyping and future thinking approaches.
summary_zh: 研究语言语义学、机器学习和因果推理，采用数字表型和未来思考的方法。

name: Brianna Yamasaki
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how language, literacy, and executive processes interact to drive individual differences in linguistic development across the lifespan, using cognitive neuroscience and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言、读写能力和执行过程如何相互作用，驱动一生中语言发展的个体差异，采用认知神经科学和行为方法。

name: MD Zeke Gleichgerrcht
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology, School of Medicine
summary: Studies neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经和精神疾病，侧重于系统神经科学。

name: MD Todd Golde
title: Professor, Department of Pharmacology and Chemical Biology, School of Medicine
summary: Studies neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on mechanisms and treatments.
summary_zh: 研究神经和精神疾病，侧重于机制和治疗方法。

name: Shannon Gourley
title: Professor, Department of Pediatrics, School of Medicine
summary: Studies neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经和精神疾病，侧重于系统神经科学。

name: MD Jim Greene
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neurology, School of Medicine
summary: Studies neurological and psychiatric diseases, focusing on systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经和精神疾病，侧重于系统神经科学。

name: Rachel Barr
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Casey Brown
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Yulia Chentsova Dutton
title: Professor
summary: Studies cultural shaping of emotions and social support, examining universal tendencies and cultural scripts.
summary_zh: 研究文化对情绪和社会支持的影响，考察普遍倾向和文化脚本的作用。

name: Adam Green
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural processes behind creative intelligence and how teaching and learning can enhance it.
summary_zh: 研究创造性智能背后的神经过程以及教学和学习如何增强它。

name: Qiwei He
title: Provost’s Distinguished Associate Professor
summary: Develops advanced computational methods and AI-enhanced measurement models to analyze multimodal data, improving assessment systems for cognitive and behavioral processes.
summary_zh: 开发先进的计算方法和AI增强的测量模型，分析多模态数据，改进评估系统以更好地理解认知和行为过程。

name: Anna Johnson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of publicly funded early care and education on low-income children's development, using longitudinal data.
summary_zh: 研究公共资助的早期保育和教育对低收入儿童发展的影响，使用纵向数据。

name: Kostadin Kushlev
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social media affects adolescent mental health, using real-time monitoring and large survey datasets.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体如何影响青少年心理健康，使用实时监测和大规模调查数据集。

name: Ian Lyons
title: Provost’s Distinguished Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点在于记忆和注意力。

name: Janet Mann
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies dolphin social networks, reproduction, and culture in Shark Bay, Australia, and the Potomac River.
summary_zh: 研究鲨鱼湾和波托马克河 dolphins的社会网络、繁殖和文化。

name: Abigail Marsh
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotional processes like empathy and altruism using neuroimaging and cognitive testing in adolescents and adults.
summary_zh: 研究情绪过程如同理心和利他主义，使用神经成像和认知测试在青少年和成人中。

name: Fathali Moghaddam
title: Professor, Department of Psychology. Editor, Cambridge University Press, Progressive Psychology Book Series
summary: Studies the impact of context and culture on human behavior, emphasizing the malleability of human nature.
summary_zh: 研究情境和文化对人类行为的影响，强调人类本性的可塑性。

name: W. Gerrod Parrott
title: Professor
summary: Studies the nature of human emotion, focusing on social foundations, functions, and self-regulation.
summary_zh: 研究人类情绪的本质，重点关注社会基础、功能和自我调节。

name: Rebecca Ryan
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of socioeconomic disadvantage on children’s development, focusing on parent-child interactions and investment in children’s environments.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位对儿童发展的影响，重点关注亲子互动和对儿童环境的投资。

name: Chandan Vaidya
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
areas: Developmental and Psychiatric PathologyUpload Featured Work
summary: Studies the functional neural architecture of adaptive mechanisms, including implicit memory, executive control, and their genetic basis in children and adults with developmental disorders.
summary_zh: 研究适应机制的功能神经架构，包括内隐记忆、执行控制及其遗传基础，特别是在发育障碍儿童和成人中的表现。

name: Kristia Wantchekon
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点关注记忆和学习过程。

name: Jennifer Woolard
title: Professor
summary: Studies how youth and parents understand legal rights in the justice system, using research to create fair legal processes.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和家长对法律权利的理解，通过研究创建公平的司法程序。

name: Mark P. Burns
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Thomas M. Coate
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using behavioral and electrophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为和电生理方法。

name: Katherine Conant
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how matrix metalloproteinases influence neuronal and synaptic structure and function, particularly through cleavage of synaptic adhesion molecules and thrombin type G protein coupled.
summary_zh: 研究基质金属蛋白酶通过切割突触黏附分子和血纤蛋白酶型G蛋白偶联受体对神经元和突触结构与功能的影响。
kw: thrombin type g protein coupled receptors

name: Joshua Corbin
title: Associate Professor, Center for Neuroscience Research
summary: Studies the genetic and cellular development of the mammalian amygdala using mice, electrophysiology, and optogenetics to understand its role in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Fragile X Syndrome.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物杏仁核的遗传和细胞发育，使用小鼠、电生理学和光遗传学方法，以理解其在自闭症谱系障碍和脆性X综合症中的作用。

name: Andrew DeMarco
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, focusing on rehabilitation and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究脑部系统与行为的关系，侧重于康复和神经科学。

name: Guinevere Eden
title: Professor, Pediatrics
summary: Studies the brain bases of reading disabilities, particularly dyslexia, using behavioral measures and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究阅读障碍（尤其是失读症）的大脑基础，使用行为测量和脑成像技术。

name: Rhonda B. Friedman
title: Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies aphasia rehabilitation, focusing on neural mechanisms and cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究失语症康复，关注神经机制和认知过程。

name: Xiong Jiang
title: Associate Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Develops and validates advanced MRI techniques, focusing on fMRI to detect early neuronal injury and disease progression.
summary_zh: 开发和验证先进的MRI技术，重点是功能MRI(fMRI)，以检测早期神经元损伤和疾病进展。

name: Tina Liu
title: Assistant Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies how visual perception changes with experience, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知如何随经验改变，使用行为和神经影像技术。

name: Ludise Malkova
title: Professor, Pharmacology
summary: Studies the neural substrates of social and emotional behavior, focusing on the amygdala and orbitofrontal cortex, and their role in reward processing and cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪行为的神经机制，重点在于杏仁核和眶额皮层在奖赏处理和认知功能中的作用。

name: Elissa L. Newport
title: Professor of Neurology, Director of CBPR, Neurology
summary: Studies how children and adults learn languages and recover from brain injuries, using both fieldwork and lab experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何学习语言及脑损伤后的语言恢复，采用实地考察和实验室实验相结合的方法。

name: Joan Orpella
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the brain supports speech production, perception, and language learning using MEG, MRI, TMS, psychophysics, computational modeling, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持言语产生、感知和语言学习，使用MEG、MRI、TMS、心理物理学、计算建模和机器学习方法。

name: Alexey Ostroumov
title: Assistant Professor, Pharmacology and Physiology
summary: Studies how experience modifies synapses and neural circuitry in the mesocorticolimbic dopamine system, impacting reward processing and executive function.
summary_zh: 研究经验如何修改中脑-前额叶多巴胺系统中的突触和神经环路，影响奖赏处理和执行功能。

name: Josef P. Rauschecker
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the functional specialization of the cerebral cortex and plasticity of sensory systems, using electrophysiology and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层的功能特化和感觉系统的可塑性，使用电生理学和fMRI技术。

name: Maximilian Riesenhuber
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the computational mechanisms of human object recognition using models, fMRI, and EEG to link neurons to behavior.
summary_zh: 研究人类物体识别的计算机制，使用模型、fMRI 和 EEG 将神经元与行为联系起来。

name: Ella Striem-Amit
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how brain organization changes based on sensory and motor experience using behavioral and fMRI techniques.
summary_zh: 研究感觉和运动经验如何影响大脑组织，使用行为和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术。

name: Peter Turkeltaub
title: Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies brain organization for language and recovery methods using TMS, tDCS, fMRI, and neuropsychology.
summary_zh: 研究语言的认知神经机制及其恢复方法，使用TMS、tDCS、fMRI和神经心理学。

name: Michael Ullman
title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural and computational bases of language and memory, and how these are affected in various disorders and influenced by sex, handedness, and hormones.
summary_zh: 研究语言和记忆的神经和计算基础，以及这些功能在各种疾病中的影响和受性别、手型、遗传变异和激素（如雌激素）的影响。

name: Ashley VanMeter
title: Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies neurodevelopment and the effects of early substance use on the brain using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育以及早期物质使用对大脑的影响，采用神经影像学方法。

name: James Baraniuk
title: Professor, Medicine
summary: Studies neurological and physiological mechanisms of various chronic conditions including Gulf War Illness and Type II Diabetes.
summary_zh: 研究多种慢性疾病的神经和生理机制，包括海湾战争综合症和2型糖尿病。

name: James Giordano
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural bases of human ecology, moral decisions, and chronic pain, focusing on the 5-HT3 receptor system.
summary_zh: 研究人类生态、道德决策和慢性疼痛的神经基础，特别是5-HT3受体系统在炎症性疼痛中的作用。

name: Thomas Mellman
title: Professor, Psychiatry, Howard University College of Medicine
summary: Studies the role of sleep disturbance in PTSD, using early sleep recordings and longitudinal assessments of patients.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠障碍在 PTSD 发展中的作用，通过早期睡眠记录和纵向评估患者进行研究。

name: Jana Reifegerste
title: Assistant Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies how cognition and the brain change across the adult lifespan, focusing on the role of learning and memory in language abilities.
summary_zh: 研究成年期认知和大脑如何变化，重点关注学习和记忆在语言能力中的作用。

name: Ted Supalla
title: Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies the structure and emergence of sign languages, including ASL acquisition, processing, and brain activation during sign language use.
summary_zh: 研究手语的结构和演变，包括ASL的习得、处理以及大脑在使用手语时的激活区域。

name: Raymond Scott Turner
title: Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies active and passive immunization strategies for Alzheimer’s disease in mice, examining effects on memory, behavior, and neuroinflammation.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病小鼠模型的主动和被动免疫策略，考察其对记忆、行为和神经炎症的影响。

name: Stefano Vicini
title: Professor, Pharmacology & Physiology
summary: Studies the role of GABA and glutamate signaling in the medial nucleus tractus solitarius and dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus for modulating vagal output to the stomach.
summary_zh: 研究谷氨酸和GABA信号在中缝核和迷走神经背核中对迷走神经输出到胃部的调节作用。
kw: dorsal motor nucleus of the vagus

name: Jian-young Wu
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how wave patterns contribute to normal and pathological processes in the cortex using voltage-sensitive dyes.
summary_zh: 使用电压敏感染料研究波形模式在正常和病理过程中的作用，特别是在皮层中。

name: Kareem Zaghloul
title: Faculty
summary: Studies memory encoding and recall using intracranial recordings during neurosurgical procedures, focusing on cortical networks.
summary_zh: 使用神经外科手术过程中植入的电极记录皮层网络在记忆编码和回忆中的激活，重点研究基底节在学习和决策中的作用。

name: Joshua Ackerman
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people detect illness in others through non-verbal cues, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过非言语线索检测他人的疾病状态，使用行为实验方法。

name: Omar Ahmed
title: Associate Professor of Psychology, Neuroscience & Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies brain and behavior relationships, focusing on addiction and memory using biopsychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑与行为的关系，重点关注成瘾和记忆的生物心理学方法。

name: Germine Awad
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies personality and social contexts, focusing on diversity and social transformation in psychology.
summary_zh: 研究人格和社会情境，重点关注心理学中的多样性和社会转型。

name: Jacinta C. Beehner
title: Professor of Psychology and Anthropology
summary: Studies sexual conflict in mammalian reproduction, focusing on female counterstrategies to male reproductive tactics such as infanticide.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物繁殖中的性别冲突，重点关注雌性对抗雄性繁殖策略（如杀婴）的对策。

name: Adriene Beltz
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how hormones influence behavior across the lifespan using network analysis and longitudinal data.
summary_zh: 研究激素如何在生命周期中影响行为，使用网络分析和纵向数据。

name: Thore Bergman
title: Professor, Psychology and Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
summary: Studies social behavior and cognition in primates, focusing on dominance, vocal communication, and hormone-behavior interactions.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的社会行为和认知，重点关注等级制度、 vocal 交流以及激素-行为相互作用。

name: Kent Berridge
title: James Olds Distinguished University Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural bases of reward wanting and liking, using optogenetic and drug microinjection techniques in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究奖励欲望和喜欢的神经基础，使用光遗传学和药物微注射技术在啮齿动物中进行操纵。

name: Affective Emotional
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of emotional behavior in animals and humans.
summary_zh: 研究情感行为的认知和神经机制，涉及动物和人类。

name: Julie Boland
title: Professor of Psychology and Linguistics
summary: Studies the cognitive processes underlying word recognition and sentence comprehension, including syntactic and semantic processing.
summary_zh: 研究单词识别和句子理解的基本认知过程，包括句法和语义处理。

name: Race Ethnicity
title: Professor of Psychology & Women's and Gender Studies
summary: Studies gender and feminist psychology, focusing on inclusive excellence and diversity in higher education.
summary_zh: 研究性别和女性主义心理学，重点关注高等教育中的包容卓越和多样性。

name: David Brang
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how sensory information from one modality influences processing in another, using psychophysical testing, fMRI, and ECoG in the Multisensory Perception Lab.
summary_zh: 研究一种感觉信息如何影响另一种感觉的处理，使用心理物理学测试、fMRI 和 ECoG 在多感官知觉实验室中。

name: Rona Carter
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how young people, especially Black girls, make sense of bodily changes during puberty in diverse social contexts, using mixed methods.
summary_zh: 研究青春期身体变化如何在不同社会背景下被年轻人，特别是黑人女孩赋予意义，采用混合方法。

name: Rosario Ceballo
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how living in poverty, especially exposure to community violence, affects academic and psychological functioning of children and adolescents, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究生活在贫困中的儿童和青少年，尤其是社区暴力暴露对其学业和心理功能的影响，采用定量和定性方法。

name: Edward Chang
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies predictors of psychological and physical adjustment, including optimism, perfectionism, and social problem solving, with a focus on cultural and racial factors.
summary_zh: 研究心理和生理适应的预测因素，包括乐观主义、完美主义和社会问题解决能力，重点关注文化与种族因素。

name: Tabbye Chavous
title: Professor of Education and Psychology
summary: Studies identity and motivation among Black youth and emerging adults, examining STEM identity development and racial climates in schools.
summary_zh: 研究黑人青少年和成年早期的身份和动机，考察STEM身份发展和学校中的种族气候。

name: Kevin Cokley
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of psychological and environmental factors on African American student outcomes, focusing on the impostor phenomenon.
summary_zh: 研究心理和环境因素对非洲裔美国学生学业成果的影响，重点关注冒充者现象。

name: Elizabeth R. Cole
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Women's and Gender Studies, Psychology and Afroamerican and African Studies
summary: Studies diversity education and gender & feminist psychology, promoting social transformation in higher education.
summary_zh: 研究多元教育和性别女性心理学，促进高等教育的社会转型。

name: Terri D. Conley
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the biological and psychological aspects of monogamy and non-monogamy, challenging traditional views.
summary_zh: 研究一夫一妻制和非一夫一妻制的心理学和生物学基础，挑战传统观点。

name: Sex Sexuality
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Psychology, Women's & Gender Studies, and Management & Organizations
summary: Studies the intersection of gender, sexuality, and social transformation, focusing on psychological and organizational dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究性别、性取向和社会转型的交叉领域，重点关注心理和组织动态。

name: Fred Conrad
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies grief and emotional processing in relation to pop culture, using qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究流行文化对情感处理和悲伤反应的影响，采用定性方法。

name: Kai Schnabel Cortina
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

name: Lilia Cortina
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Psychology, Women's & Gender Studies, and Management & Organizations
summary: Studies political attitudes and social transformation, focusing on noncitizen voting myths and their impact on policy.
summary_zh: 研究政治态度和社会转型，关注非公民投票神话及其对政策的影响。

name: Amelia Cuarenta
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies motivation and brain mechanisms underlying educational outcomes, using psychological and neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究动机和大脑机制对教育结果的影响，采用心理学和神经科学方法。

name: Ben Dantzer
title: Professor of Psychology and Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
summary: Studies the causes of variation in social behaviors and life history traits in wild animals, focusing on parental care, pair-bonding, and the effects of early life conditions.
summary_zh: 研究野生动物中社会行为和生活史特征变异的原因，重点关注亲代照顾、伴侣关系以及早期生活条件的影响。

name: Pamela Davis-Kean
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how socioeconomic status affects parenting beliefs and behaviors, using quantitative methods and longitudinal studies.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位如何影响育儿信念和行为，使用定量方法和纵向研究。

name: Patricia Deldin
title: Professor of Psychology and Psychiatry
summary: Studies the relationship between brain, emotion, cognition, and behavior in psychopathology, particularly bipolar disorder, to develop novel treatments.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、认知和行为与精神病理学之间的关系，特别是双相障碍，以开发新的治疗方法。

name: CCN Affiliate
title: Faculty
summary: Studies decision-making and affective emotional processes using quantitative methods and social psychology.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和情感过程，使用定量方法和社会心理学。

name: David Dunning
title: Mary Ann and Charles R. Walgreen, Jr., Professor of the Study of Human Understanding
summary: Studies how people's beliefs and preferences affect their judgments and decisions, including the impact of motivated reasoning on perception.
summary_zh: 研究人们的信念和偏好如何影响判断和决策，包括动机性推理对知觉的影响。

name: Myles Durkee
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social contexts influence personality and identity, particularly in relation to race and ethnicity.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境如何影响个性和身份，特别是在种族和族裔方面。

name: Allison Earl
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how rhetoric influences risk assessment in social psychology.
summary_zh: 研究修辞如何影响社会心理学中的风险评估。

name: Ada Eban-Rothschild
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neuronal circuitry of sleep-wake states and sleep-preparatory behaviors using in-vivo calcium imaging, optogenetics, and chemogenetics in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠-觉醒状态和睡眠准备行为的神经环路，使用在体钙成像、光遗传学和化学遗传学技术在啮齿动物中进行.

name: Robin Edelstein
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies personality types and categorization using the Enneagram test.
summary_zh: 研究人格类型和分类，使用伊涅agram测试。

name: Nicole Gardner-Neblett
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how African American children develop complex oral language skills and their experiences in classrooms, with implications for pedagogical practices.
summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国儿童的语言复杂性口语技能的发展及其在课堂中的经历，以探讨教学实践的影响。

name: Ashley Gearhardt
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the addictive potential of certain foods, developing the Yale Food Addiction Scale, and how food advertising affects eating behavior.
summary_zh: 研究某些食物的成瘾性，开发耶鲁食物成瘾量表（YFAS），以及食物广告如何影响饮食行为。

name: Susan Gelman
title: Heinz Werner Distinguished University Professor of Psychology and Linguistics
summary: Studies how children learn language and concepts, focusing on cognitive development and gendered language.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习语言和概念，重点关注认知发展和性别化语言。

name: Amie Gordon
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the social cognitive, affective, and biological factors that shape close relationships, focusing on prosocial processes and their dyadic outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究塑造亲密关系的社会认知、情感和生物因素，重点关注利他过程及其双人结果。

name: Arnold Ho
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social and political attitudes affect perception and behavior, focusing on prejudice, discrimination, and inequality.
summary_zh: 研究社会和政治态度如何影响感知和行为，重点关注偏见、歧视和不平等。

name: Luke Hyde
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of risk and resilience in children, particularly antisocial behaviors and psychopathology, using neuroimaging and ecological models.
summary_zh: 研究儿童风险和复原力的发展，特别是反社会行为和心理障碍，使用神经成像和生态模型。

name: Justin Jager
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of adolescent and young adult transitions, including substance use, union formation, and the school to work transition, using sophisticated analytical methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成年人过渡期的发展，包括物质使用、伴侣形成和学校到工作过渡，使用复杂的分析方法。

name: John Jonides
title: Edward E. Smith Distinguished University Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies executive control processes using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究执行控制过程，使用神经成像技术。

name: Daniel Keating
title: Professor of Psychology, Psychiatry, and Pediatrics
summary: Studies adolescent cognitive, behavioral, and brain development, including neurocognitive and neuroimaging methods, to understand neurodevelopmental pathways in health risk behavior.
summary_zh: 研究青少年的认知、行为和大脑发展，包括神经认知和神经影像学方法，以理解健康风险行为的神经发展途径。

name: Mari Kira
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how adults maintain psychological well-being during adversities, focusing on growth from struggles and coping strategies.
summary_zh: 研究成人如何在逆境中维持心理健康并从中成长，关注应对策略和资源的作用。

name: Ethan Kross
title: Professor of Psychology and Management/Organizations
summary: Studies how exercise affects emotional processing, particularly grief, using fitness classes as interventions.
summary_zh: 研究运动如何影响情绪处理，特别是悲伤，使用健身课程作为干预手段。

name: Fiona Lee
title: Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

name: Taraz Lee
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies motor movement skills and cognition, focusing on executive control and motivation.
summary_zh: 研究运动技能和认知，重点关注执行控制和动机。

name: Richard Lewis
title: Arthur F. Thuranu Professor
summary: Studies how artificial intelligence, particularly large language models, mirrors human cognitive processes, using these models to explore human thought and language.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能，特别是大型语言模型，如何模仿人类认知过程，并利用这些模型探索人类思维和语言。

name: Cindy Lustig
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how older adults' brains respond to attention demands using behavioral testing and fMRI, focusing on age-related changes in attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究老年人在注意力需求下的大脑反应，使用行为测试和fMRI，关注注意力和记忆随年龄变化的特点。

name: Annelise Madison
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the mind-brain-immune connections and develops preventative interventions for inflammatory disorders, focusing on social stress and the gut-brain axis.
summary_zh: 研究心理-大脑-免疫连接，并开发预防炎症性疾病的方法，重点关注社会压力和肠-脑轴。

name: Ramaswami Mahalingam
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Explores mindful leadership techniques to enhance students' leadership identities through mindfulness practices.
summary_zh: 探索正念领导技巧以增强学生的领导身份，通过正念实践。

name: Sara McClelland
title: Professor of Psychology & Women's and Gender Studies
summary: Studies gender and feminist psychology, personality and social contexts, and social justice.
summary_zh: 研究性别和女性主义心理学、人格和社会情境以及社会正义。

name: Kevin Miller
title: Professor of Psychology and Education
summary: Studies how educational methods and first impressions affect student evaluations of teachers, focusing on instruction quality.
summary_zh: 研究教育方法和第一印象对学生对教师评价的影响，重点关注教学质量。

name: Andras Molnar
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies motivated preferences for information and belief-based utility in social interactions, especially in moral behavior contexts.
summary_zh: 研究动机性信息偏好和信念效用在社会互动中的作用，特别是在道德行为情境中。

name: Christopher Monk
title: Professor of Psychology, Psychiatry and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how childhood adversity affects neural development and links it to anxiety and depression in adolescents, using neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究童年逆境如何影响神经发育，并将其与青少年焦虑和抑郁症状联系起来，采用神经成像技术。

name: Donna Nagata
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the intergenerational impacts of historical traumas, focusing on the Japanese American incarceration during World War II.
summary_zh: 研究历史创伤的代际影响，重点关注二战期间的日裔美国人拘留所事件。

name: Sheryl Olson
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of self-regulatory competence in children, focusing on early precursors of disruptive behavior.
summary_zh: 研究儿童自我调节能力的发展，重点关注早期反常行为的先兆。

name: Nansook Park
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of resilience and well-being in adolescents and young adults, using longitudinal studies and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻人的复原力和幸福感的发展，使用纵向研究和调查。

name: Stephanie D. Preston
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making and affective emotional processes using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 使用认知神经科学方法研究决策和情感过程。

name: Leah Richmond-Rakerd
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies emotional and behavioral dysregulation across the life course, focusing on self-regulation difficulties and their outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究生命历程中的情绪和行为调节障碍，重点关注自我调节困难及其结果。

name: Deborah Rivas-Drake
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how school, peer, family, and community settings support adolescents in navigating race and ethnicity, impacting their academic, socioemotional, and civic development.
summary_zh: 研究学校、同伴、家庭和社区环境如何帮助青少年应对种族和 ethnicity 问题，影响其学业、情感和社会发展。

name: Craig Rodriguez-Seijas
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of stigma and discrimination on psychopathology in sexual and gender minority populations, using transdiagnostic models.
summary_zh: 研究歧视和边缘化对性取向和性别少数群体心理障碍的影响，采用跨诊断模型。

name: Alexandra Rosati
title: Professor of Psychology and Anthropology
summary: Studies the cognitive abilities of primates, focusing on decision-making, executive control, and social cognition in various ape, monkey, and lemur populations.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的认知能力，重点关注决策、执行控制和社会认知在各种猿类、猴类和狐猴中的表现。

name: Gideon Rothschild
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain processes sound, focusing on perception and memory.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理声音，重点在于感知和记忆。

name: Colleen Seifert
title: Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Psychology
summary: Explores ethical and equitable use of AI through interdisciplinary research.
summary_zh: 探索人工智能的伦理和公平使用问题，通过跨学科研究进行探讨。

name: Denise Sekaquaptewa
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies implicit stereotyping, prejudice, and stereotype threat, examining their effects on academic performance and motivation, particularly among women in STEM fields.
summary_zh: 研究隐性刻板印象、偏见和刻板印象威胁，探讨它们对学术表现和动机的影响，尤其是对STEM领域女性的影响。

name: Robert Sellers
title: James S. Jackson Distinguished University Professor of Psychology, and Professor of Education
summary: Studies inclusive psychology and its impact on diverse student experiences.
summary_zh: 研究包容性心理学及其对多样化学生体验的影响。

name: Isis Settles
title: University Diversity and Social Transformation Professor
summary: Studies the experiences, perceptions, and coping strategies of devalued social group members, particularly Black people and women, using an interdisciplinary, intersectional framework.
summary_zh: 研究被贬值社会群体成员（尤其是黑人和女性）的经历、感知和应对策略，采用跨学科和交叉学科的框架。

name: Priti Shah
title: Psychology Department Chair, Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes, including attention and memory, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，包括注意力和记忆，使用行为实验方法。

name: Kristina O. Smiley
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies brain and behavior relationships, focusing on hormones and animal behavior.
summary_zh: 研究大脑与行为的关系，重点关注激素和动物行为。

name: Catherine Thomas
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Organizational Studies
summary: Studies motivation and social psychology in organizations, using interventions and cultural approaches.
summary_zh: 研究组织中的动机和社会心理学，采用干预和文化方法。

name: Natalie Tronson
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of learning and memory, focusing on how neuroimmune signaling and stress affect memory formation and reconsolidation, particularly in post-traumatic stress disorder.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的分子机制，特别是神经免疫信号和压力如何影响记忆的形成和重新巩固，特别是在创伤后应激障碍和术后认知衰退中的作用。

name: L. Monique Ward
title: Arthur F. Thurnau Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of sex, gender, and race identity in adolescents using psychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年性别、性别认同和种族身份的发展，使用心理学方法。

name: Felix Warneken
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Improves human-AI teamwork in manufacturing by helping AI recognize and repair breakdowns in human intent recognition.
summary_zh: 改善制造中的人工智能团队合作，通过使人工智能能够识别和修复人类意图理解中的故障。

name: Daniel Weissman
title: Professor of Psychology, Cognition & Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies cognitive control and executive functions, focusing on how people manage their attention and actions.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和执行功能，关注人们如何管理注意力和行为。

name: Aidan Wright
title: Professor of Psychology and Psychiatry
summary: Studies personality and its relation to psychopathology using ambulatory assessment and advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究人格及其与心理障碍的关系，使用流动评估和高级定量方法。

name: Laura Zahodne
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how psychosocial factors influence cognitive and brain aging in late life, with a focus on racial/ethnic disparities and positive social networks.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会因素如何影响晚年认知和大脑老化，重点关注种族/民族差异和积极的社会网络。

name: Jun Zhang
title: Professor of Psychology, Professor of Statistics (courtesy)
summary: Studies perception and decision-making using computational models and neural network theory.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和决策制定，使用计算模型和神经网络理论。

name: Pierre Apostolides
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain uses prior knowledge to guide auditory function and motor actions, focusing on synaptic plasticity and neural circuits during hearing loss.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何利用先验知识指导听觉功能和运动行为，重点关注听力损失期间的突触可塑性和神经环路。

name: Sara Aton
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sensory experience and sleep affect neural circuits, contributing to nervous system plasticity and memory formation.
summary_zh: 研究感觉经验与睡眠对神经回路的影响，促进神经系统可塑性和记忆形成。

name: Victoria Booth
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and sleep in rodents and humans, using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物和人类的神经回路和睡眠，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: Steven Broglio
title: Professor, Athletic Training
summary: Studies mild traumatic brain injury prevention, biomechanics, assessment, and treatment in athletes.
summary_zh: 研究运动员轻度创伤性脑损伤的预防、生物力学、评估和治疗。

name: Tim Bruns
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural interfaces with dorsal root ganglia and controlling autonomic organ function using closed-loop neuroprostheses.
summary_zh: 研究与脊神经节连接的神经接口以及控制自主器官功能，使用闭环神经假体。

name: Cindy Chestek
title: Professor, Electrical Engineering
summary: Develops brain-machine interfaces to enable paralyzed individuals to control prosthetic limbs and their own limbs using neural activity and functional electrical stimulation.
summary_zh: 开发脑机接口以使瘫痪个体能够通过神经活动和功能性电刺激控制假肢和自身肢体。

name: Josie Clowney
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how neural circuits in fruit flies are organized to process chemosensory information for instinctual behaviors versus learning, using genomic and developmental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇中化学感觉电路的组织方式，如何处理本能行为与学习之间的化学感觉信息，采用基因组和发育方法。

name: Gabriel Corfas
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of brain development, plasticity, and hearing loss, with a focus on noise-induced and age-related hearing loss and social isolation effects.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发育、可塑性以及听力损失的细胞和分子机制，重点关注噪声和年龄相关性听力损失和社会隔离对大脑结构和功能的影响。

name: Eva Feldman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neurological diseases and therapies, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to advance brain health research.
summary_zh: 研究神经疾病和治疗方法，与多学科团队合作，推进大脑健康研究。

name: Colin Greineder
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive control and decision-making in emergency medicine patients using neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究急诊患者认知控制和决策机制的神经机制，使用神经影像学方法。

name: Anthony Hudetz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies state-dependent cortical information processing during wakefulness and anesthesia using high-density microelectrode arrays.
summary_zh: 使用高密度微电极阵列研究清醒和麻醉状态下皮层信息处理的状态依赖性。

name: Chandramouli Krishnan
title: Professor, Physical Therapy, U of M F
summary: Develops rehabilitation methods for neurologic and orthopedic disorders using low-cost robots and advanced biomechanical and neurophysiological techniques.
summary_zh: 开发神经和骨科疾病康复方法，使用低成本机器人和先进的生物力学及神经生理学技术。

name: Jonathan Lifshitz
title: Professor
summary: Studies traumatic brain injury and its progression to chronic neurodegenerative disease, focusing on social impact and intervention strategies.
summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤及其进展至慢性神经退行性疾病，重点关注社会影响和干预策略。

name: Zhongming Liu
title: Professor, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science
summary: Develops computational models and imaging techniques to study neurological disorders, using neural engineering approaches.
summary_zh: 开发计算模型和成像技术研究神经疾病，采用神经工程方法。

name: Xander Nuttle
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies genetic bases of neurodevelopmental disorders and uniquely human traits using CRISPR and cerebral organoids.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍和人类特有特征的遗传基础，使用CRISPR和脑类器官技术。

name: Yujuan Su
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the lung communicates with the brain to regulate airway function and systemic responses, using neural circuit mapping and genetic techniques.
summary_zh: 研究肺与大脑之间的交流如何调节气道功能和全身反应，使用神经回路映射和遗传技术。

name: Michael Vesia
title: Associate Professor, Movement Science
summary: Studies brain network dynamics in cognition, perception, and movement after brain injuries and neurological disease, using non-invasive brain stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究脑损伤和神经性疾病后认知、知觉和运动的脑网络动态，使用非侵入性脑刺激方法。

name: Alexander Weigard
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and neural risk factors for attention problems and substance use disorders using computational and network modeling methods.
summary_zh: 使用计算和网络建模方法研究注意力问题和物质使用障碍的认知和神经风险因素。

name: Kelly Whiteford
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies auditory and visual perception, using cognitive and brain sciences methods.
summary_zh: 研究听觉和视觉感知，使用认知神经科学方法。

name: Yang Xiao
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain cell communication and spatial organization using spatial technologies and multi-modal datasets.
summary_zh: 研究大脑细胞间的通讯和空间组织，使用空间技术和多模态数据集进行功能解释。

name: Michal Zochowski
title: Professor of Physics and Biophysics
summary: Studies mechanisms of spatiotemporal patterns in coupled dynamical systems and their role in brain information processing, using both theoretical and experimental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究耦合动力系统中时空模式的形成机制及其在大脑信息处理中的作用，采用理论和实验方法相结合的研究方法。

name: Joseph P. Allen
title: Hugh Kelly Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how adolescent social relationships predict long-term health and behavior, focusing on peer influence and attachment security.
summary_zh: 研究青少年的社会关系如何预测长期的心理健康和行为，重点关注同伴影响和依附安全。

name: Lanice Avery
title: Associate Professor of Women, Gender, and Sexuality and Psychology
summary: Studies the psychological and sexual health outcomes of Black women, focusing on the impact of gender and racial stereotypes.
summary_zh: 研究黑人女性的心理和性健康结果，重点关注性别和种族刻板印象的影响。

name: Steve Boker
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the dynamics of dyadic conversations, age-related changes in resilience, and adaptive dynamic models for addiction using Latent Differential Equations and Windowed Cross-Correlation methods.
summary_zh: 研究成对对话的动力学、年龄相关的变化弹性和成瘾的适应动态模型，使用潜在差分方程和窗口交叉相关方法。

name: Jazmin Brown-Iannuzzi
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies psychological mechanisms perpetuating group-based inequalities and the consequences of status-related disparities.
summary_zh: 研究维持群体不平等的心理机制及其地位相关差异的后果。

name: Erin Clabough
title: Professor of Psychology, General Faculty
summary: Studies neurodevelopment and synaptic plasticity, focusing on the effects of ethanol on neural development and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育和突触可塑性，关注乙醇对神经发育和行为的影响。

name: Elise M. Clerkin
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology, General Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: James A. Coan
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural systems supporting social forms of emotion regulation, using fMRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会形式的情绪调节的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和行为实验。

name: Jessica Connelly
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the relationship between DNA methylation of the oxytocin receptor and behavior in humans and model systems, using epigenetic regulation and neural response methods.
summary_zh: 研究DNA甲基化与催产素受体在人类和模式生物中的行为关系，使用表观遗传调控和神经反应方法。

name: Benjamin Converse
title: Professor of Public Policy and Psychology
summary: Studies goal pursuit in social systems, including social judgment, self-regulation, and decision making.
summary_zh: 研究社会系统中的目标追求，包括社会判断、自我调节和决策制定。

name: Lauren DiNicola
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the human brain supports complex cognitive functions, using precision neuroimaging to explore individual brain networks.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持复杂的认知功能，使用精确神经成像技术探索个体脑网络。

name: Chad Dodson
title: Professor and Chair of Psychology
summary: Studies factors contributing to false memories and eyewitness identification errors, particularly in relation to confidence, face recognition ability, and decision-time.
summary_zh: 研究导致虚假记忆和目击者识别错误的因素，特别是与信心、面部识别能力和决策时间的关系。

name: Alev Erisir
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies synaptic plasticity and neuronal connectivity in sensory pathways using electron microscopy and behavioral models.
summary_zh: 研究感觉通路中的突触可塑性和神经连接性，使用电子显微镜和行为模型。

name: Hudson Golino
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops new methodologies for assessing latent factors using network psychometrics and machine learning in psychology and health.
summary_zh: 开发使用网络心理测量学和机器学习评估潜在因素的新方法，应用于心理学和健康领域。

name: Tobias Grossmann
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of social, cognitive, and brain processes in infants, focusing on adaptive social communication and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿期的社会、认知和大脑过程的发展，重点在于适应性社会交流和行为。

name: Donna Hearn
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Teague Henry
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Data Science
summary: Studies statistical methods and models in psychological research.
summary_zh: 研究心理研究中的统计方法和模型。

name: Noelle Hurd
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the promotion of healthy development among marginalized adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on leveraging intergenerational relationships and disrupting systems of oppression.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化青少年和新兴成年人的健康发展，侧重于利用代际关系并打破压迫系统。

name: Vikram Jaswal
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies communication in autism, focusing on cognitive and social processes in nonspeaking autistics and their unique communication methods.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症患者的沟通，特别是非说话自闭症患者及其父母的认知和社会过程和独特沟通方式。

name: Angeline Lillard
title: Commonwealth Professor of Psychology
areas: Lab Website: The Early Developmental Lab
The Montessori Difference: Evaluating the Evidence
summary: Studies social and cognitive development in children, focusing on Montessori education and play.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会和认知发展，重点关注蒙特梭利教育和游戏。

name: Xiaorong Liu
title: Professor of Biology and Psychology
summary: Studies the degeneration of retinal ganglion cells in mouse models of glaucoma, using genetics, imaging, and neuroprotection strategies.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经节细胞在实验性青光眼小鼠模型中的退化，使用遗传学、成像和神经保护策略。

name: Patricia Llewellyn
title: Professor Academic General Faculty
summary: Studies health psychology, personality assessment, and women's issues, focusing on treatment outcomes and assessment in therapy training.
summary_zh: 研究健康心理学、人格评估和女性问题，重点关注治疗结果和疗法培训中的评估问题。

name: Nicole Long
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how top-down and bottom-up processes affect memory encoding and retrieval using EEG and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究自上而下和自下而上的过程如何影响记忆编码和检索，并使用脑电图和功能性磁共振成像进行表征。

name: Jennifer MacCormack
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies social influence and self-perception using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会影响和自我知觉，使用实验方法。

name: Channing Mathews
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how youth of color use ethnic-racial identity and critical consciousness to engage in STEM and activism.
summary_zh: 研究有色人种青年如何利用种族身份认同和批判意识参与STEM和行动。

name: Chris Mazurek
title: Professor of Psychology, General Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程及其发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: C. Daniel Meliza
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of pattern learning and recognition in songbirds using electrophysiology and dynamical systems models.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类听觉系统中模式学习和识别的神经机制，使用电生理学和动力系统模型方法。

name: Michael Meyer
title: Associate Professor, General Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: James P. Morris
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of social behavior, using fMRI, EEG/ERP, and behavioral experiments across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究社会行为的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图/事件相关电位（EEG/ERP）和行为实验贯穿整个生命周期。

name: Brian A. Nosek
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people and systems produce values-misaligned behavior, developing methods to align behavior with values and improving research methods and culture.
summary_zh: 研究人们和系统如何产生价值观不一致的行为，开发方法以使行为与价值观一致，并改进研究方法和文化。

name: Paul Perrin
title: Professor of Data Science and Psychology
summary: Studies social determinants of health and cultural approaches to disability rehabilitation, using community-based participatory research.
summary_zh: 研究健康的社会决定因素和残疾康复的文化方法，采用社区参与式研究方法。

name: Aaron Reuben
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neuropsychiatric effects of environmental exposures across the lifespan, using advanced technologies and clinical assessments.
summary_zh: 研究环境暴露对全生命周期神经心理健康的影響，使用先進技術和臨床評估方法。

name: Adema Ribic
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how neurons assemble into circuits and adapt to the environment in the rodent visual system, using electrophysiology and gene manipulation.
summary_zh: 研究神经元如何组装成回路并适应环境，使用电生理学和单神经元基因操作技术在啮齿动物视觉系统中进行研究。

name: Zoë Robertson
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Karen M. Schmidt
title: Professor of Psychology, General Faculty
summary: Studies the latent structure of complex abilities across the lifespan, personality, and pain, using item response theory models.
summary_zh: 研究复杂能力的潜在结构、人格和疼痛，使用项目反应理论模型。

name: Per Sederberg
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neural correlates and computational models of human memory processes, combining fMRI, EEG, and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆过程的神经相关性和计算模型，结合使用功能性磁共振成像、脑电图和行为实验。

name: Stefanie Sequeira
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social threat and reward processes develop during childhood and adolescence, linking brain and social behavior to understand psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年时期的社会威胁和奖励过程的发展，将大脑和社交行为联系起来，以理解心理障碍的发展。

name: Eric Shuman
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为，使用实验方法。

name: Bethany A. Teachman
title: Commonwealth Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes contributing to anxiety disorders and emotion dysregulation, using digital technologies to improve emotional functioning.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和情绪调节的认知过程，使用数字技术改善情绪功能。

name: Mariana Teles
title: Professor of Psychology, General Faculty
summary: Studies how people learn and designs educational interventions to support effective learning, using cognitive psychology, computational tools, and AI.
summary_zh: 研究人的学习机制，并设计教育干预措施以支持有效学习，结合认知心理学、计算工具和人工智能。

name: Xin Cynthia Tong
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops and applies Bayesian and longitudinal statistical methods to study the development of cognitive ability and achievement skills over time.
summary_zh: 开发和应用贝叶斯和纵向统计方法研究认知能力和成就技能的纵向发展。

name: Sophie Trawalter
title: Professor of Public Policy and Psychology
summary: Studies how people develop competencies for life in diverse spaces, focusing on intergroup contact and social cognition.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在多元空间中发展生活技能，重点关注群体间接触和社会认知。

name: Eric Turkheimer
title: Hugh Scott Hamilton Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how genes and environments interact to shape human behavior, focusing on family life and personality development.
summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用塑造人类行为，重点关注家庭生活和个人特质的发展。

name: Amrisha Vaish
title: Pamela Feinour Edmonds and Franklin S. Edmonds, Jr. Discovery Professor in Psychology
summary: Studies the development of moral emotions, cognitions, and behaviors in children, including sympathy, guilt, and cheating.
summary_zh: 研究儿童道德情感、认知和行为的发展，包括同情、内疚和作弊。

name: John Van Horn
title: Professor of Psychology and Data Science
summary: Studies brain health and disease using multimodal neuroimaging and computational approaches, focusing on brain connectomics and white matter fiber pathways.
summary_zh: 研究大脑健康和疾病，使用多模态神经成像和计算方法，重点关注大脑连接组学和白质纤维束路径。

name: Cedric Williams
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how emotionally arousing events influence memory formation in the brain, using behavioral tasks and neurochemistry.
summary_zh: 研究情绪激动事件如何影响大脑中的记忆形成，使用行为任务和神经化学方法。

name: Daniel Willingham
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their application to K-12 education, focusing on reading and learning styles.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其在K-12教育中的应用，重点关注阅读和学习风格。

name: Adrienne Wood
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies social connections and relationships, examining nonverbal and verbal behaviors, social networks, and community dynamics using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会联系和关系，考察非言语和言语行为、社会网络和社区动态，使用多种方法。

name: Stephen Abbott
title: Faculty
areas: Neurobiology of the autonomic nervous system
summary: Studies the neural networks controlling cardiovascular and respiratory functions, and their role in diseases like neurogenic hypertension and Parkinson’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究调控心血管和呼吸功能的神经网络及其在神经性高血压和帕金森病等疾病中的作用。

name: David Acunzo
title: Faculty

summary_zh: 研究风险决策的神经生物学，重点关注青少年、社会环境和物质使用，并考察正念训练对决策和福祉的影响。

name: Stacey Dusing
title: Associate Professor of Biokinesiology and Physical Therapy and Psychology

summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究认知过程和行为。

name: Teal Eich
title: Associate Professor of Gerontology and Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive aging and memory in older adults using neuropsychological tests and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究老年人的认知老化和记忆，使用神经心理学测试和脑成像技术。

name: Deborah Finkel
title: Professor (Research) of Psychology
summary: Studies genetic and environmental factors affecting cognitive aging in adults using twin data.
summary_zh: 研究遗传和环境因素对成人认知老化的影响，使用双胞胎数据。

name: Margaret Gatz
title: Professor of Psychology and Gerontology
summary: Studies risk and protective factors for Alzheimer's disease, evaluating interventions and genetic/environmental influences.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的风险和保护因素，评估干预措施和遗传/环境影响。

name: Patricia George
title: Assistant Professor (Teaching) of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点在于记忆和学习过程。

name: Raymond Goldsworthy
title: Associate Professor of Research Otolaryngology and Psychology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of hearing and perception, focusing on the auditory system and its cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究听觉系统的神经机制及其认知过程。

name: Assal Habibi
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how cognitive, emotional, and social skills develop through interactions of biological dispositions and environmental factors, with a focus on early childhood music training.
summary_zh: 研究认知、情绪和社会技能如何通过生物倾向和环境因素的相互作用发展，重点关注早期音乐训练对大脑功能和结构的影响。

name: Leor Hackel
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, focusing on how social context influences individual behavior and cognition.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，重点关注社会环境如何影响个体的行为和认知。

name: Duke Han
title: Professor of Psychology, Family Medicine and Gerontology
summary: Studies factors impacting cognition and decision-making in aging, using empirical approaches and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究影响老化认知和决策的因素，采用实证方法和神经成像技术。

name: Andrea Hollingshead
title: Professor of Communication and Psychology
summary: Studies communication and psychology, focusing on social interactions and relationships.
summary_zh: 研究沟通与心理学，侧重于社会互动和人际关系。

name: Mary Immordino-Yang
title: Professor of Education, Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the art and science of human wellbeing, integrating psychology, neuroscience, and education.
summary_zh: 研究人类福祉的艺术与科学，结合心理学、神经科学和教育。

name: Canan Ipek
title: Assistant Professor (Teaching) of Psychology
summary: Studies language development in children using behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言发展，使用行为方法。

name: Laurent Itti
title: Professor of Computer Science and Psychology
summary: Studies visual attention and object detection in computer vision and neuroscience, using computational models and psychophysical experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意和物体检测的认知神经科学，使用计算模型和心理物理学实验。

name: Richard John

summary_zh: 研究认知过程和决策制定的心理学认知过程。

name: Doerte Junghaenel
title: Associate Professor (Research) of Psychology and Gerontology
summary: Studies patient-reported outcomes and psychosocial adjustment to chronic pain, using multi-modal assessment methods.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛患者的自我报告结果和心理社会适应，使用多模态评估方法。

name: Jonas Kaplan
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies social relationships, empathy, self-awareness and creativity using functional neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究社会关系、共情、自我意识和创造力的认知神经机制。

name: Katharina Kircanski
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies mechanisms of pediatric mood and anxiety disorders using fMRI, behavioral paradigms, and EMA to target early interventions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童情绪和焦虑障碍的机制，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、行为范式和生态时刻评估（EMA）来针对早期干预措施。

name: Matthew Kirkpatrick
title: Associate Professor of Research Population and Public Health Sciences and Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior in public health settings, focusing on psychological well-being and social factors.
summary_zh: 研究公共健康领域的认知过程和行为，重点关注心理福祉和社会因素。

name: Heather Kosakowski

summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习词汇，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Kari Kretch
title: Assistant Professor of Physical Therapy and Psychology
summary: Studies the cognitive processes involved in physical therapy and rehabilitation, focusing on memory and learning.
summary_zh: 研究物理治疗和康复中的认知过程，重点关注记忆和学习。

name: Sandy LaTourrette

summary_zh: 研究标签如何影响婴儿的分类和记忆，以及婴儿和成人如何学习词义。

name: Caryn Lerman
title: Professor of Psychiatry, Behavioral Sciences and Psychology

summary_zh: 研究成瘾和行为改变的心理和神经机制，采用临床和实验方法。

name: Pat Levitt

name: Susan Luczak
title: Professor (Research) of Psychology
summary: Studies genetic and ethnic group differences in alcohol use development and real-time drinking behavior using biosensors and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究不同遗传和族裔群体的酒精使用发展差异以及使用生物传感器和机器学习的实时饮酒行为。

name: Shan Luo
title: Assistant Professor of Medicine and Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural basis, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Thomas Lyon

summary_zh: 研究法律心理学，探讨法律与人类行为的交叉领域。

name: Mara Mather
title: Professor of Gerontology and Psychology

summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响老年人的决策和记忆。

name: Lynn Miller

summary: Studies communication processes, including sexual harassment perceptions and AIDS-related messages, using fuzzy logic and connectionist models.
summary_zh: 研究沟通过程，包括性骚扰感知和艾滋病相关信息的处理，使用模糊逻辑和连接主义模型。

name: Toby Mintz
title: Professor of Psychology and Linguistics

summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过计算建模和实验形成语法表征并学习语言。

name: Henrike Moll

summary_zh: 研究自我控制机制在成瘾和肥胖中的作用，结合行为经济学和认知神经科学的方法。

name: Santiago Morales
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Pediatrics
summary: Studies individual differences in emotion and emotion regulation, particularly how early temperament impacts socioemotional development and psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和情绪调节的个体差异，特别是早期气质如何影响情绪社会发展和心理障碍。

name: Shrikanth Narayanan
title: Niki and Max Nikias Chair and University Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Linguistics, Psychology, and Pediatrics
summary: Studies speech and language processing, integrating engineering and psychology to understand human communication.
summary_zh: 研究语音和语言处理，结合工程学和心理学来理解人类交流。

name: Samuel Nastase
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how shared neural codes for language facilitate communication between brains using fMRI and deep neural networks.
summary_zh: 研究语言在大脑间的共享神经编码如何促进交流，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和深度神经网络。

name: Daphna Oyserman
title: Dean’s Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how small changes in context can shift mindsets, affecting health and academic performance through real-world interventions.
summary_zh: 研究小情境变化如何改变心理模式，影响健康和学业表现，并通过实际干预措施进行转化。

summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习词汇，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Payam Piray
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people make decisions in uncertain situations and learn from mistakes, using machine learning and cognitive neuroscience tools.
summary_zh: 研究人在不确定情况下做决策及从错误中学习的过程，使用机器学习和认知神经科学的方法。

summary_zh: 研究数词、可数性和测量的语义以及对象和事件的划分。

summary_zh: 研究社会支持网络及其对心理健康的影响，使用定性和定量方法。

name: Elizabeth Zelinski

summary_zh: 研究老年人的认知变化，使用纵向研究评估老年人的认知能力。

summary: Studies aging in vertebrates, focusing on epigenome and transcriptome remodeling, sex differences, and immune function.
summary_zh: 研究衰老过程中的表观基因组和转录组重塑、性别差异和免疫功能。

summary: Studies the flow of cerebrospinal fluid and blood in the brain using MRI and near-infrared spectroscopy, particularly in conditions like hydrocephalus and sickle cell disease.

summary_zh: 研究健康和受伤的神经肌肉系统中的运动控制和适应，开发理论模型和实验方法。

name: Alan G. Watts

name: Carlos Cardenas-Iniguez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social stratification affects neural and cognitive development and mental health using large-cohort datasets.
summary_zh: 研究社会分层如何影响神经和认知发展以及心理健康，使用大规模队列数据集。

name: George Chen
title: Assistant Professor

summary_zh: 使用功能基因组学、生物信息学和基础神经科学研究神经发育障碍的发生机制，加速治疗方法的发展。

name: Jeiran Choupan

summary_zh: 使用高级神经成像和计算分析研究神经退行性疾病前驱阶段的大脑微结构变化。

name: Brian George Dias

summary_zh: 开发神经活动成像工具，并使用AI分析大规模模式，揭示生物智能的基本原理。

name: Mark Humayun
title: Professor of Ophthalmology, Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine and Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies neural interfaces for treating neurosensory disorders, combining engineering and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经接口以治疗神经感觉障碍，结合工程学和神经科学。

name: Scott Kanoski

summary: Studies the neural systems and psychological processes controlling energy balance and how Western diets impact learning and memory, with a focus on the gut microbiome.
summary_zh: 研究调控能量平衡的神经系统和心理过程，以及西方饮食对学习和记忆的影响，重点关注肠道微生物群的作用。

name: Katherine Lawrence
title: Assistant Professor of Research Neurology
summary: Studies brain connectivity, function, and structure in neurodevelopmental conditions like autism and ADHD using neuroimaging and computational methods.
summary_zh: 使用神经影像学和计算方法研究神经发育障碍如自闭症和ADHD的脑连接性、功能和结构。

name: Sook-Lei Liew
title: Associate Professor of Biokinesiology and Physical Therapy
summary: Studies neural plasticity in individuals with stroke, using big data neuroimaging, noninvasive brain stimulation, and brain computer interfaces to enhance quality of life.
summary_zh: 研究中风患者的神经可塑性，使用大数据神经成像、非侵入性脑刺激和脑机接口来提高生活质量。

name: Valter Longo
title: Professor of Gerontology and Biological Sciences

summary_zh: 研究系统功能障碍与衰老和认知衰退之间的联系，重点关注胰岛素抵抗和神经炎症如何加速大脑衰老和阿尔茨海默病。

name: Katherine Matho

summary_zh: 研究发育和遗传程序如何构建大脑电路以支持复杂行为，使用基因敲入小鼠和单细胞测序方法。

name: Bartlett Mel

summary_zh: 使用计算模型研究大脑功能，理解突触整合和物体识别机制，旨在开发高性能的人工视觉系统。

name: Nina Rouhani

summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆过程如何引导个体和互动行为，使用计算神经科学和认知科学方法。

name: Darby Saxbe

title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from active information-seeking, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童通过主动信息寻求学习词汇的认知发展，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验方法。

name: Johnatan Aljadeff
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain organization and function using models of neurons and networks, focusing on representations, learning, and inference.
summary_zh: 研究神经元和网络模型以理解大脑组织和功能，关注表征、学习和推理。

name: Nicola Allen
title: Associate Adj Professor
summary: Studies synaptic plasticity and neurodevelopmental disorders in rodents using electrophysiology and imaging.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的突触可塑性和神经发育障碍，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: Mikio Aoi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how populations of neurons coordinate their activity to understand behavior dynamics, using new data analysis tools and theoretical frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究神经元群体活动的协调机制，以理解行为动力学，采用新的数据分析工具和理论框架。

name: Eiman Azim
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural circuits and behavior in rodents using genetic, molecular, and electrophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 使用遗传、分子和电生理学方法研究啮齿动物的神经回路和行为。

name: Dhananjay Bambah-Mukku
title: Assistante Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of decision-making and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类决策和学习的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Matthew Banghart
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies pain modulation and placebo analgesia using optogenetics, chemogenetics, and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 使用光遗传学、化学遗传学和电生理学研究疼痛调节和安慰剂镇痛。

name: Maksim Bazhenov
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sleep, memory, and learning are regulated by neural networks and oscillations in rodents and humans using computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠、记忆和学习的神经网络和振荡调控机制，使用计算建模方法在啮齿动物和人类中进行.

name: Marcus Benna
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies computational principles of synaptic memory consolidation and efficient coding in the brain using theoretical physics and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究神经突触记忆巩固和高效编码的计算原理，使用理论物理和机器学习方法。

name: MD Divya Bolar
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain function using fMRI, focusing on blood flow and oxygen metabolism in neuromuscular coupling.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究大脑功能，重点关注血液流动和氧代谢在神经肌肉耦合中的作用。

name: Mark Bondi
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease in older adults, using neuropsychological tests and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究老年人的认知衰退和阿尔茨海默病，使用神经心理学测试和神经影像学方法。

name: Timothy Brown
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain development and cognitive function from infancy to adulthood, focusing on reading, language, and executive functions using imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究从婴儿期到成年期的大脑发育和认知功能，重点在于阅读、语言和执行功能，使用成像技术。

name: Wendy M. Campana
title: Professor
summary: Studies pain and neuropathy in rodents, focusing on nerve injury, Schwann cells, and receptors.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的疼痛和神经病变，重点关注神经损伤、施万细胞和受体。

name: Michael Castle
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies various fields of neuroscience as classified by the National Library of Medicine.
summary_zh: 研究美国国家医学图书馆分类的各类神经科学领域。

name: MD Melissa Campbell
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of autism using stem cell and mouse models.
summary_zh: 使用干细胞和小鼠模型研究自闭症的发展机制。

name: Gert Cauwenberghs
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing for cognitive and neurological disorders.
summary_zh: 研究脑机接口和神经信号处理，用于认知和神经疾病。

name: Alex Chaim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in development.
summary_zh: 研究发育过程中学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Eric Courchesne
title: Associate Adj Professor
summary: Studies autism and neural development using functional and structural neuroimaging, focusing on language development and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症和神经发育，使用功能性与结构性神经成像，关注语言发展和行为。

name: Antonio De Maio
title: Professor
summary: Studies the causes and potential interventions for health and educational disparities among different socioeconomic groups.
summary_zh: 研究不同社会经济群体之间健康和教育不平等的原因及潜在干预措施。

name: Virginia de Sa
title: Professor
summary: Studies how humans integrate sensory information and use computational models to understand brain functions and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何整合感官信息以及使用计算模型理解大脑功能和行为。

name: Kim Dore
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies synaptic weakening and resilience in Alzheimer’s disease using model mice and primary neurons, examining molecular mechanisms and potential therapies.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病中突触的削弱和韧性，使用模型小鼠和原代神经元，探讨分子机制和潜在疗法。

name: Stephanie Dulawa
title: Professor
summary: Studies rapid-acting antidepressants and perseverative behaviors in animal models using neurophysiology and chemogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究快速起效抗抑郁药和perseverative行为在动物模型中的作用，使用神经生理学和化学遗传学方法。

name: Mark Ellisman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the structure and function of neural circuits using advanced imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用先进的成像技术研究神经回路的结构和功能。

name: Cole Ferguson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory and attention in adults using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究成人在工作记忆和注意力方面的神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

name: Pascal Gagneux
title: Professor
summary: Studies primate behavior and genetics, focusing on social cognition and communication.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的行为和遗传学，重点在于社会认知和交流。

name: MD Douglas Galasko
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of aging and neurodegenerative diseases, focusing on Alzheimer's disease.
summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病）的认知和神经机制。

name: Timothy Gentner
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of vocal communication in songbirds, focusing on decision processes and auditory perception.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类（欧洲知更鸟）的鸣叫交流神经机制，重点在于决策过程和听觉感知。

name: Olivier George
title: Professor
summary: Studies addiction and its pharmacological treatments using whole-brain imaging and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾及其药物治疗，使用全脑成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Vikash Gilja
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural interfaces and brain-machine interfaces for decoding and modulating motor behavior and speech production.
summary_zh: 研究神经接口和脑机接口以解码和调节运动行为和言语产生。

name: Lawrence Goldstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

name: Hector Gonzalez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how Hispanic Americans and immigrants manage metabolic syndrome and health expenditures, using cognitive methods.
summary_zh: 研究西班牙裔美国人和移民如何管理代谢综合征和医疗支出，使用认知方法。

name: Christina Gremel
title: Professor
summary: Studies decision-making processes in the brain, focusing on how the brain evaluates risks and rewards.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的决策过程，重点关注大脑如何评估风险和奖励。

name: Eric Halgren
title: Professor
summary: Studies how ripple oscillations support working memory representations in the brain, using ECoG and nanowire arrays.
summary_zh: 研究 ripple 振动如何支持工作记忆表征，使用 ECoG 和纳米线阵列技术。

name: Shelley Halpain
title: Professor
summary: Studies cytoskeletal mechanisms in neural circuits, using imaging techniques to understand neuronal morphology and plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路中的细胞骨架机制，使用成像技术来理解神经元形态和可塑性。

name: Thomas Hnasko
title: Professor
