summary: Studies neural circuits underlying motivated behaviors and behavioral control using genetic and optogenetic tools.
summary_zh: 研究动机行为和行为控制的神经回路，使用遗传和光遗传学工具。

name: Vivian Hook
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and learning.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点在于记忆和学习。

name: William Joiner
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how fruitflies and rodents sleep, learn, and remember, using ion channels, synaptic transmission, and circuit mapping.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇和啮齿动物的睡眠、学习和记忆，使用离子通道、突触传递和电路映射的方法。

name: Ann Kennedy
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain circuitry and neural coding in animals to understand behavior, emotion, and learning.
summary_zh: 研究动物的大脑电路和神经编码，以理解行为、情绪和学习。

name: David Kleinfeld
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies brainstem circuits and feedback mechanisms using optogenetics, imaging, and electrophysiology in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究使用光遗传学、成像和电生理学方法在啮齿动物中的脑干回路和反馈机制。

name: Takaki Komiya
title: Professor
summary: Studies how rodents learn and make decisions using in-vivo two-photon imaging and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和决策机制，使用在体双光子成像和光遗传学技术。

name: Stefan Leutgeb
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and spatial navigation in rodents using neurophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物记忆和空间导航的神经机制，使用神经生理学和成像技术。

name: Byungkook Lim
title: Professor
summary: Studies how rodents learn and behave in response to stress and addiction, using molecular, cellular, genetic, and circuit approaches.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物在应激和成瘾反应中的学习和行为，使用分子、细胞、遗传和电路方法。

name: Giordano Lippi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies gene expression and neural networks in neurodevelopmental disorders like autism and schizophrenia.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍（如自闭症和精神分裂症）中的基因表达和神经网络。

name: Matthew Lovett-Barron
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how internal states influence neural circuits and behavior using optogenetics, 2-photon imaging, and virtual reality.
summary_zh: 研究内部状态如何影响神经回路和行为，使用光遗传学、双光子成像和虚拟现实技术。

name: Carolina Makowski
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neuropsychiatric disorders using human neuroimaging and genomics.
summary_zh: 使用人类神经成像和基因组学研究神经精神疾病。

name: MD Michael McCarthy
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms involved in attention and memory, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究注意和记忆的认知过程及其神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

name: Andrew Mendiola
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Gal Mishne
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies geometric representation learning and diffusion geometry to decode neural activity for handwriting BCIs and generalizable speech neuroprostheses.
summary_zh: 研究几何表示学习和扩散几何学以解码神经活动，用于手写BCI和可泛化的语音神经假体。

name: Jyoti Mishra
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how circuits in the brain influence behavior and cognition, using electrophysiology and neuroimaging to understand attention, learning, and plasticity in development and ADHD.
summary_zh: 研究大脑电路如何影响行为和认知，使用电生理学和神经成像技术理解注意力、学习和发育及ADHD中的可塑性。

name: MD William Mobley
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms in Down syndrome, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究唐氏综合症的认知和神经机制，使用行为和神经影像技术。

name: Alysson Muotri
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using animal models.
summary_zh: 使用动物模型研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

name: Nick Oesch
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how neurons in the retina process information for perception and behavior, developing treatments for blindness.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经元如何处理信息以产生感知和行为，并开发治疗失明的方法。

name: Abraham Palmer
title: Professor
summary: Studies genetic and cellular bases of addiction, anxiety, and depression in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物成瘾、焦虑和抑郁的遗传和细胞基础。

name: Victoria Risbrough
title: Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and behavioral aspects of anxiety and PTSD in rodents and humans, using pharmacology and fear learning experiments.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和PTSD的遗传和行为方面，使用啮齿动物和人类的药理学和恐惧学习实验。

name: MD Subhojit Roy
title: Professor
summary: Studies neurodegeneration, focusing on Parkinson’s disease and Alzheimer’s Disease, particularly the role of -synuclein in axons, dendrites, and synapses.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，特别是帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病，关注α-突触核蛋白在轴突、树突和突触中的作用。

name: Allen Ryan
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

name: David Salmon
title: Professor
summary: Studies early detection of dementia and Alzheimer's using neuropsychological testing and psychometric methods.
summary_zh: 研究使用神经心理学测试和心理测量方法早期检测痴呆和阿尔茨海默病。

name: Terrence Sejnowski
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and synaptic physiology, using computational modeling and electrophysiology to explore learning, memory, and schizophrenia.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和突触生理学，使用计算建模和电生理学探索学习、记忆和精神分裂症。

name: Katerina Semendeferi
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural systems involved in complex cognitive and emotional processes in humans, apes, and other primates, as well as in human mental disorders.
summary_zh: 研究人类、猿类和其他灵长类动物中复杂认知和情绪过程的神经系统，以及人类精神障碍。

name: John Serences
title: Professor, Department of Psycology
summary: Studies how behavioral goals influence perception, decision making, and memory using psychophysics, computational modeling, and neuroimaging in humans.
summary_zh: 研究行为目标如何影响知觉、决策和记忆，使用心理物理学、计算建模和神经影像学方法在人类被试中进行研究。

name: DVM Christina Sigurdson
title: Professor
summary: Studies prion neurotoxicity and prion aggregate spread in the brain, using various lab members and postdocs.
summary_zh: 研究朊病毒神经毒性及朊病毒包涵体在大脑中的传播，使用多名实验室成员和博士后。

name: Christine Smith
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain injury and Alzheimer's using neuroimaging and eye-tracking to understand learning and memory.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像和眼动追踪研究脑损伤和阿尔茨海默病的认知和记忆机制。

name: Monique Smith
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies pain, emotion, empathy, and addiction in mice, focusing on social behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究疼痛、情绪、同理心和成瘾行为在小鼠中的机制。

name: Nicholas Spitzer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neurons change their neurotransmitters in response to environmental stimuli, affecting behavior and memory in both developing and adult brains.
summary_zh: 研究神经元在环境刺激下改变神经递质的身份，影响发育和成年大脑的行为和记忆。

name: Scott Sternson
title: Professor
summary: Studies circuits and molecular mechanisms of appetite and addiction using chemogenetics, optogenetics, and bioinformatics.
summary_zh: 研究食欲和成瘾的神经环路和分子机制，使用化学遗传学、光遗传学和生物信息学方法。

name: Michael Taffe
title: Professor
summary: Studies drug addiction and psychoactive drugs using neuropharmacology and immune system interactions.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和精神活性药物，使用神经药理学和免疫系统交互机制。

name: Francesca Telese
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms underlying behavior using single cell genomics.
summary_zh: 使用单细胞基因组学研究行为的遗传和表观遗传机制。

name: Justin Trotter
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the molecular interactions between astrocytes and neurons in tripartite synapses, and how these interactions affect prosocial behaviors and psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究星形胶质细胞与神经元在三突触中的分子交互作用及其对亲社会行为和精神疾病的影响。

name: Miles Wilkinson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Sheng Zhong
title: Professor, Department of Bioengineering
summary: Studies genetic and genomic factors influencing behavior and regeneration using single-cell chromatin and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究单细胞染色质和基因组因素对行为和再生的影响，使用成像技术。

name: Yimin Zou
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using various NIH-funded projects.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知和神经机制，使用多项NIH资助的项目。

name: Stefano Anzellotti
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of person knowledge, including recognition of identity and facial expressions, using fMRI and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究人的知识的认知和神经基础，包括身份识别和面部表情，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算模型。

name: Diane-Jo Bart-Plange
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the dynamics between structural and individual racism, focusing on colorism and its gendered aspects, and how institutions reinforce racial hierarchies.
summary_zh: 研究结构层面与个体层面的种族主义动态，特别是肤色主义及其性别化特征，以及机构如何强化种族等级制度。

name: John Christianson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how stress affects social decision-making and brain circuits using behavioral paradigms, electrophysiology, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响社会决策和大脑电路，使用行为范式、电生理学和光遗传学方法。

name: Sara Cordes
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infants, children, and adults understand and process number, time, and quantity, linking these abilities to later mathematical skills and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿、儿童和成人如何理解和处理数量、时间和量，将这些能力与后来的数学技能和决策联系起来。

name: Elizabeth Kensinger
title: Professor
summary: Studies how emotional content affects memory vividness and accuracy, using behavioral testing and fMRI in young and older adults.
summary_zh: 研究情绪内容如何影响记忆的生动性和准确性，通过行为测试和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）在年轻和老年成人中进行研究。

name: Kengthsagn Louis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people's self-understanding affects health behaviors and healthcare interactions, developing interventions to reduce health disparities.
summary_zh: 研究人们自我理解如何影响健康行为和医疗互动，并开发减少健康不平等的干预措施。

name: Brooke Magnus
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and applies statistical methods for analyzing behavioral and health outcomes, including item response theory and categorical data analysis.
summary_zh: 开发和应用统计方法分析行为和健康结果，包括项目反应理论和分类数据分析。

name: Katherine McAuliffe
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children develop an understanding of cooperation norms and their enforcement, using cross-cultural comparisons.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展合作规范及其执行的理解，采用跨文化比较的方法。

name: Michael McDannald
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain computes and responds to threat, using neuronal signaling in the nucleus accumbens and other brain regions.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何计算和应对威胁，使用核杏仁核和其他脑区的神经信号传导机制。

name: Gorica Petrovich
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive and hedonic processes control the motivation to eat, using neural circuitry and plasticity mechanisms in male and female rats.
summary_zh: 研究认知和享乐过程如何控制进食动机，通过使用神经环路和可塑性机制在雄性和雌性大鼠中的研究。

name: Ehri Ryu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates statistical methods for analyzing multilevel multivariate data, focusing on structural equation modeling and its applications in various fields.
summary_zh: 开发和评估用于分析多层次多变量数据的统计方法，重点是结构方程模型及其在各个领域的应用。

name: Scott Slotnick
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual attention and memory using behavioral studies, computational modeling, fMRI, and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和记忆，使用行为研究、计算建模、fMRI 和 TMS 等方法。

name: Caroline Smith
title: Straus Family Sesquicentennial Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the nervous and immune systems interact during development, focusing on microglia, gut microbiome, and maternal toxicant exposure.
summary_zh: 研究发育过程中神经免疫系统的相互作用，特别是微胶质细胞、肠道微生物群以及母体暴露于环境毒素的影响。

name: Gregg Sparkman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies interventions for social change, examining motivations, social influence, and beliefs about change's possibility.
summary_zh: 研究社会变革的干预措施，探讨动机、社会影响以及对变革可能性的信念。

name: Momchil Tomov
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies computational cognitive neuroscience, focusing on the neural basis of cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究计算认知神经科学，关注认知过程的神经基础。

name: Liane Young
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of theory of mind in moral judgment, using fMRI and TMS, with a focus on cultural and individual differences.
summary_zh: 研究理论心智在道德判断中的作用，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅磁刺激（TMS），关注文化与个体差异。

name: Ali Banuazizi
title: Professor
summary: Studies not available.
summary_zh: 研究信息不足。

name: Jessica Black
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of humor processing and the impact of proximal and distal experiences on child and adolescent development, including sleep, family, school, and religion.
summary_zh: 研究幽默处理的神经基础以及周围近因和远因体验对儿童和青少年发展的影响，包括睡眠、家庭、学校和宗教。

name: Karen Adolph
title: Julius Silver Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how infants learn about the physical world through interaction, using experiments and observations.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿通过互动学习物理世界的认知过程，使用实验和观察方法。

name: Emily Balcetis
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how motivations and emotions influence perception and behavior, exploring visual and social perception biases.
summary_zh: 研究动机和情绪如何影响知觉和行为，探索视觉和社会知觉偏差。

name: Esti Blanco-Elorrieta
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how lexical access works and the core properties of language organization in monolingual and multilingual individuals using neuroimaging, computational, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究词汇检索机制和语言组织的基本属性，使用神经成像、计算和行为方法，涵盖单语和多语个体。

name: Marisa Carrasco
title: Julius Silver Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies visual perception and attention, developing models of visual search and attentional mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，开发视觉搜索和注意力机制的模型。

name: Andrei Cimpian
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children form explanations, understand natural kinds and social groups, and develop motivation and achievement in school.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何形成解释、理解自然种类和社会群体以及在学校中的动机和成就发展。

name: Clayton E Curtis
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how working memory functions and is affected by psychiatric and neurologic disorders using fMRI, TMS, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆的功能及其在精神和神经疾病中的影响，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和计算模型。

name: Moira Dillon
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies infants' and children's precocious knowledge about the world, using cognitive and developmental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童对世界的早期知识，使用认知和发展方法。

name: Ajua Duker
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how exposure to discrimination affects thinking, feeling, and behavior, and its impact on health.
summary_zh: 研究歧视经历如何影响思维、情感和行为，以及对其身心健康的影响。

name: Peter M Gollwitzer
title: Professor Of Psychology
summary: Studies how goals and plans influence thought, feeling, and action through self-regulation strategies, implementation intentions, and identity goals.
summary_zh: 研究目标和计划如何影响思维、情感和行为，通过自我调节策略、实施意图和身份目标。

name: Todd Gureckis
title: Professor of Psychology and Data Science
summary: Studies memory, learning, and decision processes through computational models to understand how people learn concepts and acquire skills.
summary_zh: 研究记忆、学习和决策过程的认知机制，通过计算模型理解人们如何学习概念和掌握技能。

name: Catherine Alexandra Hartley
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how cognitive, computational, and neural processes support adaptive motivated behavior through learning and decision-making, using neuroimaging, psychophysiology, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究认知、计算和神经过程如何通过学习和决策支持适应性动机行为，使用神经成像、生理心理学和计算建模方法。

name: David J. Heeger
title: Silver Professor
summary: Studies the computations performed by neural circuits in the brain, using normalization models and theoretical frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究大脑神经回路执行的计算，使用归一化模型和理论框架。

name: Mark Ho
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive, motivational, and social processes in human problem solving, using computational modeling and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类问题解决中的认知、动机和社会过程，使用计算建模和行为实验方法。

name: John Jost
title: Professor of Psychology and Politics
summary: Studies social and political behavior, including intergroup relations, political ideology, and system justification theory.
summary_zh: 研究社会和政治行为，包括群体关系、政治意识形态和系统正当化理论。

name: Eric Knowles
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how intergroup thought affects political attitudes and behavior, focusing on White Americans' ingroup and outgroup concerns.
summary_zh: 研究群体思维如何影响政治态度和行为，特别是白人美国人对群体内和群体外的关注。

name: Michael Landy
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies human perception and action using behavioral measurements, fMRI, and computational models, focusing on sensory decision-making, sensory cue integration, spatial vision, texture perception.
summary_zh: 研究人类知觉和动作，使用行为测量、功能性磁共振成像和计算模型，关注感觉决策、感觉线索整合、空间视觉、纹理知觉和视觉引导动作。

name: Grace Lindsay
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Data Science
summary: Studies how neural activity and architectures lead to perception, cognition, and action, using artificial neural networks inspired by biology.
summary_zh: 研究神经活动和架构如何导致知觉、认知和行为，使用受生物学启发的人工神经网络。

name: Wei Ji
title: Professor of Neural Science and Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making, planning, social cognition, working memory, and perception using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究决策制定、计划、社会认知、工作记忆和知觉，使用行为实验、计算建模和神经成像。

name: Laurence Maloney
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how organisms gather and act on information, focusing on visual perception, decision making, and movement planning.
summary_zh: 研究有机体如何收集和利用信息，重点在于视觉感知、决策制定和运动规划。

name: Alec Marantz
title: Silver Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of speech comprehension, focusing on morphological structure and lexical processing.
summary_zh: 研究语音理解的神经基础，重点关注形态结构和词汇处理。

name: Marcelo Mattar
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how the brain simulates past and future scenarios to make decisions, using models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何模拟过去和未来情景以做出决策，使用模型和神经成像技术。

name: Brian McElree
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies syntactic and thematic processing in sentence comprehension, with a focus on temporal dissociation and lexical preference effects.
summary_zh: 研究句子理解中的句法和主题处理，重点关注时间分离和词项偏好效应。

name: Sebastian Michelmann
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain represents and retrieves temporally dynamic information, using EEG, MEG, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表示和检索时间动态信息，使用脑电图（EEG）、磁源成像（MEG）和计算建模方法。

name: Michael Muthukrishna
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cultural evolution and behavioral science, including innovation, corruption, and artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 研究文化进化和行为科学，包括创新、腐败和人工智能。

name: Gabriele Oettingen
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies self-regulatory strategies for setting and disengaging from goals, using mental contrasting and implementation intentions.
summary_zh: 研究目标设定和脱离的自我调节策略，使用心理对比和意图实施技术。

name: Hannah Payne
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science & Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain forms and retrieves episodic memories in chickadees, focusing on the interplay between perception and memory.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类（黑头鸥）如何形成和检索情景记忆，重点关注感知与记忆之间的相互作用。

name: Denis Pelli
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies object recognition, focusing on feature detection and integration, particularly the phenomenon of crowding.
summary_zh: 研究物体识别，特别是特征检测和整合，尤其是拥挤现象。

name: David Poeppel
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies the neural basis of speech perception and auditory cognition using MEG, EEG, and fMRI, focusing on temporal mechanisms and multi-sensory integration.
summary_zh: 研究语音感知和听觉认知的神经基础，使用MEG、EEG和fMRI，关注时间机制和多感官整合。

name: Liina Pylkkänen
title: Professor of Linguistics and Psychology
summary: Studies the neural bases of syntactic and semantic processing, using MEG to understand how the brain builds complex meanings from simpler pieces.
summary_zh: 研究句法和语义加工的神经基础，使用MEG了解大脑如何从简单成分构建复杂意义。

name: Bob Rehder
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how causal knowledge influences reasoning and categorization, using computational models like causal graphical models.
summary_zh: 研究因果知识如何影响推理和分类，使用因果图形模型等计算模型。

name: Marjorie Rhodes
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Pablo Ripollés
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how music, reward, and memory interact, using brain imaging to understand cognitive processes involved in learning and aesthetic judgments.
summary_zh: 研究音乐、奖励和记忆之间的相互作用，使用脑成像技术探讨学习和审美判断中的认知过程。

name: Yaacov Trope
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people transcend their immediate concerns, self-control in decision-making, and the effects of emotions and desires on thinking and judgment.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何超越眼前关注、决策中的自我控制以及情绪和欲望对思维和判断的影响。

name: Jay Van Bavel
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how collective concerns shape the mind, brain, and behavior using a variety of methods.
summary_zh: 研究集体关注如何影响心理、大脑和行为，使用多种方法。

name: Jonathan Winawer
title: Professor of Psychology and Neural Science
summary: Studies how visual stimuli are encoded in the visual pathways and how this encoding relates to visual perception, using MRI, EEG, ECoG, and psychophysics.
summary_zh: 研究视觉刺激如何在视觉通路中编码以及这种编码如何影响视觉感知，使用MRI、EEG、ECoG和心理物理学方法。

name: Noga Zaslavsky
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies computational principles of language, learning, and reasoning using machine learning and information theory.
summary_zh: 研究语言、学习和推理的认知计算原理，使用机器学习和信息论方法。

name: Ned Block
title: Silver Professor
summary: Studies the philosophy of mind and neuroscience, exploring the relationship between mental states and brain processes.
summary_zh: 研究心灵哲学和神经科学，探讨心理状态与大脑过程之间的关系。

name: Francisco Castellanos
title: Child+Adol Psy, Professor, Medicine
summary: Studies child and adolescent psychology, focusing on cognitive and social development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年心理学，专注于认知和社会发展。

name: Sanes Dan
title: Professor of Neural Science and Biology
summary: Studies how social experience and hearing loss affect auditory perception and learning in gerbils, using wireless recording techniques.
summary_zh: 研究社会经验和听力损失对小鼠听力感知和学习的影响，使用无线记录技术。

name: Michael Hawken
title: Professor of Neural Science and Psychology
summary: Studies how visual perception is related to brain circuits in visual cortex, using connectomics, functional characterization, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知与视觉皮层神经回路的关系，使用连接组学、功能表征和计算建模方法。

name: Roozbeh Kiani
title: Associate Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how the nervous system integrates sensory information and memory to make decisions, using neural recording and manipulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何整合感官信息和记忆做出决策，使用神经记录和操控技术。

name: Joseph Ledoux
title: University Professor
summary: Studies the interaction of emotion, memory, and consciousness in the brain using peer-reviewed publications.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、记忆和意识在大脑中的相互作用，发表同行评议的出版物。

name: Tony Movshon
title: Silver Professor
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and decodes visual information, focusing on visual motion, form, and color processing in primates.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和解码视觉信息，特别是在灵长类动物中视觉运动、形状和颜色处理的功能。

name: Eero Simoncelli
title: Silver Professor
summary: Studies visual and auditory perception using computational and statistical methods.
summary_zh: 使用计算和统计方法研究视觉和听觉感知。

name: Wendy Suzuki
title: Professor of Neural Science and Psychology
summary: Studies how exercise affects learning, memory, and cognition, focusing on brain plasticity in the hippocampus and prefrontal cortex.
summary_zh: 研究运动对学习、记忆和认知的影响，重点关注海马和前额叶皮层的可塑性。

name: Cristina M. Alberini
title: Silver Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of long-term memory formation, storage, and reorganization, focusing on gene expression and memory reactivation.
summary_zh: 研究长期记忆形成、存储和重组的分子机制，重点关注基因表达和记忆重新激活。

name: Dora Angelaki
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how the brain integrates multi-sensory signals during navigation and decision-making, using naturalistic tasks and computational models in macaques and rodents.
summary_zh: 研究大脑在导航和决策过程中如何整合多感官信号，使用自然任务和计算模型在猕猴和啮齿动物中进行探索。

name: Chiye Aoki
title: Professor of Neural Science and Biology
summary: Studies the cellular mechanisms of resilience and vulnerability to mental illnesses in adolescents, focusing on synaptic plasticity in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus.
summary_zh: 研究青少年时期精神疾病易感性和复原力的细胞机制，重点在于前额叶皮层和海马体的突触可塑性。

name: Emily Bayer
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science and Biology
summary: Studies how visceral sensation affects behavior in C. elegans and D. cerebrum, focusing on how fertility status and sex differences influence neural mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究内脏感觉如何影响行为，特别是在秀丽隐杆线虫和透明鱼中的神经机制，重点关注繁殖状态和性别差异的影响。

name: Thomas J. Carew
title: Silver Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of memory formation in Aplysia, focusing on synaptic plasticity and growth factors.
summary_zh: 研究记忆形成中的分子和细胞机制，重点在于突触可塑性和生长因子，使用腹足类动物Aplysia作为模型。

name: Adam Carter
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies neural circuits in the prefrontal cortex, thalamus, and striatum, focusing on cognitive and motivated behaviors using electrophysiology, two-photon microscopy, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层、丘脑和纹状体中的神经回路，关注认知和动机行为，使用电生理学、双光子显微镜和光遗传学方法。

name: Rory Coleman
title: Assistant Professor of Biology and Neural Science
summary: Studies the genetic and neural mechanisms underlying behavioral innovation in Drosophila, using neurogenetic tools and comparative evolution.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇中行为创新的遗传和神经机制，使用神经遗传工具和比较进化方法。

name: Christine Constantinople
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the neural circuitry underlying decision-making, using electrophysiology, imaging, and optogenetics in rats.
summary_zh: 研究决策制定的神经环路机制，使用电生理学、成像和光遗传学技术在大鼠中进行研究。

name: André A. Fenton
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how brains store and retrieve memories, focusing on the molecular and neural mechanisms of long-term memory using electrophysiological and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何存储和检索记忆，重点在于长期记忆的分子和神经机制，使用电生理学和计算方法进行研究。

name: Paul Glimcher
title: Silver Professor of Neural Science, Psychology, and Economics
summary: Studies the neurobiological, economic, and psychological bases of human and animal decision-making, using tools from neuroscience, economics, and psychology.
summary_zh: 研究人类和动物决策的神经生物学、经济学和心理学基础，使用神经科学、经济学和心理学的方法。

name: Danique Jeurissen
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how the primate brain reroutes information to compensate for disruptions, using electrophysiology and behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类大脑在神经活动受阻时如何重新路由信息以进行补偿，使用电生理学和行为任务的方法。

name: Lynne Kiorpes
title: Professor of Neural Science and Psychology
summary: Studies the development of visual function in infants and the neural mechanisms underlying visual sensitivity, with a focus on amblyopia.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿视觉功能的发展及其神经机制，特别是弱视的神经过程和影响。

name: Eric Klann
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of translational control in the brain, focusing on synaptic plasticity and memory formation in mice, and how dysregulated mechanisms contribute to neurodevelopmental.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中翻译控制的分子机制，特别是在小鼠中的突触可塑性和记忆形成，以及这些机制失调如何导致神经发育和神经退行性疾病。

name: J. Anthony Movshon
title: University Professor
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and decodes visual information, focusing on visual motion, form, and color processing in primates.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和解码视觉信息，特别是在灵长类动物中视觉运动、形状和颜色处理的功能。

name: Anders Nelson
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how motor cortex neurons connect with spinal cord cells to control muscle activity and adapt to environmental changes, using anatomical tracing, RNA sequencing, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层神经元如何通过脊髓细胞控制肌肉活动并适应环境变化，使用解剖追踪、RNA 测序和光遗传学方法。

name: John Pearson
title: Associate Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the development and functional organization of the brain to understand complex natural behaviors, focusing on vocal learning and efficient coding in the retina.
summary_zh: 研究大脑的发展和功能组织以理解复杂自然行为，重点关注鸣禽的学习和视网膜的高效编码。

name: Alex Reyes
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the network mechanisms of sensory representation in cortex, focusing on the balance between excitation and inhibition, using experiments in cultures and in vivo, and theoretical analyses.
summary_zh: 研究感觉皮层中的网络机制，重点在于兴奋性和抑制性的平衡，使用体外和体内实验以及理论分析。

name: Erin Rich
title: Associate Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how neural activity in the prefrontal cortex supports decision-making and cognitive control, using behavioral tasks and neurophysiological recording.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层的神经活动如何支持决策和认知控制，使用行为任务和神经生理记录方法。

name: Dan Sanes
title: Professor of Neural Science and Biology
summary: Studies how early auditory experience and social learning impact perceptual and cognitive skills in gerbils, using behavioral tasks and auditory cortex recordings.
summary_zh: 研究早期听觉经验和社会学习对啮齿动物感知和认知技能的影响，使用行为任务和听皮层记录。

name: Cristina Savin
title: Associate Professor of Neural Science and Data Science
summary: Studies how learning and memory work through neural circuits and probabilistic computation.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆通过神经回路和概率计算的工作机制。

name: David Schneider
title: Associate Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies how the brain makes predictions about the acoustic consequences of movements, using both natural and engineered behaviors in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何预测动作的声学后果，使用啮齿动物的自然行为和工程化行为进行研究。

name: Robert Shapley
title: Natalie Clews Spencer Professor of the Sciences
summary: Studies visual physiology and perception, focusing on the primary visual cortex (V1) and color perception in the human visual cortex.
summary_zh: 研究视觉生理和知觉，重点在于初级视觉皮层（V1）和人类视觉皮层中的颜色知觉。

name: Lucas Tian
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science and Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies the neural and cognitive mechanisms of solving new problems through abstraction and recombination in behavior, computation, and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究解决问题的认知和神经机制，包括抽象和重组操作，涉及行为、计算和神经回路。

name: Xiao-Jing Wang
title: Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms and computational principles of cognitive processes like decision-making and working memory using theoretical and modeling approaches.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程（如决策和工作记忆）的神经机制和计算原理，采用理论和建模方法。

name: Alex Williams
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science
summary: Develops statistical models and computational tools to understand variability and flexibility in neural circuits during learning and development.
summary_zh: 开发统计模型和计算工具，以理解学习和发育过程中神经回路的可变性和灵活性。

name: Stephen X. Zhang
title: Assistant Professor of Neural Science
summary: Studies slow biochemical computation in the brain, using intracellular signaling molecules to influence neural activity and behavior over extended timescales.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的缓慢生物化学计算，使用细胞内信号分子影响神经活动和行为的长期变化。

name: Yadin Dudai
title: Global Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies mechanisms of learning and memory using various research methods.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的机制，使用多种研究方法。

name: Keith Maddox
title: Professor and Department Chair of Psychology
summary: Studies social cognitive aspects of stereotyping, prejudice, and discrimination, including skin tone and its impact on perceptions.
summary_zh: 研究刻板印象、偏见和歧视的认知方面，包括肤色对感知的影响。

name: Aerielle Allen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the antecedents and consequences of systemic racism in healthcare, criminal justice, and workplaces, using critical race frameworks.
summary_zh: 研究系统性种族主义在医疗保健、刑事司法和工作场所中的先兆和后果，使用批判性种族理论框架。

name: Stephanie Badde
title: Stibel Family Assistant Professor of Brain and Cognitive Science
summary: Studies how we integrate sensory information with prior knowledge to form a coherent perception of ourselves and the world, focusing on touch and body perception.
summary_zh: 研究如何将感官信息与先验知识整合以形成对自身和世界的连贯感知，重点关注触觉和身体感知。

name: J.P. de Ruiter
title: Professor of Psychology and Computer Science
summary: Studies the cognitive foundations of human communication, focusing on language, gesture, and multimodal signals in conversation.
summary_zh: 研究人类交流的认知基础，重点关注语言、手势和其他多模态信号在对话中的作用。

name: Ariel Goldberg
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how words are represented and organized in the mind, focusing on signed and spoken language, and how this affects language production and comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究单词在大脑中的表示和组织方式，特别是在手语和口语中的应用，以及这些如何影响语言生产和理解。

name: Xandra Kredlow
title: Dean of Arts and Sciences Assistant Professor
summary: Studies methods to harness memory processes for developing interventions for emotional disorders like anxiety and trauma.
summary_zh: 研究利用记忆过程的方法，开发治疗情绪障碍（如焦虑和创伤）的新干预措施。

name: Gina Kuperberg
title: Dennett Stibel Professor of Cognitive Science
summary: Studies how the human brain builds up the meaning of sentences, stories, and images using ERP and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何构建句子、故事和图像的意义，使用ERP和fMRI等多模态神经成像技术。

name: Paul Muentener
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants and toddlers reason causally and explore play, children and adults' causal language and events, and adults' beliefs about cognitive development, using looking time, actions, and.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的因果推理和探索性玩耍，儿童和成人对事件和因果语言的表征，以及成人对认知发展的信念，使用注视时间、行为和语言等方法。

name: Aniruddh Patel
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mental processes involved in making, perceiving, and responding to music, including music-language relations, rhythmic processing, and cross-species studies.
summary_zh: 研究音乐认知中的心理过程，包括音乐与语言的关系、节奏处理以及跨物种的音乐认知研究。

name: Elizabeth Race
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of human learning, memory, and cognitive control, using fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习、记忆和认知控制的认知和神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和脑电图(EEG)。

name: Jessica Remedios
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the impact of stereotypes on stigmatized group members, focusing on how people with multiple stigmatized identities are perceived and cope with discrimination.
summary_zh: 研究刻板印象对多重受歧视群体成员的影响，关注这些人如何被他人感知以及如何应对多重歧视带来的心理和行为后果。

name: Lisa Shin
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain function and cognition in patients with anxiety disorders, especially PTSD, using fMRI and PET.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和正电子发射断层扫描（PET）研究焦虑障碍患者，尤其是 PTSD 患者的脑功能和认知。

name: Holly Taylor
title: Moses Hunt Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how information sources and experiences influence the development of mental models, particularly in spatial cognition and education.
summary_zh: 研究信息来源和经验如何影响心理模型的发展，特别是在空间认知和教育方面的应用。

name: Ayanna Thomas
title: Professor and Dean of the Graduate School of Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how memory failures occur in different contexts, focusing on the accessibility of memory elements during retrieval.
summary_zh: 研究记忆失败在不同情境下的发生机制，关注记忆元素在检索过程中的可访问性。

name: Heather Urry
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people experience, express, and regulate their emotions using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们的情绪体验、表达和调节机制，采用多种方法。

name: Nathan Ward
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people manage multiple streams of information, using cognitive mechanisms like task switching and dual tasking in both lab and real-world settings.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何处理多条信息流，使用任务切换和双任务等认知机制，在实验室和实际场景中进行考察。

name: Marcus Weera
title: Evans Family Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of substance misuse and addiction, focusing on how traumatic stress alters brain function and susceptibility to alcohol misuse.
summary_zh: 研究物质滥用和成瘾的神经生物学机制，特别是创伤性压力如何改变大脑功能和对酒精滥用的易感性。

name: Peter Blake
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children decide when to share or compete for resources, using game theory experiments with candy and stickers.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在资源分配中何时分享或竞争的认知和社会过程，使用糖果和贴纸的游戏理论实验。

name: Catherine Caldwell-Harris
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotional aspects of language, second language acquisition, and word recognition, using techniques like repetition blindness and skin conductance responses.
summary_zh: 研究语言的情感方面、二语习得和词识别，使用重复盲视和皮肤电反应等技术。

name: Chandramouli Chandrasekaran
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sensory inputs and makes decisions, using electrophysiological and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理复杂的感觉输入并做出决策，使用电生理学和计算方法。

name: Rachel Denison
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain generates ongoing perceptual experience, focusing on visual perception, attention, and decision-making using behavioral and neural measurements.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何生成持续的知觉体验，重点关注视觉感知、注意力和决策过程，使用行为和神经测量方法。

name: Michael Hasselmo
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cortical dynamics of memory-guided behavior, using neurophysiological techniques and computational modeling in rats.
summary_zh: 研究记忆引导行为的皮层动态，使用神经生理学技术和计算建模方法在大鼠中进行。

name: Marc Howard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops mathematical models of episodic memory and evaluates them with behavioral and neurophysiological data, covering statistical learning and reward systems.
summary_zh: 开发情景记忆的数学模型，并通过行为和神经生理数据进行评估，涵盖统计学习和奖赏系统。

name: Mark Howe
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural circuit principles in the basal ganglia for adaptive behavior using two-photon microscopy, fiber photometry, and electrophysiology in mice.
summary_zh: 研究基底节的神经环路原则以适应行为，使用双光子显微镜、光纤光度计和电生理学技术在小鼠中进行。

name: Deborah Kelemen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children develop concepts of the natural and artificial world, focusing on religious and scientific theory-formation, object categorization, and social learning.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展对自然和人造世界的概念，重点关注宗教和科学理论形成、物体分类和社会学习。

name: Melissa Kibbe
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants, children, and adults process and store visual information, focusing on object representations, working memory, and cognitive interactions.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿、儿童和成人如何处理和存储视觉信息，重点在于对象表征、工作记忆和认知交互。

name: Arthur Lee
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies mental states through neural patterns and predicts behaviors using functional neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 通过神经模式解码心理状态，并使用功能性神经影像学方法预测行为。

name: Sam Ling
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Brain, Behavior, & Cognition Program Director
summary: Studies how attention filters visual information by altering basic brain response properties, using psychophysics, computational modeling, TMS, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究注意如何通过改变基本的脑反应属性来过滤视觉信息，采用心理物理学、计算建模、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）的方法。

name: Qimin Liu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies emotional disturbances in adults, focusing on affective phenomenology, statistical methods, and intersectional marginalization.
summary_zh: 研究成人情绪障碍，关注情感现象学、统计方法和交叉边缘化。

name: Kristin Long
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the reciprocal influences between a child’s medical illness or disability and their family and cultural context, focusing on health disparities in autism diagnosis and treatment.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的医学疾病或残疾与其家庭和文化背景之间的相互影响，重点关注自闭症诊断和治疗中的健康不平等。

name: Tara Mandalaywala
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children and nonhuman animals reason about social status and essentialist beliefs, using developmental psychology and comparative methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和非人类动物如何根据社会地位和本质主义信念进行推理，使用发展心理学和比较方法。

name: Joseph McGuire
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
areas: Forming and revising expectations in an uncertain world
Weighing the cost of mental effort
summary: Studies how the brain represents subjective value and economic utility, and how these processes relate to self-control and decision-making under uncertainty.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表征主观价值和经济效用，以及这些过程如何与自我控制和不确定性下的决策相关。

name: Samuel Meisel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social relationships influence adolescent substance use, using developmental science to improve treatments.
summary_zh: 研究社交关系如何影响青少年物质滥用，并利用发展科学改进治疗方法。

name: Heidi Meyer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Kate Nussenbaum
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies developmental changes in value-guided learning, memory, and exploration using behavioral tasks and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究从儿童到成年时期的价值导向学习、记忆和探索的发展变化，使用行为任务和fMRI。

name: Michael Otto
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops and validates new psychosocial treatments for mood, anxiety, and substance use disorders, focusing on brain-behavior relationships in therapeutic learning.
summary_zh: 开发和验证针对情绪障碍、焦虑障碍和物质使用障碍的新心理社会治疗方法，关注治疗学习中的脑-行为关系。

name: Tibor Palfai
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops psychological interventions to reduce health risk behaviors, focusing on web and mobile-based interventions for substance use and screening in medical settings.
summary_zh: 开发心理干预措施以减少健康风险行为，重点关注基于网络和移动设备的干预措施以减少物质使用，并在医疗环境中进行筛查。

name: Donna Pincus
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Master’s Program Director
summary: Studies children's fears and anxieties, developing treatments and examining coping with stress and medical conditions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童恐惧和焦虑，开发治疗方法并探讨应对压力和医疗条件的心理因素。

name: Yakeel Quiroz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies early cognitive and biological markers of Alzheimer’s disease in families with autosomal dominant Alzheimer’s disease, focusing on identifying protective mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病早期认知和生物标志物，特别是在携带早发性常染色体显性遗传阿尔茨海默病突变的家庭中，寻找保护机制。

name: Steve Ramirez
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how memories are formed and retrieved, using optogenetics and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的形成与检索，使用光遗传学和行为实验方法。

name: Robert M. G. Reinhart
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural rhythms and mechanisms underlying human cognition, using electrophysiology, neuroimaging, and neuromodulation to enhance cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知背后的神经节奏和机制，使用电生理学、神经成像和神经调节技术来增强认知功能。

name: Kimberly Saudino
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of infant and child temperament, focusing on activity level and the genetic and environmental factors influencing it.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童气质的发展，特别是活动水平，并探讨遗传和环境因素的影响。

name: Benjamin Scott
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops and applies new technologies to study the neural basis of cognition and complex learned behavior, combining biomedical engineering and neuroethology.
summary_zh: 开发和应用新技术研究认知和复杂学习行为的神经基础，结合生物医学工程和神经生态学。

name: David Somers
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the brain circuits supporting visual perception and cognition using fMRI, psychophysics, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像、心理物理学和计算建模研究支持视觉感知和认知的大脑电路。

name: Amelia Stanton
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies psychological barriers to sexual and reproductive health, focusing on marginalized populations and developing interventions.
summary_zh: 研究性与生殖健康的心理障碍，重点关注边缘化群体，并开发干预措施。

name: Chantal Stern
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies how the brain encodes, stores, and recognizes visual, spatial, and verbal information using fMRI, with a focus on memory processes and aging.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码、存储和识别视觉、空间和语言信息，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI），重点关注记忆过程和老化。

name: Amanda Tarullo
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how early life stress affects infant brain development and predicts later socio-emotional and cognitive outcomes using EEG.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力对婴儿大脑发展的影响及其与后期社会情感和认知结果的关系，使用EEG进行测量。

name: Nicholas Wagner
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Developmental Science Program Director
summary: Studies the impact of early relationships on children’s social and emotional development, focusing on self-regulation and psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究早期关系对儿童社会和情绪发展的影响，重点关注自我调节和心理障碍。

name: Helen Barbas
title: Professor
summary: Studies the organization of the prefrontal cortex and its role in central executive functions in primates, using neural tracers and imaging.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类前额叶皮层的组织及其在中央执行功能中的作用，使用神经示踪剂和成像技术。

name: Rhoda Au
title: Professor, Anatomy and Neurobiology
summary: Studies cognitive aging and dementia using multi-sensory brain health monitoring technologies.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化和痴呆症，使用多感官脑健康监测技术。

name: Camron Bryant
title: Associate Professor, Molecular Genetics of Addiction
summary: Studies genetic mechanisms of addiction, focusing on signaling pathways and conditioned behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾的遗传机制，重点关注信号通路和条件行为。

name: Gail Carpenter
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neural models derive consistent knowledge from inconsistent information, using computational analysis and dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 研究神经模型如何从不一致的信息中提取一致的知识，使用计算分析和动力系统方法。

name: Jerry Chen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between local circuits and long-range networks in the mammalian neocortex using large-scale in vivo imaging and molecular tools.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物新皮层局部回路与长距离网络之间的关系，使用大规模在体成像技术和分子工具。

name: Michael Cohen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech and language processing using neural modeling and dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 研究语音和语言处理，使用神经建模和动力系统方法。

name: Pietro Cottone
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological bases of stress-related disorders and eating behaviors, using animal models and molecular approaches.
summary_zh: 研究压力相关障碍和进食行为的神经生物学基础，使用动物模型和分子方法。

name: Ian Davison
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits underlying perception and behavior in the olfactory system, using genetic tools and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究嗅觉系统中感知和行为的神经回路，使用基因工具和电生理学方法。

name: Brian DePasquale
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops mathematical models to understand how populations of neurons perform computations for behavior, using both data-driven and theoretical approaches.
summary_zh: 开发数学模型以理解神经元群体如何进行计算以产生行为，采用数据驱动和理论两种方法。

name: Anna Devor
title: Professor, Imaging Neural circuits, Neurovascular coupling, Neurophysiological underpinning of fMRI
summary: Studies brain activity across scales, from cellular to macroscopic, using imaging and modeling techniques.
summary_zh: 研究从细胞到宏观尺度的大脑活动，使用成像和建模技术。

name: Michael Economo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling movement using optical, electrophysiological, and genetic tools.
summary_zh: 研究控制运动的神经回路，使用光学、电生理和遗传工具进行记录和操控神经活动。

name: Uri Tzvi Eden
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods to analyze neural spiking activity, integrating model identification and signal processing to dynamically model individual and ensemble neuron properties.
summary_zh: 开发统计方法分析神经放电活动，整合模型识别和信号处理技术，动态建模单个和神经元群的性质。

name: David Farb
title: Professor, Cognitive Enhancers, Alzheimer’s Disease, In Vivo Electrophysiology
summary: Studies cognitive enhancers for Alzheimer’s disease using in vivo electrophysiology to assess hippocampal systems.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的认知增强剂，使用体内电生理学评估海马系统。

name: Simone Gill
title: Associate Professor, Walking and Motor Functioning
summary: Studies how individuals' bodies and environmental demands influence walking and motor functioning across the lifespan, using motion capture and wearable technology.
summary_zh: 研究个体的身体特征和环境需求如何影响其一生中的行走和运动功能，使用动作捕捉和可穿戴技术。

name: Frank Guenther
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural computations underlying speech motor control using theoretical modeling, behavioral experiments, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究语音运动控制的神经计算，使用理论建模、行为实验和神经成像。

name: Xue Han
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural circuitry and neuromodulation therapies for brain disorders using optogenetics and deep brain stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和神经调节疗法治疗脑部疾病，使用光遗传学和深脑刺激技术。

name: Angela Ho
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of neuron movement and brain development, and the cell biology of amyloid peptides in Alzheimer’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究神经元迁移和大脑发育的分子机制以及阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样肽的细胞生物学。

name: Allyn Hubbard
title: Professor
summary: Studies the electromechanical properties of the cochlea and models auditory function, applying microcircuit technology to brain probes and neuromorphic computer architectures.
summary_zh: 研究耳蜗的电磁机械特性并建模听觉功能，应用微电路技术到脑探针和类脑计算机架构。

name: Kathleen Kantak
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive aspects of addiction-related behavior using animal models and translational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾相关行为的认知方面，使用动物模型和转化方法。

name: Terrence Keane
title: Professor
summary: Studies PTSD, using research methods in psychiatry and clinical psychology.
summary_zh: 研究 PTSD，采用精神病学和临床心理学的方法。

name: Gerald Kidd
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes complex sounds in noisy environments and how hearing loss affects sound discrimination and auditory processing.
summary_zh: 研究大脑在嘈杂环境中处理复杂声音的方式以及听力损失如何影响声音辨别和听觉处理。

name: Swathi Kiran
title: Professor
summary: Studies language recovery in aphasia, using functional neuroimaging to understand impairments in naming, reading, and writing.
summary_zh: 研究失语症的语言恢复，使用功能性神经影像学理解命名、阅读和书写障碍。

name: Vijaya B. Kolachala
title: Associate Professor, Medicine
summary: Develops software frameworks for dementia screening and clinical-grade digital pathology tools, focusing on domain generalization and representation learning.
summary_zh: 开发用于痴呆筛查的软件框架和临床级数字病理学工具，重点在于领域泛化和表示学习。

name: Mark Kon
title: Professor
summary: Studies machine learning and quantum probability in bioinformatics and computational biology, focusing on gene regulatory networks and cancer identification.
summary_zh: 研究机器学习和量子概率在生物信息学和计算生物学中的应用，特别是在基因调控网络和癌症识别方面。

name: Nancy Kopell
title: Professor, Computational Neuroscience & Dynamic Brain Rhythms
summary: Studies how the brain produces its dynamics, how brain rhythms contribute to cognition, and how pathologies of brain dynamics relate to neurological diseases and altered states of consciousness.
summary_zh: 研究大脑动态的产生机制，脑节奏在认知中的作用，以及脑动态病理如何与神经疾病和意识改变相关。

name: Mark Kramer
title: Professor
summary: Studies biophysical models of neural activity and data analysis techniques, with a focus on medical applications.
summary_zh: 研究神经活动的生物物理模型和数据分析技术，重点关注医学应用。

name: Kimberly Leite-Morris
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurochemical mechanisms of ethanol and substance abuse, using rodent models and in vivo microdialysis.
summary_zh: 研究乙醇和物质滥用的神经化学机制，使用啮齿动物模型和在 vivo 微透析方法。

name: Laura Lewis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain dynamically shifts its functional properties, using computational and signal processing approaches to analyze neuroimaging data at subsecond timescales.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何动态改变其功能属性，使用计算和信号处理方法分析神经成像数据的亚秒级时间尺度。

name: Michael Lyons
title: Professor
summary: Studies genetic influences on psychopathology, substance abuse, and aging using twin studies and MRI.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍、物质滥用和衰老的遗传影响，使用双胞胎研究和MRI。

name: Hengye Man
title: Professor
summary: Studies synaptic plasticity, AMPA receptor trafficking, homeostatic synaptic plasticity, and autism spectrum disorders using molecular and cellular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性、AMPA受体转运、稳态突触可塑性和自闭症谱系障碍，采用分子和细胞技术。

name: Melanie Matthies
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of hearing in adult speech motor control using various listener groups, including cochlear implant recipients and elderly subjects.
summary_zh: 研究听力在成人发音运动控制中的作用，使用各种听者群体，包括人工耳蜗植入者和老年人。

name: Maria Medalla
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the interaction and control of distinct limbic, sensory, and motor networks by the prefrontal cortex in primates, using electrophysiological and anatomical techniques.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物边缘、感觉和运动网络如何由前额叶皮层调控，采用电生理和解剖学技术。

name: Tara Moore
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies recovery of fine motor function and re-organization of the motor cortex after cortical injury in non-human primates, using exosomes and therapeutics.
summary_zh: 研究非人灵长类动物皮层损伤后的精细运动功能恢复和运动皮层重组，使用外泌体和治疗性药物。

name: Hamid Nawab
title: Professor (ECE)
summary: Studies complex signal processing for biosignals, integrating artificial intelligence and signal interpretation.
summary_zh: 研究生物信号的复杂信号处理，结合人工智能和信号解释。

name: Gabriel Ocker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how neural activity encodes sensory information and drives behavior using models of neuronal networks and dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 研究神经活动如何编码感官信息并驱动行为，使用神经网络模型和动力系统工具。

name: Tyler Perrachione
title: Assistant Professor, Developmental Disorders
areas: Human voice recognition and social auditory perception
Mechanisms of plasticity in human auditory cortex
summary: Studies the brain bases of complex auditory processing, including speech and voice perception, and mechanisms of plasticity in the human auditory cortex, particularly in developmental disorders like.
summary_zh: 研究复杂听觉处理的脑基础，包括语音和声音感知，以及人类听皮层可塑性的机制，特别是在发育障碍如阅读障碍中的应用。

name: Wendy Qiu
title: Professor, Alzheimer’s Disease
summary: Studies the fundamental causational mechanisms of Alzheimer’s disease and seeks biomarkers for diagnosis and treatment.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的基本致病机制，并寻找诊断和治疗的精神疾病生物标志物。

name: Douglas Rosene
title: Professor, Cognitive Decline & Aging
summary: Studies cognitive aging and recovery of motor function after stroke in rhesus monkeys, using MRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化和中风后精细运动功能恢复的神经生物学基础，使用MRI和行为实验在恒河猴模型中进行研究。

name: Jean-Pierre Roussarie
title: Assistant Professor, Anatomy & Neurobiology
summary: Studies the early stages of Alzheimer’s disease in the entorhinal cortex, focusing on layer II neurons and their molecular characteristics.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病早期阶段内嗅皮层的层II神经元及其分子特征。

name: R. J. Rushmore III
title: Assistant Professor, Visual Neglect
summary: Studies brain function and restoration after injury, focusing on cortical spreading depression and visual neglect.
summary_zh: 研究脑功能和损伤后的恢复，重点关注皮层扩散抑郁和视觉忽视。

name: Valentina Sabino
title: Associate Professor, Addiction and Anxiety
summary: Studies the neurobiology of addiction and stress-related disorders, focusing on alcohol abuse and anxiety, using animal models and interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾和压力相关障碍（如酒精滥用和焦虑）的神经生物学机制，采用动物模型和跨学科方法。

name: Karin Schon
title: Associate Professor, Brain Health & Human Brain Imaging
summary: Studies the effects of aerobic exercise on cognitive function and brain health in aging and Alzheimer’s disease using MRI, behavioral tests, and biomarker assays.
summary_zh: 研究有氧运动对衰老和阿尔茨海默病认知功能和脑健康的影响，使用MRI、行为测试和生物标志物分析。

name: Kamal Sen
title: Associate Professor, Neural coding of sound
summary: Studies how neurons encode complex natural sounds, using electrophysiological techniques and theoretical methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经元如何编码复杂自然声音，使用电生理技术和理论方法。

name: Cassandra Smith
title: Professor, Schizophrenia, Autism, Epigenetics, Metabolomics
summary: Studies genetic and molecular factors in schizophrenia and autism, focusing on epigenetics and metabolomics.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和自闭症的遗传和分子因素，重点关注表观遗传学和代谢组学。

name: Matthias Stangl
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the human brain supports cognitive functions like spatial navigation and memory, using deep brain recordings, fMRI, and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持空间导航和记忆等认知功能，采用深部脑电记录、功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和脑电图(EEG)等方法。

name: Emily Stephen
title: Assistant Professor, Statistical Neuroscience
summary: Studies how electrical and magnetic fields propagate in the brain, using statistical models to bridge spatial scales.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中电场和磁场的传播，使用统计模型跨越空间尺度。

name: Cara Stepp
title: Professor, Sensorimotor Function Disorders
summary: Studies disordered human communication, applying engineering tools to better understand and rehabilitate voice and speech systems.
summary_zh: 研究人类沟通障碍，应用工程工具更好地理解并康复语音和言语系统。

name: Robert Stern
title: Professor, Alzheimer’s Disease & Brain Trauma
summary: Studies the long-term effects of repetitive brain trauma in athletes, focusing on diagnosing and treating CTE and Alzheimer’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究运动员反复脑创伤的长期影响，重点在于诊断和治疗CTE和阿尔茨海默病。

name: Helen Tager-Flusberg
title: Professor, Autism
summary: Studies the early behavioral and brain development in infants at risk for autism, comparing autism and specific language impairment in children, and examines minimally verbal children with autism.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症风险婴儿的早期行为和大脑发育，比较自闭症与特定语言障碍儿童的行为和功能性磁共振成像，以及研究自闭症的最小语言能力儿童。

name: Louis Toth
title: Assistant Professor, Visual Pathway
summary: Studies the physiology of information transmission in the normal mammalian brain using imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究正常哺乳动物大脑中信息传递的生理机制，使用成像技术。

name: James Traniello
title: Professor, Behavioral Ecology
summary: Studies the neurobiology of social behavior in ants, using immunohistochemistry and pharmacological interventions to understand collective intelligence and brain evolution.
summary_zh: 研究蚂蚁的社会行为的神经生物学，使用免疫组织化学和药理学干预来理解集体智能和大脑进化。

name: Lucia Vaina
title: Professor, Computational Visual Neuroscience
summary: Studies visual motion analysis in the human brain using computational, psychophysical, and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑中的视觉运动分析，使用计算、心理物理学和神经影像学方法。

name: Mieke Verfaellie
title: Professor, Memory Disorders
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of human memory through patients with memory disorders and individuals with intact memory.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的认知和神经基础，通过记忆障碍患者和记忆正常个体进行研究。

name: Michael Wallace
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how specific circuits in the basal ganglia guide motivated behaviors and control motor actions using electrophysiology and in vivo optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究基底节特定回路如何指导动机行为和控制运动动作，使用电生理学和体内光遗传学技术。

name: Gloria Waters
title: Faculty
summary: Studies language and memory processes, using federal and foundation grants.
summary_zh: 研究语言和记忆过程，使用联邦和基金会资助。

name: Meg Younger
title: Assistant Professor, Odorant Receptors, Chemosensation, Mosquitoes, Calcium Imaging, Neurophysiology, Behavior
summary: Studies how mosquitoes detect and encode human odors, using calcium imaging and neurophysiology to understand biting behavior.
summary_zh: 研究蚊子如何检测和编码人类气味，使用钙成像和神经生理学方法理解叮咬行为。

name: Venetia Zachariou
title: Professor, Molecular mechanisms of chronic pain
summary: Investigates molecular mechanisms of chronic pain using genomic analysis, genetic mouse models, and epigenetic studies.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛的分子机制，使用基因组分析、遗传小鼠模型和表观遗传学研究。

name: Basilis Zikopoulos
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the structural organization and connections of brain circuits in humans and animal models, using microscopy and imaging to understand neuropathology in attention, mood, and anxiety disorders.
summary_zh: 研究人类和动物模型的大脑回路的结构组织和连接，使用显微镜和成像技术来理解注意、情绪和焦虑障碍等神经病理学。

name: Jennifer Zuk
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies factors in early childhood that shape speech, language, and reading acquisition, using behavioral and neuroimaging tools.
summary_zh: 研究早期儿童因素如何塑造语言、阅读能力的发展，使用行为和神经成像工具。

name: Kirsten C.S. Adam
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how visual attention and working memory function using EEG, fMRI, and behavioral measures.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和工作记忆的功能，使用EEG、fMRI和行为测量方法。

name: James W Antony
title: Assistant professor (starting July 2027)
summary: Studies how memories persist, focusing on reactivation during sleep and wake, and factors at encoding such as surprise and interactions among memories.
summary_zh: 研究记忆如何持久存在，重点关注睡眠和清醒期间的记忆重新激活以及编码时的惊喜和记忆间相互作用等因素。

name: Karen Bales
title: Professor
summary: Studies the physiology, neurobiology, and development of social bonding in prairie voles, titi monkeys, and seahorses, focusing on neuropeptides like oxytocin and vasopressin.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物（如铜猴）、原田鼠和海马的社会依恋的生理学、神经生物学和发育机制，重点关注神经肽如催产素和血管加压素的作用。

name: Emorie D Beck
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies personality as a complex, nonlinear dynamic system, using experience sampling, machine learning, and longitudinal data.
summary_zh: 研究个性作为复杂的非线性动态系统，使用体验抽样、机器学习和纵向数据。

name: Eliza Bliss-Moreau
title: Chancellor's Leadership Professor
summary: Studies the biological underpinnings of affective development from womb-to-tomb using multi-method, multi-species approaches.
summary_zh: 研究从子宫到成年的情绪发展生物学基础，采用多方法、多物种的综合方法。

name: Shelley Blozis
title: Professor
summary: Develops statistical methods for analyzing clustered, repeated measures, and longitudinal data, with applications in health and social psychology.
summary_zh: 开发用于分析嵌套、重复测量和纵向数据的统计方法，并应用于健康和社会心理学。

name: Lindsay Bowman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social cognition develops, using EEG, ERP, and fNIRS to examine neural correlates in infants and children.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知的发展，使用EEG、ERP和fNIRS来考察婴儿和儿童时期的神经相关性。

name: Paul Eastwick
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people form and maintain romantic relationships, focusing on ideal partner preferences and relationship development.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何建立和维持浪漫关系，重点关注理想伴侣偏好和关系发展。

name: Fernanda Ferreira
title: Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of language processing, using behavioral and neural measures in psycholinguistics.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理的机制，使用行为和神经测量方法在心理语言学中。

name: Emilio Ferrer
title: Professor
summary: Develops methods to analyze change and intra-individual variability, focusing on latent growth analysis and dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 发展方法以分析变化和个体内部变异性，特别是潜在线性增长分析和动力系统。

name: Andrew Fox
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of affective style, focusing on dispositional anxiety in humans and nonhuman primates using neuroimaging and RNA-sequencing.
summary_zh: 研究情感风格的神经生物学，重点关注人类和非人灵长类动物的固有焦虑，使用神经成像和RNA测序方法。

name: Joy J Geng
title: Professor
summary: Studies how goal-directed and sensory-driven information are integrated to determine perception, using fMRI and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究目标导向和感觉驱动信息如何整合以确定知觉，使用功能性磁共振成像和眼动追踪技术。

name: Simona Ghetti
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of memory and metamemory in children using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童记忆和元记忆的发展，使用行为和神经影像学方法。

name: Katharine Graf Estes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants learn words from statistical regularities in language, using experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过语言中的统计规律学习单词，使用婴儿实验方法。

name: Paul D. Hastings
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of physiological, social, and emotional functioning from early childhood into adulthood, exploring factors like context, nurture, and nature.
summary_zh: 研究从幼儿期到成年期的生理、社会和情绪功能的发展，探索如环境、养育和先天等因素的影响。

name: John M. Henderson
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how information about the visual world is acquired, identified, and retained in memory, focusing on visual attention and scene perception.
summary_zh: 研究视觉世界信息的获取、识别和记忆保留，重点关注视觉注意和场景感知。

name: Camelia E. Hostinar
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how early-life stress influences later health and development, focusing on stress-response systems and protective factors.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响后期发展和健康，重点关注压力反应系统和保护性因素。

name: Petr Janata
title: Professor
summary: Studies the psychological and neural mechanisms of strong experiences with music, such as music-evoked remembering and feeling 'in the groove', using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究音乐引发的强烈体验的心理和神经机制，如音乐唤起的记忆和‘入迷’的感觉，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Erin Kinnally
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the developmental interactions between genes and environment in non-human primates, focusing on epigenetics and early experiences.
summary_zh: 研究基因和环境在非人灵长类动物发育中的相互作用，重点关注表观遗传学和早期经历。

name: Kristin H. Lagattuta
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies how children and adults understand connections between mental states and emotions, and how life experiences influence reasoning and emotional reactions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何理解情绪与心理状态之间的联系，以及生活经历如何影响推理和情绪反应。

name: Alison Ledgerwood
title: Professor and Chancellor's Fellow
summary: Studies how people's attitudes and experiences are shaped by social context, focusing on when and why people get stuck in negative or positive thinking patterns.
summary_zh: 研究社会环境如何塑造人们的态度和体验，重点关注人们何时以及为何陷入消极或积极的思维模式。

name: Steve Luck
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies basic mechanisms of attention and working memory in healthy individuals, and examines cognitive dysfunction in psychiatric and neurological disorders using behavioral methods, eye tracking.
summary_zh: 研究健康个体注意力和工作记忆的基本机制，并使用行为方法、眼动追踪和ERP记录研究神经精神疾病中的认知功能障碍。

name: Ariel Mosley
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how group members navigate social identities and respond to intergroup inequalities, using experimental designs and intersectionality.
summary_zh: 研究群体成员如何导航社会身份并应对群体间不平等，使用实验设计和交集身份理论。

name: Yuko Munakata
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive, neural, and computational processes supporting executive functions and variations in thinking across diverse contexts.
summary_zh: 研究认知、神经和计算过程如何支持执行功能和思维在不同环境下的变化。

name: Lisa Oakes
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the development of cognitive abilities in infancy, focusing on the interaction between motor, language, and visual abilities.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿期认知能力的发展，重点关注运动、语言和视觉能力之间的相互作用。

name: Jonathan J. Park
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies dynamic patterns of behavior and mood over time, using statistical models to identify key patterns in individual networks.
summary_zh: 研究行为和情绪随时间动态变化的模式，使用统计模型识别个体网络中的关键模式。

name: Luis Parra
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the biopsychosocial health of sexual and gender minority adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on minority stress and intersectionality.
summary_zh: 研究性少数和性别少数青少年及成人的生物心理社会健康，重点关注少数群体压力和交叉性理论。

name: Charan Ranganath
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of human memory and executive control using functional neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 使用功能性神经成像和行为方法研究人类记忆和执行控制的神经基础。

name: Philippe Rast
title: Professor
summary: Develops and applies statistical models to estimate developmental change and individual differences in cognitive processes and emotion over time.
summary_zh: 开发和应用统计模型来估计认知过程和情绪随时间的变化及其个体差异。

name: Mijke Rhemtulla
title: Professor
summary: Develops and studies methods and models within the SEM framework, focusing on practical issues such as fitting models to ordinal and incomplete data.
summary_zh: 开发和研究结构方程模型（SEM）框架内的方法和模型，重点关注如何将模型拟合到序数和不完整数据的问题。

name: Richard W. Robins
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of personality, self-esteem, and social emotions in Mexican-origin youth using longitudinal and experimental designs.
summary_zh: 研究墨西哥裔青少年个性、自尊和社会情绪的发展，采用纵向和实验设计。

name: Jeffrey Schank
title: Professor
summary: Studies how complex social behaviors emerge from simple individual rules using agent-based models.
summary_zh: 使用基于代理的模型研究复杂社会行为如何从简单的个体规则中涌现。

name: Joanna Scheib
title: Professor
summary: Studies the experiences of families and individuals involved in donor conception, including intended parents, donors, and donor-conceived people, to inform policy and support.
summary_zh: 研究捐精受精家庭成员的经历，包括预期父母、捐精者和捐精受精者，以指导政策制定和支持措施。

name: Jeff Sherman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people perceive themselves, others, and groups, focusing on the acquisition and control of stereotypes and prejudice.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何看待自己、他人和群体，重点关注刻板印象和偏见的形成及其控制。

name: Danielle Stolzenberg
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of parental behavior, focusing on epigenetic mechanisms that make mothers more sensitive to infants.
summary_zh: 研究母性行为的神经生物学，重点关注使母亲对婴儿更加敏感的表观遗传机制。

name: Tamara Y Swaab
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural architectures of language comprehension in monolinguals, bilinguals, and multilinguals using behavioral methods, ERP, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究单语者、双语者和多语者语言理解的认知和神经架构，使用行为方法、ERP和fMRI。

name: Andrew Todd
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people understand and interpret others' mental states, influencing social interactions and reducing intergroup bias.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何理解他人的心理状态，影响社会互动并减少群体偏见。

name: Brian Trainor
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of stress on the brain and behavior in California mice, focusing on oxytocin and testosterone's roles in social behavior and anxiety.
summary_zh: 研究压力对大脑和行为的影响，特别是在加利福尼亚鼠中，关注催产素和睾酮在社交行为和焦虑中的作用。

name: Matthew Traxler
title: Professor
summary: Studies how working memory capacity affects syntactic parsing and semantic processing during language comprehension.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆容量如何影响语言理解中的句法解析和语义处理。

name: Dulce Wilkinson Westberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how individuals navigate social structures and the implications of such structures for personality and identity, using qualitative and quantitative approaches.
summary_zh: 研究个体如何应对社会结构及其对个性和身份的影响，采用定性和定量方法。

name: Google Scholar
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies identity shifting and narrative identity among racially and ethnically diverse young adults, using mixed-methods and narrative approaches.
summary_zh: 研究种族和族裔多样化青年成年人的身份转变和叙述身份，采用混合方法和叙述方法。

name: Brian Wiltgen
title: Professor
summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of memory formation in the hippocampus and neocortex, using behavioral analysis, pharmacology, electrophysiology, and optogenetics in mice.
summary_zh: 研究海马和新皮层中记忆形成的细胞和分子机制，使用行为分析、药理学、电生理学和光遗传学技术在小鼠中进行研究。

name: Tomiko Yoneda
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how personality traits and social connections influence cognitive healthspan and physiological processes in older adults, using multi-method data.
summary_zh: 研究人格特质和社会联系如何影响老年人的认知健康跨度和生理过程，使用多方法数据。

name: Andrew Yonelinas
title: Professor
summary: Studies the processes underlying human memory, using implicit and explicit tests, memory-impaired patients, and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的过程，使用隐性与显性测试、记忆受损患者以及神经成像技术。

name: David Amaral
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies neurodevelopmental disorders, particularly autism, using postmortem brain tissue and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍，特别是自闭症，使用死后脑组织和神经成像。

name: Lisa Baik
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the sensory neurobiology of mosquito behavior to control their disease-spreading behaviors and prevent bites.
summary_zh: 研究蚊子的感觉神经生物学以控制其疾病传播行为并防止叮咬。

name: Laura N. Borodinsky
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies how electrical activity and environmental factors influence nervous system and muscle development and regeneration.
summary_zh: 研究电活动和环境因素如何影响神经系统和肌肉的发育与再生。

name: Rishidev Chaudhuri
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and decision-making in animals, using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和决策的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: Xiaomo Chen
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms for attention, cognition, and emotion using systems and sensory neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 使用系统和感觉神经科学方法研究注意、认知和情绪的神经机制。

name: Yubei Chen
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sensorimotor representation and efficient deep learning in computational neuroscience, using world models and NeuroAI.
summary_zh: 研究计算神经科学中的传感器运动表示和高效深度学习，使用世界模型和神经AI。

name: Stacey Combes
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using behavioral and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为和神经生理学方法。

name: David Corina
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience, focusing on language processing and working memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知神经科学，专注于语言处理和工作记忆。

name: William DeBello
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of information processing and learning in the barn owl auditory system using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类听觉系统中的信息处理和学习的神经基础，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: Elva Diaz
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies molecular mechanisms of neural development, focusing on neural proliferation and synapse development in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育的分子机制，重点关注啮齿动物中神经增殖和突触发育。

name: Jochen Ditterich
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes sensory information and combines it with other information to make decisions, using behavioral and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理感官信息并与其他信息结合以做出决策，使用行为和神经生理学方法。

name: Kyle Fink
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies rare genetic disorders using patient-derived stem cells and animal models to screen therapies.
summary_zh: 研究罕见遗传性疾病，使用患者衍生的干细胞和动物模型筛选治疗方法。

name: Diasynou Fioravante
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how foundational neural primitives support learned behavior in the cerebellum, using transgenic mice and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究基础神经元机制如何支持学习行为，使用转基因小鼠和光遗传学技术.

name: Eva Fischer
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain development and plasticity in animals, exploring how the brain changes over time.
summary_zh: 研究动物的大脑发育和可塑性，探索大脑随时间的变化。

name: Patrick Fuller
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain circuits and transmitters for sleep and wakefulness, using genetic and electrophysiological methods in mice.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和清醒状态的脑电路和递质，使用遗传和电生理学方法在小鼠中进行。

name: Mark Goldman
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and decision-making using computational models and neurophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和决策的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经生理学方法。

name: Qizhi Gong
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience and development of social cognition in infants.
summary_zh: 研究认知神经科学和社会认知的发展，特别是在婴儿中的应用。

name: Gene G. Gurkoff
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how brain injuries, such as traumatic brain injury and epilepsy, lead to cognitive and social deficits, using animal models and advanced electrophysiology to develop neuromodulatory.
summary_zh: 研究脑损伤（如创伤性脑损伤和癫痫）导致的认知和社会功能障碍，使用动物模型和高级电生理学方法开发神经调节方法。

name: Timothy Hanks
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用多种方法。

name: Wilsaan Joiner
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how different sources of information are integrated for behavior, comparing healthy individuals to those with schizophrenia and upper extremity amputations.
summary_zh: 研究不同信息来源如何整合以指导行为，比较健康个体与精神分裂症患者和上肢截肢者。

name: Leah Krubitzer
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the evolution of neocortex structure and function across mammalian species, focusing on comparative anatomy and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物中大脑皮层结构和功能的进化，侧重于比较解剖学和电生理学研究。

name: Anna La Torre
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Jack Lin
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Steven J. Luck
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies basic mechanisms of attention and working memory in healthy individuals, and examines cognitive dysfunction in people with psychiatric and neurological disorders.
summary_zh: 研究健康个体的基本注意力和工作记忆机制，并研究精神和神经疾病患者认知功能障碍。

name: Nicholas Marsh-Armstrong
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用多种方法。

name: Veronica Martinez-Cerdeno
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development and evolution of the mammalian cerebral cortex, focusing on autism and neural stem cells.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑皮层的发育和进化，重点关注自闭症和神经干细胞。

name: Lee M. Miller
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of auditory perception and speech recognition in human listeners, especially in noisy environments, using fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究人类听觉感知和语音识别的神经基础，特别是在嘈杂环境中的表现，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和脑电图(EEG)。

name: John H. Morrison
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies neuroscience and cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究神经科学和认知过程。

name: Carina Oehrn
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural bases of cognitive and affective processing in Parkinson’s disease patients using electrophysiological recordings and deep brain stimulation to develop adaptive therapies.
summary_zh: 研究帕金森病患者认知和情感处理的神经基础，使用脑电图记录和深脑刺激开发适应性治疗方法。

name: Temitayo Oyegbile-Chidi
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive impairment in children with epilepsy by evaluating sleep abnormalities and functional neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫儿童的认知损害，通过评估睡眠异常和功能性神经影像学。

name: Carolynn Patten
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
