summary: Studies the neural basis of human movement, investigating motor control and learning, and developing techniques to predict motor recovery following stroke.
summary_zh: 研究人类运动的神经基础，探讨运动控制和学习，并开发预测中风后运动恢复的技术。

name: Gregg H. Recanzone
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of aging on auditory perception in the cerebral cortex, focusing on frequency-modulated sounds in macaques.
summary_zh: 研究老化对灵长类动物听觉皮层中频率调制声音感知的影响。

name: Cynthia Schumann
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of brain cells related to anxiety, autism, and mental health across the lifespan, using human brain tissue and nonhuman primate models.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑、自闭症和精神健康相关的脑细胞在人类生命周期中的发展，使用人类脑组织和非人灵长类动物模型。

name: David Segal
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in animals, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Jill Silverman
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neurodevelopmental disorders using rodent models and genetic approaches, focusing on biomarkers and therapeutic strategies.
summary_zh: 使用啮齿动物模型和遗传方法研究神经发育障碍，重点在于生物标志物和治疗策略。

name: Sergi Simó
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 使用神经科学方法研究认知过程。

name: Mitchell Sutter
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain analyzes sounds and how attention influences this process, using single neuron recordings and behavioral studies.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何分析声音以及注意力如何影响这一过程，采用单个神经元记录和行为研究的方法。

name: W. Martin Usrey
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
areas: Our research is funded by the N.I.H
summary: Studies the functional properties of neural circuits for vision, focusing on sensory information processing, attention effects, and feedback pathways.
summary_zh: 研究视觉神经回路的功能特性，重点关注感觉信息处理、注意力效应和反馈路径。

name: Judy Van de Water
dept: Center for Neuroscience / Neuroscience Graduate Group
title: Professor
summary: Studies the maternal immune environment and its impact on neurodevelopment, particularly in autism spectrum disorder.
summary_zh: 研究母体免疫环境及其对神经发育的影响，特别是在自闭症谱系障碍中的作用。

name: Kuan-Hua Chen
title: Assistant Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how emotions arise in the brain and body, resonate between family members, and influence health, using psychophysiology and digital measures.
summary_zh: 研究情绪在大脑和身体中的产生机制，以及它们在家庭成员之间的共鸣如何影响健康，使用心理生理学和数字测量方法。

name: Brandon Gavett
title: Associate Professor of Neurology, School of Medicine
summary: Studies cognitive changes in aging and neurodegenerative disease using psychometric methods and machine learning.
summary_zh: 使用心理测量方法和机器学习研究衰老和神经退行性疾病中的认知变化。

name: Meagan Talbott
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry, UC Davis Medical Center
summary: Studies early interventions for children’s development, adapting assessments for telehealth.
summary_zh: 研究早期干预儿童发展，将评估适应远程健康。

name: Masoud Jasbi
title: Assistant Professor of Linguistics
summary: Studies how children and adults understand complex linguistic structures, using computational models and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何理解复杂的语言结构，使用计算模型和实验方法。

name: Leigh Ann Simmons
title: Professor in School of Nursing
summary: Studies chronic disease risk factors in underrepresented populations, focusing on early life exposures and remote interventions.
summary_zh: 研究欠代表群体的慢性疾病风险因素，重点关注早期生活暴露和远程干预措施。

name: Brittany D Chambers Butcher
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the impact of racism on preterm birth among Black and Latina/x women, using a cell-to-society approach and community-participatory methods.
summary_zh: 研究种族主义对黑人和拉丁裔/美洲原住民妇女早产的影响，采用从细胞到社会的方法和社区参与式方法。

name: Faheemah Mustafaa
title: Associate Professor of Education
summary: Studies the academic performance and well-being of Black/African American youth and other marginalized youth, and the identity-related beliefs of educators.
summary_zh: 研究黑人/非洲裔美国青年和其他边缘化青年的学业表现和福祉，以及教育者的身份相关信念。

name: Nicole Sparapani
title: Associate Professor, School of Education
summary: Studies the interaction between children and their classroom environment to improve educational outcomes for learners with autism and complex learning needs.
summary_zh: 研究儿童与其课堂环境的互动，以改善具有自闭症和复杂学习需求的学习者的教育成果。

name: Angela J Thurman
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, MIND Institute, School of Medicine
summary: Studies language development in neurodevelopmental disabilities like autism spectrum disorder, Down syndrome, fragile X syndrome, and Williams syndrome, using longitudinal assessments and telehealth.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍（如自闭症谱系障碍、唐氏综合症、脆性X综合症和威廉斯综合症）的语言发展，使用纵向评估和远程医疗方法。

name: Meng Huo
title: Associate Professor of Human Development & Family Studies
summary: Studies how older adults help others, focusing on empathy, volunteering, and ageism, using diverse methods including self-report and biomarker data.
summary_zh: 研究老年人如何帮助他人，重点关注同理心、志愿服务和年龄歧视，使用自我报告和生物标志物等多种方法。

name: Maciel M. Hernández
title: Associate Professor of Human Development & Family Studies
summary: Studies the socioemotional and academic resilience of Latino/a/x children, focusing on cultural contexts, self-regulation, and social relationships.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔/美洲原住民儿童的社会情绪和学术韧性，重点关注文化背景、自我调节和社会关系。

name: Erik Henricson
title: Associate Professor of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation
summary: Studies the natural history, quality of life, and community mobility in people with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.
summary_zh: 研究杜兴氏肌肉营养不良症患者的自然病史、生活质量及社区移动性。

name: Jennifer Falbe
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies interventions to prevent chronic diseases and reduce health disparities in diverse populations, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究预防慢性疾病和减少健康不平等的干预措施，使用定量和定性方法。

name: Drew Cingel
title: Associate Professor of Communication
summary: Studies how media influences child and adolescent development, particularly on inclusion and psychosocial well-being, using experimental and survey methods.
summary_zh: 研究媒体如何影响儿童和青少年的发展，特别是促进包容性和心理健康，采用实验和调查方法。

name: Yuuko Uchikoshi Tonkovich
title: Professor, School of Education
summary: Studies bilingualism, language and literacy development, and the impact of educational television on dual language learners.
summary_zh: 研究双语主义、语言和读写能力的发展以及教育电视对双语学习者的影响。

name: Johnna Swartz
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how biology and environment interact to influence brain function and mental health in adolescents and young adults, using fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究生物学和环境如何相互作用影响青少年和年轻成年人的大脑功能和心理健康，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Aubyn Stahmer
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, Director , UC Davis MIND Institute
summary: Studies how to implement evidence-based interventions for children with autism in community settings, focusing on training teachers and leaders.
summary_zh: 研究如何在社区环境中实施针对自闭症儿童的有效干预措施，重点是培训教师和领导者。

name: Marjorie Solomon
title: Oates Endowed Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies cognitive development in autistic children, adolescents, and young adults using fMRI and neuropsychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症儿童、青少年和年轻成人认知发展，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和神经心理学方法。

name: Julie Schweitzer
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences and MIND Institute
summary: Studies attention, impulsivity, and fidgeting behavior in children and adults using cognitive neuroscience and behavior analytic principles, and develops tech-based interventions.
summary_zh: 研究注意力、冲动性和多动行为在儿童和成人中的认知神经科学和行为分析原理，并开发基于技术的干预措施。

name: Adrienne Nishina
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how peer victimization affects adolescents' psychosocial, physical, and academic adjustment, considering ethnic diversity in peer groups.
summary_zh: 研究同伴欺凌如何影响青少年的心理社会、身体和学业适应，考虑同伴群体中的种族多样性。

name: Siwei Liu
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Analyzes longitudinal data to study developmental and health psychology, focusing on close relationships and health disparities.
summary_zh: 分析纵向数据，研究发展和健康心理学，重点关注亲密关系和健康不平等。

name: Ladson Hinton
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies cultural aspects of geriatric mental health, particularly Alzheimer’s Disease and late life depression, focusing on ethnogeriatric research and developing culturally tailored interventions.
summary_zh: 研究老年精神健康的文化方面，特别是阿尔茨海默病和晚年抑郁，侧重于族裔老年研究和开发文化适应性干预措施。

name: Leah Hibel
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies mother-child relationships and physiological regulation, focusing on family stress and stress physiology in diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究母亲与婴儿的关系和生理调节，重点关注不同背景家庭的压力和压力生理学。

name: David Hessl
title: Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Science
summary: Studies emotional psychophysiology and cognitive training in children with neurodevelopmental disorders like fragile X syndrome and autism, using clinical trials and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍儿童（如脆性X综合征和自闭症）的情绪生理学和认知训练，使用临床试验和脑成像技术。

name: Amanda Guyer
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies risk and protective factors in adolescent psychopathology, focusing on social-emotional processing and brain development in diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究青少年心理障碍的风险和保护因素，重点关注社会情感处理和大脑发展在多元群体中的作用。

name: Lorena Garcia
title: Professor of Public Health Sciences
summary: Studies health disparities and social determinants of health, focusing on cardiovascular outcomes and immigrant communities.
summary_zh: 研究健康不平等和社会决定因素，重点关注心血管疾病结果和移民社区的健康。

name: Daniel Ewon Choe
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the development of children’s self-regulation and externalizing behavior, their associations with parents’ mental health, and the intergenerational transmission of psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究儿童自我调节和外部行为的发展，以及这些行为与父母心理健康之间的关联，并探讨心理障碍的代际传递。

name: Aaron Bornstein
title: Associate Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies memory, decision-making, and reinforcement learning using neuroimaging and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究记忆、决策和强化学习的认知神经科学方法。

name: Barbara Dosher
title: Distinguished Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies how humans perceive, attend, learn, remember, and retrieve information using behavioral testing and mathematical modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何感知、注意、学习、记忆和检索信息，使用行为测试和数学建模的方法。

name: Michael Lee
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies models of cognition including representation, memory, learning, and decision making, using probabilistic generative modeling and Bayesian methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知模型，包括表征、记忆、学习和决策，使用概率生成模型和贝叶斯方法。

name: Anna Leshinskaya
title: Assistant Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies how concepts of actions and their objects are represented in the brain, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究动作及其对象的概念在大脑中的表征，使用认知神经科学方法。

name: Sara Mednick
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies the role of downstates in cognitive and emotional recovery, using evidence-based multi-disciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究恢复过程中的下行状态在认知和情绪恢复中的作用，采用多学科的证据为基础的方法。

name: Zygmunt Pizlo
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies 3D shape perception and vision algorithms, proposing that the human visual system and computers must use the same algorithm for veridical 3D vision.
summary_zh: 研究3D形状知觉和视觉算法，提出人类视觉系统和计算机必须使用相同的算法进行真实的3D视觉。

name: Barbara Sarnecka
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Ramesh Srinivasan
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies perception, attention, and decision making using EEG and brain dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、注意力和决策过程，使用脑电图（EEG）和脑动态学方法。

name: Mark Steyvers
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies human-AI collaboration and metacognition, developing AI models that can understand and assist human decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究人类与人工智能协作和元认知，开发能够理解并辅助人类决策的人工智能模型。

name: Joachim Vandekerckhove
title: Professor of Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies response time modeling and Bayesian statistics, fitting models to data in cognitive sciences.
summary_zh: 研究反应时建模和贝叶斯统计，对认知科学中的数据进行模型拟合。

name: Roberto Abreu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mental health outcomes among Latinx LGBTQ people and their families, focusing on systemic and relational factors, and experiences of trans youth.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔 LGBTQ 人群及其家庭的心理健康结果，关注系统和关系因素，以及跨性别青少年的经历。

name: Susan Bluck
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social interactions influence memory and autobiographical recall, using experimental and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响记忆和自传性回忆，使用实验和观察方法。

name: Brian Cahill
title: Associate Instructional Professor
summary: Studies how social and cognitive processes influence legal decision-making, using empirical methods to investigate eyewitness and juror decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究社会和认知过程如何影响法律决策，通过实证方法探讨目击者和陪审团的决策过程。

name: Ron Chandler
title: Associate Instructional Professor, Undergraduate Coordinator
summary: Studies the role of human dignity in education and sustainability, promoting prosocial behavior and a sustainable human ecology.
summary_zh: 研究人类尊严在教育和可持续性中的作用，促进亲社会行为和可持续的人类生态。

name: Shanting Chen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how socio-cultural and bio-behavioral factors influence adolescent development in the context of inequality, using longitudinal and ecological methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会文化与生物行为因素如何影响不平等背景下青少年的发展，采用纵向和生态学方法。

name: Jonathan Chow
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of addiction and drug abuse using behavioral and cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾和药物滥用的神经机制，使用行为和认知神经科学方法。

name: Nicholas Coles
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social influence on cognitive processes, focusing on how social context affects memory and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究社会环境对认知过程的影响，重点关注社会情境如何影响记忆和决策。

name: Jesse Dallery
title: Professor
summary: Studies technology-based interventions for health behavior, decision making, and addiction using human laboratory experiments.
summary_zh: 研究基于技术的干预措施促进健康行为、决策制定和成瘾，使用人类实验室实验。

name: Iser DeLeon
title: Professor
summary: Studies the assessment and treatment of problem behavior in individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders, focusing on applied behavioral economics and individualized learning arrangements for.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍个体的问题行为评估与治疗，侧重于行为经济学和自闭症儿童的个性化学习安排。

name: Darragh Devine
title: Professor, Graduate Coordinator
summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of self-injurious behavior in animals, focusing on dopaminergic insufficiency and stress-responsive phenotypes.
summary_zh: 研究自伤行为的神经生物学基础，重点关注多巴胺不足和应激反应表型。

name: Nicole Dorey
title: Instructional Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in development, focusing on working memory and attention in children.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程，重点是工作记忆和注意力的发展。

name: Natalie Ebner
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in aging using MRI, eye-tracking, and real-life interventions.
summary_zh: 研究老化过程中的脑-行为关系，使用MRI、眼动追踪和现实生活干预方法。

name: W. Matt Friedl
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, using behavioral experiments and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用行为实验和神经成像技术。

name: Julia Graber
title: Chair, Professor
summary: Studies child development, focusing on family and policy influences.
summary_zh: 研究儿童发展，重点关注家庭和政策的影响。

name: Nicole Gravina
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational behavior management and employee well-being in healthcare settings.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为管理及医疗保健工作者的心理健康。

name: Corina Jimenez-Gomez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies choice, decision making, and reinforcement processes in diverse learners, with a focus on cultural responsiveness.
summary_zh: 研究多样学习者的选择、决策和强化过程，并注重文化适应性。

name: Andreas Keil
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotion and attention using the Center for the Study of Emotion & Attention.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与注意力，使用情绪与注意力研究中心的方法。
kw: center for the study of emotion & attention

name: Shani Kerr
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Darlene Kertes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of stress on health and development, focusing on life experiences and epigenetic processes.
summary_zh: 研究压力对健康和发展的影响，重点关注生活经历和表观遗传过程。

name: Taewon Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies economic marginalization, suboptimal work, and its impact on mental health, using intersectional forces and subjective social mobility.
summary_zh: 研究经济边缘化、非理想工作及其对心理健康的影响，使用交叉力量和主观社会流动性。

name: Marina Klimenko
title: Instructional Professor
summary: Studies social and emotional development, focusing on morality, culture, and experiential learning in undergraduate research.
summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪发展，重点关注道德、文化和体验性学习。

name: Lori Knackstedt
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neuroadaptations in the glutamate system caused by chronic drug use and tests compounds to reduce drug-seeking behavior.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾药物慢性使用引起的谷氨酸系统适应性变化，并测试减少觅药行为的化合物。

name: Faris Kronfli
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Develops social skills assessments and interventions for individuals with autism spectrum disorder, focusing on inclusive postsecondary education.
summary_zh: 开发自闭症谱系障碍个体的社会技能评估和干预措施，关注包容性高等教育。

name: Jose Martinez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social behavior and interactions, focusing on social psychology phenomena.
summary_zh: 研究社会行为和互动，侧重于社会心理学现象。

name: Ryan Mears
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral processes using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知和行为过程，使用神经科学方法。

name: Bonnie Moradi
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of discrimination, prejudice, and objectification on health, work, education, and organizations.
summary_zh: 研究歧视、偏见和物化对健康、工作、教育和组织的影响。

name: Brian Odegaard
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies attention, perception, and consciousness using computational models and machine learning, with a focus on human-LLM interactions.
summary_zh: 研究注意、知觉和意识，使用计算模型和机器学习方法，重点关注人类与LLM的交互。

name: Billy Palmer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior in counseling psychology.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为在咨询心理学中的应用。

name: Rui Pei
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate uncertain social situations, perceive others, and build social networks using surveys, experiments, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在不确定的社会环境中导航、感知他人并建立社会网络，使用调查、实验和神经成像方法。

name: Chris Podlesnik
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of fundamental conditioning processes in choice and behavior relapse, aiming to improve behavioral treatments.
summary_zh: 研究基本条件作用过程在选择和行为复燃中的作用，旨在改进行为治疗方法。

name: Lindsey Rodriguez
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies interventions for individuals and couples dealing with stressors like addictive behaviors and romantic conflict using experimental and longitudinal designs.
summary_zh: 研究针对应对成瘾行为和浪漫冲突等压力因素的个体和伴侣的干预措施，采用实验性和纵向设计。

name: Shari Schwartz
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in development, focusing on memory and attention in children.
summary_zh: 研究儿童记忆和注意力的认知过程。

name: Marek Schwendt
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological underpinnings of drug addiction, focusing on mGluR5 receptor dysregulation and developing pharmacological interventions.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的神经生物学机制，重点关注mGluR5受体的失调及其新型药物干预措施的开发。
kw: 多巴胺-谷氨酸-腺苷相互作用

name: Lisa Scott
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infants learn and process faces and objects using EEG and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过EEG和眼动追踪学习和处理面孔和物体的认知发展。

name: Laura Shambaugh
title: Assistant Instructional Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on how they learn and process information.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点在于他们如何学习和处理信息。

name: Yuki Shigemoto
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in decision-making, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程中的认知过程，使用行为实验和计算模型。

name: Colin Smith
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Tim Vollmer
title: Professor
summary: Studies applied behavior analysis, focusing on autism, intellectual disabilities, reinforcement schedules, and parenting.
summary_zh: 研究应用行为分析，重点是自闭症、智力障碍、强化时间表和育儿。

name: Feihong Wang
title: Associate Instructional Professor
summary: Studies how children develop cognitive skills, focusing on early learning and social interactions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知技能的发展，重点关注早期学习和社会互动。

name: Gregory Webster
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development and social cognition in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展和社会认知，使用行为实验方法。

name: Erin Westgate
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, focusing on social influence and attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，重点关注社会影响和态度。

name: Leo Alexander III
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies personnel selection, adverse impact, and psychometrics, focusing on machine learning in employee hiring and recruitment.
summary_zh: 研究人员选拔、不利影响和心理测量学，重点关注机器学习在员工招聘和招聘中的应用。

name: Diane M Beck
title: Professor and Head
summary: Studies how visual perception and attention work together to process and represent the world, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力如何共同作用来处理和表征世界，使用神经成像和行为方法。

name: Aaron S Benjamin
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies how human learning, memory, and decision-making processes interact, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习、记忆和决策过程的相互作用，使用多种实验方法。

name: D. A. Briley
title: Associate Head, Department Support Advocate, Associate Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences and socioecological contexts influence personality and identity development, with a focus on gender.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异和社会生态因素如何影响人格和身份发展，特别关注性别。

name: Víctor H Cervantes
title: Assistant Professor
areas: J. William Fulbright Fellowship for doctoral studies
summary: Studies the foundations of probability and probabilistic contextuality across sciences, using mathematical and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究概率和概率上下文性在科学中的基础，使用数学和计算方法。

name: Dov Cohen
title: Professor
summary: Studies social psychology, focusing on dignity, honor, and face cultures, and their impact on mental health and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学，重点关注尊严、荣誉和面子文化对心理健康和行为的影响。

name: Joseph Rich Cohen
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of internalizing symptoms in children and adolescents, focusing on cognitive, interpersonal, and physiological factors.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年内部化症状的发展，重点关注认知、人际和生理因素。

name: Jaime Lane Derringer
title: Associate Professor and Assistant Head, Information & Communication
summary: Studies individual differences in behavior using genetic methods and psychological assessment, focusing on gender and sexuality.
summary_zh: 使用遗传方法和心理评估研究行为的个体差异，重点关注性别和性取向。

name: Florin Dolcos
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions in healthy and clinical populations using fMRI and ERP.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，在健康和临床人群中的应用，使用fMRI和ERP技术。

name: Monica Fabiani
title: Faculty
summary: Studies aging and cognitive control using ERPs, MRI, and NIRS, focusing on individual differences and neurovascular coupling.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和老化，使用ERPs、MRI和NIRS，关注个体差异和神经血管耦合。

name: Catharine Edith Ann Fairbairn
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of social and emotional processes on substance use, integrating machine learning and biosensors for addiction interventions.
summary_zh: 研究社会和情绪过程对物质使用的影响，结合机器学习和生物传感器进行成瘾干预。

name: Kara D Federmeier
title: Professor
summary: Studies how semantic information is organized and accessed during language comprehension in younger and older adults, using electrophysiological techniques and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解过程中语义信息的组织和调用方式，使用电生理技术及行为方法探讨不同年龄段的认知过程。

name: Cynthia L Fisher
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children use linguistic structures to understand verb meanings and the special properties of speech addressed to young children.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何利用语言结构理解动词意义以及针对幼儿的特殊语音特征。

name: R. Chris Fraley
title: Professor
summary: Studies attachment processes in close relationships, personality dynamics and development, with a focus on why some people are more secure than others in their relationships and how attachment.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的依恋过程、个性动态和发展，重点在于为什么有些人比其他人更安全地维持关系以及依恋模式如何随时间变化。

name: Jozien Goense
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural basis, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

name: Caterina Gratton
title: Professor
summary: Studies the organization and function of human brain networks and how they contribute to goal-directed cognition, using fMRI and patient recordings.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑网络的组织和功能及其如何贡献于目标导向的认知，采用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和患者记录的方法。

name: Benjamin L Hankin
title: Fred and Ruby Kanfer Endowed Professor
summary: Studies risk factors and mechanisms in depression and related disorders in children and adolescents, using longitudinal designs and translational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年抑郁及相关障碍的风险因素和机制，使用纵向设计和转化方法。

name: Wendy Heller
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions, particularly in anxiety and depression, using fMRI, EEG, and ERP methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，特别是焦虑和抑郁，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和事件相关电位（ERP）方法。

name: James R Hinman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain represents space and navigates the world using electrophysiology and calcium imaging in rats.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表示空间以及如何导航世界，使用电生理学和钙成像技术在自由活动的鼠类中进行记录/成像。

name: LaTasha R. Holden
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Culturally Informed and Responsive Science and Pedagogy
summary: Studies working memory, long-term memory, and learning, focusing on individual differences and culturally responsive pedagogy.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆、长时记忆和学习，关注个体差异和文化响应型教学法。

name: Jared Hotaling
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people make decisions in complex scenarios, using cognitive models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究复杂情境下的人类决策过程，采用认知建模和行为实验的方法。

name: John E Hummel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neural architectures represent and process relational structures in perception and reasoning, using computational models and experiments with human subjects.
summary_zh: 研究神经架构如何表示和处理知觉和推理中的关系结构，使用计算模型和人类被试的实验方法。

name: Carla Desi-Ann Hunter
title: Professor
summary: Studies identity and well-being in African Americans and British Caribbean Americans, exploring the impact of racial identity and discrimination on mental health.
summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人和英属加勒比裔美国人的身份和福祉，探讨种族身份和歧视对其心理健康的影响。

name: Daniel Hyde
title: Professor
areas: Infant and child cognitive and brain development
summary: Studies the development of abstract concepts, numerical reasoning, and social cognition in infants and children using EEG, fNIRS, and behavioral measures.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童的抽象概念、数理推理和社会认知的发展，使用EEG、fNIRS和行为测量方法。

name: Caroline Kelsey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children develop, focusing on brain changes and early experiences using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的发展，重点关注大脑变化和早期经历，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Hans Friedrich Koehn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops machine learning and cognitive diagnosis models, particularly focusing on Q-matrix theory and clustering methods.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习和认知诊断模型，特别是Q矩阵理论和聚类方法。

name: Benedek Kurdi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how humans adaptively respond to new information and how learning is modulated by social environment constraints.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何适应性地应对新信息以及学习如何受到更广泛社会环境约束的影响。

name: Nu-Chu Liang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies ingestive behaviors and their relation to obesity, drug dependence, and cognitive decline, using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究摄食行为及其与肥胖、药物依赖和认知衰退的关系，使用动物模型。

name: Alejandro Lleras
title: Professor
summary: Studies attention and visual perception, focusing on how attention works and fails, and how objects are found in scenes.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和视觉感知，关注注意力的工作机制及其失败，以及如何在场景中找到物体。

name: Kimberly Long
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural and neuroendocrine mechanisms of social attachment using prairie voles, combining neural recordings, molecular genetics, and behavioral analyses.
summary_zh: 研究社会依附的神经和神经内分泌机制，使用原野鼠作为模型，结合神经记录、分子遗传学和行为分析方法。

name: Steve Maren
title: Professor and Director, Beckman Institute for Advanced Science and Technology
summary: Studies the neurobiology of fear and anxiety, focusing on the contextual regulation of memory and the impact of stress on fear extinction.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧和焦虑的神经生物学，重点关注记忆的上下文调节和压力对恐惧消退的影响。

name: Haylee Min
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程的发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Dominik Mischkowski
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how physical pain affects emotions and social behavior, using methods like pharmacological interventions and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究物理疼痛如何调节情绪和社会行为，使用药理干预和生理测量等方法。

name: Jessica L Montag
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how language abilities develop with experience across the lifespan, using experiments and corpus analyses.
summary_zh: 研究语言能力随经验在一生中的发展，使用实验和语料库分析方法。

name: Daniel A Newman
title: Professor
summary: Studies diversity in HR management, leadership, and social networks, using research methods and network contagion models.
summary_zh: 研究人力资源管理中的多样性、领导力和社会网络，使用研究方法和网络传染模型。

name: Eva Marie Pomerantz
title: Professor
summary: Studies how parents can support children's math learning and achievement, focusing on cultural contexts in the U.S. and China.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过父母支持促进儿童数学学习和成就，重点关注美国和中国的文化背景。

name: Michel Regenwetter
title: Professor
summary: Models and predicts preference and choice behavior, using probabilistic measurement, social choice, and preference evolution over time.
summary_zh: 建模和预测偏好和选择行为，使用概率测量、社会选择和随时间变化的偏好。

name: Justin S Rhodes
title: Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and physiological bases of natural motivation and exercise, using mice and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究自然动机和运动的遗传和生理基础，使用小鼠和脑成像技术。

name: Kimberly Michelle Rios
title: Professor
summary: Studies how majority and minority group members perceive and respond to threats to their social and personal identities, focusing on multiculturalism and religious stereotypes.
summary_zh: 研究多数群体和少数群体成员如何感知和应对对其社会和个人身份的威胁，重点关注多元文化主义和宗教刻板印象。

name: Michael T. Rizzo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children develop conceptions of fairness and social biases, using constructivist methods to examine the role of experiences and interpretations in shaping these processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童公平观念和社会偏见的发展，采用建构主义方法探讨经验和解释在这些过程中的作用。

name: Brent W Roberts
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality development and change across adulthood, focusing on conscientiousness and narcissism, and how personality can be changed through intervention.
summary_zh: 研究成年期人格的发展与变化，重点关注自律性和自恋性，并探讨通过干预如何改变人格。

name: Violeta Rodriguez Palacios
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health equity, parenting, family dynamics, and psychometrics to improve mental and behavioral health among diverse populations, using psychometric methods and AI.
summary_zh: 研究健康公平、育儿、家庭动态和心理测量，以改善多元文化群体的心理和行为健康，使用心理测量方法和人工智能。

name: Karen D Rudolph
title: Professor
summary: Studies risk and protective factors for adolescent depression, using longitudinal methods and neurobiological assessments.
summary_zh: 研究青少年抑郁症的风险和保护因素，采用纵向研究和神经生物学评估方法。

name: Sepideh Sadaghiani
title: Professor
summary: Studies large-scale neurocognitive networks and functional connectivity, focusing on cognitive control and intrinsic brain activity.
summary_zh: 研究大规模神经认知网络和功能性连接，重点关注认知控制和内在脑活动。

name: Lili Sahakyan
title: Professor
summary: Studies human long-term memory, focusing on the mechanisms and processes involved.
summary_zh: 研究人类长期记忆的机制和过程。

name: Fernando Sánchez Hernández
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cognitive mechanisms of fairness, the role of numerical cognition in social decision-making, and the attribution of agency using behavioral and neuroscientific methods with various.
summary_zh: 研究公平感的认知机制、数字认知在社会决策中的作用以及代理归因中的其他信息来源，使用行为和神经科学方法研究婴儿、儿童和成人。

name: Eleanor Seaton
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of racism on mental health outcomes among Black American youth, using mixed-methods and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究种族主义对黑人美国青少年心理健康结果的影响，使用混合方法和生理测量。

name: Daniel J Simons
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual cognition, attention, and memory, focusing on change blindness and inattentional blindness using behavioral and eye-tracking methods.
summary_zh: 研究视觉认知、注意力和记忆，重点关注变化盲视和不注意盲视，使用行为和眼动追踪方法。

name: Adam Steel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the human brain processes visual information, focusing on scene perception and spatial memory using behavioral studies, neuroimaging, and computational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理视觉信息，特别是场景感知和空间记忆，使用行为研究、神经成像和计算方法。

name: Chadly Daniel Stern
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how belief systems and motivations influence perception and interaction, using experimental social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究信念系统和动机如何影响知觉和互动，使用实验社会心理学方法。

name: Brenda Straka
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how historically marginalized groups navigate exclusion and construct social identities, using developmental cognitive foundations.
summary_zh: 研究历史上被边缘化的群体如何应对排斥并构建社会身份，利用发展认知基础。

name: Caroline Tancredy
title: Faculty
summary: Develops curricula and mentors students to integrate research, coursework, and professional growth in psychological science.
summary_zh: 开发课程并指导学生将研究、课程学习和职业发展整合到心理科学中。

name: Nathan R Todd
title: Professor
areas: Sexual and Gender Minority Health Equity
Sexual and Gender Minority Religion and Spirituality
Diversity Education and Social Justice Engagement
summary: Studies the intersection of sexual and gender minority health equity, spirituality, and religious settings, using ecological models and intersectionality.
summary_zh: 研究性少数和性别少数群体的健康公平、灵性以及宗教环境的交叉领域，使用生态模型和交叉性方法。

name: Stefan Uddenberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies visual working memory and social judgments, using experiments with infants and artificial face stimuli.
summary_zh: 研究视觉工作记忆和社会判断，使用婴儿实验和人工面孔刺激。

name: Michelle Yongmei Wang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops statistical and machine learning methods for cognitive psychology and brain sciences, using signal processing and image analysis.
summary_zh: 开发统计和机器学习方法，应用于认知心理学和脑科学，使用信号处理和图像分析。

name: Ranxiao Frances Wang
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control and mind wandering, human-robot interaction, and visual and spatial perception.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和心智漫游、人机交互以及视觉和空间知觉。

name: Jon Anthony Willits
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people and machines learn and use languages and complex knowledge, using computational, neurobiological, experimental, and naturalistic methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类和机器如何学习和使用语言和复杂知识，采用计算、神经生物学、实验和自然主义方法。

name: Bo Zhang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies personality assessment and the relationships between Big 5 traits, stress, health, and workplace outcomes using statistical methods.
summary_zh: 研究人格评估及其与五大特质、压力、健康和职场结果之间的关系，使用统计方法。

name: Susu Zhang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops measurement theory and psychometric tools for assessing human and machine capabilities, focusing on unstructured test responses and AI model evaluation.
summary_zh: 开发评估人类和机器能力的测量理论和心理测量工具，重点关注非结构化测试响应和AI模型评估。

name: Adrienne M. Antonson
title: Assistant Professor, Animal Sciences
summary: Studies how prenatal maternal immune activation disrupts fetal microglial function and neurodevelopment, using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究母体免疫激活如何通过影响胎儿小胶质细胞的功能和神经发育，使用动物模型进行探讨。

name: Benjamin D Auerbach
title: Assistant Professor, Molecular and Integrative Physiology
summary: Studies the synaptic and circuit mechanisms of sensory processing, focusing on experience-dependent plasticity and its disruption in autism spectrum disorders and hearing disorders.
summary_zh: 研究感觉处理的突触和电路机制，重点关注经验依赖性可塑性的生理机制及其在自闭症谱系障碍和听力障碍中的紊乱。

name: Alison M Bell
title: Professor, Evolution, Ecology, and Behavior
summary: Studies the evolution of paternal care in stickleback fish, linking genetic and hormonal factors to behavioral strategies.
summary_zh: 研究三刺鱼父本照顾行为的进化，关联遗传和激素因素与行为策略。

name: Paul Jeffrey Bonthuis
title: Assistant Professor, Comparative Biosciences
summary: Studies how genes, epigenetic regulation, and hormone signaling in the brain interact to regulate social behaviors in mammals.
summary_zh: 研究基因、表观遗传调控和激素信号在大脑中的相互作用，调节哺乳动物的社会行为。

name: Jonathan Cerna
title: Assistant Professor, Health and Kinesiology
summary: Investigates the neurophysiological mechanisms of cognitive, motor, and emotional benefits from practices like Tai Chi, yoga, and meditation, using multimodal approaches.
summary_zh: 研究太极、瑜伽和冥想等身心实践的认知、运动和情绪益处的神经生理机制，采用多模态方法。

name: Jason Robert Climer
title: Assistant Professor, Molecular and Integrative Physiology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory, focusing on synaptic changes and forgetting processes in the hippocampus.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的神经机制，重点关注海马体中的突触变化和遗忘过程。

name: Neal J Cohen
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies the brain's memory systems, particularly the hippocampal system, using cognitive neuropsychological, eye movement, fMRI, and ERP methods in both normal and neuropsychological populations.
summary_zh: 研究大脑的记忆系统，特别是海马系统，通过认知神经心理学、眼动、fMRI 和 ERP 方法在正常和神经心理学人群中的应用。

name: Rebecca Fuller
title: Professor, Evolution, Ecology, and Behavior
summary: Studies the evolution of mating systems and sexual selection in fishes, using genomic approaches and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究鱼类交配系统和性选择的进化，采用基因组方法和行为实验。

name: Gabriele Gratton
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies brain activity using M/EEG and fMRI to understand aging and fitness effects on cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 使用 M/EEG 和 fMRI 研究衰老和体能对认知功能的影响。

name: Howard J Gritton
title: Assistant Professor, Comparative Biosciences
summary: Studies how neuromodulators affect brain rhythms and their role in learning, memory, and neuropsychiatric disorders in mice.
summary_zh: 研究神经调节物质如何影响大脑节律及其在学习、记忆和神经精神疾病中的作用，使用小鼠模型。

name: Joshua M Gulley
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sex differences in vulnerability to adolescent methamphetamine exposure and the effects of combined alcohol and THC use on cognition and metabolism.
summary_zh: 研究青春期甲基苯丙胺暴露的性别差异神经机制以及酒精和大麻二酚共用对认知和代谢的影响。

name: Fatima T Husain
title: Professor, Speech and Hearing Science
summary: Studies brain connectivity and neural responses to sounds in conditions like misophonia and tinnitus using fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究声音诱发的神经反应及其与耳鸣和厌食症相关的脑连接性，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)。

name: Naiman A Khan
title: Associate Professor, Kinesiology and Community Health
summary: Studies dietary behaviors and their effects on health, using randomized controlled trials and observational studies.
summary_zh: 研究饮食行为及其对健康的影响，使用随机对照试验和观察研究。

name: Natsumi Komatsu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies seasonal changes in dopamine dynamics in voles using neurochemical imaging and two-photon microscopy.
summary_zh: 研究季节变化对地松鼠多巴胺动态的影响，使用神经化学成像和双光子显微镜技术。

name: Anna V Kukekova
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the genetics and behavior of domesticated animals, focusing on foxes and dogs, using behavioral phenotypes and microbiome analysis.
summary_zh: 研究家养动物（狐狸和狗）的行为和遗传学，使用行为表型和微生物群分析方法。

name: Daniel Llano
title: Associate Professor, Molecular and Integrative Physiology
summary: Studies the mechanisms of complex sound processing in the auditory system, focusing on the role of cortical subnetworks and their projections to subcortical structures.
summary_zh: 研究复杂声音在听觉系统中的处理机制，重点在于皮层亚网络及其向下丘脑结构的投射作用。

name: Megan Mahoney
title: Associate Professor, Comparative Biosciences
summary: Studies circadian rhythms, anxiety, and estrogen signaling in relation to toxicology and menopause, using behavioral and neural measures.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律、焦虑和雌激素信号传导与毒理学和更年期的关系，使用行为和神经测量方法。

name: Brian Monson
title: Associate Professor, Speech and Hearing Science
summary: Studies speech recognition in noise, focusing on high-frequency cues and talker characteristics.
summary_zh: 研究噪声中语音识别，重点关注高频线索和说话者特征。

name: Raksha Mudar
title: Professor
summary: Studies functional communication assessment in dementia, using AI tools and ERP evidence.
summary_zh: 研究痴呆症的功能性沟通评估，使用AI工具和ERP证据。

name: Gene Robinson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the mechanisms and evolution of social behavior in bees using genomics and systems biology, focusing on division of labor, aggression, and communication.
summary_zh: 研究蜜蜂的社会行为机制和进化，使用基因组学和系统生物学方法，重点关注分工、攻击性和交流。

name: Uwe Rudolph
title: Professor, Comparative Biosciences
summary: Studies the role of GABAA receptors in cognitive functions and microglial activation, using mouse models and pharmacological interventions.
summary_zh: 研究GABAA受体在认知功能和小胶质细胞激活中的作用，使用小鼠模型和药理学干预方法。

name: Matthew Francis Singh
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain dynamics and electrophysiology using precision data-driven modeling and dynamical systems.
summary_zh: 研究脑动态和脑电生理学，使用精确的数据驱动建模和动力系统方法。

name: Jimeng Sun
title: Professor in Computer Science
summary: Develops AI methods for healthcare, including deep learning for drug discovery and clinical trial optimization.
summary_zh: 开发人工智能方法用于医疗保健，包括深度学习在药物发现和临床试验优化中的应用。

name: Brad Sutton
title: Professor
summary: Studies brainstem-prefrontal-striatal pathways using fMRI to understand decision-making processes.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究脑干-前额叶-纹状体通路，以理解决策过程。

name: Yurii A Vlasov
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sensory processing and behavior in rodents using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物触须皮层和次级皮层的神经机制，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法探索感觉处理和行为机制。

name: Yuan Yang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain mechanisms of motor control and rehabilitation using transcranial direct current stimulation and EEG-fMRI coupling.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和康复的脑机制，使用经颅直流电刺激和EEG-fMRI耦合技术。

name: Jennifer Beer
title: Professor
summary: Studies self-processes, emotion processes, and social cognition to understand how they influence social interactions and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究自我过程、情绪过程和社会认知，以了解它们如何影响社交互动和决策。

name: David M Buss
title: Professor
summary: Studies human mating strategies, jealousy, and conflict between the sexes using evolutionary psychology.
summary_zh: 研究人类择偶策略、嫉妒和性别冲突的进化心理学。

name: Frances Champagne
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how genes and environment interact to shape neural and behavioral outcomes, with a focus on early life experiences and epigenetic inheritance.
summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用塑造神经和行为结果，重点关注早期生活经历和表观遗传遗传。

name: Jessica Church-Lang
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive control processes develop over age, using neuroimaging and cognitive tests to relate variability in mental health and academic achievement.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制过程随年龄的发展，使用神经成像和认知测试来关联心理健康和学业成就的变异性。

name: Alexandra L. Clark
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how neighborhood environments and social experiences affect cognitive aging and Alzheimer's disease risk, using longitudinal data and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究生活环境和社会经历如何影响认知老化和阿尔茨海默病风险，使用纵向数据和神经影像学方法。

name: Lawrence K Cormack
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes the motion of objects in 3D space, integrating depth and motion perception.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理三维空间中的物体运动，整合深度和运动感知。

name: James Curley
title: Professor, Co-Director Behavioral and Social Data Science Major
summary: Studies the neurobiological basis of social behavior in groups, including long-term changes in brain and physiology due to social status.
summary_zh: 研究群体中社会行为的神经生物学基础，包括由于社会地位引起的长期大脑和生理变化。

name: Kaya De Barbaro
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies maternal mental health and infant social-emotional development through natural home interactions and wearable sensors.
summary_zh: 研究母婴心理健康和婴儿社会情绪发展，通过自然家庭互动和可穿戴传感器。

name: Yvon Delville
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of social stress on the development of aggression during puberty, using animal models to understand neurotransmitter systems and neural networks.
summary_zh: 研究社会压力对青春期攻击行为发展的影响，使用动物模型来理解神经递质系统和神经网络。

name: Juan M Dominguez
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural and endocrine mechanisms of motivation and reward, focusing on interactions between hypothalamus and dopamine pathways, and sex differences in drug response.
summary_zh: 研究动机和奖励的神经内分泌机制，重点关注下丘脑与多巴胺通路的相互作用，以及性别差异在药物反应中的机制。

name: Michael P Domjan
title: Professor
summary: Studies basic behavioral mechanisms of learning, Pavlovian conditioning, and the control problem in instrumental conditioning.
summary_zh: 研究基本的学习行为机制、经典条件作用以及操作性条件作用中的控制问题。

name: Audrey Duarte
title: Professor and Associate Chair for Academic Affairs
summary: Studies age-related changes in episodic memory using EEG, fMRI, and neuropsychological methods, with a focus on racial/ethnic minorities.
summary_zh: 研究与年龄相关的 episodic 记忆变化，使用 EEG、fMRI 和神经心理学方法，重点关注种族/民族少数群体。

name: Nicholas Duran
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the dynamic interplay between cognition, language, and action during complex real-world tasks, using computational tools and multimodal data.
summary_zh: 研究认知、语言和行动在复杂现实任务中的动态交互，使用计算工具和多模态数据。

name: Catharine H Echols
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children use social cues to learn words, comparing linguistic, cognitive, and social factors across cultures and socio-economic statuses.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何使用社会线索学习词汇，并比较不同文化、语言和社会经济背景下的语言、认知和社会因素对语言发展的影响。

name: Andrew Gaudet
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neuroinflammation, axon plasticity, and behavioral changes after spinal cord injury, aiming to improve recovery and repair.
summary_zh: 研究脊髓损伤后的神经炎症、轴突可塑性和行为变化，旨在改善恢复和修复。

name: Bertram Gawronski
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people make evaluative, truth, and moral judgments using experimental, survey, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何进行评价、事实和道德判断，使用实验、调查和计算方法。

name: Francisco Gonzalez-Li
title: was appointed Assistant Professor of Anatomy at the newly formed Ponce School of Medicine, Ponce, Puerto Rico
summary: Studies brain function using electrophysiology and FDG neuroimaging in animals and humans.
summary_zh: 使用电生理学和FDG神经影像学研究动物和人类的大脑功能。

name: Robbe Goris
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how visual cortex processes and represents uncertainty in natural scenes, using neural recordings and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层在自然场景中处理和表示不确定性的方式，使用神经记录和计算模型。

name: Samuel D Gosling
title: Professor
summary: Studies how personality is expressed in physical spaces and develops new methods for collecting behavioral data.
summary_zh: 研究人格如何在物理空间中表达，并开发新的行为数据收集方法。

name: Zenzi M. Griffin
title: Professor
summary: Studies how far in advance people plan words and sentences, affecting speech fluency, and the learning of personal names.
summary_zh: 研究人们在说话前计划词汇和句子的程度，影响言语流畅性，以及个人名称的学习。

name: Andreana P Haley
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of midlife obesity on brain vulnerability and cognitive function, using neuroimaging and interventions like transcranial laser stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究中年肥胖对大脑脆弱性和认知功能的影响，使用神经影像学和经颅激光刺激等干预措施。

name: Mary M Hayhoe
title: Professor
summary: Studies how gaze and visual attention control walking in natural environments, using eye-tracking and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究自然环境中注视和视觉注意力如何控制行走，使用眼动追踪和行为实验方法。

name: Marlone D Henderson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how individuals' subjective construal of negotiation affects their ability to maintain priorities during conflict resolution, and how abstract versus concrete thinking influences social.
summary_zh: 研究个体在谈判中的主观认知如何影响其在冲突解决中保持优先事项的能力，以及抽象与具体思维如何影响社会判断和评价。

name: Lori Holt
title: Professor and Department of Psychology Chair
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural basis of listening, especially speech, focusing on learning and attention.
summary_zh: 研究听觉的认知和神经基础，特别是语言，关注学习和注意力的作用。

name: Theresa A Jones
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain plasticity and motor recovery after stroke, using animal models and behavioral training.
summary_zh: 研究中风后的脑可塑性和运动恢复，使用动物模型和行为训练方法。

name: Hongjoo Joanne Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of the amygdala in conditioned fear and reward processing, using behavioral and neurobiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究杏仁核在条件恐惧和奖励处理中的作用，使用行为和神经生物学方法。

name: Cristine H Legare
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies the interplay between universal human cognition and cultural variations to understand cognitive and cultural evolution.
summary_zh: 研究普遍的人类认知与文化变异之间的相互作用，以理解认知和文化进化。

name: Jarrod Lewis-Peacock
title: Professor and Interdisciplinary Neuroscience Program Director
summary: Studies how the human brain supports goal-directed behavior, focusing on working memory and cognitive control using neuroimaging and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何支持目标导向行为，重点关注工作记忆和认知控制，使用神经成像和计算技术。

name: Cindy M Meston
title: Professor
summary: Studies sexual psychophysiology, sexual function and dysfunction, and the effects of sexual abuse on women’s sexual arousal.
summary_zh: 研究性生理学、性功能障碍以及性虐待对女性性唤起的影响。

name: Marie-H. Monfils
title: Professor and Associate Chair for Research and Operations
summary: Studies how fear memories can be attenuated and the social transmission of information and affiliative kinship in rats.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧记忆的持久抑制以及信息的社会传递和亲和性在大鼠中的作用。

name: Desmond Ong
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people use AI for social and emotional support, including everyday empathy and mental health therapy.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何使用AI进行社会和情感支持，包括日常同理心和心理健康疗法。

name: Caitlin Orsini
title: Associate Professor
areas: long term impact of stress on behavior
summary: Studies how neural mechanisms, particularly in the basolateral amygdala, ventral hippocampus, and prefrontal cortex, affect decision making and fear persistence, using animal models and hormonal.
summary_zh: 研究神经机制，特别是基底外侧杏仁核、腹侧海马和前额叶皮层，如何影响决策和恐惧持久性，使用动物模型和激素调节。

name: Franco Pestilli
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain’s structural connections support perception, cognition, learning and development, using computational methods and neuroimaging data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究大脑结构连接如何支持知觉、认知、学习和发育，使用计算方法和神经影像数据分析。

name: Alison Preston
title: Dr. A. Wilson Nolle and Sir Raghunath P. Mahendroo Professor
areas: cognitive development in childhood and adolescence
summary: Studies how the hippocampus and frontoparietal cortices work together to form new knowledge and support memory in adults and adolescents, using fMRI and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究海马体和前顶叶皮层如何在成人和青少年中协同工作以形成新知识并支持记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和计算建模。

name: Katherine Schaumberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies risk factors and treatments for eating disorders, focusing on adaptive versus maladaptive eating and physical activity patterns.
summary_zh: 研究饮食障碍的风险因素和治疗方法，重点关注适应性与病理性饮食和身体活动模式。

name: Eyal Seidemann
title: Professor
areas: Optical imaging and novel neurophysiological techniques
summary: Studies the cortical mechanisms of visual perception and behavior using optical imaging, electrophysiology, and computational models in awake primates.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类大脑皮层的视觉感知和行为机制，使用光学成像、电生理学和计算模型在清醒的灵长类动物中进行研究。

name: Jasper Smits
title: Professor and Department Liaison for Medical Affairs
summary: Develops and evaluates interventions for anxiety and related problems, integrating clinical science and implementation research.
summary_zh: 开发和评估焦虑及相关问题的干预措施，结合临床科学和实施研究。

name: Hayoung Song
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how brain circuits and systems give rise to cognition, focusing on memory and attention using fMRI and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑电路和系统如何产生认知，重点关注记忆和注意力，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和计算模型。

name: Michael J Telch
title: Professor
summary: Studies the nature and treatment of panic, phobias, and anxiety disorders using clinical trials, prospective longitudinal risk studies, and experimental psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究恐慌、恐惧症和焦虑障碍的本质及其治疗方法，采用临床试验、前瞻性纵向风险研究和实验性心理病理学方法。

name: Katharine Tillman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children acquire abstract concepts, focusing on time, color, number, and causality, using cognitive development methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何获得抽象概念，包括时间、颜色、数字和因果关系，采用认知发展方法。

name: Adela Timmons
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies mental health processes and interventions using ambulatory assessment, wearable technologies, and artificial intelligence to understand and improve everyday life.
summary_zh: 研究心理健康过程和干预措施，使用可穿戴技术、生态评估和人工智能来理解并改善日常生活。

name: Elliot Tucker-Drob
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how genes and social experiences influence cognitive function, personality, and academic achievement across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究基因和社会经验如何影响认知功能、人格发展和学业成就的生命周期.

name: Jacqueline D Woolley
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children develop their understanding of reality, superstition, and imagination through social and cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会和认知过程发展对现实、迷信和想象的理解。

name: David S. Yeager
title: Raymond Dickson Centennial Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how social-cognitive development influences adolescent behaviors such as motivation and engagement, using psychological interventions.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知发展如何影响青少年的行为，如动机和参与度，并使用心理干预方法进行研究。

name: Chen Yu
title: Charles and Sarah Seay Regents Professor of Psychology and Computer Science, Director of Center for Perceptual Systems (CPS)
summary: Studies how perception, action, and social interaction develop and learn through visual attention and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、动作和社会互动如何通过视觉注意和机器学习发展和学习。

name: Charles J Holahan
title: Professor
summary: Studies stress and coping mechanisms, focusing on factors that predict health outcomes and addictive behaviors in adults.
summary_zh: 研究压力和应对机制，重点关注预测健康结果和成瘾行为的因素。

name: Marc S Lewis
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies medical problem solving and develops novel ideas in science, medicine, and engineering, focusing on genetic searches and diagnostic instruments.
summary_zh: 研究医学问题解决并开发科学、医学和工程领域的新型想法，重点关注基因搜索和诊断仪器。

name: William B Swann
title: Professor
summary: Studies identity fusion and its effects on group behavior and extreme pro-group actions.
summary_zh: 研究身份融合及其对群体行为和极端亲群体行为的影响。

name: Julia Campbell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the plasticity of sensory processing in the brain, focusing on auditory and visual processing in children and adults with hearing loss and tinnitus.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中感觉处理的可塑性，重点关注听力损失和耳鸣儿童及成人的听觉和视觉处理。

name: Josh Cisler
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies emotional and cognitive mechanisms of anxiety disorders using fMRI and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍的情绪和认知机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和计算方法。

name: Laura Colgin
title: Professor
summary: Studies how brain rhythms coordinate neuronal populations during learning and memory, using electrophysiology and behavior in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑节律如何协调神经元群体在学习和记忆中的活动，使用电生理学和行为学方法在啮齿动物模型中进行.

name: Samuel Cooper
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies maladaptive fear and anxiety mechanisms in adults and adolescents, using computational approaches and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究成人和青少年不良恐惧和焦虑机制，使用计算方法和神经影像学。

name: Jennifer Donegan
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how stress affects neural circuits associated with psychiatric disorders, using techniques like optogenetics and behavioral testing.
summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响与精神疾病相关的神经回路，使用光遗传学和行为测试等技术。

name: Manoj Doss
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of psychoactive drugs, focusing on psychedelics and their impact on learning and memory, and the efficacy of psychedelic therapy in depression and PTSD.
summary_zh: 研究精神活性药物的基本神经认知机制，特别是致幻剂对学习和记忆的影响，以及致幻剂疗法在抑郁症和创伤后应激障碍中的疗效。

name: Michael Drew
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain forms and retrieves memories, focusing on the hippocampus in mice using genetic tools and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成和检索记忆，重点研究小鼠的海马体，使用遗传工具和行为实验。

name: Joseph Dunsmoor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emotion and cognition interact in learning and memory, using fMRI, virtual reality, and translational cognitive neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和认知如何在学习和记忆中相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像、虚拟现实和转化认知神经科学方法。

name: Thomas W. Elston
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the prefrontal cortex interacts with other brain areas to enable cognitive control, using brain-computer interfaces.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层与其他脑区如何交互以实现认知控制，并利用脑-机接口进行生理认知交互。

name: Laura K. Fonken
title: Associate Professor of Pharmacology & Toxicology
summary: Studies how immune, nervous, and endocrine systems interact to regulate cognitive and mood behaviors, focusing on neuroinflammation in aging and circadian regulation.
summary_zh: 研究免疫、神经系统和内分泌系统如何相互作用以调节认知和情绪行为，重点关注衰老过程中的神经炎症以及昼夜节律的调节作用。

name: Nace Golding
title: Professor
areas: To better understand auditory computations in the brain
summary: Studies auditory computations in the brain, focusing on dendritic processing and synaptic integration in binaural neurons.
summary_zh: 研究听觉系统中的计算过程，重点在于双耳神经元的树突处理和突触整合。

name: Kristen Harris
title: Professor
summary: Studies the structural components of synaptic plasticity and memory consolidation in the hippocampus, using electrophysiology and electron microscopy.
summary_zh: 研究海马区突触可塑性和记忆巩固的结构成分，使用电生理学和电子显微镜技术。

name: Maya Henry
title: is a Professor in the Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences at The University o
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of spoken and written language in aphasia, exploring rehabilitation strategies.
summary_zh: 研究失语症中的口头和书面语言的认知和神经基础，探索康复策略。

name: Ted Ho
title: Faculty
summary: Studies aging and neurodegenerative diseases using optogenetics and neural activity imaging, with a focus on cognitive decline in Alzheimer’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病，使用光遗传学和神经活动成像技术，重点关注阿尔茨海默病中的认知衰退。

name: Johann (Hans) Hofmann
title: Professor
areas: AI for Health or Computational Science
summary: Studies the molecular and hormonal mechanisms of social behavior in African cichlid fishes using gene expression profiling, neuroanatomical techniques, and bioinformatics.
summary_zh: 研究非洲慈鲷鱼类的社会行为背后的分子和激素机制，使用基因表达谱分析、神经解剖技术和生物信息学工具。

name: Ayland Letsinger
title: is an assistant professor in the Department of Kinesiology and Health Education at The University of Texa
summary: Studies the neurobiological regulation of physical activity motivation in mice, using fiber photometry, chemogenetics, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠运动动机的神经生物学调节，使用光纤光度法、化学遗传学和机器学习技术。

name: Elizabeth Lippard
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies brain-behavior relationships in development, focusing on genes and environmental stress in affective and alcohol use disorders.
summary_zh: 研究发展过程中大脑与行为的关系，重点关注情绪障碍和酒精使用障碍中的基因和环境压力因素。

name: Regina Mangieri
title: is an Assistant Professor in the Division of Pharmacology and Toxicology in the College of Pharmacy at Th
summary: Studies how ethanol exposure affects brain physiology and synaptic transmission, using behavioral testing and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究酒精暴露如何影响大脑生理和突触传递，使用行为测试和电生理学技术。

name: Michela Marinelli
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the biological bases of addiction using a systems-approach that combines molecular, cellular, anatomical, and behavioral studies.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾的生物学基础，采用结合分子、细胞、解剖和行为研究的系统方法。

name: Michael Mauk
title: Professor of Neuroscience
areas: AI for Health or Computational Science
summary: Studies mechanisms of learning and plasticity in the cerebellum and prefrontal cortex using behavioral studies, in vivo recordings, and large-scale computer simulations.
summary_zh: 研究小脑和前额叶皮层的学习和可塑性机制，使用行为研究、在体记录和大规模计算机模拟。

name: Jacie McHaney
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of speech processing challenges in noisy environments using neurophysiological and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究嘈杂环境中语音处理挑战的神经机制，使用神经生理学和计算方法。

name: Esther Melamed
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies genetic, environmental, and sex differences in multiple sclerosis, advancing patient-specific treatments.
summary_zh: 研究多发性硬化症的遗传、环境和性别差异，推进个性化治疗方法。

name: Robert Messing
title: Professor
summary: Studies molecular and circuit neuroadaptations to drugs of abuse, using genetic and electrophysiological methods to identify drug targets for addiction and co-morbid disorders.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及其共病障碍的分子和电路适应性，使用遗传和电生理方法来识别药物靶点。

name: Risto Miikkulainen
title: Professor
summary: Studies biologically-inspired computation, including neuroevolution and deep learning, to understand and develop intelligent systems.
summary_zh: 研究生物启发的计算，包括神经进化和深度学习，以理解并开发智能系统。

name: José del R. Millán
title: is a professor and holds the Linda Steen Norris & Lee Norris Endowed Chair in Neuroengineering
summary: Develops noninvasive brain-computer interfaces (BCI) to control robots and promote brain reorganization in motor rehabilitation.
summary_zh: 开发非侵入式脑机接口（BCI）以控制机器人并促进运动康复中的大脑重组。

name: Marie Monfils
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how fear memories can be reduced and the factors behind social bonding and information transmission.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧记忆的减少机制以及社会纽带和信息传递的因素。

name: Hitoshi Morikawa
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural plasticity in the mesostriatal dopaminergic system to understand reward-based learning and addiction, using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究多巴胺系统中的神经可塑性，以理解基于奖励的学习和成瘾行为，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法。

name: Luis Natividad
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neuroproteome to understand addiction and disease, using mass spectrometry and in vivo neuropharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾和疾病中的神经蛋白质组，使用质谱和体内神经药理学方法。

name: Hiroshi Nishiyama
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the formation, maintenance, and rewiring of synaptic connections in the mammalian brain, particularly during development and adulthood.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物大脑中突触连接的形成、维持和重编，特别是在发育和成年期。

name: Kimberly Nixon
title: Faculty
summary: Studies alcohol use disorder by examining neuroprotective agents and the role of adult neural stem cells and microglia in brain damage and recovery.
summary_zh: 研究酒精使用障碍，通过探讨神经保护剂以及成年神经干细胞和小胶质细胞在大脑损伤和恢复中的作用。

name: David Paydarfar
title: Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Develops biosensors and algorithms to track and predict patient health, aiding in disease trajectory forecasting.
summary_zh: 开发生物传感器和算法以跟踪和预测患者健康状况，帮助预测疾病轨迹。

name: Steven Phelps
title: Professor of Integrative Biology
summary: Studies the evolution of social behavior and neural mechanisms in rodents, particularly prairie voles and singing mice, using behavioral, molecular, and computational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物（尤其是原野鼠和鸣鼠）的社会行为和神经机制的进化，采用行为学、分子生物学和计算模型等方法。

name: Nicholas Priebe
title: Professor of Neuroscience
areas: AI for Health or Computational Science
summary: Studies how visual cortex processes motion, orientation, and depth, using electrophysiology and imaging.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层如何处理运动、方向和深度信息，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: Samantha SantaCruz
title: Faculty
summary: Develops brain-computer interfaces and neuromodulation devices to understand and control neural dynamics, using computational models and experimental neuroengineering.
summary_zh: 开发脑-机接口和神经调节设备，以理解和控制神经动力学，使用计算模型和实验神经工程方法。

name: Thibaud Taillefumier
title: Associate Professor
areas: AI for Health or Computational Science
summary: Studies the collective properties and design principles of neural networks using optimization theory and stochastic dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络的集体性质和设计原理，使用优化理论和随机动力学方法。

name: Xuexin Wei
title: Associate Professor
areas: AI for Health or Computational Science
summary: Studies how the brain supports adaptive and intelligent behavior using computational and statistical methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持适应性和智能行为，采用计算和统计方法。

name: C. Shawn Green
title: Mark and Ilene Laufman Family Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies how learning conditions affect transfer, rate, and depth of learning in perceptual and cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究学习条件如何影响感知和认知任务中的迁移、学习速率和深度学习。

name: Yuri Saalmann
title: Professor and Associate Chair of Graduate Studies
areas: The research goals of my lab are
summary: Studies how neural dynamics enable cognitive control and the neural correlates of consciousness, using neuroimaging and electrophysiology in macaques and humans.
summary_zh: 研究神经动态如何实现认知控制以及意识的神经相关性，通过神经成像和电生理学方法在猕猴和人类中进行研究。

name: Karen Schloss
title: Associate Professor and Associate Chair for Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies how people interpret meaning from visual features, particularly color, to make visual communication more effective.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过视觉特征，特别是颜色，来赋予意义，以提高视觉交流的有效性。

name: Gary Lupyan
title: Professor and PCCN Area Group Chair
summary: Studies how language shapes perception and cognition, investigating how verbal labeling affects categorization and memory.
summary_zh: 研究语言如何塑造知觉和认知，探讨词汇标签如何影响分类和记忆。

name: Brad Postle
title: Professor and Biology of Brain and Behavior Area Group Chair
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of short-term and working memory, attention, and consciousness using behavioral studies, fMRI, TMS, EEG, and multivariate analysis.
summary_zh: 研究短时记忆、工作记忆、注意力和意识的认知和神经基础，使用行为研究、功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）、脑电图（EEG）和多元分析方法。

name: Kristin Shutts
title: Professor and Developmental Area Group Chair
summary: Studies how children develop social categories and intergroup biases, exploring mechanisms and strategies to reduce biases.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展社会类别和群体偏见，探索机制和减少偏见的策略。

name: Paula Niedenthal
title: Professor and Social Area Group Chair
summary: Studies the function and processing of facial expressions of emotion, focusing on facial mimicry and eye gaze.
summary_zh: 研究面部表情情感的功能及其处理过程，重点关注面部模仿和眼动。

name: Martha Alibali
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults use gestures to think about and learn mathematics, focusing on the role of gesture in mathematical cognition.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何通过手势思考和学习数学，重点关注手势在数学认知中的作用。

name: Brooke Ammerman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of non-suicidal self-injury and suicidal thoughts, focusing on interpersonal stress.
summary_zh: 研究非自杀性自伤和自杀念头的机制，重点关注人际压力的影响。

name: Anthony P. Auger
title: Professor
summary: Studies how epigenetic mechanisms in the juvenile brain mediate risk and resilience to mental health disorders, with a focus on sex differences.
summary_zh: 研究青春期大脑表观遗传机制如何调节精神健康障碍的风险和韧性，重点关注性别差异。

name: Allyson J. Bennett
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of early environments and experiences on psychological and physical health across the lifespan using nonhuman primates.
summary_zh: 研究早期环境和经历对整个生命周期的心理和身体健康的影响，使用非人灵长类动物进行跨学科研究。

name: Craig Berridge
title: The Patricia Goldman-Rakic Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neurobiology of stress, ADHD-related cognitive enhancers, and prefrontal cortex function using electrophysiological and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究压力、ADHD相關認知增強劑和前額葉皮層功能，使用電生理學和行為方法。

name: Markus Brauer
title: Professor
summary: Studies social power, intergroup perception, and civil courage, examining the cognitive and behavioral consequences of group dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究社会权力、群体知觉和公民勇气，探讨群体动态的认知和行为后果。

name: Nick Buttrick
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychology of American cultural beliefs, particularly around gun ownership and success, using socioecological and multi-method approaches.
summary_zh: 研究美国文化信念的心理学，特别是关于枪支所有权和成功，采用社会生态学和多方法论。

name: Sara Chadwick
title: Assistant Professor of Gender & Women's Studies and Psychology
summary: Studies gendered experiences of sexual coercion and orgasm, using surveys, interviews, and experiments to understand health disparities.
summary_zh: 研究性别差异下的性胁迫和高潮体验，使用调查、访谈和实验来理解健康差异。

name: John J. Curtin
title: Professor
summary: Develops digital therapeutics for substance use disorders and mental illnesses, using machine learning and passive personal sensing.
summary_zh: 开发数字疗法以预防和治疗物质使用障碍和精神疾病，采用机器学习和被动个人传感技术。

name: Richard Davidson
title: William James and Vilas Professor of Psychology and Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neural substrates of emotion and affective disorders, including depression and anxiety, using electrophysiology, PET, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和情感障碍（如抑郁和焦虑）的神经基础，使用电生理学、正电子发射断层扫描和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Patricia G. Devine
title: Kenneth and Mamie Clark Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how people manage prejudice in society, focusing on motivations and processes of responding without prejudice.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社会中管理偏见，重点关注无偏见反应的动机和过程。

name: Stephen Ferrigno
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of uniquely human cognitive abilities, focusing on number cognition, grammar, logical reasoning, and metacognition in children, monkeys, and native Amazonians.
summary_zh: 研究人类独特认知能力的发展，包括数字认知、语法、逻辑推理和元认知在儿童、猴子和亚马逊土著人中的发展。

name: Diane Carol Gooding
title: Professor
summary: Studies risk factors for brain disorders, including schizophrenia and Alzheimer’s disease, using psychometric, genetic, and neurocognitive methods.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和阿尔茨海默病等脑部疾病的危险因素，采用心理测量、遗传学和神经认知方法。

name: João Guassi Moreira
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how youths develop cognitive, affective, and social skills using fMRI, naturalistic text, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年认知、情感和社会技能的发展，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、自然语言文本和计算方法。

name: Morgan Jerald
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how media influence Black women’s gender beliefs and sexual well-being, focusing on the Jezebel stereotype.
summary_zh: 研究媒体如何影响黑人女性的性别观念和性健康，重点关注‘妓女’刻板印象。

name: Tatum Jolink
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the behavioral and biological mechanisms of close relationships, focusing on positive interactions and the body's role in relationship initiation.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的行为和生物机制，重点关注积极互动以及身体在关系启动中的作用。

name: Ashley Jordan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children form social preferences based on group similarity, using developmental psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童基于群体相似性形成社会偏好的机制，使用发展心理学方法。

name: Rosa Lafer-Sousa
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain turns sensory data into perception, focusing on color vision in humans and nonhuman primates using psychophysics, brain imaging, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何将感官数据转化为知觉，重点是人类和非人灵长类动物的颜色视觉，使用心理物理学、脑成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Pearl Han Li
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children balance independent thinking and reliance on others' testimony in developing and updating their beliefs, focusing on moral judgments and social learning.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在发展和更新信念时如何平衡独立思考和依赖他人证词，重点关注道德判断和社会学习。

name: Catherine Marler
title: Professor
summary: Studies the bi-directional interactions between endocrinology and animal behavior, focusing on California mice and how past winning experience influences future ability to win and androgen receptors.
summary_zh: 研究内分泌学与动物行为之间的双向互动，重点关注加利福尼亚鼠，以及过去获胜经历如何影响未来获胜能力和雄激素受体。

name: Ali Mohebi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control processes in rodents using optical and electrophysiological techniques, focusing on neuromodulators like dopamine.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的认知控制过程，使用光学和电生理技术，重点关注多巴胺等神经递质的作用。

name: Vivian Paulun
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies visual intuitive physics, our ability to understand the physics of a scene at a glance, using behavioral experiments, neuroimaging, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉直观物理，即从快速视觉输入中理解场景物理性质的能力，使用行为实验、神经成像和计算建模方法。

name: Seth Pollak
title: Vaughan Bascom Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how early experiences influence children's emotional development and decision-making, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究早期经历如何影响儿童的情绪发展和决策制定，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Carol Ryff
title: Professor
summary: Studies how various aspects of psychological well-being are influenced by social structural factors and biological processes, linking well-being with health outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究心理幸福感如何受到社会结构因素和生物学过程的影响，并将幸福感与健康结果联系起来。

name: Jenny Saffran
title: Rubinstein Professor
summary: Studies how babies learn language through statistical learning and its relationship to prediction and active sampling.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过统计学习来学习语言及其与预测和主动采样的关系。

name: Kate Walsh
title: Professor
summary: Studies risk factors for sexual violence and outcomes of victimization, developing prevention and treatment programs.
summary_zh: 研究性暴力的风险因素及其后果，开发预防和治疗计划。

name: Andrew Alexander
title: Position title: Faculty Co-Director, Brain Imaging Core, Director of MR Physics Research, Professor of Medical Physics and Psychiatry
summary: Develops MRI techniques to study brain changes across the lifespan, focusing on infants, adults with Down syndrome, and autism.
summary_zh: 开发MRI技术研究大脑随生命周期的变化，重点关注婴儿、唐氏综合症成人和自闭症。

name: Vaishali Bakshi
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies mental illness in rodents, focusing on information-processing abnormalities in schizophrenia and PTSD, using behavioral, neuroendocrine, and molecular methods.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的精神疾病，重点关注精神分裂症和 PTSD 中的信息处理异常，使用行为学、神经内分泌和分子方法。

name: Brian A. Baldo
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling motivated behavior, particularly feeding, using behavioral, anatomical, and molecular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究控制动机行为（尤其是进食）的神经回路，使用行为、解剖和分子技术。

name: Matthew Banks
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Anesthesiology
summary: Studies how changes in brain activity and connectivity affect consciousness, using behavioral assays and imaging in humans and rodents.
summary_zh: 研究大脑活动和连接性变化如何影响意识，使用行为测试和成像技术在人类和啮齿动物中进行研究。

name: Barbara Bendlin
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Medicine
summary: Studies brain aging and dementia risk factors using neuroimaging and biomarkers.
summary_zh: 研究大脑老化和痴呆风险因素，使用神经影像学和生物标志物。

name: Rasmus Birn
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Develops new imaging strategies to improve fMRI accuracy and functional connectivity estimates, focusing on resting fMRI fluctuations and brain development.
summary_zh: 开发新的成像策略以提高功能性磁共振成像的准确性和功能性连接估计，重点关注静息状态fMRI波动和大脑发育。

name: Melanie Boly
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of consciousness in healthy subjects and neurological patients using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究健康受试者和神经疾病患者意识的神经机制，使用神经影像学技术。

name: Corinna Burger
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of learning and memory in aging and neurodegenerative disorders using gene therapy and rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病中学习和记忆的分子和细胞机制，使用基因疗法和啮齿动物模型。

name: Michael Cahill
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Comparative Biosciences
summary: Studies the molecular and biochemical mechanisms of synaptic plasticity and how genetic and environmental factors impact cognition and behavior in neuropsychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性的分子和生物化学机制以及遗传和环境因素如何影响神经精神疾病中的认知和行为。

name: Melisa C. Carrasco
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies long-term cognitive development of children, focusing on how children's cognitive abilities evolve over time.
summary_zh: 研究儿童长期认知发展，关注儿童认知能力随时间的变化。

name: Qiang Chang
title: Position title: Professor, Departments of Medical Genetics and Neurology
summary: Studies epigenetic regulation of brain functions and brain development, contributing to understanding brain diseases.
summary_zh: 研究大脑功能和发育的表观遗传调控，以及大脑疾病的机制。

name: Bradley T. Christian
title: Position title: Professor, Departments of Medical Physics and Psychiatry
summary: Develops and translates novel PET radiotracers to study neurochemical changes in the brain, focusing on neurodevelopment and neurodegeneration.
summary_zh: 开发和转化新型PET示踪剂，研究大脑中的神经化学变化，重点关注神经发育和神经退行性疾病。

name: Chiara Cirelli
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the mechanisms and functional consequences of sleep and sleep loss using a variety of methods in animal models.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和睡眠缺失的机制及其功能后果，使用多种方法在动物模型中进行.

name: Michelle Ciucci
title: Position title: Professor, Departments of Communication Sciences & Disorders and Surgery-Otolaryngology Head & Neck Surgery
summary: Studies the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases, particularly Parkinson's, using animal models and human clinical studies to understand communication, swallowing, and cognitive.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，尤其是帕金森病的起始和进展，使用动物模型和临床研究来理解沟通、吞咽和认知功能。

name: LaTasha K. Crawford
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Pathobiological Sciences
summary: Studies chronic pain mechanisms and peripheral neuropathies using mouse models and veterinary patients, focusing on sensory neurobiology and neuronal circuits.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛机制和周围神经病变，使用小鼠模型和兽医患者，侧重于感觉神经生物学和神经环路。

name: Jared Cregg
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Departments of Neuroscience and Neurology
summary: Studies brainstem circuits controlling locomotor movement, using advanced techniques to understand motor control and disorders like Parkinson’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究脑干电路控制运动的机制，使用先进技术理解运动控制和帕金森病等运动障碍。

name: David Ehrlich
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Integrative Biology
summary: Studies interactions between the nervous system and body during movement control, with a focus on development and behavioral state across various species.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统与身体在运动控制中的相互作用，特别关注发育和行为状态的影响，涉及多种物种。

name: Bernadette Gillick
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Pediatrics
summary: Studies early brain injury, rehabilitation, and neuroplasticity in children, using neuromodulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究儿童早期脑损伤、康复和神经可塑性，使用神经调节技术。

name: Carey E. Gleason
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Medicine
summary: Develops and tests Alzheimer’s disease biomarkers in Black and Indigenous populations, focusing on improving timely detection.
summary_zh: 开发和测试阿尔茨海默病生物标志物，重点关注提高黑人和土著人群的早期检测。

name: Tim Gomez
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
