summary: Studies intracellular signaling and molecular mechanisms in axon outgrowth and neural circuit formation, linking to cognitive functions like autism and dyslexia.
summary_zh: 研究轴突生长和神经回路形成的细胞内信号传导和分子机制，与认知功能障碍如自闭症和阅读障碍相关。

name: David Herzfeld
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural circuits for adaptive behavior, using motor control tasks, optogenetics, and machine learning in awake, behaving nonhuman primates.
summary_zh: 研究适应性行为的神经回路，使用运动控制任务、光遗传学和机器学习在清醒行为的非人灵长类动物中进行探究。

name: Xin Huang
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying visual perception and behavior using electrophysiology, psychophysics, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和行为的神经机制，使用电生理学、心理物理学和计算建模方法。

name: Zhen Huang
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Departments of Neurology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of brain development and degeneration, focusing on microglial and neuro-vascular signaling in neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和退化中的分子和细胞机制，重点关注小胶质细胞和神经血管信号在神经发育障碍和神经退行性疾病中的作用。

name: Edward Hubbard
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Educational Psychology
summary: Studies how education and neuroscience intersect, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods with children and adults, especially those with neurodevelopmental abnormalities.
summary_zh: 研究教育与神经科学的交叉领域，使用行为和神经成像方法研究儿童和成人，特别是神经发育异常个体的认知和感觉整合。

name: Sterling C. Johnson
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Medicine
summary: Studies brain changes related to Alzheimer's disease, using PET and MRI to identify pre-symptomatic processes.
summary_zh: 研究与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑部变化，使用PET和MRI识别亚临床过程。

name: Ned H. Kalin
title: Position title: Professor and Chair, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neurobiological development of anxiety and depression, using translational research methods.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和抑郁的神经生物学发展，采用转化研究方法。

name: Ruth Litovsky
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Communication Sciences & Disorders
summary: Studies how the auditory system enables listeners to function in complex environments, using behavioral and neural measures.
summary_zh: 研究听觉系统如何使听者在复杂环境中正常工作，使用行为和神经测量方法。

name: Christopher Nicholas
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Family Medicine and Community Health
summary: Studies the clinical efficacy and therapeutic mechanisms of psychedelic compounds like psilocybin and ketamine for addiction, PTSD, and depression, using fMRI as a biomarker.
summary_zh: 研究致幻化合物（如迷幻蘑菇、 MDMA 和酮胺）在成瘾、PTSD 和抑郁治疗中的临床疗效及其机制，使用功能性磁共振成像 (fMRI) 作为生物标志物。

name: Caroline Niziolek
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Communication Sciences and Disorders
summary: Studies the sensorimotor control of speech, using neuroimaging techniques to understand how feedback from our voices helps us learn and correct speech errors.
summary_zh: 研究语音产生的传感器运动控制，使用神经影像技术理解反馈如何帮助我们学习和纠正语音错误。

name: Ozioma Okonkwo
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Medicine
summary: Studies Alzheimer’s disease risk factors and cognitive resilience, using brain and fluid biomarkers, with a focus on modifiable and non-modifiable factors.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的风险因素和认知韧性，使用脑部和体液生物标志物，重点关注可改变和不可改变的因素。

name: Benjamin Parrell
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Communication Sciences and Disorders
summary: Studies the neurobiological and computational bases of speech motor control, using behavioral studies and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究言语运动控制的神经生物学和计算基础，使用行为研究和计算建模方法。

name: David T. Plante
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies sleep disorders, particularly hypersomnolence, using neurophysiology and high-density EEG.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠障碍，特别是过度嗜睡，使用神经生理学和高密度脑电图方法。

name: Luis Populin
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sensorimotor integration, decision-making, and the effects of psychostimulants and vagus nerve stimulation on cognitive function.
summary_zh: 研究感觉运动整合、决策机制以及精神刺激剂和迷走神经刺激对认知功能的影响。

name: Vivek Prabhakaran
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Radiology
summary: Develops multimodal neuroimaging biomarkers for aging and stroke using MRI, fMRI, PET, and machine learning.
summary_zh: 开发用于衰老和中风的多模态神经影像学生物标志物，使用MRI、fMRI、PET和机器学习。

name: Betsy Quinlan
title: Position title: Professor and Chair, Department of Neuroscience, Herman and Rubinstein Chair of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how synaptic plasticity in the aging mouse visual cortex can be rejuvenated by visual deprivation and light exposure, using psychophysics and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层在老化小鼠中的突触可塑性可以通过视觉剥夺和光照恢复，并使用心理物理学和电生理学方法定义其机制。

name: Lauren Riters
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Integrative Biology
summary: Studies the neural basis of social behavior and vocal communication in songbirds using behavioral and molecular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的社会行为和鸣唱交流的神经基础，使用行为和分子技术。

name: Timothy T. Rogers
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain forms and retrieves concepts, using neural network models and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究概念知识的形成和检索过程，使用神经网络模型和脑成像技术。

name: Ari Rosenberg
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how hierarchical neural circuits transform sensory signals into precise object representations, using behavioral tasks, neuroimaging, and modeling with human and non-human primates.
summary_zh: 研究层次神经网络如何将感官信号转化为精确的对象表征，使用行为任务、神经成像和建模方法，涉及人类和非人灵长类动物。

name: Melissa Rosenkranz
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the bi-directional mind-brain-immune pathways, using neuroimaging to examine the effects of stress and emotion on inflammation and vice versa, with a focus on meditation as a behavioral.
summary_zh: 研究大脑-免疫-情绪双向路径，使用神经影像学研究压力和情绪对炎症的影响以及反之亦然，并将冥想作为行为干预手段。

name: Sarah J. Short
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Educational Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of poverty on brain development and cognitive processes in children using neuroimaging and biomarkers.
summary_zh: 研究贫困对儿童大脑发育和认知过程的影响，使用神经影像学和生物标志物。

name: André M. M. Sousa
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of human brain development and evolution, and their disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑发育和进化的分子和细胞机制及其在神经发育障碍中的紊乱。

name: Giulio Tononi
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the functions and mechanisms of sleep and the neural substrate of consciousness, developing theories like integrated information theory and synaptic homeostasis hypothesis.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠的功能和机制以及意识的神经基础，发展了整合信息理论和突触稳态假说等理论。

name: Brittany Travers
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Kinesiology
summary: Studies the intersection between sensorimotor skills and neurobiology in autistic individuals, using MRI and DWI to understand brain contributions to movement and daily living skills.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍个体的运动和感觉运动技能与神经生物学之间的交集，使用MRI和DWI了解大脑对运动和日常生活技能的贡献。

name: Han Wang
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Department of Integrative Biology
summary: Studies sleep regulation in C. elegans using genetic tools and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 使用遗传工具和光遗传学研究秀丽隐杆线虫的睡眠调控机制。

name: Cody J. Wenthur
title: Position title: Associate Professor, School of Pharmacy
summary: Develops and applies methods to study psychoactive drugs and their effects on learning, memory, and behavior.
summary_zh: 开发和应用方法研究精神活性药物对其学习、记忆和行为的影响。

name: Cara Westmark
title: Position title: Associate Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies the effects of amyloid beta on synaptic function in fragile X syndrome and Alzheimer’s disease, using mouse models and therapeutic interventions.
summary_zh: 研究淀粉样蛋白β对脆性X综合症和阿尔茨海默病突触功能的影响，使用小鼠模型和治疗干预措施。

name: Jerry Yin
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Genetics
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular bases of memory consolidation in Drosophila, focusing on the role of protein synthesis.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇记忆巩固的细胞和分子基础，重点关注蛋白质合成的作用。

name: JP Yu
title: Position title: Assistant Professor, Departments of Radiology, Psychiatry, and Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies the impact of genes, environment, and gene-environment interactions on brain microstructure in neuropsychiatric illnesses, using MRI and PET.
summary_zh: 研究基因、环境及其相互作用对神经精神疾病中脑微结构的影响，使用MRI和PET成像技术。

name: Xinyu Zhao
title: Position title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms regulating neuronal development and their implications in human intellectual disabilities, including autism, Fragile X syndrome, and Rett Syndrome.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育机制及其在人类智力障碍（包括自闭症、脆性X综合征和雷特综合征）中的作用。

name: John Adams
title: Faculty
summary: Applies creative problem-solving methods to behavioral science research and teaching.
summary_zh: 应用创造性解决问题的方法进行行为科学的研究和教学。

name: Analia Albuja
title: is an assistant professor in the psychology and applied psychology departments
summary: Studies how people integrate multiple identities and are perceived by others, using experimental, physiological, and developmental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究多重身份的整合及其被他人感知的方式，采用实验、生理和发展性方法。

name: Iris Berent
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how phonology is constrained by universal principles and how laypeople reason about human nature.
summary_zh: 研究语音学是否受普遍原则的约束以及普通人如何推理人类本质。

name: Peter Bex
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception in dynamic environments and develops treatments for blinding eye diseases using behavioral and computational techniques.
summary_zh: 研究动态环境中的视觉感知，并使用行为和计算技术开发治疗致盲眼病的方法。

name: Reyyan Bilge
title: Faculty
summary: Studies spatial cognition and episodic memory using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究空间认知和情景记忆，采用多种实验方法。

name: Kristopher Bradley
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches psychology, statistics, and research design courses.
summary_zh: 教授心理学、统计学和研究设计课程。

name: Heather Brenhouse
title: is a professor and director of Graduate Studies for the Department of Psychology at Northeaste
summary: Studies how early life stress affects the development of inhibitory interneurons in the prefrontal cortex, leading to behavioral dysfunction later in life.
summary_zh: 研究早期压力如何影响前额叶皮层抑制性中间神经元的发展，导致后期行为功能障碍。

name: Terri Bright
title: Faculty
summary: Develops methods to assess and modify dog behavior, improving shelter dogs' adoptability.
summary_zh: 开发评估和修改犬类行为的方法，提高收养率。

name: Jamie Bunce
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how disruptions in prefrontal cortex and medial temporal lobe pathways affect emotional memory integration in anxiety disorders.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层和内侧颞叶通路的中断如何影响焦虑障碍中情绪记忆的整合。

name: John Coley
title: is a professor of psychology and director of the Conceptual Organization, Reasoning, and Educa
summary: Studies how people organize and use knowledge, reasoning, and conceptual development in various domains like plants and animals, food, and people, using experimental methods with children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何组织和运用知识、推理和概念发展，特别是在植物和动物、食物和人的领域，通过实验方法考察儿童和成人的认知广度、深度和灵活性。

name: Aaron B. Daniels
title: Faculty
summary: Explores the use of imagination in criminal profiling and the intersection of psychology, literature, and spirituality.
summary_zh: 探索想象在犯罪画像中的应用以及心理学、文学和灵性之间的交叉。

name: Juliet Davidow
title: joined the psychology department as an assistant professor at Northeastern University in 2020, and established the Learning and Brain Deve
summary: Studies how learning behaviors change with age, influencing memory, decision-making, and goals in children, adolescents, and adults.
summary_zh: 研究随年龄变化的学习行为如何影响记忆、决策和目标。

name: Elisabetta del Re
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how psychosis develops in relation to genetic and environmental factors, using neuroimaging and genetics.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症的发生与发展与遗传和环境因素的关系，使用神经成像和遗传学方法。

name: David DeSteno
title: is a professor in the Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how emotions influence decision-making and social behavior, using multiple approaches.
summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响决策和社会行为，采用多层面的方法。

name: Amy DiBattista
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how sentence production works, focusing on syntactic planning and lexical selection.
summary_zh: 研究句子生成过程，关注句法规划和词汇选择。

name: R. Cole Eidson
title: Faculty
summary: Modifies pedagogical approach in psychology courses using AI and experiential learning to promote deeper learning.
summary_zh: 使用人工智能和体验式学习调整教学方法，促进更深入的学习。

name: Rhea Eskew
title: Faculty
summary: Studies color detection and discrimination using psychophysical data and quantitative models.
summary_zh: 研究颜色检测与辨别，使用心理物理学数据和定量模型。

name: Craig Ferris
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how early risk factors like drugs and social stress alter brain plasticity and behavior in rodents and monkeys, aiming to improve interventions for psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究早期风险因素如药物和社交压力如何改变啮齿动物和猴子的大脑可塑性和行为，旨在改善精神疾病干预策略。

name: Laurel Gabard-Durnam
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how different environments and neuroplasticity interact to shape brain and behavior development, focusing on typical and adverse interactions.
summary_zh: 研究不同环境和神经可塑性如何相互作用塑造大脑和行为的发展，重点关注典型和不良的相互作用。

name: Charles Hillman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the impact of physical activity on brain health and cognition across the lifespan, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究体育活动对大脑健康和认知功能的影响，使用神经影像技术贯穿整个生命周期。

name: Jenn Ingemi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the nervous system coordinates complex behaviors using the nematode worm, identifying neurotransmitters and neural circuits.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何协调复杂行为，通过秀丽隐杆线虫识别神经递质和神经回路。

name: Susanne Jaeggi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how working memory and executive functions can be improved through training, using experimental and neuroscientific methods.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和执行功能可以通过训练得到改善，使用实验和神经科学方法。

name: Jennelle Kariotis
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches courses in personality, social psychology, and research design.
summary_zh: 教授人格、社会心理学和研究设计等课程。

name: Grayson Kimball
title: Faculty
summary: Works with athletes and executives, providing mental performance coaching and running mental skills training.
summary_zh: 为运动员和高管提供心理表现辅导，进行长距离跑步的心理技能训练。

name: MiYoung Kwon
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how visual impairment affects visual perception and brain plasticity, using behavioral experiments, eye tracking, neuroimaging, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉障碍如何影响视觉感知和大脑可塑性，使用行为实验、眼动追踪、神经成像和计算建模方法。

name: Esteban Sebastian Lelo de Larrea-Mancera
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how perception, cognition, and action interact in behavior, using behavioral, electro-physiological, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、认知和行动如何在行为中相互作用，使用行为学、电生理学和计算方法。

name: Psyche Loui
title: is Associate Professor of Creativity and Creative Practice in the Department of Music and director of
summary: Studies the neuroscience of music perception and cognition, exploring brain connectivity and its effects on emotional responses to music.
summary_zh: 研究音乐感知和认知的神经科学，探索大脑连接性及其对音乐情感反应的影响。

name: Stacy Marsella
title: Faculty
summary: Models human cognition, emotion, and social behavior for health interventions and social skills training.
summary_zh: 建模人类认知、情绪和社会行为，应用于健康干预和社会技能训练。

name: Richard Melloni Jr
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiology of aggression and anxiety, using pharmacology and social stress to understand neural circuits and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究攻击和焦虑的神经生物学，使用药理学和社会压力来理解神经回路和行为。

name: Stephanie Noble
title: Faculty
summary: Develops tools for precise human neuroscience inference and prediction, combining data science, neuroscience, and open science.
summary_zh: 开发工具以实现精确的人类神经科学推断和预测，结合数据科学、神经科学和开放科学。

name: Lace Padilla
title: joined Northeastern University in 2023 as an assistant professor of computer science and psychology where she is a member of the Data Visualizat
summary: Studies how data visualizations of future events align with human decision-making, using information visualization techniques.
summary_zh: 研究未来事件的数据可视化如何与人类决策相匹配，使用信息可视化技术。

name: Jonathan Peelle
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how sensory and cognitive factors interact in speech comprehension, using neuroimaging to understand communication success.
summary_zh: 研究感觉和认知因素如何在言语理解中相互作用，使用神经成像技术来理解沟通成功。

name: Mark Prokosch
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the integration of ultimate and proximate explanations of human social-cognitive traits, focusing on mate preferences and individual differences in intelligence and creativity.
summary_zh: 研究人类社会认知特征的终极和近因解释，重点关注择偶偏好和智力、创造力等个体差异。

name: Zhenghan Qi
title: is an assistant professor jointly appointed by Communication Sciences and Disorders at Bouvé and Psycholo
summary: Studies the neurobiological organization of language in the human brain, its development from childhood to adulthood, and disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑中语言的神经生物学组织、其从儿童到成年的发育以及神经发育障碍中的中断。

name: Karen Quigley
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how bodily signals influence emotional experiences and behaviors, using laboratory and daily life measures to understand individual differences in affective responses.
summary_zh: 研究身体信号如何影响情绪体验和行为，使用实验室和日常生活测量来理解个体在情绪反应中的差异。

name: Brie Reid
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how early social experiences and nutrition affect human development, examining stress, the immune system, and nutrient metabolism.
summary_zh: 研究早期社会经历和营养如何影响人类发展，考察压力、免疫系统和营养代谢。

name: Lesley Ricci
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, using evidence-based practices in teaching and research.
summary_zh: 研究大脑系统的行为机制，采用基于证据的教学和研究实践。

name: David Richters
title: Faculty
summary: Studies low-level detection and discrimination mechanisms for color vision and how eye movements affect perception.
summary_zh: 研究颜色视觉的基本检测和辨别机制以及眼动对知觉的影响。

name: Alexandra Rodman
title: is an assistant professor in the Department of Psychology and Center for Cognitive and Brain Health
summary: Studies how social experiences interact with cognitive and brain development to increase risk for mental health problems during adolescence, using behavioral tasks, neuroimaging, and mobile phone.
summary_zh: 研究青少年的社会经历如何与认知和大脑发展相互作用，增加心理健康问题的风险，使用行为任务、神经成像和移动电话数据。

name: Karen Rodriguez
title: Faculty
summary: Studies collaborative memory, metamemory, and social conformity in decision-making, using experimental psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究协作记忆、元记忆和社会一致性在决策中的作用，采用实验心理学方法。

name: Terri Scott
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of language and working memory using fMRI, electrocorticography, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像、皮层脑电图、计算建模和机器学习研究语言和工作记忆的神经机制。

name: Aaron Seitz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes, learning, and perceptual enhancement using diverse methods and populations.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程、学习和知觉增强，使用多种方法和人群。

name: Saba Shahid
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social and health behaviors, using rigorous research and data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究社会和健康行为，通过严谨的研究和数据分析推进人类行为的理解。

name: William Sharp
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how individual minds work, focusing on learning difficulties and therapy, using psychoanalytic research.
summary_zh: 研究个体心理，关注学习障碍和治疗，采用精神分析研究方法。

name: Summer Sheremata
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain processes and remembers visual information, using brain imaging techniques to understand everyday tasks and clinical conditions.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和记忆视觉信息，使用脑成像技术理解日常任务和临床状况。

name: Karen Spikes
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches undergraduate courses and provides management consulting in strategic coaching, leadership development, and change management.
summary_zh: 教授本科课程并提供战略辅导、领导力发展和变革管理方面的管理咨询。

name: Briony Swire-Thompson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people believe in inaccurate information and how to correct misinformation effectively.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何相信错误信息以及如何有效纠正错误信息。

name: Xiangyun Tang
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychosocial development of adolescents and young adults using communication technologies.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻人在通信技术背景下的心理社会发展。

name: Briana Taylor
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how circadian rhythms and sleep affect daytime functioning in youth with autism spectrum disorder, using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究昼夜节律和睡眠对自闭症谱系障碍青少年日间功能的影响，采用计算方法。

name: Jordan Theriault
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain-based metabolic costs of information encoding and their implications for mental health using neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究信息编码的脑基代谢成本及其对心理健康的影响，使用神经成像技术。

name: Hilmar von Strünck
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程及其发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Joanna Weaver
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive development in early childhood and how social-psychological factors influence learning in educational settings.
summary_zh: 研究早期儿童的认知发展以及社会心理因素如何影响教育环境中的学习。

name: Susan Whitfield-Gabrieli
title: is a professor of psychology, the Founding Director of the Biomedical Imaging Center at Northe
summary: Studies brain development and disorders using neuroimaging, focusing on working memory and treatment translation.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和障碍，使用神经成像技术，重点关注工作记忆和治疗方法的转化。

name: Alison Athey
title: The Sara and Curt Moll Professor in Caregiver Mental Health and Well-Being
summary: Studies the mental health and well-being of caregivers, focusing on suicide and overdose prevention, with a particular emphasis on bereaved families and individuals involved in the criminal-legal.
summary_zh: 研究照顾者的心理健康和福祉，特别是在自杀和过量用药预防方面，重点关注丧亲家庭和刑事司法系统中的个体。

name: Kristina Bowdrie
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the interactions between individuals with hearing loss and their environments, impacting clinical outcomes and advancing aural rehabilitation practices.
summary_zh: 研究听力损失个体与其环境之间的互动，影响临床结果并推进听觉康复实践。

name: Lauren Calandruccio
title: Professor & COSI PhD Program Director
summary: Studies auditory perception for listeners with normal hearing and hearing loss, including second language speakers.
summary_zh: 研究正常听力和听力损失听者的听觉感知，包括第二语言学习者。

name: R. Elizabeth Capps
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies factors affecting academic and social functioning in adolescents with ADHD and develops school-based interventions to improve their outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究影响患有ADHD的青少年学业和社会功能的因素，并开发学校干预措施以提高其结果。

name: Angela Ciccia
title: Professor & Associate Interim Chair, Graduate Program Director (SLP program)
summary: Studies factors affecting children's recovery from neurogenic communication disorders, including the use of telemedicine.
summary_zh: 研究神经性沟通障碍儿童恢复的影响因素，包括远程医疗服务的应用。

name: Heath Demaree
title: Professor
summary: Studies the interaction between emotional and cognitive processing, focusing on exploration versus exploitation decision-making in humans and other animals.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和认知处理之间的相互作用，重点关注人类和其他动物的探索与利用决策。

name: Anastasia Dimitropoulos
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral characteristics of individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders, using brain imaging and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍个体的认知和行为特征，使用脑成像和眼动追踪技术。

name: Norah Feeny
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive behavioral treatments for anxiety and mood disorders, evaluating PTSD treatments and predicting treatment outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究认知行为疗法治疗焦虑和情绪障碍，评估 PTSD 治疗并预测治疗效果。

name: Robert Greene
title: Professor
summary: Studies how repetition and short-term vs long-term memory affect word recall in humans.
summary_zh: 研究重复和短期与长期记忆对人类单词回忆的影响。

name: Melissa Libertus
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of mathematical thinking from infancy to adulthood, focusing on early numerical understanding and parental support.
summary_zh: 研究从婴儿期到成年期的数学思维发展，重点关注早期的数字理解及父母的支持。

name: Helen Long
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies early communication development and intervention in young children with neurodevelopmental disabilities, focusing on motor disabilities like cerebral palsy.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍儿童（如脑瘫）的早期沟通发展和干预。

name: Rachel Mulheren
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurophysiology of swallowing and communication, focusing on how sensation and perception affect swallowing.
summary_zh: 研究吞咽和交流的神经生理学，重点关注感觉和知觉如何影响吞咽。

name: Katerina Ntourou
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of executive function, emotional processes, and temperament in childhood stuttering, focusing on risk and protective factors.
summary_zh: 研究执行功能、情绪过程和气质在儿童口吃中的作用，重点关注风险和保护因素。

name: Rita Obeid
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies predictors of language difficulties in school-aged children and factors influencing stigma towards people with disabilities.
summary_zh: 研究学龄儿童语言困难的预测因素以及残疾人污名的影响因素。

name: Stacy R. Ryan-Pettes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies therapeutic processes in family-based treatments for adolescent substance use, using AI and machine learning in real-world settings.
summary_zh: 研究家庭治疗过程对青少年物质使用障碍的影响，使用人工智能和机器学习方法在实际环境中进行干预。

name: Lee A. Thompson
title: Professor
summary: Studies genetic and environmental influences on cognitive development and academic achievement in children, using twins and longitudinal designs.
summary_zh: 研究遗传和环境因素对儿童认知发展和学业成就的影响，使用双胞胎和纵向设计。

name: Rebecca Hazen
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Anthony Jack
title: Associate Professor and Elmer G. Beamer-Hubert H. Schneider Chair in Ethics
summary: Studies attention, consciousness, and social processing using fMRI.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像研究注意力、意识和社会处理。

name: Carolyn Landis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Lynn Singer
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effects of maternal drug use during pregnancy on child development, focusing on cocaine, alcohol, MDMA, and opioids.
summary_zh: 研究母体在怀孕期间使用毒品对儿童发展的影响，重点关注可卡因、酒精、 MDMA 和阿片类药物。

name: Terry Stancin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Primary Appointment
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为，使用多种实验方法。

name: Fey Parrill
title: Professor, Department of Cognitive Science, College of Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how the human body shapes thinking (embodied cognition) and how gestures aid learning in STEM subjects, with a focus on climate cognition.
summary_zh: 研究人体如何塑造思维（具身认知）以及手势如何帮助学习STEM知识，并关注气候变化认知。

name: Yasuhiro Shirai
title: Professor, Department of Cognitive Science, College of Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies first and second language acquisition of grammatical constructions, particularly tense-aspect and relative clauses, using cognitive models and corpus-based research.
summary_zh: 研究第一语言和第二语言中语法结构（尤其是时态-方面和定语从句）的习得，采用认知模型和语料库研究方法。

name: Vera Tobin
title: Associate Professor, Department of Cognitive Science
summary: Studies how cognitive biases influence narrative interpretation and construction, focusing on irony and joint attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知偏差如何影响叙事的解释与构建，重点关注讽刺和共注意现象。

name: Mark Turner
title: Institute professor, Department of Cognitive Science, College of Arts and Sciences
summary: Studies how human meaning and language are constructed through conceptual integration and mental packing and unpacking.
summary_zh: 研究人类意义和语言是如何通过概念整合以及心理打包和解包构建起来的。

name: Danming An
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the interplay between social cognitive characteristics and contextual factors in shaping children’s socio-emotional competence and psychopathology, using complex methods like structural.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知特征与环境因素如何共同塑造儿童的情绪社会能力和心理病理学问题，使用复杂的方法如结构方程模型和访谈。

name: Kate Arrington
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control in multitasking environments, exploring how individuals select and switch between tasks.
summary_zh: 研究多任务环境中的认知控制，探讨个体如何选择和切换任务。

name: Susan Barrett
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children develop cognitive skills, focusing on perception and memory.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知技能的发展，重点关注知觉和记忆。

name: Sarah Borowski
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how close friendships affect adolescents' development and well-being, focusing on disclosure behaviors and psychophysiological reactivity.
summary_zh: 研究亲密友谊如何影响青少年的发展和福祉，重点关注披露行为和生理心理反应。

name: Amanda Brandone
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children understand non-obvious properties of people and abstract categories, using generics and social experience.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何理解人的非显而易见的属性和抽象类别，使用泛指短语和社会经验。

name: Christopher Burke
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate difficult life experiences, including grief and loss, and how autobiographical reflection and ritual can foster personal transformation.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对艰难生活经历，包括丧亲之痛，并探讨自传性反思和仪式如何促进个人转变。

name: Nancy Carlisle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences in proactive control influence attentional templates, using behavioral and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异的前向控制如何影响注意模板，使用行为和神经生理学方法。

name: Patrick Cox
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how context and experience affect visual perception and attention, using behavioral testing, EEG, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究上下文和经验如何影响视觉感知和注意力，使用行为测试、EEG和计算建模方法。

name: Michael Gill
title: Professor
summary: Studies how historical narratives influence blame and moral judgment, using social psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究历史叙事如何影响责备和道德判断，使用社会心理实验方法。

name: Almut Hupbach
title: Professor
summary: Studies memory dynamics, including directed forgetting, memory consolidation, and stress effects on memory.
summary_zh: 研究记忆动态，包括定向遗忘、记忆巩固以及压力对记忆的影响。

name: Jiin Jung
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social psychological processes, including identity uncertainty and outgroup influence, using theoretical models and empirical research.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理过程，包括身份不确定性及外群体影响，采用理论模型和实证研究方法。

name: Debbie Laible
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children construct understanding of self, others, and relationships through close relationships, focusing on socialization of emotion and morality, and how economic risk affects these.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过亲密关系构建自我、他人和关系的理解，重点关注情感和道德的社会化以及经济风险对其的影响。

name: Jessecae Marsh
title: Professor
summary: Studies how beliefs about causality and categories influence reasoning and decision-making, using cognitive psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究信念如何影响因果关系和类别推理，以及决策制定，采用认知心理学方法。

name: Gordon Moskowitz
title: Professor
summary: Studies unconscious influences on social judgments and how to control biases through automatic goals.
summary_zh: 研究社会判断中的无意识影响及其通过自动目标进行控制的方法。

name: Lucy Napper
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the mental health and substance use behaviors of college students during the pandemic, focusing on parental communication and drinking games.
summary_zh: 研究疫情期间大学生的心理健康和物质使用行为，重点关注父母沟通和饮酒游戏。

name: Dominic Packer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social identities influence beliefs, emotions, and decisions, with a focus on intergroup relations and leadership.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份如何影响信念、情感和决策，重点关注群体关系和领导力。

name: Alexis Smith-Flores
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how infants and young children use emotional cues to learn about the physical and social world, combining behavioral methods and open science practices.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何利用情绪线索学习物理和社会世界，结合行为方法和开放科学实践。

name: Duane Wegener
title: Professor and Department Chair, Social Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies how attitudes and beliefs form and change, focusing on information processing and its consequences.
summary_zh: 研究态度和信念的形成与变化，重点关注信息处理及其后果。

name: Riana Brown
title: Assistant Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies how people respond to social problems like social inequality and climate change, focusing on communication strategies to promote social change.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对社会问题（如社会不平等和气候变化），重点关注促进社会变革的沟通策略。

name: Gyeongcheol Cho
title: Assistant Professor, Quantitative Psychology
summary: Develops quantitative methods to explore relationships between human behavioral, psychological, and biological variables, using factor analyses, structural equation modeling, and interpretable.
summary_zh: 开发定量方法以探索人类行为、心理和生物变量之间的关系，使用因子分析、结构方程模型和可解释的机器学习。

name: Laurence Coutellier
title: Associate Professor, Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies the prefrontal cortex's role in anxiety, executive function, and social impairments using behavioral assays and transgenic mice.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层在焦虑、执行功能和社会障碍中的作用，使用行为测试和转基因小鼠。

name: Michael DeKay
title: Professor, Decision Psychology, Quantitative Psychology
summary: Studies judgment and decision-making, focusing on risky-choice framing effects and perceptions of energy use.
summary_zh: 研究判断与决策，重点关注风险选择框架效应和能源使用感知。

name: Ido Erev
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making processes, particularly how people's choices are influenced by past experiences and incentives, using descriptive models and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程，特别是人们的选择如何受到过去经验及激励的影响，使用描述性模型和实验方法。

name: Kentaro Fujita
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies self-control failures and decision-making processes, particularly why people make choices that undermine their goals.
summary_zh: 研究自我控制失败和决策过程，特别是人们为何做出损害自身目标的选择。

name: John Gibbs
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies cross-cultural sociomoral development, parental socialization, empathy, and antisocial behavior, developing assessment measures and prevention programs.
summary_zh: 研究跨文化道德发展、父母社会化、同理心和反社会行为，开发评估量表和预防项目。

name: Julie Golomb
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies how visual attention, memory, and eye movements interact to influence perception and behavior using human behavioral and computational cognitive neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意、记忆和眼动如何相互作用影响知觉和行为，使用人类行为和计算认知神经科学方法。

name: Kurt Gray
title: Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies moral psychology and how to reduce political divides, using lab and center-based research.
summary_zh: 研究道德心理学，探索如何减少政治分歧，通过实验室和中心研究。

name: Richard Jagacinski
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology
summary: Studies rhythmic attention in athletic and musical performance, attention and memory in vehicular control, and perceptual-motor skills in older adults.
summary_zh: 研究运动和音乐表现中的节律注意力、车辆控制中的注意力和记忆以及老年人的知觉-运动技能。

name: Peter Kvam
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies how people make complex, dynamic decisions, using machine learning and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何做出复杂动态的决策，使用机器学习和计算模型。

name: Andrew Leber
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies cognitive control, focusing on how humans selectively attend to relevant stimuli and ignore irrelevant ones, using behavioral studies and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制，关注人类如何选择性地注意相关信息并忽略无关信息，使用行为研究和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Luc Lecavalier
title: Professor, Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
summary: Studies diagnosis and assessment of autism spectrum disorder and intellectual disabilities, focusing on behavior and psychiatric problems in children.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍和智力障碍的诊断与评估，关注儿童的行为和精神健康问题。

name: Kathryn Lenz
title: Professor, Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies the role of hormones and immune cells in brain development and neuropsychiatric disorders, using pharmacological and behavioral manipulations in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究激素和免疫细胞在大脑发育和神经精神障碍中的作用，使用药理学和行为操作在啮齿动物中进行研究。

name: Benedetta Leuner
title: Professor, Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies the effects of pregnancy, stress, and hormones on maternal behavior and brain health, using preclinical models.
summary_zh: 研究妊娠、压力和激素对母性行为和脑健康的影响，使用预临床模型。

name: Hsin-Hung Li
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies the computational and neural processes of decision-making, attention, and working memory using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究决策、注意和工作记忆的认知和神经过程，使用计算建模和神经成像方法。

name: Lisa Libby
title: Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies how subjective perceptions influence cognition, emotion, and behavior, using visual perspective in mental imagery.
summary_zh: 研究主观知觉如何影响认知、情绪和行为，并使用心理成像中的视觉视角进行研究。

name: Kristen Lindquist
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies the psychological and neural basis of emotions, moods, and feelings, using social cognition, physiology, and neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、情绪状态和感觉的心理和神经基础，使用社会认知、生理学和神经科学方法。

name: John Opfer
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies how children develop numerical concepts and understanding of proportional magnitude, using cognitive and educational methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展数概念和比例大小的理解，使用认知和教育方法。

name: David Osher
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies the relationship between brain connectivity, neural function, and behavior through computational modeling, focusing on attention and high-level visual perception.
summary_zh: 研究大脑连接性、神经功能与行为之间的关系，通过计算建模聚焦于注意力和高级视觉知觉。

name: Jolynn Pek
title: Professor, Quantitative Psychology
summary: Studies quantifying uncertainty in statistical results and methods for practical application in study design and data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究统计结果中的不确定性及其在研究设计和数据分析中的应用方法。

name: Stephen Petrill
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies how genetics and the environment influence the development of cognitive skills related to reading, mathematics, and language, using quantitative genetic, molecular genetic, behavioral.
summary_zh: 研究遗传和环境如何影响阅读、数学和语言认知技能的发展，采用定量遗传学、分子遗传学、行为学、认知学和神经影像学视角。

name: Alexander Petrov
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Psychology
summary: Studies how relational processing and analogy making contribute to human cognition, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究关系处理和类比推理在人类认知中的作用，采用计算模型和行为实验方法。

name: Richard Petty
title: Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies the factors influencing beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors, particularly the role of meta-cognitive and implicit factors in persuasion.
summary_zh: 研究信念、态度和行为的变化因素，特别是元认知和隐性因素在说服中的作用。

name: Roger Ratcliff
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making processes and reaction times using sequential sampling models.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和反应时，使用顺序采样模型。

name: Leslie Rudy
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches psychology and clinical skills, focusing on evidence-based practices and individualized learning strategies.
summary_zh: 教授心理学和临床技能，注重基于证据的教学实践和个性化学习策略。

name: Zeynep Saygin
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies how brain areas become responsible for specific cognitive functions, using neuroimaging and computational methods in development and clinical disorders.
summary_zh: 研究大脑区域如何承担特定认知功能，使用神经成像和计算方法在发展和临床障碍中的应用。

name: Sarah Schoppe-Sullivan
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies coparenting relationships, father-child dynamics, and the impact of children's behavior on family interactions, focusing on young children's social-emotional development.
summary_zh: 研究共育儿关系、父亲与孩子的互动以及儿童行为对家庭关系的影响，重点关注幼儿的社会情感发展。

name: Megha Sehgal
title: Assistant Professor, Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of habit formation and contextual memory integration in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中习惯形成和情境记忆整合的神经机制。

name: Brynn Sherman
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience, Cognitive Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain supports the formation of unique memories and abstracts general regularities, using neuroimaging and neural network models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持形成独特记忆和抽象一般规律，使用神经成像和神经网络模型。

name: Vladimir Sloutsky
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies how infants and young children form categories and generalize knowledge, using experimental methods with pre-linguistic infants, toddlers, and preschoolers.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何形成类别并进行知识泛化，使用预语言婴儿、学步儿和学龄前儿童的实验方法。

name: Steven Spencer
title: Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies how implicit processes affect stereotyping and prejudice, particularly how threats to the self-concept lead to biased thoughts and behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究潜意识过程如何影响刻板印象和偏见，特别是威胁自我概念如何导致有偏见的思维和行为。

name: Marc J. Tassé
title: Professor, Intellectual and Developmental Disablities
summary: Studies intellectual disability, autism spectrum disorder, and related neurodevelopmental disorders, focusing on co-occurring psychiatric disorders and adaptive behavior.
summary_zh: 研究智力障碍、自闭症谱系障碍及相关神经发育障碍，重点关注共发的精神障碍和适应行为。

name: Brandon Turner
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies how selective attention causes cognitive inertia, a pattern of information search, and how curated information can harm or distort learning.
summary_zh: 研究选择性注意如何导致认知惯性，即信息搜索的模式，以及如何使受curated信息损害或扭曲学习。

name: Trisha Van Zandt
title: Professor, Quantitative Psychology, Decision Psychology
summary: Studies the quantitative modeling of human information processing systems, neural networks, and memory, focusing on how information flows and is transformed during cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究人类信息处理系统的定量建模、神经网络和记忆，关注信息在认知任务中的流动和转换。

name: Dylan Wagner
title: Associate Professor, Social Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies how the brain encodes social relationships, including friends, fictional characters, and AI companions, using neuroimaging and naturalistic social tasks.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码人际关系，包括朋友、虚构人物和人工智能伴侣，使用神经成像和自然社会任务。

name: Laura Wagner
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies how children acquire language, focusing on their understanding of temporal and event semantics, and social indexical meanings.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的语言习得，特别是时间与事件语义以及社会语用意义的理解。

name: Katie Walton
title: Associate Professor, Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities
summary: Studies interventions for building early social-communication skills in individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorders, examining individual and family factors.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍早期社交沟通技能干预措施，考察个体和家庭因素。

name: Baldwin Way
title: Professor, Social Psychology
summary: Studies how social factors influence health through neurochemical signals, focusing on stress reactivity, drug action, and immune system modulation.
summary_zh: 研究社会因素如何通过神经化学信号影响健康，重点关注压力反应、药物作用和免疫系统调节。

name: Sami Yousif
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies spatial cognition and visual perception as case studies of mental representation.
summary_zh: 研究空间认知和视觉感知作为心智表征的案例研究。

name: Amy Brunell
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Mansfield Campus
summary: Studies the role of narcissism in social contexts, including leadership, decision-making, and relationship behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究自恋在社会情境中的作用，包括领导力、决策和人际关系行为。

name: Patrick Carroll
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Lima Campus
summary: Studies how and why people revise self-views in response to social feedback, and how such changes affect mental health and relational satisfaction.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何以及为何根据社会反馈调整自我观点，并探讨这些变化对心理健康和关系满意度的影响。

name: Christopher Daddis
title: Associate Professor, Developmental Psychology, Marion Campus
summary: Studies how adolescents construct boundaries of personal and parental authority, focusing on peer influence and voluntary disclosure.
summary_zh: 研究青少年如何构建个人与父母的权威边界，重点关注同伴影响和自愿披露。

name: Julie Hupp
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology, Newark Campus
summary: Studies how children learn words from prosodic cues, using experiments with adults and children.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从声调线索中学习新词，使用成人和儿童的实验方法。

name: Melissa Jungers
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Newark Campus
summary: Studies how people communicate in auditory domains, focusing on memory for complex auditory sequences, perception and production systems, and language and music parallels.
summary_zh: 研究人在听觉领域中的交流方式，关注复杂听觉序列的记忆、感知与生产系统以及语言与音乐的相似性。

name: Fabio Leite
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Lima Campus
summary: Studies cognitive processes, analyzing response time and accuracy in decision-making tasks.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，分析决策任务中的反应时间和准确性。

name: Delwin Lindsey
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Mansfield Campus
summary: Studies color vision, including neural channels, molecular genetics, and early development in infants, combining empirical and computational approaches.
summary_zh: 研究颜色视觉，包括神经通道、分子遗传学和婴儿早期发展，结合实证和计算方法。

name: Philip Mazzocco
title: Associate Professor, Social Psychology, Mansfield Campus
summary: Studies beliefs and opinions related to marginalized populations, focusing on racial ideology and colorblindness.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化群体相关的信念和观点，特别是种族意识形态和肤色盲视。

name: Bradley Okdie
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Newark Campus
summary: Studies how new technologies influence social interactions and psychological phenomena.
summary_zh: 研究新技术如何影响社会互动和心理现象。

name: Nikole Patson
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Marion Campus
summary: Studies how adults process and represent plurals in language comprehension, using experimental psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究成人如何在语言理解中处理和表示复数，采用实验心理学方法。

name: Chris Robinson
title: Associate Professor, Developmental Psychology, Newark Campus
summary: Studies how infants, children, and adults integrate multisensory information for tasks like word learning and categorization.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿、儿童和成人如何整合多感官信息以完成词汇学习和分类等任务。

name: Vanessa Sawicki
title: Associate Professor, Social Psychology, Marion Campus
summary: Studies how attitudes and attitude strength influence behavior and interpersonal attraction, focusing on information seeking and close relationships.
summary_zh: 研究态度和态度强度如何影响行为和人际吸引力，重点关注信息寻求和亲密关系。

name: Dennis Shaffer
title: Professor, Cognitive Psychology, Mansfield Campus
summary: Studies visual space and motion perception, investigating human and animal navigation and object tracking strategies.
summary_zh: 研究视觉空间和运动知觉，探究人类和动物在环境中的导航及追踪物体的策略。

name: Virginia Tompkins
title: Professor, Developmental Psychology, Lima Campus
summary: Studies social cognitive development in early childhood, focusing on language, literacy, and theory of mind, and their relation to social interaction with parents and teachers.
summary_zh: 研究幼儿的社会认知发展，特别是语言、文字能力和理论思维的发展及其与父母和教师互动的关系。

name: James Wirth
title: Professor, Social Psychology, Newark Campus
summary: Studies the impact of ostracism on social pain, basic human needs, mood, and aggression, and why individuals ostracize others.
summary_zh: 研究排斥对社会痛苦、基本人类需求、情绪和攻击性的影响，以及为什么个体会排斥他人。

name: Billur Akkaya
title: Assistant Professor, Neurology
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和学习的神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Elisabetta Babetto
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的神经机制，使用行为和神经影像技术。

name: Ruth Barrientos
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies how aging brain vulnerabilities, triggered by factors like infection and diet, lead to memory deficits, focusing on neuroinflammation and behavioral interventions.
summary_zh: 研究老化大脑的脆弱性如何因感染和饮食等因素触发，导致记忆障碍，重点关注神经炎症和行为干预。

name: Jay Fournier
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
summary: Studies the functional neuroanatomy of depression and anxiety, identifying predictors and mechanisms of treatment response and individual differences.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁和焦虑的功能神经解剖学，识别治疗反应的预测因素和机制以及个体差异。

name: Erica Glasper
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how rewarding experiences and stressors alter brain structure and function, using multidisciplinary techniques.
summary_zh: 研究奖励经历和应激对大脑结构和功能的影响，采用多学科技术方法。

name: Jonathan Godbout
title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the bi-directional communication between the brain and immune system, focusing on age, stress, and traumatic brain injury, and their effects on cognitive decline, anxiety, and depression.
summary_zh: 研究大脑与免疫系统之间的双向通讯，重点关注年龄、压力和创伤性脑损伤对认知衰退、焦虑和抑郁的影响。

name: Stephanie Gorka
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用行为和神经影像技术研究学习和记忆的神经机制。

name: Tamar Gur
title: Assistant Professor, Departments of Psychiatry and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the impact of maternal mental illness on offspring psychiatric outcomes, using behavioral and molecular methods.
summary_zh: 研究母体精神疾病对后代精神病学结果的影响，采用行为和分子方法。

name: Martin Haesemeyer
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how neurons interact in circuits to allow zebrafish to seek out preferred temperatures, using calcium imaging and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究鱼类如何通过神经元电路寻找适宜温度，使用钙成像和电生理学方法。

name: Ashley Ingiosi
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies how astrocytes and neurons interact to regulate sleep using molecular, cellular, and circuit-level approaches.
summary_zh: 研究星形胶质细胞和神经元如何相互作用以调节睡眠，使用分子、细胞和回路水平的方法。

name: Anthony King
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Health
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知和神经机制的学习与记忆，使用行为和神经影像技术。

name: Elizabeth Kirby
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how hippocampal neural stem and progenitor cells respond to brain injury, using transgenic models and molecular biology.
summary_zh: 研究海马神经干细胞和前体细胞在脑损伤中的反应，使用转基因模型和分子生物学方法。

name: Nina Kraguljac
title: Professor and Vice Chair, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
summary: Studies the neural basis of learning and memory in humans, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习和记忆的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Gordon Meares
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和学习的神经机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: K. Luan Phan
title: Professor and Chair, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
summary: Studies the neural basis of attention and working memory in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类注意力和工作记忆的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

name: Leah Pyter
title: Professor, Department of Psychiatry
summary: Studies how cancer and cancer survival affect brain and behavior, identifying immune and endocrine pathways using mouse models and cancer patients.
summary_zh: 研究癌症及其幸存对大脑和行为的影响，通过小鼠模型和癌症患者识别免疫和内分泌途径。

name: Andrew Sas
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neurology
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

name: Hillary Schiff
title: Assistant Professor, Dentistry
summary: Studies how early life taste experiences shape the maturation of taste sensory systems and feeding behaviors in mammals, using electrophysiology and genetic tools.
summary_zh: 研究早期味觉经验如何塑造哺乳动物味觉感觉系统和进食行为的成熟，使用电生理学和遗传工具。

name: Ivy Tso
title: Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Health
summary: Studies behavioral neuroscience, focusing on the neural mechanisms underlying behavior and mental processes.
summary_zh: 研究行为神经科学，专注于行为和心理过程的神经机制。

name: Jessica Turner
title: Professor, Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Health
summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of learning and memory in humans and animals.
summary_zh: 研究人类和动物学习和记忆的认知和神经机制。

name: Cole Vonder Haar
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies behavioral dysfunction after traumatic brain injuries, focusing on neuroinflammation and dopamine system changes, using behavioral and molecular techniques.
summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤后的行为功能障碍，重点关注神经炎症和多巴胺系统的变化，使用行为和分子技术。

name: Jason Wester
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
areas: Postdoctoral training: National Institutes of Health
summary: Studies the development of cortical circuits in mice, focusing on the assembly of excitatory and inhibitory neurons and their synaptic physiology.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠皮层回路的发育，重点在于兴奋性和抑制性神经元的组装及其突触生理学。

name: Lihua Ye
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the function and regulatory mechanisms of the gut sensory machinery and gut-brain interaction in zebrafish using genetic engineering and in vivo imaging.
summary_zh: 研究斑马鱼肠道感觉机制及其与大脑的相互作用，使用基因工程和体内成像技术。

name: Hojjat Adeli
title: Professor, Department of Civil, Environmental, and Geodetic Engineering
summary: Models brain processes and develops automated EEG-based diagnoses for neurological and psychiatric disorders using machine learning and image analysis.
summary_zh: 使用机器学习和图像分析建模大脑过程并开发神经和精神疾病（如癫痫、阿尔茨海默病、自闭症、帕金森病和ADHD）的自动EEG诊断方法。

name: Georgia Bishop
title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Develops educational materials and curricula for neuroscience courses, focusing on structure and function of the nervous system.
summary_zh: 开发神经科学课程的教学材料和课程，重点在于神经系统结构与功能。

name: Paco Herson
title: Professor, Department of Neurological Surgery
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using animal models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用动物模型和电生理学方法。

name: Michael Kearse
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Biological Chemistry and Pharmacology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory using pharmacological and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用药理学和遗传学方法。

name: Michael Knopp
title: Professor, Department of of Radiology
summary: Develops advanced imaging methodologies for assessing morphology, function, and molecular pathways in the nervous system, focusing on high and ultra-high field MRI and PET/MRI.
summary_zh: 开发高级成像方法，评估神经系统形态、功能和分子途径，重点是高场和超高场MRI及PET/MRI。

name: Ulysses Magalang
title: Professor, Department of Pulmonary, Allergy, Critical Care and Sleep
summary: Studies the effects of intermittent hypoxia on adipose tissue biology, particularly adiponectin secretion, using cellular, animal, and clinical models.
summary_zh: 研究间歇性低氧对脂肪组织生物学的影响，特别是对脂联素分泌的影响，使用细胞、动物和临床模型。

name: W. Jerry Mysiw
title: Professor, Department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies outcomes after traumatic brain injury and spinal cord injury, aiming to improve patient recovery.
summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤和脊髓损伤后的恢复结果，旨在改善患者康复。

name: John Oberdick
title: Associate Professor, Department of Neuroscience
summary: Studies the development and function of the cerebellum, focusing on the role of L7/Pcp2 in non-motor functions and autism, and explores drug therapies to prevent neonatal abstinence syndrome.
summary_zh: 研究小脑的发育和功能，重点关注L7/Pcp2在非运动功能和自闭症中的作用，以及探索预防新生儿戒断综合征的药物疗法。

name: John Sheridan
title: Professor, Dentistry
summary: Studies how psychosocial stressors affect gene expression in immune, behavioral, and pain responses, using a model of social defeat in mice.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会压力如何影响免疫、行为和疼痛反应中的基因表达，使用小鼠社会挫败模型。

name: David Barker
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits involved in drug addiction and comorbid disorders using anatomical, electrophysiological, and optogenetic techniques.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾及相关障碍的神经环路，使用解剖学、电生理学和光遗传学技术。

name: Kasia Bieszczad
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural substrates of information-rich memory in auditory associative learning, using electrophysiology and pharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究听觉关联学习中信息丰富的记忆的神经基础，使用电生理学和药理学方法。

name: Shana Cole
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive, perceptual, and affective processes influence goal pursuit, using multi-method approaches to test self-regulatory strategies in various domains.
summary_zh: 研究认知、知觉和情感过程如何影响目标追求，并使用多方法测试各种领域中的自我调节策略。

name: Richard Contrada
title: Professor
summary: Studies psychosocial and emotional factors in chronic diseases, particularly coronary disease, using psychophysiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疾病（尤其是冠心病）中的心理社会和情绪因素，使用心理生理技术。

name: Maurice Elias
title: Professor
summary: Studies social-emotional and character development in students, focusing on emotional intelligence and school success.
summary_zh: 研究学生的情感智能和社会情绪发展，关注情感智力和学校成功。

name: Samantha Farris
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how anxiety and fear affect physical health and risk behaviors, using experimental methodologies to develop interventions.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和恐惧如何影响身体健康和风险行为，并使用实验方法学开发干预措施。

name: Jacob Feldman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how visual perception and categorization work by creating mathematical and computational models of human mental processes, focusing on simplicity and organization.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和分类的心理机制，通过构建数学和计算模型来模拟人类的认知过程，重点关注简洁性和组织性。

name: Luis Flores
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of interpersonal processes in depression, particularly in emerging adults, using cognitive-affective and neuroscientific approaches.
summary_zh: 研究人际关系在抑郁症中的作用，特别是在青少年晚期，采用认知情感和神经科学方法。

name: Arnold Glass
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and retrieves information, creating computational models of simple cognitive tasks like detecting letter repetition.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和检索信息，创建检测字母重复等简单认知任务的计算模型。

name: Adam Gordon
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits of motivated behavior, particularly substance use disorder and feeding, using fiber photometry, two-photon calcium imaging, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究动机行为的神经回路，特别是物质使用障碍和进食行为，使用光纤光度法、双光子钙成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Jessica Hamilton
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies risk factors for suicidal thinking and self-harming behaviors among young people, using technology like smartphone sensing and EMA.
summary_zh: 研究青少年自杀念头和自伤行为的风险因素，使用智能手机传感和生态时刻评估等技术。

name: Pernille Hemmer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people use prior knowledge and expectations to make decisions in complex environments, integrating episodic and semantic memory.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在复杂环境中利用先验知识和预期进行决策，整合情景记忆和语义记忆。

name: Judith Hudson
title: Professor
summary: Studies memory development in children, the role of parent-child interaction in memory and time understanding, and the effects of emotion and odors on autobiographic memory and narrative construction.
summary_zh: 研究儿童记忆发展、亲子互动对记忆和时间理解的作用以及情绪和气味对自传式记忆和叙述结构的影响。

name: Michelle Hurst
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive processes related to mathematical and numerical reasoning vary across development and contexts, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究数学和数值推理的认知过程如何随发展和情境变化，使用行为实验和计算模型。

name: Lee Jussim
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies social perception and its effects, using empirical methods to examine biases and accuracy in social judgments.
summary_zh: 研究社会知觉及其影响，使用实证方法研究社会判断中的偏见和准确性。

name: Evan Kleiman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the prediction and prevention of suicidal thoughts and behaviors using ecological momentary assessment and ambulatory physiological monitoring.
summary_zh: 使用生态瞬时评估和可穿戴生理监测研究自杀念头和行为的预测与预防。

name: Alexander Kusnecov
title: Professor
summary: Studies how immune events influence cognitive and emotional states in mice, focusing on cytokines and anxiogenic neuropeptides.
summary_zh: 研究免疫事件如何影响小鼠的认知和情绪状态，重点关注细胞因子和焦虑肽。

name: Calvin Lai
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies implicit biases and develops interventions to reduce their effects on social behavior, including hiring and policing.
summary_zh: 研究隐性偏见并开发干预措施以减少其对社会行为（如招聘和警务）的影响。

name: Alan Leslie
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how abstract ideas like cause and effect and social agent emerge in early development through experiments with babies and preschool children.
summary_zh: 研究抽象概念如因果关系和社会代理在早期发展中的出现，通过婴儿和学龄前儿童的实验进行探索。

name: Bridget Matikainen-Ankney
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how obesity alters brain circuits involved in food-seeking behaviors over time, using molecular and systems-level techniques.
summary_zh: 研究肥胖如何随着时间改变与食物寻求行为相关的脑回路，采用分子和系统水平的技术。

name: John McGann
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes and adapts to sensory stimuli, particularly odors, using optical imaging and pharmacology in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和适应感官刺激，特别是气味，使用光学成像和药理学方法在啮齿动物模型中进行。

name: Melchi Michel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how humans integrate sensory information to make perceptual judgments, using probabilistic inference and ideal observers.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何整合感官信息进行知觉判断，使用概率推断和理想观察者的方法。

name: Julien Musolino
title: Professor
summary: Studies what makes human intelligence distinctively human, focusing on language, rationality, agency, memory, and belief formation.
summary_zh: 研究人类智能的独特性，关注语言、理性、代理、记忆和信念形成。

name: Gandalf Nicolas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people and AI represent social groups and stereotypes, using behavioral experiments and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们和AI对社会群体和刻板印象的表征，使用行为实验和计算方法。

name: Yoobin Park
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how close relationships influence people's lives, focusing on romantic relationships and their impact on health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系如何影响人们的生活，特别是浪漫关系及其对健康和福祉的影响。

name: Philip Parker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how visual behaviors are processed in the brain using optogenetics and neural recordings in natural settings.
summary_zh: 研究视觉行为的神经基础，使用光遗传学和神经记录技术在自然环境中进行实验。

name: Erin Reilly
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes like learning and decision-making in individuals with eating disorders during treatment, using neurocognitive methods.
summary_zh: 研究进食障碍患者在接受治疗期间的认知过程，如学习和决策，使用神经认知方法。

name: Benjamin Samuels
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how chronic stress exposure changes behavior in mice and how neural circuits can reverse these effects.
summary_zh: 研究慢性应激暴露如何改变小鼠行为及其神经回路如何逆转这些影响。

name: Diana Sanchez
title: Professor
summary: Studies racial identity and gender roles in close relationships, focusing on perceptions and experiences of multiracial and biracial individuals, and how gender role investment affects psychological.
summary_zh: 研究种族身份和亲密关系中的性别角色，关注多种族和混血个体的感知和经历，以及性别角色投资如何影响心理健康。

name: Edward Selby
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotion dysregulation and self-sabotaging behaviors in personality disorders and eating disorders, using models like the Emotional Cascade Model.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节障碍和自我破坏行为在人格障碍和进食障碍中的作用，使用情绪级联模型等理论。

name: Manish Singh
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain represents geometric information and generates layered surface representations, using psychophysical experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何表示几何信息并生成分层表面表示，使用心理物理学实验和计算模型。

name: Karin Stromswold
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural basis of language, using cross-linguistic, behavior genetic, and neuroimaging approaches.
summary_zh: 研究语言的认知和神经基础，使用跨语言、行为遗传学和神经成像方法。

name: Valerie Jones Taylor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies intergroup relations, stereotype threat, and virtual reality interventions to improve racial attitudes and identity safety.
summary_zh: 研究群体关系、刻板印象威胁以及虚拟现实干预措施以改善种族态度和身份安全感。

name: Elizabeth Torres
title: Professor
summary: Studies primate motor learning and adaptation, using electrophysiology and computational methods to derive indexes of performance in stroke and Parkinson’s patients, with applications to autism.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的运动学习和适应，使用电生理学和计算方法来推导出在中风和帕金森病患者中的表现指标，并应用于自闭症的治疗方法。

name: David Vicario
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of vocal learning in songbirds, focusing on sensory-motor integration during vocal communication.
summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的神经基础，关注发声学习中的感觉-运动整合。

name: Juli Wade
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies hormonal and genetic factors regulating brain structure and behavior using songbirds and lizards.
summary_zh: 研究激素和遗传因素如何调节大脑结构和行为，使用鸣禽和蜥蜴作为模型系统。

name: Jenny Wang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn mathematical concepts, exploring the roles of visual attention, memory, language, and social factors.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习数学概念，探索视觉注意力、记忆、语言和社会因素的作用。

name: David Wilder
title: Professor
summary: Studies social psychology phenomena, including attitudes, group behavior, and interpersonal relationships.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学现象，包括态度、群体行为和人际交往。

name: Qiong Zhang
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the human memory system retrieves past experiences efficiently, using computational modeling, behavioral methods, and neural imaging.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆系统如何高效检索过往经验，采用计算建模、行为方法和神经成像技术。

name: Kostas Bekris
title: Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies robotic rearrangement and manipulation, using NSF grants and collaborations with industry.
summary_zh: 研究机器人重新排列和操作，使用NSF资助和与工业的合作。

name: Ahmed Elgammal
title: Professor
summary: Develops algorithms for image recognition and generation, using machine learning techniques.
summary_zh: 开发图像识别和生成的算法，使用机器学习技术。

name: Konstantinos Michmizos
title: Associate Professor, Associate Chair
summary: Studies neuromorphic computing and its applications in robotics and artificial intelligence, using computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经形态计算及其在机器人和人工智能中的应用，使用计算方法。

name: Vladimir Pavlovic
title: Professor
summary: Develops machine learning and computer vision techniques for biomedical informatics.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习和计算机视觉技术，用于生物医学信息学。

name: Matthew Stone
title: Professor
summary: Studies artificial intelligence and its applications, focusing on language technology and design justice.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能及其应用，特别是在语言技术和设计正义方面。

name: Kristin Dana
title: Professor
summary: Studies computer vision, pattern recognition, and machine learning to develop innovative approaches in robotics and computational photography.
summary_zh: 研究计算机视觉、模式识别和机器学习，开发创新的机器人和计算摄影方法。

name: Mark Baker
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和行为实验研究认知过程。

name: Kristen Syrett
title: Professor, Co-Director
summary: Studies language acquisition and the interface between syntax and semantics, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言习得及句法与语义的接口，采用实验方法。

name: Bruce Tesar
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational learning and parsing in phonology using Optimality Theory.
summary_zh: 研究语音学中的计算学习和解析，使用优化理论。

name: Michael Glanzberg
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the nature of linguistic meaning and the role of mathematical techniques in the empirical study of language.
summary_zh: 研究语言意义的本质以及数学技术在语言实证研究中的作用。

name: Zoe Jenkin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of reasons in perception and cognition, and the scope of epistemic evaluability.
summary_zh: 研究理由在感知和认知中的作用，以及知识评价的范围。

name: Ernest Lepore
title: Board of Governors Professor
summary: Explores the philosophy of language, logic, and mind, collaborating with colleagues on various books and papers.
summary_zh: 研究语言哲学、逻辑学和心灵哲学，与同事合著多部书籍和论文。

name: Brian McLaughlin
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Explores the mind-body problem and metaphysical issues in psychology, focusing on supervenience, emergence, and vagueness.
summary_zh: 探讨心灵-身体问题和心理学中的形而上学问题，关注 supervenience、涌现和含糊性。

name: Paul Pietroski
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between grammatical structure and linguistic meaning, using psycholinguistic experiments to explore how words relate to concepts.
summary_zh: 研究句法结构与语言意义之间的关系，通过心理语言学实验探讨词汇与概念之间的联系。

name: Jake Quilty-Dunn
title: Associate Professor
summary: Explores philosophical questions about the mind and cognitive processes, including language and aesthetics.
summary_zh: 探讨心灵和认知过程的哲学问题，包括语言和美学。

name: Susanna Schellenberg
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Explores the nature of mental content, perceptual experience, and evidence in epistemology and philosophy of mind.
summary_zh: 研究知觉内容、知觉经验和证据在认识论和心灵哲学中的本质。

name: David Zald
title: Henry Rutgers Professor
summary: Studies the links between brain structure and function and psychopathology using MRI and PET imaging.
summary_zh: 使用MRI和PET成像研究大脑结构和功能与心理障碍之间的联系。

name: Adam McCollum
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies phonology and the phonology-phonetics interface using laboratory methods with Central Asian and West African languages.
summary_zh: 研究音系学和音系-音素界面，使用实验室方法研究中亚和西非语言。

name: Victoria E. Abraira
title: Faculty
summary: Studies fundamental principles of sensory neurobiology, focusing on spinal cord circuits.
summary_zh: 研究感觉神经生物学的基本原理，集中在脊髓回路方面。

name: Gary Aston-Jones
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognition and addiction, exploring the cognitive processes involved in addictive behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究认知与成瘾，探索成瘾行为中的认知过程。

name: Nicholas T. Bello
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis for food preferences and how metabolism controls eating behavior.
summary_zh: 研究食物偏好的神经基础以及新陈代谢如何调控进食行为。

name: Alison Bernstein
title: Faculty
summary: Studies epigenetic changes and environmental factors contributing to sporadic Parkinson's disease.
summary_zh: 研究环境暴露和表观遗传变化在散发性帕金森病中的作用。

name: Detlev Boison
title: Faculty
summary: Studies metabolism and disease modification in epilepsy and traumatic brain injury, using neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫和创伤性脑损伤的代谢和疾病修饰机制，采用神经科学方法。

name: Sangmi Chung
title: Faculty
summary: Studies GABAergic interneuron-associated brain disorders using iPSCs, genomics, and chimeric mice.
summary_zh: 研究与GABA能中间神经元相关的脑部疾病，使用iPSCs、基因组学和嵌合小鼠。

name: David P. Crockett
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural plasticity in response to spinal cord injury and traumatic brain injury.
summary_zh: 研究脊髓损伤和创伤性脑损伤后的神经可塑性。

name: Santiago Cuesta
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain health and neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究脑健康和神经科学。

name: Brian Daniels
title: Faculty
summary: Studies infection and inflammation in the central nervous system.
summary_zh: 研究中枢神经系统中的感染和炎症.

name: Robin L. Davis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how sensory signals develop, focusing on molecular mechanisms that control auditory function in ontogeny.
summary_zh: 研究感觉信号的发育及其分子机制如何调控听觉功能的发展。

name: MD Emanuel DiCicco-Bloom
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular regulation of neurogenesis and its effects on brain development in animal models of autism.
summary_zh: 研究神经发生细胞和分子调控及其对自闭症动物模型脑发育的影响。

name: Monica Driscoll
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the molecular genetics of neurodegeneration and aging, focusing on mechanotransduction.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病和衰老的分子遗传学，重点关注机械转换机制。

name: Isaac Edery
title: Faculty
summary: Studies biological clocks and circadian rhythms in Drosophila using photic signal transduction and PAS-containing transcription factors.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇的生物钟和昼夜节律，使用光信号转导和PAS含转录因子。

name: Andy Alexander
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies spatial cognition and mnemonic processes in corticothalamic circuits using electrophysiology, neuroimaging, and behavioral experiments in mice and rats.
summary_zh: 研究空间认知和记忆过程在皮层-丘脑回路中的作用，使用电生理学、神经成像和行为实验方法在小鼠和大鼠中进行。

name: Michael Beyeler
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how sight is restored in people with incurable blindness using behavioral experiments, immersive VR, and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过行为实验、沉浸式虚拟现实和神经生理学方法恢复因不可治愈的失明而受损的视力。

name: Nancy Collins
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies social support and caregiving in couples, psychosocial predictors of health, and social perception in close relationships, using experimental, observational, and neuroendocrine methods.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣关系中的社会支持和照顾行为、心理社会预测因子对健康的影响以及亲密关系中的社会知觉，使用实验、观察和神经内分泌方法。

name: Daniel Conroy-Beam
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor & Vice Chair
summary: Studies how mate preferences influence mating decisions, using computational models and real couples.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣偏好如何影响择偶决策，使用计算模型和真实情侣进行研究。

name: Leda Cosmides
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the evolution of human cognitive mechanisms, focusing on cooperation, social exchange, and reasoning about social exchange, using empirical methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类认知机制的进化，重点关注合作、社会交换以及社会交换中的推理，使用实证方法。

name: Miguel Eckstein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how the brain perceives and processes visual information, using psychophysics, eye tracking, EEG, fMRI, and computational modeling to understand everyday visual tasks like recognizing objects.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何感知和处理视觉信息，使用心理物理学、眼动追踪、脑电图（EEG）、功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和计算建模来理解诸如识别物体和面孔等日常视觉任务。

name: Alan Fridlund
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how facial expressions affect social interaction, including with nonhuman and imaginary others, using evolutionary and cultural perspectives.
summary_zh: 研究面部表情如何影响社会互动，包括与非人类和想象中的他者互动，采用进化和文化视角。

name: Shelly Gable
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies motivation in social interactions and close relationships, focusing on approach and avoidance motives.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动和亲密关系中的动机，重点关注趋近和回避动机。

name: Tamsin German
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how core knowledge systems develop and influence beliefs about supernatural concepts and social cognition in children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究核心知识系统的发展及其对儿童和成人关于超自然概念的信念和社会认知的影响。

name: Barry Giesbrecht
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the functional consequences, mechanisms, and experience-based shaping of selective attention using vision as a model, combining cognitive psychology with fMRI, EEG, and neuropsychology.
summary_zh: 研究选择性注意的功能后果、机制及其经验性塑造，使用视觉作为模型，结合认知心理学与功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和神经心理学方法。

name: Michael Goard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuitry underlying visual processing, decision-making, and navigation in mice using two-photon calcium imaging and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠视觉处理、决策和导航的皮层回路，使用双光子钙成像和光遗传学方法。

name: Scott Grafton
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Recall Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive architecture underlying action representation, focusing on sequence and skill acquisition, motor simulation, and sensorimotor transformation using fMRI, transcranial magnetic.
summary_zh: 研究动作表征的认知架构，重点在于序列和技能习得、运动模拟以及传感器运动转换，使用功能性磁共振成像、经颅磁刺激和高密度脑电图进行研究。

name: Emily Jacobs
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sex hormones influence brain structure and function in women and men using brain imaging and endocrine assessments.
summary_zh: 研究性激素如何影响女性和男性的大脑结构和功能，使用脑成像和内分泌评估方法。

name: Skirmantas Janusonis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the dynamics and self-organization of serotonergic axons in the brain, using transgenic models, advanced microscopy, and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中血清素轴突的动力学和自组织，使用转基因模型、先进显微镜技术和计算方法。

name: Ron Keiflin
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of associative learning and decision-making, and their alterations in psychiatric disorders using behavioral tasks and neuroscience tools in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究条件反射学习和决策机制及其在精神疾病中的改变，使用小鼠的行为任务和神经科学工具。

name: Heejung Kim
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how culture influences psychological processes, examining pro-environmental actions, social support, and interpersonal power.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何影响心理过程，包括亲环境行为、社会支持和人际权力。

name: Tod Kippin
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the factors governing the action of cellular components of the nervous system that produce behavioral, endocrine, and cognitive processes, focusing on vulnerability and resilience to drug.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的细胞成分如何产生行为、内分泌和认知过程，并关注药物成瘾的易感性和韧性。

name: Stan Klein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the nature of self, memory, and consciousness, focusing on the role of episodic memory in mental time travel.
summary_zh: 研究自我、记忆和意识的本质，重点关注情景记忆在心理时间旅行中的作用。

name: Regina Lapate
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions, focusing on cognitive control, temporal memory, and adaptive emotion.
summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，重点关注认知控制、时间记忆和适应性情绪。

name: Laura Simone Lewis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of social cognition in humans and great apes using eye-tracking and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类和大猿的社会认知发展，使用眼动追踪和行为方法。

name: Zoe Liberman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the origins and development of social cognition, including how children categorize and reason about social relationships from infancy to childhood.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知的起源和发展，包括儿童如何从婴儿期到童年进行社会分类和推理社会关系。

name: Richard Mayer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how people learn from multimedia and computer-supported environments, focusing on multimedia learning, computer games for learning, and online tutoring systems.
summary_zh: 研究多媒体学习、计算机支持的学习环境以及教育游戏，关注如何通过多媒体和计算机技术帮助人们学习。

name: Michael Miller
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive neuroscience of human memory and decision-making using fMRI, ERP, TMS, and signal detection analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和决策的认知神经科学，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、事件相关电位（ERP）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和信号检测分析。

name: David Pietraszewski
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of social group representations and conflict, integrating social, cognitive, developmental, and evolutionary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究社会群体表征和冲突的认知机制，结合社会、认知、发展和进化方法。

name: Kyle Ratner
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social contexts influence cognitive, affective, and biological processes, particularly intergroup reactions and their effects on social relations and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境如何影响认知、情感和生物过程，特别是群体反应及其对社会关系和福祉的影响。

name: Nils Karl Reimer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how intergroup contact affects prejudices and social change, using advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究不同群体接触如何影响偏见和社会变革，使用先进的定量方法。

name: James Roney
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor & Chair
