summary: Studies the evolved functions of hormones in regulating human psychology and behavior, focusing on how hormones influence mate choice and women's motivational priorities.
summary_zh: 研究激素在调节人类心理和行为中的进化功能，重点关注激素如何影响择偶选择和女性的动力优先级。

name: John M. Ruiz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: is a Professor in the Department of Psychology at the University of Arizona
summary: Studies psychosocial influences on health, focusing on individual-level factors and social behaviors related to cardiovascular and cancer diseases.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会因素对健康的影响，重点关注心血管和癌症疾病相关的个体水平因素和社会行为。

name: Jonathan Schooler
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the nature of mental life, including mindfulness, mind-wandering, and creativity, using empirical, philosophical, and contemplative approaches.
summary_zh: 研究心智的本质，包括正念、心流和创造力，采用实证、哲学和冥想的方法。

name: David Sherman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people respond to threats to the self, focusing on self-affirmation and environmental sustainability.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对自我威胁，重点关注自我肯定和环境保护。

name: Ikuko Smith
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the functional role of neural dendrites in synaptic computations using electrophysiology and two-photon imaging.
summary_zh: 研究神经树突在突触计算中的功能作用，使用电生理学和双光子成像技术。

name: Thomas Sprague
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how actions influence neural representations of the world, using fMRI, EEG, and model-based analysis.
summary_zh: 研究行为目标如何影响大脑对世界的表征，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和模型分析方法。

name: Karen Szumlinski
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the biochemical mechanisms of drug abuse, focusing on glutamate signaling and its role in neuropsychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的生物化学机制，特别是谷氨酸信号传导及其在神经精神疾病中的作用。

name: Rene Weber
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies complex cognitive responses to media narratives, focusing on moral conflict, persuasion, and ADHD-related media multitasking.
summary_zh: 研究媒体叙事对复杂认知反应的影响，重点关注道德冲突、说服力以及与ADHD相关的媒体多任务处理。

name: Annie E. Wertz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants learn about plants using social and behavioral cues, focusing on avoidance behaviors and edibility learning.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会和行为线索学习植物，重点在于避免行为和可食用性学习。

name: Brandon Woo
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how infants and children understand others' actions and minds, particularly in social contexts, using developmental experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童如何理解他人的行为和心灵，特别是在社会情境中的认知发展实验。

name: Hongbo Yu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of social emotions like guilt and gratitude, their moral significance, and how they are shaped by culture.
summary_zh: 研究社会情绪（如内疚和感激）的神经认知机制及其道德意义，以及这些情绪如何受到文化的影响。

name: ENGAGE Keynote Speakers
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: is Professor and Chair of the Department of Chicano/Latino Studies
summary: Studies the impact of social relationships on health and well-being, particularly in Latino cultures, using social-personality psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会关系对健康和福祉的影响，特别是在拉丁裔文化中的应用，使用社会个性心理学方法。

name: Google Scholar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural dynamics and network interactions in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的神经动力学和网络交互。

name: Jean Carlson
title: Professor
summary: Studies learning, memory, categorization, and decision processes in perception and cognition using network and complexity analysis.
summary_zh: 研究学习、记忆、分类和知觉与认知中的决策过程，使用网络和复杂性分析方法。

name: Mary Hegarty
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how people remember and learn information, using experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知神经科学，使用实验和计算模型方法。

name: Sung Soo Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how fruit flies navigate using neural circuits and multi-sensory information, combining electrophysiology and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇如何使用神经回路和多感官信息进行导航，结合电生理学和计算建模方法。

name: Upamanyu Madhow
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces, network complexity analysis, and signal processing.
summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口、网络复杂性分析和信号处理。

name: B.S. Manjunath
title: Professor
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and computational vision using network and complexity analysis.
summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和计算视觉，使用网络和复杂性分析方法。

name: Wendy Meiring
title: Professor
summary: Studies computational models of cognitive processes, using computational neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程的计算模型，使用计算神经科学方法。

name: Mike Miller
title: Professor
summary: Studies the psychological and neural processes underlying human memory and decision-making using fMRI, ERP, TMS, and signal detection analysis.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和决策的心理和神经过程，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)、事件相关电位(ERP)、经颅磁刺激(TMS)和信号检测分析等方法。

name: Nina Miolane
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the geometry of neural networks and signal processing techniques to understand brain dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络的几何结构和信号处理技术以理解大脑动力学。

name: Jeff Moehlis
title: Professor
summary: Studies network and complexity analysis in computational neuroscience, using signal processing and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究计算神经科学中的网络与复杂性分析，使用信号处理和机器学习方法。

name: Craig Montell
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how environmental cues like temperature, light, taste, and smell influence behavior in flies, using molecular, cellular, and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究环境线索（如温度、光线、味道和气味）如何影响果蝇的行为，采用分子、细胞和遗传学方法。

name: Julie H. Simpson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural circuits and algorithms that control complex behaviors, using genetic model systems like fruit flies and optogenetic methods.
summary_zh: 研究控制复杂行为的神经回路和算法，使用遗传模型系统如果蝇和光遗传学方法。

name: Ambuj K. Singh
title: Professor
summary: Studies dynamical systems in neuroscience, focusing on computational models of brain function.
summary_zh: 研究神经科学中的动力系统，专注于大脑功能的计算模型。

name: Spencer LaVere Smith
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and uses novel instrumentation to study neural circuitry and its role in adaptive behavior.
summary_zh: 开发和使用新型仪器研究神经回路及其在适应性行为中的作用。

name: Misha Sra
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and computational cognitive neuroscience using signal processing and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和计算认知神经科学，使用信号处理和机器学习方法。

name: Gregory Ball
title: Professor
summary: Studies how hormones affect learning and behavior in birds, and how behavioral cues influence reproductive endocrine activity.
summary_zh: 研究激素如何影响鸟类的学习和行为，以及行为线索如何影响生殖内分泌活动。

name: Oscar Barbarin
title: Professor of African American Studies and of Psychology
summary: Studies the social and familial determinants of ethnic and gender achievement gaps in early childhood, developing screening systems for children.
summary_zh: 研究早期儿童的族裔和性别成就差距的社会和家庭决定因素，并开发儿童筛查系统。

name: Edward Bernat
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain mechanisms underlying cognitive and affective processing, with a focus on substance use and psychopathology in lower SES minority individuals.
summary_zh: 研究认知和情绪处理的脑机制，特别是在低 SES 少数族裔个体中的物质使用和心理障碍。

name: Jude Cassidy
title: Professor
summary: Studies socio-emotional development from infancy to adolescence, focusing on attachment and family relationships, and early interventions.
summary_zh: 研究从婴儿期到青春期的社会情感发展，重点关注依恋和家庭关系，以及早期干预措施。

name: Caroline Charpentier
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neuro-cognitive bases of social learning using cognitive tasks, fMRI, and computational modeling, linking these processes to psychiatric symptoms and natural social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究社会学习的认知神经基础，使用认知任务、fMRI 和计算建模方法，将这些过程与精神症状和自然社会情境联系起来。

name: Nathan Cheek
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people form and act on beliefs about poverty and sexual harassment, and how these beliefs relate to identity and choice goals.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何形成和实施关于贫困和性骚扰的信念，以及这些信念如何与身份和选择目标相关。

name: Andrea Chronis-Tuscano
title: Professor
summary: Studies early predictors of developmental outcomes for children with ADHD, focusing on maternal parenting and developing interventions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）早期预测因素，重点关注母性养育和干预开发。

name: Michael Dougherty
title: Faculty
summary: Studies decision-making, working memory, and long-term memory using computational modeling and transparency in scientific processes.
summary_zh: 研究决策制定、工作记忆和长时记忆，采用计算建模和透明的科学过程。

name: Arianna Gard
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how environmental adversity and promotive factors shape children’s behavioral, cognitive, and brain development, focusing on neighborhood context and resilience.
summary_zh: 研究环境逆境和促进因素如何塑造儿童的行为、认知和大脑发展，特别关注邻里环境和韧性过程。

name: James Grand
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how planning and action-oriented teams gather, share information, develop collective knowledge, and make decisions, using computational modeling and Bayesian statistics.
summary_zh: 研究计划和行动导向团队如何收集、分享信息、构建集体知识并做出决策，采用计算建模和贝叶斯统计方法。

name: Paul Hanges
title: Professor
summary: Studies human resource practices, team diversity, organizational climate, leadership, and cross-cultural issues using statistical methods.
summary_zh: 研究人力资源实践、团队多样性、组织气候、领导力和跨文化问题，使用统计方法。

name: Evan Hart
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how rats learn about sensory information to form cognitive maps, using neurophysiological recordings and behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物如何通过感官信息形成认知地图，使用神经生理记录和行为任务。

name: Jens Herberholz
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying social behaviors, including aggression, decision-making, and the effects of social isolation and drugs in crayfish.
summary_zh: 研究社会行为的神经机制，包括攻击行为、决策制定以及社会隔离和药物的影响在螃蟹中的表现。

name: Derek Iwamoto
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies socio-cultural factors influencing substance use and mental health in ethnic minorities, developing interventions.
summary_zh: 研究社会文化因素对少数族裔物质滥用和心理健康的影响，开发干预措施。

name: Desiree Jones
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how autistic people are perceived by their peers, focusing on stigma, intersectionality, and social interaction.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症人士在同伴中的形象，关注污名、交叉身份和社会互动。

name: Atsushi Kikumoto
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control, memory, learning, and decision making using experimental psychology, cognitive neuroscience, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制、记忆、学习和决策制定，采用实验心理学、认知神经科学和计算建模方法。

name: Arie Kruglanski
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies motivation, goal pursuit, and cognitive processes related to radicalization and deradicalization, using psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究动机、目标追求和认知过程与极端化和去极端化的关系，采用心理实验方法。

name: Edward Lemay
title: Professor
summary: Studies the influence of loneliness and world beliefs on social interactions and relationships, using various methods including dyadic and longitudinal studies.
summary_zh: 研究孤独感和世界观信念对社交互动和关系的影响，采用双人和纵向研究等多种方法。

name: Xuan Li
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of drug addiction using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的神经机制，采用多种方法。

name: Jessica Magidson
title: Director and MPower Professor
summary: Studies how nature can address the global mental health treatment gap by training peers and community health workers, and integrates nature exposure with cognitive behavioral therapy.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过培训同伴和社区卫生工作者以及将自然暴露与认知行为疗法结合来解决全球心理健康治疗缺口。

name: Ethan Mereish
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of social and psychological determinants on mental health and substance use in LGBTQ+ and minoritized youth, using experimental and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会和心理因素对 LGBTQ+ 和少数群体青年心理健康和药物使用的影响，采用实验和质性研究方法。

name: Jonathan Mohr
title: Associate Professor
areas: Sexual orientation and sexual minority populations
summary: Studies stigma, discrimination, and stereotypes affecting LGBTQ+ individuals, and interpersonal relationships, especially in therapy.
summary_zh: 研究 LGBTQ+ 人群中的污名、歧视和刻板印象，以及人际关系，特别是治疗关系。

name: Karen O'Brien
title: Professor and Faculty Ombuds, Office of the President
areas: Intimate Partner Violence and Dating Violence
summary: Studies factors related to successful management of work and family, and develops interventions to reduce dating violence.
summary_zh: 研究工作与家庭管理的成功因素，并开发减少恋爱暴力的干预措施。

name: Luiz Pessoa
title: Professor
summary: Studies the interactions between cognition and emotion in the human brain using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑中认知与情绪之间的相互作用，使用神经成像技术。

name: Cassandra Phetmisy
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of financial stress and pay practices on employee behavior, resilience, and health, using various organizational research methods.
summary_zh: 研究财务压力和薪酬实践对员工行为、韧性及健康的影响，采用多种组织研究方法。

name: Elizabeth Redcay
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children and individuals with autism learn from social interactions, using cognitive and neural mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和自闭症个体如何通过社会互动学习，探讨认知和神经机制。

name: Tracy Riggins
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory develops in early childhood, examining neural changes with behavioral, electrophysiological, and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童早期记忆发展的神经机制，使用行为、电生理和神经影像学方法进行探索。

name: Matthew Roesch
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning, executive control, and decision-making in addiction using pharmacological and optogenetic manipulations in rats.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾中学习、执行控制和决策机制的神经机制，使用药理学和光遗传学操纵在大鼠中进行研究。

name: Alexander Shackman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the biological bases of anxiety-related states and disorders using neuroimaging, psychophysiology, and genetic analyses in various populations.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑相关状态和障碍的生物学基础，使用神经成像、生理心理学和基因分析方法，涉及不同人群。

name: L. Robert Slevc
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive mechanisms involved in language and music processing in both normal and brain-damaged populations.
summary_zh: 研究语言和音乐加工的认知机制，包括正常和脑损伤人群。

name: Terrill Taylor
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines issues of race and racism, focusing on intersectionality, racial disparities, and restorative justice to promote social transformation and healing.
summary_zh: 研究种族和种族主义问题，重点关注交集性、种族不平等和修复正义，以促进社会变革和疗愈。

name: Noah Triplett
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Applies implementation science and participatory research to improve behavioral health outcomes, focusing on systemic contributors and strategies for increasing access to evidence-based practices.
summary_zh: 应用实施科学和参与式研究，改善行为健康结果，重点关注系统性因素和增加证据基线实践可及性的策略。

name: Fanita Tyrell
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies resilience and socioemotional development among ethnic-racial minority and adversity-exposed populations, focusing on cultural influences.
summary_zh: 研究文化背景对少数民族和经历逆境群体的社会情感发展和韧性的影响。

name: Jennifer Wessel
title: Associate Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies the experiences and reactions of individuals with stigmatized identities in the workplace, focusing on identity management strategies and authenticity.
summary_zh: 研究职场中受污名化个体的经历和反应，重点关注身份管理策略和真实性。

name: Henry Willis
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Culturally-Adapted Mental Health Treatments and Assessments
summary: Studies the impact of racial discrimination on mental health, developing culturally adapted treatments and using mHealth to address disparities.
summary_zh: 研究种族歧视对心理健康的影响，开发文化适应性的治疗方法，并利用移动健康技术解决健康不平等。

name: Weizhen Xie
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of memory, including short-term and long-term memory, using fMRI, EEG, and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的认知神经机制，包括短期记忆和长期记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和行为实验。

name: Linda Zou
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social, group, and cultural processes, focusing on diversity and intergroup relations.
summary_zh: 研究社会、群体和文化过程，重点关注多样性和群体间关系。

name: Yiannis Aloimonos
title: Professor
summary: Studies computer vision and its applications, using computational models and algorithms.
summary_zh: 研究计算机视觉及其应用，使用计算模型和算法。

name: Samira Anderson
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies the neural processing of speech across the lifespan, focusing on aging and hearing loss effects, using electrophysiology and perceptual techniques.
summary_zh: 研究生命不同阶段的语音神经处理，重点关注老化和听力损失的影响，使用电生理学和感知技术。

name: Juan Angueyra
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of the retina, focusing on cell fate and connectivity to build functional organoids for regenerative medicine.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜的发育，关注细胞命运和连接性，以构建用于再生医学的功能性器官样结构。

name: Ricardo C. Araneda
title: Professor
summary: Studies how neuromodulatory transmitters regulate brain circuits and influence sensory processing, using the olfactory system as a model.
summary_zh: 研究神经调质如何调节大脑回路并影响感觉处理，以嗅觉系统作为模型。

name: Behtash Babadi
title: Professor
summary: Develops signal processing techniques for analyzing high-dimensional neural data to study attention, plasticity, and auditory processing.
summary_zh: 开发信号处理技术分析高维神经数据，研究注意力、可塑性和听觉处理。

name: Nan Bernstein Ratner
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies typical and disordered child speech and language development, focusing on stuttering, using computational analysis and longitudinal studies.
summary_zh: 研究典型和异常儿童的语言和语言发展，重点关注口吃，使用计算分析和纵向研究方法。

name: Donald Bolger
title: Associate Professor, Director Maryland Initiative for Literacy and Equity
summary: Studies how the brain learns to read and the cognitive and neural bases of reading ability and disability, using MRI, ERP, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何学习阅读以及阅读能力和障碍的认知和神经基础，使用MRI、ERP和行为方法。

name: Lucas Butler
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn from social cues, integrating causal reasoning and social cognitive capacities in early development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习，结合因果推理和社会认知能力在早期发展中的整合。

name: Dan Butts
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes visual information, developing theories and experiments to understand system-level function in sensory systems.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理视觉信息，发展理论和实验以理解感觉系统中的系统级功能。

name: Melissa Caras
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how experience affects auditory perception and neural circuits, using electrophysiology and pharmacological manipulations.
summary_zh: 研究经验如何影响听觉感知和神经回路，使用电生理学和药理学操作方法。

name: Catherine Carr
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies how barn owls localize sound using delay lines and coincidence detection, focusing on development and evolution.
summary_zh: 研究猫头鹰如何使用延迟线和同步检测定位声音，关注发展和进化。

name: Peter Carruthers
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Explores theories of consciousness, knowledge of mental states, and the role of language in cognition.
summary_zh: 探讨意识理论、心灵状态的知识以及语言在认知中的作用。

name: Lea Dougherty
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of depression in children, focusing on irritability, stress physiology, and environmental factors using neuroimaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童抑郁的发展，重点关注易怒性、压力生理学和环境因素，使用神经影像学和行为方法。

name: Kevin Dunbar
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children, students, and scientists think and create new ideas, focusing on reasoning strategies and using naturalistic observations, experiments, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、学生和科学家的思维和创新想法，关注推理策略，并使用自然观察、实验和神经成像方法。

name: Ramani Duraiswami
title: Professor and Associate Chair for Graduate Education
summary: Develops algorithms for machine learning and wave propagation, applying them to spatial audio and computer vision.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习和波传播算法，应用于空间音频和计算机视觉。

name: Yasmeen Faroqi-Shah
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural underpinnings of language, focusing on language breakdown after brain injury, neural plasticity, and bilingual language production.
summary_zh: 研究语言的神经基础，重点关注脑损伤后语言障碍、神经可塑性和双语语言产生中的认知机制。

name: Naomi Feldman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people learn and represent language structure using computational methods and machine learning.
summary_zh: 使用计算方法和机器学习研究人们如何学习和表示语言结构。

name: Nathan Fox
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies the effects of early experience on brain and behavioral development in infants and children, using methods to assess brain activity during emotional tasks.
summary_zh: 研究早期经历对婴儿和儿童大脑和行为发展的影响，使用方法评估情绪任务期间的大脑活动。

name: Nikolas Francis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies auditory decision-making and pitch perception in mice, using neurophysiology and data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠的听觉决策和音高感知的神经机制，使用神经生理学和数据分析方法。

name: Rodolphe Gentili
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the brain processes underlying human motor behavior using EEG, fNIRS, kinematics, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 使用EEG、fNIRS、运动学和计算建模研究人类运动行为的大脑过程。

name: Matthew Goupell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brains of people with cochlear implants process sounds and understand speech, focusing on sound localization, aging effects, and binaural hearing.
summary_zh: 研究植入人工耳蜗的人如何处理声音和理解言语，重点关注声源定位、年龄影响和双耳听觉。

name: Bradley Hatfield
title: Professor & Chair of the Department of Kinesiology
summary: Studies the impact of physical activity and aging on cognitive-motor performance using EEG, ERP, MEG, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究体育活动和衰老对认知-运动表现的影响，使用EEG、ERP、MEG和fMRI等技术。

name: Eric Hoover
title: Associate Professor
areas: Hearing aids and related hearing assistive devices
summary: Develops technologies to improve communication for those with hearing loss by understanding auditory system representations.
summary_zh: 开发技术以改善听力损失者的交流，通过理解听觉系统的表征。

name: Timothy Horiuchi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural circuit architectures in neuromorphic VLSI-based processors, focusing on sensorimotor coordination and neural computation in cultured neurons.
summary_zh: 研究神经电路架构在神经形态VLSI处理器中的实现，重点关注传感器和运动系统的协调以及体外培养神经元中的计算和学习。

name: Yi Ting Huang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how language comprehension in children is shaped by past experiences and background, using eye-tracking experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的语言理解如何受到过去经历和背景的影响，使用眼动追踪实验。

name: William Idsardi
title: Professor
summary: Studies how language and auditory processing interact using MEG, focusing on neural coding and music.
summary_zh: 研究语言和听觉处理之间的相互作用，使用MEG技术探讨神经编码和音乐的认知神经科学问题。

name: Michael Israel
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how linguistic forms are motivated by their functions, focusing on polarity sensitivity and child language acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究语言形式的功能动机，特别是极性敏感性和儿童语言获得。

name: Nan Jiang
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and psycholinguistic processes in adult second language acquisition, focusing on bilingual language processing and lexical development.
summary_zh: 研究成人二语习得中的认知和心理语言学过程，重点关注双语语言处理和词汇发展。

name: Scott Juntti
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain produces social behaviors using cichlid fishes, manipulating signaling pathways and identifying relevant genes.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何产生社会行为，使用慈鲷鱼作为模型，通过操纵信号通路和鉴定相关基因来探究。

name: Stacey Kane
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech perception in children with hearing loss, focusing on perceptual, linguistic, and developmental factors.
summary_zh: 研究听力受损儿童的语音感知，关注感知、语言和发育因素。

name: Melanie Killen
title: Professor
summary: Studies the origins of morality and the emergence of prejudice in children, using social and moral reasoning experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童道德起源和偏见形成，采用社会和道德推理实验方法。

name: P. S. Krishnaprasad
title: Professor
summary: Studies collective behavior in biological and engineered systems, using geometric control theory and robotics.
summary_zh: 研究生物和工程系统中的集体行为，使用几何控制理论和机器人技术。

name: Ellen Lau
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how readers and listeners use their knowledge of language to access and construct lexical-conceptual representations, using ERPs, MEG, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究读者和听众如何利用语言知识获取和构建词义概念表示，使用ERP、MEG和fMRI等技术。

name: Anna Li
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of drug addiction using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的认知神经机制。

name: Jeffrey Lidz
title: Professor and Chair
summary: Studies the relation between syntax-semantics and language acquisition, using diverse languages and methods like eye-tracking and truth-value judgment experiments.
summary_zh: 研究句法-语义关系与语言习得之间的联系，使用多种语言和眼动追踪、语义判断实验等方法。

name: Huang Lin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops statistical and machine learning methods for analyzing complex biological data, particularly in genomics and aging.
summary_zh: 开发统计和机器学习方法，分析复杂的生物数据，特别是在基因组学和衰老方面。

name: Jeff MacSwan
title: Professor
summary: Studies bilingualism and codeswitching, developing a model of intrasentential codeswitching using linguistic and corpus data.
summary_zh: 研究双语主义和代码转换，发展了基于语言学和语料库数据的代码转换模型。

name: Rochelle Newman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain recognizes and learns words from speech, especially in noisy contexts, with a focus on infants and children.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何从语音中识别和学习单词，特别是在嘈杂环境中的变化，重点关注婴儿和儿童。

name: Jared Novick
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people understand language in real time, focusing on cognitive control and attention, using eye-tracking, EEG, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在实时中理解语言，重点关注认知控制和注意力，使用眼动追踪、EEG和fMRI的方法。

name: Devon Payne-Sturges
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the combined effects of psychosocial stressors and environmental contaminants on children’s neurocognitive development, and evaluates food insecurity as a determinant of academic outcomes and.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会压力因素和环境污染物对儿童神经认知发展的影响，并评估食物不安全对新兴成年人学业表现和污染物暴露的决定作用。

name: Danielle Powell
title: Assistant Professor
areas: AuDUniversity of North Carolina- Chapel Hill
summary: Studies the intersection of hearing and dementia, using health information technology and implementation sciences.
summary_zh: 研究听力与痴呆的交叉领域，使用健康信息技术和实施科学。

name: Richard Prather
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies human cognitive development using computational modeling and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 使用计算建模和神经成像方法研究人类认知发展。

name: Philip Resnik
title: Professor
summary: Develops computational models of language, integrating linguistic knowledge, context, and machine learning to address social science questions and multilingual text analysis.
summary_zh: 开发语言的计算模型，结合语言学知识、上下文和机器学习方法，解决社会科学研究和多语言文本分析问题。

name: Rachel Romeo
title: Assistant Professor
areas: How early experiences shape neurocognitive development
summary: Studies how early experiences, particularly socioeconomic status, influence neural, cognitive, and academic development, focusing on language and literacy in infants through adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究早期经历，尤其是社会经济地位，如何影响神经、认知和学术发展，特别是在婴儿至青少年的语言和阅读能力发展。

name: Shihab Shamma
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the acoustic signal is represented in mammalian auditory systems, from theoretical models to neurophysiological investigations and human perception experiments.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物听觉系统中声信号的表示，从理论模型到神经生理学研究以及人类听觉感知实验。

name: Jae Kun Shim
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural and mechanical mechanisms of locomotion and hand actions in healthy individuals and those with compromised systems such as stroke patients.
summary_zh: 研究健康个体和患有神经系统受损（如中风患者）个体的运动和手部动作的神经和机械机制。

name: Jonathan Simon
title: Professor and NACS Director
summary: Studies the neural computations underlying speech processing and perception, particularly for degraded speech, using MEG and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究语音处理和感知的神经计算，特别是降质语音，使用MEG和计算方法。

name: Elisabeth Smela
title: Professor
summary: Develops cell-based olfactory sensors, using engineering techniques.
summary_zh: 开发基于细胞的嗅觉传感器，采用工程方法。

name: J. Carson Smith
title: Professor
summary: Studies how exercise affects brain function and mental health in older adults and patients with cognitive impairment or mood disorders, using MRI and neuropsychological testing.
summary_zh: 研究运动对老年人和认知障碍或情绪障碍患者的大脑功能和心理健康的影响，使用MRI和神经心理学测试。

name: Colenso Speer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the development and plasticity of neural circuits for sensory perception using the mammalian visual system, electrophysiology, and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究感觉感知的神经回路的发展和可塑性，使用哺乳动物视觉系统、电生理学和成像技术。

name: Juan Uriagereka
title: Professor, Linguistics & SLLC
summary: Studies syntactic patterns and their implications for language evolution and performance, using matrix products.
summary_zh: 研究句法模式及其对语言演化和表现的影响，使用矩阵乘积的方法。

name: Nan Xu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops advanced computational models and analyses of functional neuroimaging data to uncover insights into brain functions and diseases.
summary_zh: 开发高级计算模型和功能性神经成像数据的分析方法，以揭示大脑功能和疾病的奥秘。

name: Dora Biro
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Beverly Petterson Bishop and Charles W. Bishop Professor of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies how animals use collective behavior and decision-making to navigate and learn, including tool use and social learning.
summary_zh: 研究动物如何通过集体行为和决策导航和学习，包括工具使用和社会学习。

name: Gregg Castellucci
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies speech production, gesture and multimodal communication, motor planning and control, animal behavior, neural circuits and systems.
summary_zh: 研究言语产生、多模态交流、运动计划与控制、动物行为、神经回路和系统。

name: Kevin Davis
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Instructional Track
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and perceives acoustic information, focusing on the inferior colliculus and its response types.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和感知声学信息，重点在于内侧膝状体及其反应类型。

name: Greg DeAngelis
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: George Eastman Professor
summary: Studies cortical circuits for visual perception and behavior, focusing on neural mechanisms of depth perception and sensory integration for self-motion perception.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和行为的皮层电路，重点关注深度感知的神经机制以及视觉和前庭觉信号的整合以感知自身运动。

name: Manuel Gomez-Ramirez
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of haptic perception and sensori-motor integration in rodents and non-human primates using electrophysiology, optogenetics, and neural imaging.
summary_zh: 研究触觉感知和传感器-运动整合的神经机制，使用电生理学、光遗传学和神经成像技术在啮齿动物和非人灵长类动物中进行探究。

name: Ralf Haefner
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain forms percepts and uses them to make decisions, especially in the visual domain, using machine learning tools to model neural responses and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何形成知觉并利用这些知觉进行决策，特别是在视觉领域，使用机器学习工具来建模神经反应和行为。

name: Coraline Rinn Iordan
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Neuroscience
summary: Studies visual and semantic cognition, learning, attention, and neuroplasticity using real-time fMRI and neurofeedback.
summary_zh: 研究视觉和语义认知、学习、注意和神经可塑性，使用实时fMRI和神经反馈技术。

name: Robert A. Jacobs
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Computer Science, and the Center for Visual Science
summary: Studies how new visual information is acquired and stored in memory, using computational models and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过视觉信息的学习和记忆来获取新知识，使用计算模型和实验方法。

name: T. Florian Jaeger
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences and Computer Science
areas: Models of human speech perception and production
summary: Studies human speech perception and production, adaptive language processing, and Bayesian inference for learning over changing inputs.
summary_zh: 研究人类语音感知和产生、语言处理的适应性变化以及用于学习非平稳输入的贝叶斯推理。

name: Chigusa Kurumada
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies the neural basis of social cognition and emotion using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究社会认知和情绪的神经基础。

name: Renee Miller
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Instructional Track
summary: Studies sex differences in brains and behaviors, focusing on cognitive bias and behavioral genetics.
summary_zh: 研究性别差异在大脑和行为中的表现，关注认知偏差和行为遗传学。

name: Jude Mitchell
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences
areas: How spatial attention alters statistics of neuronal spiking
summary: Studies how spatial attention alters neuronal spiking statistics and uses marmosets to understand visual perception and attention in cortical circuits.
summary_zh: 研究空间注意力如何改变神经元放电统计，并使用狨猴来理解视觉感知和注意力在皮层回路中的作用。

name: Elise Piazza
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Brain and Cognitive Sciences, Neuroscience
summary: Studies communication, auditory perception, music cognition, and learning across the lifespan using naturalistic paradigms and two-person neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究交流、听觉感知、音乐认知以及跨生命周期的学习，使用自然范式和两人神经科学方法。

name: Martina Poletti
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Brain & Cognitive Sciences, Neuroscience, Center for Visual Science
summary: Studies visual perception and cognition using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和认知，使用神经成像技术。

name: Karl Rosengren
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain & Cognitive Sciences, Psychology
areas: interaction of cognition and action in childrenâs drawing
summary: Studies cognitive and motor development, the interaction of cognition and action in children's drawing, and conceptual development.
summary_zh: 研究认知和运动发展、儿童绘画中的认知与动作交互以及概念发展。

name: Michele Rucci
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain & Cognitive Sciences, Center for Visual Science
summary: Studies how visual perception and eye movements interact to enhance visual acuity and spatial representation, using both theoretical and experimental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和眼球运动之间的交互如何提高视觉清晰度和空间表征，采用理论和实验方法。

name: Takao Sasaki
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how groups of animals, such as homing pigeons and acorn ants, achieve higher cognitive abilities through collective cognition, using mathematical models and empirical data.
summary_zh: 研究群体动物（如归巢鸽和橡子蚁）如何通过集体认知实现更高的认知能力，使用数学模型和实证数据。

name: Adam Snyder
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the computational mechanisms of visual attention at micro- and macro-scale levels, focusing on how the brain processes goal-relevant information.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意的微观和宏观机制，关注大脑如何处理目标相关信息。

name: Duje Tadin
dept: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences
title: Professor, Brain & Cognitive Sciences, Ophthalmology, Neuroscience, Center for Visual Science
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of visual perception, focusing on how the brain processes visual information.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知的神经机制，关注大脑如何处理视觉信息。

name: Patrick Davies
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children adapt to family adversity, focusing on emotional and behavioral responses, resilience factors, and temperament patterns.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在家庭逆境中的适应，关注情感和行为反应、韧性因素和气质模式。

name: Isobel Heck
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how young children understand societal hierarchies and social group-based inequities, using developmental psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何理解社会阶层和基于社会群体的不平等，采用发展心理学方法。

name: Hannah J. Kramer
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children and adults reason about other people's thoughts and feelings, considering social contexts and time.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何根据社会背景和时间推断他人的心思和感受。

name: Jennie Noll
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the bio-psycho-social impacts of childhood sexual abuse, teen pregnancy, and high-risk behaviors, using longitudinal research and public policy recommendations.
summary_zh: 研究儿童性虐待的生物-心理-社会影响，青少年怀孕和高风险行为，采用纵向研究和公共政策建议。

name: Melissa Sturge-Apple
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies family processes, parental functioning, and child development, focusing on interparental relationships, parenting behaviors, and child adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究家庭过程、父母功能和儿童发展，重点关注亲子关系、育儿行为和儿童适应。

name: Nestor Tulagan
title: Assistant Professor of Counseling & Human Development, Warner School of Education
summary: Studies how ethno-racially minoritized adolescents and emerging adults develop achievement motivation and connect it to their social identities, with a focus on the role of parents and other social.
summary_zh: 研究美国少数族裔青少年和新兴成年人如何发展学业动机并将其与社会身份联系起来，重点关注父母和其他社会人物的作用。

name: Andrew Elliot
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies approach and avoidance motivation, examining antecedents, consequences, and development of achievement and social motivation in educational and sport contexts.
summary_zh: 研究趋避动机，探讨成就动机和社会动机的前因、后果及其发展，特别是在教育和体育情境中的应用。

name: Cameron Hecht
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies psychological processes contributing to societal problems, developing interventions to address these processes, and examining effective contexts for intervention success.
summary_zh: 研究心理过程如何导致社会问题，并开发干预措施来解决这些问题，同时研究干预措施在不同环境中的有效性。

name: Jeremy P. Jamieson
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how stress impacts decisions, emotions, and performance, and how stress responses can be optimized to promote resilience.
summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响决策、情绪和表现，并优化压力反应以促进韧性。

name: Bonnie Le
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how emotions and motivation affect well-being in interpersonal relationships, using naturalistic methods like surveys and lab observations.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和动机如何影响人际关系中的幸福感，使用自然主义方法如调查和实验室互动观察。

name: Christopher Niemiec
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies human motivation, emotion, and personality in social contexts using self-determination theory and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境中的人类动机、情绪和个性，采用自我决定理论和实验方法。

name: Harry Reis
title: Deanâs Professor in Arts & Sciences
summary: Studies the factors influencing social interaction and close relationships, and their impact on health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究影响社交互动和亲密关系的因素及其对健康和福祉的影响。

name: Arielle H. Sheftall
title: Associate Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the developmental mechanisms in early to middle childhood that confer vulnerability to future suicidal behavior, focusing on racial disparities among youth.
summary_zh: 研究早期到中期童年时期的发展机制，这些机制会增加未来自杀行为的脆弱性，重点关注青年中的种族差异。

name: Benjamin Suarez-Jimenez
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies PTSD and anxiety disorders using virtual reality, MRI, and machine learning to understand threat and reward learning.
summary_zh: 使用虚拟现实、磁共振成像和机器学习研究 PTSD 和焦虑障碍中的威胁和奖励学习机制。

name: Osama Ahmed
title: Assistant Professor and Weill Neurohub Term Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the robustness of biological neural networks, using fruit flies as a model organism.
summary_zh: 研究生物神经网络的鲁棒性，使用果蝇作为模型生物。

name: Geoffrey Boynton
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between neuronal responses in the visual cortex and conscious visual experience, focusing on attention and perceptual tasks.
summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层神经反应与意识视觉体验之间的关系，重点关注注意力和感知任务。

name: Jonathon Brown
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the development and impact of self-esteem on emotional reactions to success and failure, focusing on cultural similarities and differences.
summary_zh: 研究自尊的发展及其对成功和失败的情绪反应的影响，重点关注文化相似性和差异性。

name: Sapna Cheryan
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cultural stereotypes affect racial and gender diversity in computer science and the health consequences of identity recognition, using lab-based research.
summary_zh: 研究文化刻板印象如何影响计算机科学领域的种族和性别多样性以及身份认同被认可的健康后果，采用实验室研究方法。

name: Cyril Delgado
title: Faculty
summary: Manages academic services for psychology students and faculty.
summary_zh: 管理心理学系学生的学业服务。

name: Shannon Dorsey
title: Professor
summary: Studies treatment effectiveness and implementation science for mental health care in low and under-resourced settings, training lay counselors.
summary_zh: 研究低资源地区儿童和青少年的心理健康治疗方法的有效性和实施科学，培训非专业治疗师。

name: Angela Fang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of social information processing in social anxiety disorder and body dysmorphic disorder, using brain connectivity techniques and pharmacologic administration.
summary_zh: 研究社交焦虑障碍和躯体变形障碍中社会信息处理的神经生物学机制，使用脑连接技术及药物干预方法。

name: Ione Fine
title: Professor
summary: Studies the computational and neurophysiological basis of visual processing, including perceptual learning and retinal prostheses.
summary_zh: 研究视觉处理的计算和神经生理基础，包括知觉学习和视网膜假体。

name: Brian Flaherty
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies measurement and applied statistics with a developmental perspective, focusing on latent variable models and the analysis of change.
summary_zh: 研究测量和应用统计，具有发展视角，专注于潜在变量模型和变化分析。

name: Jennifer Forsyth
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the genetic and environmental factors contributing to the emergence of psychotic symptoms in adolescence, using genetic, neuroimaging, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究青春期精神病症状出现的遗传和环境因素，使用遗传学、神经成像和行为学方法。

name: Katherine T. Foster
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in psychopathology and health behaviors over the lifespan, using person-centered approaches and longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍和健康行为在个体和生命周期中的差异，采用个体中心的方法和纵向研究方法。

name: William George
title: Professor
summary: Studies the influence of alcohol on sexual behavior, including sexual aggression and HIV risk-taking, using experimental designs and individual differences.
summary_zh: 研究酒精对性行为的影响，包括性侵犯和HIV风险行为，使用实验设计和个体差异评估。

name: David Gire
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how brains code and respond to sensory inputs during active behavior, using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑在主动行为中如何编码和响应感官输入，使用电生理学和光遗传学技术。

name: Debrielle T. Jacques
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how parent and family factors affect caregiving, family functioning, and children's psychological development and risk for psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究父母和家庭因素如何影响照顾、家庭功能以及儿童的心理发展和心理病理风险。

name: Peter Kahn
title: Professor
summary: Studies the psychological impacts of human interaction with nature and technological systems, including the effects on children's development and the design of personified computational systems.
summary_zh: 研究人类与自然和技术系统互动的心理影响，包括对儿童发展的影响以及人形计算系统的设计。

name: Cheryl Kaiser
title: Professor
summary: Studies psychological aspects of prejudice, stereotypes, and diversity, and their intersection with law, politics, and policy.
summary_zh: 研究偏见、刻板印象和多样性等心理方面及其与法律、政治和政策的交叉。

name: Jeansok Kim
title: Professor
summary: Studies fear and stress responses in rats and Alzheimer’s disease models, using optogenetics and electrophysiology to examine neural circuit dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧和压力反应在大鼠和阿尔茨海默病模型中的神经环路动态，使用光遗传学和电生理学方法。

name: Kevin King
title: Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive and emotional self-regulation develops in adolescence, using advanced statistical methods to examine substance use risk factors.
summary_zh: 研究青春期认知和情绪自我调节的发展，使用高级统计方法探讨物质使用风险因素。

name: Mary Larimer
title: Professor, Psychology and Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies prevention and treatment of alcohol and substance use disorders among adolescents and young adults, predicting initiation and maintenance of risky drinking patterns, and co-morbidity with.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成人酒精和物质使用障碍的预防和治疗方法，预测风险饮酒模式的形成和维持，以及与抑郁、焦虑和赌博障碍的共病。

name: Liliana Lengua
title: Professor
summary: Studies children's emotional, social and behavioral adjustment, focusing on individual differences in response to adversity and vulnerability/resilience.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的情绪、社会和行为调整，重点关注在逆境中个体差异的反应、脆弱性和韧性。

name: Cynthia Levine
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cultural, social, and psychological factors influence health and well-being, focusing on the fit between individuals and their social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究文化、社会和心理因素如何影响健康和福祉，重点关注个体与其社会环境的契合度。

name: Priscilla Lui
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the impact of cultural, ethnic, and racial experiences on psychopathology and addictive behaviors, developing measurement tools and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究文化、种族和 Ethnicity 经验对心理病理学和成瘾行为的影响，开发测量工具和干预措施。

name: Lucía Magis-Weinberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how digital technologies impact adolescent development, focusing on social and affective tasks in international settings.
summary_zh: 研究数字技术如何影响青少年发展，特别是在国际背景下对社交和情感任务的影响。

name: Andrew Meltzoff
title: Professor Co-director, UW Institute for Learning and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how infants develop understanding of others, focusing on imitation, memory, and social-cognitive development, linking to neuroscience measures.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解他人，重点在于模仿、记忆和社会认知发展，并将其与神经科学指标联系起来。

name: Scott Murray
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural and computational mechanisms of perception and attention, using fMRI, computational models, and behavioral assessments, with a focus on neurodiversity, particularly autism.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和注意力的神经和计算机制，使用功能性磁共振成像、计算模型和行为评估方法，特别关注神经多样性，包括自闭症。

name: Chantel Prat
title: Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in complex skill learning like reading and programming using fMRI, EEG, and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究复杂技能学习（如阅读和编程）中的个体差异，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和行为实验方法。

name: Betty Repacholi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants understand and learn from emotional expressions, using attentional cues and socially-guided learning.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解并从情感表达中学习，使用注意力线索和社会导向学习的方法。

name: Yuichi Shoda
title: Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in psychological responses to social situations, using quantitative methods to identify triggers of specific behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究个体在社会情境中的心理反应差异，使用定量方法识别特定行为的触发因素。

name: Joseph Sisneros
title: Professor
summary: Studies how fish auditory systems adapt to social and reproductive signals, using behavioral and neurophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究鱼类听觉系统如何适应社会和繁殖信号，使用行为和神经生理学方法。

name: Ariel Starr
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how language interacts with memory and numerical cognition in children’s development using behavioral and eye-tracking methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言如何与儿童记忆和数理认知相互作用，使用行为和追踪凝视方法。

name: Andrea Stocco
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the computational processes in the brain, focusing on the prefrontal cortex and basal ganglia interactions for intelligent behavior.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的计算过程，特别是前额叶皮层和基底节之间的交互作用，以实现智能行为。

name: Z Yan Wang
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Biology and Weill Neurohub Term Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neuroethology of corpse-directed behavior in bees and the nervous system of cephalopods, focusing on oddities and death spirals.
summary_zh: 研究蜜蜂的尸体定向行为和乌贼的神经系统，关注异常现象和死亡螺旋。

name: Jhada Weems
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Clara Wilkins
title: Associate Professor and Earl R. Carlson Professor
summary: Studies how social hierarchies and perceptions of bias affect intergroup relations and discrimination, using psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会等级制度和偏见感知如何影响群体关系和歧视，使用心理实验方法。

name: Amber Williams
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children think about racial and ethnic categories, stereotypes, and inequality, and how these beliefs impact their behaviors and attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童对种族和 Ethnic 类别、刻板印象和不平等的看法，以及这些信念如何影响他们的行为和态度。

name: Lori Zoellner
title: Professor
summary: Studies mechanisms of trauma memory and recovery, focusing on prevention and intervention strategies to reduce chronic psychopathology.
summary_zh: 研究创伤记忆和恢复机制，重点在于预防和干预策略，以减少慢性心理病理学。

name: Ellen Covey
title: Professor
summary: Studies how complex sound patterns are processed in the auditory brainstem of bats and humans, using neuropharmacological experiments and electrophysiological recordings.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物听觉脑干中复杂声模式的处理机制，使用神经药理学实验和电生理记录方法。

name: Sheri Mizumori
title: Professor
summary: Studies neuroplasticity mechanisms of learning, memory, and decision-making using rodent models and optogenetic techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习、记忆和决策的神经可塑性机制，使用啮齿动物模型和光遗传学技术。

name: Kyrill Gurtovenko
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Douglas Ramsay
title: Professor and Chair, Dental Public Health Sciences, School of Dentistry
summary: Studies cognitive processes in children, focusing on learning and development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程，重点在于学习和发育。

name: Sara Jane Webb
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Sama Ahmed
title: Faculty
summary: Studies motivation, emotion, and motor function, examining sensory perception and motor control in students.
summary_zh: 研究动机、情绪和运动功能，探讨感觉感知和运动控制，面向学生。

name: Michael Ailion
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and sensory function & perception.
summary_zh: 从事细胞与分子神经科学研究，关注动机-情绪-状态以及感觉功能与感知。

name: Fritzie Arce-McShane
title: Faculty
summary: Studies motor and sensory functions using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究运动和感觉功能，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Nathan Baertsch
title: Faculty
summary: Studies motivation, emotion, and motor function using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究动机、情绪和运动功能的认知神经科学方法。

name: Wyeth Bair
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational and systems neuroscience, focusing on theoretical approaches to understanding brain function.
summary_zh: 从事计算和系统神经科学的研究，侧重于理论方法来理解大脑功能。

name: Melissa Barker-Haliski
title: Faculty
summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system at the cellular and molecular level.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病的细胞和分子机制。

name: Michele Basso
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive function and motor and sensory processing using computational and systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究认知功能以及运动和感觉处理，采用计算和系统神经科学方法。

name: Michael Bruchas
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of motivation and emotion in the brain, using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中动机和情绪的细胞和分子机制，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Bing Brunton
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational and systems neuroscience, focusing on theoretical approaches to understanding brain function.
summary_zh: 从事计算和系统神经科学的研究，侧重于理论方法来理解大脑功能。

name: Astra Bryant
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of sensory function and perception, using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究感觉功能和知觉的细胞和分子机制，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Elizabeth Buffalo
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive function and disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究认知功能和神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Erik Carlson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Charles Chavkin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of motivation and emotion in animals.
summary_zh: 研究动机和情绪的细胞和分子机制，使用动物模型。

name: Timothy Cherry
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development of the nervous system and disorders affecting it, focusing on sensory function and perception.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的发展及其疾病，重点关注感觉功能和感知。

name: Gabriel Cler
title: Faculty
summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system and motor function, accepting rotation students.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病和运动功能障碍，接受研究生申请。

name: Kevin Coffey
title: Faculty
summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system and motivation-emotion-state relationships, accepting rotation students.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病和动机-情绪-状态关系，接受研究生轮转学生。

name: Forrest Collman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience and computational/theoretical neuroscience.
summary_zh: 从事细胞与分子神经科学和计算/理论神经科学研究。

name: Kayvon Daie
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational and theoretical aspects of motor function and systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究计算和理论神经科学中的运动功能和系统神经科学。

name: Martin Darvas
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of nervous system disorders.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病中的细胞和分子机制。

name: Nikolai Dembrow
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of motor function using computational models.
summary_zh: 研究运动功能的细胞和分子机制，使用计算模型。

name: Adrienne Fairhall
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational and theoretical neuroscience, using mathematical models to understand brain function.
summary_zh: 从事计算和理论神经科学的研究，使用数学模型来理解大脑功能。

name: Yijie Geng
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development of the nervous system and disorders of the nervous system, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的发展和神经系统障碍，重点关注动机-情绪-状态和系统神经科学。

name: Anna Gillespie
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive function and disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究认知功能和神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

name: Sam Golden
title: Faculty
summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and systems neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病，侧重动机-情绪-状态以及系统神经科学。

name: Matt Golub
title: Faculty
summary: Studies computational and theoretical neuroscience.
summary_zh: 从事计算和理论神经科学的研究。

name: Drew Abney
title: Associate Professor, Associate Head, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies how behaviors and social interactions impact developmental trajectories in infancy and toddlerhood, using various techniques including laboratory experiments and free-flowing play sessions.
summary_zh: 研究行为和社会互动如何影响婴儿和幼儿的发展轨迹，使用实验室实验和自由流动的游戏会话等多种技术。

name: Keith Campbell
title: Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies narcissism and its manifestations in social media and relationships, using psychological scales and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究自恋及其在社交媒体和人际关系中的表现，使用心理量表和调查方法。

name: Malissa Clark
title: Professor, Department Head, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies employee well-being, focusing on overwork, workaholism, and work-family dynamics, using mixed methods and meta-analysis.
summary_zh: 研究员工福祉，关注过度工作、工作狂和工作家庭动态，采用混合方法和元分析。

name: Katie Ehrlich
title: Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology Program Chair
summary: Studies how children's social experiences impact their mental and physical health, using behavioral and health assessments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会经历如何影响其一生的心理和身体健康，采用行为和健康评估方法。

name: Jessica Flannery
title: Assistant Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of substance use and health behaviors using fMRI and ecological behavior tracking.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和生态行为跟踪研究物质使用和健康行为的神经认知机制。

name: Janet Frick
title: Associate Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies how infants develop visual attention, using behavioral and physiological measures to understand learning and social interaction.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿视觉注意力的发展，使用行为和生理测量方法来理解学习和社会互动。

name: Brian Frost
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches and manages the Professional Industrial-Organizational Psychology Master’s Program, focusing on talent management and leadership development.
summary_zh: 教授并管理专业工业组织心理学硕士项目，专注于人才管理和领导力发展。

name: Adam Goodie
title: Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making under uncertainty, particularly in relation to gambling behaviors and cognitive distortions.
summary_zh: 研究不确定性下的决策问题，特别是赌博行为和认知扭曲。

name: Brian W. Haas
title: Associate Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies how cultural contexts shape people's identity and the dynamic changes in identity, using a personality approach.
summary_zh: 研究文化背景如何塑造人们的身份及其动态变化，采用个性取向的方法。

name: Billy Hammond
title: Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies how dietary carotenoids affect retinal and brain function, using psychophysical methods and interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究饮食类胡萝卜素对视网膜和大脑功能的影响，采用心理物理学方法和跨学科方法。

name: Yimin He
title: Associate Professor, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies occupational health, organizational climate, and social networks using quantitative methods like social network analysis and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究职业健康、组织气候和社会网络，使用社会网络分析、机器学习等定量方法。

name: Max Herzberg
title: Assistant Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology, Cognitive Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the impact of stressful environments on brain development and subsequent behavioral outcomes in youth and adolescents, using MRI techniques.
summary_zh: 研究压力环境对青少年和青少年脑发育及其行为结果的影响，使用MRI技术。

name: Brian Hoffman
title: Professor, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies leadership, personnel selection, and workplace behaviors, including star performers and microaggressions.
summary_zh: 研究领导力、人员选拔和职场行为，包括顶尖表现者和职场微侵犯。

name: Jennifer McDowell
title: Professor, Associate Director of Owens Institute for Behavioral Research, Cognitive Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and cognitive control, using neuroimaging techniques in children and adults.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和认知控制的神经基础，使用神经影像技术在儿童和成人中进行研究。

name: Paul Moon
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches neuroscience, sensation and perception, cognition, and general psychology, bridging sciences and arts.
summary_zh: 教授神经科学、感觉与知觉、认知和普通心理学，跨学科融合自然科学与艺术。

name: Jeffrey Olenick
title: Assistant Professor, I-O Program Chair, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies the development of teamwork and diversity in extreme environments, using computational models and training interventions.
summary_zh: 研究极端环境中的团队发展和多样性，使用计算模型和培训干预措施。

name: Dylan Richards
title: Assistant Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies health behaviors related to alcohol and cannabis use, focusing on motivation and recovery processes.
summary_zh: 研究与酒精和大麻使用相关的健康行为，重点关注动机和恢复过程。

name: Melissa Robertson
title: Assistant Professor, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies social relationships, particularly mentoring and supervisor-subordinate dynamics, to improve employee development and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社交关系（如导师关系和上下级关系），以提高员工的发展和福祉。

name: Ashley Sanders
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience Program, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies how socioeconomic disadvantage impacts children's neurodevelopment and risk for psychiatric disorders, using neuroimaging and immune metrics.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济劣势如何影响儿童的神经发展和精神疾病风险，使用神经成像和免疫指标。

name: Allison Skinner
title: Associate Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology
summary: Studies how biases are established and maintained through subtle social cues, using experimental and correlational methods.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过微妙的社会线索建立和维持偏见，使用实验和相关方法。

name: Richard Slatcher
title: Gail M. Williamson Distinguished Professor, Social, Developmental, and Health Psychology, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies the effects of close relationships on health and well-being, focusing on intimacy processes and smartphone use.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系对健康和福祉的影响，重点关注亲密关系中的披露过程和智能手机使用。

name: Brett Clementz
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies structural and functional abnormalities in schizophrenia using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经影像技术研究精神分裂症的结构和功能异常。

name: Rodney K. Dishman
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Professor, Kinesiology
summary: Studies exercise and physical activity's effects on cognitive function and mental health, using longitudinal studies and intervention trials.
summary_zh: 研究体育活动和身体活动对认知功能和心理健康的影响，使用纵向研究和干预试验。

name: Gaylen L. Edwards
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain processes abdominal sensory information and controls eating and autonomic functions.
summary_zh: 研究腹腔感觉信息的神经处理以及进食和自主功能的调控。

name: Dorothy Munkenbeck Fragaszy
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies flexible instrumental behavior, perception, and skill learning in primates, focusing on capuchin monkeys.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物（尤其是卷尾猴和狨猴）的灵活操作行为、知觉和技能学习。

name: Silvia Giraudo
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Associate Professor, Foods and Nutrition
summary: Studies the role of melanocortin systems in regulating food intake and body weight in rats, using neurochemical and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究黑素细胞刺激素系统在调节进食和体重中的作用，使用神经化学和行为学方法。

name: Phil Holmes
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Professor, Behavior and Brain Science Program (Psychology)
summary: Studies the neurobiological effects of exercise on stress resilience, affective motivation, and learning, using rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究运动对压力韧性、情感动机和学习的神经生物学效应，使用啮齿动物模型。

name: Hongxiang Liu
dept: Neuroscience PhD (Biomedical and Health Sciences Institute)
title: Assistant Professor, Animal & Dairy Science
summary: Studies the development and maintenance of taste sensitivity in mammalian tongues using whole embryo and tongue organ cultures, transgenic mice, and non-mammalian vertebrates.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物舌头味觉敏感性的发育和维持，使用整体胚胎和舌头器官培养系统、转基因小鼠和非哺乳动物脊椎动物。

name: Jamie Edgin
title: Professor and Chair, Psychology, Director Memory Development and Policy lab
summary: Studies memory development and policy, focusing on educational practices and forensic interviewing methods for children with disabilities.
summary_zh: 研究记忆发展和政策，重点关注残疾儿童的教育实践和司法访谈方法。

name: Martha Ann Bell
title: University Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies developmental changes in brain-behavior relations during infancy and childhood, focusing on executive function, emotion regulation, and EEG coherence.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童期间脑-行为关系的发展变化，重点在于执行功能、情绪调节和EEG同步性。

name: Rosanna Breaux
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies the social, emotional, and academic functioning of children, adolescents, and emerging adults, particularly those with ADHD, focusing on emotion regulation and parenting practices.
summary_zh: 研究儿童、青少年和新兴成年人的社会、情感和学业功能，特别是患有ADHD的个体，重点关注情绪调节和父母养育实践。

name: Meagan Brem
title: Associate Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies the risk factors and prevention of intimate partner violence among heavy drinking young adults, using ecological momentary assessment methods.
summary_zh: 研究高风险饮酒年轻人的伴侣暴力风险因素及其预防，使用生态时刻评估方法。

name: Charles Calderwood
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how employees perceive and recover from work stress, focusing on commuting spillover, work recovery, and employee physical activity.
summary_zh: 研究员工如何感知和恢复工作压力，重点关注通勤溢出、工作恢复和员工体育活动。

name: Brooks Casas
title: Professor, Fralin Biomedical Research Institute
areas: Fundamentals of Cognitive and Brain Science
summary: Studies decision-making in social contexts, including trust and risk preferences, using decision neuroscience and social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会情境下的决策过程，包括信任和风险偏好，采用决策神经科学和社会心理学方法。

name: Pearl Chiu
title: Professor
summary: Studies decision-making, depression, and computational psychiatry using reinforcement learning and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究决策制定、抑郁症和计算精神病学，使用强化学习和神经成像技术。

name: Heather Davis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the overlap between disordered eating, depression, anxiety, and suicidality, focusing on shame as a transdiagnostic mechanism.
summary_zh: 研究饮食障碍、抑郁、焦虑和自杀行为之间的重叠，重点关注羞耻作为跨诊断机制的作用。

name: Rachel Diana
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychology and cognitive neuroscience of human memory using behavioral techniques, event-related potentials, and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的心理学和认知神经科学，使用行为技术、事件相关电位和计算建模方法。

name: Vanessa Diaz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how bilingualism affects cognitive development, particularly in infants and young children, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究双语能力如何影响儿童认知发展，特别是婴儿和幼儿的认知发展，使用多种实验方法。

name: Roseanne Foti
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
areas: Process of how leaders emerge in small groups
Congruence of leader and follower perceptions of leadership
Differences in the way male vs. female leaders emerge
Improving the measurement of leadership behavior
summary: Studies how leaders emerge in small groups and the dynamics of leader-follower relationships, using leadership assessments and feedback.
summary_zh: 研究小团队中领导者的 emergence 过程及其与追随者的关系动态，使用领导力评估和反馈方法。

name: Bruce Friedman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychophysiology of anxiety, emotion, and personality, analyzing heart rate variability and autonomic nervous system activity.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑、情绪和人格的心理生理学，分析心率变异性及自主神经系统活动。

name: Zehra Gulseven
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology, Developmental Science
summary: Studies positive social development in children and adolescents, focusing on prosocial behavior and moral development.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年的积极社会发展，重点关注亲社会行为和道德发展。

name: Ivan Hernandez
title: Associate Professor, Industrial-Organizational Psychology
summary: Studies social behavior and machine learning in industrial-organizational psychology, using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为和社会心理学中的机器学习方法，使用定量方法。

name: Ning Hsu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies leadership, personality, and gender differences, focusing on female leadership advantage, agency and communion, and destructive leadership.
summary_zh: 研究领导力、人格和性别差异，重点关注女性领导优势、自主与共情以及破坏性领导。

name: Chloe Hudson
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies how individual differences in mental state processing affect daily life and psychotherapy outcomes, using dimensional and transdiagnostic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异在心理状态加工中的作用及其对日常生活和心理治疗结果的影响，采用维度和跨诊断方法。

name: Samantha Kempker-Margherio
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Develops and evaluates interventions for adolescents with externalizing difficulties and substance use problems, focusing on cost-effective strategies for rural communities.
summary_zh: 开发和评估针对具有外部化问题和物质使用问题的青少年的干预措施，重点关注农村社区的成本效益策略。

name: Jungmeen Kim-Spoon
title: 2025-present Heilig-Meyers Professor of Psychology, Virginia Tech
areas: Risk and resilience in child maltreatment
Adolescent decision making and health risk behaviors
summary: Studies the development of psychopathology and resilience in children and adolescents, focusing on risk and resilience factors in maltreatment and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年心理病理学和复原力的发展，重点关注虐待中的风险和复原力因素以及决策制定。

name: Dominique La Barrie
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children develop cognitive skills, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知技能的发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Tae-Ho Lee
title: is an Associate Professor of Psychology at Virginia Tech
summary: Studies age-related changes in attentional control and emotional processing, using brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究注意力控制和情绪处理随年龄变化的神经机制，采用脑成像技术。

name: Amy Marshall
title: Faculty
summary: Studies factors contributing to psychological and physical aggression in close relationships, focusing on trauma's impact on social information processing.
summary_zh: 研究影响亲密关系中心理和身体攻击的因素，重点关注创伤对社会信息处理的影响。

name: Arturia Melson-Silimon
title: Faculty
summary: Studies experiences of underrepresented identities at work, including code-switching and neurodivergence.
summary_zh: 研究工作场所中被边缘化身份的经验，包括代码切换和神经多样性。

name: Ian Neath
title: Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Robin Panneton
title: Associate Professor, Virginia Tech (1995 - present)
summary: Studies how infants process speech and language, using eye-tracking and social engagement measures.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何处理语言和语音，使用眼动追踪和社会互动测量方法。

name: Seongmin Park
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology, School of Neuroscience, and Department of Biomedical Engineering, Virginia Tech
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and decision-making, focusing on how the brain learns from past experiences and uses internal models to make decisions.
summary_zh: 研究学习和决策的神经机制，关注大脑如何从过去的经验中学习并利用内部模型做出决策。

name: Ross Rogers
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social psychology, focusing on the psychology of meaning and social interactions.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学，特别是意义心理学和社会互动。

name: Adrienne Romer
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychology
summary: Studies the comorbidity of mental disorders using transdiagnostic, dimensional, and neuroscience-informed approaches, examining shared risk markers in adolescents and adults.
summary_zh: 研究精神障碍共病的跨诊断维度和神经科学导向方法，探讨青少年和成人中共享的风险标志物。

name: Ann Gregus
title: Assistant Professor, Virginia Tech (2020- )
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of chronic pain, focusing on druggable targets in endocannabinoid signaling and nonopioid therapeutics.
summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛的分子机制，重点在于内源性大麻素信号通路中的可成药靶点以及非阿片类治疗药物。

name: Maria Puxeddu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the brain’s network architecture gives rise to cognition and behavior, using neuroimaging, network science, and statistics.
summary_zh: 研究大脑网络架构如何产生认知和行为，使用神经成像、网络科学和统计学方法。

name: Meike van der Heijden
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the development of cerebellar functions in health and disease, focusing on cell types and communication in motor and social behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究健康和疾病中小脑功能的发展，重点关注细胞类型和在运动和社会行为中的通信。

name: Ryan Purcell
title: Assistant Professor, Fralin Biomedical Research Insti
summary: Studies the neurobiology disrupted by genetic risk factors for schizophrenia and autism, identifying molecular mechanisms of disease risk.
summary_zh: 研究遗传风险因素（如精神分裂症和自闭症）对神经生物学的影响，识别疾病风险的分子机制。

name: Ryunosuke Amo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究认知过程。

name: Sujith Vijayan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural dynamics during active behavior and sleep using computational modeling and electrophysiological recordings, focusing on memory consolidation and sleep physiology.
summary_zh: 研究行为和睡眠期间的神经动态，使用计算建模和电生理记录，重点在于记忆巩固和睡眠生理学。

name: Timothy Jarome
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of memory formation and modification, focusing on fear memories and sex differences, using rodent behavioral paradigms and molecular biology techniques.
summary_zh: 研究记忆形成和修改的细胞和分子机制，重点关注恐惧记忆和性别差异，使用啮齿动物行为范式和分子生物学技术。

name: William 'Matt' Howe
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neurobiological mechanisms of reward learning, motivation, and executive control, using optogenetics and pharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究奖励学习、动机和执行控制的神经生物学机制，使用光遗传学和药理学方法。

name: Wynn Legon
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the use of low-intensity focused ultrasound (LIFU) to modulate human brain activity for clinical applications in addiction, pain, and depression.
summary_zh: 研究低强度聚焦超声波（LIFU）对人类大脑活动的调节作用，应用于成瘾、疼痛和抑郁等临床应用。

name: Reginald Adams
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how social and emotional meaning is extracted from nonverbal cues, particularly facial expressions and gaze, using visual cognition and affective neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究非言语线索（尤其是面部表情和凝视）如何传达社会和情感意义，采用视觉认知和情感神经科学的方法。

name: Peter Arnett
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neuropsychological aspects of multiple sclerosis, focusing on depression, cognitive functioning, and coping strategies, and explores the consequences of sports-related concussions.
summary_zh: 研究多发性硬化症的认知神经心理学方面，重点关注抑郁、认知功能和应对策略，并探讨运动相关脑震荡的后果，包括风险因素和结果。

name: Roger Beaty
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people think creatively, using brain imaging and behavioral experiments to examine neural and cognitive systems that support creative thinking.
summary_zh: 研究创造性思维的认知神经机制，使用脑成像和行为实验来探讨支持创造性思维的神经和认知系统。

name: Karen Bierman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the long-term effects of early school-based and family-focused interventions on social-emotional learning and school readiness, evaluating new parent-guided play interventions.
summary_zh: 研究早期学校和家庭干预对社会情感学习和学校准备的长期影响，评估新的家长指导游戏干预措施。

name: Ricardo Brooks
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the impact of information and communication technology on attention and the influence of basic income on job selection and employee turnover.
summary_zh: 研究信息技术对注意力的影响以及基本收入对就业选择和员工离职的影响。

name: Katie Burkhouse
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive-affective and reward processing styles in youth at risk for depression, using EEG, fMRI, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁高风险青少年的认知情感和奖赏处理模式，使用EEG、fMRI和行为方法。

name: Kristin Buss
title: Faculty
summary: Studies emotional development and risk factors for anxiety in children and adolescents using interdisciplinary methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年的情绪发展及焦虑风险因素，采用跨学科方法。

name: Daryl Cameron
title: Faculty
summary: Studies empathy and moral decision-making, examining motivational and situational factors that influence empathic emotions and prosocial behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究同理心和道德决策，探讨动机和情境因素如何影响同理心情绪和利他行为。

name: Louis Castonguay
title: Faculty
summary: Studies psychotherapy effectiveness and implementation, focusing on therapeutic alliance, client-therapist variables, and practice research networks.
summary_zh: 研究心理治疗的有效性和实施，重点关注治疗联盟、来访者-治疗师变量以及实践研究网络。

name: Jonathan Cook
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how social categories like race/ethnicity, gender, and sexual orientation affect cognitive, affective, and physiological processes, and develops interventions to mitigate environmental.
summary_zh: 研究社会类别（如种族/民族、性别和性取向）如何影响认知、情感和生理过程，并开发干预措施以减轻环境威胁。

name: Nancy Dennis
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effects of aging on episodic memory using behavioral and neuroimaging methods, focusing on false memories and associative memories.
summary_zh: 研究老化对情景记忆的影响，使用行为和神经影像学方法，重点关注虚假记忆和关联记忆。

name: Michele Diaz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how language differs across adulthood using cognitive tasks, neuropsychological assessments, and neuroimaging measures.
summary_zh: 研究成年期语言差异，使用认知任务、神经心理学评估和神经影像学措施。

name: Rina D. Eiden
title: Faculty
summary: Studies developmental trajectories for children experiencing parental substance use, focusing on interventions to promote resilience and positive outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究因父母使用物质而经历多重逆境儿童的发展轨迹，侧重于促进韧性和积极结果的干预措施。

name: Karen Gasper
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how feelings like boredom and neutrality affect creativity, decision-making, and social interactions, using psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究日常情感（如无聊和中性情感）如何影响创造力、决策和社交互动，采用心理实验方法。

name: Rick Gilmore
title: Rick O. Gilmore is Professor of Psychology and a Huck Institute of the Life Sciences Faculty Co-fund.
summary: Studies the development of brain networks that process visual motion to understand spatial layout and object shape, using optic flow.
summary_zh: 研究大脑网络的发展，以处理视觉运动来理解空间布局和物体形状，使用视网膜流动。

name: Alicia Grandey
title: Liberal Arts Professor
summary: Studies midlife women’s health, particularly menopause, and its impact on leadership, using interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究中年女性健康（尤其是更年期）对领导力的影响，采用跨学科方法。

name: Frank Hillary
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how brain injury and disease affect functional brain organization over the lifespan, using MRI and network neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究脑损伤和疾病如何影响生命周期中的功能脑组织，使用MRI和网络神经科学方法。

name: Cynthia Huang-Pollock
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive and neuropsychological mechanisms of attention, learning, and disruptive behavior in children, focusing on ADHD.
summary_zh: 研究儿童注意、学习和破坏性行为的认知和神经心理机制，重点关注注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）。

name: Sarah Holowach Kollat
title: Faculty
summary: Studies child and adolescent development, focusing on behavioral therapy, peer relationships, and autism spectrum disorders.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年发展，重点在于行为疗法、同伴关系和自闭症谱系障碍。

name: Sean Laurent
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how people think and feel about others, focusing on moral judgments, perspective taking, and empathy.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何看待他人，特别是道德判断、换位思考和共情。

name: Kenneth Levy
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the relationship between attachment theory, emotion regulation, and personality disorders, focusing on psychotherapy outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究依恋理论、情绪调节与人格障碍之间的关系，重点关注心理治疗的结果。

name: Lynn Liben
title: is Professor in the Department of Psychology of the College of the Liberal Arts at Penn Stat
summary: Studies gender development, gender stereotypes, and spatial cognition, their development and impact on STEM education.
summary_zh: 研究性别发展、性别刻板印象以及空间认知的发展及其对STEM教育的影响。

name: Erika Lunkenheimer
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how parent-child interaction patterns affect child development, focusing on self-regulation and the prevention of child maltreatment.
summary_zh: 研究父母与儿童互动模式如何影响儿童发展，重点关注自我调节和儿童虐待的预防。

name: Jes Matsick
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social and health disparities, focusing on how marginalized groups experience stigma and its impact on well-being, using mixed-method approaches.
summary_zh: 研究边缘群体经历的污名及其对心理社会福祉的影响，采用混合方法研究。

name: Emiko Muraki
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how perceptual, motor, and affective neural systems support language processing and mental imagery, using EEG and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、运动和情感神经系统的功能，如何支持语言处理和心智成像，使用EEG和fMRI方法。

name: Jenae Neiderhiser
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how genes and environment interact to shape development throughout the lifespan, focusing on interpersonal relationships and early life experiences.
summary_zh: 研究基因和环境如何相互作用影响整个生命周期的发展，重点关注人际关系和早期生活经历。

name: Michelle Newman
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the nature and treatment of anxiety disorders and depression, using cutting-edge methods to examine psychotherapy outcomes and underlying processes.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和抑郁障碍的性质及其治疗方法，使用前沿方法研究心理治疗效果和潜在过程。

name: Koraly Pérez-Edgar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the relationship between temperament and psychopathology, focusing on behavioral inhibition and attention mechanisms in children, using direct observation, EEG, ERP, fMRI, and mobile.
summary_zh: 研究气质与心理障碍之间的关系，特别是在儿童中关注行为抑制和注意机制，使用直接观察、EEG、ERP、fMRI 和移动眼追踪技术。

name: Aaron Pincus
title: Faculty
summary: Studies social processes in personality, psychopathology, and psychotherapy, integrating interpersonal theories and developing measures for clinical assessment.
summary_zh: 研究人格、心理障碍和心理治疗中的社会过程，整合人际理论并开发临床评估量表。

name: Suzy Scherf
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children form representations of the visual world, focusing on the development of face processing from early childhood to adulthood.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何形成对视觉世界的表征，重点关注从幼儿期到成年期面孔处理的发展。

name: Susan J. Simkins
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how team members coordinate effectively, especially in human-robot teams, and promotes psychological safety in various teams.
summary_zh: 研究团队成员如何有效协调，尤其是在人机团队中，并在各种团队中促进心理安全感。

name: Jose Soto
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cultural and contextual influences on emotional functioning, mental health and well-being, focusing on oppressed groups and accurate assessment methods.
