summary_zh: 研究文化与情境对情绪功能、心理健康和福祉的影响，重点关注受压迫群体和准确评估方法。

name: Janet Swim
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychological factors influencing pro-environmental actions and policies, using experimental and survey research.
summary_zh: 研究促进环保行为和政策的心理因素，使用实验和调查研究方法。

name: Theresa Vescio
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effects of hegemonic masculinity on political preferences, sexual violence, and voting behavior, examining how these factors reinforce social inequalities.
summary_zh: 研究霸权男性主义如何影响政治偏好、性暴力和投票行为，探讨这些因素如何巩固社会不平等。

name: Martha Wadsworth
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children in poverty adapt to stress and trauma, identifying strengths and developing interventions.
summary_zh: 研究贫困儿童如何适应压力和创伤，识别优势并开发干预措施。

name: Stephen Wilson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the causes and effects of cigarette smoking and overeating, using brain imaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究吸烟和暴饮暴食的原因及其影响，采用脑成像和行为方法。

name: Dawn Witherspoon
title: is Professor of Psychology and former McCourtney Family Early Career Professor in Psychology
summary: Studies how urban and rural family contexts affect adolescents' well-being, using community-engaged methods.
summary_zh: 研究城市和农村家庭环境如何影响青少年的福祉，采用社区参与的方法。

name: Sonia Cavigelli
title: Associate Professor of Biobehavioral Health
summary: Studies how temperament and social status affect stress and health in natural environments, focusing on corticosterone and anxiety-like behavior.
summary_zh: 研究气质和社会地位如何影响自然环境中的应激和健康，重点关注皮质醇和焦虑样行为。

name: Emily Ansell
title: Professor of Biobehavioral Health
summary: Studies the impact of stress and addiction on personality disorders, particularly borderline personality disorder, in adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究压力和成瘾对边缘型人格障碍的影响，特别是在青少年中的表现。

name: Orfeu Buxton
title: Elizabeth Fenton Susman Professor of Biobehavioral Health
summary: Studies the causes and health consequences of chronic sleep deficiency, especially in relation to aging and work-life balance.
summary_zh: 研究慢性睡眠不足的原因及其健康后果，特别是在衰老和工作生活平衡方面的表现。

name: Laura Cabrera
title: Associate Professor of Engineering Science and Mechanics
summary: Studies the ethical and societal implications of neurotechnologies used for treatment and enhancement.
summary_zh: 研究神经技术在治疗和增强用途中的伦理和社会影响。

name: Eric Claus
title: Associate Professor of Biobehavioral Health
summary: Studies the neural and cognitive mechanisms supporting behavior change in alcohol use disorders using fMRI.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像研究酒精使用障碍中支持行为改变的神经和认知机制。

name: Nikki Crowley
title: Associate Professor of Biology, of Biomedical Engineering, and of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies how peptides, especially somatostatin, affect neuronal signaling and behavior in the prefrontal cortex during stress and drug use.
summary_zh: 研究肽类物质（尤其是生长抑素）如何影响前额叶皮层的神经信号和行为，特别是在应激和药物使用的情况下。

name: Timothy Currier
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Biology
summary: Studies developmental mechanisms that build neural circuits and computational diversity in the fruit fly visual system, examining visuomotor behaviors and navigation.
summary_zh: 研究发育机制构建神经回路和果蝇视觉系统的计算多样性，探讨运动视觉行为和导航。

name: Patrick Drew
title: Professor of Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Engineering Science and Mechanics, and Neurosurgery
summary: Studies neural activity and neurovascular coupling during sleep and behavior using optical imaging.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和行为期间的神经活动和神经血管耦合，使用光学成像技术。

name: Chris Engeland
title: Professor of Biobehavioral Health and Nursing
summary: Studies how stress, age, gender, and hormones affect inflammation and health, with a focus on biomarker feasibility.
summary_zh: 研究压力、年龄、性别和激素如何影响炎症和健康，并关注生物标志物的可行性。

name: Lisa Gatzke-Kopp
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the development of aggressive and hyperactive behaviors, linking experience and environment to neurobiological dysfunction.
summary_zh: 研究攻击性和多动行为的发展，将经验和环境与神经生物学功能障碍联系起来。

name: Bruce Gluckman
title: Professor of Engineering Science and Mechanics, of Neurosurgery, and of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies the dynamics of neural systems and how to measure and interact with them, focusing on seizures and epilepsy.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统的动力学及其测量和交互方法，重点关注癫痫和发作。

name: Thomas Gould
title: Jean Phillips Shibley Professor and Department Head of Biobehavioral Health
summary: Studies the neurobiology of learning and memory, focusing on the effects of nicotine and fear conditioning on the hippocampus.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经生物学，重点关注尼古丁和条件恐惧对海马的影响。

name: John Hayes
title: Professor of Food Science
summary: Studies taste perception, particularly bitterness, and its relation to food preferences and eating behavior.
summary_zh: 研究味觉感知，尤其是苦味，并探讨其与食物偏好和进食行为的关系。

name: David M. Almeida
title: Distinguished Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies daily stress processes and their effects on health in middle adulthood, using longitudinal diary studies and workplace interventions.
summary_zh: 研究中年时期日常压力过程及其对健康的影響，使用纵向日記研究和職場干預措施。

name: Timothy Brick
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how interactions between people change and are changed by internal states, using real-time data collection and analysis tools.
summary_zh: 研究人际互动如何以及在多大程度上受到内在状态的影响，并使用实时数据收集和分析工具来理解这些过程。

name: Sy-Miin Chow
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Develops methods for handling intensive longitudinal data and fitting nonlinear dynamical systems models, focusing on dynamic modeling and human dynamics.
summary_zh: 开发处理密集纵向数据和拟合非线性动力系统模型的方法，专注于动态建模和人类动态。

name: H. Harrington Cleveland
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies gene-environment interactions affecting substance use among adolescents and relapse processes in addiction recovery, using longitudinal designs and smartphone data.
summary_zh: 研究基因-环境交互作用对青少年物质使用的影响以及成瘾康复中的复发过程，使用纵向设计和智能手机数据。

name: Blake Colaianne
title: Assistant Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how mindfulness, compassion, and social connection support adolescent well-being, using longitudinal and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究正念、同情和社交联系如何支持青少年的幸福感，采用纵向和实验方法。

name: Christian Connell
title: Ken Young Family Professor in Healthy Children
summary: Studies the effects of child maltreatment on behavioral health outcomes, using large-scale data and partnerships with public systems.
summary_zh: 研究虐待对儿童行为健康结果的影响，利用大规模数据和与公共系统的合作。

name: Shannon Corkery
title: Professor-in-Charge of Undergraduate Programs
summary: Studies how commitment dimensions affect relational outcomes and influences in higher education, using social exchange theories.
summary_zh: 研究承诺维度如何影响关系结果和高等教育中的影响因素，使用社会交换理论。

name: Max Crowley
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies, and Public Policy
summary: Studies how to optimize investments in healthy development to reduce substance misuse and delinquent behavior, using economic evaluations and policy analysis.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过经济评估和政策分析优化健康发展的投资，以减少物质滥用和不良行为。

name: Sebrina L. Doyle Fosco
title: Assistant Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the development of social and emotional skills and wellbeing through mindfulness-based interventions in educational settings, focusing on adult populations.
summary_zh: 研究通过基于正念的干预措施促进教育环境中成年人的社会情感技能和幸福感的发展。

name: Gregory M. Fosco
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies family systems processes influencing adolescent development, including substance use, emotional distress, and positive well-being, and evaluates family-centered interventions.
summary_zh: 研究家庭系统过程对青少年发展的影响，包括物质滥用、情绪困扰和积极幸福感，并评估家庭中心干预措施。

name: Steffany J. Fredman
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how PTSD symptoms affect intimate relationships and family functioning, developing couple-based interventions.
summary_zh: 研究 PTSD 症状如何影响亲密关系和家庭功能，并开发基于伴侣的干预措施。

name: Michael Hunter
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the dynamics of human behavior using mathematical modeling and statistical computing, developing novel methods for dynamical systems and software packages.
summary_zh: 研究人类行为的动力学，使用数学建模和统计计算方法，开发新的动力系统方法和软件包。

name: Abenaa Jones
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies opioid use and overdose among criminal justice-involved women, examining racial differences and developing interventions for treatment.
summary_zh: 研究刑事司法系统内女性的阿片类药物使用和过量，探讨种族差异并开发治疗方法。

name: Heidemarie Laurent
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies stress regulation and resilience, using stress physiology monitoring, neuroimaging, and behavioral observation to understand and enhance coping mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究压力调节和韧性，使用压力生理监测、神经成像和行为观察来理解并增强应对机制。

name: Jennifer L. Maggs
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the etiology, consequences, and prevention of substance use among adolescents and young adults, using longitudinal designs and national cohort studies.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成年人的物质使用原因、后果和预防，采用纵向设计和全国性队列研究。

name: Lynn M. Martire
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies how close relationships in adulthood affect health and chronic illness management, and the effects of chronic illness on close relationships, using interviews, lab experiments, and daily life.
summary_zh: 研究成年亲密关系对健康和慢性病管理的影响，以及慢性病对亲密关系的影响，使用访谈、实验室实验和日常生活跟踪方法。

name: Zita Oravecz
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Develops and applies advanced statistical methods to study emotional and cognitive development, using intensive longitudinal data.
summary_zh: 开发和应用高级统计方法研究情绪和认知发展，使用密集纵向数据。

name: Nelson Roque
title: Assistant Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies cognitive aging, using mobile health technologies and passive sensors to track attention in older adults.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化，使用移动健康技术和被动传感器跟踪老年人的注意力。

name: Alexis R. Santos
title: Associate Professor of Human Development and Family Studies, and Demography
summary: Studies the determinants and promotion of well-being, especially among racially/ethnically minoritized adults, using biomarkers and self-reports.
summary_zh: 研究少数族裔成年人的幸福感及其促进因素，使用生物标志物和自我报告的方法。

name: Elizabeth Skowron
title: Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the psychosocial and physiological bases of parenting to prevent child abuse and neglect, using clinical trials and neurobiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究育儿的心理社会和生理基础，以预防儿童虐待和忽视，使用临床试验和神经生物学测量方法。

name: Martin J. Sliwinski
title: Gregory H. Wolf Professor in Healthy Aging and Human Development
summary: Studies daily experiences and cognitive function in older adults, using ecological momentary assessment and ambulatory cognitive assessments.
summary_zh: 研究老年人日常经验和认知功能，使用生态瞬时评估和可穿戴认知评估。

name: Douglas M. Teti
title: Distinguished Professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies infant and early child development, focusing on socio-emotional development, parenting competence, and the effects of parenting on child functioning.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和早期儿童发展，重点关注社会情感发展、育儿能力以及育儿对孩子功能的影响。

name: Samantha L. Tornello
title: Associate professor of Human Development and Family Studies
summary: Studies the role of family composition and parental sexual orientation/gender in family dynamics, children's development, and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究家庭构成和父母性取向/性别在家庭动态、儿童发展和福祉中的作用。

name: Christopher R. Agnew
title: Professor
summary: Studies close interpersonal relationships and their impact on social and health processes, using relational models.
summary_zh: 研究亲密的人际关系及其对社会和健康过程的影响，使用关系模型。

name: Ximena Arriaga
title: Professor
summary: Studies close connections and personal relationships, focusing on social psychology.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和个人关系，侧重于社会心理学。

name: Stephen Broomell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how environmental factors influence judgment and decision-making, using lab experiments and statistical models.
summary_zh: 研究环境因素如何影响判断和决策，使用实验室实验和统计模型。

name: Jennifer Brown
title: Professor, Associate Head for Strategic and Operational Initiatives
summary: Studies culturally-tailored interventions to prevent HIV/AIDS and improve substance use and reproductive health outcomes, using implementation science and cultural consensus modeling.
summary_zh: 研究文化适应干预措施以预防艾滋病、改善物质使用和生殖健康结果，采用实施科学和文化共识建模方法。

name: Julia Chester
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development and characterization of animal models to understand the biological and behavioral mechanisms influencing alcohol use disorders and co-occurring conditions.
summary_zh: 研究动物模型的发展和表征，以了解影响酒精使用障碍及其共病条件的生物和行为机制。

name: Yu-Chin Chiu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control, attention, and inhibitory response using fMRI and EEG to understand neurocognitive mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制、注意力和抑制反应，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图来理解神经认知机制。

name: Christopher Eckhardt
title: Professor
summary: Studies psychological risk factors for intimate partner violence, including cognitive distortions, alcohol use, and behavior change in treatment.
summary_zh: 研究亲密伴侣暴力的心理风险因素，包括认知扭曲、酒精使用和治疗中的行为改变。

name: Dan Foti
title: Professor
summary: Studies the pathophysiology of psychiatric illnesses, particularly depression and schizophrenia, using EEG as an intermediate phenotype.
summary_zh: 研究精神疾病（尤其是抑郁症和精神分裂症）的病理生理机制，使用EEG作为中间表型。

name: Edward Fox
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how neural pathways in the vagus nerve control food intake and metabolism, using mouse genetics and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究迷走神经的神经通路如何控制食物摄入和新陈代谢，使用小鼠遗传学和行为学方法。

name: Monica Gamez-Djokic
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how artificial intelligence and emerging technologies influence social perception, intergroup relations, and moral judgments, exploring biases and ethical evaluations.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能和其他新兴技术如何影响社会知觉、群体关系和道德判断，探讨偏见和伦理评价。

name: Alexandra Harris-Watson
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences affect job performance and interpersonal dynamics in teams and AI collaborations.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异如何影响工作表现和团队及人工智能合作中的人际动态。

name: Sébastien Hélie
title: Professor
summary: Studies automaticity, problem solving, and decision-making using computational cognitive neuroscience and neuroeconomics approaches.
summary_zh: 使用计算认知神经科学和神经经济学方法研究自动化、问题解决和决策制定。

name: George Hollich
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants perceive speech and learn words, using methods from epigenetic robotics and dynamic systems theory.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何感知语音和学习词汇，使用来自表观遗传机器人学和动力系统理论的方法。

name: Jeffrey D. Karpicke
title: Named Professor
summary: Studies how people remember information, using experiments to understand memory strategies and retrieval practices.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何记忆信息，通过实验了解记忆策略和检索实践。

name: Brandon Keehn
title: Professor
summary: Studies attentional strengths and weaknesses in autistic children using fMRI, EEG, and eye-tracking to identify early markers for diagnosis and intervention.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和眼动追踪技术研究自闭症儿童的注意力优势和劣势，以识别早期诊断和干预的生物标志物。

name: Andy Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system affects attention and emotional processing in aging, using eye tracking, EEG, neuroimaging, and cognitive assessments.
summary_zh: 研究去甲肾上腺素系统如何影响老化过程中的注意力和情绪处理，使用眼动追踪、脑电图、神经影像学和认知评估方法。

name: Kimberly Kinzig
title: Professor, Department Head
summary: Studies neuroendocrine regulation of food intake and body weight, and the neurobiology of eating disorders and stress.
summary_zh: 研究神经内分泌对食物摄入和体重的调节以及进食障碍和压力的神经生物学机制。

name: Teri Kirby
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies diversity, inclusion, and the effectiveness of diversity initiatives in organizations and society, focusing on identity, stereotypes, and unintended consequences.
summary_zh: 研究多样性和包容性及其在组织和社会中的有效性，重点关注身份、刻板印象和意外后果。

name: Joshua Alexander
title: Associate Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how hearing aids affect speech perception and individual differences in hearing aid benefit using hearing aid simulators and laboratory measures.
summary_zh: 研究助听器对语音感知的影响以及个体在助听器益处方面的差异，使用助听器模拟器和实验室测量方法。

name: Satyajit Ambike
title: Faculty
summary: Studies human movement stability and efficiency, particularly in older adults and those with Parkinson’s disease, using biomechanical and motor control methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类运动的稳定性和效率，特别是在老年人和帕金森病患者中的表现，使用生物力学和运动控制方法。

name: Ed Bartlett
title: Professor of Biological Sciences and Professor of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies how hearing circuits function in normal and pathological conditions, examining sound representation from behavioral to molecular levels.
summary_zh: 研究听觉电路在正常和病理条件下的功能，从行为到分子水平研究声音的表征。

name: Ximena Bernal
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how natural enemies influence animal communication systems and human impacts on these networks, focusing on frogs and their predators.
summary_zh: 研究自然天敌如何影响动物的交流系统及其人类活动对这些网络的影响，重点关注蛙类及其捕食者。

name: Alexander Chubykin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how neuromodulatory systems affect visual perception circuits using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and mouse models.
summary_zh: 研究神经调质系统如何影响视觉感知回路，使用光遗传学、电生理学和小鼠模型。

name: Laura Claxton
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants learn to balance and the impact of object interactions on their gait and posture, using observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何学习平衡以及物体交互对其步态和姿势的影响，使用观察方法。

name: Ulrike Dydak
title: Professor, School of Health Sciences
areas: Neuroimaging of Manganese Toxicity in Humans
summary: Studies manganese toxicity in humans using MRI and MRS techniques to measure neurochemical changes and brain dynamics.
summary_zh: 研究人类锰中毒的认知神经科学方法，使用MRI和MRS技术测量神经化学变化和大脑动态。

name: Esteban Fernandez-Juricic
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the co-evolution of avian visual system properties with behaviors and human-wildlife interactions in protected areas.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类视觉系统属性与行为之间的共进化以及在保护区的人类-野生动物互动。

name: Alexander Francis
title: Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how listening effort affects cognitive engagement and health in older adults, using psychophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究听力努力如何影响老年人的认知参与和健康，使用生理心理测量方法。

name: Jennifer Freeman
title: Professor, School of Health Sciences
areas: Developmental origin of health and disease (DOHaD
summary: Studies the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of toxicity from environmental stressors in developmental neurotoxicity and neurodegenerative diseases using zebrafish models.
summary_zh: 研究环境应激因素在发育神经毒性和神经退行性疾病中的遗传和表观遗传机制，使用斑马鱼模型进行研究。

name: Elliot Friedman
title: William and Sally Berner Hanley Professor of Gerontology, Department of Human Development and Family Science
summary: Studies biological processes related to health and well-being in aging adults, focusing on inflammation and sleep.
summary_zh: 研究与健康和福祉相关的生物学过程在老年人中的作用，重点关注炎症和睡眠。

name: Stephanie Gardner
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how undergraduate students learn and apply scientific reasoning and graphing skills in biology through active experimentation and visualization methods.
summary_zh: 研究本科生在生物学中通过主动实验和可视化方法学习和应用科学推理和绘图技能。

name: Joaquin Goni
title: Juan Ernesto de Bedout Rising Star Associate Professor, Edwardson School of Industrial Engineering
summary: Studies complex systems, graph theory, and neuroimaging to understand brain connectomics.
summary_zh: 研究复杂系统、图论和神经成像以理解大脑连接组学。

name: Jeffrey Haddad
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies changes in postural stability and manual control across the lifespan, using non-linear dynamics and analytical techniques.
summary_zh: 研究不同年龄段的姿势稳定性和手动控制的变化，使用非线性动力学和分析技术。

name: Michael Heinz
title: Professor, Interim Head, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
areas: models of auditory signal processing and perception
summary: Studies the neural correlates of normal and impaired auditory perception, using neurophysiology, computational modeling, and psychoacoustics.
summary_zh: 研究正常和受损听觉感知的神经相关性，使用神经生理学、计算建模和听觉生理学方法。

name: Fang Huang
title: Reilly Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mary Jo and Robert L. Kirk Director
summary: Studies neural networks and machine learning, focusing on computational neuroscience and brain-inspired algorithms.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络和机器学习，专注于计算神经科学和脑启发算法。

name: Afshin Izadian
title: Faculty
summary: Studies optical neuromodulation using nanoparticles and quantum dots to develop injectable artificial photoreceptors for vision restoration.
summary_zh: 研究光神经调控技术，使用纳米颗粒和量子点开发可注射的人工视网膜，用于恢复视力。

name: Natalya Kaganovich
title: Associate Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how children combine auditory and visual information, focusing on multisensory processing in speech perception and its role in developmental language disorders.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何结合听觉和视觉信息，特别是在语音感知中的多感官处理及其在发育性语言障碍中的作用。

name: David Kemmerer
title: Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how people’s knowledge of word meanings is implemented in the brain, focusing on semantics, grammar, perception, and action.
summary_zh: 研究单词意义知识在大脑中的实现方式，重点在于语义学、语法、知觉和动作之间的关系。

name: Patrick Kerstein
title: Assistant Professor, School of Health Sciences
summary: Studies the genetic and molecular factors that define neuronal cell types and connectivity in the visual system, and how gene-environment interactions disrupt normal nervous system development during.
summary_zh: 研究视觉系统中神经元细胞类型和连接性的遗传和分子因素，以及基因-环境相互作用如何在眼内毒物暴露期间扰乱正常神经系统发育。

name: Kwang Seob Kim
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies stuttering and sensorimotor learning in speech motor control using computational models.
summary_zh: 研究口吃和运动学习在言语运动控制中的作用，使用计算模型方法。

name: Arianna Lacroix
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how language and cognition interact in individuals with brain injuries, using fMRI and eye-tracking to improve communication abilities.
summary_zh: 研究语言和认知在脑损伤个体中的相互作用，使用功能性磁共振成像和眼动追踪技术以提高沟通能力。

name: Hongmi Lee
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how the human brain stores and recalls memories for naturalistic experiences, using behavioral experiments and functional magnetic resonance imaging.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何存储和回忆自然经历的记忆，使用行为实验和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Ji Yeon Lee
title: Associate Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies aphasia rehabilitation and age-related communication disorders using implicit structural priming and sentence production tasks.
summary_zh: 研究失语症康复和与年龄相关的交流障碍，使用隐性结构 priming 和 句子生成 任务。

name: Laurence Leonard
title: Distinguished Professor, Rachel E. Stark Distinguished Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies the nature of childhood language disorders, focusing on grammatical symptoms and word learning interventions.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言障碍的本质，重点关注语法症状和词汇学习干预。

name: Maria Makin
title: Assistant Professor of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies how animals learn to use new sensory information for movement, applying this to neural prostheses for recovery from injury.
summary_zh: 研究动物如何利用新感觉信息进行运动学习，并将其应用于神经假体以促进损伤恢复。

name: Kristine Marceau
title: Professor, Department of Human Development and Family Science
summary: Studies gene-environment interplay and its effects on behavior and substance use across development, using longitudinal and twin designs.
summary_zh: 研究基因-环境交互作用及其对行为和物质使用在发展过程中的影响，使用纵向和双生子设计。

name: Rebecca Marks
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Human Development and Family Science
summary: Studies how language development supports reading acquisition in children, using fMRI and fNIRS to examine word processing and reading development.
summary_zh: 研究语言发展如何支持儿童的阅读习得，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和功能性近红外光谱(fNIRS)来考察单词处理和阅读发展。

name: Richard Mattes
title: Distinguished Professor, Department of Nutrition Science, Department of Public Health
summary: Studies how taste, appetite, and food intake influence energy balance and cephalic phase responses in humans.
summary_zh: 研究味觉、食欲和食物摄入如何影响能量平衡以及人类的头期胰岛素反应。

name: Rebecca McNally Keehn
title: Associate Professor of Pediatrics
summary: Develops and evaluates service models to improve equitable access to autism diagnosis and care in minoritized and resource-constrained communities.
summary_zh: 开发和评估服务模型，以提高对少数族裔和资源匮乏社区自闭症诊断和护理的公平可及性。

name: Jane Mondul
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
areas: Physiological and behavioral measures of hearing in noise
summary: Studies the effects of noise on hearing, focusing on olivocochlear efferent systems and hearing-in-noise abilities in both humans and animals.
summary_zh: 研究噪声对听觉的影响，重点关注橄榄-耳蜗外周系统和噪声环境下的听觉能力，涉及人类和动物模型。

name: Niwako Ogata
title: Associate Professor, Animal Behavior
areas: Pursuing mental health and well being in companion animals
Translational research between human psychiatric field
summary: Studies mental health and well-being in companion animals, translating findings to human psychiatric research.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣动物的心理健康和福祉，并将其发现应用于人类精神医学研究。

name: Brandon Pitts
title: Dr. Brandon Pitts is an Elliot Sigal Rising Star Associate Professor at Purdue University.
summary: Studies how aging affects attention and information processing in multimodal displays, using engineering methods.
summary_zh: 研究老化对多模态显示中注意力和信息处理的影响，使用工程方法。

name: Thomas Redick
title: Professor, Department of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies working memory, investigating individual differences, cognitive interventions, and augmented reality technology.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆，探索个体差异、认知干预和增强现实技术。

name: Jenna Rickus
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Shirley Rietdyk
title: Professor
summary: Studies the interaction between neural and mechanical systems in mobility, posture, and balance, focusing on how the nervous system integrates sensory information to prevent trips and falls.
summary_zh: 研究神经和机械系统在移动、姿势和平衡中的相互作用，重点在于神经系统如何整合感官信息以防止绊倒和跌倒。

name: Allison Schaser
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies protein aggregation in mouse models of Parkinson disease and Dementia with Lewy Bodies using advanced imaging tools.
summary_zh: 使用先进的成像工具研究帕金森病和路易体痴呆的小鼠模型中的蛋白质聚集。

name: A.J. Schwichtenberg
title: Associate Professor, Department of Human Development and Family Science
summary: Studies how sleep and biosocial processes are developmentally consequential for children and families, focusing on neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative disorders.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和生物社会过程对儿童和家庭发展的意义，重点关注神经发育和神经退行性疾病。

name: Anne Sereno
title: Professor, Department of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the physiological mechanisms of attention, short-term memory, and eye movements to diagnose and treat related disorders.
summary_zh: 研究注意、短期记忆和眼球运动的生理机制，以诊断和治疗相关障碍。

name: Maureen Shader
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies auditory perception and cortical processing in adults with cochlear implants using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).
summary_zh: 研究植入人工耳蜗成人的听觉感知和皮层处理，使用功能性近红外光谱成像（fNIRS）技术。

name: Riyi Shi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经影像技术。

name: Jeffrey Siskind
title: Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering
summary: Studies artificial intelligence and computational linguistics, focusing on machine vision and child language acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能和计算语言学，专注于机器视觉和儿童语言习得。

name: Susie Swithers
title: Professor, Department of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies how lifestyle factors affect health and longevity, focusing on behavior and development.
summary_zh: 研究生活方式因素如何影响健康和长寿，重点关注行为和发展。

name: Robbee Wedow
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

name: Ellen Wells
title: Professor, Department of Public Health, School of Health Sciences
summary: Studies the development of health and wellness, focusing on environmental and occupational health.
summary_zh: 研究发展健康和福祉，重点关注环境和职业健康。

name: Ronnie Wilbur
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

name: Howard Zelaznik
title: Professor, Department of Health and Kinesiology
summary: Studies how movement timing and learning affect healthy lifestyles and longevity.

summary: Studies the affective basis of psychopathology and the development of language and literacy skills in preschool children, examining their interplay with self-regulation and social development.
summary_zh: 研究情绪对心理障碍发展的影响以及学龄前儿童语言和阅读技能的发展，探讨这些技能与自我调节和社会发展之间的相互作用。

name: Rick Macatee
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies co-occurring mood/anxiety and substance use disorders, particularly cannabis use disorder, using EEG/ERP methods and digital technology for assessment and treatment.
summary_zh: 研究共病情绪/焦虑障碍和物质使用障碍，特别是大麻使用障碍，使用EEG/ERP方法和数字技术进行评估和治疗。

name: Heath M. Maranges
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies factors that facilitate cooperation and moral decision-making, including developmental environments, traits, and perceptual processes.
summary_zh: 研究促进合作和道德决策的因素，包括发展环境、特质和知觉过程。

name: David S. March
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how automatic processes shape social perception and response to threat, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and virtual reality.
summary_zh: 研究自动过程如何塑造人们对威胁的社会感知和反应，使用行为实验、计算建模和虚拟现实技术。

name: Chris Martin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of human memory using fMRI, EEG, eye tracking, and cognitive behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的认知和神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）、眼动追踪和认知行为实验。

name: Jim McNulty
title: Professor
summary: Studies how strong beliefs in close relationships change or remain stable over time, focusing on marital satisfaction and forgiveness.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中强烈信念的变化或稳定性，重点关注婚姻满意度和原谅。

name: Andrea Meltzer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how personal qualities and intimate relationships influence each other, using evolutionary and longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究个人特质和亲密关系如何相互影响，采用进化论和纵向研究方法。

name: Andrew Moberly
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes sensory information in real time using in vivo calcium imaging in mice.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何实时处理感官信息，使用小鼠体内钙成像技术。

name: Derek Nee
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive control and working memory using fMRI and TMS, examining how the prefrontal cortex guides behavior and the role of sub-cortical areas.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)和经颅磁刺激(TMS)研究认知控制和工作记忆的神经机制，探讨前额叶皮层如何引导行为以及下皮层区域的作用。

name: Tehila Nugiel
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain function in children with learning challenges and ADHD using fMRI and network science to improve academic and mental health outcomes.
summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像和网络科学研究患有学习障碍和 ADHD 的儿童的大脑功能，以改善学业和心理健康结果。

name: Irmak Olcaysoy Okten
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people form and update implicit and explicit impressions and beliefs, focusing on the role of motivational factors like reducing uncertainty and preserving ideological convictions.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何形成和更新显性和隐性的印象和信念，重点关注减少不确定性动机和维护意识形态信念的作用。

name: Ashby Plant
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people's motivations affect intergroup attitudes, emotions, and behavior, focusing on reducing intergroup tension.
summary_zh: 研究动机如何影响群体态度、情绪和行为，以减少群体间的紧张关系。

name: Justin Riddle
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how electrical brain activity supports cognitive control and its disruption in psychiatric illness, using EEG, fMRI, TMS, and tACS.
summary_zh: 研究大脑电活动如何支持认知控制及其在精神疾病中的中断，使用EEG、fMRI、TMS和tACS。

name: Alireza Salami
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive decline in aging, focusing on episodic memory, using fMRI and PET.
summary_zh: 研究衰老过程中认知衰退的神经机制，重点是情景记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像和正电子发射断层扫描。

name: Chris Schatschneider
title: Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in reading skill development, identifying at-risk children and using statistical methods like hierarchical linear modeling.
summary_zh: 研究阅读技能发展的个体差异，识别有阅读障碍风险的儿童，并使用分层线性建模等统计方法。

name: James Sullivan
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches undergraduate psychology courses.
summary_zh: 教授本科心理学课程。

name: Carmen Varela
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cellular and network mechanisms of thalamic cells and their role in learning and memory, particularly during sleep.
summary_zh: 研究丘脑细胞和网络机制及其在学习和记忆中的作用，特别是在睡眠过程中的作用。

name: Rick Wagner
title: Robert O. Lawton Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies dyslexia and reading acquisition, focusing on assessment and cognitive foundations.
summary_zh: 研究阅读障碍和阅读获得，重点关注评估和认知基础。

name: Aaron Wilber
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain network for spatial learning and memory is altered by mental disorders and age-related cognitive disorders, using rodent models and behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究与空间学习和记忆相关的脑网络如何因精神疾病和年龄相关认知障碍而改变，使用啮齿动物模型和行为任务。

name: Tonya Dodge
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies how physical activity influences attitudes and decisions related to substance use, and the origins of attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究体育活动如何影响与物质使用相关的态度和决策，以及态度的起源。

name: Stephen C Dopkins
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies how humans mentally represent and negotiate physical space, and recognize objects based on past encounters, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过认知神经科学方法在心理上表示和协商物理空间，以及基于过去的经验识别物体。

name: Dwight Kravitz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies the relationship between neuroanatomy, experience, and neural representations in visual object recognition, working memory, and patient populations using fMRI and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究神经解剖学、经验与神经表征之间的关系，特别是在视觉物体识别、工作记忆和患者群体中的应用，使用功能性磁共振成像和行为学方法。

name: Stephen Mitroff
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies visual cognition, focusing on individual differences in perception, memory, and attention, using smartphone apps and other tools with various participant groups.
summary_zh: 研究视觉认知，关注感知、记忆和注意力方面的个体差异，使用智能手机应用程序和其他工具，涉及不同参与者群体。

name: Phillip J Moore
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Applied Social Psychology
summary: Studies how psychological, environmental, and biological factors influence health-related decisions and behaviors, focusing on obesity and stress.
summary_zh: 研究心理、环境和生物学因素如何影响健康相关决策和行为，重点关注肥胖和压力。

name: John W Philbeck
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies how vision helps determine location and remains oriented during movement, using people of various ages and those with brain injuries.
summary_zh: 研究视觉如何帮助确定位置并在移动中保持定向，使用不同年龄段的人和脑损伤个体作为研究对象。

name: Gabriela Rosenblau
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies social learning mechanisms during adolescence and adulthood using computational modeling, aiming to improve clinical treatments.
summary_zh: 研究青春期和成年期的社会学习机制，使用计算神经科学方法，旨在改善临床治疗效果。

name: Sarah Shomstein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies the psychological and neural mechanisms of attentional selection using behavioral paradigms, eye tracking, and functional neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究注意选择的心理学和神经机制，使用行为范式、眼动追踪和功能性神经成像方法。

name: Carol Sigelman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Applied Social Psychology
summary: Studies the development of social cognition and stigmatization in children and adolescents, and parent-child communication during military deployments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年的社会认知和污名化发展以及军事部署期间的亲子沟通。

name: Myeong-Ho Sohn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Neuroscience
summary: Studies cognitive control processes, including conflict detection, interference from past experiences, and individual differences in cognitive capacity.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制过程，包括冲突检测、过去经验的干扰以及认知能力的个体差异。

name: Michelle Stock
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Applied Social Psychology
summary: Studies risky health behaviors, including substance use and UV exposure, using dual-processing models and social comparison.
summary_zh: 研究健康风险行为，如物质使用和紫外线暴露，使用双加工模型和社会比较理论。

name: Ellen Yeung
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Applied Social Psychology
summary: Studies the risk and resilience factors of addiction and chronic pain, examining genetic, social, and environmental influences across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾和慢性疼痛的风险和韧性因素，考察遗传、社会和环境影响的跨生命周期机制。

name: Joanne Davila
title: Distinguished Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies romantic relationships and sexual communication among sexual and gender minority adolescents and adults, using daily diary and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究性少数青少年和成年人的恋爱关系和性沟通，使用日常日记和观察方法。

name: Candice Alfano
title: Professor
areas: The role of sleep in the development
Childhood adverse experiences and interpersonal trauma
summary: Studies the role of sleep in emotional and behavioral outcomes in children, developing interventions for trauma and foster care.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠在儿童情绪和行为结果中的作用，开发针对创伤和寄养儿童的干预措施。

name: Kristin Bernard
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of early life stress on children’s neurobiological and behavioral development, and the role of sensitive caregiving in preventing maladaptive outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力对儿童神经生物学和行为发展的影响，以及敏感养育在预防不良结果中的作用。

name: Julian Burger
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops new methods for personalizing psychotherapy using network analysis and computational approaches, focusing on LGBTQ individuals.
summary_zh: 开发个性化心理治疗的新方法，利用网络分析和计算建模技术，重点关注LGBTQ群体。

name: Lu Dong
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how sleep affects mental health outcomes among underserved populations, focusing on stigma, discrimination, and neighborhood environments.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠如何影响边缘化群体的心理健康结果，重点关注污名、歧视和社区环境。

name: Nicholas Eaton
title: Professor
summary: Studies psychopathology, comorbidity, and mental health disparities, using AI and psychometrics.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍、共病和心理健康差异，使用人工智能和心理测量学方法。

name: Daniel Klein
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the development and course of mood disorders in children and adults, focusing on early temperament and emotional reactivity.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人情绪障碍的发展和病程，重点关注早期情绪反应和气质。

name: Briana Last
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the social determinants of mental health and the implementation of mental health services, using mixed methods and policy research.
summary_zh: 研究心理健康的社会决定因素以及心理健康服务的实施，使用混合方法和政策研究。

name: Aprajita Mohanty
title: Faculty
areas: Impact of emotion on perception and attention
Transdiagnostic neural markers of psychotic disorders
summary: Studies how the brain predicts and processes emotional stimuli, using fMRI and cognitive behavioral tasks to understand anxiety and attention.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何预测和处理情绪刺激，使用功能性磁共振成像和认知行为任务来理解焦虑和注意力。

name: Brady Nelson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cognitive, emotional, and motivational mechanisms of anxiety disorders and depression, using psychophysiological and neuroimaging methods in child, adolescent, and adult populations.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和抑郁障碍的认知、情绪和动机机制，使用心理生理学和神经影像学方法在儿童、青少年和成人中进行研究。

name: Brenda Anderson
title: Professor
summary: Studies how exercise and stress affect the brain, using behavioral and neuroanatomical methods.
summary_zh: 研究运动和压力对大脑的影响，使用行为和神经解剖学方法。

name: Turhan Canli
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of loneliness in cognitive decline and financial decision-making, using gene expression analysis and functional MRI.
summary_zh: 研究孤独感对认知衰退和财务决策的影响，使用基因表达分析和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Hoi-Chung Leung
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of cognitive processes, particularly visual-spatial working memory and prefrontal cortex function using fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程的神经基础，特别是视觉-空间工作记忆和前额叶皮层的功能，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Ryan Parsons
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of fear learning and memory consolidation using Pavlovian fear conditioning in rats.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧学习和记忆巩固的神经生物学机制，使用大鼠的经典条件恐惧学习模型。

name: Naftali Raz
title: Faculty
summary: Studies individual differences in cognitive aging, focusing on brain changes and risk factors in older adults without dementia.
summary_zh: 研究老年人认知老化中的个体差异，关注无痴呆老年人的大脑变化和风险因素。

name: Susan Brennan
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the psychology of language use in interactive spoken dialogue, using eye-tracking to measure language processing and nonverbal communication.
summary_zh: 研究语言使用中的心理过程，特别是在互动口语对话中，使用眼动追踪来衡量语言处理和非言语交流。

name: Cameron Jones
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the similarities and differences between humans and AI systems, how people interact with AI, and the long-term psychological impacts of AI.
summary_zh: 研究人类与人工智能系统之间的相似性和差异性，人们如何与人工智能互动以及人工智能对人类心理的长期影响。

name: Sahil Luthra
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how speech perception and cognition interact, using behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究语言感知与认知之间的交互作用，使用行为实验、计算建模和神经成像方法。

name: Suparna Rajaram
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how social interactions affect memory accuracy and the emergence of collective memory, using collaborative recall experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响记忆准确性以及集体记忆的形成，使用协作回忆实验。

name: Lauren Richmond
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies everyday cognition and working memory in younger and older adults, developing interventions to improve daily functioning.
summary_zh: 研究日常认知和工作记忆在年轻和老年成人中的差异，开发提高日常功能的干预措施。

name: Gregory Zelinsky
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual cognition, visual search, and eye movements using cognitive, computational, and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究视觉认知、视觉搜索和眼动，使用认知、计算和神经成像技术。

name: Antonio Freitas
title: Associate Professor, Co-Director of Social and Health Program
summary: Studies how motivation and cognitive control interact to influence social behavior, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究动机与认知控制的相互作用如何影响社会行为，采用多种实验方法。

name: Sheri Levy
title: Professor
summary: Studies the interrelated topics of ableism, ageism, aging, climate change, and mental health using a multi-method approach including experiments, surveys, and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究残疾人歧视、年龄歧视、老龄化、气候变化和心理健康，采用实验、调查和干预等多种方法。

name: Marci Lobel
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies stress, coping, and their effects on reproductive health, particularly prenatal maternal stress and its impact on birth outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究压力、应对策略及其对生殖健康的影响，特别是孕期压力对分娩结果的影响。

name: Stacey Scott
title: Professor
summary: Studies stress, emotions, and health across the lifespan using longitudinal and intensive measurement designs.
summary_zh: 研究生命历程中的压力、情绪与健康，采用纵向和密集测量设计。

name: Andrea Pittarello
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychological and social factors influencing donation behavior and workplace harassment perceptions, using real-world data and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究捐赠行为和社会因素以及职场骚扰感知的心理学和社会学因素，使用实地数据和实验方法。

name: Margaret Echelbarger
title: Assistant Professor (Marketing)
summary: Studies consumer behavior and decision-making processes in marketing.
summary_zh: 研究消费者行为和营销中的决策过程。

name: Katherine Jonas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点在于记忆和注意力。

name: Brittain Mahaffey
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Heidi Preis
title: Assistant Professor of Research
summary: Studies the cognitive processes involved in decision-making during pregnancy, using behavioral experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究妊娠期间决策的认知过程，使用行为实验和问卷调查的方法。

name: James E. Swain
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Jared Van Snellenberg
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Arthur Aron
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how shared activities enhance relationship quality and the neural circuits involved in close relationships.
summary_zh: 研究共同活动如何增强人际关系质量及其相关神经回路的作用。

name: Arthur Samuel
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how humans process spoken language, focusing on word recognition and the role of time in perceptual processing.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何处理口语，重点在于单词识别以及时间在感知处理中的作用。

name: Ying-Wan Lam
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Brian Albanese
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of anxiety and suicide risk using event-related potentials and ecological momentary assessments.
summary_zh: 使用事件相关电位和生态时刻评估研究焦虑和自杀风险的认知神经机制。

name: Gerianne Alexander
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of human sex differences in social and cognitive behavior, focusing on hormonal influences.
summary_zh: 研究人类性别差异在社会和认知行为的发展，关注激素的影响。

name: Brian Anderson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how learning changes attentional control, using psychophysics and neuroimaging to explore distraction, habit learning, and drug addiction.
summary_zh: 研究学习如何改变注意力控制，使用心理物理学和神经成像方法探索分心、习惯学习和药物成瘾。

name: Winfred Arthur
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies personnel psychology, focusing on testing, assessment, and validation of selection methods, as well as individual and team training for complex skill acquisition.
summary_zh: 研究人事心理学，侧重于选拔方法的测试、评估和验证，以及复杂技能获取和保留的个体与团队培训。

name: Mayson Astle
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Instructional Assistant Professor
summary: Studies self, choice, and memory in social contexts.
summary_zh: 研究自我、选择和记忆在社会中的作用。

name: Bisi Atoba
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Instructional Associate Professor
summary: Studies employee well-being and optimal organizational performance through work teams, leadership, and training.
summary_zh: 研究员工福祉和组织绩效优化，通过工作团队、领导力和培训。

name: Mindy Bergman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of organizational climate on workplace behaviors and individual well-being, focusing on diversity and safety.
summary_zh: 研究组织气候对工作行为和个体福祉的影响，重点关注多样性和安全。

name: Jessica Bernard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Dean of Research, Professor, Ella McFadden Endowed Professorship in Liberal Arts, APS Fellow
summary: Studies how cognitive and motor behavior changes with age, focusing on mild cognitive impairment and the cerebellum.
summary_zh: 研究随年龄变化的认知和运动行为，重点关注轻度认知障碍和小脑。

name: Carlos Bolaños
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Investigates how early-life exposure to drugs and stress alters brain biochemistry and behavior, affecting mood and motivation later in life.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活经历对药物和压力暴露如何改变大脑生物化学和行为的影响，特别是在情绪和动机方面的长期效应。

name: Rebecca Brooker
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, APS Fellow
areas: Neurodevelopmental Correlates of Risk for Psychopathology
summary: Studies emotional and biological risk factors for anxiety in early life, using neurodevelopmental and gene-environment interaction approaches.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活中的情绪和生物风险因素对焦虑的影响，采用神经发展和基因-环境交互作用的方法。

name: Ivette Calles-Ramirez
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Instructional Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms involved in learning and memory, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的认知过程和脑机制，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Yifeng Cheng
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how brain regions communicate to support flexible decision-making and learning, using behavioral tasks and neural recordings.
summary_zh: 研究大脑区域如何交流以支持灵活的决策和学习，使用行为任务和神经记录方法。

name: Pamela Stanush Edens
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Instructional Associate Professor
summary: Teaches courses in psychology, focusing on human sexuality, organizational psychology, and career guidance.
summary_zh: 教授心理学课程，包括性心理学、组织心理学和职业指导。

name: John Edens
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the assessment and management of violence risk, particularly in forensic and correctional settings, focusing on psychopathy and personality measurement.
summary_zh: 研究犯罪和矫正环境中暴力风险的评估与管理，特别是心理病态和人格测量。

name: Megan Edwards
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the role of hope and awe in promoting human flourishing and meaning in life, especially after adversity.
summary_zh: 研究希望和敬畏在促进人类繁荣和生活意义中的作用，尤其是在经历逆境之后。

name: Shoshana Eitan
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the biological mechanisms of mental and neurological disorders, focusing on dietary and microbial modulators for depression, anxiety, and Parkinson’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究精神和神经疾病的基本机制，重点关注饮食和微生物调节剂对抑郁症、焦虑症和帕金森病的影响。

name: Sherecce Fields
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies behavioral decision-making, impulsivity, and its role in health risk behaviors and addictive behaviors in children and adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究行为决策、冲动性及其在健康风险行为和青少年成瘾行为中的作用。

name: Leland Fleming
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how psychological stress and early-life trauma affect brain development and aging using neuroimaging and epigenetics.
summary_zh: 研究心理压力和早期生活创伤如何影响大脑发展和衰老，使用神经成像和表观遗传学方法。

name: James Grau
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Mary Tucker Currie Professor, APA & APS Fellow
areas: the recovery of function after neural injury
summary: Studies how the spinal cord can learn and recover function after injury, focusing on pain modulation and neural plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究脊髓在损伤后的学习和功能恢复机制，重点关注疼痛调节和神经可塑性。

name: Joshua Hicks
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people find meaning in life and how this influences their attitudes and behaviors, using hypotheses related to existential concerns.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在生活中寻找意义及其对态度和行为的影响，关注存在主义关切的相关假设。

name: Daniel Howard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies health outcomes and disparities among African Americans, using health services and policy research.
summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人健康结果和差异，使用健康服务和政策研究方法。

name: Ian Hughes
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impacts of interpersonal exchanges on workers' well-being, including psychological, behavioral, emotional, and cognitive indicators.
summary_zh: 研究人际交流对员工福祉的影响，包括心理、行为、情绪和认知指标。

name: Heather Lench
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Senior Associate Vice President for Faculty Affairs, Professor, Interim Head of the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences
summary: Studies how emotions influence future thinking and decision-making, examining when emotions improve functioning.
summary_zh: 研究情绪如何影响对未来思维和决策的作用，探讨情绪在何种情况下改善功能。

name: Annmarie MacNamara
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies emotional responses and cognitive factors in psychiatric disorders using neuroimaging and psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究情绪反应和认知因素在精神疾病中的作用，使用神经成像和生理学方法。

name: Vani Mathur
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the sources of disparities in pain, focusing on how social and cultural factors influence pain experience and physiology.
summary_zh: 研究疼痛差异的来源，重点关注社会和文化因素如何影响疼痛体验和生理学。

name: Allegra Midgette
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children and families develop moral and caring behaviors, focusing on justice within and outside the family.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和家庭如何发展道德和关怀行为，重点关注家庭内外的正义感。

name: Yumiko Mochinushi
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Instructional Associate Professor
summary: Studies industrial-organizational psychology, focusing on workplace behavior and performance.
summary_zh: 研究工业组织心理学，关注工作场所的行为和绩效。

name: Justin Moscarello
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
areas: Neural pathways of learning and memory
Active avoidance behavior and aversively motivated action
summary: Studies the neural pathways of learning and memory, focusing on how different types of memory compete to influence behavior, using active avoidance behavior as a model.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经通路，关注不同类型记忆如何竞争影响行为，使用主动回避行为作为模型。

name: Joseph Orr
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychological and neural mechanisms of executive functions, focusing on task-switching and voluntary task selection, using behavioral, computational, and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究执行功能的心理学和神经机制，重点关注任务切换和自愿任务选择，使用行为、计算和神经成像方法。

name: Stephanie C. Payne
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences affect human resource practices and organizational safety initiatives.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异如何影响人力资源实践和组织安全倡议。

name: Rebecca Schlegel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Associate Head of UG Studies and Programs, APS Fellow, SPSP Fellow
summary: Studies the true self, well-being, and meaning in life, exploring authenticity and self-integrity.
summary_zh: 研究真正的自我、幸福感和生命意义，探讨真实性和自我完整性。

name: Brandon Schmeichel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies self-control, emotion regulation, and working memory, exploring how these processes influence decision-making and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究自我控制、情绪调节和工作记忆，探讨这些过程如何影响决策和行为。

name: Rachel Smallman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how counterfactual thinking influences decision-making and categorization, integrating social and cognitive methodology.
summary_zh: 研究反事实思维如何影响决策和分类过程，结合社会认知方法论。

name: Rachel Smith
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of drug addiction and relapse using animal models, focusing on compulsive behaviors and maladaptive habits.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和复燃的神经机制，使用动物模型探讨强迫行为和适应不良习惯。

name: Sebastian Speer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how minds become coupled during interactions, using fMRI hyperscanning and computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究互动过程中人类和人工心智如何耦合，使用功能性磁共振成像超扫描和计算建模方法。

name: Rongxiang Tang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain supports higher-order cognitive functions like attention and memory in young and older adults, using neuroimaging and cognitive assessments.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何支持注意力和记忆等高级认知功能，使用神经成像和认知评估方法，涵盖从年轻到老年各年龄段。

name: Zina Trost
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive, affective, and behavioral factors contributing to chronic pain and disability, using virtual reality interventions and examining perceptions of injustice.
summary_zh: 研究认知、情感和行为因素对慢性疼痛和残疾的影响，使用虚拟现实干预措施并探讨不公正感知。

name: Jyotsna Vaid
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
areas: Gender and race in psychological inquiry
summary: Studies cognitive and neurocognitive aspects of bilingualism, reading processes, and directional biases in spatial cognition.
summary_zh: 研究双语认知和神经认知方面、阅读过程以及空间认知中的方向偏差。

name: Matthew Vess
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how existential concerns like personal identity and meaning impact psychological processes, using social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究存在主义关切（如个人身份和意义）对心理过程的影响，采用社会心理学方法。

name: Zak Witkower
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies nonverbal communication, particularly how body movements convey social rank, emotion, and personality, using advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究非言语交流，特别是身体动作如何传达社会地位、情绪和个性，并使用先进的定量方法。

name: Darrell Worthy
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes like learning and decision-making using behavioral methods, computational modeling, and fMRI, with a focus on individual differences and aging.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程如学习和决策，使用行为方法、计算建模和fMRI，关注个体差异和老化。

name: Amanda J. Wright
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how personality changes and develops across the lifespan, using various analytic methods and data sources.
summary_zh: 研究人格在一生中的变化和发展，使用多种分析方法和数据来源。

name: Takashi Yamauchi
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how emotions and unconscious processing influence behavior, using computational models and mouse-tracking techniques.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和无意识处理如何影响行为，使用计算模型和鼠标追踪技术。

name: Mia Zhu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies employee well-being and recovery from work stress using interventions like cognitive reappraisal and just-in-time adaptive interventions.
summary_zh: 研究员工福祉和工作压力恢复，使用认知重评和即时适应性干预等方法。

name: Outreach Pro
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿通过社会线索学习单词的认知过程，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: John Buchanan
title: Professor, Department of Health and Kinesiology
summary: Studies motor neuroscience, focusing on motor control and learning in humans and animals.
summary_zh: 研究运动神经科学，专注于人类和动物的运动控制与学习。

name: Wei-Jung A. Chen
title: Professor, Department of Neuroscience and Experimental Therapeutics
summary: Studies the effects of substance abuse on the developing brain, including polydrug interactions and fetal alcohol syndrome, using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究物质滥用对发育中大脑的影响，包括多药交互作用和胎儿酒精综合症，使用动物模型进行研究。

name: Yoonsuck Choe
title: Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
areas: Multi-scale modeling of mouse brain networks project
summary: Studies brain networks and neural intelligence using computational models and simulations, focusing on mouse brain networks and cortical maps.
summary_zh: 研究大脑网络和神经智能，使用计算模型和模拟，重点关注小鼠大脑网络和皮层图谱。

name: Dustin Dubois
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Neuroscience & Experimental Therapeutics
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of neuropsychopharmacological agents and their effects on brain development and aging, using electrophysiology and optogenetic techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经精神药理学剂的细胞和分子机制及其对大脑发育和衰老的影响，使用电生理学和光遗传学技术。

name: Daniel Hajovsky
title: Associate Professor, Department of Educational Psychology
summary: Studies educational and school psychology, focusing on interventions and support systems for students.
summary_zh: 研究教育和学校心理学，侧重于学生干预和支持系统的评估与设计。

name: Stephen Maren
title: Professor and Claude H Everett, Jr '47 Chair of Liberal Arts, Department of Psychological & Brain Sciences
summary: Studies neural systems for emotion, learning, and memory, focusing on fear and anxiety in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、学习和记忆的神经机制，特别是在啮齿动物中的恐惧和焦虑。

name: Christine Merlin
title: Professor, Department of Biology
summary: Studies how monarch butterflies use circadian clocks for long-distance migration, focusing on gene function and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究 monarch 蝴蝶如何使用昼夜节律钟进行长距离迁徙，重点关注基因功能和行为机制。

name: Courtney N. Baker
title: Professor
summary: Studies the translation of effective prevention and intervention programs into community settings for children and families, using a community-engaged research approach.
summary_zh: 研究将有效的预防和干预项目转化为社区环境，服务于儿童和家庭，采用社区参与的研究方法。

name: Esther Calzada
title: Professor
summary: Studies parenting and early childhood development in Latinx and other minoritized families, focusing on reducing disparities in academic achievement and socio-emotional well-being.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔和其他少数族裔家庭的育儿和早期儿童发展，旨在减少学业成就和社会情绪问题方面的不平等。

name: Michael Cunningham
title: Professor
summary: Studies adolescent development, resilience and vulnerability in African American children and adolescents, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年发展，特别是在非洲裔美国儿童和青少年中的韧性和脆弱性，采用定性和定量方法。

name: Jill M. Daniel
title: Gary P. Dohanich Professor in Brain Science
summary: Studies how estrogens and androgens affect cognition across the lifespan in rodents, using behavioral, biochemical, and molecular methods.
summary_zh: 研究雌激素和雄激素在不同生命阶段对认知的影响，使用行为学、生物化学和分子方法在啮齿动物中进行实验。

name: Benjamin Deen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how we perceive and reason about other people, using fMRI and behavioral testing.
summary_zh: 研究我们如何感知和推理关于其他人的认知，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和行为测试。

name: Jonathan P. Fadok
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain controls emotional memory formation and expression using in vivo recordings and targeted manipulations in animals.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过特定神经环路控制情绪记忆的形成和表达，使用体内记录和功能操控方法。

name: Michael Hoerger
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how adults with cancer make healthcare decisions and manage quality of life, focusing on patient-provider communication and palliative care utilization.
summary_zh: 研究癌症患者在医疗决策和生活质量管理中的表现，重点关注患者与医生的沟通以及姑息性护理的利用。

name: Yo Jackson
title: Professor, Lila L. and Douglas J. Hertz Endowed Chair in Psychology
summary: Studies resilience in youth exposed to trauma, focusing on child maltreatment and intergenerational transmission using longitudinal and physiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究创伤暴露儿童的复原力，重点关注虐待和代际传递，使用纵向和生理学技术。

name: Julie Markant
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how developing attention control influences learning and how prior learning shapes attention in infants and young children, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究发展中的注意力控制如何影响学习以及先前学习如何塑造婴儿和幼儿的注意力，采用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Lisa Molix
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies intergroup relations and health/well-being among marginalized populations, using social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究群体关系和边缘化群体的健康/福祉，使用社会心理学方法。

name: Damian R. Murray
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of disease-avoidance motives on social attitudes and interpersonal relationships, including political beliefs and romantic relationships.
summary_zh: 研究疾病避免动机对社会态度和人际关系的影响，包括政治信念和浪漫关系。

name: Bonnie K. Nastasi
title: Professor
summary: Develops culturally relevant assessment and intervention approaches to promote psychological well-being and reduce health risks in children and adolescents, both domestically and internationally.
summary_zh: 开发适合不同文化背景的评估和干预方法，促进儿童和青少年的心理健康和减少健康风险，国内外均有涉及。

name: Laurie O'Brien
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people from high and low status groups perceive prejudice and its consequences, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究不同社会地位群体如何看待偏见及其后果，采用实验方法。

name: Stacy Overstreet
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of community violence and other traumatic experiences on children's psychosocial and academic functioning, identifying protective factors.
summary_zh: 研究社区暴力和其他创伤经历对儿童心理社会和学业功能的影响，并识别保护性因素。

name: Janet B. Ruscher
title: Professor
summary: Studies how stereotypes and prejudice are expressed through language and communication, focusing on metaphors and hate speech.
summary_zh: 研究语言和沟通中刻板印象和偏见的表达，重点关注隐喻和仇恨言论。

name: Selin Zeytinoglu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how real-world social experiences with caregivers and peers, along with children’s characteristics, contribute to social learning and emotional development.
summary_zh: 研究现实生活中与照顾者和同伴的社会互动以及儿童自身特征如何共同促进社会学习和情绪发展。

name: Mariana Acquarone
title: Assistant Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory in humans, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究人类学习和记忆的神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

name: Lydia Bazzano
title: Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in rodents, using behavioral tasks and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为任务和电生理学方法。

name: Dan Burnston
title: Associate Professor of Philosophy
summary: Explores philosophical questions about cognitive science, mind, and neuroscience, focusing on explanation and decomposition in complex systems.
summary_zh: 探讨认知科学、心灵和神经科学中的哲学问题，关注复杂系统中的解释和分解。

name: Matthew Dalva
title: Professor of Cell and Molecular Biology
summary: Studies synaptic development and function, focusing on the mechanisms underlying neural connectivity.
summary_zh: 研究突触的发育和功能，探讨神经连接的基础机制。

name: Harry Howard
title: Associate Professor of Spanish & Portuguese
summary: Develops computational models of language and cognition using principles of computational neuroscience and multi-agent systems.
summary_zh: 开发语言和认知的计算模型，使用计算神经科学和多代理系统的原理。

name: Michael J. Moore
title: Professor and Chair of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Develops in vitro models of neural growth, physiology, and disease using microscale tissue engineering and nanomaterials.
summary_zh: 开发体外模型以研究神经生长、生理和疾病，使用微尺度组织工程和纳米材料。

name: Ricardo Mostany
title: Professor of Pharmacology
summary: Studies how brain circuits change during normal functions and after injury, using imaging techniques in mice.
summary_zh: 研究大脑回路在正常功能和损伤后如何变化，使用成像技术在小鼠中进行研究。

name: Stephen Nelson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies genetic causes of epilepsy, treatment options for seizures, and molecular basis of developmental brain disorders.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫的遗传原因、难治性癫痫的治疗方法以及发育性脑障碍的分子基础。

name: Jeffrey Rouse
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior in forensic psychology, focusing on criminal behavior and mental health.
summary_zh: 研究行为的脑机制，特别是在犯罪心理学领域，关注犯罪行为和心理健康。

name: Laura Schrader
title: Professor and Chair of Cell and Molecular Biology
summary: Studies how ion channels regulate neuronal excitability and synaptic plasticity, using electrophysiology and molecular biology.
summary_zh: 研究离子通道如何调节神经元兴奋性和突触可塑性，使用电生理学和分子生物学技术。

name: Gregory W. Stewart
title: W. Kennon McWilliams Professor of Sports Medicine in Orthopaedics / Associate Professor, Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
summary: Studies sports concussions and disability prevention in athletes, focusing on management and long-term effects.
summary_zh: 研究运动员脑震荡和残疾预防，专注于管理与长期影响。

name: Yu-Ping Wang
title: Professor of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies brain cognition using multimodal fusion networks and interpretable machine learning techniques.
summary_zh: 使用多模态融合网络和可解释的机器学习技术研究大脑认知。

name: James E Zadina
title: Professor of Medicine, Pharmacology & Neuroscience
summary: Develops safer analgesics by modifying naturally occurring opioids, reducing side effects like tolerance and respiratory depression.
summary_zh: 开发更安全的镇痛药，通过修改天然存在的阿片类物质，减少如耐受性和呼吸抑制等副作用。

name: Mohammad Atari
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how culture shapes moral values and judgment, using computational methods and lab experiments.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何塑造道德价值观和判断，采用计算方法和实验室实验。

name: Lauren Aulet
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children represent and use spatial information to learn about numbers and physics, using behavioral and fMRI methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过空间信息来学习数字和物理知识，使用行为和功能性磁共振成像方法。

name: Joseph Bergan
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies behavioral neuroscience, focusing on the neural mechanisms underlying behavior.
summary_zh: 研究行为神经科学，关注行为背后的神经机制。

name: Nava Caluori
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how socio-ecological contexts shape individual psychology, including beliefs and intergroup attitudes, using multi-method approaches.
summary_zh: 研究社会-生态背景如何塑造个体心理，包括信念和群体态度，采用多方法研究。

name: Kelsey Canada
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in brain and memory development using behavioral measures, neuroimaging, and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异的脑和记忆发展，使用行为测量、神经成像和定量方法。

name: Kyle Cave
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Cognition and Cognitive Neuroscience Area Head
summary: Studies visual attention and object recognition, using eye-tracking to understand how attention is allocated during complex visual tasks.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意力和物体识别，使用眼动追踪来理解在复杂视觉任务中注意力是如何分配的。

name: Andrew Cohen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Associate Chair for Academic Affairs
summary: Studies reasoning, judgment, and decision-making using computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究推理、判断和决策制定，使用计算建模方法。

name: Daniel Coppersmith
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the dynamic factors and interventions for suicidal thoughts and behaviors using smartphones and biosensors.
summary_zh: 研究自杀念头和行为的动态因素及干预措施，使用智能手机和生物传感器。

name: Nilanjana Dasgupta
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of implicit biases on social evaluations and actions, and how these biases influence self-perceptions and career choices.
summary_zh: 研究隐性偏见对社会评价和行为的影响，以及这些偏见如何影响自我感知和职业选择。

name: Kirby Deater-Deckard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in social-emotional, behavioral, and cognitive development, focusing on parenting and families.
summary_zh: 研究个体在社会情感、行为和认知发展方面的差异，重点关注父母和家庭的作用。

name: Maria M. Galano
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of early-life exposure to interpersonal violence on mental health in diverse populations, focusing on family processes and structural inequities.
summary_zh: 研究早期经历人际暴力对不同群体心理健康的影响，重点关注家庭过程和结构性不平等。

name: Melinda Gonzales-Backen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Associate Chair of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
summary: Studies the well-being of Latino adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on cultural, contextual, and familial processes.
summary_zh: 研究拉丁裔青少年和成年早期个体的心理健康，重点关注文化、环境和家庭过程。

name: Adam Grabell
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotion regulation in early childhood, using neuroimaging and psychophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究幼儿情绪调节，采用神经成像和生理测量方法。

name: Linda Isbell
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Feldman-Vorwerk Family Professor in Social Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of affect on social cognition and judgment, particularly in medical decision-making and political psychology.
summary_zh: 研究情感对社会认知和判断的影响，特别是在医疗决策和政治心理学中的作用。

name: Alexandra Jesse
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Graduate Program Director
summary: Studies how humans recognize speech from hearing and seeing a speaker, using methods like eye tracking and event-related potentials.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过听觉和视觉识别语音，使用眼动追踪和事件相关电位等方法。

name: Ilia Karatsoreos
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies how environmental factors affect behavior and physiology, focusing on circadian rhythms and stress responses.
summary_zh: 研究环境因素如何影响行为和生理功能，重点关注昼夜节律和应激反应。

name: Youngbin Kwak
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how humans learn, adjust, and make decisions in new environments across the lifespan and in neurological diseases, using neuroimaging and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究人类在新环境中的学习、适应和决策行为及其随年龄变化和神经疾病的变化，使用神经影像学和生理测量方法。

name: Agnès Lacreuse
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive aging and women's health, focusing on neurocognitive aging in nonhuman primates and the effects of estrogens on brain and cognitive aging in females.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化和女性健康，重点关注非人灵长类动物的神经认知老化以及雌激素对女性大脑和认知老化的影响。

name: Brian Lickel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Social Psychology Area Head
summary: Studies how people's emotions and self-concepts influence support for social and political policies in intergroup conflicts, using cognitive and emotional processes.
summary_zh: 研究人们在群体间冲突中的情绪和自我概念如何影响对社会和政治政策的支持，通过认知和情绪过程进行分析。

name: Jennifer M. McDermott
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how early experience affects cognitive development and social outcomes in children, focusing on response monitoring and executive functions.
summary_zh: 研究早期经历对儿童认知发展和社会结果的影响，重点关注反应监控和执行功能。

name: Evelyn Mercado
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how close relationships affect mental health in ethnic minority families, focusing on stress, emotion dynamics, and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系如何影响少数民族家庭的心理健康，重点关注压力、情绪动态和生理指标。

name: David Moorman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Behavioral Neuroscience Area Head
summary: Studies how networks of neurons control complex behavior, using animal models and techniques like electrophysiology, cellular imaging, optogenetics, and pharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络如何控制复杂行为，使用动物模型和电生理学、细胞成像、光遗传学和药理学等技术。

name: Elsbeth Neil
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the psychological and social impacts of adoption, focusing on identity development and recovery in children who have experienced early adversity.
summary_zh: 研究收养的心理和社会影响，重点关注经历过早期逆境的儿童的身份发展和恢复。

name: Joonkoo Park
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor and Honors Faculty
summary: Studies how foundational cognitive abilities interact with developmental experiences to give rise to uniquely human knowledge, focusing on the acquisition and emergence of numerical concepts.
summary_zh: 研究基础认知能力与发展经验如何相互作用，产生人类独有的知识，重点关注数字概念的获取与涌现。

name: Jamie Parnes
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies psychosocial determinants of cannabis use among sexual and gender minoritized individuals, using self-report and longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究性少数群体中大麻使用的精神社会决定因素，采用自我报告和纵向方法。

name: Mariana Pereira
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of parenting, including limbic-cortical-striatal interactions and the mesocorticolimbic dopamine system, using animal models of depression and drug addiction.
summary_zh: 研究育儿的认知、动机和情感机制，包括边缘-皮层-纹状体相互作用和中皮层-边缘系统多巴胺系统，使用抑郁和药物成瘾的动物模型。

name: Benjamin Pitt
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how cultural, linguistic, and physical context shapes human thinking about fundamental concepts like space, time, and numbers, using behavioral experiments with diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究文化、语言和物理环境如何塑造人们对空间、时间及数字等基本概念的认知，通过跨文化人群的行为实验进行探索。

name: Rebecca Ready
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional skills and well-being in adults with high functioning Autism Spectrum Disorders, examining how they understand emotions.
summary_zh: 研究高功能自闭症成人的情感认知和情感福祉，探讨他们如何理解情绪。

name: Allecia Reid
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychological and social factors influencing health behaviors, using correlational and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究心理和社会因素对健康行为的影响，采用相关性和实验方法。

name: Luke Remage-Healey
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the nonclassical regulation of brain function and behavior by steroid hormones in songbirds using electrophysiology and neuropharmacology.
summary_zh: 研究类固醇激素对鸟类鸣叫行为的非经典调节作用，使用电生理学和神经药理学方法。

name: Heather Richardson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of stress and addiction, focusing on sex differences and adolescent development in rodents.
summary_zh: 研究压力和成瘾的神经生物学，重点关注啮齿动物中性别差异和青春期发展。

name: Lisa Sanders
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Developmental Science Area Head
summary: Studies speech processing in noise and its neural mechanisms, including ERP measures and attention allocation.
summary_zh: 研究噪声中语音处理及其神经机制，包括ERP测量和注意力分配。

name: Rebecca Spencer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies sleep function and measurement across the lifespan, focusing on relations between sleep and brain development, and age-related changes in sleep-dependent consolidation of motor learning.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠功能和测量在生命周期中的关系，重点在于睡眠与大脑发育之间的关系以及随年龄变化的睡眠依赖性巩固的运动学习。

name: Jeffrey Starns
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how memory works, including accurate and illusory memory, using computational models and decision-making tasks.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的工作原理，包括准确记忆和虚假记忆，使用计算模型和决策任务。

name: Adrian Staub
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how we analyze grammatical structure during language comprehension using eye-tracking experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言理解过程中如何分析句法结构，使用眼动追踪实验。

name: Linda Tropp
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how group membership affects intergroup relations and seeks strategies to reduce tensions and promote peace in divided societies.
summary_zh: 研究群体成员身份如何影响群体间关系，并寻求减少紧张局势和促进分裂社会和平的策略。

name: John-Paul Baird
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain controls eating behavior and signals of fullness.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何控制进食行为及其饱腹感的神经机制。

name: Michael Barresi
