title: Professor of Biological Sciences and Neuroscience, Smith College
areas: Assistant Neuron and Glial Cell Interactions
Astroglial Cell Development in the CNS
summary: Studies the development of astroglial cells and their interactions with neurons in the central nervous system.
summary_zh: 研究中枢神经系统中星形胶质细胞的发育及其与神经元的相互作用。

name: Richard van Emmerik
title: Professor, Department of Kinesiology
summary: Studies the effects of fatigue on balance and postural control in Multiple Sclerosis and Parkinson's disease, and assesses balance changes in older individuals.
summary_zh: 研究疲劳对多发性硬化症和帕金森病患者平衡和姿势控制的影响，以及评估老年人平衡变化。

name: Mary Harrington
title: Professor, Department of Psychology, Smith College
summary: Studies the link between disrupted circadian rhythms and health, using epidemiological data.
summary_zh: 研究扰乱的昼夜节律与健康之间的关系，使用流行病学数据。

name: Katherine C. Haydon
title: Assistant Professor, Psychology and Education, Mount Holyoke College
summary: Studies attachment processes in adolescence and adulthood, examining how relationships influence emotional and social development.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和成年期的依恋过程，探讨人际关系如何影响情感和社会发展。

name: Travis Hodges
title: Assistant Professor, Mt. Holyoke College
summary: Studies sex-specific involvement of neuronal activation and networks, inflammation, neurogenesis, and gut microbiota in negative cognitive bias using rat models.
summary_zh: 研究性别的特定参与神经激活和网络、炎症、神经发生和肠道微生物群在负面认知偏见中的作用，使用抑郁样行为的鼠模型。

name: Elizabeth M. Jakob
title: Professor, Biology
summary: Studies animal behavior, focusing on perception, learning, and social behavior.
summary_zh: 研究动物行为，尤其是感知、学习和社会行为。

name: Paul S. Katz
title: Professor of Biology and Director of the Initiative on Neurosciences
summary: Studies the nervous system of the nudibranch mollusc Berghia stephanieae, focusing on life-long neurogenesis and olfactory coding.
summary_zh: 研究海蛞蝓 Berghia stephanieae 的神经系统，重点关注终生神经发生和嗅觉编码。

name: Jacquie Kurland
title: Professor of Communication Disorders, School of Public Health
summary: Studies brain reorganization mechanisms in poststroke aphasia patients.
summary_zh: 研究中风后获得性失语症患者的大脑重组机制。

name: Jennifer E. Mack
title: Associate Professor, Department of Speech, Language, and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies the neural basis of language in adults, focusing on sentence comprehension and production using eye-tracking and MRI.
summary_zh: 研究成人的语言神经基础，重点在于句子理解和生成，使用眼动追踪和MRI技术。

name: Lisa Mangiamele
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Biological Sciences and Program in Neuroscience, Smith College
summary: Studies how sensory systems integrate communication signals to guide mating behaviors, and how these processes are influenced by hormones.
summary_zh: 研究感觉系统如何整合交流信号以指导交配行为，以及这些过程如何受到激素的影响。

name: Douglas N. Martini
title: Assistant Professor, Kinesiology, School of Public Health
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms linking mobility and cognitive decline in aging and neurological populations.
summary_zh: 研究运动能力和认知衰退在衰老和神经性疾病人群中的神经机制。

name: Sharon Owino
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience, Smith College
summary: Studies brain repair mechanisms following injury, particularly G-protein coupled signaling pathways.
summary_zh: 研究脑损伤后的修复机制，特别是G蛋白偶联信号通路。

name: Cana Park
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive decline in aging and age-related neurological conditions, focusing on the roles of platelets and platelet factors in brain/cognitive aging.
summary_zh: 研究与老化和年龄相关神经性疾病相关的认知衰退，重点关注血小板及其因子在大脑/认知老化中的作用。

name: Jeffrey E. Podos
title: Professor, Biology
areas: Mechanisms and evolution of vertebrate behavior
Mechanisms and evolution of vertebrate behavior
summary: Studies the mechanisms and evolution of vertebrate behavior, focusing on bioacoustics.
summary_zh: 研究脊椎动物行为的机制和进化，重点关注生物声学。

name: Alex Ajayi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social identity, stress, and sociocultural context affect psychological well-being and educational outcomes among marginalized communities, developing interventions to reduce disparities.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份、压力和社会文化背景如何影响边缘化群体的心理健康和教育成果，并开发减少不平等的干预措施。

name: Eugene Borgida
title: Professor of Psychology & Law
summary: Studies social psychology, psychology and law, and political psychology, examining how social and legal contexts influence human behavior.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学、法律心理学和政治心理学，探讨社会和法律环境如何影响人类行为。

name: Juan Del Toro
title: Assistant Professor, McKnight Land Grant Professor
summary: Studies how adolescents develop resilience against racial/ethnic discrimination, examining the role of ethnic-racial socialization and the potential evolutionary adaptations to structural racism.
summary_zh: 研究青少年如何在种族/ Ethnic-种族歧视中发展韧性，探讨种族/ Ethnic-种族社会化的作用以及种族主义结构下的进化适应。

name: Colin DeYoung
title: Professor
summary: Studies the structure and neurobiological basis of personality traits, including the Big Five, cognitive abilities, and their links to mental health.
summary_zh: 研究人格特质的结构及其神经生物学基础，包括大五人格、认知能力及其与心理健康的关系。

name: Iris Donga Vilares
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decision-making under uncertainty, both perceptually and socially, using cognitive neuroscience and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究不确定性条件下的决策过程，包括感知和社会层面，使用认知神经科学和计算模型。

name: Maxwell Elliott
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly working memory and attention, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是工作记忆和注意力，使用行为实验。

name: Stephen Engel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human brain processes visual perception using fMRI and EEG, focusing on neural plasticity and adaptation.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理视觉感知，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图，重点关注神经可塑性和适应性。

name: Melissa M. Ertl
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies health risk behaviors and health equity among marginalized populations, focusing on women, immigrants, and LGBTQ+ individuals.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化群体（如女性、移民和LGBTQ+人群）的健康风险行为和健康公平性。

name: Christopher Federico
title: Professor
summary: Studies the psychological foundations of political preferences and intergroup attitudes, using quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究政治偏好和群体态度的心理基础，使用定量方法。

name: Charles Fletcher
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the meaning of a discourse is represented and constructed in memory, using experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究话语意义在记忆中的表示和构建，使用实验和计算模型。

name: Kurt Fraser
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies motivational processes and behavioral flexibility using electrophysiology, fiber photometry, and optogenetics in the striatum.
summary_zh: 研究动机过程和行为灵活性，使用电生理学、光纤光度计和光遗传学在纹状体中的机制。

name: Nicola Grissom
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms in mouse models that control goal-directed behaviors and motivation, with a focus on neurodevelopmental disorders like autism and ADHD.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠模型中的分子机制，控制目标导向行为和动机，重点关注如自闭症和ADHD等神经发育障碍。

name: Nathaniel Helwig
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops machine learning algorithms for analyzing psychological and biomedical data.
summary_zh: 开发机器学习算法分析心理和生物医学数据。

name: Drexler James
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the social and psychological determinants of health among minoritized groups, focusing on racism and internalized stigma.
summary_zh: 研究少数群体的健康心理和社会决定因素，特别是种族主义和内化污名的影响。

name: Bonnie Klimes-Dougan
title: Professor
summary: Studies risk factors for early depression and suicidal behavior in adolescents, using neuroimaging and psychosocial approaches.
summary_zh: 研究青少年早期抑郁和自杀行为的风险因素，采用神经成像和心理社会方法。

name: Wilma Koutstaal
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the human mind innovates and creates using past and present knowledge, focusing on cognitive, behavioral, and brain mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究人类思维如何利用过去和现在的知识进行创新，重点关注认知、行为和脑机制。

name: Robert Krueger
title: Regents Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in psychopathology, using a taxonomy to describe symptoms across a spectrum.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍中的个体差异，使用分类系统描述症状谱系。

name: Nathan Kuncel
title: Professor
summary: Studies the structure and prediction of performance in academic and work settings, using standardized tests and personality traits.
summary_zh: 研究学术和工作表现的结构与预测，使用标准化测试和人格特质。

name: Richard Landers
title: Professor
summary: Studies the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning to improve psychometric assessment and employee selection.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能和机器学习在心理测量评估和员工选拔中的应用。

name: Vanessa Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual cognition using behavioral testing and functional brain imaging, focusing on brain mechanisms for perception, attention, learning, and memory.
summary_zh: 使用行为测试和功能性脑成像研究视觉认知，关注感知、注意、学习和记忆的脑机制。

name: James Lee
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in development using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究发展心理学中的认知过程，使用行为实验方法。

name: Rich Lee
title: Professor
summary: Studies the unique racial and ethnic experiences of minority youth and adults, focusing on acculturation, ethnic identity, and discrimination to improve their well-being.
summary_zh: 研究少数族裔青年和成人的独特种族和文化体验，重点关注文化适应、族裔身份和歧视，以改善其福祉。

name: Gordon Legge
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual perception, especially how vision affects reading and navigation in people with impaired vision.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知，特别是视觉如何影响视力受损者的阅读和导航。

name: Shmuel Lissek
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of fear and anxiety, using neuroimaging and conditioning experiments to understand fear generalization and avoidance behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧和焦虑的神经基础，使用神经成像和条件反射实验来理解恐惧泛化和回避行为。

name: Monica Luciana
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of executive functions in adults and children, including working memory and emotional control, using pharmacological and neuroimaging approaches.
summary_zh: 研究成年人和儿童的执行功能神经生物学，包括工作记忆和情绪控制，使用药理学和神经成像方法。

name: Angus MacDonald
title: Professor, Distinguished McKnight University Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and affective processes in healthy and clinical populations, using fMRI, behavioral genetics, and cognitive testing.
summary_zh: 研究健康和临床人群的认知和情感过程，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、行为遗传学和认知测试。

name: Traci Mann
title: Professor
summary: Studies self-control of health behaviors, eating regulation, and attention and self-control, helping people change health behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究自我控制的健康行为、进食调节以及注意力和自我控制，帮助人们改变健康行为。

name: Katerina Marcoulides
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and applies advanced modeling and data mining techniques to analyze complex psychological data, focusing on developmental and educational processes, especially among economically.
summary_zh: 开发和应用高级建模和数据挖掘技术分析复杂的心理学数据，特别是在经济困难的移民儿童的发展和教育过程中的应用。

name: Cheryl Olman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how local image features are integrated into scene perception using visual psychophysics and fMRI, exploring the relationship between BOLD signals and neural activity.
summary_zh: 研究局部图像特征如何整合到场景感知中，使用视觉心理物理学和fMRI，探索BOLD信号与神经活动之间的关系。

name: Deniz Ones
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality assessment and personnel selection, using meta-analysis and integrity testing.
summary_zh: 研究人格评估和人员选拔，使用元分析和诚信测试。

name: Andrew Oxenham
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the ear and brain process sound, focusing on pitch perception and its applications in hearing aids and cochlear implants.
summary_zh: 研究听觉感知，特别是在耳和大脑如何处理声音以及音调感知在助听器和人工耳蜗中的应用。

name: Whitney Ringwald
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people's daily behaviors and environmental interactions affect their well-being and mental health, using ambulatory assessment methods.
summary_zh: 研究日常行为和环境互动如何影响人们的福祉和心理健康，使用流动评估方法。

name: Alexander Rothman
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people process and respond to health information, developing and evaluating interventions to promote healthy behavior.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何处理和应对健康信息，开发和评估促进健康行为的干预措施。

name: Paul Sackett
title: Professor
summary: Studies the balance between job performance and diversity in selection systems, measuring counterproductive behavior, and assessing managerial potential.
summary_zh: 研究选拔系统在提高绩效与促进种族、性别多样性之间的平衡，测量职场反生产性行为，并评估管理潜力。

name: Aaron Schmidt
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how employees manage competing work goals and the effects of success on motivation, using self-regulation theory.
summary_zh: 研究员工如何应对工作中的多重目标冲突以及成功对动机的影响，运用自我调节理论。

name: Paul Schrater
title: Professor
summary: Studies human and computer vision, motor control, and multi-modal sensory integration using statistical pattern recognition.
summary_zh: 研究人类和计算机视觉、运动控制以及多模态感官整合，使用统计模式识别方法。

name: Jeffry Simpson
title: Professor, Chair
summary: Studies close relationships and interpersonal processes, focusing on attachment, mating decisions, social influence, and their effects on health and parenting.
summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和人际过程，包括依恋过程、择偶决策、社会影响及其对健康和育儿的影响。

name: Moin Syed
title: Professor, McKnight Presidential Endowed Professor
summary: Studies meta-science and scientific reform to improve psychological research methods and integration of minority psychology.
summary_zh: 研究元科学和科学改革，以改进心理研究方法并整合少数族裔心理学。

name: Scott Vrieze
title: Distinguished McKnight University Professor
summary: Studies the nature, origins, and consequences of psychopathology, focusing on drug use and antisocial behavior, using genetic and environmental research designs.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍的本质、起源及其后果，特别是药物滥用和反社会行为，采用遗传和环境研究设计。

name: David J. Weiss
title: Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates statistical tests for detecting intraindividual change using computerized adaptive testing and item response theory.
summary_zh: 开发和评估用于检测个体内部变化的心理测量统计测试，基于计算机自适应测试和项目反应理论。

name: Gabriella Alvarez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social and environmental determinants of health relate to brain function and aging, using neuroimaging and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究社会和环境因素如何影响大脑功能和老化，使用神经成像和生理测量方法。

name: Kevin Binning
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies diversity and equity issues in psychology, promoting inclusive research environments.
summary_zh: 研究心理学中的多样性和公平性问题，促进包容性的研究环境。

name: Sophia Choukas-Bradley
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the impact of social media on adolescent girls' body image and mental health, focusing on minority stress and gender identity.
summary_zh: 研究社交媒体对青少年女孩体型形象和心理健康的影响，重点关注少数群体压力和性别认同。

name: Julie Fiez
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of language processing and basic learning systems in the human brain, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理和人类大脑的基本学习系统的神经基础，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Amanda Forest
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how expressing negativity and positivity affects romantic partners' support, using personality and social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究表达消极情绪和积极情绪如何影响伴侣的支持，使用个性和社会心理学方法。

name: Scott Fraundorf
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive aging, memory, and metacognition using statistical modeling and decision making experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知老化、记忆和元认知，使用统计建模和决策实验。

name: Peter J. Gianaros
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the brain bases of emotion regulation using systems identification and Bayes factors, and how local resources affect cardiovascular risk and brain morphology.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节的脑基础及其系统识别方法，并探讨当地资源如何影响心血管风险和脑结构。

name: Marquis Hawkins
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how sleep and sleep-related behaviors affect maternal well-being during pregnancy and postpartum, developing interventions to promote healthy sleep.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠和睡眠相关行为如何影响孕妇和产后妇女的健康，并开发促进健康睡眠的干预措施。

name: Daphne A. Henry
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of race/ethnicity and socioeconomic status on children’s academic and socioemotional development, using large-scale datasets and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究种族/族裔和经济地位对儿童学业和情感社会发展的影响，使用大规模数据集和定性方法。

name: Thomas W. Kamarck
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies the impact of behavioral and psychosocial factors on heart disease and hypertension, focusing on daily stress, physical activity, and social integration.
summary_zh: 研究行为和心理社会因素对心脏病和高血压的影响，重点关注日常压力、身体活动和社会整合。

name: Joel M. Le Forestier
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies identity concealment and its effects on health and wellbeing, focusing on stigma and social costs.
summary_zh: 研究身份隐藏及其对健康和福祉的影响，重点关注耻辱和社会成本。

name: Diana Leyva
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies how home learning environments affect children’s cognitive and socioemotional development, focusing on math activities, book-sharing, and food practices.
summary_zh: 研究家庭学习环境对儿童认知和社会情感发展的影响，重点关注家庭数学活动、共读书籍和饮食实践。

name: Emily Lindsay
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how mindfulness interventions affect stress, emotion, social, and health outcomes in older adults and those with early life adversity.
summary_zh: 研究正念干预如何影响老年人和早期生活压力下的个体在压力、情绪、社会和健康方面的结果。

name: Anna Marsland
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between inflammation and cognitive performance, using psychological and biological measures.
summary_zh: 研究炎症与认知表现之间的关系，使用心理和生物测量方法。

name: Andrea S. Medrano
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of community violence on mental health in urban Mexico, focusing on school belonging and family cohesion.
summary_zh: 研究社区暴力对墨西哥城市青少年心理健康的影响，重点关注学校归属感和家庭凝聚力的作用。

name: Timothy Nokes-Malach
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and metacognitive processes, motivation, social and ecological factors, and mindfulness meditation to understand knowledge transfer.
summary_zh: 研究认知和元认知过程、动机、社会和生态因素以及正念冥想对知识迁移的理解。

name: Rebecca G. Reed
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how stress and protective factors affect biological aging and cognitive function in older adults, using longitudinal and multilevel statistical models.
summary_zh: 研究压力和保护性因素如何影响老年人的生物老化和认知功能，使用纵向和多层次统计模型。

name: Kathryn A. Roecklein
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of retinal sensitivity to light and sleep patterns in seasonal affective disorder, using pupillometry, melatonin assays, and behavioral genetics.
summary_zh: 研究季节性情感障碍中视网膜对光的敏感性和睡眠模式的作用，使用瞳孔测量、褪黑素检测和行为遗传学方法。

name: Ben Rottman
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies causal learning and decision making, especially in medical contexts, to improve research methods teaching.
summary_zh: 研究因果学习和决策制定（尤其是在医疗决策中），以改进研究方法的教学。

name: Michael Sayette
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the effects of alcohol on emotions and social behavior, using various methods including facial coding and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究酒精对情绪和社会行为的影响，使用面部编码和神经成像等多种方法。

name: Walter Schneider
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies brain imaging and connectivity mapping to understand learning, executive control, and attention using computational modeling.
summary_zh: 研究脑成像和连接性映射，以理解学习、执行控制和注意力，并使用计算建模方法。

name: Karina Schumann
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people respond to conflict and interpersonal harm, focusing on transgressors' and victims' experiences and factors promoting relationship repair.
summary_zh: 研究冲突和人际伤害的心理过程，重点关注侵犯者和受害者的体验以及促进关系修复的因素。

name: Christian Schunn
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies how peer feedback affects learning and performance in educational settings, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究同伴反馈如何影响学习和表现，使用多种实验方法。

name: Daniel S. Shaw
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies parent-child interaction and intervention effectiveness for young children at risk for conduct and emotional problems.
summary_zh: 研究父母与儿童互动及其干预措施的有效性，针对有行为和情绪问题风险的幼儿。

name: Jennifer Silk
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies emotional health and social interactions in adolescents, particularly during crises like the COVID-19 pandemic.
summary_zh: 研究青少年的情感健康和社会互动，特别是在COVID-19疫情期间。

name: Jonathan Stange
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotion regulation and affect dynamics in depression, using ambulatory physiological measures and cognitive-affective strategies.
summary_zh: 研究抑郁中的情绪调节和情感动态，使用可穿戴生理测量和认知情感策略。

name: Mehrgol Tiv
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social context influences cognition through interpersonal and ecological dynamics, using social network analysis and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会环境如何影响认知，通过人际和生态动态，使用社会网络分析和行为实验。

name: Natasha Tokowicz
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies how adult second language learners process and learn ambiguous words, using training studies and examining individual differences in cognitive abilities.
summary_zh: 研究成人第二语言学习者处理和学习多义词的方式，使用训练研究并考察认知能力差异的作用。

name: Colin E. Vize
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms through which antagonistic traits lead to harmful interpersonal behaviors, using personality science and advanced quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究对抗性特质如何导致有害的人际行为，使用人格科学和高级定量方法。

name: Elizabeth Votruba-Drzal
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies how key contexts support learning and socioemotional development during early and middle childhood, focusing on ethnically diverse and socioeconomically disadvantaged children.
summary_zh: 研究关键环境如何支持早期和中期儿童的认知和社会情感发展，重点关注多元文化和经济条件不利的儿童。

name: Tessa Warren
title: Full Professor
summary: Studies how linguistic and world knowledge interact in language processing, using models and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理中语言知识和世界知识的交互作用，使用模型和实验方法。

name: Simon Chamberland
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the genetic diversity of neurons and their functional roles in memory circuits, using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经元的遗传多样性及其在记忆回路中的功能作用，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: Yan Dong
title: Professor and Chairman, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotional and motivational responses, particularly in drug addiction models.
summary_zh: 研究情感和动机反应的神经机制，特别是在成瘾模型中的作用。

name: Anthony A. Grace
title: Distinguished Professor of Neuroscience, Professor of Psychiatry and Psychology
summary: Studies the neurobiology of mental disorders, particularly schizophrenia, using electrophysiology and pharmacology in animals.
summary_zh: 研究精神障碍的神经生物学，特别是精神分裂症，使用动物的电生理学和药理学方法。

name: Dylan Hale
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in rodents, using behavioral and electrophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为和电生理学方法。

name: Chengcheng Huang
title: Associate Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Develops theoretical approaches to understand circuit dynamics and information processing in sensory systems, focusing on how task and stimulus contexts change neuronal responses and the implications.
summary_zh: 发展理论方法以理解感觉系统中的神经网络动力学和信息处理，重点关注任务和刺激上下文如何改变神经元反应及其对神经编码的影响。

name: Diego Mendoza-Halliday
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms of working memory manipulation at the level of single neurons and neuronal populations using electrophysiological methods in animal models.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆操纵的机制，通过在动物模型中使用电生理学方法同时监测大量单个神经元的活动来探究不同神经元、神经元类型、皮层层以及脑区之间的电生理活动及其相互作用。

name: Caroline Runyan
title: Associate Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sensory information interacts with brain state to control information flow between brain regions in mice.
summary_zh: 研究感觉信息如何与大脑状态相互作用以控制大脑区域之间的信息流动，特别是在小鼠中的表现。

name: Susan R. Sesack
title: Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the synaptic and extrasynaptic actions of monoamines on brain circuits regulating cognitive and emotional behaviors, using light and electron microscopy.
summary_zh: 研究单胺类物质在调节认知和情绪行为的大脑回路中的突触和超突触作用，使用光和电子显微镜技术。

name: Shushruth Shushruth
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how abstract properties of sensory information are stored and used to guide actions, using animal and human models.
summary_zh: 研究感觉信息的抽象属性如何存储和用于指导行为，使用动物和人类模型。

name: Shawn Sorrells
title: Associate Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the development of emotional responses and the cellular basis of emotional disorders in the human brain, focusing on late-developing neurons.
summary_zh: 研究情感反应的发展和情感障碍的细胞基础，重点关注人类大脑中晚期发育的神经元。

name: Sierra Stringfield
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the effects of stress and substance use, particularly nicotine, cannabis, and alcohol, on adolescent brain development, using techniques like fiber photometry and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究压力和物质使用（尤其是尼古丁、大麻和酒精）对青少年大脑发育的影响，使用光纤光度计和光遗传学等技术。

name: Weifeng Xu
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience
summary: Studies how experience induces long-lasting changes in synaptic transmission, using molecular, electrophysiological, and behavioral analyses in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究经验如何诱导持久的突触传递变化，使用分子、电生理和行为分析方法在啮齿动物模型中进行研究。

name: Marlene Behrmann
title: Professor, Ophthalmology
summary: Studies the cognitive basis of visual perception, focusing on object and face recognition, and the visual cortex in blindness.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知的认知基础，特别是物体和面孔识别以及盲人的视觉皮层功能。

name: Judy L. Cameron
title: Professor, Psychiatry
summary: Studies the effects of mild everyday stresses on long-term health, focusing on neural systems and physiological responses in nonhuman primates.
summary_zh: 研究日常轻度压力对长期健康的影响，关注神经系统的生理反应和非人灵长类动物中的变化。

name: Neeraj J. Gandhi
title: Associate Professor, Otolaryngology, Neuroscience, Bioengineering, Center for the Neural Basis of Cognition
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of sensory-to-motor transformations, including population activity dynamics and premotor theory of attention, using experimental and computational tools.
summary_zh: 研究感觉-运动转换的神经机制，包括群体活动动力学和前运动注意理论，使用实验和计算工具。

name: Bill J. Yates
title: Professor, Otolaryngology, Neuroscience
summary: Studies the role of the vestibular system in maintaining homeostasis and spatial cognition, using electrophysiological and neuroanatomical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究前庭系统在维持稳态和空间认知中的作用，采用电生理学和神经解剖学方法。

name: Ignacio Acevedo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies adolescent sociopolitical development, focusing on promoting community engagement.
summary_zh: 研究青少年政治社会发展，侧重于促进社区参与。

name: Adrienne Adams
title: Professor, Director of Program Evaluation Master's and Certificate Programs
summary: Studies community and ecological factors influencing mental health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社区和生态因素对心理健康和福祉的影响。

name: Melissa Allman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies mediated conditioning in rodents, focusing on learning about stimuli and generalization effects.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的中介性条件作用，关注刺激学习和泛化效应。

name: Erik Altmann
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using computational models and experiments.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和实验研究认知过程。

name: Kaston D. Anderson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the impact of socioeconomic status, built environment, and community connectedness on behavioral health outcomes, using theoretically-grounded research.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位、建成环境和社区联系对行为健康结果的影响，采用理论导向的研究方法。

name: Aldo M. Barrita
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychological impact of microaggressions on minoritized communities and develops quantitative measures for oppression.
summary_zh: 研究日常压迫对少数群体的心理影响，并开发衡量压迫的量化指标。

name: Mark Becker
title: Professor
summary: Studies attention and perception, using behavioral experiments and psychophysical methods.
summary_zh: 研究注意和知觉，使用行为实验和心理物理学方法。

name: Marisa Beeble
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the criminal justice system's response to female offenders, aiming to improve their treatment.
summary_zh: 研究刑事司法系统对女性犯罪者的应对措施，旨在改善其待遇。

name: Tara S. Behrend
title: John Richard Butler II Endowed Professor
summary: Studies the ethical, social, and psychological implications of workplace technologies, including electronic surveillance and human-AI interactions.
summary_zh: 研究工作场所技术的伦理、社会和心理影响，包括电子监控和人机交互。

name: Jan Brascamp
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how sensation becomes conscious perception using psychophysics, fMRI, and brain stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究感觉如何转化为意识知觉，使用心理物理学、功能性磁共振成像和脑刺激技术。

name: S Marc Breedlove
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effect of steroid hormones on the developing and adult nervous system, including sexual differentiation and plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究类固醇激素对发育和成年神经系统的影响，包括性分化和可塑性。

name: Daniel Campbell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effects of autism-related long noncoding RNAs and environmental factors on brain development, using human neurons.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症相关长非编码RNA和环境因素对大脑发育的影响，使用人类神经元细胞.

name: Alex Castillo-Ruiz
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies how birth and microbiota affect brain and behavioral development in mice.
summary_zh: 研究出生和微生物如何影响小鼠的大脑和行为发育。

name: Charles L. Cox
title: Professor, Research Integrity Officer, Physiology
summary: Studies the cellular mechanisms of behavioral plasticity, focusing on thalamocortical circuits and their role in sensory processing and attention.
summary_zh: 研究行为可塑性的细胞机制，集中在丘脑-皮层回路及其在感觉处理和注意力中的作用。

name: Shane Crandall
title: Assistant Professor, Physiology
summary: Studies how brain circuits control sensations, focusing on neocortex and thalamus using electrophysiology and optical tools.
summary_zh: 研究大脑回路如何控制感觉，重点研究新皮层和丘脑，使用电生理学和光学工具。

name: Anne Dorrance
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using pharmacological and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用药理学和遗传学方法。

name: Heather L Eisthen
title: Professor, Integrative Biology
summary: Studies evolutionary changes in nervous systems and their behavioral consequences, focusing on chemical signals, toxins, and infrared sensing in amphibians and snakes.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统进化的因果关系及其行为后果，重点关注两栖动物和蛇类中的化学信号、毒素和红外感知。

name: Kimberly Fenn
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of sleep in learning complex skills and episodic memory, using fMRI to examine biological mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠在学习复杂技能和情景记忆中的作用，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）探讨生物机制。

name: Yuen Gao
title: Assistant Professor, Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Casey L Henley
title: Fixed Term Associate Professor, Dean’s Office
summary: Studies neurobiology and cell and molecular medicine in neuroscience.
summary_zh: 研究神经生物学和细胞与分子医学的神经科学。

name: Hanne Hoffmann
title: Assistant Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies how biological timing and light exposure affect reproduction, pregnancy, and labor in various mammals, integrating neuroendocrinology and physiology.
summary_zh: 研究生物节律和光照如何影响哺乳动物的繁殖、妊娠和分娩，结合神经内分泌学和生理学方法。

name: Jie Huang
title: Faculty
summary: Develops novel fMRI methods and investigates the neurological bases of visual stress in migraine patients.
summary_zh: 开发新的功能性磁共振成像方法并研究视觉诱发偏头痛的神经基础。

name: Alex Johnson
title: Associate Professor, Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms of learning and motivation using behavioral procedures and neuroscience techniques in both animals and humans.
summary_zh: 研究学习和动机的神经机制，使用行为程序和神经科学技术在动物和人类中。

name: Florian Kagerer
title: Faculty
summary: Studies motor learning and adaptation using behavioral and electrophysiological techniques to investigate upper limb coordination and brain dynamics during movement.
summary_zh: 研究运动学习和适应，使用行为技术和电生理技术（如运动捕捉、脑电图和经颅磁刺激）来探究上肢协调和运动期间的大脑动态。

name: Rebecca Knickmeyer
title: Associate Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies how the gut microbiota, genetics, and sex differences influence infant brain development, using neuroimaging and genomics.
summary_zh: 研究微生物群、遗传学和性别差异如何影响婴儿大脑发育，使用神经影像学和基因组学方法。

name: Geoffroy Olivier Laumet
title: Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies the communication between neurons and immune cells in chronic pain, using mouse models and genetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究神经元与免疫细胞之间的通讯在慢性疼痛中的作用，使用小鼠模型和遗传学方法。

name: Gina Leinninger
title: Red Cedar Distinguished Professor, Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the neurophysiological mechanisms by which neurons in the lateral hypothalamic area regulate energy balance and contribute to obesity and metabolic disease.
summary_zh: 研究下丘脑外侧区神经元的神经生理机制，这些机制调控能量平衡并导致肥胖和代谢疾病。

name: Taosheng Liu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies visual perception and attention, visual working memory, and perceptual decision making.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力、视觉工作记忆和知觉决策。

name: Joseph Lonstein
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neurobiology of peripartum emotional regulation and maternal behaviors in rodents, focusing on the BST and its role in anxiety and mothering trade-offs.
summary_zh: 研究哺乳期情绪调节和母性行为的神经生物学，重点关注下外侧隔核及其在焦虑和母性行为权衡中的作用。

name: Andrew Mason
title: Faculty
summary: Studies microsystem sensor technologies for enhancing human awareness, wellness, social perception, and cognitive performance.
summary_zh: 研究微系统传感器技术以增强人类意识、福祉、社会感知和认知表现。

name: Michelle Mazei-Robison
title: Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of changes in VTA dopamine neuron signaling and morphology induced by stress and drugs, using behavioral assays and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究应激和药物诱导的中脑导水管周围灰质多巴胺神经元信号传导和形态变化的分子机制，使用行为学和光遗传学技术。

name: J. Devin McAuley
title: Faculty
areas: Mechanisms of timing and temporal processing
dynamic systems approaches to brain and behavior
summary: Studies auditory perception, attention and memory, and the relationship between music and language using computational modeling and dynamic systems approaches.
summary_zh: 研究听觉感知、注意力和记忆以及音乐与语言之间的关系，使用计算建模和动态系统方法。

name: Dar Meshi
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the human brain processes socially communicated information, using neuroimaging and experimental methods to understand motivations and decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究人类大脑如何处理社会传达的信息，使用神经成像和实验方法来理解动机和决策过程。

name: Adam Moeser
title: Associate Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies the pathophysiologic mechanisms of stress-induced gastrointestinal and immune disorders, focusing on early life adversity, neuro-immune signaling, and biological sex differences.
summary_zh: 研究应激诱导的消化道和免疫障碍的病理生理机制，重点关注早期生活应激、神经免疫信号传导和生物性别差异。

name: Jason Moser
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive, emotional, and behavioral regulation, and their clinical significance in anxiety and depression.
summary_zh: 研究认知、情绪和行为调节的神经机制及其在焦虑和抑郁中的临床意义。

name: Lucas Pozzo-Miller
title: Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies how neurons communicate and the role of calcium signaling in learning and memory, using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究神经元如何交流以及钙信号在学习和记忆中的作用，使用电生理学和成像技术。

name: Chunqi Qian
title: Faculty
summary: Develops wirelessly powered multi-modal detectors to correlate fMRI signals with EEG and fiber photometry, improving understanding of NGV interaction.
summary_zh: 开发无线供电多模态检测器，将fMRI信号与EEG和光纤光度计相关联，以改善对NGV相互作用的理解。

name: Susan Ravizza
title: Faculty
summary: Studies working memory and task switching using fMRI, neuropsychological, and behavioral techniques.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和任务切换，使用功能性磁共振成像、神经心理学和行为技术。

name: Alfred J Robison
title: Associate Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies how drug addiction and chronic stress alter gene expression in the hippocampus, using transgenic mice and viral gene-transfer tools.
summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和慢性应激如何通过转基因小鼠和病毒基因转移工具改变海马的基因表达。

name: Debajit Saha
title: Assistant Professor, BioMolecular Science Gateway
summary: Studies neural engineering and brain-computer interfaces to understand associative learning and decision-making in insects, developing insect-based chemical sensors.
summary_zh: 研究神经工程和脑-机接口技术，理解昆虫的关联学习和决策机制，并开发基于昆虫的化学传感器。

name: Ralf Schmälzle
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural responses to dynamic real-world messages, comparing brain activity similarities across different recipients.
summary_zh: 研究动态现实信息的神经反应，比较不同接收者的大脑活动相似性。

name: Caryl Sortwell
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how the growth factor pleiotrophin affects the development and maintenance of the nigrostriatal system in a rat model of Parkinson's disease, and whether deep brain stimulation can slow.
summary_zh: 研究生长因子pleiotrophin (PTN) 对黑质纹状体系统的影响及其在帕金森病动物模型中的神经修复作用，以及深部脑刺激是否可以减缓疾病进展。

name: Katy Thakkar
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cognitive and biological mechanisms of psychotic disorders, particularly schizophrenia, using MRI, eye tracking, and experimental psychology.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症等精神病性障碍的认知和生物机制，使用MRI、眼动追踪和实验心理学方法。

name: Barbara Thompson
title: Faculty
summary: Studies affective processing and reward circuitry disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders, using both basic science and clinical research methods.
summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍中情感处理和奖励电路中断的神经生物学基础，采用基础科学和临床研究方法。

name: Alexa Veene
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the roles of vasopressin and oxytocin in social behavior using rats and various techniques.
summary_zh: 研究血管加压素和催产素在社会行为中的作用，使用大鼠和多种技术方法。

name: Michael Williams
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of Autism Spectrum Disorder candidate genes in neuronal development, using viral and transgenic animal strategies.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍候选基因在神经发育中的作用，使用病毒和转基因动物策略。

name: Lily Yan
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how light affects mood and cognition, using rodent models and cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究光照如何影响情绪和认知，使用啮齿动物模型和认知任务来阐明其神经机制。

name: Mengsen Zhang
title: Assistant Professor, Computational Mathematics, Science and Engineering
summary: Studies complex systems in neuroscience using computational methods and dynamical systems theory.
summary_zh: 研究神经科学中的复杂系统，使用计算方法和动力系统理论。

name: Selmer Bringsjord
title: Professor, Lab Director
summary: Studies artificial intelligence and reasoning, developing computational models and systems.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能和推理，开发计算模型和系统。

name: Brett Fajen
title: HASS Associate Dean for Academic Affairs and Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate through complex environments and perform perceptual-motor skills, using virtual environments and motion capture technology.
summary_zh: 研究人在复杂环境中的导航和知觉-运动技能的执行，使用虚拟环境和动作捕捉技术。

name: Thomas Ferguson
title: Associate Professor, Graduate Program Director
summary: Studies the foundations of mathematics and logic, exploring paradoxes and the philosophical challenges in their development.
summary_zh: 研究数学和逻辑的基础，探讨悖论及其发展中的哲学挑战。

name: James Hendler
title: Faculty
summary: Develops AI and machine learning techniques for healthcare and open government data integration.
summary_zh: 开发用于医疗保健和政府数据集成的人工智能和机器学习技术。

name: Marjorie McShane
title: Professor
summary: Develops cognitive models of intelligent agents for task-oriented dialog applications, integrating functionalities like physiological simulation and emotion modeling.
summary_zh: 开发用于任务导向对话应用的智能代理的认知模型，整合生理模拟和情绪建模等功能。

name: Sergei Nirenburg
title: Professor
summary: Develops computational models of human cognitive capabilities and implements them in hybrid-engine models of societies of human and computer agents.
summary_zh: 开发人类认知能力的计算模型，并将其应用于人类和计算机代理的混合模型。

name: Stefan Radev
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops new Bayesian methods through generative AI and computational models to gain insights from big data.
summary_zh: 通过生成式人工智能和计算模型开发新的贝叶斯方法，以从大数据中获得见解。

name: Mei Si
title: Associate Professor, Cognitive Science
summary: Develops interactive narratives and embodied conversational agents for virtual and mixed realities, enhancing user engagement and learning.
summary_zh: 开发交互叙事和具身对话代理，增强虚拟和混合现实中的用户参与和学习。

name: Christopher Sims
title: Associate Professor and Undergraduate Program Director
summary: Studies the computational principles of human intelligence, applying information theory to perception and memory, and how people learn behaviors that maximize reward.
summary_zh: 研究人类智能的计算原理，应用信息论到知觉和记忆，并探讨人们如何学习最大化奖励的行为。

name: Tomek Strzalkowski
title: Constellation Chair Professor
summary: Studies social dimensions of information spread online and develops AI defenses against disinformation and social engineering attacks.
summary_zh: 研究信息在网络上传播的社会维度，并开发AI防御措施以对抗虚假信息和社交工程攻击。

name: Alicia Walf
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies individual differences in stress through hormones' effects on brain and body growth and plasticity, focusing on estradiol's actions in the hippocampus and amygdala.
summary_zh: 研究压力的个体差异，通过激素对大脑和身体生长及可塑性的影响，重点关注雌二醇在海马体和杏仁核中的作用。

name: Yingrui Yang
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies economic mechanics, reasoning, and decision making by integrating cognitive science and theoretical physics.
summary_zh: 研究经济机制、推理和决策，通过结合认知科学和理论物理。

name: Mayra Bámaca
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the development of ethnic-racial minoritized youth, focusing on family and peer contexts, with an emphasis on Latinx young adults.
summary_zh: 研究少数民族青少年的发展，重点关注家庭和同伴环境，特别是拉丁裔青年成年人。

name: Heather Bortfeld
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Linda Cameron
title: Professor
summary: Studies health behaviors and psychological factors influencing health, using surveys and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为和心理因素对健康的影响，使用调查和实验方法。

name: Sarah Depaoli
title: Professor

summary_zh: 开发心理研究的统计模型，重点是贝叶斯统计和结构方程建模。

summary_zh: 研究儿童语言发展的机制，重点关注社会互动的作用。

name: Martin Hagger
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the psychological determinants of health behavior and develops theory-based interventions for behavior change.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为的心理决定因素，并开发基于理论的行为改变干预措施。

name: Jennifer Hahn-Holbrook
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social stress affects mental health, using longitudinal studies and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究社会压力对心理健康的影响，使用纵向研究和调查问卷。

name: Jennifer Howell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies health behaviors and psychological factors influencing health, using surveys and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为和心理因素对健康的影响，使用调查和实验方法。

summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Fan Jia
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops statistical models and methods for psychological research, focusing on measurement and data analysis.
summary_zh: 开发心理研究中的统计模型和方法，专注于测量和数据分析。

name: Ren Liu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and applies advanced statistical methods to measure complex human performance and behavior in applied settings, focusing on reliability and practical relevance.
summary_zh: 开发和应用高级统计方法来衡量复杂的人类表现和行为，注重可靠性和实际相关性。

name: Haiyan Liu
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops advanced statistical models for understanding human behaviors, including Bayesian structural equation modeling and social network analysis.
summary_zh: 开发高级统计模型以理解人类行为，包括贝叶斯结构方程模型和社会网络分析。

name: Alexandra Main
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Meng (Chris) Qiu
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops and applies Bayesian statistics and mixture modeling to analyze psychological and behavioral data, addressing issues in developmental studies.
summary_zh: 开发和应用贝叶斯统计和混合模型分析心理和行为数据，解决发展研究中的问题。

name: Rose Scott
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

summary_zh: 研究健康行为和心理因素对健康的影响，使用调查和实验设计。

name: Eric Walle

summary: Studies infant emotional development and language acquisition following walking, using behavioral and cross-cultural methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿情绪发展和行走后语言习得，采用行为和跨文化方法。

name: Deborah Wiebe
title: Professor
summary: Studies health behaviors and psychological factors influencing health, using surveys and experimental designs.
summary_zh: 研究健康行为和心理因素对健康的影响，使用调查和实验设计。

summary_zh: 研究健康行为和心理因素对健康的影响，使用调查和实验方法。

name: Zenaida Aguirre-Muñoz
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how culturally and linguistically diverse students learn abstract concepts and how to design inclusive learning environments to support their engagement and understanding.
summary_zh: 研究文化及语言背景多样学生的抽象概念学习，并设计包容性学习环境以支持他们的参与和理解。

name: Kristina Backer
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how auditory perception and speech processing change with age and in bilinguals, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究年龄和双语者中听觉感知和语音处理的变化，采用认知神经科学方法。

name: Ramesh Balasubramaniam
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how the brain encodes and predicts time, focusing on musical beat perception, sensorimotor synchronization, and noise effects on motor control using TMS, EEG, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何编码和预测时间，重点在于音乐节拍感知、传感器运动同步以及噪声对运动控制的影响，使用TMS、EEG和行为方法。

name: Colin Holbrook
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies decision-making under threat, focusing on trust, cooperation, and aggression in human-AI interactions during crises.
summary_zh: 研究威胁情境下的决策制定，重点关注信任、合作和攻击性在人类与人工智能互动中的作用。

name: Christopher Kello
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor

summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑中的信息处理。

name: Paul Maglio
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how services are designed and experienced, integrating cognitive and computer science.
summary_zh: 研究服务的设计与体验，结合认知科学与计算机科学。

name: Tyler Marghetis
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how thought and behavior change suddenly ('ruptures') and get stuck in stable patterns ('regimes'), using behavioral experiments, neuroscience methods, and historical case studies.
summary_zh: 研究思维和行为如何突然发生转变（'断裂'）和陷入稳定模式（'稳定态'），使用行为实验、神经科学方法和历史案例研究。

name: David Noelle
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies computational models of brain function, focusing on the prefrontal cortex and its role in learning and memory.
summary_zh: 研究大脑功能的计算模型，重点关注前额叶皮层在学习和记忆中的作用。

name: Rachel Ryskin
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how humans use language to communicate in real-time, using various methods including behavioral experiments and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究人类如何在实时交流中使用语言，采用行为实验和眼动追踪等多种方法。

name: Paul Smaldino
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how behaviors emerge and evolve in response to social, cultural, and ecological pressures, using mathematical models and simulations.
summary_zh: 研究行为如何在社会、文化和生态压力下产生和演变，使用数学模型和模拟。

name: Michael Spivey
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how decisions are made dynamically, using eye movements to track moral decisions and computational models of visual world paradigm.
summary_zh: 研究决策的动态过程，使用眼动追踪道德决策，并通过视觉世界范式计算模型进行建模。

name: Jeff Yoshimi
dept: Department of Cognitive and Information Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using social media platforms and computational models.
summary_zh: 使用社交媒体平台和计算模型研究认知过程。

name: Sarah Karalunas
title: Cobb-Jones Endowed Professor & Department Chair
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Brett K. Jakubiak
title: Renée Crown Professor in the Sciences and Mathematics, Associate Professor and Associate Chair and Director of Graduate Studies’
summary: Studies cognitive processes and learning in humans, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类的认知过程和学习，使用行为实验方法。

name: Leonard Newman
title: Professor, Associate Chair, Director of Undergraduate Studies, and Director of the Ph.D. Program in Social Psychology
summary: Studies social psychology, focusing on social cognition and interpersonal processes.
summary_zh: 研究社会心理学，侧重于社会认知和人际过程。

name: Natalie Russo

summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Melissa Birkett Greene
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and learning in educational settings, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和学习在教育环境中的机制，使用实验方法。

name: Sara E. Burke
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in development using behavioral experiments with children.
summary_zh: 研究发展心理学中的认知过程，使用儿童的行为实验。

summary_zh: 研究压力和情绪对健康行为的影响，采用行为和心理社会干预方法。

name: Tanya Eckert
title: Associate Professor and Director of the Ph.D. Program in School Psychology
summary: Studies educational and developmental psychology, focusing on school-based interventions and programs.
summary_zh: 研究教育与发展心理学，专注于学校干预和项目。

name: Lee Kalish
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: David Kellen
title: Associate professor
summary: Studies decision-making processes and cognitive biases using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和认知偏差，使用计算模型和行为实验。

name: Katie Kidwell
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Lynn Lohnas
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes in development, focusing on memory and attention in children.
summary_zh: 研究发展认知过程，重点关注儿童的记忆和注意力。

name: Laura V. Machia
title: Associate Dean for Academic Initiatives and Curriculum, Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive development and learning processes in children.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展和学习过程。

summary: Studies cognitive and developmental psychology, focusing on learning and memory processes.
