summary: Studies the long-lasting effects of early-life drug exposure on emotional processing and substance misuse, using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究早期药物暴露对情绪处理和物质滥用的长期神经生物学影响，使用电生理学和光遗传学方法。

name: Michael Dulas
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the roles of the hippocampus and PFC in relational memory, using neuroimaging and eye-tracking to differentiate healthy aging from brain injury.
summary_zh: 研究海马和前额叶皮层在关系记忆中的作用，使用神经成像和眼动追踪技术区分健康老化和脑损伤。

name: Alice Friedman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies psychological adjustment in young children and behavioral medicine/pediatric psychology, focusing on fears, anxiety, coping strategies, and the relationship between psychological adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的心理适应和行为医学/儿科心理学，关注恐惧、焦虑、应对策略以及心理适应与身体健康之间的关系。

name: Peter C Gerhardstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies the perceptual and attention processes that influence visual perception and memory development in infants and children, and how digital content affects these processes.
summary_zh: 研究知觉和注意力过程如何影响婴儿和儿童的视觉感知和记忆发展，以及数字内容如何影响这些过程。

name: Brandon Gibb
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how information-processing biases develop and increase the risk for depression across the lifespan, using experimental and developmental psychopathology approaches.
summary_zh: 研究信息加工偏差如何随年龄发展并增加抑郁症风险，采用实验和发展心理病理学方法。

name: Jennifer Gillis Mattson
title: Distinguished Service Professor
areas: Lifespan issues for neurodivergent and autistic individuals
summary: Studies factors that predict success in higher education for autistic adults and adapts evidence-based practices for limited-resource settings.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症成人高等教育成功的关键因素，并适应有限资源环境下的循证实践。

name: Kenneth Kurtz
title: Professor
summary: Studies how categorization and comparison processes guide interpretation and learning, using behavioral studies and neural network models.
summary_zh: 研究分类和比较过程如何指导解释和学习，使用行为研究和神经网络模型。

name: Lisa M Savage
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiology of memory disorders, particularly Wernicke-Korsakoff's disease and alcohol-induced dementia, using animal models and circuit-level approaches.
summary_zh: 研究记忆障碍的神经生物学，特别是韦尼克-科尔萨科夫综合征和酒精引起的痴呆，使用动物模型和电路级方法。

name: David F Werner
title: Professor
summary: Studies the molecular targets in the brain, such as receptors and pathways, that influence alcohol's effects and development, using cellular and animal models.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中的分子靶点，如受体和通路，影响酒精作用及其在发育中的影响，使用细胞和动物模型。

name: Deanne L Westerman
title: Professor and Cognitive Area Coordinator
summary: Studies recognition memory processes, focusing on familiarity and the factors influencing memory decisions.
summary_zh: 研究识别记忆过程，重点关注熟悉感以及影响记忆决策的因素。

name: Emily L. Zale
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Biopsychosocial model of health and illness
summary: Studies the interplay between substance use, pain, and psychopathology, using laboratory and survey methods to develop interventions.
summary_zh: 研究物质使用、疼痛和心理障碍之间的相互作用，使用实验室和调查方法开发干预措施。

name: Yetunde Akinola
title: Faculty
summary: Studies developmental psychology, focusing on closing academic achievement gaps in Black and Brown communities.
summary_zh: 研究发展心理学，专注于缩小黑人和棕色人种社区的学术成就差距。

name: Ezer Kang
title: Professor
summary: Studies HIV stigma and its psychological effects on individuals, particularly in marginalized communities, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究HIV污名及其对边缘化群体的心理影响，采用定性和定量方法。

name: Darren Bernal
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the measurement and function of socioeconomic status in mental health disparities, mindfulness, and psychological well-being.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位在心理健康不平等、正念和心理福祉中的测量和功能。

name: Alfonso Campbell
title: Professor
summary: Studies physiological mechanisms of behavior using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究行为的生理机制，使用动物模型。

name: Terri Collin Dilmore
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychological health needs of justice-involved youth, focusing on racial identity and multi-generational trauma.
summary_zh: 研究司法涉及的青少年的心理健康需求，重点关注种族身份和代际创伤。

name: Jules Harrell
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly attention and memory, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是注意力和工作记忆，使用行为实验方法。

name: Hope Hill
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Ron Hopson
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Pastoral Care
summary: Studies the psychological implications of atonement theology and sexuality in the Black Church, using psychotherapy and pastoral care.
summary_zh: 研究赎罪神学和黑人教会性行为的心理影响，使用心理治疗和牧养关怀的方法。

name: Woojae Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops methodology for modeling research in psychology, focusing on optimal experimental design and computational cognition.
summary_zh: 开发心理学研究中的建模方法，重点是优化实验设计和计算认知。

name: Denee Thomas Mwendwa
title: Professor
summary: Studies the biopsychosocial factors influencing cardiovascular and neurocognitive health in African Americans, using community-based samples.
summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国人的心血管和神经认知健康的心理生物学和社会因素，使用社区样本。

name: Patrick Plummer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children develop language and social skills, using observational methods and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童语言和社会技能的发展，使用观察方法和实验。

name: Debra D Roberts
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies the impact of cultural and ethnic identity on the development of diasporic African children, focusing on normative development within various contexts.
summary_zh: 研究文化与种族身份对非洲裔 Diasporic 儿童规范性发展的影响。

name: Cynthia Winston
title: Professor
summary: Studies how personal narratives influence identity and academic success, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究个人叙事如何影响身份和学术成功，使用定性和定量方法。

name: Joshua Brown
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive control and decision-making in complex environments, using computational models and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究复杂环境中的认知控制和决策机制，使用计算模型和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Jerome Busemeyer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor and Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies decision-making processes and preferences using computational models and cognitive theories.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和偏好，使用计算模型和认知理论。

name: Thomas Busey
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological Brain Sciences
summary: Studies visual perception, recognition memory, and face recognition using EEG analysis and mathematical modeling.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、识别记忆和面孔识别，使用EEG分析和数学建模方法。

name: Natasha Chaku
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive development in adolescence, using intensive longitudinal assessments and physiological data to understand individual differences in executive functioning.
summary_zh: 研究青少年的认知发展，使用密集纵向评估和生理数据来理解执行功能的个体差异。

name: Hu Cheng
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies brain networks using diffusion tensor imaging and fMRI, focusing on structural connectivity and network topology.
summary_zh: 研究大脑网络，使用扩散张量成像和fMRI，关注结构连接性和网络拓扑结构。

name: Jonathon Crystal
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies animal models of episodic and prospective memory to understand cognitive impairments and develop treatments.
summary_zh: 研究动物模型的事件记忆和前瞻性记忆，以理解认知障碍并开发治疗方法。

name: Brian D'Onofrio
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Sharon Stephens Brehm Endowed Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the etiology, assessment, and treatment of behavioral health problems, using epidemiologic methods, longitudinal studies, and intervention research.
summary_zh: 研究行为健康问题的病因、评估和治疗方法，使用流行病学方法、纵向研究和干预研究。

name: Simon Davis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neurobiology of aging, focusing on cognitive changes with age.
summary_zh: 研究衰老的神经生物学，关注随年龄变化的认知变化。

name: Amanda Diekman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies gender roles and their influence on social roles and motivation, particularly in STEM fields.
summary_zh: 研究性别角色及其对社会角色和动机的影响，特别是在STEM领域。

name: Joseph Farley
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular bases of associative learning and memory, focusing on changes in ion channels and their contributions to learning in invertebrates and mammals.
summary_zh: 研究关联学习和记忆的细胞和分子基础，重点关注离子通道的变化及其在无脊椎动物和哺乳动物中的贡献。

name: Debra Finn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how working memory and externalizing psychopathology affect decision-making, particularly in young adults.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和外部化心理障碍如何影响决策，特别是在年轻人中的表现。

name: Emily Fyfe
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how children learn mathematics, using behavioral experiments and error analyses to understand cognitive development and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习数学，通过行为实验和错误分析来理解认知发展和学习过程。

name: Preston Garraghty
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Jason Gold
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how visual patterns are processed after initial sensory encoding, focusing on perceptual learning, face recognition, and visual memory.
summary_zh: 研究视觉模式在初始感觉编码之后的处理过程，重点在于知觉学习、面孔识别和视觉记忆。

name: Robert Goldstone
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor and Chancellor’s Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how context influences category learning and perception, using computational models and cognitive science methods.
summary_zh: 研究上下文如何影响类别学习和知觉，使用计算模型和认知科学方法。

name: Dorainne Green
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how social identity threat affects cognitive, psychological, and physiological outcomes, using experimental and longitudinal methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会身份威胁如何影响认知、心理和生理结果，采用实验和纵向方法。

name: Elizabeth Gunderson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Norbert Hajos
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the types and circuits of interneurons in the basolateral amygdala, using electrophysiology and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠基底外侧杏仁核中不同类型抑制性神经元及其环路，使用电生理和成像技术。

name: William Hetrick
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies global mental health and clinical neuroscience in East Africa, focusing on WEIRD science issues and developing clinical research infrastructure.
summary_zh: 研究东非的精神健康和临床神经科学，关注 WEIRD 科学问题并发展临床研究基础设施。

name: Edward Hirt
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how perceptions of mental depletion affect self-control and performance, with a focus on self-handicapping and mood effects.
summary_zh: 研究心理耗竭的感知如何影响自我控制和表现，重点关注自我设障和情绪效应。

name: Andrea Hohmann
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the endocannabinoid system and its role in pain and anxiety, using pharmacological inhibitors and animal models.
summary_zh: 研究内源性大麻素系统在疼痛和焦虑中的作用，使用药理学抑制剂和动物模型。

name: Kurt Hugenberg
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how stereotypes and prejudices influence perceptions of others' minds and bodies, using face and body cues.
summary_zh: 研究刻板印象和偏见如何影响对他人心理和身体的感知，利用面部和身体线索。

name: Tom James
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of human object recognition using functional MRI and psychophysics, integrating visual, somatosensory, and auditory perception.
summary_zh: 研究人类物体识别的神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和心理物理学，整合视觉、本体感觉和听觉感知。

name: Karin James
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how motor experience influences visual recognition in adults and children, using behavioral methods and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究运动经验如何影响成人和儿童的视觉识别，使用行为方法和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Mike Jones
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies semantic memory and its representations using distributional models and high-dimensional semantic spaces.
summary_zh: 研究语义记忆及其表示，使用分布模型和高维语义空间。

name: Daniel Kennedy
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies gaze patterns and social attention in autism spectrum disorder using eye-tracking and functional connectivity methods.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍中的凝视模式和社会注意力，使用眼动追踪和功能性连接方法。

name: Anne Krendl
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies social cognition and aging using functional MRI, focusing on how stigma and stereotypes affect older adults.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知和老化，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）探讨刻板印象和偏见如何影响老年人。

name: Lorenzo Lorenzo-Luaces
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies personalized medicine in cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) for depression, using machine learning and risk stratification.
summary_zh: 研究认知行为疗法（CBT）在抑郁症个性化治疗中的应用，使用机器学习和风险分层方法。

name: Hui-Chen Lu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how neuronal circuits are fine-tuned during brain development and how genetic and environmental factors affect neural wiring and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路在大脑发育期间如何精细调节以及遗传和环境因素如何影响神经回路的建立和行为。

name: Kenneth Mackie
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the effects of cannabinoids on pain and memory, using mouse models and organoids.
summary_zh: 研究大麻素对疼痛和记忆的影响，使用小鼠模型和类器官。

name: Ben Motz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly memory and attention, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是记忆和注意力，使用计算模型和行为实验。

name: Alexandra Moussa-Tooks
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究认知过程和大脑机制。

name: Ehren Newman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the role of cholinergic modulation on grid cell properties and cognitive processing in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究乙酰胆碱调节在网格细胞功能和认知处理中的作用。

name: Robert Nosofsky
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor and Chancellor's Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies how people categorize objects and recognize them, using models and neural network simulations.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何分类和识别物体，使用模型和神经网络模拟。

name: N. Bonnie Nozari
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: David Pisoni
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the earliest stages of speech perception, focusing on how acoustic-phonetic information interacts with lexical knowledge to support spoken word recognition and spoken language processing.
summary_zh: 研究语音感知的早期阶段，探讨声学-音位信息如何与词汇知识相互作用，以支持语音单词识别和口语语言处理。

name: Tim Pleskac
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies decision-making processes, particularly in risky environments and police decision-making, using models of evidence accumulation.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程，特别是在风险环境和警察决策中的过程，使用证据积累的模型。

name: Lauren Rutter
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional phenotypes that increase risk for internalizing psychopathology and cognitive aging, using experience sampling and natural language processing techniques.
summary_zh: 研究增加内化心理障碍风险的认知和情绪表型，使用体验抽样和自然语言处理技术。

name: Robert Rydell
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the effects of stereotype threat on learning and performance, and the differences between implicit and explicit attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究刻板印象威胁对学习和表现的影响以及隐性态度与显性态度之间的差异。

name: Dale Sengelaub
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies hormonal control of neural development and sex differences in the nervous system, using various species and anatomical techniques.
summary_zh: 研究激素对神经发育的控制以及神经系统中的性别差异，使用多种物种和解剖学技术。

name: Richard Shiffrin
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished and Luther Dana Waterman Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies recognition memory and visual perception, using associative recognition and stochastic stimuli.
summary_zh: 研究识别记忆和视觉感知，使用关联识别和随机刺激。

name: Linda Smith
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor and Chancellor's Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly memory and attention, using behavioral experiments and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是记忆和注意力，使用行为实验和神经成像技术。

name: Olaf Sporns
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor and Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies brain connectivity and networks, including anatomical and functional brain connectivity, using computational and network techniques.
summary_zh: 研究大脑连接性和网络，包括解剖和功能大脑连接性，使用复杂系统和网络技术。

name: Wei Tang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用计算模型和神经影像技术研究认知过程和大脑机制。

name: Peter Todd
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Provost Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive search processes in memory and decision-making, using neural and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和决策中的认知搜索过程，使用神经和计算方法。

name: Jennifer Trueblood
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Ruth N. Halls Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies decision-making under uncertainty, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究不确定性下的决策，使用行为实验和计算模型。

name: Richard Viken
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the genetic and environmental factors influencing adolescent behavior problems and adult outcomes such as alcohol abuse, and the cognitive processing related to clinical problems like alcohol.
summary_zh: 研究基因和环境因素对青少年行为问题以及成年期酒精滥用等结果的影响，并探讨与临床问题如酒精滥用和性侵犯相关的认知处理机制。

name: Cara Wellman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies the effects of chronic stress on neural activity and dendritic morphology in the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus, using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究慢性应激对前额叶皮层和海马神经活动和树突形态的影响，使用动物模型。

name: Krista Wisner
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies neural mechanisms underlying symptoms of psychosis and substance use with neuroimaging and novel paradigms, focusing on the insular cortex.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和物质使用障碍的症状背后的神经机制，使用神经成像和新型范式，重点关注岛叶皮层。

name: Ann-Sophie Barwich
title: Assistant Professor, Cognitive Science
summary: Studies the sense of smell as a model for mind and brain, focusing on the temporal integration of sensory and cognitive features in odor responses using EEG and olfactometry.
summary_zh: 研究嗅觉作为心智和大脑模型，关注气味感知中感觉和认知特征的时间整合，使用EEG和嗅觉测量技术。

name: Randall Beer
title: Provost Professor, Cognitive Science
summary: Studies how agents learn and act in complex environments, using computational models and robotics.
summary_zh: 研究智能体在复杂环境中的学习与行为，使用计算模型和机器人技术。

name: Erica Cartmill
title: Professor, Anthropology
summary: Studies the acquisition and evolution of human language, focusing on gesture and its role in communication and cognitive development.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言的获得与进化，重点关注手势在交流和认知发展中的作用。

name: Luis H. Favela
title: Associate Professor, History and Philosophy of Science and Medicine
summary: Explores the philosophical and historical foundations of cognitive science.
summary_zh: 探索认知科学的哲学和历史基础。

name: Andrew Goldman
title: Assistant Professor, Music Theory
summary: Studies improvisation in music and dance, using behavioral, perceptual, and neuroscientific methods.
summary_zh: 研究音乐和舞蹈中的即兴创作，使用行为、感知和神经科学方法。

name: William Holmes
title: Associate Professor, Mathematics
summary: Models complex systems using PDEs, dynamical systems, and Bayesian methods, with applications in mathematical biology and psychology.
summary_zh: 使用偏微分方程、动力系统和贝叶斯方法建模复杂系统，应用于数学生物学和心理学。

name: John M. Beggs
title: Professor, Biophysics
summary: Studies how neural networks organize themselves into metastable states and operate near critical points, using biophysics and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究神经网络如何组织成亚稳态并接近临界点，使用生物物理学和计算模型。

name: Gavin Bidelman
title: Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies how sound and music affect the brain, using auditory cognitive neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究声音和音乐如何影响大脑，采用听觉认知神经科学方法。

name: Kathryn Bonnen
title: Assistant Professor of Vision Science, Optometry
summary: Studies 3D vision, sensorimotor processing related to walking and eye movements, and visual encoding.
summary_zh: 研究三维视觉、与行走和眼球运动相关的传感器运动处理以及视觉编码。

name: Stephen A. Burns
title: Professor, School of Optometry
summary: Studies the impact of retinal disease on retinal structure and function, and the control of blood flow in the retina.
summary_zh: 研究视网膜疾病对视网膜结构和功能的影响，以及视网膜血流的控制。

name: T. Rowan Candy
title: Professor, Optometry and Vision Science, School of Optometry
summary: Studies visual development during infancy and early childhood, ocular motor performance, and vision.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿的视觉发展、眼动性能和视觉。

name: Gregory E. Demas
title: Professor, Biology
summary: Studies neuroendocrine-immune interactions and seasonal changes in immunity in rodents, using melatonin, hormones, and behavioral tests.
summary_zh: 研究神经内分泌-免疫相互作用和季节性免疫变化在啮齿动物中的作用，使用褪黑激素、激素和行为测试。

name: Silvina Ferradal
title: Assistant Professor of Intelligent Systems Engineering
summary: Studies neuroengineering and neuroimaging, using magnetic resonance imaging to design biomedical systems.
summary_zh: 从事神经工程和神经成像研究，使用磁共振成像设计生物医学系统。

name: Kess Folco
title: Faculty
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of motor control and learning, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和学习的神经机制，使用计算模型和行为实验。

name: María de la Paz Fernandez
title: Associate Professor, Biology
summary: Studies the neuronal basis of sex differences in circadian clock network organization and function using Drosophila, combining genetics, imaging, and behavioral assays.
summary_zh: 研究节律钟网络中性别差异的神经基础，使用果蝇结合遗传学、成像和行为实验方法。

name: Eleftherios Garyfallidis
title: Associate Professor, Intelligent Systems Engineering, School of Informatics and Computing
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using engineering and computing techniques.
summary_zh: 使用工程和计算技术研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

name: Feng Guo
title: Assistant Professor, Intelligent Systems Engineering
summary: Studies cognitive and computational aspects of brain function, using intelligent systems engineering methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知和计算方面的脑功能，使用智能系统工程方法。

name: Samantha Gustafson
title: Assistant Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies communication challenges in school-age children with and without hearing loss, using subjective, behavioral, and electrophysiologic methods.
summary_zh: 研究学龄儿童（包括听力障碍儿童）的沟通挑战，使用主观、行为和电生理方法。

name: Laura Hurley
title: Professor, Biology
summary: Studies how serotonin-auditory interactions filter important information in mice, using electrophysiology and behavioral analysis.
summary_zh: 研究血清素-听觉相互作用如何过滤重要信息，使用电生理学和行为分析方法。

name: Andrea Parolin Jackowski
title: Professor, Health and Wellness Design, Applied Health Science
summary: Studies the impact of early life adversities on brain development and mental health, using neuroimaging and clinical trials.
summary_zh: 研究早期生活逆境对大脑发育和心理健康的影响，使用神经成像和临床试验方法。

name: Blair Johnson
title: Associate Professor, School of Public Health
summary: Studies cognitive and computational processes, focusing on behavioral and translational research.
summary_zh: 研究认知和计算过程，侧重于行为和转化研究。

name: Keisuke Kawata
title: Professor, Kinesiology, School of Public Health
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of motor control and learning, using computational models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究运动控制和学习的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Sachiko Koya
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how social environment affects physiological conditions and behaviors through pheromones and social status in mice and humans, focusing on neurogenesis.
summary_zh: 研究社会环境如何通过气味分子和社会地位影响生理状态和行为，重点关注神经发生。

name: Joo Yeun Lee
title: Assistant Professor, School of Optometry
summary: Studies visual neuroscience, focusing on retinal circuits and synaptic integration, using electrophysiology and high-resolution imaging.
summary_zh: 从事视觉神经科学研究，关注视网膜电路和突触整合，使用电生理学和高分辨率成像技术。

name: Jennifer J. Lentz
title: Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies auditory perception in listeners with normal hearing and hearing loss, developing tools to diagnose and characterize tinnitus.
summary_zh: 研究正常听力和听力损失听者的听觉感知，开发诊断和表征耳鸣的工具。

name: Steven Lulich
title: Associate Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies speech production and modeling using 3D/4D ultrasound imaging techniques to explore the intersection of anatomy, articulation, acoustics, and aerodynamics.
summary_zh: 研究语音产生和建模，使用3D/4D超声成像技术探索解剖学、发音、声学和气动学之间的交集。

name: Melissa M. Pangelinan
title: Associate Professor, Department of Kinesiology, School of Public Health
summary: Develops and measures the efficacy of physical activity interventions on neurocognitive and physical health outcomes in children, adolescents, and adults with intellectual and developmental.
summary_zh: 开发和评估针对智力和发育障碍儿童、青少年和成人的体育活动干预措施对神经认知和身体健康结果的有效性。

name: Rob Potter
title: Professor and Director of the Institute for Communication Research
summary: Studies the effects of audio and music on emotion and social interactions using psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究音频和音乐对情绪及社会互动的影响，使用生理心理学方法。

name: G. Troy Smith
title: Associate Professor, Biology
summary: Studies how the nervous system controls rhythmic behavior and how hormones influence neural physiology to modify behavior in weakly electric fish.
summary_zh: 研究神经系统如何控制节律行为以及激素如何影响神经生理学以改变行为，特别是在弱电鱼中的研究。

name: Caroline Spencer
title: Assistant Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies the neural and behavioral mechanisms of speech production, focusing on atypical speech motor control in disorders.
summary_zh: 研究言语产生中的神经和行为机制，特别是在障碍中的异常言语运动控制。

name: Brielle Stark
title: Associate Professor, Speech, Language and Hearing Sciences
summary: Studies spoken discourse in aphasia, using microlinguistic analysis and virtual study methods.
summary_zh: 研究失语症患者的口语表达，采用微语言分析和虚拟研究方法。

name: Zoran Tiganj
title: Assistant Professor, Computer Science
summary: Develops computational models of cognitive processes, using AI techniques to simulate human cognition.
summary_zh: 开发认知过程的计算模型，使用人工智能技术模拟人类认知。

name: Christopher Mayhorn
title: is a Professor in the Human Factors and Applied Cognitive Psychology program
summary: Studies everyday memory, decision-making, and human-computer interaction, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究日常生活中的记忆、决策和人机交互，采用多种实验方法。

name: Jing Feng
title: Professor
summary: Studies attention across the visual field and its applications in aging and driving, using both theoretical and practical approaches.
summary_zh: 研究视觉场中的注意力及其在老化和驾驶中的应用，采用理论和实践相结合的方法。

name: Yingchen He
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies visual constraints in daily tasks, accessibility of technology for people with visual differences, and brain plasticity following training and vision loss.
summary_zh: 研究视觉限制在日常任务中的作用、视力障碍人士的技术可访问性以及训练和长期视力丧失后的脑可塑性。

name: Anne McLaughlin
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive ergonomics and learning processes, focusing on human factors and aging.
summary_zh: 研究认知人机工程学和学习过程，重点关注人类因素和老化。

name: Colleen Patton
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies human-automation interaction, focusing on perceptions and decisions of human operators in using automation.
summary_zh: 研究人机交互，关注人类操作者在使用自动化工具时的感知和决策过程。

name: John Begeny
title: Professor
summary: Studies methods to improve educational equity through academic interventions and school-based systems.
summary_zh: 研究通过学术干预和学校系统提高教育公平的方法。

name: Jennifer Burnette
title: Professor
summary: Studies how to reduce depression in youth through growth mindset interventions, improving self-regulation and health.
summary_zh: 研究通过成长心态干预减少青少年抑郁，提高自我调节和健康。

name: Vanessa Volpe
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies the impact of race-related stress on health outcomes in Black people from the African diaspora, focusing on online and technological contexts.
summary_zh: 研究种族相关压力对非洲裔美国人健康结果的影响，重点关注在线和技术环境。

name: Lori Hoggard
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies the physiological and psychological impacts of racism on African American communities, focusing on cardiovascular disease and mental health.
summary_zh: 研究种族主义对非洲裔美国人社区的生理和心理影响，重点关注心血管疾病和心理健康。

name: Tim Michaelis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the psychological determinants of entrepreneurial behavior, including resourcefulness, persistence, and health.
summary_zh: 研究创业行为的心理决定因素，包括资源利用、坚持性和健康状况。

name: S. Bartholomew Craig
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies organizational leadership and counterproductive work behavior using psychological measurement.
summary_zh: 研究组织领导力和反生产性工作行为，使用心理测量方法。

name: Lori Foster
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点关注记忆和学习过程。

name: Adam Meade
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Jenna McChesney
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Jason Allaire
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies cognitive changes and health disparities in older adults, using cognitive tests and real-world data.
summary_zh: 研究老年人的认知变化和健康不平等，使用认知测试和现实世界数据。

name: Daniel Gruehn
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies socio-emotional functioning and emotion-cognition interactions in adulthood and old age, including empathy and social rejection.
summary_zh: 研究成年期和老年期的情绪和社会认知互动，包括同理心和社会排斥。

name: Kelly Lynn Mulvey
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children's social and moral development influences their intergroup relations and challenges to peer norms.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会和道德发展如何影响他们的群体关系以及对同伴规范的挑战。

name: Shevaun Neupert
title: Professor
summary: Studies how daily stressors and coping strategies affect subjective age and emotional well-being in older adults.
summary_zh: 研究日常压力和应对策略如何影响老年人的主观年龄和情绪福祉。

name: Aura Mishra
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies how life-course adversity affects health and behavior, using biopsychosocial approaches.
summary_zh: 研究生命周期逆境如何影响健康和行为，采用生物心理社会方法。

name: Breanne Wylie
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies how children report experiences of maltreatment when questioned by adults, using experimental and field-based methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童在被成人询问时报告虐待经历的能力，采用实验和实地方法。

name: Lindsey McGowen
title: Faculty
summary: Evaluates the outcomes and impacts of cooperative research centers involving academia and the private sector.
summary_zh: 评估涉及学术界和私营部门合作研究项目的成果和影响。

name: Scott Stage
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies the over-representation of students of color in exclusionary discipline and the effects of adverse childhood experiences on mental health.
summary_zh: 研究学生种族在排斥性纪律处分中的过度代表以及不良童年经历对心理健康的影响。

name: Jason Frydman
title: Assoc Professor
summary: Studies the role of creative arts in promoting K-12 students' mental health and wellbeing, integrating arts-based approaches in school mental health systems.
summary_zh: 研究创意艺术在促进K-12学生心理健康和福祉中的作用，将艺术导向的方法整合到学校心理健康系统中。

name: Kristen Mahony-Atallah
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies positive psychology interventions and well-being supports in educational settings, focusing on strengths-based approaches and implementation processes.
summary_zh: 研究学校环境中的积极心理学干预和福祉支持，侧重于基于优势的方法和实施过程。

name: Nicholas Scheel
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies school safety, multi-tiered systems of support, and social-emotional well-being in youth.
summary_zh: 研究学校安全、多级支持系统和支持学生的情绪和社会福祉。

name: Isaac Woods
title: Asst Professor
summary: Studies the academic, behavioral, social, and emotional development of Black children and adolescents, focusing on culturally responsive assessment and school mental health services.
summary_zh: 研究黑人儿童和青少年的认知发展、行为、社会和情感发展，重点关注文化响应性评估和学校心理健康服务。

name: Paul Boxer
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly working memory and attention, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是工作记忆和注意力，使用行为实验。

name: Mauricio Delgado
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social and economic factors influence decision-making and emotions, using neuroeconomic experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会和经济因素如何影响决策和情绪，使用神经经济学实验方法。

name: William Graves
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes, particularly working memory and attention, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是工作记忆和注意力，使用行为实验方法。

title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Kent Harber
title: Professor and Graduate Director
summary: Studies social influence on decision-making and group behavior, using experiments with humans.
summary_zh: 研究社会影响下的决策与群体行为，使用人类实验方法。

name: Samantha Heintzelman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Barry Komisaruk
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of sexual response and orgasm in humans, using MRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究人类性反应和高潮的神经基础，使用MRI和行为实验。

name: Vanessa LoBue
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Kimele Persaud
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和注意力。

summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Razia Sahi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知过程的发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Karen Smith
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Elizabeth Tricomi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Sean Trott
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Gretchen Van de Walle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Joseph Jay Williams
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies computational models of decision-making and learning, using mathematical and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究决策和学习的计算模型，使用数学和计算方法。

name: Ken Aizawa
title: Professor
summary: Studies the nature of mental states and their relation to the brain, focusing on philosophical issues in cognitive science.
summary_zh: 研究心智状态的本质及其与大脑的关系，重点关注认知科学中的哲学问题。

name: Jennifer Austin
title: Faculty
summary: Studies not relevant to psychology, cognitive science or neuroscience.
summary_zh: 与心理学、认知科学或神经科学无关的研究。

name: April Benasich
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in infants using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知发展，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

name: Michael Cole
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Raffaella DeRosa
title: Professor, Chair
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和记忆。

name: Mark Gluck
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and learning, using computational models and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和学习，使用计算模型和行为实验。

name: NTT Criteria
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为，使用多种实验方法。

name: Denis Pare
dept: Center for Molecular and Behavioral Neuroscience
title: Distinguished Professor, CMBN Co-director
summary: Studies the neural basis of learning and memory using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经基础，使用行为和神经影像技术。

name: Bart Krekelberg
dept: Center for Molecular and Behavioral Neuroscience
title: Professor, CMBN Co-director
summary: Studies visual perception using transcranial stimulation, eye movements, and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知，使用经颅刺激、眼动和计算模型方法。

name: Tibor Koos
dept: Center for Molecular and Behavioral Neuroscience
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of learning and memory in rodents using electrophysiology and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经基础，使用电生理学和行为实验方法。

name: Juan Mena-Segovia
dept: Center for Molecular and Behavioral Neuroscience
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits involved in action selection and motor execution, using connectivity, electrophysiology, and behavior.
summary_zh: 研究参与动作选择和运动执行的神经回路，使用连接性、电生理学和行为学方法。

name: Gerry Altmann
title: Professor and Director of Perception, Action, and Cognition
summary: Studies how individuals build representations of events described by unfolding language using eye-tracking and neuroscientific methods.
summary_zh: 研究个体如何通过不断的语言描述构建事件表征，使用眼动追踪和神经科学方法。

name: Robert Astur
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the memory of neurobiology, focusing on the hippocampus and amygdala, using tasks that are highly translational to examine risk factors for anxiety disorders, substance abuse, and depression.
summary_zh: 研究神经生物学中的记忆，重点是海马体和杏仁核，使用高度可转化的任务来研究焦虑障碍、物质滥用和抑郁症的风险因素，并开发干预措施。

name: Nick Audette
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain combines sensory input with environmental context to help perceive the world, using neural recordings in mice.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何结合感官输入和环境上下文来帮助感知世界，使用小鼠的大规模神经记录。

name: Augusto Buchweitz
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies early literacy and brain development in underrepresented populations, using brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究欠发达地区儿童的早期读写能力和大脑发展，采用脑成像技术。

name: Jeffrey Burke
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the development and outcomes of disruptive behavior disorders, focusing on irritability and its link to depression and anxiety in children.
summary_zh: 研究破坏性行为障碍的发展及其后果，重点关注易怒与儿童抑郁和焦虑之间的联系。

name: Leslie Burton
title: Professor
summary: Studies gender and cultural differences in cognition and emotion, including metacognition and frontal lobe functioning.
summary_zh: 研究性别、文化和个体差异的认知和情绪，包括元认知和前额叶功能。

name: Chi-Ming Chen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural oscillations and their role in schizophrenia, using electrophysiology and transcranial magnetic stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究神经振荡及其在精神分裂症中的作用，使用电生理学和经颅磁刺激方法。

name: James Chrobak
title: Department Head, Professor
summary: Studies how neuronal synchronization in the hippocampus varies along the septotemporal axis and how it is affected by environmental factors, behavior, and pharmacology, relating to memory formation.
summary_zh: 研究海马沿隔底轴的神经同步性如何变化以及受环境因素、行为和药理学影响，并与记忆形成的关系。

name: Marie Coppola
title: Professor
summary: Studies language acquisition and creation, focusing on how early exposure to language affects numerical cognition in deaf and hearing children.
summary_zh: 研究语言习得和创造，重点关注早期语言接触如何影响聋童和听童的数理认知。

name: Kimberly Cuevas
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of cognitive skills in infants and young children, focusing on learning, memory, and executive function using EEG methods.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿认知技能的发展，重点在于学习、记忆和工作记忆，使用EEG方法。

name: James Dixon
title: Professor and Director of Ecological Psychology
summary: Studies self-organization in perception, action, and cognition, and thermodynamic origins of behavior.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、动作和认知的自组织以及行为的热力学起源。

name: Amy Egbert
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social stressors, particularly discriminatory experiences, influence the development of psychopathology in youth, with a focus on eating disorders and coping mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究社会压力源（尤其是歧视性经历）如何影响青少年心理障碍的发展，特别是饮食障碍和应对机制。

name: Inge-Marie Eigsti
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neurocognitive processes underlying language acquisition and social communication in autism, using brain imaging and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症的语言获取和社会沟通的认知神经过程，使用脑成像和行为方法。

name: Roslyn Fitch
title: Professor
summary: Studies rodent models of developmental disability and neonatal brain injury, focusing on the modulating effects of hormones and experience, and neuroprotection.
summary_zh: 研究发育性残疾和新生儿脑损伤的啮齿动物模型，关注激素和经验的作用以及神经保护。

name: Till Frank
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies human perception and motor control using dynamical systems and stochastic modeling.
summary_zh: 研究人类感知和运动控制，使用动力系统和随机建模方法。

name: Alexandra Garr-Schultz
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies identity, self-definition, and experiences of marginalization among underrepresented groups, using experimental and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究边缘化群体的身份、自我定义及其经历，采用实验和定性方法。

name: Amy Gorin
title: Professor
summary: Studies weight loss and maintenance strategies, focusing on motivational and environmental factors affecting eating and physical activity.
summary_zh: 研究减肥和维持策略，重点关注影响饮食和身体活动的动机和环境因素。

name: Sarah Gray
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the developmental consequences of trauma and early life adversity, focusing on intergenerational processes and prevention programs.
summary_zh: 研究早期创伤和生活逆境的发展后果，重点关注代际过程和预防项目。

name: Fumiko Hoeft
title: Professor, Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of brain development and learning, focusing on literacy skills and dyslexia in children.
summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和学习的神经生物学机制，重点关注儿童的阅读技能和诵读障碍。

name: Blair Johnson
title: Board of Trustees Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies health promotion, specifically exercise, mindfulness, and music performance anxiety, using meta-analysis and spatiotemporal methods.
summary_zh: 研究健康促进，特别是运动、正念和音乐表演焦虑，使用元分析和时空方法。

name: Seth Kalichman
title: Professor
summary: Studies the behavioral and social aspects of HIV/AIDS, focusing on interventions to prevent HIV spread and improve health care access and adherence.
summary_zh: 研究艾滋病的行为和社会方面，重点在于预防艾滋病传播和提高医疗保健准入及依从性的干预措施。

name: Arielle Keller
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies attention as a core element of human cognition, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods to explore its development and disruptions.
summary_zh: 研究注意力作为人类认知的核心要素，通过神经成像和行为评估方法探索其发展和中断。

name: Nicole Landi
title: Professor and Director of Developmental Psychology
summary: Studies reading and language development using ERP, MRI, and neuroimaging genetics.
summary_zh: 使用ERP、MRI和神经影像遗传学研究阅读和语言发展。

name: Edward Large
title: Professor
summary: Studies auditory neuroscience and music psychology, using psychophysics, fMRI, and EEG to understand neural dynamics in response to music.
summary_zh: 研究听觉神经科学和音乐心理学，使用心理物理学、fMRI 和 EEG 理解音乐对神经动态的影响。

name: Vicki Magley
title: Professor and Director of Industrial and Organizational Psychology
summary: Studies workplace incivility and sexual harassment, focusing on interventions and their effectiveness.
summary_zh: 研究职场不礼貌和性骚扰，关注干预措施及其有效性。

name: James Magnuson
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural and behavioral bases of language processing, including spoken and written language, using computational models and electrophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理的神经和行为基础，包括口头和书面语言，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

name: Etan Markus
title: Professor and Associate Department Head of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how memory formation changes with aging, focusing on the hippocampal system in rats using behavioral tasks and neural monitoring.
summary_zh: 研究记忆形成随年龄变化的机制，重点关注大鼠的海马系统，使用行为任务和神经监测技术。

name: Kerry Marsh
title: Professor
areas: Implicit attitudes and HIV risk behavior
summary: Studies motivational and affective processes in persuasion, social cognition, and behavior, using immersive virtual reality methods and ecological approaches.
summary_zh: 研究动机和情感过程在说服、社会认知和行为中的作用，使用沉浸式虚拟现实方法和生态学方法。

name: Steven Mellor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies union-management psychology and self-evaluation in the workplace, focusing on union tolerance and work motivation.
summary_zh: 研究工会-管理层心理学和工作场所的自我评价，重点关注工会容忍度和工作动机。

name: Jonas Miller
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social and physical environmental factors affect brain development, empathy, and mental health in children and adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究社会和物理环境因素如何影响儿童和青少年的大脑发育、同理心和心理健康。

name: Crystal Park
title: Board of Trustees Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies coping with stress, meaning making, and yoga's effects on health, particularly in cancer survivors and veterans.
summary_zh: 研究应对压力、意义构建以及瑜伽对健康的影响，特别是在癌症幸存者和退伍军人中的应用。

name: Alexandra Paxton
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies communication and social interaction as a complex dynamical system, using data-rich and dynamics-focused methods.
summary_zh: 研究沟通和社会互动作为复杂的动态系统，采用数据丰富和动态导向的方法。

name: Felicia Pratto
title: Professor and Director of Social Psychology
summary: Studies the processes and consequences of inequality, including race- and sex-discrimination, using experiments and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究不平等的过程及其后果，包括种族和性别歧视，使用实验和调查方法。

name: Kenneth Pugh
title: Professor
summary: Studies reading processes and phonological deficits using fMRI and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究阅读过程和音位缺陷，使用功能性磁共振成像和神经影像学技术。

name: Diane Quinn
title: Professor and Associate Dean for Life and Behavioral Sciences and Undergraduate Affairs
summary: Studies the psychological and health outcomes of people with socially stigmatized identities, focusing on obesity and weight stigma.
summary_zh: 研究社会上标签化身份个体的心理和健康结果，重点关注肥胖和体重标签化。

name: Nairán Ramírez-Esparza
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how culture and language influence personality, behavior, and health using digital recording devices, text analysis, and brain measures.
summary_zh: 研究文化和语言如何影响人格、行为和健康，使用数字录音设备、文本分析和脑部测量方法。

name: John Salamone
title: Board of Trustees Distinguished Professor and Director of Behavioral Neuroscience
summary: Studies the behavioral functions of neurotransmitters like dopamine, acetylcholine, serotonin, and adenosine, using animal models of neurological and psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究多巴胺、乙酰胆碱、血清素和腺苷等神经递质的行为功能，使用神经精神障碍的动物模型进行研究。

name: Rhiannon Smith
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies friendships and social-emotional adjustment in childhood and adolescence, focusing on the development of social cognition and empathy in friendships.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年时期的友谊和社会情绪适应，重点关注友谊中社会认知和同理心的发展。

name: Lorena Solis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring, retention, and career advancement practices for marginalized groups.
summary_zh: 研究多样性和包容性在招聘、保留和职业晋升实践中的表现，特别是针对历史上被边缘化的群体。

name: Ian Stevenson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops computational tools to model neural dynamics and link neural data with perception, behavior, and learning.
summary_zh: 开发计算工具来描述和解码神经活动，将神经数据与感知、行为和学习联系起来。

name: Umay Suanda
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children learn words from their environment, focusing on statistical learning and the dynamics of early social interactions.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何从环境中学词，重点在于统计学习和社会互动的动力学。

name: Whitney Tabor
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how structured systems and language change through sentence processing and group coordination, using cognitive and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究结构系统和语言变化的句法和语义编码，以及群体协调，采用认知和计算方法。

name: Kimberli Treadwell
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies childhood anxiety and worry, focusing on generalized anxiety disorder in adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究儿童焦虑和担忧，特别是在青少年中的广泛焦虑障碍。

name: Maxim Volgushev
title: Professor
areas: Signal processing in visual cortical neurons in vivo
Generation of action potentials and cell electrophysiology
summary: Studies the neurophysiology of the visual system, focusing on signal processing in visual cortical neurons and synaptic transmission.
summary_zh: 研究视觉系统的神经生理学，重点在于视觉皮层神经元的信号处理和突触传递。

name: Eiling Yee
title: Associate Professor
areas: Semantic memory and the neural representation of concepts
Spoken word recognition and language processing
summary: Studies how meaning is represented in the brain, focusing on semantic memory and the neural basis of language.
summary_zh: 研究概念的认知神经科学，特别是语义记忆和语言的神经基础。

name: Angela Incollingo Rodriguez
title: Associate Professor & Program Director, Psychological and Cognitive Sciences
summary: Studies the impact of weight stigma on health behaviors and disparities, using mixed-methods approaches.
summary_zh: 研究体重歧视对健康行为和差异的影响，采用混合方法。

name: Jim Doyle
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people develop mental models of complex environmental and societal problems, using judgment and decision-making research to improve personal and public decision-making.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何构建复杂环境和社会问题的心理模型，并通过判断与决策研究改进个人和公共决策。

name: Richard Lopez
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how digital media and emerging technologies affect emotional regulation and mental health, using EEG and fNIRS.
summary_zh: 研究数字媒体和新兴技术如何影响情绪调节和心理健康，使用EEG和fNIRS等工具。

name: Erin Ottmar
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how classroom interventions improve mathematics teaching and learning, using dynamic educational technologies and multi-level modeling.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过动态教育技术改进数学教学和学习，使用多层次建模方法。

name: Stacy Shaw
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how anxiety and classroom experiences affect mathematical cognition and reasoning, and the role of rest in academic achievement and student wellbeing.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑和课堂经验如何影响数学认知和推理，以及休息在学术成就和学生福祉中的作用。

name: Jeanine Skorinko
title: Professor
summary: Studies how social and contextual factors influence decisions and interpersonal interactions, particularly in legal and organizational settings.
summary_zh: 研究社会和环境因素如何影响决策和人际互动，特别是在法律和组织领域。

name: Shubham Agrawal
title: Assistant Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies human factors in transportation, particularly connected and automated vehicles and traveler behavior.
summary_zh: 研究交通领域的人因工程，特别是连接和自动化车辆以及旅行者行为。

name: Betsy Albritton
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies leadership, emotions, and quantitative research methods, focusing on the impact of modern prediction methods like deep learning and natural language processing.
summary_zh: 研究领导力、情绪和定量研究方法，重点关注现代预测方法（如深度学习和自然语言处理）的影响。

name: Jinan Allan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the effects of cognitive abilities and statistical numeracy on decision-making and risk literacy, using behavioral science and psychometric techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知能力和统计数商对决策和风险素养的影响，使用行为科学和心理测量技术。

name: Anna Baker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies strategies to improve patient adherence in healthcare through communication and intervention, focusing on anxiety and genetic results.
summary_zh: 研究通过沟通和干预策略提高患者在医疗系统中的依从性，重点关注焦虑和基因结果。

name: Brooke Bennett
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the impact of media use and digital interventions on eating behaviors and body image, particularly in diverse and underserved populations.
summary_zh: 研究媒体使用和数字干预对饮食行为和身体形象的影响，特别是在多样性和未服务群体中的影响。

name: Thomas Britt
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies factors that enhance the resilience of employees in high-risk occupations, focusing on stigma and barriers to mental health care.
summary_zh: 研究高风险职业（如军事人员、警察、消防员、急救人员、情报分析师）员工的韧性增强因素，重点关注 stigma 和心理健康护理障碍。

name: Kaileigh Byrne
title: Wallace R. Roy Distinguished Associate Professor
summary: Studies individual differences and mechanisms of reward-based decision-making using neuroimaging, computational, genetics, and physiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异和基于奖励的决策机制，使用神经成像、计算、遗传学和生理学方法。

name: Claudio Cantalupo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the evolution of hemispheric specialization in primates, focusing on handedness and brain asymmetries.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物大脑半球专业化进化的机制，重点关注手偏好和大脑不对称。

name: Hye Won Chai
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how family and social relationships affect health outcomes in middle and older adults, using daily experience assessments.
summary_zh: 研究家庭和社会关系如何影响中老年人的健康结果，使用日常经验评估方法。

name: Alyssa Gamaldo-Roddy
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive functioning in diverse adult populations, focusing on adverse and protective factors like sleep and social support.
summary_zh: 研究不同成人群体的认知功能，重点关注睡眠和社会支持等不利和保护因素。

name: Robin Kowalski
title: Professor
summary: Studies aversive interpersonal behaviors, particularly cyber bullying and complaining, with a focus on psychological mattering and its relation to suicide and school shootings.
summary_zh: 研究令人不悦的人际行为，特别是网络欺凌和抱怨，以及心理重要性与其自杀和学校枪击事件的关系。

name: Richard Pak
title: Professor
summary: Studies human interactions with autonomous technologies, focusing on trust, attention control, and cognitive factors.
summary_zh: 研究人类与自主技术的交互，重点关注信任、注意力控制和认知因素。

name: Irene Pericot-Valverde
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies tobacco and opioid addiction, focusing on public health disparities and integrated interventions.
summary_zh: 研究烟草和阿片类药物成瘾，重点关注公共卫生不平等和综合干预措施。

name: Cynthia Pury
title: Professor
summary: Studies courage and its applications in various contexts such as organizations, performing arts, healthcare, and interpersonal relationships.
summary_zh: 研究勇气及其在组织、表演艺术、医疗保健和人际交往等不同领域的应用。

name: Pat Raymark
title: Professor, Department Chair
summary: Studies decision-making processes in employment interviews, job analysis, and performance appraisal.
summary_zh: 研究招聘面试、职位分析和绩效评估中的决策过程。

name: Patrick Rosopa
title: Professor
summary: Teaches and conducts research on statistical methods and applied psychology, focusing on univariate and multivariate statistics.
summary_zh: 教授和研究统计方法和应用心理学，专注于单变量和多变量统计。

name: Lesley Ross
title: Professor and SmartState/SmartLife Endowed Chair in Aging and Cognition
summary: Studies predictors of everyday function in older adults, focusing on cognitive aging and interventions for healthy aging.
summary_zh: 研究老年人日常功能的预测因素，重点关注认知老化和促进健康老龄化的干预措施。

name: Robert Sinclair
title: Professor
summary: Studies economic stressors and organizational climates that affect worker health and well-being, using psychological theories and methods.
summary_zh: 研究经济压力和组织氛围对工人健康和福祉的影响，使用心理学理论和方法。

name: Dustin Souders
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how older adults use advanced driver assistance systems and fully autonomous vehicles, using driving simulators and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究老年人如何使用高级驾驶辅助系统和完全自动驾驶车辆，使用驾驶模拟器和眼动追踪技术。

name: Mary Taylor
title: Professor
summary: Studies retirement adaptation and employment challenges for minority and older workers, often in real-world settings.
summary_zh: 研究老年人和少数群体就业挑战及退休适应问题，通常在实际工作环境中进行。

name: Allison Traylor
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies team dynamics and leadership in healthcare settings, particularly in neonatal intensive care units.
summary_zh: 研究医疗团队动态和领导力，特别是在新生儿重症监护病房。

name: Rick Tyrrell
title: Professor
summary: Studies how well people see in challenging conditions, using on-road studies to improve pedestrian and cyclist safety at night.
summary_zh: 研究人在复杂条件下的视觉表现，通过道路实地研究提高夜间行人的可见性和安全性。

name: Jenna Van Fossen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies worker health and well-being, focusing on the impact of new technologies on career and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究工作者的健康和福祉，重点关注新技术对其职业生涯和福祉的影响。

name: Hasan Ayaz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences, School of Biomedical Engineering, Science and Health Systems
summary: Studies neuroergonomics and functional neuroimaging, focusing on real-world contexts and brain-computer interfaces using EEG and fNIRS.
summary_zh: 从事神经人机交互和功能性神经成像研究，重点关注实际应用场景，并使用EEG和fNIRS进行脑机接口研究。

name: Meghan L. Butryn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies obesity prevention and treatment, physical activity promotion, and lifestyle modification using behavioral therapy.
summary_zh: 研究肥胖预防和治疗、体力活动促进和生活方式改变，采用行为疗法。

name: Evangelia G. Chrysikou
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive flexibility and creative thinking, using fMRI and tECS to explore the neural basis of problem solving and semantic memory organization.
summary_zh: 研究认知灵活性和创造性思维，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅电刺激（tECS）探索问题解决和语义记忆组织的神经基础。

name: Brian P. Daly
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies evidence-based psychosocial interventions for youth, socioemotional learning, and school mental health promotion.
summary_zh: 研究针对青少年的心理社会干预、社会情感学习以及学校心理健康促进。

name: David DeMatteo
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychological and Brain Sciences
summary: Studies psychopathy and forensic mental health assessment, focusing on legal contexts and offender behavior.
summary_zh: 研究心理变态和司法心理健康评估，重点关注法律环境和犯罪行为。

name: Naomi E. Goldstein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies juvenile justice reform and adolescent development, collaborating with agencies to improve policy and practice.
summary_zh: 研究青少年司法改革和青少年发展，与机构合作改善政策和实践。

name: John Kounios
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how sudden insights occur in problem-solving, using brain activity patterns and cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究突发灵感在解决问题中的发生机制，使用脑活动模式和认知神经科学方法。

name: Aaron Kucyi
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the neuroscience of spontaneous thought, using fMRI and electrophysiology to understand how mental experiences arise from brain activity.
summary_zh: 研究自发思维的神经科学，使用功能性磁共振成像和电生理学方法理解大脑活动如何产生心理体验。

name: Nancy Raitano Lee
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the causes and correlates of learning difficulties in individuals with Down syndrome and autism spectrum disorder, focusing on executive function and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究唐氏综合症和自闭症谱系障碍患者学习困难的原因和相关因素，重点关注执行功能和神经成像。

name: Matthew Lerner
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor and Life Course Outcomes Program Leader
summary: Studies social development and connection across the lifespan, using advanced quantitative methods and electrophysiology to develop interventions for neurodiverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究生命历程中的社会发展和连接，使用高级定量方法和脑电图来开发神经多样性群体的干预措施。

name: Michael R. Lowe
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the origins and treatments of obesity and eating disorders, focusing on hedonic hunger and weight variability.
summary_zh: 研究肥胖和进食障碍的起源和治疗方法，重点关注享乐性饥饿和体重波动。

name: John D. Medaglia
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies self-control and brain function using network analysis, neuroimaging, and brain stimulation in healthy and clinical samples.
summary_zh: 研究自我控制和脑功能，使用网络分析、神经成像和脑刺激方法，在健康和临床样本中进行研究。

name: James R. Muruthi
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social relationships and psychosocial experiences affect resilience, health, and well-being across the lifespan, with a focus on Black men and cardiometabolic health.
summary_zh: 研究社会关系和心理社会经历如何影响生命历程中的韧性、健康和福祉，重点关注黑人男性和心血管代谢健康。

name: Diana Robins
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Director
summary: Studies early detection of autism in toddlers using screening tools and validation of diagnostic methods.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症早期检测方法和筛查工具的验证，特别是在幼儿中的应用。

name: Maria T. Schultheis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops virtual reality technologies to assess and rehabilitate cognitive functions in individuals with neurological impairments, focusing on driving capacity.
summary_zh: 开发虚拟现实技术评估和康复神经损伤个体的认知功能，重点关注驾驶能力。

name: Alexa Tompary
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
areas: Neural bases of episodic memory and conceptual knowledge
summary: Studies the neural bases of episodic memory and conceptual knowledge, using fMRI and TMS to understand memory consolidation and the interaction between episodic memory and concept knowledge.
summary_zh: 研究情景记忆和概念知识的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）来理解记忆巩固以及情景记忆与概念知识之间的相互作用。

name: Fengqing Zoe Zhang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Develops multimodal integrative approaches and advanced statistical methods to study brain development and aging, neurodegenerative diseases, and psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 开发多模态集成方法和高级统计方法，研究大脑发育与老化、神经退行性疾病和精神障碍。

name: Eric A. Zillmer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Carl R. Pacifico Professor of Neuropsychology
summary: Studies the psychology of happiness, military psychology, and sport psychology, focusing on the meaning of happiness and its applications.
summary_zh: 研究幸福心理学、军事心理学和运动心理学，关注幸福的意义及其应用。

name: Khaleel A. Razak
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using functional MRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用功能性磁共振成像和行为实验。

name: Stephen Antonoplis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social interactions influence individual behavior and self-perception.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响个体行为和自我感知。

name: M. Alejandra Arce
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies resilience and resistance in immigrant and BIPOC youth through strengths-based and community-engaged research.
summary_zh: 研究移民和BIPOC青少年的韧性与反抗，通过基于优势和社区参与的研究。

name: Olivia E Atherton
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes, using lab managers and undergraduate research assistants.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，使用实验室经理和本科生研究助理。

name: Ian Ballard
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies decision-making processes and their neural basis using behavioral experiments and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程及其神经基础，使用行为实验和神经成像技术。

name: Ilana J Bennett
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies age-related differences in learning and memory using neuroimaging techniques in various age groups.
summary_zh: 研究不同年龄段学习和记忆差异的认知神经科学方法。

name: Diamond Bravo
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies organizational behavior and decision-making processes in the workplace.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为和工作场所的决策过程。

name: Gene Brewer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies consumer behavior and decision-making processes, using experimental methods in marketing psychology.
summary_zh: 研究消费者行为和决策过程，使用营销心理学中的实验方法。

name: Jimmy Calanchini
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social and spatial cognition, examining how people navigate and understand social spaces.
summary_zh: 研究社会与空间认知，探讨人们如何导航和理解社会空间。

name: Cecilia Cheung
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how children develop across cultural contexts, examining roles of parents, teachers, and peers in academic and emotional adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究文化背景下儿童的发展，考察父母、教师和同伴在儿童学业和情绪调整中的作用。

name: Kiera Midori Coulter
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies youth development using psychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究青少年发展，使用心理学方法。

name: Liz Davis
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: By Appointment
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies business psychology phenomena, using various methods.
summary_zh: 研究商业心理学现象，使用多种方法。

name: Halle Dimsdale-Zucker
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how context influences human memory and brain representation of memories using behavioral, computational, and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究上下文如何影响人类记忆及其在大脑中的表征，采用行为学、计算建模和脑成像技术。

name: John M. Franchak
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants learn through perception and action, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿通过知觉和动作学习的认知发展机制，使用行为实验方法。

name: Anubhuti Goel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how the brain links different features of stimuli to complex behavior, focusing on sensory discrimination.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何将不同刺激特征联系起来产生复杂行为，重点在于感觉辨别。

name: Peter W Hickmott
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural basis, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和记忆。

name: Kelly J. Huffman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the effects of prenatal alcohol exposure on gene expression and behavior in mice, with a focus on epigenetic inheritance and prevention.
summary_zh: 研究孕期酒精暴露对小鼠基因表达和行为的影响，重点关注表观遗传继承和预防机制。

name: Brent Hughes
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies social neuroscience, focusing on how social interactions affect brain function and behavior.
summary_zh: 社会认知神经科学，研究社会互动如何影响大脑功能和行为。

name: Na Yeon Kim
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how attention and perception vary across individuals and neurodevelopmental conditions like autism spectrum disorder, using behavioral assessments, eye-tracking, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和知觉在个体和自闭症等神经发育障碍中的变化，使用行为评估、眼动追踪和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Edward Korzus
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms involved in learning and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制在学习和记忆中的作用。

name: Aerika Brittian Loyd
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies youth health and development using psychological methods.
summary_zh: 研究青年健康与发展，使用心理学方法。

name: Sonja Lyubomirsky
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how positive activities contribute to well-being, using surveys and experimental designs.
summary_zh: 研究积极活动如何促进幸福感，使用调查和实验设计。

name: Kalina J. Michalska
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and emotional processes using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 使用神经成像技术研究认知和情绪过程。

name: Misaki Natsuaki
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies business psychology, focusing on organizational behavior and management.
summary_zh: 研究组织心理学，专注于组织行为和管理。

name: Holly O'Rourke
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and decision-making in business settings.
summary_zh: 研究商业环境中的认知过程和决策制定。

name: Bernardette J. Pinetta
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how identities influence resistance and empowerment, using qualitative and quantitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究身份如何影响抵抗和赋能，使用定性和定量方法。

name: Deepa L Ramamurthy
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和记忆。

name: Rebekah Richert
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Megan L. Robbins
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and decision-making, using behavioral experiments and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和决策制定，使用行为实验和计算模型。

name: David A. Rosenbaum
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Distinguished Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive processes, including attention and memory, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，包括注意力和记忆，使用行为实验。

name: Tabea Springstein
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies emotional development in children using behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童情绪发展，使用行为方法。

name: Kate Sweeny
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social support affects well-being and motivation, using surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究社会支持如何影响幸福感和动机，使用调查和实验方法。

name: Tom Sy
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies leadership and group dynamics, focusing on how groups form and function.
summary_zh: 研究领导与团体动态，关注团体的形成与运作。

name: Rachel Wu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies organizational behavior and decision-making processes in the workplace.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为和工作场所的决策过程。

name: Tuppett M. Yates
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how adversity affects cognitive and emotional development in foster youth, using psychological assessments and interviews.
summary_zh: 研究逆境对寄养儿童认知和情绪发展的影响，使用心理评估和访谈方法。

name: Weiwei Zhang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies business psychology, focusing on organizational behavior and management.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为与管理，侧重于商业心理学。

name: Polly Campbell
title: Associate Professor, Dept. of EEOB
summary: Studies the evolution of behavior and cognition in animals, focusing on communication and social interactions.
summary_zh: 研究动物行为和认知的进化，重点关注交流和社会互动。

name: Djurdjica Coss
title: Professor, Biomedical Sciences
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in rodents using electrophysiology and behavioral assays.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用电生理学和行为测试方法。

name: Margarita Curras-Collazo
title: Professor of Neuroscience
summary: Studies molecular and cellular mechanisms of learning and memory in neurons.
summary_zh: 研究神经元中学习和记忆的分子和细胞机制。

name: Iryna Ethell
title: Professor, Biomedical Sciences
summary: Studies the role of neurogenesis in brain function and repair, using rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究神经发生在大脑功能和修复中的作用，使用啮齿动物模型。

name: Theodore Garland
title: Distinguished Professor, Dept. of EEOB
summary: Studies the evolution of physiological traits in animals, using comparative methods across species.
summary_zh: 研究动物生理特征的进化，使用跨物种比较方法。

name: Xuecai Ge
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies primary cilium and neurodevelopment, focusing on cellular structures important for brain development.
summary_zh: 研究初级纤毛和神经发育，关注对大脑发育至关重要的细胞结构。

name: Wendy Saltzman
title: Professor, Dept. of EEOB
summary: Studies the evolution of behavior and cognition in animals, focusing on communication and social behavior.
summary_zh: 研究动物行为和认知的进化，重点关注交流和社会行为。

name: Seema K. Tiwari-Woodruff
title: Professor, Biomedical Sciences
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using computational models and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

name: Shahab Vahdat
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies recovery from stroke, focusing on neurorehabilitation techniques and brain plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究中风后的恢复，重点在于神经康复技术和大脑可塑性。

name: Elissa Aminoff
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how visual information is processed in the brain and expressed through behavior using neuroimaging techniques and computational models.
summary_zh: 研究视觉信息在大脑中的处理及其通过行为的表达，使用神经影像技术和计算模型。

name: Rachel Annunziato
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies health behaviors and transitions in medically-ill adolescents, developing interventions to improve quality of life and medication adherence.
summary_zh: 研究医病共病青少年的健康行为和过渡，开发提高生活质量及药物依从性的干预措施。

name: Joshua L. Brown
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the social, emotional, and academic development of diverse, urban youth through school-based interventions in classroom settings.
summary_zh: 研究多元背景的城市青少年的社会、情感和学术发展，通过学校干预措施在教室环境中进行。

name: Natasha L. Burke
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies eating- and weight-related disparities among multiply marginalized children, adolescents, and emerging adults, focusing on measurement, models, and interventions.
summary_zh: 研究多重边缘化儿童、青少年和新兴成年人的饮食和体重相关差异，重点关注测量、模型和干预措施。

name: Heining Cham
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the impact of discrimination and social-environmental factors on adolescent substance use and sleep, using statistical methods like structural equation modeling.
summary_zh: 研究歧视和社会环境因素对青少年物质使用和睡眠的影响，使用结构方程建模等统计方法。

name: Christopher Conway
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the development of borderline personality disorder, anxiety, and depression, focusing on momentary links between personality processes and self-injurious behaviors, distress tolerance, and.
summary_zh: 研究边缘型人格障碍、焦虑和抑郁的发展，关注个性过程与自伤行为之间的瞬时联系、耐受压力的能力以及个性维度。

name: Leah Feuerstahler
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops psychometric models and applies Bayesian statistics to item response theory, focusing on model specification, fit, and interpretation.
summary_zh: 开发心理测量模型并应用贝叶斯统计方法于项目反应理论，专注于模型的规范、拟合和解释。

name: Celia B. Fisher
title: Professor
summary: Studies ethical issues and well-being of vulnerable populations, including LGBTQ+ youth, ethnic minority youth, and persons with HIV and substance use disorders.
summary_zh: 研究LGBTQ+青少年、少数民族青少年以及艾滋病和药物滥用患者等弱势群体的伦理问题和福祉。

name: Selin Gülgöz
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children with diverse identities construct social categories and their attitudes towards social groups, focusing on gender cognition and social status hierarchies.
summary_zh: 研究具有不同身份的儿童如何构建社会类别及其对社会群体的态度，重点关注性别认知和社会地位等级。

name: David Marcotte
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the relationship between socialization and personality, focusing on self-determination in underprivileged groups, especially in the context of trauma and substance abuse.
summary_zh: 研究社会化与个性之间的关系，特别是在创伤和药物滥用背景下，关注弱势群体的自我决定。

name: Alfonso J. Martinez
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies latent variable and psychometric modeling using Bayesian inference and longitudinal data analysis.
summary_zh: 研究潜在变量和心理测量模型，使用贝叶斯推断和纵向数据分析。

name: Betsy McCoach
title: Anne Anastasi Professor of Psychometrics and Quantitative Psychology
summary: Develops psychometric and quantitative methods for assessing and modeling educational outcomes, particularly in gifted education.
summary_zh: 开发心理测量和定量方法，评估和建模教育成果，特别是在天才教育方面。

name: Haruka Minami
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how smoking cessation interventions can reduce health disparities in vulnerable populations, focusing on affect and stress.
summary_zh: 研究如何通过干预措施减少易感人群中吸烟戒断的健康不平等现象，重点关注情绪和压力的作用。

name: Andrew Rasmussen
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychosocial needs and assessment of displaced populations, focusing on trauma and stress in humanitarian disasters.
summary_zh: 研究流离失所人群的心理社会需求和评估，重点关注人道主义灾难中的创伤和压力。

name: Monica Rivera Mindt
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive aging and Alzheimer's disease in under-studied populations, using plasma and digital biomarkers.
