summary_zh: 研究认知老化和阿尔茨海默病在未充分研究的人群中的作用，使用血浆和数字生物标志物。

name: Barry Rosenfeld
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies violence risk assessment and cross-cultural applications of forensic assessment techniques, evaluating tools for determining when thorough violence risk assessments are needed.
summary_zh: 研究暴力风险评估和司法评估技术的跨文化应用，评估确定何时需要进行彻底的暴力风险评估的工具。

name: Amy Roy
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies emotion dysregulation in youth, focusing on physiological and cognitive factors, and their impact on parental responses.
summary_zh: 研究儿童情绪调节障碍，关注生理和认知因素及其对父母反应的影响。

name: Karen Siedlecki
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies age-related differences in cognition and memory, and the impact of Long COVID on cognitive functioning.
summary_zh: 研究年龄相关认知和记忆的变化，以及长新冠对认知功能的影响。

name: Jing Tian
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how children develop mathematical and spatial skills, and their impact on STEM outcomes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童数学和空间技能的发展及其对STEM成果的影响。

name: Lindsay Till Hoyt
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how social and environmental factors affect adolescent health and well-being, using stress biology and participatory research methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会和环境因素如何影响青少年的健康和福祉，使用压力生物学和参与式研究方法。

name: Therese L. Todd
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies mental health disparities in the criminal legal system, focusing on non-police response programs for mental health crises.
summary_zh: 研究刑事司法系统中的心理健康不平等现象，重点关注应对心理健康危机的非警察替代响应项目。

name: Tiffany Yip
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies ethnic identity, discrimination, and sleep among minority adolescents and young adults, linking these factors to psychological adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究少数族裔青少年和年轻人的族裔身份、歧视和睡眠对其心理适应的影响。

name: Molly E. Zimmerman
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive and sleep disturbances, focusing on their impacts on learning and memory in adults and children.
summary_zh: 研究认知和睡眠障碍对成人和儿童学习和记忆的影响。

name: Austin Baldwin
title: Professor
summary: Studies the affective, cognitive, and motivational factors influencing health behaviors, particularly physical activity and vaccinations, through laboratory and field experiments.
summary_zh: 研究影响健康行为（如体育锻炼和疫苗接种）的情感、认知和动机因素，通过实验室和实地实验进行探索。

name: Holly Bowen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how affective states influence memory formation and retrieval using behavioral paradigms, computational modeling, ERP, and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究情绪状态如何影响记忆形成和检索，使用行为范式、计算建模、ERP 和 fMRI 等方法。

name: Michael Chmielewski
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates psychological tests and measures to understand psychopathology and personality traits.
summary_zh: 开发和评估心理测试和量表，以理解心理障碍和人格特质。

name: Frank He
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the hierarchical structure of mental health and measurement invariance/equivalence in historically under-represented populations.
summary_zh: 研究心理健康层次结构和测量不变性/等效性在历史上被忽视的群体中。

name: Nathan W. Hudson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how people's personalities change over time and their attempts to change them, focusing on volitional personality change in adult attachment and social cognition.
summary_zh: 研究成年人个性随时间的变化及其试图改变个性的努力，重点是自愿性个性变化、成人依恋和社会认知。

name: Akihito Kamata
title: Mary Elizabeth Holdsworth Endowed Professor
summary: Develops and implements item-level test data analysis methods using item response theory, multilevel modeling, and structural equation modeling.
summary_zh: 开发和实施项目反应理论、多层次建模和结构方程建模等项目级测试数据分析方法。

name: Chrystyna Kouros
title: Professor
summary: Studies the role of family relationships in shaping mental health across development, focusing on interparental conflict and parental depression.
summary_zh: 研究家庭关系在不同发展阶段对心理健康的影响，重点关注父母间的冲突和母性抑郁。

name: Sarah Kucker
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how infants and toddlers learn words from digital media, using dynamic systems approaches to examine individual differences and environmental influences.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿通过数字媒体学习词汇的过程，采用动态系统方法考察个体差异和环境因素的影响。

name: Renee McDonald
title: Professor
summary: Studies the impact of family conflict and violence on children's psychological adjustment and develops interventions for children exposed to violence.
summary_zh: 研究家庭冲突和暴力对儿童心理适应的影响，并开发针对受暴力影响儿童的干预措施。

name: Thomas Ritz
title: University Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the psychobiology of emotion, stress, and chronic disease, focusing on respiratory disease, anxiety disorders, and depression.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、压力和慢性疾病的神经生物学，重点关注呼吸道疾病、焦虑障碍和抑郁障碍。

name: David Rosenfield
title: Professor
summary: Applies advanced statistical methods like hierarchical linear modeling and structural equation modeling to longitudinal data to understand individual change over time.
summary_zh: 应用高级统计方法（如分层线性模型和结构方程模型）对纵向数据进行分析，以理解个体随时间的变化过程。

name: Rebecca Ashare
title: Professor
summary: Studies health behaviors and outcomes among people with HIV and cancer, focusing on tobacco and cannabis use, and mental health services in the Black community.
summary_zh: 研究HIV和癌症患者的行为和结果，重点关注烟草和大麻使用以及黑人社区的心理健康服务。

name: Julie Bowker
title: Professor
summary: Studies how peer relationships influence social and emotional development, focusing on risk and protective factors for internalizing and externalizing problems in children and adolescents.
summary_zh: 研究同伴关系如何影响儿童和青少年的社会和情绪发展，重点关注内部化和外部化问题的风险和保护因素。

name: Federica Bulgarelli
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how learners process variable linguistic input, focusing on infants and adults using eye-tracking and corpus methods.
summary_zh: 研究学习者如何处理语言输入的变异性，重点关注婴儿和成人，使用眼动追踪和语料库方法。

name: Andrés Buxó-Lugo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people produce and comprehend language, focusing on the integration of semantic, syntactic, and phonological information, and the role of prosody in language processing.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何产生和理解语言，重点关注语义、句法和音节信息的整合以及语调在语言处理中的作用。

name: Kim Chaney
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how lay beliefs about prejudice affect marginalized and privileged group members, and how prejudice confrontations impact health and allyship behavior.
summary_zh: 研究关于偏见的民间理论如何影响边缘化和特权群体成员的表现、行为和健康，以及偏见对抗如何影响健康和盟友行为。

name: Rebecca Cipollina
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how stigma affects health outcomes in LGBTQ+ and disabled individuals, focusing on identity disclosure and belonging.
summary_zh: 研究社会污名如何影响 LGBTQ+ 和残疾人的健康结果，重点关注身份披露和归属感。

name: Craig Colder
title: SUNY Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the development of adolescent substance use, focusing on individual, family, and community influences.
summary_zh: 研究青少年物质使用的发展，重点关注个体、家庭和社区的影响因素。

name: Kenneth DeMarree
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the impact of certain thoughts, self-views, and emotions on behavior, and how interactions and listening influence attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究特定想法、自我观点和情绪对行为的影响，以及互动和倾听如何影响态度。

name: Micheal Dent
title: Professor
areas: and noise on acoustic communication in mice
summary: Studies how age, sex, and noise affect mouse hearing and vocalizations, using behavioral and physiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究年龄、性别和噪声对小鼠听觉和鸣声的影响，使用行为和生理技术进行研究。

name: Ilan Dinstein
title: Empire Innovation Professor
summary: Develops AI-enabled digital phenotyping techniques to study behavior and neurophysiology in children with autism and other neurodevelopmental conditions.
summary_zh: 开发AI驱动的数字表型技术，研究自闭症和其他神经发育障碍儿童的行为和神经生理学。

name: Shira Gabriel
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people fulfill their social needs through collective effervescence and non-traditional social surrogates like music and books, enhancing wellbeing.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过集体亢奋和音乐、书籍等非传统社交替代品满足社交需求，从而提升幸福感。

name: Larry Hawk
title: Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the mechanisms of smoking and vaping cessation, focusing on withdrawal, motivation, and psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究吸烟和电子烟戒断机制，重点关注戒断症状、动机和心理生理学。

name: Gregory Loney
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neurophysiological mechanisms of drug abuse and overeating, focusing on the insular cortex and its role in motivated behavior.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾行为和过度进食的神经生理机制，重点关注杏仁核在动机行为中的作用。

name: Paul Meyer
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the brain’s reward circuitry in appetitive learning and drug addiction, using behavioral and neurophysiological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究奖赏回路在可获得学习和药物成瘾中的作用，使用行为和体内神经生理学技术。

name: Sandra Murray
title: Professor
summary: Studies how motivations to feel safe and perceive value in partners shape affect, cognition, and behavior in adult close relationships, using motivated cognition and person by situation interactions.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣关系中对安全和价值的动机如何影响情感、认知和行为，采用动机认知和情境互动的视角。

name: Jamie M. Ostrov
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of aggressive behavior in children using multiple methods and informants, including psychophysiology and biological markers.
summary_zh: 研究儿童攻击行为的发展，使用多种方法和信息源，包括心理生理学和生物标志物。

name: Lora Park
title: Professor
summary: Studies how self-esteem and lay theories affect motivation, well-being, and relationships, using experimental and daily diary methods.
summary_zh: 研究自我价值感和常识理论如何影响动机、幸福感和人际关系，使用实验和日常日记方法。

name: Matthew Paul
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how hormones and the brain shape social and emotional behavior in rats and hamsters, focusing on sex differences during adolescence.
summary_zh: 研究激素和大脑如何塑造啮齿动物（大鼠和旱獭）的社会和情感行为，重点关注青春期的性别差异。

name: Michael J. Poulin
title: Associate Professor
areas: physical and psychological adjustment to stress and trauma
summary: Studies how people respond to adversity, focusing on empathy, compassion, and their effects on health and well-being.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对逆境，重点关注同理心和同情心对健康和福祉的影响。

name: Hollen Reischer
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people make meaning of their lives through narrative identity, focusing on self-transcendence and acceptance, and their impact on psychological well-being.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过叙事身份赋予生活意义，重点关注自我超越和接纳对心理福祉的影响。

name: John Roberts
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the role of psychosocial factors in depression, including self-esteem, attachment, and coping, and examines how physical environments like green space and air pollution affect mental health.
summary_zh: 研究心理社会因素在抑郁症中的作用，包括自尊、依恋和应对策略，并探讨物理环境如绿地和空气污染对心理健康的影响。

name: Rebecca Schwartz-Mette
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the social context of adolescent internalizing distress and self-destructive behaviors, focusing on peer interactions and emotion regulation strategies.
summary_zh: 研究青少年内部化困扰和自毁行为的社会背景，重点关注同伴互动和情绪调节策略。

name: Mark Seery
title: Professor
summary: Studies stress and coping, examining how self-esteem and past adversity influence resilience and vulnerability.
summary_zh: 研究压力和应对策略，探讨自尊和过往逆境如何影响韧性与脆弱性。

name: David W. Shucard
title: Professor of Neurology, Pediatrics and Psychology
summary: Studies the neural basis of cognitive control and attention in healthy and impaired individuals using electrophysiology and MRI.
summary_zh: 研究健康和受损个体的认知控制和注意力的神经基础，使用电生理学和MRI方法。

name: Leonard Simms
title: Professor
summary: Studies personality and psychopathology using item response theory and computerized adaptive testing, focusing on personality disorders and psychometrics.
summary_zh: 研究人格和心理障碍，使用项目反应理论和计算机自适应测试，重点关注人格障碍和心理测量学。

name: Ann-Marie Torregrossa
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how salivary proteins affect taste perception and food choice, particularly for bitter foods, using behavioral and physiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究唾液蛋白如何影响味觉感知和食物选择，特别是苦味食物，使用行为和生理学方法。

name: Anna Klintsova
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies behavioral interventions that enhance neuroplasticity in normal and damaged brains, focusing on fetal alcohol spectrum disorders.
summary_zh: 研究行为干预措施以增强正常和受损大脑的可塑性，重点关注胎儿酒精谱系障碍。

name: Kristen Begosh
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the presentation of information during lectures affects students' memory, using PowerPoint and other graphics programs.
summary_zh: 研究信息呈现方式对学生记忆的影响，使用PowerPoint等图形程序。

name: Stacia Bourne
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies children’s social and emotional development and narrative ways of making sense of autobiographical experiences using self-report, observational coding, and psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会和情感发展以及如何通过自述故事理解个人经历，使用自陈报告、观察编码和生理心理评估方法。

name: Johanna Chajes
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Jasmin Cloutier
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how interracial contact and social status influence social cognition and person evaluation, using fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究种族接触和社会地位如何影响社会认知和人格评价，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图。

name: Mary Dozier
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of early parenting interventions on adolescent brain and behavior, using neuroimaging and biomarker analysis.
summary_zh: 研究早期育儿干预对青少年大脑和行为的影响，使用神经成像和生物标志物分析。

name: Philip Gable
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: is a professor in the Department of Psychological & Brain Sciences at the University of Delawa
summary: Studies the interplay of emotion, motivation, personality, and cognition, using EEG and rTMS to understand motivational processes in daily life and mental health.
summary_zh: 研究情绪、动机、人格和认知之间的相互作用，使用EEG和rTMS来理解动机过程在日常生活和心理健康中的作用。

name: Adrian Gilmore
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the parietal lobe supports memory recognition and the effects of stimulus familiarity on neural responses.
summary_zh: 研究顶叶在记忆识别中的作用以及熟悉刺激对神经反应的影响。

name: Amy Griffin
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of memory using inactivation and electrophysiological recording in rats.
summary_zh: 研究记忆的神经机制，使用在activation和电生理记录方法在自由移动的rat中进行。

name: Adele Hayes
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies mechanisms of therapeutic change in cognitive-behavioral therapies for depression and PTSD, focusing on dynamic systems theory and emotional processing.
summary_zh: 研究认知行为疗法在治疗抑郁症和 PTSD 中的治疗机制，侧重于动态系统理论和情绪处理。

name: Helene Intraub
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults perceive and remember visual scenes, using eye-tracking and memory experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉场景的知觉和记忆，使用眼动追踪和记忆实验，探讨儿童和成人的场景感知和发展轨迹。

name: Lisa Jaremka
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the physiological consequences of loneliness and rejection, linking them to mental and physical health outcomes, particularly in cancer survivors.
summary_zh: 研究孤独和拒绝的心理生理后果，将其与癌症幸存者的心理健康和身体健康结果联系起来。

name: Will Kenkel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neuroendocrine regulation of social behavior, particularly oxytocin and vasopressin in prairie voles.
summary_zh: 研究神经内分泌对社会行为的调节作用，特别是小草原田鼠中的催产素和血管加压素。

name: Dayan Knox
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how stress affects learning and memory, particularly the role of peripheral hormones and cholinergic systems.
summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响学习和记忆，特别是外周激素和胆碱能系统的作用。

name: Jennifer Kubota
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: is an associate professor in the Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences at the University of Dela
summary: Studies how interracial contact influences social cognition and mentalizing ability, using fMRI and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究种族多样性接触如何影响社会认知和心智化能力，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑电图。

name: Jean-Philippe Laurenceau
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Unidel A. Gilchrist Sparks III Chair in the Social Sciences and Professor
summary: Studies how partners in marital and romantic relationships develop and maintain intimacy, using intensive longitudinal methods and analyzing change in individuals and dyads.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣在婚姻和浪漫关系中如何发展和维持亲密关系，使用密集纵向方法分析个体和伴侣的变化。

name: Agnes Ly
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies family dynamics, particularly marital and coparenting relationships, and their impact on child functioning in autism spectrum disorder.
summary_zh: 研究家庭动态，特别是婚姻和共育儿关系，及其对自闭症谱系障碍儿童功能的影响。

name: Stuart McCaughey
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the sense of taste influences feeding behavior in rodents, focusing on individual differences in sweetener preferences and need-based appetites for sodium and calcium.
summary_zh: 研究味觉如何影响啮齿动物的进食行为，重点关注甜味剂偏好和对钠和钙的需求性食欲的个体差异。

name: Peter Mende-Siedlecki
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how perceptions of pain and racial bias influence medical treatment, using fMRI and perceptual experiments.
summary_zh: 研究疼痛感知和种族偏见如何影响医疗治疗，使用功能性磁共振成像和知觉实验。

name: Beth Morling
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how culture shapes human motivation and social life, focusing on where cultural differences are located—within the person or in cultural products.
summary_zh: 研究文化如何塑造人类动机和社会生活，关注文化差异是内在于个人还是文化产品中。

name: Joshua Neunuebel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how mice process social information through ultrasonic vocalizations, using neurophysiology in freely moving animals.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠通过超声 vocalizations 处理社会信息，使用自由移动动物的神经生理学方法。

name: Eric Roth
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies spatial behavior and cognition in reptiles, focusing on navigation mechanisms, sensory integration, and epigenetic influences.
summary_zh: 研究爬行动物的空间行为和认知，关注导航机制、感觉整合以及表观遗传影响。

name: Tania Roth
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how early-life adversity affects behavior through epigenetic changes in DNA, using behavioral and developmental approaches.
summary_zh: 研究早期逆境如何通过DNA表观遗传变化影响行为，采用行为和发展方法。

name: Naomi Samimi-Sadeh
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of impulse control and self-regulation, using neuroimaging and clinical samples.
summary_zh: 研究冲动控制和自我调节的神经生物学机制，使用神经成像和临床样本。

name: Keith Schneider
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the visual subcortex and its role in attention, perception, and awareness, using MRI and psychophysics in both normal and clinical populations.
summary_zh: 研究人类视觉系统的结构与注意、感知和意识功能之间的关系，使用MRI和心理物理学方法，包括正常和临床人群。

name: Manuel Schottdorf
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how learned knowledge changes perception using computational techniques, electrophysiology, and virtual reality.
summary_zh: 研究已学习的知识如何改变知觉，使用计算技术、电生理学和虚拟现实。

name: Jaclyn Schwarz
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how early-life immune activation disrupts neural circuits controlling learning, with a focus on sex differences.
summary_zh: 研究早期免疫激活如何扰乱控制学习的大脑回路，并关注性别差异。

name: Jeffrey Spielberg
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the developmental mechanisms leading to adolescent anxiety and depression, focusing on brain circuitry and pubertal factors.
summary_zh: 研究青春期焦虑和抑郁的发展机制，重点关注大脑电路和青春期因素。

name: Maryam Vaziri-Pashkam
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of real-time object interaction and social prediction using neuroimaging and computational methods.
summary_zh: 研究实时物体交互和社会预测的神经机制，使用神经成像和计算方法。

name: Timothy Vickery
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies visual perception, attention, and working memory using behavioral experiments and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知、注意力和工作记忆，使用行为实验和功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）。

name: Anjana Bhat
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Physical Therapy
summary: Studies physical therapy interventions for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder, focusing on embodied rhythm and robotic interventions.
summary_zh: 研究自闭症儿童的物理治疗干预措施，重点关注有节奏的身体运动和机器人干预。

name: Erin Cassese
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, Political Science & International Relations
summary: Studies voter psychology, focusing on the role of gender in political campaigns and elections.
summary_zh: 研究选民心理，重点关注性别在政治竞选和选举中的作用。

name: Roberta Michnick Golinkoff
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor, School of Education
summary: Studies language development, the benefits of play, and preschoolers' early spatial knowledge, using lab and community-based experiments.
summary_zh: 研究语言发展、游戏的好处以及学龄前儿童的早期空间知识，使用实验室和社区实验。

name: Alon Hafri
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Linguistics & Cognitive Science
summary: Studies the connection between language and visual perception, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言与视觉知觉之间的联系，使用行为和神经成像技术。

name: Arild Hestvik
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor, Department of Linguistics & Cognitive Science
areas: Psycholinguistics and cognitive neuroscience of language
summary: Studies how the brain processes language in real time, using behavioral and electrophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何实时处理语言，使用行为和脑电图等电生理测量方法。

name: Curtis Johnson
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor, Department of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies the mechanics of brain tissues using magnetic resonance elastography to understand the structure, function, and health of the brain.
summary_zh: 使用磁共振弹性成像研究大脑组织的力学特性，以了解大脑的结构、功能和健康状况。

name: Amit Kumar
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor of Marketing, Lerner College of Business & Economics
summary: Studies the scientific aspects of happiness and social cognition, examining how people's decisions and behaviors impact their well-being and relationships.
summary_zh: 研究幸福和社交认知的科学方面，探讨人们的决策和行为如何影响其福祉和人际关系。

name: Joanne Miller
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Studies, Political Science & International Relations
summary: Studies the antecedents and consequences of belief in conspiracy theories and conspiratorial thinking, motivations for political participation, and media effects on public opinion.
summary_zh: 研究信念阴谋论及其后果、政治参与动机以及媒体对公众意见的影响。

name: Joint Appointment
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies political psychology and cognitive processes in decision-making, using surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究政治心理学和决策过程中的认知过程，使用调查和实验方法。

name: Masha Gartstein
title: Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
summary: Studies the biological foundations of temperament development, including prenatal stress effects and brain activity measured via EEG, with a focus on infant and child development.
summary_zh: 研究气质发展的生物基础，包括产前压力效应和通过EEG测量的大脑活动，重点关注婴儿和儿童发展。

name: Thomas A. Fergus
title: Associate Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies anxiety disorders and obsessive-compulsive disorder, focusing on metacognitive beliefs.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍和强迫症，关注元认知信念。

name: Fernanda Andrade
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how contexts influence substance use behaviors and self-regulation strategies, using experimental and observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究情境如何影响物质使用行为和自我调节策略，使用实验和观察方法。

name: A. Alexander Beaujean
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Develops methods for studying human variability in personality, cognitive ability, and educational outcomes.
summary_zh: 开发研究人类个性、认知能力和教育成果个体差异的方法。

name: James R. Brockmole
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies how human observers acquire and use visual information, using eye movements to understand cognition and memory.
summary_zh: 研究人类观察者如何获取和使用视觉信息，使用眼动追踪来理解认知和记忆。

name: Sara L. Dolan
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the relationship between neuropsychological dysfunction and substance use disorders, focusing on memory and executive functions.
summary_zh: 研究神经心理功能障碍与物质使用障碍之间的关系，重点关注记忆和执行功能。

name: Gary R. Elkins
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the efficacy of hypnosis and mind-body interventions for sleep disturbances, menopause, and pain, examining physiological and cognitive mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究催眠和身心干预对睡眠障碍、更年期和疼痛的有效性，探讨生理和认知机制。

name: Annie T. Ginty
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how psychological stress affects cognitive, biological, and behavioral changes related to health, using neuroimaging and psychophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究心理压力如何影响与健康相关的认知、生物和行为变化，使用神经成像和生理心理方法。

name: N. Bradley Keele
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the functional role of neuronal excitability in the limbic system, focusing on fear and anxiety disorders using animal models.
summary_zh: 研究边缘系统的神经兴奋性功能，重点关注恐惧和焦虑障碍，使用动物模型进行研究。

name: Brittany Kuhn
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neurobiological states and genetic regulation of vulnerability and resiliency to opioid use disorder using rodent behavioral models.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾性物质使用障碍（如阿片类药物使用障碍）的神经生物学状态和遗传调控，使用啮齿动物行为模型。

name: Shawn J. Latendresse
title: Associate Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the development of alcohol use and related behaviors, focusing on parental socialization and genetic factors.
summary_zh: 研究酒精使用及相关行为的发展，重点关注父母的社会化作用和遗传因素。

name: Christine A. Limbers
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies psychosocial factors and health outcomes in children and their families, developing patient-reported outcome measures and moving evidence-based practices into routine care.
summary_zh: 研究儿童及其家庭的心理社会因素和健康结果，开发患者报告的结果量表，并将循证实践应用于常规护理。

name: Joaquin N. Lugo
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
areas: the relationship between epilepsy and autism
summary: Studies how seizures during neurodevelopment affect learning, memory, and social behavior in children with epilepsy, using molecular and imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究癫痫发作对儿童神经发育期学习、记忆和社会行为的影响，使用分子和成像技术。

name: Francesca Penner
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the effects of parent mental health and addiction on child socio-emotional development, using self-report, behavioral observation, and psychophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究父母的心理健康和成瘾对其子女的社会情绪发展的影响，使用自我报告、行为观察和生理心理测量方法。

name: Wade C. Rowatt
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies personality traits like humility and their relationship with religiousness and prejudice, using surveys and experiments.
summary_zh: 研究谦逊等个性特质与其与宗教性和偏见的关系，使用调查和实验方法。

name: Keith P. Sanford
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies health-related attitudes and behaviors, developing psychometric tools and examining interpersonal influences and diversity issues.
summary_zh: 研究健康相关的态度和行为，开发心理测量工具并考察人际关系和多样性问题的影响。

name: Sarah A. Schnitker
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies virtue and character development in adolescents and emerging adults, focusing on spirituality and religion's role in forming virtues like patience and gratitude.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和成年早期的价值观和品格发展，重点关注灵性和宗教在形成耐心和感恩等美德中的作用。

name: Michael K. Scullin
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how sleep physiology impacts memory, cognition, and health, and investigates prospective memory in older adults and those with early Alzheimer's disease.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠生理如何影响记忆、认知和健康，并探讨老年人和早期阿尔茨海默病患者中的前瞻性记忆。

name: Jo-Ann C. Tsang
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies the psychology of religion, gratitude, and forgiveness, using experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究宗教心理学、感恩和宽恕，使用实验方法。

name: Elisabeth G. Vichaya
title: Assistant Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the mechanisms of fatigue, depression, and cognitive impairment in cancer and diabetes using murine models and interdisciplinary methods.
summary_zh: 研究癌症和糖尿病中疲劳、抑郁和认知障碍的机制，使用小鼠模型和跨学科方法。

name: Charles A. Weaver III
title: Professor of Psychology and Neuroscience
summary: Studies memory and language, confidence and memory, and eyewitness identification using psychological experiments.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和语言、信心与记忆以及目击者识别的认知实验。

name: Michael E Young
title: Professor of Psychology & Neuroscience
summary: Studies decision making in dynamic tasks, focusing on impulsive and risky choice in video game environments.
summary_zh: 研究动态任务中的决策过程，特别是在视频游戏环境中冲动和冒险选择的个体和情境变量。

name: Karen K. Melton
title: Baylor University, Associate Professor, Child & Family Studies Dept. of Human Sciences & Design
summary: Studies the development of social and emotional skills in children using neurophysiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究儿童社会和情感技能的发展，使用神经生理学测量方法。

name: Brittany Tausen
title: Baylor University, Assistant Professor of Social Psychology in the BIC
summary: Studies social influence and persuasion, focusing on how people are affected by others' opinions and behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究社会影响和说服，关注人们如何受到他人意见和行为的影响。

name: Dwayne D. Simmons
title: Baylor University, Cornelia Marschall Smith Endowed Professor, Senior Director of STEM Initiatives
summary: Studies cognitive and social processes, focusing on memory and attention in diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究认知和社会过程，重点关注不同人群的记忆和注意力。

name: Sara Jansen Perry
title: Baylor University, Professor of Management
summary: Studies management and organizational behavior, integrating psychological principles.
summary_zh: 研究管理与组织行为，整合心理学原理。

name: Timothy Barth
title: Associate Dean for Graduate Studies, Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and developmental psychology, focusing on memory and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究认知和发展心理学，专注于记忆和学习过程。

name: Gary Boehm
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用多种实验方法。

name: Michelle Chen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and learning processes.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和学习过程。

name: Brenton G. Cooper
title: Professor -- Neuroscience
summary: Studies cognitive processes and brain mechanisms using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和大脑机制，使用神经成像技术。

name: Cathy R. Cox
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点关注记忆和注意力。

name: Naomi Ekas
title: Professor and Department Chair
summary: Studies cognitive development and social cognition in infants using eye-tracking and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知发展和社会认知，使用眼动追踪和行为实验方法。

name: Javier Granados Samayoa
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using functional MRI and behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像和行为实验。

name: Sarah E. Hill
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development and social cognition in children using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展和社会认知，使用行为实验方法。

name: Danica Knight
title: Professor, Rees-Jones Director of Karyn Purvis Institute of Child Development
summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on social cognition and memory.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知发展，重点关注社会认知和工作记忆。

name: Kenneth Leising
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Justin Luningham
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates, focusing on working memory and attention.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注工作记忆和注意力。

name: Mauricio R. Papini
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and behavior using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和行为，使用多种实验方法。

name: Qinxin Shi
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive development in infants using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿的认知发展，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Uma Tauber
title: Professor and Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用多种实验方法。

name: Xin Zhao
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用多种实验方法。

name: Laura Juliano
title: Professor and Department Chair, Psychology
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral factors influencing drug taking and drug effects, focusing on tobacco and caffeine.
summary_zh: 研究认知和行为因素如何影响药物使用及其效果，重点关注烟草和咖啡因。

name: Jonathan Tubman
title: Jonathan Tubman Professor of Psychology CAS
summary: Studies health risk behaviors, substance use, and mental health problems among adolescents and emerging adults, developing and evaluating prevention and intervention programs.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和新兴成年人的健康风险行为、物质使用和心理健康问题，并开发和评估预防和干预项目。

name: Anthony Ahrens
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between gratitude and independence, integrating social cognitive theory and virtue theory, and examines the consequences of witnessing moral violations.
summary_zh: 研究感恩与独立性的关系，整合社会认知理论和美德理论，并探讨目睹道德违反的后果。

name: Laurie Bayet
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how infants and young children learn to interpret complex visual objects, using EEG, behavioral methods, and computational tools.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何学习解释复杂的视觉对象，使用脑电图（EEG）、行为方法和计算工具。

name: Alice Coyne
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how patient and therapist characteristics can enhance the effectiveness of treatments for depression and anxiety, using psychotherapy and multilevel modeling.
summary_zh: 研究患者和治疗师特征如何提高抑郁症和焦虑症治疗效果，使用心理治疗和多级建模方法。

name: Noemi Enchautegui de Jesus
title: Faculty
summary: Studies stressors affecting low-income individuals, particularly women balancing work and family, and their coping mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究低收入个体，尤其是平衡工作和家庭的女性，所面临的压力及其应对机制。

name: David Kearns
title: Professor
summary: Studies learning, behavior, and addiction through experiments on drug and non-drug reinforcers.
summary_zh: 研究学习、行为和成瘾，通过实验研究药物和非药物强化物。

name: Judy Kim
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between language, thought, and social cognition, using goal inference in moral narratives and shared understanding of color.
summary_zh: 研究语言、思维和社会认知之间的关系，通过道德叙事中的目标推断和颜色共享理解进行研究。

name: Nicole Lorenzo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between parenting and early childhood social-emotional and behavioral functioning, with a focus on early identification of at-risk children and adapting interventions for.
summary_zh: 研究亲子关系与幼儿社会情绪和行为功能之间的关系，重点关注早期识别高风险儿童和为少数民族家庭调整干预措施。

name: Arthur Shapiro
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual perception and neuroscience, focusing on color perception, motion, visual illusions, and low-light-level vision.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和神经科学，专注于颜色感知、运动、视觉幻觉和低光照下的视觉。

name: Christopher Tripoli
title: Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies memory and cognition, teaching courses on these topics.
summary_zh: 研究记忆与认知，教授相关课程。

name: Lisa Velkoff
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

name: Cecilia Alm
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies AI and machine learning for human-AI teaming, multimodal dialogue processing, and affective AI.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能和机器学习在人机团队中的应用、多模态对话处理以及情感人工智能。

name: Matt Altobelli
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive processes such as perception, learning, memory, and problem-solving, using theories and research methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，如知觉、学习、记忆和问题解决，采用理论和研究方法。

name: Joseph Baschnagel
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies the attentional and emotional aspects of addiction, using psychophysiological methods like eye-tracking and physiological measures.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾行为的认知和情绪方面，使用眼动追踪和生理测量方法如眨眼反射、面部肌电图、心率和皮肤电导反应。

name: Christian Bean
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Assistant Professor, Psychology
summary: Studies the onset of depression and anxiety during life transitions using smartphones and biosensors.
summary_zh: 研究生活转变（如青春期、大学入学、怀孕和新父母身份）期间抑郁和焦虑的发作，使用智能手机和生物传感器探索心理适应。

name: Rain Bosworth
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Associate Professor, Liberal Studies
summary: Studies how deafness and sign language experience impact perceptual abilities in infants and children, using visual and tactile exploratory behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究聋哑和手语经验如何影响婴儿和儿童的感知能力，使用视觉和触觉探索行为。

name: Kassidy Colton
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Faculty
summary: Studies human development from conception to adulthood, focusing on cognitive, social, and emotional changes.
summary_zh: 研究从胎儿期到成年期的人类发展，重点在于认知、社会和情绪变化。

name: Kirsten Condry
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Faculty
summary: Studies learning, perception, and cognitive development in children and adults, and develops teaching techniques to improve writing and critical thinking.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人学习、知觉和认知发展，并开发教学技术以提高写作和批判性思维能力。

name: Frances Cooley
dept: School of Psychology and Cognitive Science
title: Assistant Professor, Liberal Studies
summary: Studies how deaf readers use sign language and visual information to read, using eye-tracking experiments to understand reading strategies in this population.
summary_zh: 研究聋人读者如何使用手语和视觉信息阅读，并通过眼动追踪实验了解该群体的阅读策略。

name: Olutosin Adesogan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Examines how systemic racism affects the mental and physical health of Black Americans, focusing on stressors and resilience.
summary_zh: 研究系统性种族主义如何影响黑人美国人的心理健康和身体健康，重点关注压力源和韧性。

name: Josefina Bañales
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how youth of color develop critical racial consciousness in schools and community organizations, collaborating with youth and community partners.
summary_zh: 研究有色青年如何在学校和社区组织中发展批判性种族意识，与青年和社区伙伴合作。

name: Christine Coughlin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children develop constructive memory and its role in future event imagination, reasoning, and creative problem solving using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展建设性记忆及其在未来事件想象、推理和创造性问题解决中的作用，使用行为和神经成像方法。

name: Alexander Demos
title: Clinical Associate Professor, Statistics, Methods, and Measurement Core
summary: Studies the cognitive, perceptual, and social mechanisms of action coordination during musical performances and social interactions, using dynamical systems and time-series approaches.
summary_zh: 研究音乐表演和社会互动中的动作协调的认知、知觉和社会机制，使用动力系统和时间序列方法。

name: Ryne Estabrook
title: Clinical Assistant Professor
summary: Develops statistical models for longitudinal data, focusing on measurement and variability in lifespan development.
summary_zh: 发展心理学中的纵向数据统计模型开发，重点关注生命全程中的测量和变化性。

name: Jin Goh
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social cognition and perception, examining how people understand and interact with others.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知和知觉，探讨人们如何理解与他人互动。

name: Mayra Guerrero
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the development of social skills and emotional regulation in children, using observational and experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童社会技能和情绪调节的发展，使用观察和实验方法。

name: Alex Keinath
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of episodic memory and navigation using techniques like high-yield miniscope calcium imaging in mice, immersive virtual reality experiments in humans, and.
summary_zh: 研究情景记忆和导航的认知和神经基础，使用高产显微钙成像技术（miniscope calcium imaging）在小鼠中，沉浸式虚拟现实实验在人类中，以及计算建模方法。

name: Eric Leshikar
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies aging and memory using fMRI, focusing on social and emotional memory across the lifespan.
summary_zh: 研究老化与记忆，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI），关注生命历程中的社会情感记忆。

name: Rebecca Littman
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social and personality development, focusing on how social interactions shape individual behavior.
summary_zh: 研究社会与人格发展，关注社会互动如何塑造个体行为。

name: Pauline Maki
title: Professor
summary: Studies how menopause and HIV affect cognition and brain function in women, using clinical trials and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究绝经和HIV对女性认知和脑功能的影响，使用临床试验和神经影像学方法。

name: Robin J. Mermelstein
title: LAS Distinguished Professor and IHRP Director
summary: Studies the etiology and cessation of tobacco use in youth and adults, using longitudinal and intervention studies.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和成人烟草使用的原因和戒烟干预，采用纵向和干预研究方法。

name: Kara Morgan-Short
title: Professor, Director of Cognition of the Second Language Acquisition Lab, & Interim Department Head Hispanic and Italian Studies
summary: Studies how working memory and other cognitive processes influence the acquisition and use of second languages, using behavioral and electrophysiological methods.
summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和其他认知过程如何影响第二语言的习得和使用，使用行为和电生理方法。

name: Sohad Murrar
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social attitudes and perceptions can be changed through interventions in entertainment media and social norms messaging to reduce prejudice and promote inclusivity.
summary_zh: 研究通过娱乐媒体和社交规范信息干预来改变社会态度和感知，以减少偏见和促进包容。

name: Michael Pasek
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies intergroup relations, focusing on how religion influences moral decision-making and social attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究群体关系，特别是宗教如何影响道德决策和社会态度。

name: Michael Ragozzino
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of behavioral flexibility in the frontal cortex-basal ganglia circuitry, using pharmacology, neurochemical techniques, and functional brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究前额叶皮层-基底节回路中的行为灵活性的神经基础，使用药理学、神经化学技术和功能性脑成像。

name: Jamie Roitman
title: Associate Professor and Department Head
summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程和神经机制，使用行为和神经影像学方法。

name: Mitchell Roitman
title: Professor, Director, Graduate Program in Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neural basis of adaptive and maladaptive motivated behaviors, focusing on the mesolimbic dopamine system and its role in reward-related learning.
summary_zh: 研究动机行为的神经基础，重点关注中脑边缘多巴胺系统及其在奖励相关学习中的作用。

name: Amanda L. Roy
title: Associate Professor, Director of Graduate Studies
summary: Studies how neighborhoods affect health and well-being, and how social and emotional competencies influence youth development.
summary_zh: 研究居住环境对健康和福祉的影响，以及社会情感能力如何影响青年发展。

name: Kim Schonert-Reichl
title: Professor
summary: Studies how community factors influence child development, using longitudinal studies and surveys.
summary_zh: 研究社区因素如何影响儿童发展，使用纵向研究和调查方法。

name: Jasmin Searcy-Pate
title: Associate Director of OAPS, Clinical Associate Professor
summary: Studies the intersection of mental and physical health, focusing on how psychosocial stressors influence health outcomes, particularly among underserved populations.
summary_zh: 研究心理健康与身体健康之间的交叉点，特别是心理社会压力如何影响不同群体的健康结果。

name: Jessica L Shaw
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies community-based interventions to improve responses to sexual assault, focusing on partnerships and sustainable change.
summary_zh: 研究社区干预措施以改善对性侵犯的响应，重点关注伙伴关系和可持续变化。

name: Dennis Sparta
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Tomas Stahl
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies moral values and epistemic rationality, examining how individual differences and situational factors influence moral beliefs and beliefs about the world.
summary_zh: 研究道德价值观和知识理性，探讨个体差异和情境因素如何影响道德信念和对世界的信念。

name: Jennifer Wiley
title: Professor
summary: Studies how individual differences in prior knowledge, working memory, and spatial ability affect learning, comprehension, and problem-solving, and how collaboration can enhance these processes.
summary_zh: 研究个体差异（如先前知识、工作记忆和空间能力）对学习、理解及问题解决的影响，以及合作如何促进这些过程。

name: Katherine Zinsser
title: Professor, Director of Undergraduate Studies
summary: Studies early childhood education systems and their impact on social-emotional development, focusing on teacher-child interactions and emotion socialization practices.
summary_zh: 研究早期教育系统及其对社会情感发展的影响，重点关注教师与儿童的互动和情绪社会化实践。

name: Jamie Arndt
title: Senior Associate Dean, College of Arts and Science, Professor
summary: Studies how awareness of mortality influences social behaviors, self-esteem, and health decisions, using existential psychology and metaphor analysis.
summary_zh: 研究死亡意识如何影响社会行为、自尊和健康决策，采用存在主义心理学和隐喻分析方法。

name: Debora Bell
title: Department Chair, Professor
summary: Studies graduate education, training, and service delivery in health service psychology, focusing on mental health concerns, licensure, and evidence-based interventions.
summary_zh: 研究健康服务心理学中的研究生教育、培训和服务交付，重点关注心理健康问题、执照考试和基于证据的干预措施。

name: David Beversdorf
title: Professor (Radiology, Neurology, and Psychology)
summary: Studies cognitive effects of stress, pharmacological modulation of cognition, and autism, using fMRI and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究压力的认知效应、药物对认知的调节以及自闭症，使用功能性磁共振成像和神经影像学技术。

name: Jordan A. Booker
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotional, personality, and identity development in adolescents and young adults using autobiographical storytelling.
summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成年人的情感、人格和身份发展，使用自传式叙事作为数据收集方法。

name: Nicole Campione-Barr
title: Professor
summary: Studies family relationships during adolescence, focusing on how multiple relationships impact adolescent development and adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究青少年时期的家庭关系，关注多重关系如何影响青少年的发展和适应。

name: Shawn E. Christ
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and neural processes in typical and atypical development, focusing on neurodevelopmental conditions like autism and PKU, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究典型和异常发展中的认知和神经过程，重点关注自闭症和苯丙酮尿症等神经发育障碍，使用行为和神经影像学技术。

name: Roberto Ulises Cofresí-Bonilla
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies addictive behaviors and alcohol craving using brain potentials and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾行为和酒精渴求，使用脑电图和功能性磁共振成像。

name: Clintin Davis-Stober
title: Frederick A. Middlebush Professor of Psychology
summary: Studies decision-making processes and rationality, using models and experiments to understand how people make choices.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程和理性，使用模型和实验来理解人们如何做出选择。

name: Keely Dugan
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how personality traits and attachment styles change over time, using modern statistical approaches to understand everyday environmental influences.
summary_zh: 研究个性特质和依恋风格如何随时间变化，使用现代统计方法来理解日常环境的影响。

name: Lisa Flores
title: Professor
summary: Studies alcohol addiction and its effects on behavior, using psychological research methods.
summary_zh: 研究酒精成瘾及其对行为的影响，采用心理学研究方法。

name: Brett Froeliger
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural and behavioral mechanisms of substance use disorders and evaluates new therapeutic approaches, including medications, behavioral treatments, and neural stimulation.
summary_zh: 研究物质使用障碍的神经和行为机制，并评估新的治疗方法，包括药物、行为治疗和神经刺激。

name: Nicholas Gaspelin
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies attention mechanisms and cognitive control, using cognitive tasks, eye movements, and ERPs to understand how the brain selectively processes information.
summary_zh: 研究注意力机制和认知控制，通过使用认知任务、眼动和事件相关电位（ERPs）来理解大脑如何选择性地处理信息。

name: David C. Geary
title: Curators' Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies the biological bases of sex differences and mathematical cognition, focusing on children's development.
summary_zh: 研究性别差异和数学认知的生物学基础，重点关注儿童的发展。

name: Ian Gizer
title: Professor
summary: Studies genetic influences on externalizing spectrum disorders, including ADHD, substance abuse, and antisocial personality disorder, using twin and genome-wide analyses.
summary_zh: 研究外部化谱系障碍（包括ADHD、物质滥用和反社会人格障碍）的遗传因素，使用双胞胎和全基因组分析方法。

name: Ashley Groh
title: Professor
summary: Studies the intergenerational transmission of parent-child attachment relationships and the developmental significance of early caregiving experiences for socioemotional development, using.
summary_zh: 研究亲子依恋关系的代际传递及其早期养育经历对社会情感发展的重要性，采用访谈、观察和生理测量等多方法研究。

name: Erin Hennes
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how system-justifying attitudes and beliefs influence behavior and social cognition, using experiments and theoretical analyses.
summary_zh: 研究系统正当化态度和信念如何影响行为和社会认知，使用实验和理论分析方法。

name: Jeffrey D. Johnson
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how cognitive control strategies and re-engagement of thoughts, emotions, and perceptions influence memory retrieval.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制策略和重新激活与事件相关的思维、情感和感知如何影响记忆检索。

name: John G. Kerns
title: Professor
summary: Studies striatal functioning and prediction error processing in schizotypy and psychotic disorders using neuroimaging and behavioral tasks.
summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症谱系障碍和精神病性障碍中的纹状体功能和预测误差处理，采用神经影像学和行为任务方法。

name: Laura A. King
title: Curators' Distinguished Professor
summary: Studies how personality, well-being, and meaning in life are related, focusing on social cognitive factors and intuitive information processing.
summary_zh: 研究人格、幸福感和生命意义之间的关系，关注社会认知因素和直觉信息处理。

name: Sean Lane
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies emotion regulation processes and their effects on health and relationships, using statistical methodologies and power analyses.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节过程及其对健康和关系的影响，采用统计方法和功效分析。

name: Yuyan Luo
title: Professor
summary: Studies how infants understand social and physical worlds, using experiments with infants to explore their cognitive development.
summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解社会和物理世界，通过婴儿实验探索其认知发展。

name: Denis M. McCarthy
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive factors influencing alcohol use disorder and addictive behavior, including genetic, personality, and environmental factors.
summary_zh: 研究认知因素对酒精使用障碍和成瘾行为的影响，包括遗传、个性和环境因素。

name: Quinnehtukqut McLamore
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies social and personality processes, focusing on how social interactions influence cognitive development.
summary_zh: 研究社会和人格过程，重点关注社会互动如何影响认知发展。

name: Ed Merkle
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people aggregate and evaluate subjective probabilities, using forecasting and crowdsourcing methods.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何聚合和评估主观概率，使用预测和众包方法。

name: Samantha Portis
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neuropharmacological approaches to treat substance use disorders in older adults, focusing on neuroinflammatory biomarkers and harm reduction.
summary_zh: 研究神经药理学方法治疗老年人物质使用障碍，重点关注神经炎症生物标志物和减害措施。

name: Amanda Rose
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of friendships and peer relationships in children and adolescents, focusing on gender differences and psychological adjustment.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年友谊和其他同伴关系的发展，重点关注性别差异和心理适应。

name: Victoria Shaffer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how patient decision aids and narratives impact medical decision-making processes, using decision theory and behavioral economics.
summary_zh: 研究患者决策辅助工具和叙述如何影响医疗决策过程，使用决策理论和行为经济学的方法。

name: Doug Steinley
title: Professor
summary: Develops and applies statistical methods, particularly cluster analysis and mixture modeling, to analyze data in social network contexts.
summary_zh: 开发和应用统计方法，特别是聚类分析和混合模型，以分析社会网络数据。

name: Timothy Trull
title: Curators’ Distinguished Professor of Psychological Sciences
summary: Studies mood and anxiety disorders, substance use, and emotional dysregulation using ambulatory assessment methods.
summary_zh: 研究情绪和焦虑障碍、物质使用以及情绪调节障碍，采用随访评估方法。

name: Matthew J. Will
title: Associate Professor / Director, Undergraduate Neuroscience Program
summary: Studies the neural systems mediating the motivational aspects of drug of abuse and natural rewards, using behavioral, pharmacological, and molecular biological techniques.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾物质和自然奖励的动机神经机制，采用行为学、药理学和分子生物学技术。

name: Sara Blaine
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neuroendocrine, immune, neural network, and genomic factors contributing to alcohol use disorders.
summary_zh: 研究神经内分泌、免疫、神经网络和基因组因素在酒精使用障碍中的作用。

name: Tiffany Brown
title: Associate Professor
summary: Develops and evaluates interventions for appearance-based and eating disorders, particularly for LGBTQ+ and male populations, focusing on interoception and body image.
summary_zh: 开发和评估针对LGBTQ+和男性群体的外貌和饮食障碍干预措施，重点关注内感受和身体形象。

name: Chris Correia
title: Professor
summary: Studies the use, misuse, and treatment of psychoactive substances and addictive behaviors, focusing on cannabis motives and substance use among college students.
summary_zh: 研究精神活性物质的使用、滥用及其治疗，重点关注大麻动机和大学生的物质使用。

name: Christopher Dishop
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how modern work environments, particularly those involving AI and remote work, affect employee cooperation and productivity.
summary_zh: 研究现代工作环境，尤其是涉及人工智能和远程工作的环境，如何影响员工的合作与生产力。

name: Travis Evans
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural circuit and motivational system dysfunction contributing to social avoidance in internalizing disorders, using fMRI and TMS.
summary_zh: 研究导致内部化障碍中社交回避的神经电路和动机系统功能障碍，使用fMRI和TMS。

name: Jinyan Fan
title: Professor
summary: Studies the application of artificial intelligence in personnel selection and personality assessment.
summary_zh: 研究人工智能在人员选拔和人格评估中的应用。

name: Samantha Fede
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of psychopathology and high-risk behaviors, using fMRI and neurofeedback with diverse populations.
summary_zh: 研究心理障碍和高风险行为的神经基础，使用功能性磁共振成像和神经反馈技术，针对不同人群。

name: Academic Affairs
title: Faculty
summary: Studies various cognitive and developmental processes through interdisciplinary research and teaching.
summary_zh: 研究认知和发展的各种过程，通过跨学科的研究和教学进行探索。

name: CASE Awards
title: Faculty
summary: Teaches and conducts research, driving intellectual development and knowledge in psychology.
summary_zh: 从事教学和研究，推动心理学领域的智力发展和知识积累。

name: Foreign Credential Evaluations Guidelines
title: Faculty
summary: Develops guidelines for evaluating foreign academic credentials, ensuring equitable assessment.
summary_zh: 制定外国学术资质评估指南，确保评估公平。

name: Tony W. Buchanan
title: Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition & Neuroscience
summary: Studies how stress impacts cognition and decision-making, particularly in relation to addiction and gambling disorders.
summary_zh: 研究压力如何影响认知和决策，特别是在成瘾和赌博障碍方面的生理和行为影响。

name: Eddie M. Clark
title: Professor, Experimental Program: Social
summary: Studies health attitudes and close relationships, examining factors like social support and religious beliefs in African American populations.
summary_zh: 研究健康态度和亲密关系，探讨社会支持和宗教信仰等因素对非洲裔美国人健康的影响。

name: Richard D. Harvey
title: Associate Professor, Industrial-Organizational Program and Experimental Program
summary: Studies the impact of collective identity on social group phenomena such as prejudice and organizational engagement.
summary_zh: 研究集体身份对偏见和社会群体现象（如参与度）的影响。

name: Genevieve Keyser
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive and social processes in online learning environments, focusing on discourse and collaboration among underrepresented populations.
summary_zh: 研究在线学习环境中认知和社会过程，特别是关注代表性不足群体之间的交流与合作。

name: Brenda A. Kirchhoff
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition and Neuroscience
summary: Studies memory formation, self-initiated learning strategies, and cognitive rehabilitation using neuroimaging and cognitive assessments.
summary_zh: 研究记忆形成、自主学习策略和认知康复，使用神经成像和认知评估方法。

name: Janet E. Kuebli
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Developmental
summary: Studies socialization processes in the family, including emotion understanding, behavior, and parenting.
summary_zh: 研究家庭中的社会化过程，包括情绪理解、行为和社会化育儿。

name: Donna J. LaVoie
title: Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition and Neuroscience
summary: Studies how handedness affects cognitive processes, focusing on priming mechanisms.
summary_zh: 研究手部偏好如何影响认知过程，重点关注启动机制。

name: Katherine Luking
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the neurodevelopmental origins of depression and borderline personality disorder in middle childhood and early adolescence using EEG, fMRI, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究中童年期和早期青春期抑郁症和边缘型人格障碍的神经发展起源，使用EEG、fMRI和行为方法。

name: Kimberly K. Powlishta
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Developmental
summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童如何从社会线索中学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

name: Bryan W. Sokol
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Developmental
areas: particularly as young people grow in their empathy
where his studies concentrated on young people’s social
summary: Studies how young people develop empathy, agency, and meaning-making, focusing on social cognition and cross-cultural differences.
summary_zh: 研究年轻人如何发展同理心、自主性和意义建构，重点关注社会认知和跨文化差异。

name: Jill D. Waring
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition and Neuroscience
summary: Studies the interactions of cognition and emotion processing across the lifespan, identifying markers for cognitive decline and mental health symptoms in older adults.
summary_zh: 研究认知和情绪处理在生命周期中的相互作用，识别老年人认知衰退和心理健康症状的生物标志物。

name: Ruth H. Warner
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Social
summary: Studies intergroup relations, social justice, and stereotypes, using social psychology experiments.
summary_zh: 研究群体关系、社会正义和刻板印象，采用社会心理学实验方法。

name: Lisa Willoughby
title: Associate Professor, Experimental Program: Cognition and Neuroscience
summary: Studies memory and attention, and engages psychology majors in research following best practices.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和注意力，并让心理学专业学生参与遵循最佳实践的研究活动。

name: Xiaowen Chen
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Develops and validates assessment instruments for personnel selection and cross-cultural management, applying machine learning methods.
summary_zh: 开发和验证人员选拔和跨文化管理的评估工具，应用机器学习方法。

name: Edward J. Sabin
title: Associate Professor, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies organizational behavior and human resource management in industrial settings.
summary_zh: 研究组织行为和人力资源管理，特别是在工业环境中的应用。

name: Kristin Kiddoo
title: Professor, Experimental Program: Social
summary: Studies how social interactions influence cognitive development in children, using observational methods.
summary_zh: 研究社会互动如何影响儿童认知发展，使用观察方法。

name: Christopher Schmank
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how social aspects of emotion regulation, ostensible observation, and psychosocial stress impact cognitive performance, using psychometric network modeling.
summary_zh: 研究情绪调节的社会方面、显性观察和心理社会压力如何影响认知表现，使用心理测量网络建模方法。

name: Quan Tran
title: Assistant professor
summary: Studies interventions for youth in poverty, focusing on psychosocial and academic development.
summary_zh: 研究针对贫困青少年的心理社会和学术发展干预措施。

name: Mark Blumberg
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
areas: Evolutionary and Comparative Approaches to Behavior
summary: Studies the neural bases and functions of sleep, sensorimotor development, and developmental neurophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠的神经基础和功能、传感器运动的发展以及发育神经生理学。

name: Bengi Baran
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies sleep-related developmental biomarkers of psychopathology and sleep-dependent memory consolidation using EEG/ERP and fMRI.
summary_zh: 研究与心理障碍发展相关的睡眠生物标志物以及睡眠依赖的记忆巩固，使用EEG/ERP和fMRI方法。

name: Bruce Bartholow
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how alcohol affects cognitive control and social categorization, using EEG/ERP and cognitive tasks.
summary_zh: 研究酒精如何影响认知控制和社会分类，使用EEG/ERP和认知任务。

name: Scott Bolkan
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and context-dependent decision-making, linking cognitive dysfunction to psychiatric diseases.
summary_zh: 研究神经回路和情境依赖性决策，将认知功能障碍与精神疾病联系起来。

name: Jeffrey Cockburn
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how value and risk are represented in the brain during decision making, using computational models and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究决策过程中大脑如何表示价值和风险，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

name: Susan Wagner Cook
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how hand gestures aid in mathematical learning and memory consolidation, using various experimental methods.
summary_zh: 研究手势如何促进数学学习和记忆巩固，使用多种实验方法。

name: Ece Demir-Lira
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: F. Wendell Miller Associate Professor
summary: Studies how socioeconomic status affects brain development and academic performance, using brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位如何影响大脑发展和学业表现，使用脑成像技术。

name: Natalie Denburg
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor (PBS/Neurology)
summary: Studies cognitive neuroscience of aging, real-world decision-making, and individual differences in older adults, using neuroimaging and psychophysiology.
summary_zh: 研究老化过程中的认知神经科学、现实世界中的决策以及个体差异，使用神经成像和生理心理学方法。

name: John Freeman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Dewey B. and Velma P. Stuit Professor in Psychology
summary: Studies how the brain learns and categorizes information, using rats and pigeons in experiments on learning and memory.
summary_zh: 研究大脑如何学习和分类信息，使用老鼠和鸽子进行学习和记忆实验。

name: Prahlad Gupta
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between language processing, working memory, and memory mechanisms, using computational and neural evidence.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理、工作记忆和记忆机制之间的关系，使用计算和神经证据的方法。

name: Eliot Hazeltine
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how actions and executive functions interact, using EEG/ERP and brain imaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究动作和执行功能的相互作用，使用ERP和脑成像技术。

name: Andrew Hollingworth
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies attention, eye movements, and visual memory using scene perception and spatial cognition experiments.
summary_zh: 研究注意力、眼动和视觉记忆，使用场景感知和空间认知实验。

name: Kai Hwang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neural, cognitive, and developmental dynamics of cognitive control, using multimodal neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制的神经、认知和发展动态，使用多模态神经成像技术。

name: Jiefeng Jiang
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neurocomputational mechanisms of complex behavior, learning and memory, and aging of executive function using computational modeling and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究复杂行为的神经计算机制、学习与记忆以及执行功能的老化，使用计算建模和神经成像技术。

name: Dorit Kliemann
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the neural basis of social cognition, particularly in individuals with autism, using fMRI and brain lesion studies.
summary_zh: 研究社会认知的神经基础，特别是在自闭症个体中的表现，使用功能性磁共振成像和脑损伤研究。

name: Grazyna Kochanska
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Dewey B. and Velma P. Stuit Professor in Psychology
summary: Studies the development of conscience, parent-child interaction, and child temperament in social development.
summary_zh: 研究良知的发展、亲子互动以及儿童气质在社会发展中作用的认知神经科学。

name: Ethan Kutlu
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor (PBS/Linguistics)
summary: Studies how bilinguals process speech and words, using eye-tracking and EEG/ERP to understand language diversity.
summary_zh: 研究双语者如何处理语音和单词，使用眼动追踪和ERP来理解语言多样性。

name: Ryan LaLumiere
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how learning and memory work in rodents, focusing on addiction and neural plasticity.
summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和记忆机制，特别是成瘾和神经可塑性。

name: Susan Lutgendorf
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Dewey B. and Velma P. Stuit Professor in Psychology
summary: Studies the biobehavioral pathways linking stress, mindfulness, and cancer outcomes, using various clinical and molecular methods.
summary_zh: 研究压力、正念与癌症结果之间的生物行为学途径，采用多种临床和分子方法。

name: Bob McMurray
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: F. Wendell Miller Professor
summary: Studies how children and adults recognize and learn words, using eye-tracking and cognitive neuroscience techniques like ERP, with a focus on language impairment and cochlear implants.
summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何识别和学习单词，使用眼动追踪和事件相关电位等认知神经科学技术，重点关注语言障碍和人工耳蜗植入。

name: Cathleen Moore
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual perception and attention, focusing on object perception and perceptual organization, using visual search and working memory experiments.
summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，专注于物体知觉和知觉组织，使用视觉搜索和工作记忆实验。

name: Isabel Muzzio
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Ronnie Ketchel Professor
summary: Studies how fear, spatial reorientation, and sleep affect memory in mice using single-unit recording and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 研究恐惧、空间定向和睡眠对小鼠记忆的影响，使用单细胞记录和光遗传学技术。

name: Molly Nikolas
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the gene-environment interplay in the development of ADHD and externalizing behaviors, focusing on neurocognitive functioning.
summary_zh: 研究基因-环境交互作用在注意力缺陷多动障碍和外部化行为发展中的作用，重点关注神经认知功能。

name: Isaac Petersen
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies developmental psychopathology, focusing on externalizing behavior problems and self-regulation in children, using EEG/ERP and cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究儿童外部行为问题和自我调节的发展心理障碍，使用EEG/ERP和认知神经科学方法。

name: Jodie Plumert
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how children and typically- and atypically-developing populations perceive and judge affordances, particularly in road-crossing scenarios, using virtual reality and parent-child interaction.
summary_zh: 研究儿童及其异常发展群体在道路穿越场景中如何感知和判断可利用性，使用虚拟现实和亲子互动实验。

name: Jason Radley
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the neural control of adaptive responses to stress and chronic stress-induced structural plasticity in cortical systems.
summary_zh: 研究应激的神经控制及其引起的慢性应激对皮层系统的结构可塑性影响。

name: David Schwebel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control and development of executive functions in children using behavioral tasks and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知控制和执行功能的发展，使用行为任务和神经成像技术。

name: James Traer
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies perception of natural scenes, especially hearing and audiovisual integration, using models and machine learning.
summary_zh: 研究自然场景的感知，特别是听觉和视听整合，使用模型和机器学习方法。

name: Daniel Tranel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: F. Wendell Miller Professor (PBS/Neurology)
summary: Studies the neural basis of higher cognitive functions and personality using lesion methods and functional neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究高级认知功能和人格的神经基础，使用病损方法和功能性神经影像学。

name: Teresa Treat
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies perception, judgment and decision making, and social cognition, focusing on sexual aggression and disordered eating.
summary_zh: 研究知觉、判断与决策以及社会认知，重点关注性侵犯和饮食障碍。

name: Shaun Vecera
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies visual attention and perception, focusing on how attention is directed and controlled during visual search tasks.
summary_zh: 研究视觉注意和感知，重点在于注意力在视觉搜索任务中的定向和控制。

name: Michelle Voss
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies the aging brain and cognition using cognitive neuroscience methods, focusing on the effects of health behaviors on brain structure and function.
summary_zh: 研究衰老的大脑和认知，采用认知神经科学方法，关注健康行为对大脑结构和功能的影响。

name: Edward Wasserman
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Dewey B. and Velma P. Stuit Professor in Psychology
areas: Evolutionary and Comparative Approaches to Behavior
summary: Studies how animals learn and remember concepts, focusing on causation and visual perception, using comparative analysis.
summary_zh: 研究动物的概念学习和记忆，特别是因果关系和视觉感知，采用比较分析方法。

name: Jan Wessel
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
areas: How do surprising events affect thoughts and actions?
How can humans cancel impending movements when necessary?
How can humans identify and correct action errors?
summary: Studies how surprising events impact thoughts and actions, and how humans cancel and correct movements.
summary_zh: 研究意外事件如何影响思维和行为，以及人类如何取消和纠正动作。

name: Paul Windschitl
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Professor
summary: Studies how people make decisions under uncertainty, particularly focusing on optimistic and pessimistic biases in health and medical contexts.
summary_zh: 研究不确定性情境下的决策过程，特别是健康和医疗决策中的乐观和悲观偏差。

name: Debbie Yee
dept: Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies cognitive control and affective neuroscience using computational modeling and brain imaging.
summary_zh: 研究认知控制和情感神经科学，使用计算建模和脑成像方法。

name: Ted Abel
title: Professor, Chair, and Department Executive Officer of Neuroscience and Pharmacology
summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of memory storage and neurodevelopmental disorders using mouse models and transgenic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究记忆存储和神经发育障碍的分子机制，使用小鼠模型和转基因方法。

name: MD Georgina Aldridge
title: Assistant Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies neurodegenerative disorders, particularly Dementia with Lewy Bodies, using systems and behavioral neuroscience approaches.
summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，特别是路易体痴呆，采用系统和行为神经科学方法。

name: Zahra Aminzare
title: Associate Professor, Department of Mathematics
summary: Studies the collective behavior of coupled cell networks, including neural and bacterial systems, using dynamical systems and PDEs.
summary_zh: 研究耦合细胞网络的集体行为，包括神经和细菌系统，使用动力系统和偏微分方程方法。

name: MD Steven Anderson
title: Associate Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral impairments resulting from brain damage, using neuropsychological tests and MRI in patients.
summary_zh: 研究脑损伤导致的认知和行为障碍，使用神经心理学测试和MRI对患者进行研究。

name: Deniz Atasoy
title: Associate Professor of Neuroscience and Pharmacology
summary: Studies neural circuits regulating feeding behavior and metabolism, using optogenetics, electrophysiology, and behavioral analysis in rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究调节进食行为和新陈代谢的神经回路，使用光遗传学、电生理学和行为分析方法，以啮齿动物模型为对象。

name: Biomedical Engineering
title: Professor of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using interdisciplinary approaches.
summary_zh: 研究行为的认知神经科学系统。

name: Basal Ganglia
title: Professor of Biomedical Engineering
summary: Studies the function of basal ganglia in movement and cognition using computational models and neural recordings.
summary_zh: 研究基底节在运动和认知中的功能，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

name: MD Aubrey Chan
title: Assistant Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of anxiety disorders in mice and humans using electrophysiology and transgenic models.
summary_zh: 研究焦虑障碍的神经机制，使用电生理学和转基因模型在小鼠和人类中进行.

name: Inyong Choi
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies neural mechanisms of speech-in-noise processing in normal and impaired hearing listeners, using neuroimaging techniques.
summary_zh: 研究正常和听力受损个体在噪声背景中言语理解的神经机制，使用神经影像学技术。

name: Huxing Cui
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies neural circuits and intraneuronal signaling mechanisms regulating appetite, sleep, and cardiorespiratory function in mice, using advanced neuroscience techniques.
summary_zh: 研究小鼠调节食欲、睡眠和心血管功能的神经环路和细胞内信号机制，采用先进的神经科学技术。

name: MD Brian Dlouhy
title: Associate Professor of Neurosurgery
summary: Studies the neural networks in the brain that influence breathing during seizures, using animal models and children with epilepsy to understand SUDEP.
summary_zh: 研究大脑中影响癫痫发作期间呼吸的神经网络，使用动物模型和患有癫痫的儿童来理解SUDEP。

name: Daniel Eberl
title: Professor - Department of Biology
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of hearing in Drosophila, using genetics, electrophysiology, and behavioral methods.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇听觉系统的分子和细胞机制，使用遗传学、电生理学和行为方法。

name: Sarah Ferri
title: Assistant Professor - Pediatrics
summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying social behaviors and sex differences in neurodevelopmental disorders using behavioral, molecular, and imaging techniques with rodent models.
summary_zh: 研究社会行为的神经机制以及性别的差异在神经发育障碍中的作用，使用行为、分子和成像技术以及啮齿动物模型。

name: Carrie Figdor
title: Professor
summary: Explores theoretical issues in integrating neuroscience and psychology, the relation between human and nonhuman cognition, and ethical implications of neuroscience.
summary_zh: 探讨神经科学与心理学的整合理论问题，人类与非人类认知的关系以及神经科学的伦理影响。

name: Kyle Flippo
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how communication between endocrine tissues and the central nervous system influences motivated behavior and decision-making, using behavioral models and in vivo neural recording.
summary_zh: 研究内分泌组织与中枢神经系统之间的通讯如何影响动机行为和决策制定，使用行为模型和在体神经记录方法。

name: MD Jeremy Greenlee
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cortical mechanisms of human language and vocalization using electrophysiological recording in awake patients.
summary_zh: 研究人类语言和发声的大脑机制，使用清醒患者体内的电生理记录方法。

name: MSc Banu Gumusoglu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how complications of pregnancy affect offspring brain development, focusing on neuroimmune and endocrine factors in the placenta-brain axis.
summary_zh: 研究妊娠并发症如何影响胎儿大脑发育，重点关注胎盘-大脑轴上的神经免疫和内分泌因素。

name: MD Lyndsay Harshman
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies brain growth and development in pediatric chronic kidney disease using MRI and neurocognitive testing.
summary_zh: 研究慢性肾病儿童的大脑生长和发展，使用MRI和神经认知测试。

name: Karin Hoth
title: Faculty
summary: Studies cognitive and psychological changes in adults with chronic cardiopulmonary diseases, focusing on physiological mechanisms and anxiety/depression.
summary_zh: 研究慢性心血管和肺部疾病成人的认知和心理变化，重点关注生理机制和焦虑/抑郁。

name: Taylor Jay
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how neurons and glia work together to form and maintain synaptic connections, using genetic, biochemical, imaging, and behavioral approaches in fruit flies and mice.
summary_zh: 研究神经元和胶质细胞如何合作形成和维持突触连接，使用遗传学、生物化学、成像和行为学方法在果蝇和小鼠中进行研究。

name: Jing Jiang
title: Assistant Professor - Pediatrics - Neurology
summary: Studies the neural and psychological processes of language and emotion in social interaction, using neuroimaging and neuromodulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究语言和情绪的社会互动神经和心理过程，使用神经成像和神经调节技术。

name: Alan R. Kay
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the role of vesicular zinc in synaptic transmission and develops techniques for imaging neuronal activity in the cerebral cortex.
summary_zh: 研究囊泡中锌的作用以及开发成像神经元活动的技术，特别是在大脑皮层。

name: Toshihiro Kitamoto
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the genetic basis of complex behaviors like learning, memory, sleep, and mood using Drosophila genetics and molecular, cellular, and systems approaches.
summary_zh: 研究复杂行为（如学习、记忆、睡眠和情绪）的遗传基础，使用果蝇遗传学和分子、细胞和系统方法。

name: Hans-Joachim Lehmler
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the effects of environmental pollutants on the developing brain, using exposomics and metabolomics approaches.
summary_zh: 研究环境污染物对发育中大脑的影响，使用暴露组学和代谢组学方法。

name: Jia Luo
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of alcohol-induced damage to the brain and its effects on neurodegeneration and behavior, using transgenic models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究酒精对大脑的细胞和分子机制损伤及其对神经退行性疾病和行为的影响，使用转基因模型和神经成像技术。

name: Vince Magnotta
title: Professor
summary: Develops novel imaging approaches and analysis strategies to understand psychiatric and neurological disorders, focusing on diffusion tensor and chemical shift imaging.
summary_zh: 开发新的成像方法和分析策略，以更好地理解精神和神经疾病，重点关注扩散张量成像和化学移相成像。

name: Drosophila CNS
title: Professor
summary: Studies the cognitive neuroscience of learning and memory in fruit flies using behavioral assays and genetic tools.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇的认知神经科学，使用行为测试和遗传工具研究学习和记忆。

name: David Moser
title: Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies vascular disease and cognitive decline in the elderly, assessing decisional capacity in vulnerable populations.
summary_zh: 研究血管疾病和老年人的认知衰退，评估脆弱人群的决策能力。

name: MD Nandakumar Narayanan
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies cognitive dysfunction in Parkinson’s disease using systems neuroscience, in vivo electrophysiology, and neuromodulation techniques.
summary_zh: 研究帕金森病的认知功能障碍，使用系统神经科学、在体电生理学和神经调节技术。

name: MD Kirill Nourski
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the functional organization of human auditory cortex through electrophysiological recordings, focusing on how the brain processes sound and the effects of attention and degraded listening.
summary_zh: 研究人类听皮层的功能组织，通过电生理记录探讨大脑如何处理声音以及注意力和降噪条件的影响。

name: Krystal L. Parker
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the cerebellar contribution to cognition using neurophysiology, pharmacology, and optogenetics in animals, and EEG in humans.
summary_zh: 研究小脑对认知的贡献，使用神经生理学、药理学和光遗传学技术在动物中，以及使用EEG在人类中。

name: Christopher Petkov
title: Professor and Vice Chair for Research
areas: Audio-visual sensory integration for concept formation
summary: Studies the neuronal mechanisms and circuits of learning, memory, and sensory integration in primates and humans, using computational models.
summary_zh: 研究灵长类和人类学习、记忆和感官整合的神经机制和电路，使用计算模型。

name: Rasna Sabharwal
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies brain mechanisms of Alzheimer’s disease, psychiatric disorders, and heart failure using optogenetics, pharmacology, and transgenic models in mice.
summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病、精神障碍和心力衰竭的大脑机制，使用光遗传学、药理学和转基因小鼠模型。

name: Justin S. Sipla
title: Faculty
summary: Studies the evolution of semicircular canals in birds, dinosaurs, pterosaurs, and bats, using imaging techniques to assess functional morphology and correlates with locomotor maneuverability.
summary_zh: 研究鸟类、非鸟类恐龙、翼龙和蝙蝠的半规管进化，使用成像技术评估功能形态并与其运动灵活性相关联。

name: Levi Sowers
title: Assistant Professor of Pediatrics - Neurology
summary: Studies the neurocircuitry underlying migraine and post-traumatic headache, using MRI and optogenetic approaches.
summary_zh: 研究偏头痛和创伤后头痛的神经环路，使用MRI和光遗传学方法。

name: MD Janice Staber
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the effects of cerebral microbleeds and neuroinflammation on brain structure and behavior in hemophilia A using mouse models and neuroimaging.
summary_zh: 研究脑微出血和神经炎症对血友病A患者脑结构和行为的影响，使用小鼠模型和神经影像学技术。

name: MD Hanna Stevens
