title: Professor of Psychiatry
summary: Studies the impact of prenatal stress and environmental factors on early brain development and childhood behavior, using mouse models and family cohorts.
summary_zh: 研究孕期应激和环境因素对早期大脑发育及儿童行为的影响，使用小鼠模型和家庭队列进行研究。

name: Adele Stewart
title: Assistant Professor - Neuroscience and Pharmacology
summary: Studies how sex-biased neuronal architecture affects the behavioral consequences of mental illness risk factors, focusing on dopamine signaling in the brain.
summary_zh: 研究性别的神经架构如何影响精神疾病风险因素的行为后果，重点研究大脑中的多巴胺信号传导。

name: MBBS Lane Strathearn
title: is Professor of Pediatrics and the Division Director for Developmental and Behavioral Pediat
summary: Studies the neurobiology of mother-infant attachment and neurodevelopmental disabilities like autism, using functional MRI and smartphone apps.
summary_zh: 研究母婴依恋的神经生物学和神经发育障碍如自闭症，使用功能性磁共振成像和智能手机应用程序。

name: Seth Tomchik
title: Professor of Neuroscience and Pharmacology
summary: Studies how genetic disorders affect neurodevelopmental processes, learning, and metabolism, using molecular, cellular, and circuit-level techniques.
summary_zh: 研究遗传性疾病如何影响神经发育过程、学习和新陈代谢，使用分子、细胞和神经回路水平的技术。

name: MD Nicholas Trapp
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the physiologic effects of brain stimulation therapies, particularly rTMS, and their applications in clinical trials for psychiatric disorders.
summary_zh: 研究脑刺激疗法（特别是rTMS）的生理效应及其在精神疾病临床试验中的应用。

name: MD Ergun Uc
title: Professor of Neurology
summary: Studies how Parkinson's disease affects driving safety, using cognitive and visual functions to predict risky driving behaviors.
summary_zh: 研究帕金森病如何影响驾驶安全，通过认知和视觉功能预测危险的驾驶行为。

name: Yangyang Wang
title: Faculty
summary: Studies how complex activity patterns in neuronal systems are produced and how they drive animal behaviors, using computational modeling and differential equations.
summary_zh: 研究神经元系统中复杂活动模式的产生及其如何驱动动物行为，使用计算建模和微分方程。

name: MD John Wemmie
title: Professor
summary: Studies the effects of Acid Sensing Ion Channels (ASICs) on behavior in mice, focusing on fear conditioning and anxiety disorders.
summary_zh: 研究酸敏离子通道（ASICs）对小鼠行为的影响，特别是在恐惧条件反射和焦虑障碍方面。

name: MD Aislinn Williams
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of genetic risk factors contributing to psychiatric disorders, using stem cells and transgenic mice.
summary_zh: 研究遗传风险因素对精神疾病分子和细胞机制的影响，使用诱导多能干细胞和转基因小鼠。

name: Virginia Willour
title: Faculty
summary: Studies genetic and epigenetic risk factors for suicidal behavior, using GWAS and epigenetics in post-mortem brain studies.
summary_zh: 研究自杀行为的遗传和表观遗传风险因素，使用全基因组关联研究和死后大脑研究。

name: Chun-Fang Wu
title: Faculty
summary: Studies genetic mechanisms of nervous system function and behavior in Drosophila, focusing on neuronal plasticity, learning behavior, and social interactions affecting lifespan and stress resistance.
summary_zh: 研究果蝇神经系统的功能和行为的遗传机制，重点关注神经元可塑性、学习行为以及社会互动对寿命和应激抵抗的影响。

name: Paul Atchley
title: Professor
summary: Studies cognitive factors related to driving, using behavioral science, cognitive neuroscience, and driving simulation to understand distracted driving.
summary_zh: 研究驾驶相关的认知因素，使用行为科学、认知神经科学和驾驶模拟来理解分心驾驶。

name: Ruthann Atchley
title: Professor and Associate Chair
summary: Studies individual differences in linguistic and emotional processes using event-related potential electrophysiological data and cognitive psychology tools.
summary_zh: 使用事件相关电位脑电图数据和认知心理学工具研究语言和情绪过程中的个体差异。

name: Jennifer Bosson
title: Professor
summary: Studies gender beliefs and their impact on identity, discrimination, and cultural differences, using cross-cultural research.
summary_zh: 研究性别信念及其对身份、歧视和文化差异的影响，采用跨文化研究方法。

name: Judith Bryant
title: Professor and Chair, Psychology Department
summary: Studies language development and pragmatic socialization in preschool children, focusing on lexical innovation and gender-neutral pronouns.
summary_zh: 研究语言发展和学前儿童的语用社会化，重点关注词汇创新和性别中立代词。

name: Anthony Coy
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how partners' behaviors influence each other in romantic relationships and person-pet interactions, using social psychology theories.
summary_zh: 研究伴侣行为如何相互影响以及人与宠物的互动，运用社会认知理论。

name: David Diamond
title: Professor
summary: Studies auditory system plasticity and memory, and uses animal models to investigate cognitive impairments in Alzheimer’s disease.
summary_zh: 研究听觉系统可塑性和记忆，使用动物模型研究阿尔茨海默病的认知损害。

name: Chad Dubé
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies memory and perception using signal detection theory and ROC analysis, focusing on recognition memory and visual short-term memory.
summary_zh: 研究记忆和知觉，使用信号检测理论和ROC分析，重点在于识别记忆和视觉短期记忆。

name: Juliana French
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people choose and maintain long-term relationships, focusing on the role of modern societal factors like hormonal contraceptives.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何选择和维持长期关系，重点关注现代社会因素（如激素避孕药）的作用。

name: Jamie Goldenberg
title: Professor and Area Director, Cognition, Neuroscience, and Social Program
summary: Studies the psychological experiences of women, particularly the objectification of women and its effects on self-perception and health.
summary_zh: 研究女性的心理体验，特别是女性物化现象及其对自我认知和健康的影响。

name: Kenneth Malmberg
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the processes and representations involved in human memory, including aging effects, context-dependent memory, and models of episodic memory and decision making.
summary_zh: 研究人类记忆的过程和表征，包括记忆随年龄变化的影响、情境依赖性记忆以及情景记忆和决策的模型。

name: Jay Michaels
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies how social and cognitive factors influence the relationship between religion, spirituality, and health outcomes, using surveys and cognitive processes.
summary_zh: 研究社会和认知因素如何影响宗教、灵性与健康结果之间的关系，使用问卷调查和认知过程。

name: Jennifer O'Brien
title: Associate Professor and Campus Coordinator
summary: Studies how attention and perception change across the lifespan using behavioral and EEG methods.
summary_zh: 研究注意力和知觉在生命周期中的变化，使用行为和脑电图方法。

name: Tiina Ojanen
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the psychological predictors and social adjustment outcomes of aggression, bullying, and victimization in school settings, focusing on social goals, self-esteem, and empathy.
summary_zh: 研究学校环境中攻击、欺凌和受害的心理预测因素及其社会适应结果，重点关注社会目标、自尊和同理心。

name: Max Owens
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies mood disorders, cognitive control, emotion regulation, and working memory training using EEG and eye-tracking.
summary_zh: 研究情绪障碍、认知控制、情绪调节和工作记忆训练，使用脑电图和眼动追踪技术。

name: Mark Pezzo
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies judgmental biases, particularly hindsight bias and algorithm aversion, using social psychology and decision-making experiments.
summary_zh: 研究判断偏差，尤其是事后偏差和算法厌恶，使用社会心理学和决策实验方法。

name: Doug Rohrer
title: Professor
summary: Studies how different learning strategies affect long-term memory retention in students.
summary_zh: 研究不同的学习策略如何影响学生长期记忆的保留。

name: Wendy Rote
title: Associate Professor and
summary: Studies how individual differences and goals within the parent-adolescent relationship influence interaction and perception, focusing on autonomy development and parental socialization.
summary_zh: 研究亲子关系中个体差异和目标如何影响互动和感知，重点关注青少年自主性发展和父母的社会化。

name: Christine Ruva
title: Professor
areas: my research focuses on applying principles of memory
My research utilizes both quantitative and qualitative (i.e
summary: Studies how pretrial publicity affects jurors' perceptions, emotions, and verdicts, using both quantitative and qualitative methods.
summary_zh: 研究预审报道对陪审团感知、情感和裁决的影响，采用定量和定性方法。

name: Kristen Salomon
title: Professor
summary: Studies cardiovascular responses to stress, psychological and social factors influencing these responses, and their impact on risk for cardiovascular disease.
summary_zh: 研究心血管对压力的反应，影响这些反应的心理和社会因素及其对心血管疾病风险的影响。

name: Elizabeth Schotter
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies the neuro-cognitive mechanisms of language processing and reading comprehension using eye-tracking and EEG.
summary_zh: 研究语言处理和阅读理解的神经认知机制，使用眼动追踪和脑电图（EEG）方法。

name: Jack Silcox
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how the brain processes speech under acoustic challenges using EEG, TMS, and pupillometry.
summary_zh: 研究在噪声挑战下大脑如何处理语音，使用EEG、TMS和瞳孔测量法。

name: Toru Shimizu
title: Professor and Associate Dean for Faculty Affairs
summary: Studies visual information processing, animal cognition, and the evolution of brain and cognition, comparing different species.
summary_zh: 研究视觉信息处理、动物认知以及大脑和认知的进化，比较不同物种。

name: Joseph Vandello
title: Professor and Graduate Program Director
summary: Studies gender anxiety and its implications on men's behaviors and prejudice against gender nonconformers, using social psychology methods.
summary_zh: 研究性别焦虑及其对男性行为和对性别非遵从者偏见的影响，使用社会心理学方法。

name: Tammy Allen
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies work-family balance, remote work, and career development using organizational practices and flexible work arrangements.
summary_zh: 研究工作与家庭平衡、远程工作和职业发展，使用组织实践和灵活工作安排的方法。

name: Georgia T. Chao
title: Professor and Area Director, Industrial-Organizational Program
summary: Studies team dynamics, work adjustments, and the integration of new technologies in the workplace, focusing on exoskeleton technologies and team cohesion.
summary_zh: 研究团队动态、工作调整以及新科技在工作场所的应用，重点关注外骨骼技术与团队凝聚力。

name: Michael Gillespie
title: Associate Professor
summary: Studies decision-making at work and critical thinking, using organizational culture and job attitudes.
summary_zh: 研究工作中的决策和批判性思维，使用组织文化及工作态度。

name: Daniel Griffin
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how effective leadership, social connection, and group identity impact team performance in high-stakes situations, using network-based paradigms and advanced analytical techniques.
summary_zh: 研究有效领导、社会联系和群体认同如何影响高风险情境下团队表现，使用网络范式和高级分析技术。

name: Daphne Xin Hou
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies how people navigate careers and find fulfillment in the rapidly evolving world of work, focusing on career choice, transitions, and adaptability, especially with emerging technologies like AI.
summary_zh: 研究人们如何在快速变化的工作环境中寻找职业发展和满足感，重点关注职业选择、过渡和适应性，特别是新兴技术如人工智能和虚拟现实。

name: Steve W. J. Kozlowski
title: World Class Scholar and Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies team leadership and effectiveness, developing actionable theory and tools for adaptive organizations.
summary_zh: 研究团队领导和有效性，开发可操作的理论和工具，以促进组织的适应性。

name: Claire Smith
title: Assistant Professor
summary: Studies the work-life interface and long-term health impacts of work, focusing on high-risk and high-stress employees.
summary_zh: 研究工作与生活之间的关系以及工作对长期健康的影响，重点关注高风险和高压力员工。

name: Stephen Stark
title: Professor
summary: Develops and applies psychometric methods to improve tests of job performance, personality, and cognitive ability in industrial and organizational settings.
summary_zh: 开发和应用心理测量方法，改进工作绩效、人格和认知能力测试在工业和组织中的应用。

name: Ashley Curtis
title: Assistant Professor, College of Nursing
summary: Studies the bidirectional relationships between sleep and cognition in aging populations, focusing on how cognitive training affects sleep and cognitive functions.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠与认知在老化人群中的双向关系，关注认知训练如何影响睡眠和认知功能。

name: Christina Mccrae
title: Professor, College of Nursing
summary: Studies cognitive and behavioral mechanisms of sleep disorders and their impact on daily functioning.
summary_zh: 研究睡眠障碍的认知和行为机制及其对日常功能的影响。

name: Douglas Bernstein
title: Professor
summary: Focuses on teaching psychology and promoting excellence in the field through workshops and publications.
summary_zh: 专注于心理学教学和促进该领域的卓越表现，通过研讨会和出版物。

name: Zenia Doris Vasconcellos-Bernstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies the relationship between sexuality and identity issues in fatherhood, artificial reproduction technology patients, and seniors.
summary_zh: 研究性身份问题在父亲身份、辅助生殖技术患者和老年人中的关系。

name: Emanuel Donchin
title: Distinguished University Professor
summary: Studies cognitive processes using event-related potentials, particularly the P300 component, with dense electrode arrays.
summary_zh: 研究认知过程，特别是使用事件相关电位（P300）成分，采用密集电极阵列技术。

name: Cheryl Kirstein
title: Professor
summary: Studies the development of addiction and the effects of drugs of abuse on the brain, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
summary_zh: 研究成瘾的发展和药物成瘾对大脑的影响，采用认知神经科学方法。
